translations.translation: (Arambha karicho~) parama karuNAmaYa parama daYAlu AllAhara nAmata|
sakalo dharaNara hAmada (prazaMsA) vizvajagatara rava AllAhara vAve|
yijana parama karuNAmaYa, parama daYAlu|
vicAra diৱsara mAlika|
Ami keৱla tomArei ivAdata karo~, Aru tomAra ocaratei sahAYa prArthanA karo~|
AmAka sarala pathara hidAYata diYA|
teOMlokara patha, yisakalaka tumi niYAmata (anugraha) pradAna karichA, siha~tara nahaYa, yisakalara oparata tomAra krodha Apatita haiche Aru siha~taro nahaYa yisakala pathabhraSTa haiche|
Alipha-lAma-mIma| [1]
eikhana sei grantha; ya’ta kono sandeha nAi, muttAkvIsakalara vAve (eikhana) patha-nirdezaka|
yisakale gAYevara prati ImAna poSaNa kare, chAlAta kAYema kare Aru Ami teOMlokaka yi pradAna karicho~ tAra parA vyaYa kare|
Aru yisakale ImAna poSaNa kare tAra oparata, yi tomAra prati aৱtIrNa karA haiche Aru yi tomAra pUrve aৱtIrNa karA haichila Aru AkhirAtara prati teOMloka pUrNa vizvAsI|
teOMlokei nija pratipAlakara nirdezita hidAYatara oparata Ache Aru teOMlokei sAphalyamaNDita|
nizcaYa yisakale kupharI kariche, tumi siha~taka satarka karA vA nakarA ekei kathA, siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
AllAhe siha~tara hRdaYasamUha Aru siha~tara zraৱNazaktira oparata mohara mAri diche Aru siha~tara dRSTira oparata Ache AৱraNa| lagate siha~tara vAve Ache mahAzAsti|
Aru mAnuhara mAjata enekuৱA kichumAna mAnuho Ache yisakale kaYa, ‘Ami AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna Anicho~’, athaca siha~ta mumina nahaYa|
siha~te AllAha Aru muminasakalaka pratArita kariva vicAre, prakRtate siha~ta nijei nijake pratArita kari Ache, athaca siha~te seYA anudhAৱna kariva noৱAre|
siha~tara antarasamUhata Ache vyAdhi| eteke AllAhe siha~tara vyAdhi Aru vRddhi kari diche, Aru siha~tara vAve Ache kaSTadAYaka zAsti, kAraNa siha~ta michalIYA|
Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa, 'tomAloke pRthiৱIta phAchAda (viparyaYa) sRSTi nakarivA', siha~te kaYa, 'Ami keৱla saMzodhanakArIhe'|
sAৱdhAna! iha~tei phAchAda sRSTikArI, kintu siha~te seYA anudhAৱna nakare|

Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa, 'tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karA, yenekai lokasakale ImAna poSaNa kariche', siha~te kaYa, 'Amio tenekai ImAna Anima neki yenekai nirvodha lokasakale ImAna Aniche'? sAৱdhAna! nizcaYa siha~tei nirvodha, kintu siha~te nAjAne|

Aru yetiYA siha~te muminasakalara lagata sAkSAt kare, tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami ImAna Anicho~’, Aru yetiYA siha~te akalazarIYAkai siha~tara caYatAnasakalara lagata ekatrita haYa, tetiYA kaYa, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara lagatei Acho~’| Ami keৱla upahAsahe karo~'|
AllAheo siha~tara saite upahAsahe kare Aru siha~taka siha~tara avAdhyatAra mAjata vibhrAntara dare ghUri phurAra aৱkAza diYe|
iha~tei seisakala loka, yisakale hidAYatara vinimaYata bhraSTatA kini laiche| kintu siha~tara vyaৱsAYa lAbhajanaka hoৱA nAi, Aru siha~ta hidAYata prAptao nahaYa|

siha~tara udAharaNa sei vyaktira dare, yiYe jui jvalAle| tArapichata yetiYA sei juYe tAra cAriophAle Alokita karile, tetiYA AllAhe siha~tara jyoti apasAraNa kari la’le Aru siha~taka enekuৱA andhakArata eri dile ye, siha~ta dekhivalai nopoৱA ha’la|
siha~ta kalA, vovA, andha| seYe siha~ta Aru ubhati nAhiva|

athavA (siha~tara udAharaNa) dhArAsAra varaSuNara dare, ya'ta Ache ghora andhakAra, vajradhvani Aru vidyutara camaka| siha~te vajradhvanira samaYata mRtyura bhaYata AGulire kANata sopA diYe, Aru AllAhe kAphirasakalaka cAriophAlara parA Aguri Ache|

ene lAge yena vijulIra camakaniYe siha~tara dRSTizakti haraNa kari nivahi| yetiYAi alapa siha~tara vAve pohara haYa tetiYAi siha~ta AgavADha়i yAYa Aru yetiYAi andhakAra haYa tetiYAi siha~ta thamaki raYa| AllAhe icchA karile siha~tara zraৱNazakti Aru dRSTizakti haraNa kariva pArilehe~tena| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
he mAnaৱ sampradAYa! tomAloke tomAlokara sei rava (pratipAlaka)ra ivAdata karA, yijane tomAlokaka Aru tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakalaka sRSTi kariche, yAte tomAloke tAkvaৱAra adhikArI ha’va pArA|

yijane tomAlokara vAve pRthiৱIkhanaka vichanA kari diche Aru AkAzakhanaka kari diche cAlasvarUpa, Aru AkAzara parA pAnI aৱtIrNa kari tAra dvArA tomAlokara jIৱikAra vAve phalamUla utpAdana kariche| gatike tomAloke jAni-zuni kAko AllAhara samakakSa thira nakarivA|

Ami AmAra vAndAra oparata yi aৱtIrNa karicho~ tAta yadi tomAlokara kono sandeha thAke tente iYAra anurUpa kono eTA churA racanA kari AnA Aru AllAhara vAhire tomAlokara sakalo sAkSI-sahAYakArIka AhvAna karA, yadihe tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA|

eteke yadi tomAloke ene nakarA- Aru tomAloke eiTo ketiYAo kariva noৱArivA, teneha’le sei juira parA vAcivalai vyaৱsthA karA, yAra indhana ha’va mAnuha Aru zila, yiTo prastuta karA haiche kAphirasakalara vAve|

Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMlokaka susaMvAda diYaka ye, teolokara vAve Ache jAnnAta, yAra taledi nadIsamUha pravAhita haYa, yetiYAi teOMlokaka tAra parA kono phala khAvalai diYA ha’va, tetiYAi teOMloke ka’va, itipurve AmAka ei dharaNara phala-mUla khAvalai diYA haichila, kAraNa teOMlokaka phalamUla sAdRzyapUrNa kari diYA ha’va Aru teOMlokara vAve tAta thAkiva paৱitrA-saGginI, Aru tAta teOMloka cirakAla thAkiva|

nizcaYa AllAhe maha athavA tAtokai kSudra kono vastura upamA diOMte saMkocavodha nakare| eteke yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMloke jAne ye, nizcaYa eiTo teOMlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA satya| Aru yisakale kupharI kariche siha~te kaYa ye, 'AllAhe ei upamAra dvArA ki vujAva vicAriche'? teOM iYAra dvArA vahutake vibhrAnta kare Aru vahutake hidAYata diYe| Aru teOM phAchikasakalara vAhire Ana kAko iYAra dvArA vibhrAnta nakare|

yisakale AllAhara lagata dRDha় aGgIkArata Aৱddha hoৱAra pichata seiTo bhaGga kare, AllAhe yi samparka aTuTa rAkhivalai nirdeza diche seiTo vicchinna kare Aru pRthiৱIta viparyaYa sRSTi kari phure, siha~tei haiche kSatigrastha|

tomAloke kenekai AllAhara lagata kupharI karA? athaca tomAloka prANahIna AchilA| tAra pichata teৱe~i tomAlokaka jIৱita kariche Akau teৱe~i tomAlokara mRtyu ghaTAva, tAra pichata punara jIৱita kariva Aru tAra pichata tomAlokaka teOMra ocaralaikei obhatAi niYA ha’va|
teৱe~i pRthiৱIra sakalo vastu tomAlokara vAvei sRSTi kariche| tAra pichata teOM AkAzara pine manoniveza kari iYAka sAtakhana AkAzata vinyasta kariche; Aru teOM sakalo vastu samparke savizeSa aৱgata|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAra pratipAlake phiristAsakalaka ka’le, nizcaYa mai pRthiৱIta khaliphA[1] sRSTi karivalai thira karicho~| teOMloke ka’le, tumi pRthiৱIta ene eTA jIৱ sRSTi kariva vicarA neki, yiYe pRthiৱIta viparyaYa sRSTi kariva Aru teja pravAhita kariva? Aru Amito tomAra hAmda sahakAre tachavIha pATha karoৱe~i lagate tomAra paৱitratAo ghoSaNA karo| teOM ka’le, nizcaYa mai yiTo jAno tomAloke seiTo nAjAnA|
Aru teOM Adamaka yAৱtIYa nAmara zikSA dile, tAra pichata seivora phiristAsakalara Agata upasthApana kari ka’le, yadi tomAloke satyavAdI tente moka eivorara nAma koৱA|
teOMloke ka’le, tumi paৱitra| tumi AmAka yi zikSA dichA tAra vAhire AmAra Ana kono jJAna nAi| nizcaYa tumi sarvajJa prajJAmaYa|

teOM ka’le, ‘he Adama, eivorara nAma tumi siha~taka janAi diYA’| tAra pichata yetiYA teOM (Adame) eivorara nAma janAi dile, tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘mai tomAlokaka koৱA nAchilo~ne ye, nizcaYa mai AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra gAYeva (adRzya) samparke jAno? mai seivoro jAno yivora tomAloke prakAza karA Aru yivora tomAloke gopana karA’|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami phiristAsakalaka kaichilo~, tomAloke Adamaka chAjadA karA| tetiYA ivalichara vAhire sakaloৱe chAjadA karichila| si asvIkAra karile Aru ahaMkAra karile| Aru si kAphirasakalara antarbhukta ha’la|

Aru Ami ka’lo~, he Adama, tumi Aru tomAra strIYe jAnnAtata vasavAsa karA Aru ya’ra parA icchA svAcchande AhAra grahaNa karA, kintu ei gachajopAra ocaralaike nAyAvA, anyathA tomAloka yAlimasakalara antarbhukta hai yAvA|

aৱzeSata caYatAne tAra parA teOMlokaka padaskhalita karile Aru teOMloka ya’ta Achila tAra parA teOMlokaka vahiskRta karAle, Aru Ami ka’lo~, ‘tomAloke nAmi yoৱA; tomAloke ijane sijanara zatru; Aru tomAlokara vAve pRthiৱIta Ache nirdiSTi samaYalaike AvAsa Aru bhoga-upabhogara upakaraNa’|
tAra pichata Adame teOMra pratipAlakara parA kichumAna vAkya ziki la’le; phalata AllAhe teOMra tAovA kavula karile| nizcaYa teOM tAovA kavulakArI ati daYAlu|

Ami ka’lo~, ‘tomAloka ATAYe iYAra parA nAmi yoৱA| yetiYA mora phAlara parA tomAlokara ocaralai kono hidAYata Ahiva, tetiYA yisakale AmAra hidAYatara anusaraNa kariva, teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va’|
Aru yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche, siha~tei haiche juira adhivAsI| tAta siha~te cirakAla thAkiva|

he IcharAIlara vaMzadharasakala! tomAloke mora sei anugrahasamUhara kathA smaraNa karA, yi anugraha mai tomAlokaka pradAna karichilo~ Aru tomAloke mora aGgIkAra pUraNa karA, maYo tomAlokara aGgIkAra pUraNa karima, Aru tomAloke keৱla mokei bhaYa karA|

Aru mai yi aৱtIrNa karicho~ tomAloke tAra prati ImAna poSaNa karA| eikhana haiche tomAlokara ocarata thakA granthara satyatA pramANakArI| gatike tomAlokei iYAra prathama asvIkArakArI naha’vA Aru tomAloke mora AYAtasamUhaka sAmAnya mUlyata vikrI nakarivA| lagate tomAloke keৱla mokei bhaYa karA|
Aru tomAloke satyaka michAra lagata mizrita nakarivA Aru jAni-zuni satya gopana nakarivA|
Aru tomAloke chAlAta pratiSThA karA Aru yAkAta pradAna karA lagate rukukArIsakalara saite ruku karA|
tomAloke mAnuhaka satkarmara Adeza diYA Aru nijake pAhari yoৱA neki? athaca tomAloke kitAva adhyaYana karA| tomAloke nuvujA neki?
Aru tomAloke dhairyya Aru chAlAtara dvArA sahAYa prArthanA karA| nizcaYa vinaYIsakalara vAhire Anara vAve i vara kaThina kAma|
(Aru ei kAma seisakala lokara vAve sahaja) yisakale vizvAsa kare ye, nizcaYa siha~te siha~tara pratipAlakara lagata sAkSAt kariva Aru nizcaYa siha~ta teOMra phAlei ubhati yAva|
he icharAIlara vaMzadharasakala! mora sei anugrahara kathA manata peloৱA, yivora mai tomAlokaka pradAna karichilo~, Aru nizcaYa mai tomAlokaka samagra jAtira oparata zreSThatva pradAna karichilo~|
Aru tomAloke seidinaToka bhaYa karA yidinA konoৱei kAro kAmata nAhiva, Aru kAro vAvei madhyastatA gRhIta naha’va lagate kAro parAi kono vinimaYa loৱA naha’va, Aru siha~te sahAYa prAptao naha’va|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami tomAlokaka phiraAunara vaMzara parA rakSA karichilo~| siha~te tomAlokaka nirmama zAsti vihichila| tomAlokara putra santAnaka hatyA karichila Aru kanyAsantAnaka jIYAi rAkhichila, Aru iYAra mAjata Achila tomAlokara vAve tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA eka mahAparIkSA|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami tomAlokara vAve sAgaraka dubhAga karichilo~ Aru tomAlokaka uddhAra karichilo~ Aru tomAlokara cakura sanmukhate phiraAunara vaMzaka DuvAi mArichilo~|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami mUchAra saite calliza rAtira pratizruti laichilo~, teOM (guci yoৱA)ra pichata tomAloke dAmuri eTAka (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karichilA, Aru tomAloka yAlima hai gaichilA|
iYAra pichato Ami tomAlokaka kSamA karichilo~ yAte tomAloke kRtajJatA jJApana karA|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami mUchAka kitAva Aru phurakAna dAna karichilo~ yAte tomAloke hidAYata lAbha kariva pArA|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA mUchAi nija sampradAYaka kaichila, he mora jAti! tomAloke dAmuriToka (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa kari nijara oparata anyAYa karichA| eteke tomAloke nijara prANa nijei visarjana di sRSTikartAra ocarata tAovA karA| eiToৱei haiche tomAlokara sRSTikartAra ocarata tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara| tAra pichata teOM tomAlokaka kSamA karichila| nizcaYa teOM kSamAzIla ati daYAlu|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAloke kaichilA, he muchA! Ami AllAhaka prakAzyabhAৱe nedekhAlaike tomAka vizvAsa nakaro~, phalata tomAloke cAi thAko~tei haThAt tomAlokaka vajrapAte AkramaNa karichila|
tAra pichata Ami tomAlokara mRtyura pichato tomAlokaka punara jIৱna dAna karilo~ yAte tomAloke kRtajJa hoৱA|

Aru Ami tomAlokara oparata meghara chA~ vistAra karichilo~ Aru tomAlokara vAve aৱtIrNa karichilo~ ‘mAnnA’ Aru ‘chAlaৱA’| (kaichilo~) ‘Ami tomAlokaka dAna karA paৱitra (uttama) jIৱikAra parA tomAloke AhAra karA’| darAcalate siha~te AmAra eko anyAYa kariva parA nAchila varaM siha~te nijei nijara pratihe anyAYa karichila|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami kaichilo~, ‘tomAloke ei gAOMkhanata praৱeza kari tAra parA yi icchA Anandacitte AhAra karA Aru duৱArata praৱeza karo~te zira nata kari praৱeza karivA| Aru ka’vA ‘hittAtuna’ (kSamA vicAro~)| phalata Ami tomAlokara aparAdhasamUha kSamA karima Aru satkarmazIlasakalaka Aru adhika (anugraha) dAna karima’|
kintu yAlimasakale sei kathASAraka parivartana karile yi kathASAra ka’valai siha~taka koৱA haichila, phalata Ami yAlimasakalara prati siha~tara avAdhyatAra kAraNe AkAzara parA zAsti aৱtIrNa karilo~|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA mUchAi teOMra jAtira vAve pAnI vicArile, Ami ka’lo~, ‘tomAra lAkhuTiDAlere zilata AghAta karA’, phalata vAraTA nijarA pravAhita ha’la| pratyeka gotrai nijara nijara pAnI khoৱAra ThAi jAni la’le| (mai ka’lo~) ‘tomAloke AllAhe diYA jIৱikAra parA khoৱA Aru seৱna karA Aru pRthiৱIta viparyaYa sRSTi kari nuphurivA’|

Aru yetiYA tomAloke kaichilA, ‘he mUchA! Ami ekei dharaNara khAdyara oparata ketiYAo dhairya dhAraNa kariva noৱArima| eteke tumi tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata AmAra vAve prArthanA karA... teOM yena AmAra vAve bhUmijAta draৱya zAka-pAcali, tiYa~ha, gama, dAila Aru pi~YAja utpAdana kare’| mUchAi ka’le, ‘tomAloke uttama vastura parivarte nimnamAnara vastu vicarA neki? tente kono caharalai guci yoৱA, tAta tomAloke nizcaYa tomAlokara vicarA vastuvora pAvA’; Aru siha~tara oparata lAJchanA Aru dAridratA Apatita ha’la, lagate siha~ta AllAhara gayavara cikAra ha’la| eiTo ei kAraNe ye, siha~te AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichila Aru navIsakalaka anyAYabhAৱe hatyA karichila| avAdhyatA Aru sImAlaGghana karAra vAvei siha~tara ei pariNati haichila|

nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru eidare iYAhudi, nAchArA Aru chAveYIsakalara yiYei AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna poSaNa kare Aru satkarma kare, siha~tara vAve siha~tara pratipAlakara ocarata puraskAra Ache; Aru siha~tara kono bhaYa nAi Aru siha~ta cintitao naha’va|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami tomAlokara parA aMgIkAra laichilo~ Aru tomAlokara oparata ‘tura’ parvata uttolana karichilo~ (Aru kaichilo~) ‘Ami yi (grantha) dilo~ seikhana dRDha়tAre saite grahaNa karA Aru tAta yi (vidhi-vidhAna Aru upadeza) Ache seYA smaraNa rAkhivA, yAte tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariva pArA’|
iYAra pichato tomAloka vimukha haichilA! eteke tomAlokara prati AllAhara anugraha Aru anukampA nAthAkile tomAloka nizcaYa kSatigrasta ha'lAhe~tena|

Aru tomAlokara mAjara yisakale zanivAra (vizrAmara dina) samparke sImAlaMghana karichila siha~taka tomAloke nizcitabhAৱe bhAlakaiYe jAnA| phalata Ami siha~taka kaichilo~, ‘tomAloka nikRSTa vAndarata pariNata hai yoৱA’|
eteke Ami ei ghaTanAka siha~tara samasAmaYika Aru paravartIsakalara vAve eTA zikSAmUlaka dRSTAnta vanAicho~, Aru muttAkvIsakalara vAve vanAicho~ upadeza|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA muchAi teOMra jAtika kaichila, ‘AllAhe tomAlokaka ejanI gAi garu javeha karivalai nirdeza diche’, siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi AmAra lagata dhemAli karichA neki’? muchAi ka’le, ‘mai ajJasakalara antarbhukta hoৱAra parA AllAhara AzraYa vicAro~’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi AmAra vAve tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata duA karA, teOM yena AmAka spaSTabhAৱe janAi diYe ye, sei gAijanI kenekuৱA ha’va lAge?’ muchAi ka’le, ‘AllAhe kaiche, seijanI enekuৱA gAi ha’va lAge yijanI vRddhAo nahaYa kamavaYasIYAo nahaYa, varaM madhyavaYasI| eteke tomAlokaka yi Adeza karA haiche seiTo pAlana karA’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata AmAra vAve duA karA, teOM yena AmAka spaSTa kari diYe ye, tAira raM kenekuৱA ha’va lAge?’ muchAi ka’le, ‘teOM kaiche, gAijanI hAladhIYA raGara ha’va lAge, ati ujjala raM viziSTa, dekhilei yena darzakasakale utphullita haYa’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata AmAra vAve duA karA, teOM yena AmAka spaSTabhAৱe varNanA kari diYe ye, seijanI kenekuৱA ha’va lAge? nizcaYa gAijanI AmAra vAve sandehapUrNa haiche; Aru AllAhe icchA karile nizcaYa Ami hidAYataprApta ha’ma’|

muchAi ka’le, ‘teOM kaiche, seijanI enekuৱA gAi, yijanIka mATi cahAvalai vA khetita pAnI divalai vyaৱhAra karA hoৱA nAi, sustha Aru nikhu~ta’| siha~te ka’le, ‘etiYA tumi satya lai AhichA’| aৱzeSata siha~te gAijanIka javeha karile, yadio siha~te seYA karivalai prastuta nAchila|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAloke ejana vyaktika hatyA karichilA tAra pichata ejane Anajanara prati doSAropa karichilA, Aru tomAloke yi gopana karichilA seYA AllAhe prakAza karile|

tAra pichata Ami ka’lo~, ‘iYAra kono eTA aMzare (arthAt gAijanIra mAMsare) tAka AghAta karA’| eidarei AllAhe mRtaka jIৱita kare Aru teOM tomAlokaka teOMra nidarzanasamUha dekhuৱAYa yAte tomAloke anudhAৱna kariva pArA|

iYAra pichato tomAlokara hRdaYa kaThina hai parichila, yenivA zila athavA tAtokai kaThina| athaca kichumAna zila enekuৱAo Ache yiTora parA nai-nijarA pravAhita haYa, Aru kichumAna enekuৱAo Ache yiTo vidIrNa hoৱAra pichata tAra parA pAnI nirgata haYa, Aru kichumAna Ache AllAhara bhaYata khahi pare, Aru tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha amanoyogI nahaYa|
tomAloke ei AzA karichA neki ye, siha~te tomAlokara kathAta ImAna Aniva? athaca siha~tara eTA dale AllAhara vANI zraৱNa kare Aru siha~te sei vANI anudhAৱna karAra pichato jAni vuji vikRta kare|

Aru yetiYA siha~te muminasakalara lagata sAkSAt kare tetiYA kaYa, 'Ami ImAna Anicho~'| Akau yetiYA siha~te gopane ijane sijanara lagata milita haYa tetiYA kaYa, 'tomAloke siha~tara lagata sei kathAvora kiYa AlocanA karA yivora AllAhe tomAlokara ocarata unmukta kari diche; siha~te iYAra dvArA tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocarata tomAlokara viruddhe pramANa dAGi dhariva seiTo tomAloke vuji nopoৱA neki'?
siha~te nAjAne neki ye, siha~te yi gopana kare Aru yi prakAza kare, seYA AllAhe jAne?
Aru siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA kichumAna nirakSara mAnuho Ache yisakale michA AzAra vAhire kitAva (aizIgrantha) samparke ekoৱei nAjAne, siha~te keৱla amUlaka dhAraNAhe poSaNa kare|

eteke durbhoga siha~tara vAve yisakale nija hAte kitApa racanA kare Aru tAra pichata sAmAnya mUlya poৱAra vAve kaYa, ‘eiTo AllAhara parA (aৱtIrNa)’| eteke siha~tara hAte yi racanA kariche tAra kAraNe siha~tara vAve Ache dhvaMsa Aru siha~te yi upArjana kariche tAra kAraNeo siha~tara vAve Ache dhvaMsa|

Aru siha~te kaYa, 'sAmAnya kichu dinara vAhire juYe (jAhAnnAme) AmAka ketiYAo sparza kariva noৱAriva'| koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAhara parA ene kono aGgIkAra laichA neki, yi aGgIkAra AllAhe ketiYAo bhaMga nakariva? ne tomAloke AllAha samparke ene kathA koৱA yiTo tomAloke nAjAnA?’
haYa, yiYe veYA upArjana kariche Aru tAra pAparAziYe tAka pariveSTana kari rAkhiche, siha~tei haiche jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI, tAta siha~te cirakAla thAkiva|
AnahAte yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru neka Amala kariche, teOMlokei haiche jAnnAtara adhivAsI, teOMloka tAta cirasthAYI ha’va|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami vanI icharAIlara parA pratizruti laichilo~ ye, tomAloke AllAhara vAhire Ana kAro ivAdata nakarivA, pitR-mAtR, AtmIYa-svajana, etIma Aru daridrara saite sadAYa sadvyaৱhAra karivA Aru mAnuhara lagata uttama kathA ka'vA tathA chAlAta pratiSThA karivA lagate yAkAta pradAna karivA, tAra pichato tomAlokara kichu saMkhyaka lokara vAhire sakaloৱe aৱjJA kari mukha ghUrAi laichila|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAlokara parA Ami pratizruti laichilo~ ye, tomAloke paraspare raktapAta nakarivA Aru ejane Anajanaka svadezara parA vahiSkAra nakarivA| tomAloke ei viSaYaToka mAni laichilA Aru tomAlokei iYAra sAkSI|

eteke tomAlokei seisakala loka, yisakale nijara mAjatei hatyAyajJa calAichA Aru tomAlokare eTA dalaka siha~tara nija dezara parA vahiSkAra karichA| anyAYa Aru sImAlaMghanara dvArA siha~tara viruddhe tomAloke ejane Anajanara sahayogitA karichA Aru siha~ta yetiYA vandIrUpe tomAlokara ocarata upasthita haYa tetiYA tomAloke muktipaNa AdAYa kari siha~taka mukta karA; athaca siha~taka vahiSkAra karAToৱe tomAlokara oparata hArAma Achila| tente tomAloke kitAvara kichu aMzaka vizvAsa karA Aru kichu aMzaka asvIkAra karA neki? teneha’le (jAni thoৱA) tomAlokara mAjara yisakale ene kare pRthiৱIra jIৱnata siha~tara vAve ekamAtra pratiphala haiche lAJchanA Aru apamAna tathA kiYAmatara dinA siha~taka obhatAi niYA ha’va ati kaThina zAstira pine Aru siha~te yi kare sei samparke AllAha amanoyogI nahaYa|
iha~tei AkhirAtara vinimaYata pRthiৱIra jIৱnaka kini laiche; seYe siha~tara zAsti akaNo kamoৱA naha’va Aru siha~taka sahAYao karA naha’va|

Aru nizcaYa Ami muchAka kitAva pradAna karichilo~ Aru teOMra pichata paryAYakrame rAchulasakalaka preraNa karichilo~ Aru Ami mAraYAmara putra IchAka spaSTa pramANa pradAna karichilo~ Aru ‘rUhula kuducha’ra dvArA teOMka zaktizAlI karichilo~| eiTo sa~cA nahaYa jAno yetiYAi tomAlokara ocaralai kono rAchule tomAlokara pravRttira viparIta kono vastu lai Ahichila tetiYAi tomAloke ahaMkAra karichilA? tAra pichata tomAloke navIsakalara eTA dalaka asvIkAra karichilA Aru eTA dalaka hatyA karichilA|
Aru siha~te kaichila, ‘AmAra antarasamUha haiche AcchAdita’, varaM siha~tara kupharIra kAraNe AllAhe siha~taka abhizApa kariche| eteke siha~tara kama saMkhyakei ImAna poSaNa kariva|

ipine yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai AllAhara taraphara parA ene ekhana kitAva Ahila yikhane siha~tara lagata thakA granthaka samarthana kare, athaca iYAra pUrve siha~te iYAra sahAYa vicAri kAphirasakalara viruddhe vijaYa prArthanA karichila| eteke yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai seYA Ahi pAle yAka siha~te bhAladare cini pAYa, (tathApio) asvIkAra karile| seYe kAphirasakalara oparata AllAhara lA’nata|

yiTora vinimaYata siha~te nijake vikrI kariche seYA kimAna ye nikRSTa! seYA haiche, AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche, siha~te tAra lagata kupharI kariche, ei jidara vazaৱrtI hai ye, AllAhe teOMra vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yAka icchA kare tAra oparata teOMra anugraha aৱtIrNa kare| seYe siha~te krodhara oparata krodha arjana kariche Aru kAphirasakalara vAve Ache lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|

Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa, ‘AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche tAra prati tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karA’, tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘AmAra prati yi nAyila haiche Ami keৱla tAra pratihe ImAna poSaNa karo~’| athaca siha~te iYAra vAhire yi Ache sei sakalo asvIkAra kare, yadio seYA satya Aru siha~tara ocarata yi Ache tAra samarthanakArI| koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke mumina tente tomAloke atItata kiYa AllAhara navIsakalaka hatyA karichilA?’
Aru nizcaYa muchAi tomAlokara ocaralai suspaSTa pramANasaha Ahichila, tAra pichato tomAloke teOMra anupasthitita dAmuriToka (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karichilA| vAstavikatei tomAloka haichA yAlima|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami tomAlokara parA pratizruti laichilo~ Aru tura parvataka tomAlokara oparata uttolana karichilo~, (Aru kaichilo~) ‘Ami yi pradAna karilo~ seYA dRDha়bhAৱe grahaNa karA Aru (manoyoga sahakAre) zunA’| siha~te kaichila, ‘Ami zunilo~ Aru amAnya karilo~’, Aru kupharIra kAraNe siha~tara antarata dAmuriprIti somoৱAi diYA haichila| koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloka mumina tente tomAlokara ImAne tomAlokaka yi nirdeza diYe seYA kimAna ye nikRSTa!’
koৱA, ‘yadi anyAnya mAnuhara vAhire AllAhara ocarata yadi AkhirAtara vAsasthAna keৱla tomAlokara vAvei nirdiSTa tente tomAloke mRtyu kAmanA karA, yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA’|
kintu siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve siha~te ketiYAo eYA kAmanA nakariva; Aru AllAha yAlimasakalara viSaYe samyaka jJAnI|

Aru tumi nizcaYa siha~taka jIৱnara prati Ana Ana lokatakai vechi lobhI dekhivalai pAvA, Anaki muzvarikasakalatakaio vechi| siha~tara pratyekei AzA kare yadi hAjAra vachara AYu diYA ha’lahe~tena; athaca dIrghAYuYe tAka zAstira parA niSkRti diva noৱAriva| siha~te yi kare sei samparke AllAha samyaka draSTA|

koৱA, ‘yiYe jivrIlara prati zatrutA poSaNa kariva, eikAraNe ye, teOM AllAhara anumatikrame tomAra hRdaYata koraAna aৱtIrNa kariche, yikhana pUrvaৱrtI grantharo samarthanakArI Aru yikhana muminasakalara vAve pathapradarzaka Aru zubha saMvAda|
AllAha, teOMra phiristAsakala, teOMra rAchulasakala, jivrIla Aru mIkAilara saite yiYe zatrutA poSaNa kariva, tente (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAha kAphirasakalara zatru’|
Aru nizcaYa Ami tomAra prati suspaSTa AYAtasamUha aৱtIrNa karicho~, phAchikasakalara vAhire Ana konoৱei iYAka asvIkAra nakare|
eYA sa~cA nahaYa jAno, yetiYAi siha~te kono aMgIkAra kariche tetiYAi siha~tara kono eTA dale iYAka daliYAi diche? varaM siha~tara adhikAMzai vizvAsa nakare|

Aru yetiYA AllAhara taraphara parA siha~tara ocaralai ejana rAchula Ahila, siha~tara ocarata yi Ache tAka samarthanakArI hicApe, tetiYA kitAvIsakalara eTA dale AllAhara kitAvaka pichaphAle daliYAi dile, yenivA siha~te ekoৱei nAjAne|

Aru chulAimAnara rAjatvata caYatAnasakale yi AvRtti karichila seYA siha~te anusaraNa kariche Aru chulAimAne (ketiYAo) kupharI karA nAchila, varaM caYatAnehe kupharI karichila| siha~te mAnuhaka yAdu zikSA dichila Aru (sei viSaYe zikSA dichila) yiTo vAvila caharata hArUta Aru mArUta phiristAdaYara oparata aৱtIrNa haichila| teOMloka ubhaYei ei kathA nokoৱAlaike kAko zikSA diYA nAchila ye, ‘Ami keৱla eTA parIkSAhe’; seYe tumi kupharI nakarivA| iYAra pichato siha~te phiristAdvaYara parA enekuৱA yAdu ziki laichila yiTora dvArA siha~te svAmI-strIra mAjata viccheda ghaTAichila| athaca siha~te AllAhara anumativine tAra dvArA kAro kSati kariva parA nAchila; Aru siha~te keৱla seiToৱe zikichila yiTo siha~taka kSati karichila, kono upakAra karA nAchila; Aru siha~te nizcitabhAৱe jAne ye, yiYe iYAka kraYa kare (arthAt yiYe yAdura AzraYa laYa) tAra vAve AkhirAtata kono aMza nAi| yAra vinimaYata siha~te nijake vikrI kari Ache, seYA kimAna ye nikRSTa, yadi siha~ta jAnilehe~tena!

Aru yadi siha~te ImAna Anilehe~tena Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karilehe~tena, tente AllAhara taraphara parA pAvalagIYA choৱAva nizcitabhAৱe (siha~tara vAve) adhika kalyANakara ha’lahe~tena, ei kathA yadi siha~ta jAnilehe~tena!
he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke ‘rA-YinA’ vuli naka'vA, varaM ‘unayuranA’ vuli koৱA Aru zunA; Aru kAphirasakalara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

kitAvIsakalara mAjara yisakale kupharI kariche siha~ta Aru muzvarikasakale eiTo nivicAre ye, tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara oparata kono kalyANa aৱtIrNa haoka| athaca AllAhe yAka icchA nija rahamatara dvArA vizeSita kare; Aru AllAha mahAna anugrahadAtA|
Ami kono AYAta rahita karile vA pAharAi dile tAtokai uttama athavA tAra samaparyAYara kono AYAta Ani diOM| tumi nAjAnAne ye, nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
tumi nAjAnAne ye, AkAmaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra sArvabhaumatva ekamAtra AllAharei? (jAni thoৱA) AllAhara vAhire tomAlokara kono abhibhAৱka nAi Aru kono sahAYakArIo nAi|
tomAloke tomAlokara rAchulaka enekuৱA prazna kariva vicarA neki yenekuৱA prazna iYAra pUrve mUchAka karA haichila? Aru yiYe ImAnaka kupharIlai parivartana kare, nizciYa si pona patha heruৱAYa|

kitAvIsakalara vahutei vicAre, yadi siha~te tomAlokaka tomAlokara ImAna poSaNa karAra pichata kAphirarUpe obhatAi niva pArilehe~tena! satya spaSTa hoৱAra pichato siha~tara nijara phAlara parA vidveSavazataH (siha~te eiTo kari thAke)| eteke tomAloke kSamA karA Aru upekSA karA AllAhe teOMra kono nirdezanA nidiYAlaike--- nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

Aru tomAloke chAlAta pratiSThA karA Aru yAkAta pradAna karA Aru yikhini neka Amala tomAloke nijara vAve Agalai preraNa karivA, seiTo tomAloke AllAhara ocarata nizcaYa pAvA| nizcaYa tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka draSTA|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘iYAhUdI athavA nAchArAra vAhire Ana koneo ketiYAo jAnnAtata praৱeza nakariva’| eiTo siha~tara michA AzA mAthona| koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA teneha’le pramANa lai AhA’|
haYa, yiYe AllAhara ocarata sampUrNarUpe AtmasamarpaNa kare Aru satkarmazIla haYa tAra pratidAna tAra pratipAlakara ocarata Ache; Aru teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va|

Aru iYAhUdIsakale kaYa, ‘nAchArAsakalara kono bhitti nAi’ Aru nAchArAsakale kaYa, ‘iYAhUdIsakalara kono bhitti nAi’ athaca siha~te kitAva adhyAYana kare| eidare yisakale ekoৱei nAjAne siha~teo sei ekei kathAi kaYa| eteke yi viSaYe siha~te matabheda karichila kviYAmatara dinA AllAhe siha~tara mAjata (sei viSaYe) mImAMsA kari diva|

Aru seijanatakai adhika yAlima Aru kona ha’va pAre, yiYe AllAhara machajidasamUhata teOMra nAma smaraNa karivalai vAdhA diYe Aru seivorara aniSTa sAdhana karivalai ceSTA kare? athaca siha~tara ucita Achila bhIta-santrasta hai tAta praৱeza karA| siha~tara vAve pRthiৱIta Ache lAJchanA Aru Aru AkhirAtata siha~tara vAve Ache mahAzAsti|
pUৱ Aru pazcima AllAharei; eteke tomAloke yi phAlei mukha nakarA kiYa, seiToৱei haiche AllAhara diza| nizcaYa AllAha sarvavyApI, sarvajJa|
Aru siha~te kaYa, AllAhe santAna grahaNa kariche| teOM (iYAra parA) ati paৱitra| varaM AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei| sakalo teOMrei ekAnta anugata|
teOM AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra udbhAৱka; Aru teOM yetiYA kivA karAra siddhAnta laYa, tetiYA tAra vAve keৱla kaYa, ‘ha’, phalata i hai yAYa|

Aru yiha~te ekoৱei nAjAne siha~te kaYa, ‘AllAhe AmAra lagata kathA nakaYa kiYa? athavA AmAra ocarata kono nidarzana nAhe kiYa?’ enekai siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo siha~tara darei kathA kaichila| siha~tara antarasamUha ekei dharaNara| nizcaYa Ami AYAtasamUhaka spaSTabhAৱe varNanA karicho~ seisakala lokara vAve, yisakale dRDha় vizvAsa poSaNa kare|
nizcaYa Ami tomAka preraNa karicho~ satya sahakAre, susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArIrUpe; Aru jAhAnnAmIsakalara viSaYe tomAka kono sodha-poca karA naha’va|

iYAhUdI Aru nAchArAsakale ketiYAo tomAra prati santuSTa naha’va, yetiYAlaike tumi siha~tara millAtara anusaraNa nakarivA| koৱA, ‘nizcaYa AllAhara hidAYatei prakRta hidAYata’; Aru tomAra ocarata yi jJAna Ahiche tAra pichato yadi tumi siha~tara pravRttira anusaraNa karA tente AllAhara taraphara parA tomAra kono abhibhAৱka Aru kono sahAYakArIo nAthAkiva|

yisakalaka Ami kitAva pradAna karicho~, siha~tara mAjata yisakale yathAyathabhAৱe seYA tilAৱta kare, teOMlokei iYAra prati ImAna poSaNa kare; AnahAte yisakale iYAka asvIkAra kare, siha~tei haiche kSatigrasta|

he IcharAIlara vaMzadharasakala! mora sei anugrahara kathA manata peloৱA, yi anugraha mai tomAlokaka pradAna karichilo~, Aru nizcaYa mai (sei samaYata) tomAlokaka samagra vizvata zreSThatva pradAna karichilo~|

Aru tomAloke sei diৱsaka bhaYa karA, yidinA koneৱei kAro upakArata nAhiva Aru kono vyaktira parA vinimaYa grahaNa karA naha’va Aru kono madhyastatAo tAra kono kAmata nAhiva Aru siha~ta sahAYaprAptao naha’va|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA ivrAhImaka teOMra pratipAlake keiTAmAna vANIra dvArA parIkSA karichila, Aru teOM seivora pUraNa karichila| AllAhe ka’le, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAka mAnaৱ jAtira imAma vanAma’| teOM ka’le, ‘Aru mora vaMzadharasakalara parAo? AllAhe ka’le, ‘mora ei pratizruti yAlimasakalaka antarbhukta nakariva’|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami kA’vAgharaka mAnaৱ jAtira milana kendra tathA nirApattAsthala vanAlo~; Aru (Adeza dilo~ ye,) ‘tomAloke mAkAme ivrAhImaka chAlAtara sthAnarUpe grahaNa karA| ivrAhIma Aru ichamAIlaka dAYitva dichilo~ ye, tomAloke mora gharaka tAৱAphakArI, e’tekAphakArI Aru ruku’ Aru chAjadAkArIsakalara vAve paৱitra rAkhivA’|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA ivrAhIme kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! iYAka tumi nirApada cahara vanAi diYA Aru iYAra adhivAsIsakalara mAjata yisakale AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna poSaNa kare teOMlokaka phala-mUlara jIৱikA pradAna karA’| teOM (AllAhe) ka’le, ‘yiYe kupharI kariva tAko mai alapa samaYara vAve jIৱnopabhoga karivalai suvidhA dima, tAra pichata mai tAka juira zAsti bhoga karivalai vAdhya karAma Aru seiTo ye kimAna nikRSTa pratyAৱrtanasthala’!

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA ivrAhIma Aru ichamAIle kA’vAgharara AdhArazilA sthApana karichila, (Aru kaichila) ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra phAlara parA tumi kavula karA| nizcaYa tumi sarvazrotA, sarvajJa’|

‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka ubhaYake tomAra ekAnta anugata karA Aru AmAra vaMzadharara parA tomAra eTA anugata jAti utthita karA; Aru AmAka ivAdatara niYama-paddhati dekhuৱAi diYA Aru AmAra tAovA kavula karA| nizcaYa tumi adhika tAovA grahaNakArI, parama daYAlu’|

‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi siha~tara mAjara parAi siha~tara ocaralai ejana rAchula preraNa karA, yiYe tomAra AYAtasamUha siha~tara ocarata tilAৱta kariva; Aru siha~taka kitAva Aru hikamatara zikSA diva Aru siha~taka parizuddha kariva| nizcaYa tumi parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

ivrAhImara millAtara parA keৱla sei vyaktiYei vimukha ha’va pAre yiYe nijake nirvodha vanAi laiche| nizcaYa Ami teOMka pRthiৱIta manonIta karicho~ Aru AkhirAtato teOM satkarmazIlasakalara anyatama ha’va|
smaraNa karA, yetiYA teOMra pratipAlake teOMka kaichila, ‘tumi AtmasamarpaNa karA’| teOM kaichila, ‘mai vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAhara ocarata AtmasamarpaNa karilo~’|

Aru ivrAhIma Aru iYAkUve teOMlokara putrasakalaka iYArei nirdeza di kaichila, ‘he mora putrasakala! nizcaYa AllAhe tomAlokara vAve ei dvInaka manonIta kariche| eteke tomAloke AtmasamarpaNakArI (muchalima) nohoৱAlaike mRtyu varaNa nakarivA’|

iYAkUvara mRtyura samaYata tomAloke tAta upasthita AchilA neki? teOM yetiYA nija santAnasakalaka kaichila, ‘mora pichata tomAloke kAra ivAdata karivA? siha~te kaichila, ‘Ami AponAra ilAha Aru AponAra pitR-puruSa ivrAhIma, ichamAIla Aru ichahAkara ilAha- sei ejana ilAharei ivAdata karima; Aru Ami teOMra ocaratei AtmasamarpaNakArI’|

teOMloka Achila enekuৱA eTA jAti, yisakala atIta hai gaiche| teOMloke yi arjana kariche seYA teOMlokara vAve, Aru tomAloke yi arjana karichA seYA tomAlokara vAve; Aru teOMloke yi karichila sei samparke tomAlokaka prazna karA naha’va|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘tomAloke iYAhUdI vA nAchArA hai yoৱA, saThika patha pAvA’| koৱA, ‘varaM Ami ekaniSTha hai ivrAhImara millAtara anusaraNa karima; Aru teOM muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta nAchila’|

tomAloke koৱA, ‘Ami ImAna Anicho~ AllAhara prati Aru yi AmAra prati aৱtIrNa haiche, lagate tAra pratio ImAna Anicho~ yi aৱtIrNa haiche ivrAhIma, ichamAIla, ichahAkva, iYAkUva Aru teOMra vaMzadharasakalara prati, Aru muchA, IchA lagate anyAnya navIsakalaka teOMlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA yi pradAna karA haiche (tAra pratio ImAna Anicho~)| Ami teOMlokara mAjata kono pArthakya nakaro~; Aru Ami teOMrei ocarata AtmasamarpaNakArI|

eteke tomAloke yenekai ImAna AnichA siha~teo yadi tenekai ImAna Ane, tente nizcaYa siha~ta hidAYata prApta ha’va; Aru yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa, tente siha~ta Ache keৱla virodhitAta lipta, eteke siha~tara vipakSe tomAra vAve AllAhei yatheSTa; Aru teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
AllAhara raGere raJjita hoৱA; Aru AllAhara raGatakai Aru kAra raM vechi sundara ha’va pAre? Aru Ami teOMrei ivAdatakArI|

koৱA, ‘AllAha samparke tomAloke AmAra lagata vitarkata lipta ha’va vicarA neki? athaca teOM AmAra pratipAlaka Aru tomAlokaro pratipAlaka! AmAra vAve AmAra Amala, Aru tomAlokara vAve tomAlokara Amala; Aru Ami teOMrei prati ekaniSTha|

tomAloke eiTo ka’va vicarA neki ye, ivrAhIma, ichamAIla, ichahAkva, iYAkUva Aru teOMra vaMzadharasakala iYAhUdI vA nAchArA Achila? koৱA, ‘tomAloke vechi jAnA ne AllAhe vechi jAne’? seijanatakai DAGara yAlima Aruno kona ha’va pAre, yiYe AllAhara taraphara parA lAbha karA sAkSya gopana kare? Aru tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha amanoyogI nahaYa|

teOMloka Achila enekuৱA eTA jAti, yisakala atIta hai gaiche| teOMloke yi arjana kariche seYA teOMlokara vAve, Aru tomAloke yi arjana karichA seYA tomAlokara vAve; Aru teOMloke yi karichila sei samparke tomAlokaka prazna karA naha’va|

mAnuhara mAjara nirvodhasakale anatipalame ka’va ye, ‘imAna dine siha~te yi kivalAra anusaraNa kari Ahichila tAra parA siha~taka kihe vimukha karAle? koৱA, ‘pUৱ Aru pazcima AllAharei| teOM yAka icchA kare sarala pathara hidAYata pradAna kare’|

Aru enekai Ami tomAlokaka eTA madhyapanthI jAtita pariNata karicho~, yAte tomAloka mAnaৱ jAtira oparata sAkSI hoৱA, Aru rAchule tomAlokara oparata sAkSI haYa; Aru tumi imAna dine yiTo kivalAra anusaraNa kari AchilA seiToka Ami ei uddezye kivalAta pariNata karichilo~, yAte prakAza kari diva pAro~ ye, kone rAchulara anusaraNa kare Aru kone pichaphAle ubhati yAYa? AllAhe yisakalaka hidAYata kariche siha~tara vAhire Anara vAve eiTo eTA nizcita kaThina kAma| AllAha enekuৱA nahaYa ye, tomAolakara ImAna vyartha kari diva| nizcaYa AllAha mAnuhara prati sahAnubhUtizIla, parama daYAlu|

AkAzara phAle tomAra vAre vAre cAi thakATo nizcaYa Ami lakSya karicho~| eteke Ami tomAka ene kivalAra phAle nizcaYa obhatAi dima yiToka tumi pachanda karA| eteke tumi machajide hArAmara phAle mukha karA; Aru tomAloke ya’tei nAthAkA kiYa iYAra phAlei tomAlokara cehArA ghUrAi loৱA; Aru nizcaYa yisakalaka kitAva diYA haiche siha~te nizcitabhAৱe jAne ye, eiTo siha~tara pratipAlakara parA satya; Aru siha~te yi kare sei samparke AllAha amanoyAgI nahaYa|

Aru yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karA haiche, tumi yadi siha~tara ocarata sakalo dalila-pramANa dAGi dharA, tathApio siha~te tomAra kivalAra anusaraNa nakariva; Aru tumio siha~tara kivalAra anusArI nahaYa; Aru siha~teo parasparara kivalAra anusArI nahaYa| tomAra ocarata satyara jJAna ahAra pichato yadi tumi siha~tara pravRttira anusaraNa karA, tente nizcaYa tumi yAlimasakalara antarbhukta ha’vA|
Ami yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karicho~, siha~te teOMka enekai cini pAYa yenekai siha~te nijara santAnaka cini pAYa; Aru nizcaYa siha~tara eTA dale jAni vuji satya gopana kari thAke|
satya tomAra pratipAlakara parA prerita| gatike tumi ketiYAo sandeha poSaNakArIsakalara antarbhukta naha’vA|

Aru pratyekare ekoTAkai (nirdiSTa) diza Ache, sei phAlei si mukha kare, eteke tomAloke satkarmata pratiyogitA karA| tomAloke ya’tei nAthAkA kiYa AllAhe tomAloka sakaloke samaveta kariva| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
Aru tumi ya’ra parAi noloৱA kiYa, tumi machajidula hArAmara phAle mukha karivA; nizcaYa eiTo tomAra pratipAlakara parA paThoৱA satya; Aru tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha amanoyogI nahaYa|

Aru tumi ya’ra parAi noloৱA kiYa, machajidula hArAmara phAle tomAra mukha ghUrAi loৱA, Aru tomAlokeo ya’tei nAthAkA kiYa iYAra phAlei tomAloke mukha karivA, yAte tomAlokara vipakSe mAnuhara vAve vitarka karAra kono aৱkAza nAthAke; kintu siha~tara mAjata thakA yAlimasakalara vAhire| gatike tomAloke siha~taka bhaYa nakarivA, keৱla mokei bhaYa karA~; ei kAraNe ye, yAte Ami tomAlokara oparata mora anugraha paripUrNa kariva pAro~ Aru yAte tomAloke hidAYata prApta hoৱA|

yenekai Ami tomAlokara mAjara parA tomAlokara ocaratei ejana rAchula preraNa karicho~, yijane tomAlokara ocarata AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAৱta kare, Aru tomAlokaka parizuddha kare tathA tomAlokaka kitAva Aru hikamatara zikSA diYe, ene zikSA diYe yiTo tomAloke janA nAchilA|
eteke, tomAloke mokei smaraNa karA, maYo tomAlokaka smaraNa karima; Aru tomAloke mora prati kRtajJa hoৱA Aru akRtajJa naha’vA|
he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke dhairyya Aru chAlAtara mAdhyamata sahAYa prArthanA karA| nizcaYa AllAha dhairyyazIlasakalara lagata Ache|
Aru yisakale AllAhara pathata nihata haYa, teOMlokaka mRta vuli nAmAtivA, varaM teOMloka haiche jIৱita; kintu tomAloke upalavdhi kariva noৱArA|
Aru Ami tomAlokaka nizcaYa parIkSA karima alapa bhaYa-bhIti, bhoka Aru dhana-sampada, jIৱna Aru phacalara kSaYa-kSatira dvArA; Aru tumi dhairyyazIlasakalaka susaMvAda diYA--
yisakale vipadata AkrAnta ha’le kaYa, ‘Amito AllAharei, Aru nizcaYa Ami teOMra pinei pratyAৱrtanakArI’|
eOMlokei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara prati teOMlokara pratipAlakara parA vizeSa anugraha Aru rahamata varSita haYa, Aru eOMlokei satpathata paricAlita|

nizcaYa cAphA Aru mAraৱA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhara antarbhukta| eteke yiYe (kAvA) gharara hajja athavA omarAha sampanna kare, ei duTAra mAjata chAYI (pradakSiNa) karile tAra kono pApa naha’va; Aru yiYe svataHsphUrtabhAৱe kono satkarma kariva, tente nizcaYa AllAha uttama puraskAradAtA, sarvajJa|

nizcaYa Ami yivora su-spaSTa nidarzana Aru hidAYata aৱtIrNa karicho~, mAnuhara vAve kitAvata seivora spaSTabhAৱe vyakta karAra pichato yisakale seivora gopana kare, siha~taka AllAhe abhizApa kare Aru abhizApakArIsakaleo siha~taka abhizApa kare|

kintu yisakale tAovA kariche Aru nijake saMzodhana kariche Aru satyaka suspaSTabhAৱe vyakta kariche| teOMlokei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara tAovA Ami kavula karo~; Aru mai adhika tAovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa yisakale kupharI kariche Aru kAphira aৱsthAtei mRtyuvaraNa kariche, siha~tara oparata AllAhara, phiristAsakalara Aru sakalo mAnuhara abhizApa|
tAta siha~ta sthAYI ha’va| siha~tara zAsti akaNo zithila karA naha’va Aru siha~taka aৱkAzo diYA naha’va|
Aru tomAlokara ilAha keৱla ejana ilAha| teOMra vAhire Ana kono (satya) ilAha nAi| teOM parama karuNAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYa AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra sRSTira mAjata, rAti Aru dinara parivartanara mAjata, mAnuhara upakArI draৱyavAhI sAgarata calAcala karA jAhAjata Aru AkAzara parA AllAhe pAnI varSaNa kari mRta bhUmika punarjIৱita karAra mAjata, lagate AllAhe prasArita karA sakalo prakAra vicaraNazIla prANIra mAjata Aru vatAhara diza parivartanata tathA AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra mAjata niYantrita meghamAlAra mAjata vivekaৱAna sampradAYara vAve Ache vahuto nidarzana|

Aru mAnuhara mAjata enekuৱA kichumAna mAnuho Ache, yisakale AllAhara vAhire Anaka AllAhara samakakSarUpe grahaNa kare, siha~te siha~taka seidare bhAla pAYa, yidare AllAhaka bhAla pAva lAge; AnahAte yisakale ImAna Aniche, teOMloke AllAhaka sarvAdhika bhAla pAYa; Aru yisakale anyAYa kariche siha~te yadi AyAva dekhivalai pAlehe~tena (tente siha~ta nizcita ha’lahe~tena ye,) nizcaYa sakalo zakti AllAharei; Aru nizcaYa AllAha zAsti pradAnata ati kaThora|

yetiYA, netAsakale (yisakalaka anusaraNa karA haichila) siha~tara anusArIsakalara parA nijake mukta kari lava Aru siha~te zAsti dekhivalai pAva (tetiYA) siha~tara yAৱtIYa pArasparika samparka vicchinna hai yAva|

Aru yisakale anusaraNa karichila siha~te ka’va, ‘hAYa’, Akau evAra yadi Ami ubhati yAvalai suyoga pAlohe~tena, teneha’le Amio siha~tara parA samparka vicchinna karilohe~tena yenekai siha~te AmAra parA samparka vicchinna kariche| enekai AllAhe siha~tara kAryAৱlI siha~taka dekhuৱAva, siha~tara vAve AkSepasvarUpa; Aru siha~ta ketiYAo juira parA olAva noৱAriva|
he mAnaৱ sampradAYa! pRthiৱIta thakA hAlAla Aru paৱitra vastuvora tomAloke bhakSaNa karA; Aru tomAloke caYatAnara padAnusaraNa nakarivA| nizcaYa si tomAlokara prakAzya zatru|
nizcaYa si tomAlokaka keৱla veYA Aru azlIla kAmara Adeza diYe Aru AllAha samparke enevora kathA koৱAra (Adeza diYe) yiTo tomAloke nAjAnA|

Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa, ‘AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche seYA tomAloke anusaraNa karA’, (tetiYA) siha~te kaYa, ‘nahaYa, varaM Ami anusaraNa karima seiTora, yiTora oparata Ami AmAra pitR puruSasakalaka pAicho~’| yadio siha~tara pitR-puruSasakale eko vujA nAchila Aru siha~ta satpathato paricAlita nAchila, (tathApio siha~te tArei anusaraNa karivane?)
Aru yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara udAharaNa haiche sei vyaktira dare, yiYe ene kArovAka mAtiche yiYe ciJara vAkharara vAhire eko nuzune| siha~ta kalA, vovA, andha; seYe siha~te nuvuje|
he ImAndArasakala! tomAlokaka Ami yivora jIৱikA pradAna karicho~ tAra parA tomAloke paৱitra vastuvora bhakSaNa karA, Aru AllAhara kRtajJatA prakAza karA, yadihe tomAloke keৱla teOMrei ivAdata karA|

nizcaYa teOM tomAlokara oparata hArAma kariche mRta jantu, teja, gAharira mAMsa Aru yiTo gAYarullAhara nAmata (javeha karAra samaYata AllAhara nAma nalai Anara nAmata) javeha karA haiche| kintu yiYe nirUpAYa hai (alapa bhakSaNa kare) avAdhya vA sImAlaMghana nakare tente tAra kono pApa naha’va| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYa yisakale AllAhe aৱtIrNa karA granthara parA kichu kathA gopana kare Aru iYAra vinimaYata sAmAnya mUlya grahaNa kare, siha~te nijara peTata juira vAhire Ana eko nabharAYa| kviYAmatara dinA AllAhe siha~tara lagata kathA naka’va Aru siha~taka paৱitrao nakariva; Aru siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
siha~tei hidAYatara vinimaYata bhraSTatA Aru mAgaphirAtara parivarte zAsti kini laiche; eteke jui sahya karivalai siha~ta kimAna ye dhairyyazIla!
eYA eivAvei ye, AllAhe satyasaha kitAva aৱtIrNa kariche Aru yisakale kitAva samvandhe matabheda sRSTi kariche, siha~ta nizcaYa sudUra matAnaikyata lipta|

pUৱ vA pazcima dizata tomAlokara mukha karAToৱe satkarma nahaYa, varaM satkarma haiche, yiYe AllAha, zeSa diৱsa, phiristAsakala, kitAvasamUha Aru navIsakalara prati ImAna poSaNa kare Aru sampadara prati Asakti thakA sattveo AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma, abhAৱgrasta, muchAphira, sAhAyyaprArthI Aru dAsamuktira vAve vyaYa kare Aru chAlAta pratiSThA kare, yAkAta pradAna kare, pratizruti dile seYA pUraNa kare, artha-saMkaTata, dukha-kaSTata Aru saMgrAma-saMkaTata dhairyya dhAraNa kare| eOMlokei haiche satyavAdI Aru eOMlokei haiche muttAkvI|

he ImAndArasakala! hatyAra kSetrata tomAlokara oparata kicAcara (pratizodha grahaNara) vidhAna pharaja karA haiche| svAdhIna vyaktira pariৱrte svAdhIna vyakti, krItadAsara pariৱrte krItadAsa, nArIra pariৱrte nArI| kintu tAra bhAtRra phAlara parA kSamA pradarzana karA ha'le yathAyatha vidhira anusaraNa kari satatAra saite tAra raktapaNa AdAYa karA kartavya| eiTo haiche tomAlokara pratipAlakara phAlara parA zithilatA Aru anugraha| eteke iYAra pichato yiYe sImAlaMghana kariva tAra vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Aru he vuddhi-vivekasampanna lokasakala! kicAcara mAjata tomAlokara vAve Ache jIৱna, yAte tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA|

tomAlokara mAjata yAra mRtyura samaYa upasthita ha’va, si yadi dhana-sampada rAkhi yAYa, tente pracalita nyAYanIti anuyAYI tAra pitR-mAtR Aru AtmIYa svajanara vAve achiYata karAra vidhAna tomAlokaka diYA ha’la| eiTo muttAkvIsakalara eTA kartavya|
eteke eiTo zunAra pichato yiYe iYAta parivartana sAdhana kariva, tente yisakale parivartana kariva aparAdha siha~tare ha’va| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|
kintu yadi konovAi achiYatakArIra pakSapAtitva athavA gunAhara AzaMkA kare, tAra pichata siha~tara mAjata mImAMsA kari diYe tente tAra kono aparAdha nAi| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|
he ImAndArasakala! tomAlokara oparata chiYAma pharaja karA haiche yenekai tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara oparata pharaja karA haichila, yAte tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariva pArA|

(rojA) nirdiSTa kichumAna dinara vAve| eteke tomAlokara mAjata konovAi asustha ha’le athavA bhramaNata thAkile, Ana dinavorata ei saMkhyA pUraNa kari lava, Aru yisakalara vAve chiYAma pAlana karA kaSTasAdhya siha~tara kartavya haiche iYAra parivarte phidiYA- ejana michakinaka khAdya dAna karA| yadi konovAi svecchAi satkarma kare tente seYA tAra vAve kalyANakara; Aru chiYAma pAlana karAToৱe tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara, yadi tomAloke jAnilAhe~tena!

ramajAna haiche sei mAha, yi mAhata koraAna aৱtIrNa karA haiche mAnaৱ jAtira hidAYatara vAve Aru hidAYatara spaSTa nidarzana hicApe Aru satya-asatyara pArthakyakArIrUpe|eteke tomAlokara mAjata yiYe ei mAhata upanIta ha’va si yena ei mAhata chiYAma pAlana kare| kintu tomAlokara konovAi asustha thAkile athavA bhramaNAৱsthAta thAkile velega dinavorata ei saMkhyA pUraNa kariva| AllAhe tomAlokara vAve sahajaTo vicAre Aru tomAlokara kaSTa nivicAre, kAraNa yAte tomAloke saMkhyA pUraNa kariva pArA Aru teOM yihetu tomAlokaka hidAYata diche seYe tomAloke yAte AllAhara mahimA ghoSaNA kariva pArA Aru yAte tomAloka kRtajJa ha’va pArA|

Aru mora vAndAsakale yetiYA mora viSaYe tomAka sodhe, (tetiYA tumi kai diYA) nizcaYa mai ati ocarata Acho~| mai prArthanAkArIra prArthanA kavula karo~, yetiYA si prArthanA kare| eteke siha~teo yena mora AhvAnata sa~hAri diYe Aru mora prati ImAna poSaNa kare, yAte siha~ta saThika pathata paricAlita ha’va pAre|

chiYAmara rAtita tomAlokara vAve strI-sambhoga vaidha karA haiche| siha~ta tomAlokara pochAkasvarUpa Aru tomAlokeo siha~tara pochAkasvarUpa| AllAhe jAne ye, tomAloke nijara lagata khiYAnata karichilA| eteke teOM tomAlokara tAovA kavula kariche Aru tomAlokaka mArjanA kariche| tomAloke etiYA siha~tara lagata milita ha’va pArivA Aru AllAhe tomAlokara vAve yi vidhivaddha kari rAkhiche seiTo kAmanA karA; Aru tomAloke pAnAhAra karA yetiYAlaike rAtira ka'lA rekhAra parA USAra vagA rekhA spaSTarUpe tomAlokara ocarata prakAza nahaYa| tAra pichata rAtira Agamana paryanta chiYAma pAlana karA; Aru tomAloke machajidata e’tikApha aৱsthAta siha~tara lagata sahavAsa nakarivA| eivora haiche AllAhara sImArekhA| seYe eivorara nikaTaৱrtI naha’vA| enekai AllAhe teOMra AYAtasamUha mAnuhara vAve suspaSTabhAৱe varNanA kare, yAte siha~ta tAkvaৱAra adhikArI ha’va pAre|
Aru tomAloke nijara mAjate ejane Anajanara artha-sampada anyAYabhAৱe nAkhAvA Aru mAnuhara dhana-sampattira kichu aMza jAni vuji anyAYabhAৱe AtmasAt karivalai vicArakasakalaka utkoca pradAna nakarivA|

siha~te tomAka natuna jona samparke prazna kare (kiYa eiTo saru haYa Aru DAGara haYa)| koৱA, 'eiTo haiche mAnuhara (vibhinna kAmakAjara) Aru hajjara vAve samaYa nirdhAraka; Aru pichaphAlere gharata praৱeza karATo kono pUNyara kAma nahaYa, varaM pUNya haiche tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| eteke tomAloke (sanmukhara) duৱArerei gharata praৱeza karA Aru tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, yAte tomAloke saphalatA arjana kariva pArA'|
Aru yisakale tomAlokara viruddhe yuddha kare, tomAlokeo AllAhara pathata siha~tara viruddhe yuddha karA; kintu sImAlaMghana nakarivA| nizcaYa AllAha sImAlaMghanakArIsakalaka bhAla nApAYa|

Aru siha~taka ya’tei pAvA hatyA karivA, Aru yi sthAnara parA siha~te tomAlokaka vahiSkAra karichila tomAlokeo sei sthAnara parA siha~taka vahiSkAra karivA| (jAni thoৱA) phitanA (azAnti, zvirka vA dharmadrohitA) haiche hatyA karAtakaio sAMghAtika; Aru machajidula hArAmara ocarata tomAloke siha~tara lagata yuddha nakarivA yetiYAlaike siha~te tomAlokara viruddhe tAta yuddha nakare| eteke yadi siha~te tomAlokara viruddhe yuddha kare tente tomAlokeo siha~taka hatyA karivA, eiToৱei kAphirasakalara pariNAma|
eteke yadi siha~ta virata haYa tente nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru tomAloke siha~tara viruddhe yuddha kariYei thAkivA yetiYAlaike phitanA cuDa়AntabhAৱe dUrIbhUta nahaYa Aru dvIna ekamAtra AllAhara vAve pratiSThita nahaYa| kintu yadi siha~te virata haYa tente yAlimasakalara vAhire Ana kAro oparata AkramaNa karA vaidha nahaYa|

paৱitra mAhara pariৱrte paৱitra mAha| yAra paৱitratA alaMghanIYa tAra aৱmAnanA kicAcara antarbhukta| eteke yiYe tomAlokaka AkramaNa kariva tomAlokeo tAka anurUpa AkramaNa karivA Aru tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karivA; Aru jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha muttAkvIsakalara lagata Ache|
Aru tomAloke AllAhara pathata vyaYa karA Aru nija hAtere nijake dhvaMsara mukhata Theli nidivA, Aru tomAloke ihachAna karA, nizcaYa AllAhe ihachAnakArIsakalaka bhAlapAYa|

Aru tomAloke hajja Aru omarAha AllAhara vAvei sampAdana karA| eteke yadi tomAloke (iharAma vandhi loৱAra pichata) vAdhAprApta hoৱA tente sahajalabhya hAda’YI (kuravAnI) pradAna karA, Aru hAda’YI (kuravAnIra jantu) tAra nirdiSTa sthAna nopAৱAlaike tomAloke mUra nukhurAvA| kintu tomAlokara mAjara konovAi yadi asustha haYa athavA mUrata kaSTadAYaka kivA haYa (Aru iYAra phalata yadi mUra khurAvalagIYA haYa) tente chiYAma athavA chAdakvA nAivA pazu javeha kari tAra phidiYA diva lAgiva| eteke yetiYA tomAloke nirApada ha’vA tetiYA tomAlokara mAjata yiYe omarAka hajjara lagata milAi tAmAttu kariva vicAre, si sahajalabhya hAda’YI javeha kariva| kintu yadi konovAi eiTo kariva noৱAre, tente tAra vAve hajjara samaYata tini dina Aru gharata ubhati Ahi sAta dina, ei sampUrNa daha dina chiYAma pAlana kariva lAgiva| eiTo keৱla sei vyaktira vAve yAra pariYAlavarga machajidula hArAmara adhivAsI nahaYa; Aru tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru jAni thoৱA ye, nizcaYa AllAha zAsti pradAnata ati kaThora|

hajja haiche nirdiSTa mAhasamUhata (zvAoৱAla, julakAdAha Aru julahijjA mAhata)| eteke yiYe ei mAhasamUhata hajja karivalai sthira kare si yena hajjara samaYata strI-sambhoga, anyAYa AcaraNa Aru kalaha-vivAda nakare; Aru tomAloke yi satkarmai nakarA kiYa seYA AllAhe jAne Aru tomAloke samvala saMgraha karA| nizcaYa ATAitakai uttama samvala haiche tAkvaৱA| he vivekasampanna vyaktisakala! tomAloke keৱla morei tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA|

(hajjara samaYata) tomAlokara pratipAlakara anugraha sandhAna (vyaৱsAYa-vANijya) karAta tomAlokara kono pApa nahaYa| eteke tomAloke yetiYA ArAphAtara parA ubhati AhivA tetiYA (mujadAliphAta) mAzvaArula hArAmara ocarata AllAhaka smaraNa karivA Aru teOM tomAlokaka yenekai zikSA diche Thika tenekaiYe tomAloke teOMka smaraNa karivA| yadio iYAra Agata tomAloke vibhrAntasakalara antarbhukta AchilA|

tAra pichata (kurAizvara dare ArAphAtata nagai keৱla mujadAliphAra parA ubhati nAhivA varaM) anyAnya loke ya'ra parA ubhati Ahe tomAlokeo sei sthAnara parA (ArAphAtara parA mujadAliphAlai) ubhati AhivA Aru AllAhara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karA| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tAra pichata yetiYA tomAloke hajjara yAৱtIYa kAmasamUha samApta karivA tetiYA (minAta) AllAhaka enekai smaraNa karivA yenekai (ajJatA yugata) tomAloke nijara pitR-puruSasakalaka smaraNa karichilA athavA tAtakaio adhika| mAnuhara mAjata enekuৱA mAnuho Ache yiYe kaYa, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka pRthiৱItei (sakalo) di diYA’| (jAni thoৱA) AkhirAtata tAra vAve kono aMza nAi|
AnahAte siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA mAnuho Ache yiYe kaYa, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka pRthiৱIta kalyANa pradAna karA Aru AkhirAtato kalyANa diYA Aru AmAka jAhAnnAmara zAstira parA rakSA karA’|
eOMloke yi arjana kariche sei prApya aMza eOMlokara vAvei, Aru AllAha hicApa grahaNata atyanta tatpara|

Aru tomAloke nirdiSTa dinasamUhata (julahijjA mAhara 11, 12 Aru 13 tArikha ei tinidina mInAta aৱsthAna karA samaYata) AllAhaka smaraNa karivA| eteke konovAi yadi kharakhedAkai dudinatei guci Ahe tente tAra kono pApa naha’va Aru yadi konovAi palamakai Ahe tAro kono pApa naha’va| eiTo (niYama) sei vyaktira vAve yiYe tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare, Aru tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA lagate jAni thoৱA ye, tomAlokaka teOMra ocaratei samaveta karA ha’va|
Aru mAnuhara mAjata enekuৱA vyaktio Ache, pArthiৱ jIৱnata yAra kathAvArtAi tomAka mugdha kare Aru tAra antarata yi Ache sei samparke si AllAhaka sAkSI rAkhe| kintu prakRtate si bhISaNa kalahapriYa|
Aru yetiYA si (tomAra ocarara parA) ubhati yAYa, tetiYA si pRthiৱIta phAchAda (azAnti) sRSTi kare, lagate zasyakSetra Aru prANI dhvaMsa karivalai ceSTA kare; kintu AllAhe phAchAda bhAla nApAYa|
Aru yetiYA tAka koৱA haYa, ‘AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA’, tetiYA tAra AtmAbhimAne tAka pApa karivalai utsAha diYe, eteke tAra vAve jAhAnnAmei yatheSTa| nizcaYa i nikRSTa vizrAmasthala|
pakSAntare mAnuhara mAjata enekuৱA loko Ache, yiYe AllAhara santuSTi lAbhara vAve nijake vikrI kari diYe| AllAha teOMra vAndAsakalara prati atyanta sahAnubhUtizIla|
he muminasakala! tomAloke paripUrNabhAৱe ichalAmata praৱeza karA Aru caYatAnara padAnusaraNa nakarivA| nizcaYa si tomAlokara prakAzya zatru|
eteke tomAlokara ocaralai suspaSTa pramANAdi ahAra pichato yadi tomAlokara padaskhalana ghaTe, tente jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

siha~te ei apekSAta Ache neki ye, AllAha Aru phiristAsakala meghara chA~ta siha~tara ocarata Ahi upasthita ha’va? Aru tetiYA sakalo viSaYara mImAMsA hai yAva? Aru sakalo viSaYa AllAhara ocaratei pratyAৱrtita ha’va|

icharAIlara vaMzadharasakalaka sudhi coৱA, Ami siha~taka kimAna spaSTa nidarzana pradAna karichilo~! Aru AllAhara anugraha ahAra pichata konovAi tAka parivartana karile tente (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAha zAsti pradAnata ati kaThora|

yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara vAve pRthiৱIra jIৱna suzobhita karA haiche Aru siha~te muminasakalaka upahAsa kare; Aru yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariche teOMloke kviYAmatara dinA siha~tara oparata (jAnnAtata) thAkiva; Aru AllAhe yAka icchA kare aparimita jIৱikA pradAna kare|

(Adite) sakalo mAnuha eTAi ummatara antarbhukta Achila| (pichalai tAta mAnuhe vibheda sRSTi kariche) phalata AllAhe navIsakalaka susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArIrUpe preraNa karile Aru teOMlokara lagata satyasaha kitAva aৱtIrNa karile yAte mAnuhe yivora viSaYata matabheda karichila seivorara mImAMsA kariva pAre; Aru yisakalaka eiTo diYA haichila, spaSTa nidarzana siha~tara ocaralai ahAra pichato keৱla paraspara vidveSavazataH siha~te sei viSaYata matabheda sRSTi karichila| tAra pichata AllAhe teOMra icchAkrame ImAndArasakalaka sei satya viSaYata hidAYata kariche, yi viSaYe siha~te matAnaikya sRSTi karichila; Aru AllAhe yAka icchA kare sarala pathara phAle hidAYata kare|

tomAloke bhAvichA neki ye, tomAloke jAnnAtata praৱeza karivA athaca tomAlokara ocaralai etiYAo tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara dare aৱsthA Ahi poৱA nAi? artha-saMkaTa Aru dukha-kaSTai siha~taka sparza karichila Aru siha~ta bhIta-kampita haichila| Anaki rAchula Aru teOMra saMgI-sArathi ImAndArasakale kai uThichila, ‘AllAhara sahAYa ketiYA Ahiva’? jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAhara sahAYa ati nikaTaৱrtI|

teOMloke tomAka prazna kare ye, teOMloke ki vyaYa kariva? koৱA, yi dhana-sampada tomAloke vyaYa karivA tAra adhika hakadAra haiche, pitR-mAtR, AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma (pitRhIna), michakIna (abhAৱgrasta) Aru (durdazAgrasta) muchAphirasakala; Aru tomAloke yi satkarmai nakarA kiYa sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱgata|

tomAlokara oparata yuddhara vidhAna anivArya karA haiche yadio eiTo tomAlokara vAve apachandanIYa| kintu tomAloke yiTo apachanda karA, haYato seiTo tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara Aru yiToka tomAloke bhAla poৱA haYato seiTo tomAlokara vAve akalyANakara; Aru AllAhe jAne tomAloke nAjAnA|

paৱitra mAhata yuddha karA samparke mAnuhe tomAka prazna kare; koৱA, ‘ene mAhata yuddha karATo kaThina aparAdha| kintu AllAhara pathata vAdhA pradAna karA, AllAhara lagata kupharI karA, machajidula hArAmata vAdhA diYA Aru iYAra adhivAsIsakalaka iYAra parA vahiSkAra karATo AllAhara ocarata tAtokai vechi aparAdha; Aru phitanA (zvirka) haiche hatyA karAtakaio kaThina aparAdha| (jAni thoৱA) yadi siha~ta sakSama haYa tente tomAlokaka tomAlokara (supratiSThita) dvInara parA obhatAi lai noyoৱA paryanta siha~te tomAlokara viruddhe yuddha kari yAva| eteke tomAlokara mAjara parA yiYe nijara dharma tyAga kari kAphira aৱsthAta mRtyuvaraNa kariva tente (jAni thoৱA) pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata siha~tara AmalasamUha niSphala hai yAva; Aru siha~tei jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI, tAta siha~ta cirakAla thAkiva’|
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru yisakale hijarata kariche Aru AllAhara pathata jihAda kariche, teOMlokei AllAhara rahamata kAmanA kare; Aru AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|

siha~te tomAka mada Aru juৱA samparke prazna kare| koৱA, ‘duYoTAra mAjate Ache mahApApa Aru mAnuhara vAve (kichu parimANa) upakAro Ache; Aru ubhaYare pApa upakAratakai vahu guNe DAGara’| Aru siha~te tomAka sodhe, siha~te (AllAhara pathata) ki vyaYa kariva? koৱA, ‘yiTo praYojanara atirikta’| enekaiYe AllAha tAAlAi tomAlokara vAve AYAtasamUha spaSTabhAৱe varNanA kare, yAte tomAloke cintA-gaৱeSaNA karA,

pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtara viSaYe| mAnuhe tomAka iYAtImasakalara viSaYe prazna kare; koৱA, ‘siha~tara vAve suvyaৱsthA karATo uttama’| tomAloke yadi siha~tara lagata ekelage thAkA tente siha~ta tomAlokare bhAi| AllAhe jAne kona upakArI Aru kona aniSTakArI| Aru AllAhe icchA karile ei viSaYe nizcaYa tomAlokaka kaSTata pelAva pArilehe~tena| nizcaYa AllAha pravala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Aru muzvarikA nArIYe ImAna poSaNa nakarAlaike tomAloke tAika vivAha nakarAvA| yadio muzvarikA nArIYe tomAlokaka mugdha nakaraka kiYa, ejanI muminA kRtadAsI muzvarikA nArItakai uttama| eidare muzvarika puruSe ImAna poSaNa nakarAlaike (tAra saite kono muchalima choৱAlIka) vivAha nidivA, yadio muzvarika puruSe tomAlokaka mugdha kare, iYAra parivarte ejana mumina kRtadAsa muzvarika vyaktitakai uttama| kAraNa siha~te jAhAnnAmara pine AhvAna kare Aru AllAhe tomAlokaka sva-icchAi jAnnAtaphAle Aru kSamAra pine AhvAna kare; Aru teOM mAnuhara vAve teOMra AYAtasamUha suspaSTabhAৱe varNanA kare, yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kariva pAre|

Aru siha~te tomAka hAYeja samparke prazna kare, koৱA, ‘i evidha azuci’| eteke tomAloke hAYeja aৱsthAta strI-saMgamara parA virata thAkA Aru paৱitra nohoৱAlaike (saMgamara vAve) siha~tara nikaTaৱrtI naha’vA| tAra pichata siha~te yetiYA uttamarUpe parizuddha ha’va tetiYA siha~tara ocaralai Thika tenekai gamana karivA yenekai AllAhe tomAlokaka Adeza diche| nizcaYa AllAhe tAovAkArIsakalaka bhAla pAYa Aru siha~tako bhAla pAYa yisakale adhika paৱitratA arjana kare|

tomAlokara strIsakala tomAlokara vAve zasyakSetra(svarUpa)| eteke tomAloke tomAlokara zasyakSetrata yenekai icchA gamana kariva pArA, Aru tomAloke nijara bhaৱiSyatara vAve Agalai samvala preraNa karA Aru AllAhaka bhaYa karA lagate jAni thoৱA! nizcaYa tomAloka AllAhara sanmukhIna ha’vA Aru muminasakalaka susaMvAda diYA|
tomAloke satkarma Aru tAkvaৱA Aru mAnuhara mAjata zAnti sthApanara parA virata thakAra vAve AllAhara nAmara zapataka prativandhaka hicApe vyaৱhAra nakarivA; (jAni thoৱA) AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

tomAlokara anarthaka zapatara vAve AllAhe tomAlokaka sodha-poca nakariva; kintu teOM seivora zapatara viSaYe sodha-poca kariva, yivora tomAlokara antare dRDha়bhAৱe saMkalpa karichila, Aru AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, parama sahanazIla|

yisakale nijara strIra saite milita nohoৱAra zapata kare siha~te cAri mAha apekSA kariva lAgiva| ei samaYachoৱAta yadi siha~te mata parivartana kare (tathA sahavAsalai ubhati Ahiva vicAre) tente nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AnahAte yadi siha~te tAlAkva diYAra saMkalpa kare tente nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

Aru tAlAkvaprAptA strIsakale tini kurUlaike [1] apekSAta thAkiva, Aru siha~te yadi AllAha Aru AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa kare tente siha~tara garbhAzaYata AllAhe yi sRSTi kariche seYA gopana karA siha~tara vAve vaidha nahaYa; Aru yadi siha~te saMzodhana vicAre tente ei samaYachoৱAta punara grahaNa karAra vechi adhikAra haiche siha~tara svAmIra; Aru nArIsakalaro tenekaiYe nyAYasaMgata adhikAra Ache yenekai siha~tara oparata puruSasakalara adhikAra Ache; kintu nArIsakalara oparata puruSasakalara maryAdA (kichu parimANe vechi) Ache; AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tAlAkva haiche duvAra| iYAra pichata (strIka) ha’le vidhimate rAkhi diYA, naha’le sadbhAৱe eri diYA; Aru tomAloke tomAlokara strIsakalaka yi pradAna karichA tAra parA kivA obhatAi loৱATo tomAlokara vAve vaidha nahaYa| kintu yadi siha~ta ubhaYare AzaMkA haYa ye, siha~te AllAhara sImArekhA rakSA kariva noৱAriva (tente viSaYaTo sukIYA)| eteke yadi tomAloke AzaMkA karA ye, siha~te AllAhara sImArekhA rakSA kariva noৱAriva, ene aৱsthAta strIYe yadi kono vastura vinimaYata nijake mukta kari laYa tente kono aparAdha naha’va| eivora haiche AllAhara sImArekhA, eteke tomAloke iYAka ulaMghana nakarivA; Aru yisakale AllAhara sImArekhA laMghana kare siha~tei haiche yAlima|

eteke yadi si strIka (antima) tAlAkva diYe tente sei strI Aru tAra vAve hAlAla naha’va, yetiYAlaike tAi Ana ejana svAmIra lagata milita naha’va| tAra pichata si ( sei dvitIYa svAmIYe) yadi tAlAka diYe Aru ipine siha~ta ubhaYe (strI Aru prathama svAmIYe yadi) anubhaৱ kare ye, siha~te AllAhara sImArekhA rakSA kariva pAriva, tente siha~tara punara milanata kAro eko aparAdha naha’va| eivora haiche AllAhara sImArekhA, yivora teOM spaSTabhAৱe ene sampradAYara vAve varNanA kare yisakale jAne|

Aru yetiYA tomAloke strIka tAlAkva divA, Aru iYAra pichata yetiYA siha~ta iddata sampUrNa karAra nikaTaৱrtI ha’va tetiYA tomAloke ha’le vidhi anuyAYI siha~taka rAkhi divA nAivA vidhimate siha~taka eri divA| siha~taka kSati sAdhana karivalai sImAlaMghanara uddezye siha~taka ATaka kari nArAkhivA| yiYe enekuৱA kare, si nijara oparate anyAYa kare; Aru tomAloke AllAhara vidhi-vidhAnaka ThATTA-vidrUpara viSaYarUpe grahaNa nakarivA; Aru tomAloke AllAhara niYAmatasamUhaka smaraNa karA yivora teOM tomAlokaka dAna kariche lagate teOM tomAlokara oparata aৱtIrNa kariche kitAva Aru hikamata, yAra dvArA teOM tomAlokaka upadeza diYe; eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastu samparke suparijJAta|

Aru yetiYA tomAloke strIsakalaka tAlAkva diYA Aru siha~te siha~tara iddatakAla pUrNa kare, iYAra pichata yadi siha~te vidhi mutAvika paraspare sanmata haYa, tente strIsakale nijara (pUrva) svAmIra lagata vivAha pAzata Aৱddha ha’va vicArile tomAloke siha~taka vAdhA pradAna nakarivA| iYAra dvArA sei vyaktika upadeza diYA haiche tomAlokara mAjara yiYe AllAha Aru AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa kare, eiToৱe tomAlokara vAve zuddha Aru paৱitra; Aru AllAhe jAne tomAlokehe nAjAnA|

Aru mAtRsakale siha~tara santAnasakalaka paripUrNa duvachara stanya pAna karAva, yadi konovAi stanyapAna karoৱAra samaYa sampUrNa kariva vicAre| pitAra kartavya haiche vidhi mutAvika siha~tara (mAtRsakalara) bharaNa-poSaNa karA| sAdhyara atirikta kono vyaktika dAYitva pradAna karA nahaYa| kono mAtRka tAira santAnara vAve Aru yAra santAna (pitA) tAko tAra santAnara vAve kaSTa diYA ucita nahaYa, Aru uttarAdhikAriro sei ekei kartavya| kintu yadi siha~te parasparara sanmati Aru parAmarzakrame (duvacharara mAjatei) stanyapAna erAva vicAre, tente siha~tara kono aparAdha naha’va; Aru yadi tomAloke (kono dhAtrIra dvArA) tomAlokara santAnasakalaka stanya pAna karAva vicarA, tente yadi tomAloke pracalita vidhi mutAvika vinimaYa pradAna karA tente tomAlokara kono pApa naha’va; Aru tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA lagate jAni thoৱA, tomAloke yi karA nizcaYa AllAha seYA pratyakSakArI|

Aru tomAlokara mAjara yisakale strI thai mRtyuvaraNa kare, siha~tara strIsakale cAri mAha dahadina apekSA kariva (iddata pAlana kariva)| tAra pichata yetiYA siha~te nijara iddatakAla pUrNa kariva, tetiYA vidhi mutAvika nijara vAve kivA (saundarya vA vivAha) karile tAta tomAlokara kono pApa naha’va; Aru tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka aৱgata|

Aru yadi tomAloke AkAra-iGgitata (seijanI) nArIka vivAhara prastAৱ diYA athavA antarate gopana rakhA tente tomAlokara kono pApa naha’va| AllAhe jAne ye, tomAloke siha~tara viSaYe nizcaYa AlocanA karivA; kintu vidhi mutAvika kathA-vatarAra vAhire gopane siha~tara lagata kono pratizruti nidivA; Aru nirdiSTa kAla pUrNa nohoৱAlaike vivAha vandhanara saMkalpa nakarivA; Aru jAni thoৱA, tomAlokara antarata yi Ache seYA AllAhe jAne| eteke teOMka bhaYa karA, Aru jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, parama sahanazIla|

yadi tomAloke strIsakalaka sparza karAra Agatei vA moharAnA nirdhAraNa karAra pUrvei tAlAkva diYA tente tomAlokara kono pApa nahaYa; kintu tomAloke siha~taka upayukta (kSatipUraNa) saMsthAna kari divA, sacchale tAra sAdhyamate Aru asacchale tAra sAmarthAnuyAYI, vidhimate saMsthAna kariva, eiTo satkarmazIla lokara kartavya|

AnahAte tomAloke yadi siha~taka sparza karAra Agate tAlAkva diYA, athaca siha~tara vAve moharAnA dhAryya karichA, tente yi nirdhAraNa karichA tAra arddheka AdAYa diva lAgiva| kintu yadi strIsakale kSamA kari diYe athavA yAra hAtata vivAha vandhanara dAYitva Ache si yadi mApha kari diYe (tente seiTo sukIYA kathA)| kSamA kari diYAToৱei tAkvaৱAra adhika nikaTaৱrtI; tomAloke nijara mAjata anugrahara kathA pAhari nAyAvA| tomAloke yi karA nizcaYa AllAha seYA savizeSa pratyakSakArI|
tomAloke chAlAtara prati yatnaৱAna hoৱA, vizeSakai madhyaৱrtI (Acara) chAlAtara prati, Aru AllAhara vAve vinitabhAৱe thiYa hoৱA|

kintu yadi tomAloke vipada AzaMkA karA, tente khojakaDha়A athavA ArohI aৱsthAtei (chAlAta AdAYa karivA)| tAra pichata yetiYA tomAloke nirApada vodha karivA tetiYA tomAloke AllAhaka seidare smaraNa karivA, yenekai teOM tomAlokaka zikSA diche, yiTo tomAloke janA nAchilA|

Aru tomAlokara mAjara yisakale strI thai mRtyuvaraNa kare, siha~te nijara strIsakalara viSaYe ei achiYata kariva ye, teOMlokaka yena sampUrNa evacharalaike bharaNa-poSaNa diYA haYa Aru yAte gharara parA uliYAi diYA nahaYa| kintu yadi siha~te (nija icchAte) olAi yAYa, tente vidhi mutAvika siha~te nijara vAve yi kariva tAta tomAlokara kono pApa nahaYa; Aru AllAha pravala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Aru tAlAkvaprAptA nArIsakaleo vidhi mutAvika bharaNa-poSaNa (kSatipUraNa) lAbha kariva| muttAkvIsakalara vAve eiTo aৱzya kartavya|
enekaiYe AllAhe teOMra AYAtasamUha tomAlokara vAve spaSTabhAৱe varNanA kare yAte tomAloke vujiva pArA|

tumi siha~taka dekhA nAine, yisakale mRtyura bhaYata hAjAre hAjAre nija AvAsabhUmi parityAga karichila? tAra pichata AllAhe siha~taka kaichila, ‘tomAloke mRtyuvaraNa karA’| iYAra pichata AllAhe siha~taka (punara) jIৱita karichila| nizcaYa AllAha mAnuhara prati anugrahazIla; kintu adhikAMza mAnuhe kRtajJatA prakAza nakare|
Aru tomAloke AllAhara pathata yuddha karA Aru jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

konovA Achene, yiYe AllAhaka uttama RNa pradAna kariva? teOM iYAka tAra vAve vahuguNe vRddhi kari diva; Aru AllAhei jIৱikA saMkucita kare Aru samprasArita kare, Aru teOMra pinei tomAlokaka pratyAৱrtita karA ha’va|

tumi muchAra paraৱrtI icharAIla vaMzIYa netAsakalaka dekhA nAine? siha~te yetiYA siha~tara navIka kaichila, ‘AmAra vAve ejana rajA niyukta kari diYaka yAte Ami AllAhara pathata yuddha kariva pAro~’, teOM ka’le, ‘enekuৱA nahaYato ye, tomAlokaka yuddhara vidhAna diYA ha’le tetiYA tomAloke Aru yuddha nakarivA’? siha~te ka’le, ‘Ami yihetu nijara AvAsabhUmi Aru nija santAna-santatira parA vahiSkRta haicho~, tetiYAha’le AllAhara pathata kiYa yuddha nakarima’? eteke yetiYA siha~tara prati yuddhara vidhAna diYA ha’la tetiYA siha~tara kichumAnara vAhire ATAYe pRSTha pradarzana karile; Aru AllAhe yAlimasakalara viSaYe bhAlakaiYe aৱgata|

Aru siha~tara navIYe siha~taka kaichila, ‘nizcaYa AllAhe tAlutaka tomAlokara vAve rajA hicApe preraNa kariche’| siha~te ka’le, ‘tAra rAjatva AmAra oparata kenekai sambhaৱ? athaca Ami tAtakai rAjatvara vechi hakadAra Aru tAka pracura aizvaryao diYA hoৱA nAi’! teOM ka’le, ‘AllAhe nizcaYa tAka tomAlokara vAve manonIta kariche Aru teOM tAka jJAna Aru zArIrikabhAৱe samRddha kariche; Aru AllAhe yAka icchA kare tAka rAjatva pradAna kare Aru AllAha sarvavyApI-prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa’|

siha~tara navIYe siha~taka ei kathAo kaichila ye, ‘tAra rAjatvara nidarzana ha’va ei ye, tomAlokara ocaralai tAvUta (canduka) Ahiva ya’ta thAkiva tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA prazAnti lagate tAta thAkiva kichu parityakta AcavAva yivora muchA Aru hArUnara vaMzadharasakale eri thai gaiche; phiristAsakale seiTo vahana kari Aniva| yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA, nizcaYa tomAlokara vAve iYAta Ache nidarzana’|

tAra pichata tAlute yetiYA senAvAhinIsaha olAi Ahila, tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘AllAhe tomAlokaka eTA nadIra dvArA parIkSA kariva| yiYe tAra parA pAnI khAva si mora dalara antarbhukta nahaYa; Aru yiYe tAra soৱAda grahaNa nakariva si mora dalabhukta; iYAra vAhire yiYe ecalu pAnI grahaNa kariva sio (mora dalara antarbhukta)’| eteke kichusaMkhyaka lokara vAhire ATAYe tAra parA pAnI pAna karile| iYAra pichata teOM Aru teOMra saMgI ImAndArasakale yetiYA nadI atikrama karile tetiYA siha~te ka’le, ‘jAluta Aru tAra senAvAhinIra viruddhe yuddha karAra zakti Aji Aru AmAra ocarata nAi’| kintu yisakale dRDha় vizvAsa karichila ye, AllAhara lagata teOMlokara sAkSAt ha’va, teOMloke ka’le, ‘AllAhara Adezata kimAna ye kSudra dale kimAna vRhat dalaka parAjaYa kariche’! Aru AllAha dhairyyazIlasakalara lagata Ache|

Aru teOMloke yetiYA yuddha karivalai jAluta Aru tAra senAvAhinIra mukhAmukhi ha’la, tetiYA teOMloke ka’le, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra oparata dhairyya DhAli diYA Aru AmAra bhari avicalita rAkhA Aru kAphira sampradAYara viruddhe AmAka jaYayukta karA’|

eteke teOMloke AllAhara Adezata siha~taka (kAphirasakalaka) parAjita karile Aru dAUde jAlutaka hatyA karile| AllAhe teOMka rAjatva Aru hikamata dAna karile lagate teOM yi icchA karile seiToৱei teOMka zikSA dile; Aru AllAhe yadi mAnuhara eTA dalaka Ana eTA dalara dvArA pratihata nakarilehe~tena tente pRthiৱI viparyasta hai ga'lahe~tena| kintu AllAha sRSTijagatara prati anugrahazIla|
eivora haiche AllAhara AYAta, Ami tomAra oparata eivora yathAyathabhAৱe tilAৱta karo~; Aru nizcaYa tumi rAchulasakalara antarbhukta|

sei rAchulasakala, Ami teOMlokara kichumAnaka Ana kichumAnara oparata zreSTatva pradAna karicho~| teOMlokara mAjara kichumAnara saite AllAhe kathAo pAtiche, Akau kichumAnaka ucca maryAdA pradAna kariche; Aru mAraYAmara putra IchAka Ami spaSTa pramANAdi pradAna karichilo~ lagate rUhula kuducha (jivrIla phiristA)ra dvArA teOMka zaktizAlI karichilo~; AllAhe icchA karile siha~tara paraৱrtI lokasakale siha~tara ocarata spaSTa pramANAdi samAgata hoৱAra pichato pAraspArika yuddha-vigrahata lipta naha’lahe~tena; kintu siha~te matabheda karichila| phalata siha~tara kichumAne ImAna Anichila Aru kichumAne kuphurI karichila; kintu AllAhe icchA karile siha~ta pAraspArika yuddha-vigrahata lipta naha’lahetena; kintu AllAhe yiTo icchA kare seiToৱei kare|

he muminasakala! Ami tomAlokaka yi jIৱikA pradAna karicho~ tAra parA tomAloke vyaYa karA, sei (zeSa vicArara) diৱsa ahAra Agate, yidinA vyaৱsAYa, vandhutva Aru cupAricha Adi eko nAthAkiva, Aru kAphirasakalei haiche yAlima|

AllAha, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| teOM ciraJjIৱ, sakalo sattvAra dhAraka| teOMka kalAghUmaTio sparza kariva noৱAre Aru Topanio nahaYa| AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sakalo teOMrei| kona Ache enekuৱA, yiYe teOMra anumati avihane teOMra ocarata cupAricha kariva pAriva? siha~tara sanmukhata Aru pAchata yi yi Ache sei sakalo teOM jAne; Aru teOM yi icchA kare seikhinira vAhire teOMra jJAnara ekoৱei siha~te AYatta kariva noৱAre| teOMra kurachI AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIka parivyapta kari Ache; Aru ei duTAra rakSaNAvekSaNa teOMra vAve vojA nahaYa; Aru teOM suucca, sumahAna|

dvIna grahaNara kSetrata kono jora-javaradasti nAi; satya patha bhrAnta pathara parA suspaSTa haiche| eteke yiYe tAgutaka (arthAt AllAhara vAhire anyAnya vAtila upAsyasamUhaka) asvIkAra kariva Aru AllAhara prati ImAna Aniva, si darAcalate enekuৱA eDAla rachIta khAmuci dhariva yiTo ketiYAo vicchinna naha’va; Aru AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|

yisakale ImAna Aniche AllAhei teOMlokara abhibhAৱka, teৱe~i teOMlokaka (kupharIra) andhakArara parA uliYAi (ImAnara) poharara phAle lai yAYa; AnahAte yisakale kuphurI kariche, tAguta haiche siha~tara abhibhAৱka, eivore siha~taka (ImAnara) poharara parA (kupharIra) andhakArara pine lai yAYa| siha~tei haiche jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI, tAta siha~te cirakAla aৱsthAna kariva|

tumi seijana vyaktira (namarUdara) kathA bhAৱi coৱA nAine? yiYe ivrAhImara lagata teOMra pratipAlaka samparke vitarkata lipta haichila, yihetu AllAhe tAka rAjatva pradAna karichila| yetiYA ivrAhIme ka’le, ‘teOM haiche mora pratipAlaka, yijane jIৱna dAna kare Aru mRtyu pradAna kare’, si ka’le, ‘maYo jIৱna dAna karo~ Aru mRtyu ghaTAOM’| ivrAhIme ka’le, ‘nizcaYa AllAhe sUryaka pUৱra parA udaYa kare, tumi iYAka pazcimara parA udaYa kari dekhuoৱAcona’| phalata kAphirajana vuddhihIna hai parila; Aru AllAha yAlima sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|

athavA sei vyaktira kathA bhAৱi coৱA nAine, yiYe enekuৱA eTA janapada atikrama kari Achila yiTo sampUrNarUpe vidhvasta haichila| sei vyaktijane ka'le, 'mRtyura pichata Akau kenekai AllAhe iYAka jIৱita kariva'? tAra pichata AllAhe tAka eza vachara mRta aৱsthAta rAkhile| aৱzeSata tAka punarjIৱita karile| AllAhe ka'le, 'tumi kimAna dina aৱsthAna karilA'? si ka'le, 'edina vA edinatakaio kama samaYa aৱsthAna karicho~'| teOM ka'le, 'varaM tumi eza vachara aৱsthAna karichA| eteke tumi tomAra khAdyasAmagrI Aru pAnIYa vastura phAle lakSya karA, seivora avikRta Ache Aru coৱA, tomAra gAdhaTora pine, Aru (eYA karicho~) yAte Ami tomAka mAnuhara vAve nidarzana vanAva pAro~, Aru (gAdhara) asthisamUhara pine coৱA; kenekai seivora saMyojita karo~ Aru mAMsapiNDare DhAki diOM'| tAra pichata yetiYA tAra ocarata spaSTa ha’la tetiYA si ka’le, 'mai jAno, nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna'|

Aru yetiYA ivrAhIme ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi kenekai mRtaka jIৱita karA moka dekhuৱAi diYA’, teOM ka’le, ‘tente tumi vizvAsa karA nAi neki’? ivrAhIme ka’le, ‘nizcaYa karo~, kintu mora manara prazAntira vAve (cAva vicAro~)’, AllAhe ka’le, ‘tente cAriTA carAi loৱA Aru seivoraka poha manAi loৱA (yAte mAtilei tomAra ocaralai Ahe)| tAra pichata seivorara TukurA-Tukura kari eTA eTA bhAga pratyeka pAhArata sthApana karA| tAra pichata seivoraka mAtA, (cAvA) seivora tomAra ocaralai drutagatita guci Ahiva, Aru jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha pravala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa’|

yisakale nijara dhana-sampada AllAhara pathata vyaYa kare, teOMlokara (ei vyaYara) udAharaNa haiche zasyara eTA vIjara dare, yiTora parA sAtaTAkai siha (thoka) olAYa, pratyeka thokata thAke ezaTAkai zasya dAnA; Aru AllAhe yAka icchA kare vahu guNe vRddhi kari diYe; Aru AllAha sarvavyApI-prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

yisakale AllAhara pathata nijara dhana-sampada vyaYa kare, Aru sei dAnara kathA mAnuhara ocarata gAi nuphure lagate (ei dAnara vinimaYata mAnuhaka) kono prakAra kaSTao nidiYe, teOMlokara pratidAna Ache teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata Aru teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAi lagate teOMloka cintitao naha’va|
yi dAnara pichata (dAna grahaNakArIka) kaSTa diYA haYa, sei dAnatakai bhAla kathA koৱA Aru kSamA karAi uttama, Aru AllAha abhAৱmukta, parama sahanazIla|

he ImAndArasakala! dAnara kathA pracAra kari Aru (dAna grahaNakArIka) kaSTa pradAna kari tomAloke nijara dAnaka sei vyaktira dare niSphala nakarivA yiYe nijara dhana-sampada lokaka dekhuৱAvalai vyaYa kare, lagate AllAha Aru AkhirAtara prati vizvAsa poSaNa nakare| phalata tAra upamA haiche enekuৱA eTA masRNa zilara dare, yAra oparata alapa mATi Ache, tAra pichata dhArASAra varaSuNe seiToka pariSkAra kari diYe| iha~te yi upArjana kariche tAra ekoৱei nijara kAmata khaTAvalai sakSama nahaYa; Aru AllAhe kAphira sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|

AnahAte yisakale AllAhara santuSTi lAbhara vAve Aru nijara AtmA valiSTha karAra vAve dhana-sampada vyaYa kare, teOMlokara upamA haiche kono okha bhUmita aৱsthita ekhana udyAnara dare, ya'ta dhArASAra varaSuNa haYa, phalata tAta dviguNa phala-mUla utpAdana haYa; Aru dhArASAra varaSuNa naha’leo alapa varaSuNei tAra vAve yatheSTa haYa| tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe AllAha yathArtha pratyakSakArI|

tomAlokara konovAi vicarAne ye, tAra vAve khejura Aru AGurara ekhana udyAna haoka, yAra mAjere nadI pravAhita thAkiva, lagate sei udyAnata tAra vAve sakalo dharaNara phalamUla thAkiva, tene aৱsthAte tAka vArdhakyai pAva Aru ipine tAra kichumAna durvala santAna-santatio thAkiva, enekuৱA paristhitita tAra ei udyAnara oparata eTA agnisaha pracaNDa ghurNi vatAha Ahi udyAnakhana dAha kari yAva (eiTo tomAlokara konovAi vicarAne)? eidarei AllAhe teOMra nidarzanasamUha tomAlokara vAve suspaSTabhAৱe vyakta kare, yAte tomAloke cintA-bhAৱnA Aru gaৱeSaNA karA|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke yi upArjana karA Aru Ami mATira parA tomAlokara vAve yi utpAdana karo~, tAra parA yiTo utkRSTa sampada seiTo dAna karA; Aru nimnamAnara vastu dAna karAra saMkalpa nakarivA, athaca tomAloke nijei enekuৱA vastu caku vandha nakarAlaike grahaNa nakarA| jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha abhAৱmukta, prazaMsita|

caYatAne tomAlokaka daridratAra pratizruti diYe (bhaYa dekhuৱAYa) Aru azlilatAra nirdeza diYe| AnahAte AllAhe tomAlokaka teOMra kSamA Aru anugrahara pratizruti diYe; Aru AllAha sarvavyApI-prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
teOM yAka icchA kare hikamata dAna kare, Aru yAka hikamata pradAna karA haYa, tAka prakRtate pracura kalyANa pradAna karA haYa; Aru vivekasampanna vyaktisakalei keৱla upadeza grahaNa kare|
Aru yiTo tomAloke vyaYa karA athavA tomAloke yiTo mAnnata karA nizcaYa seYA AllAhe jAne; Aru yAlimasakalara vAve kono sahAYakArI nAi|

tomAloke yadi prakAzyabhAৱe cAdAkA karA tente eYA bhAla kathA; Aru yadi gopane karA Aru abhAৱgrasthaka pradAna karA tente eYA tomAlokara vAve Aru uttama; Aru (iYAra phalata) teOM tomAlokara vAve kichu parimANa pApa mocana kariva; prakRtate tomAloke yi Amala karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱhita|

siha~taka hidAYata pradAnara dAYitva tomAra nahaYa; varaM AllAhe yAka icchA kare hidAYata diYe; tomAloke yi dhana-sampada dAna karA seiTo keৱla tomAlokara nijara vAvei upakArI| eteke tomAloke keৱla AllAhara (santuSTi arjanara) vAvei dAna karA; Aru tomAloke uttama kono vastu dAna karile tAra puraskAra tomAlokaka paripUrNabhAৱe pradAna karA ha'va Aru tomAlokara prati anyAYa karA naha’va|

(cAdAkA haiche) seisakala abhAৱgrastha lokara prApya, yisakale AllAhara pathata enekai vyApRta ye, (jIৱikAra sandhAnata) pRthiৱIta calA phurA kariva noৱAre; AtmasanmAnavodhara vAve teOMloke Anara ocarata khuji nokhoৱAra kAraNe ajJa lokasakale teOMlokaka abhAৱmukta vuli dhAraNA kare; tumi teOMlokara lakSaNa dekhiYe ciniva pArivA| teOMloke mAnuhara pAche pAche gai vyAkulabhAৱe sahAYa bhikSA kari nuphure; Aru yi dhana-sampada tomAloke dAna karA, nizcaYa AllAha sei viSaYe savizeSa jAne|
yisakale nijara dhana-sampada dine-rAti, gopane Aru prakAzyabhAৱe dAna kare, teOMlokara vAve teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata Ache puraskAra; teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va|
