yisakale suta khAYa, siha~te sei vyaktira darei (kavarara parA) uThiva, yAka caYatAne sparza kari valiYA vanAiche| eiTo eikAraNe ye, siha~te kaYa, vyaৱsAYa-vANijyao dekhona sutara darei| athaca AllAhe vyaৱsAYa.-vANijyaka hAlAla kariche Aru sutaka hArAma kariche| eteke yAra ocarata teOMra pratipAlakara upadeza Ahi pAiche, tAra pichata si (suta khoৱAra parA) virata haiche, gatike (niSiddha hoৱAra pUrve) yi atIta haiche seiTo haichei; tAra hicApa nikAca AllAhara adhInata; AnahAte yisakale amAnya kari ubhati yAva (arthAt punara suta khAva) siha~tei jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI, tAta siha~ta cirasthAYI ha’va|
AllAhe sutaka nizcihna kare Aru cAdAkAka vRddhi kare; AllAhe kono akRtajJa, pApIka bhAla nApAYa|

nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche, neka Amala kariche, chAlAta pratiSThA kariche Aru yAkAta pradAna kariche, teOMlokara pratidAna Ache teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata; teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va|
he muminasakala! tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru sutara yi aৱziSTa Ache seikhini eri diYA, yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA|

kintu yadi tomAloke (suta varjana) nakarA tente AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara parA yuddha sunizcita vuli jAni thoৱA, Aru yadi tomAloke tAovA karA tente tomAlokara mUladhana tomAlokarei thAkiva| tomAloke anyAYa nakarivA Aru tomAlokara oparato anyAYa karA naha’va|
Aru yadi (khAtaka) abhAৱgrastha haYa tente sacchalatA nohoৱAlaike tAra aৱkAza Ache; Aru yadi tomAloke chAdAkA (kSamA) kari diYA tente eiTo tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara, yadi tomAloke jAnilAhe~tena|

Aru tomAloke sei diৱsaka bhaYa karA yidinA tomAlokaka AllAhara pine obhatAi lai yoৱA ha'va| tAra pichata pratyekake tAra karmaphala paripUrNabhAৱe pradAna karA ha’va Aru siha~tara prati kono dharaNara anyAYa karA naha’va|

he muminasakala! tomAloke yetiYA ejane Anajanara lagata nirdhArita samaYara vAve RNa AdAna-pradAna karivA tetiYA seiTo likhi rAkhivA; tomAlokara mAjata kono lekhake yAte seiTo nyAYabhAৱe likhi diYe; Aru yenekai AllAhe tAka zikSA diche tenekai likhivalai kono lekhake yena asvIkAra nakare| eteke tAra likhi diYAToৱe ucita; Aru yi vyaktira oparata haka Ache (RNagrahItA) teOM yena likhAra viSaYavastu kai diYe lagate teOM yena teOMra pratipAlaka AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare; Aru tAra parA eko yAte hrAsa nakare (arthAt likhAra mAjata yAte kono kama vechi nakare)| AnahAte RNagrahItA yadi nirvodha haYa vA durvala haYa athavA likhAra viSaYavastu kai diva noৱAre tente tAra abhibhAৱke yena nyAYabhAৱe likhAra viSaYavastu kai diYe| tomAloke tomAlokara mAjara dujana puruSaka (ei AdAna-pradAnara) sAkSI rAkhivA, eteke yadi dujana puruSa nAthAke tente ejana puruSa Aru dujanI nArIka sAkSI vanAi lavA, yisakalaka tomAloke sAkSI hicApe pachanda karA, yAte nArIsakalara mAjara konovAi pAhari ga'le ejanIYe AnajanIka smaraNa karAi diva pAre; Aru sAkSIsakalaka yetiYA (sAkSI divalai) mAtA ha'va tetiYA siha~te yena asvIkAra nakare; RNa saru haoka vA DAGara, nirdhArita samaYa likhivalai tomAloke kono dharaNara alasatA nakarivA| eiToৱei AllAhara ocarata nyAYa Aru sAkSyadAnara vAve dRDha়tara Aru tomAlokara mAjata sandehe sthAna nopoৱAra vAve adhika upayukta| kintu tomAloke paraspare yi nagada vyaৱsAYa paricAlanA karA seiTo tomAloke nilikhileo kono doSa nAi, Aru tomAloke yetiYA paraspare vecA-kinA karA tetiYA sAkSI rAkhivA; (mana karivA) kono lekhaka Aru sAkSIYe yAte kSatigrasta nahaYa, Aru yadi tomAloke teOMlokaka kono kSati karA tente eiTo ha'va tomAlokara vAve gunAhara viSaYa| tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, eiToৱe AllAhe tomAlokaka zikSA diYe Aru AllAha sakalo viSaYe sarvajJa|

yadi tomAloke bhramaNata thakA Aru kono lekhaka nopoৱA tente hastAntarakRta vandhaka rAkhivA| eteke yadi tomAloke ejane Anajanaka vizvAsa karA, tente yAra ocarata AmAnata rakhA haiche teOM (sei vizvAsa vajAYa rAkhi) AmAnata pratyArpana karA ucita, Aru teOMra pratipAlaka AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA ucita; Aru tomAloke sAkSI gopana nakarivA, kAraNa yiYe iYAka gopana kare nizcaYa tAra antara haiche pApI; Aru tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|

AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakalovora AllAharei| tomAlokara manata yi Ache seYA prakAza karA vA gopana karA, AllAhe seivorara hicAva tomAlokara parA lava| tAra pichata yAka icchA kariva teOM tAka kSamA kariva Aru yAka icchA kariva zAsti vihiva; Aru AllAha sakalo vastura oparata pUrNa kSamatAৱAna|

rAchule teOMra pratipAlakara taraphara parA teOMra ocarata yi aৱtIrNa haiche tAra oparata ImAna Aniche Aru muminasakaleo| pratyekei ImAna Aniche AllAhara oparata, teOMra phiristAsakalara oparata, teOMra kitApasamUha Aru teOMra rAchulasakalara oparata| Ami teOMra rAchulasakalara mAjata kono pArthakya nakaro~; Aru eOMloke kaYa, ‘Ami zunicho~ Aru mAni laicho~| he AmAra pratipAlaka! tomAra kSamA prArthanA karo~ Aru tomAra pinei (Ami) ubhati yAva lAgiva’|

AllAhe kAko tAra sAmarthara vAhirata kono dAYitva nidiYe| yiYe bhAla upArjana kariva tAra pratiphala si nije pAva, Aru yiYe veYA upArjana kariva tAra pratiphalo si nijei bhoga kariva| he AmAra pratipAlaka! yadi Ami vismRta haOM athavA bhula karo~ tente tumi AmAka aparAdha nadharivA| he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra pUrvaৱrtIsakalara oparata yenekai tumi vojA arpaNa karichilA AmAra oparata tenekuৱA vojA arpaNa nakarivA| he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAka enekuৱA vojA vahana nakarAvA yiTo vahana karAra sAmartha AmAra nAi; Aru tumi AmAra pApa mocana kari diYA, AmAka kSamA kari diYA, AmAra prati daYA karA, tumiYei AmAra abhibhAৱka| gatike kAphira sampradAYara viruddhe AmAka sahAYa karA|
Alipha-lAma-mIma| [1]
AllAha, teOMra vAhire Ana kono prakRta ilAha nAi, teOM ciraJjIৱ, sarvasattvAra dhAraka|
teOM satya sahakAre tomAra prati kitAva aৱtIrNa kariche, iYAra Agata yi Ahiche tAra satyatA pratipannakArI hicApe, Aru teৱe~i aৱtIrNa karichila tAorAta Aru iJjIla|

itipUrve mAnuhaka hidAYata divalai (teৱe~i tAorAta Aru iJjIla aৱtIrNa karichila); Aru teৱe~i phurakAna (nyAYa-anyAYara mImAMsAkArI, koraAna) aৱtIrNa kariche| nizcaYa yisakale AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kare siha~tara vAve Ache kaThora zAsti| prakRtate AllAha mahA-parAkramazAlI, pratizodha grahaNakArI|
nizcaYa AllAhara ocarata AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra ekoৱei gopana nahaYa|
teৱe~i mAtRgarbhata yenekai icchA tomAlokara AkRti gaThaNa kare| teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi; (teOM) pravala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

teৱe~i tomAra prati eikhana kitAva (koraAna) aৱtIrNa kariche yAra kichumAna AYAta haiche ‘muhakAma’(suspaSTa, dvyarthahIna), seivorei haiche kitAvara mUla; Aru Ana kichumAna haiche mutAzvAviha, eteke yiha~tara antarata vakratA Ache keৱla siha~tei phitanA Aru bhula vyAkhyAra uddezye mutAzvAvihAtara anusaraNa kare| athaca AllAhara vAhire Ana koneo iYAra vyAkhyA nAjAne; Aru yisakala jJAnata sugabhIra teOMloke kaYa, ‘Ami eivorara prati ImAna poSaNa karo~, ei sakalovora AmAra pratipAlakara taraphara parAi Ahiche’; darAcalate jJAna-vuddhisampanna lokara vAhire, Ana koneo upadeza grahaNa nakare|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! sarala patha pradAna karAra pichata tumi AmAra antarasamUhaka vakra kari nidivA Aru tomAra taraphara parA AmAka rahamata dAna karA, nizcaYa tumi mahAdAtA|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! nizcaYa tumi edinAkhana mAnuhaka samaveta karivA tAta kono sandeha nAi; nizcaYa AllAhe pratizruti bhaMga nakare|
nizcaYa yisakale kuphurI kariche, AllAhara ocarata siha~tara dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati kono kAmata nAhiva, Aru iha~tei haiche juira (jAhAnnAmara) indhana|

siha~tara abhyAsa phiraAunI sampradAYa Aru siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara abhyAsara darei, siha~te AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichila, phalata AllAhe siha~tara pApa karmara vAve siha~taka karAYatta karichila, Aru AllAha zAsti pradAnata ati kaThora|
yisakale kuphurI kare siha~taka koৱA, ‘tomAloke anatipalame parAjita ha’vA Aru tomAlokaka jAhAnnAmata ekatrita karA ha’va Aru seiTo ati nikRSTa AvAsasthala!’

(vadarara yuddhata) duTA dalara paraspara sanmukhIna hoৱAra mAjata nizcaYa tomAlokara vAve Ache nidarzana| eTA dale AllAhara pathata yuddha karichila Aru AnaTo dala Achila kAphira| siha~te vAhyika dRSTita teOMlokaka siha~tara dviguNa dekhA pAichila| AllAhe yAka icchA kare nija sAhAyyara dvArA zaktizAlI kare| nizcaYa iYAta antardRSTisampanna lokasakalara vAve zikSA Ache|

nArI, santAna-santati, soNa-rUpara bhANDAra, (pachandanIYa) cihnita gho~rA, gharacIYA jantu Aru kheti-pathAra Adika mAnuhara vAve suzobhita tathA lobhanIYa kari diYA haiche| eivora haiche pArthiৱ jIৱnara bhogasAmagrI; AnahAte AllAhara ocarata Ache uttama AzraYasthala|

koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokaka eivora vastutakai utkRSTa kono vastura saMvAda dimane? (tente zunA) yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare teOMlokara vAve teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata Ache jAnnAta, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita haYa, tAta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va; Aru Ache paৱitra strIsakala lagate AllAhara taraphara parA santuSTi; Aru AllAha vAndAsakalara viSaYe samyaka draSTA|
yisakale kaYa, he AmAra pratipAlaka! nizcaYa Ami ImAna Anicho~; gatike tumi AmAra guNAhasamUha kSamA kari diYA Aru AmAka jAhAnnAmara zAstira parA rakSA karA’|
teOMloka dhairyyazIla, satyavAdI, anugata, dAnazIla Aru rAtira zeSa bhAgata kSamA prArthanAkArI|

AllAhe sAkSya diYe ye, nizcaYa teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha (upAsya) nAi, Aru phiristAsakala lagate jJAnIsakaleo (ei sAkSya diYe); teOM nyAYanItira oparata pratiSThita| AllAhara vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, (teOM) parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa ichalAmei haiche AllAhara ocarata ekamAtra (manonIta) dvIna; Aru yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karA haichila siha~te keৱlamAtra paraspara vidveSavazataH siha~tara ocaralai jJAna ahAra pichato matAnaikya karichila| eteke yiYe AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariva tente (si jAni thoৱA ucita) nizcaYa AllAhe hicApa grahaNa karAta palama nakare|

eteke siha~te yadi tomAra saite vitarkata lipta haYa tente tumi koৱA, ‘mai AllAhara ocarata AtmasamarpaNa karicho~ Aru mora anusArIsakaleo’| Aru yisakalaka kitAva diYA haiche siha~taka Aru nirakSarasakalaka koৱA, ‘tomAlokeo AtmasamarpaNa karichA neki?’ yadi siha~te AtmasamarpaNa kare tente nizcaYa siha~teo hidAYata pAva; AnahAte yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa tente tomAra kartavya haiche keৱla pracAra karA; Aru (jAni thoৱA) AllAha vAndAsakalara viSaYe samyaka draSTA|

nizcaYa yisakale AllAhara AYAtasamUhara lagata kuphurI kare, anyAYabhAৱe navIsakalaka hatyA kare Aru teOMlokako hatyA kare yisakale mAnuhara mAjata nyAYaparAYaNatAra nirdeza diYe, tumi siha~taka yantraNAdAYaka zAstira saMvAda diYA|
iha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara goTei Amala pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata niSphala haiche Aru siha~tara kono sahAYakArIo nAi|

tumi siha~tara prati lakSya karA nAine, yisakalaka kitAvara aMza vizeSa pradAna karA haichila? siha~taka AllAhara kitAvara phAle AhvAna karA haichila yAte i siha~tara mAjata (thakA vivAdasamUha) mImAMsA kari diYe; tAra pichato siha~tara edala loke vimukha hai ubhati ga’la|
eiTo eikAraNe ye, siha~te kaYa, ‘mAtra keiTAmAna dinara vAhire juYe AmAka ketiYAo sparza nakariva’; darAcalate siha~tara nijara dvIna samparke siha~tara michA udbhAৱne siha~taka pravaJcita kariche|

eteke (seidinA siha~tara) ki aৱsthA ha’va? yidinA Ami siha~taka ekatrita karima, yiTo diৱsa samparke kono sandeha nAi, seidinA pratyekake siha~tara arjita Amalara pratidAna paripUrNabhAৱe diYA ha’va; Aru siha~tara prati kono anyAYa karA naha'va|

koৱA, ‘he sArvabhauma zaktira mAlika AllAha! tumi yAka icchA karA kSamatA pradAna karA, Aru yAra parA icchA karA kSamatA kADha়i loৱA; yAka icchA karA tumi sanmAnita karA, Aru yAka icchA karA tumi apamAnita karA| tomAra hAtatei yAৱtIYa kalyANa| nizcaYa tumi sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

tumiYei rAtika dinara mAjata Aru dinaka rAtira mAjata praৱeza karoৱA; tumiYei mRtara parA jIৱntara AvirbhAৱ ghaToৱA Akau jIৱntara parA mRtara AvirbhAৱ ghaToৱA; Aru yAka tumi icchA karA aparimita jIৱikA pradAna karA|

muminasakale yena muminasakalara vAhire kAphirasakalaka abhibhAৱka (vA antaraMga vandhurUpe) grahaNa nakare; Aru yiYe enekuৱA kariva tAra lagata AllAhara kono samparka nAi| kintu vyatikrama, yadi tomAloke siha~tara parA AtmarakSAra vAve satarkatA aৱlamvana karA (teneha’le viSaYaTo sukIYA); Aru AllAhe tomAlokaka teOMra nijara viSaYe sAৱdhAna kariche Aru (jAni thoৱA) AllAhara phAlei (tomAlokara) pratyAৱrtana|

koৱA, ‘tomAlokara antarata yi Ache seYA yadi tomAloke gopana karA athavA vyakta karA, (tathApio) AllAhe seYA jAne; AkAzasamUhata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache seYAo teOM jAne| Anaki AllAha sakalo vastura oparate kSamatAৱAna’|

yidinA pratyekei nijara bhAla Amala Aru veYA Amala upasthita pAva, seidinA si kAmanA kariva- yadi tAra Aru iYAra mAjata vizAla vyaৱdhAna ha’lahetena! AllAhe tomAlokaka teOMra nijara viSaYe sAৱdhAna kariche; Aru AllAha vAndAsakalara prati atyanta snehazIla|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke yadi AllAhaka bhAla poৱA tente moka anusaraNa karA, AllAhe tomAlokaka bhAla pAva Aru tomAlokara aparAdhasamUha kSamA kariva| AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAha Aru rAchulara Anugatya karA’| tAra pichato yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa, tente (jAni thoৱA) AllAhe nizcaYa kAphirasakalaka pachanda nakare|
nizcaYa AllAhe Adama, nuha Aru ivrAhImara vaMzadhara Aru imarANara vaMzadharaka samagra sRSTijagatara oparata manonIta kariche|
teOMloka haiche ijane sijanara vaMzadhara; Aru AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA imarANara strIYe kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! mora garbhata yi Ache nizcaYa mai seYA ekAnta mane tomAra vAve mAnnata karilo~| seYe tumi mora parA eiTo kavula karA, nizcaYa tumi sarvazrotA, sarvajJa’|

tAra pichata yetiYA teOM (imarANara strIYe) sei santAna prasaৱ karile, tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa mai kanyA santAnahe prasaৱ karicho~| prakRtate teOM yi prasaৱ kariche sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱgata; Aru putra santAna kanyA santAnara dare nahaYa; (yikinahaoka) mai iYAra nAma rAkhicho~ mAraYAma lagate abhizapta caYatAnara parA teOMka Aru teOMra vaMzadharasakalaka tomAra AzraYata dicho~|

eteke teOMra pratipAlake teOMka Agrahere kavula karile Aru teOMka uttamarUpe lAlana-pAlana karile Aru yAkAriYyAra tattvAৱdhAnata rAkhile| yetiYAi yAkAriYyAha teOMra koThAta praৱeza karichila, tetiYAi teOMra ocarata khAdya sAmagrI dekhivalai pAichila| teOM kaichila, ‘he mAraYAma! eivora tumi ka’ta pAlA? teOM (mAraYAme) kaichila, ‘eivora AllAhara taraphara parA (ahA)’| nizcaYa AllAhe yAka icchA kare aparimita jIৱikA dAna kare|
sei ThAite yAkAriYyAi teOMra pratipAlakara ocarata prArthanA kari ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi moka tomAra phAlara parA uttama vaMzadhara dAna karA| nizcaYa tumi prArthanA zraৱNakArI’|

tAra pichata yAkAriYyAi yetiYA ivAdata kakSata chAlAtata thiYa ha’la, tetiYA phiristAsakale teOMka AhvAna kari ka’le, ‘nizcaYa AllAhe AponAlai iYAhaYAra susaMvAda diche, teOM ha’va AllAhara taraphara parA AgamanakRta eTA kalimA (IchA)ra satyAYanakArI, lagate teOM ha’va ejana netA, bhoga-Asaktimukta Aru pUNyaৱAnasakalara antarbhukta ejana navI’|
teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! mora santAna kenekai ha’va? athaca mora vArdhakya Ahi pariche Aru mora strIo haiche vandhyA’| teOM (AllAhe) ka’le, ‘eidarei’| AllAhe yiTo icchA seiToৱe kare|

teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka eTA nidarzana diYA’| teOM ka’le, ‘tomAra nidarzana eiToৱe ye, tini dinalaike tumi AkAra-iGgitara vAhire mAnuhara lagata kathA ka’va noৱArivA| eteke tumi tomAra pratipAlakaka adhika smaraNa karA Aru puৱA-gadhUli teOMra paৱitratA-mahimA ghoSaNA karA’|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA phiristAsakale kaichila, ‘he mAraYAma! nizcaYa AllAhe tomAka manonIta kariche Aru paৱitra kariche lagate vizvajagatara nArIsakalara oparata tomAka manonIta kariche’|
he mAraYAma! tumi tomAra pratipAlakara anugata hoৱA, lagate (teOMka) chAjadA karA Aru rukukArIsakalara lagata ruku karA’|

eiTo adRzya saMvAdasamUhara antarbhukta, yiTo Ami tomAka ahIra dvArA aৱhita karicho~; Aru mAraYAmara tattvAৱdhAnara dAYitva siha~tara mAjara kone grahaNa kariva tAra vAve yetiYA siha~te siha~tara kalama nikSepa karichila tetiYA tumi siha~tara ocarata upasthita nAchilA Aru siha~te yetiYA (ei viSaYe) vAdAnuvAda kari Achila tetiYAo tumi tAta upasthita nAchilA|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA phiristAsakale kaichila, ‘he mAraYAma! nizcaYa AllAhe tomAka teOMra taraphara parA eTA kAlimAra (dvArA sRSTi ha’valagIYA santAnara) susaMvAda diche| yAra nAma ha’va machIha, mAraYAmara putra IchA, teOM pRthiৱI Aru parakAlata sanmAnita Aru sAnnidhyaprAptasakalara anyatama ha’va|
teOM ke~cuৱA aৱsthAta (dolanAta) Aru pUrNa vaYasato mAnuhara lagata kathA ka’va Aru teOM pUNyaৱAnasakalara antarbhukta ha’va|

teOM (mAraYAme) ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! kenekai mora santAna ha’va? athaca kono puruSei moka sparza karA nAi’| teOM (AllAhe) ka’le, ‘enekaiYe’, AllAhe yi icchA kare sRSTi kare| teOM yetiYA kono viSaYe siddhAnta laYa tetiYA keৱla teOM kaYa, ‘ha’, phalata seiTo tatkSaNAta hai yAYa|
Aru teOM tAka kitAva, hikamata, tAorAta Aru iJjIlara zikSA diva’|

Aru teOMka vanI icharAIlara vAve rAchula hicApe (preraNa kariva,) (teOM ka’va) ‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara ocaralai nidarzana lai Ahicho ye, nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve vokA mATira dvArA eTA carAi sadRza AkRti gaThaNa karima; tAra pichata tAta mai phu~ dima; phalata AllAhara Adezata seiTo carAi hai yAva; lagate mai AllAhara Adezata janmAndha Aru kuSTha vyAdhigrastha lokaka nirAmaYa karima Aru mRta vyaktiko jIৱita kari dekhuৱAma| tomAloke nijara gharata yi khoৱA Aru yi saJcaYa karA seYAo mai tomAlokaka janAi dima| nizcaYa iYAta tomAlokara vAve nidarzana Ache yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA’|

‘Aru (mai Ahicho~) mora sanmukhata thakA tAorAtara (vANIka) satyAYanakArIrUpe Aru tomAlokara vAve yivora hArAma Achila tAre kichumAna hAlAla karivalai Aru mai tomAlokara pratipAlakara parA tomAlokara vAve nidarzana lai Ahicho~| gatike tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru mora Anugatya karA’|
‘nizcaYa AllAhei haiche mora Aru tomAlokara pratipAlaka, eteke tomAloke teOMrei ivAdata karA| eiToৱei haiche sarala patha’|

tAra pichata yetiYA IchAi siha~tara avAdhyatAra kathA upalavdhi karile tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘AllAhara pathata kone moka sahAYa karivA? hAoৱArI (ziSya)sakale ka’le, ‘Ami sakaloৱe AllAhara (pathata) sahAYa karima| Ami AllAhara prati ImAna Anicho~ Aru Apuni sAkSI thAkaka ye, nizcaYa Ami muchalima|
‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi yi aৱtIrNa karichA tAra prati Ami ImAna Anicho~ Aru Ami rAchulara anusaraNa karicho~| eteke AmAka sAkSyadAnakArIsakalara tAlikAbhukta kari loৱA’|
Aru siha~te SaDa়yantra racichila Aru AllAheo kauzala karichila; Aru AllAha uttama kauzalakArI|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA AllAhe kaichila, ‘he IchA! nizcaYa mai tomAka parigrahaNa karima, Aru tomAka mora ocaralai uThAi Anima Aru yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~tara parA tomAka paৱitra karima Aru tomAra anusArIsakalaka kviYAmata paryanta kAphirasakalara oparata prAdhAnya dima, tAra pichata tomAloke mora ocaratei ubhati AhivA’| tetiYA mai tomAlokara mAjata mImAMsA kari dima yivora viSaYakalai tomAloke matAnaikya karichilA|
eteke yisakale kupharI kariche mai siha~taka pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata kaThora zAsti pradAna karima Aru siha~tara kono sahAYakArIo nAthAkiva|
Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru neka Amala kariche teOM siha~taka siha~tara pratiphala paripUrNabhAৱe pradAna kariva; Aru AllAhe yAlimasakalaka pachanda nakare|
eivora Ami tomAra oparata AYAta Aru hikamata bharA (prajJApUrNa) upadezara parA tilAৱta kari Acho~|
nizcaYa AllAhara ocarata IchAra udAharaNa haiche Adamara dare, tekhete teOMka mATira parA sRSTi karichila| tAra pichata teOMka kaichila, ‘ha’, phalata teOM hai ga’la|
satya tomAra pratipAlakara parA prerita| gatike tumi ketiYAo sandeha poSaNakArIsakalara antarbhukta naha’vA|

eteke tomAra ocaralai jJAna ahAra pichato yiYe ei viSaYe (IchA samparke) tomAra lagata tarka kare tAka koৱA, ‘AhA, Ami AmAra Aru tomAlokara putrasakalaka AhvAna karo~, AmAra strIsakalaka Aru tomAlokara strIsakalako AhvAna karo~, Amio Aho~ Aru tomAloko AhA, tAra pichata Ami muvAhAlA (vinIta prArthanA) karo~ ye, michalIYAsakalara oparata AllAhara abhisampAta haoka|
nizcaYa eiToৱe haiche satya viৱraNa Aru AllAhara vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi; nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i haiche parama parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tathApio yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa (arthAt IchA samparkIYa satya itihAsaka asvIkAra kare), tente (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAha phAchAdakArIsakalara viSaYe samyaka aৱgata|

koৱA, ‘he kitAvIsakala! AhA sei kathAra pine yiTo AmAra Aru tomAlokara mAjata mila Ache; seYA haiche- Ami yena ekamAtra AllAhara vAhire Ana kAro ivAdata nakaro~, teOMra lagata Ana kAko aMzI sthApana nakaro~ Aru AmAra mAjara konoৱei yAte ijane sijanaka ravva hicApe grahaNa nakare’| tathApio yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa, teneha’le tomAloke koৱA, ‘tomAloke sAkSI thAkA ye, nizcaYa Ami muchalima’|
he Ahale kitAvasakala! ivrAhImara viSaYe kiYa tomAloke tarka karA? athaca tAorAta Aru iJjIla teOMra pichatahe aৱtIrNa haichila| eteke tomAloke navujA neki?

sAৱdhAna! tomAlokei seisakala loka, yisakale sAmAnya jJAnalai tarka-vitarka karichA, kintu yi viSaYe tomAlokara kono jJAnei nAi sei viSaYakalai kiYa tomAloke tarka-vitarka karA? AllAhe jAne tomAloke ekoৱei nAjAnA|
ivrAhIma iYAhudIo nAchila, nAchArAo nAchila; varaM teOM Achila ekaniSTha muchalima Aru teOM muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta nAchila|

nizcaYa mAnuhara mAjata teOMlokei haiche ivrAhImara ghaniSThatama vyakti, yisakale teOMra anusaraNa karichila, lagate ei navI Aru muminasakaleo (teOMra anusaraNa kare); (jAni thoৱA) AllAha haiche muminasakalara abhibhAৱka|
kitAvIsakalara eTA dale vicAre, siha~ta yadi tomAlokaka vipathagAmI kariva pArilehe~tena, athaca siha~ta nijei nijake vipathagAmI kari Ache; kintu siha~te upalavdhi kariva parA nAi|
he Ahale kitAva! kiYa tomAloke AllAhara AYAtasamUhara lagata kuphurI karA, athaca tomAlokei iYAra sAkSya vahana karichA?
he Ahale kitAva! tomAloke kiYa satyaka michAra saite mizrita karA, lagate jAni vuji kiYa satyaka gopana karA?

Aru kitAvIsakalara eTA dale kaYa, ‘yisakale ImAna Aniche siha~tara prati yi aৱtIrNa haiche tomAloke dinara prathamAMzata tAra oparata ImAna AnivA Aru dinara zeSa bhAgata seiToka asvIkAra karivA; yAte siha~te (ichalAmara parA) ubhati Ahe|

Aru yisakale tomAlokara dvInara anusaraNa kare teOMlokara vAhire Ana kAko vizvAsa nakarivA’| koৱA, ‘nizcaYa AllAhara nirdezita pathei haiche ekamAtra patha| (siha~te ei kathAo kaYa ye, tomAloke eiToo vizvAsa nakarivA ye) tomAlokaka yiTo diYA haiche seYA Anako diYA ha’va, athavA tomAlokara pratipAlakara sanmukhata siha~te tomAlokara viruddhe yukti utthApana kariva’| koৱA, ‘nizcaYa anugraha haiche AllAhara hAtata, teOM yAka icchA kare tAka seiTo pradAna kare; Aru AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
teOM yAka icchA kare teOMra anugrahara vAve ekAntabhAৱe nirvAcita kari laYa; Aru AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

Aru kitAvIsakalara mAjata enekuৱA kichumAna mAnuho Ache, yAra ocarata vipula sampada AmAnata rAkhileo (ghUrAi vicarAra lage lage) si ghUrAi diva; Akau siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA mAnuho Ache, yAra ocarata mAtra eTA dInAra AmAnata rAkhileo tAra oparata sarvocca tAgidA nidiYAlaike si seiTo ghUrAi nidiva| eiTo eivAve ye, siha~te kaYa, ‘ei azikSitasakalara adhikAra haraNata AmAra kono pApa nahaYa; darAcalate siha~te jAni vuji AllAhara nAmata michA kathA kaYa|
haYa nizcaYa, yadi konovAi nija pratizruti pUraNa kare Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare tente (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAhe mattAkvIsakalaka bhAla pAYa|

nizcaYa yisakale AllAhara lagata karA pratizruti Aru nijara zapataka tuccha mulyara vinimaYata vikrI kare, AkhirAtata siha~tara kono aMza nAi; Aru kviYAmatara dinA AllAhe siha~tara lagata kathA naka’va, siha~tara prati dRSTio nidiva Aru siha~taka parizuddhao nakariva; Aru siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

Aru nizcaYa siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA eTA dalo Ache, yisakale kitApaka jibhAra dvArA vikRta kare yAte tomAloke seiToka AllAhara kitAvara aMza vuli bhaৱA; athaca seiTo kitAvara aMza nahaYa| kintu siha~te kaYa, ‘eiTo AllAhara taraphara parA ahA’; athaca seiTo AllAhara taraphara parA (aৱtIrNa) nahaYa| varaM siha~te jAni-vuji AllAhara oparata michA kathA kaYa|

kono mAnuhara vAve saMgata nahaYa ye, AllAhe teOMka kitAva, hikamata Aru nuvuoৱta dAna karAra pAchata teOM mAnuhaka ka’va, ‘AllAhara parivarte tomAloke mora dAsa hai yoৱA’, varaM teOM (ei vulihe) ka’va, yihetu tomAloke kitAva zikSA diYA Aru yihetu tomAloke adhyaYana karA, gatike ‘tomAloke rAvvAnI hai yoৱA,’|
eidare teOM tomAlokaka eiToo nirdeza nidiva ye, tomAloke phiristA Aru navIsakalaka ravva hicApe grahaNa karA| tomAloka muchalima hoৱAra pichata teOM tomAlokaka kuphurIra nirdeza divane?

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA AllAhe navIsakalara parA aGgIkAra laichila ye, ‘yihetu mai tomAlokaka kitAva Aru hikamata(ra zikSA) dicho~; gatike tomAlokara ocarata thakA tathyara satyAYanakArIrUpe yetiYAi tomAlokara ocaralai kono rAchula Ahiva- tetiYAi tomAloke nizcaYa tAra prati ImAna AnivA Aru teOMka sahAYa karivA’| teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke svIkAra karilAne? Aru ei viSaYe mora aGgIkAra grahaNa karilAne’? teOMloke ka’le, ‘Ami svIkAra karilo~’| teOM ka’le, ‘tente tomAloke sAkSI thAkA Aru maYo tomAlokara lagata sAkSI thAkilo~|
eteke iYAra pichata yisakale mukha ghUrAi lava, siha~tei haiche phAchika (satyatyAgI)|

siha~te AllAhara dvInara parivarte Ana kivA vicAre neki? athaca AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sakaloৱe icchAte haoka vA anicchAte teOMra ocarata AtmasamarpaNa kariche; Aru teOMra ocaralaikei siha~te pratyAৱrtana kariva|

tomAloke koৱA, ‘Ami ImAna Anicho~ AllAhara prati Aru yi AmAra prati aৱtIrNa haiche lagate tAra pratio ImAna Anicho~ yi aৱtIrNa haiche ivrAhIma, ichamAIla, ichahAkva, iYAkUva Aru teOMra vaMzadharasakalara prati, Aru muchA, IchA lagate anyAnya navIsakalaka teOMlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA yi pradAna karA haiche (tAra pratio ImAna Anicho~)| Ami teOMlokara mAjata kono dharaNara pArthakya nakaro~; Aru Ami teOMra ocaratei AtmasamarpaNakArI|
Aru yiYe ichalAmara vAhire Ana kono dvIna sandhAna kariva tAra parA seiTo ketiYAo grahaNa karA naha’va Aru si parakAlata kSatigrastasakalara antarbhukta ha’va|

AllAhe kenekai sei sampradAYaka hidAYata kariva, yisakale ImAna poSaNa karAra pichata Aru rAchulaka satya vuli sAkSya diYAra pichata lagate siha~tara ocaralai spaSTa nidarzana ahAra pichata kuphurI kariche? AllAhe yAlima sampradAYaka hidAYata nidiYe|
iha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara pratidAna haiche ei ye, iha~tara oparata AllAhara Aru phiristAsakalara tathA sakalo mAnuhare abhisampAta|
siha~te tAta (jAhAnnAmata) sthAYI ha’va| siha~tara zAsti akaNo zithila karA naha’va Anaki siha~taka aৱkAzo diYA naha’va|
kintu seisakala lokara vAhire, yisakale iYAra pichata tAovA kariche Aru nijake saMzodhana kariche| ei kSetrata nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna poSaNa karAra pichata kuphurI kariche, tAra pichata siha~te kuphurI kAryata adhika AguৱAi gaiche, siha~tara tAovA ketiYAo kavula karA naha’va; Aru siha~tei haiche pathabhraSTa|

nizcaYa yisakale kuphurI kariche Aru kAphira aৱsthAtei mRtyuvaraNa kariche, siha~tara konovAi (nijara muktira vAve) vinimaYa hicApe pRthiৱI bharA soNa pradAna karileo seiTo ketiYAo grahaNa karA naha’va| iha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti Aru siha~tara vAve kono sahAYakArIo nAi|
tomAloke yi bhAlapoৱA tAra parA vyaYa (dAna) nakarAlaike tomAloke ketiYAo choৱAva arjana kariva noৱArivA; Aru tomAloke yi vyaYa (dAna) karA, nizcaYa AllAha sei samparke savizeSa aৱgata|

tAorAta aৱtIrNa hoৱAra Agate icharAIle nijara oparata yi hArAma karichila tAra vAhire vanI icharAIlara vAve yAৱtIYa khAdya hAlAla Achila| koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA teneha’le tAorAta lai AhA Aru seYA pATha karA’|
eteke iYAra pichato yisakale AllAhara oparata michA raTanA kare siha~tei haiche yAlima|
koৱA, ‘AllAhe satya kaiche| seYe tomAloke ekaniSThabhAৱe ivrAhImara millAtara anusaraNa karA, Aru teOM muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta nAchila’|
nizcaYa mAnaৱjAtira vAve sarvaprathama yikhana ghara pratiSThita haichila, seYA makkAta aৱsthita, seikhana haiche varakatamaYa Aru vizvavAsIra vAve hidAYata|

tAta vahuto suspaSTa nidarzana Ache, yene mAkAme ivrAhIma (zilara oparata ivrAhImara padacihna); yiYe tAta praৱeza kariva si nirApattA lAbha kariva; Aru mAnuhara mAjara parA tAta yAvalai yAra sAmartha Ache, AllAhara uddezye sei gharara hajja karA tAra vAve aৱzya kartavya (anivArya); Aru yiYe kuphurI kariva si jAni thoৱA ucita, nizcaYa AllAha sRSTijagatara mukhApekSI nahaYa|
koৱA, ‘he Ahale kitAva! tomAloke AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka (nidarzanasamUhaka) kiYa asvIkAra karA? Aru tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe AllAhei sAkSI’|

koৱA, ‘he Ahale kitAva! yijana vyaktiYe ImAna Aniche tomAloke vakratA anusandhAna kari AllAhara pathata teOMka kiYa vAdhA diYA? athaca tomAlokei (ei viSaYe) sAkSI; (jAni thoৱA) tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha amanoyogI nahaYa’|
he muminasakala! yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karA haiche, tomAloke yadi siha~tara eTA dalara Anugatya karA, tente siha~te tomAlokaka ImAna AnAra pichata Akau kAphira aৱsthAta obhatAi laihe eriva|

Aru kenekai tomAloke kuphurI karA athaca AllAhara AYAtasamUha tomAlokara ocarata tilAৱta karA haYa Aru tomAlokara mAjata teOMra rAchulo upasthita Ache? Aru yi vyaktiYe AllAhaka dRDha়bhAৱe aৱlamvana kariva, si nizcaYa sarala pathara hidAYata lAbha kariva|
he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke yathArthabhAৱe AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru tomAloke muchalima (paripUrNa AtmasamarpaNakArI) nohoৱAlaike mRtyuvaraNa nakarivA|

Aru tomAloka sakaloৱe AllAhara rachIka dRDha়bhAৱe dhAraNa karA Aru paraspare vicchinna naha’vA; lagate tomAlokara prati AllAhe karA anugraha smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAloke paraspare zatru AchilA| tAra pichata teৱe~i tomAlokara hRdaYata prItira saJcAra kariche, phalata teOMra anugrahata tomAloke paraspara bhAi-bhAi hai gaichA| tomAloka AchilA agnigartara duৱArata, teৱe~i tomAlokaka tAra parA rakSA kariche| eidare AllAhe tomAlokara vAve teOMra AYAtasamUha spaSTabhAৱe vivRta kare yAte tomAloke hidAYata poৱA|

Aru tomAlokara mAjata enekuৱA eTA dala hoৱA ucita, yisakale kalyANara phAle (mAnuhaka) AhvAna kariva Aru satkarmara nirdeza diva Aru asatkarmara parA niSedha kariva; Aru teOMlokei ha’va sAphalyamaNDita|
tomAloke siha~tara dare naha’vA, yisakale spaSTa nidarzanasamUha ahAra pichato (vibhinna dalata) vibhakta haiche Aru nijara mAjatei matAnaikya sRSTi kariche; Aru siha~tara vAvei Ache mahAzAsti|

seidinA kichumAna mukha ujjala ha’va Aru kichumAna mukhamaNDala ka'lA pariva; yiha~tara mukha ka'lA pariva (siha~taka koৱA ha’va), ‘tomAloke ImAna AnAra pichata Akau kuphurI karichilA neki? eteke tomAloke zAsti bhoga karA, yihetu tomAloke kuphurI karichilA’|
Aru yisakalara mukha ujjala ha’va teOMloke AllAhara anugrahata thAkiva, tAta teOMloka cirasthAYI ha’va|
eivora haiche AllAhara AYAta (nidarzana), yivora Ami tomAra ocarata yathAyathabhAৱe tilAৱta karicho~; Aru AllAhe sRSTijagatara prati anyAYa-avicAra kariva nivicAre|
AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei Aru AllAhara ocaratei sakalo pratyAৱrtita ha’va|

tomAlokei zreSTha ummata, mAnaৱjAtira (hidAYatara) vAve (tomAlokaka) ulioৱA haiche, (kAraNa) tomAloke satkarmara Adeza diYA Aru asatkarmara parA niSedha karA lagate AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana karA| Ahale kitAvasakale yadi ImAna Anilehe~tena tente siha~tara vAve eYA bhAla ha’lahe~tena| siha~tara mAjata kichumAna mumino Ache; kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai haiche phAchikva|

sAmAnya kaSTa diYAra vAhire siha~te tomAlokara kono kSati kariva noৱAriva Aru yadi siha~te tomAlokara lagata yuddha kare tente siha~te pRSTha pradarzana kariva tAra pichata siha~taka sahAYa karA naha’va|

AllAha Aru mAnuhara AzraYara vAhire siha~te ya’tei aৱsthAna nakaraka kiYa, tAtei siha~tara vAve lAJchanA nirdhAraNa karA haiche, siha~ta AllAhara krodhara pAtra haiche lagate siha~tara oparata dAridratA nirdhAraNa kari diYA haiche; eikAraNe ye, siha~te AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichila Aru anyAYabhAৱe navIsakalaka hatyA karichila; lagate eikAraNeo ye, siha~ta avAdhya haichila Aru sImAlaMghana karichila|
siha~tara sakaloৱe samAna nahaYa| kitAvIsakalara mAjata avicalita eTA dalo Ache; siha~te rAti AllAhara AYAtasamUha tilAৱta kare Aru siha~te chAjadA kare|

siha~te AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna poSaNa kare, satkarmara nirdeza diYe asatkarmara parA niSedha kare, lagate siha~te kalyANakara kAmata pratiyogitA kare; Aru eOMlokei haiche pUNyaৱAnasakalara antarbhukta|
siha~te yi bhAla kAma kariche, tAra parA siha~taka ketiYAo vaJcita karA naha’va; Aru AllAha muttAkvIsakalara viSaYe savizeSa aৱgata|
nizcaYa yisakale kuphurI kariche, AllAhara ocarata siha~tara dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati kono kAmata nAhiva| siha~tei haiche jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI, Aru tAta siha~ta cirakAla thAkiva|

ei pArthiৱ jIৱnata siha~te yi vyaYa kare tAra udAharaNa hima-zItala vatAhara dare, yiToৱe anyAYakArI sampradAYara zasya khetita AghAta kare; Aru tAka dhvaMsa kari diYe| prakRtate AllAhe siha~tara prati kono anyAYa karA nAi, siha~ta nijei nijara prati anyAYa kariche|

he muminasakala! tomAloke nijara vAhire Ana (avizvAsI) kArovAka antaraGga vandhurUpe grahaNa nakarivA| siha~te tomAlokaka aniSTa karivalai truTi nakariva; kAraNa siha~te tomAlokara mArAtmaka kSatira kAmanA kare| nizcaYa siha~tara mukhara parA zatrutA prakAza pAiche Aru siha~tara antare yiTo gopana kare seYA Aru adhika bhaYAৱha| nizcaYa tomAlokara vAve AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe vivRta karicho~, yadi tomAloke anudhAৱna karA|

coৱA, tomAlokei siha~taka bhAlapoৱA, siha~te kintu tomAlokaka bhAla nApAYa, AnahAte tomAloke sakalo aizIgranthaka vizvAsa karA (kintu siha~te tomAlokara granthaka vizvAsa nakare)| lagate siha~te yetiYA tomAlokara saMsparzata Ahe tetiYA kaYa, ‘Ami ImAna Anicho~’, kintu yetiYA akalazarIYAkai (paraspare) milita haYa tetiYA tomAlokara prati Akrozata siha~te nijara AGulira agrabhAga kAmurivalai dhare| koৱA, ‘tomAlokara krodhata tomAlokei marA’| nizcaYa antarata yi Ache sei viSaYe AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|

tomAlokara maGgala ha’le siha~te kaSTa anubhaৱ kare Aru tomAlokara amaGgala ha’le siha~te Anandita haYa| tomAloke yadi dhairyyazIla hoৱA Aru muttAkvI hoৱA tente siha~tara SaDa়yantrai tomAlokaka eko kSati kariva noৱAriva| siha~te yi kare nizcaYa AllAhe seYA pariveSTana kari Ache|
Aru smaraNa karA, (uhudara dinA) yetiYA tumi puৱAra bhAgata nijara pariYAlara parA olAi gai yuddhara vAve muminasakalaka raNakSetrata vinyasta karichilA; Aru AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yetiYA tomAlokara mAjara duTA dala hatAza hai sAhasa heruৱAra upakrama haichila, athaca AllAha Achila ubhaYare sahAYaka, Aru AllAhara oparatei muminasakale tAৱAkkula (nirbhara) karA ucita|

Aru nizcaYa vadarara yuddhata AllAhe tomAlokaka sahAYa karichala, sei samaYata tomAloka ati durvala AchilA| eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, yAte tomAloke kRtajJatA prakAza kariva pArA|
smaraNa karA, yetiYA tumi muminasakalaka kaichilA, ‘eiTo tomAlokara vAve yatheSTa nahaYa neki ye, tomAlokara pratipAlake tini hejAra phiristA aৱtIrNa kari tomAlokaka sahayogitA kariva’?

haYa, nizcaYa, yadi tomAloke dhairyya dhAraNa karA Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, tente siha~te druta gatita tomAlokara oparata AkramaNa karile tomAlokara pratipAlake pA~ca hejAra (vizeSarUpe) cihnita phiristA pradAna kari tomAlokaka sahAYa kariva|
Aru AllAhe (ei sahAYaka) tomAlokara vAve susaMvAda vanAiche, yAte iYAra dvArA tomAlokara antare prazAnti lAbha kare; kiYano sahAYa keৱla parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAhara taraphara parAhe Ahe|
yAte teOM kAphirasakalara eTA aMzaka dhvaMsa kariva pAre athavA lAJchita kariva pAre; phalata yAte siha~te nirAza hai ubhati yAYa|
teOM siha~tara tAovA kavula kare ne siha~taka zAsti diYe- ei viSaYe tomAra kono adhikAra nAi; kAraNa siha~ta haiche yAlima|
AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei| teOM yAka icchA kare kSamA kari diYe Aru yAka icchA kare zAsti vihe; (jAni thoৱA) AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he muminasakala! tomAloke cakra vRddhi hArata suta nAkhAvA Aru AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA yAte tomAloke saphala ha’va pArA|
Aru tomAloke sei juika bhaYa karA yiTo kAphirasakalara vAve prastuta karA haiche|
lagate tomAloke AllAha Aru rAchulara Anugatya karA yAte tomAloke kRpA lAbha kariva pArA|
Aru tomAloke druta agrasara hoৱA nija pratipAlakara kSamAra pine Aru sei jAnnAtara pine yAra paridhi AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra samAna, yiTo prastuta karA haiche muttAkvIsakalara vAve|
yisakale sacchala Aru asacchala aৱsthAta dAna kare, Aru krodha saMvaraNa kare tathA mAnuhaka kSamA kare; AllAhe (sei) satkarmazIla lokasakalaka bhAla pAYa;

Aru yisakale kono azlIla kAma karile vA nijara prati anyAYa karile AllAhaka smaraNa kare Aru nijara pApa kAryara vAve kSamA prArthanA kare| AllAhara vAhire Ana koneno pApa kSamA kariva? Aru teOMloke yiTo (gunAha) kari pelAiche seiTo jAni vuji punara nakare|

eOMlokei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara puraskAra haiche teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata kSamA Aru jAnnAta, yAra taladezata nadI pravAhita thAkiva, tAta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va; Aru satkarmazIla lokara puraskAra kimAna ye uttama!
nizcaYa tomAlokara pUrve vahu (jAtira) rIti-nIti atIta hai gaiche, seYe tomAloke pRthiৱIta bhramaNa karA Aru coৱA michalIYAsakalara ki pariNAma haichila|
eivora haiche mAnuhara vAve spaSTa varNanA Aru muttAkvIsakalara vAve hidAYata Aru upadeza|
tomAloke durvala naha’vA Aru cintitao naha’vA; tomAlokei vijaYI ha’vA, yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA|

(uhuda yuddhata) yadi tomAloke AghAta pAichA tente siha~teo (vadarara yuddhata) tenei AghAta pAiche| Ami mAnuhara mAjata paryAYakrame ei dinavorara Aৱrtana ghaTAi thAko~, yAte AllAhe muminasakalaka prakAza kariva pAre Aru tomAlokara mAjara parA kichumAnaka zvahIdarUpe grahaNa kariva pAre; Aru AllAhe yAlimasakalaka pachanda nakare|
lagate yAte AllAhe muminasakalaka parizuddha kariva pAre Aru kAphirasakalaka nizcihna kariva pAre|
tomAloke bhavA neki ye, tomAloke (enei) jAnnAtata praৱeza karivA athaca AllAhe etiYAo tomAlokara mAjara kone jihAda kariche Aru kona dhairyyazIla seYA prakAza karA nAi?
nizcaYa tomAloke mRtyura sanmukhIna hoৱAra Agata seYA (mRtyu) kAmanA karichilA, eteke etiYAto tomAloke nija cakure tAka pratyakSa karilA|

Aru muhAmmada keৱla ejana rAchula; teOMra Agata vahuto rAchula atIta haiche| eteke yadi teOM mRtyuvaraNa kare athavA nihata haYa tente tomAloke pRSThapradarzana karivA neki? prakRtate yiYe pRSTha pradarzana kariva si ketiYAo AllAhara kono kSati kariva noৱAriva; Aru AllAhe anatipalame kRtajJasakalaka puraskRta kariva|

AllAhara anumati avihane kAro mRtyu ha’va noৱAre, yihetu eYA sunirdiSTabhAৱe likhita Ache| yiYe pArthiৱ puraskAra vicAre Ami tAka iYAra parA pradAna karo~ Aru yiYe AkhirAtara puraskAra vicAre Ami tAka tAra parAi pradAna karo~, Aru anatipalame Ami kRtajJasakalaka puraskRta karima|

Aru enekuৱA vahuto navI Achila, yisakalara lagata thAki vahu saMkhyaka (ImAna Aru Amale chalehara oparata prazikSaNaprApta) loke yuddha kariche| AllAhara pathata teOMlokara yi viparyaYa ghaTichila tAta teOMloke manovala heruৱA nAchila, durvalao hoৱA nAchila Aru nata hoৱAo nAchila; prakRtate AllAha dhairyyazIlasakalaka bhAla pAYa|

ei kathAra vAhire teOMlokara (mukhata) Ana kono kathA nAchila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra pApasamUha Aru karmajIৱnara sImAlaMghanasamUha tumi kSamA kari diYA Aru AmAra bharika avicala rakhA, lagate kAphira sampradAYara viruddhe AmAka sahAYa karA’|
phalata AllAhe teOMlokaka pRthiৱIra puraskAra Aru AkhirAtara uttama puraskAra pradAna kariche; kAraNa AllAhe satkarmazIla lokasakalaka bhAlapAYa|
he muminasakala! yadi tomAloke kAphirasakalara Anugatya karA tente siha~te tomAlokaka viparIta phAle (pUrvAৱsthAlai) obhatAi lai yAva, phalata tomAloka kSatigrasta hai parivA|
varaM AllAhei haiche tomAlokara abhibhAৱka Aru teৱe~i uttama sahAYakArI|

anatipalame Ami kAphirasakalara hRdaYata bhItira saJcAra karima, yihetu siha~te AllAhara lagata aMzIdAra sthApana kariche, yAra sapakSe AllAhe kono pramANa aৱtIrNa karA nAi; siha~tara AvAsa haiche jAhAnnAma, Aru yAlimasakalara AvAsa kimAna ye nikRSTa!

nizcaYa AllAhe tomAlokara lagata teOMra pratizruti pUraNa karichila yetiYA tomAloke AllAhara anumatikrame siha~taka vinAza karichilA, kintu yetiYA tomAloke sAhasa heruৱAichilA Aru (rAchulara) nirdeza samparke matabheda sRSTi karichilA Aru yi tomAloke bhAlapoৱA (vijaYa) seYA dekhuৱAra pichata tomAloke avAdhya haichilA| kAraNa, tomAlokara kichumAne pArthiৱ sampadara abhilASI Achila Aru kichumAna Achila AkhirAtara abhilASI| tetiYA teOM tomAlokaka parIkSA karAra vAve siha~tara (tomAlokara zatrusakalara) parA pazcAdavartI karAle| tathApio (kintu) teOM tomAlokaka kSamA kari diche| kAraNa AllAha muminasakalara prati anugrahazIla|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAloke pAhAra vagAi AchilA Aru kAro phAlei ghUri coৱA nAchilA, Aru rAchule tomAlokaka pichaphAlara parA mAti Achila| phalata teOM (AllAhe) tomAlokaka vipadara oparata vipada dichila, yAte tomAloke yi heruৱAichA Aru yi vipada tomAlokara oparata Ahiche tAra vAve tomAloke duHkhita nohoৱA; Aru tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|

dukhara pichata teOM tomAlokaka tandrArUpe prazAnti pradAna karile, yiTo tomAlokara eTA dalaka Acchanna karichila Aru eTA dale ajJatA yugara ajJatAra dare AllAha samparke avAstaৱ dhAraNA kari nijei nijake udvigna karichila ei kathA kai ye, ‘AmAro kivA adhikAra Achene? koৱA, ‘sakalo viSaYa AllAharei ikhatiYArata’| siha~te nijara antarata enekuৱA kichumAna viSaYa gopana rAkhe yivora tomAra ocarata prakAza nakare| siha~te kaYa, ‘ei viSaYe AmAra kivA adhikAra thAkile Ami iYAta eidare nihata naha’lohe~tena’| koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke nija gharato aৱsthAna karilAhe~tena tathApio yisakalara vAve nihata hoৱATo aৱdhArita Achila, siha~te nizcaYa nijara mRtyusthAnalai olAi Ahilahe~tena’| eiTo eikAraNe ye, tomAlokara antarata yi Ache seYA yAte AllAhe parIkSA kare Aru tomAlokara manata yi Ache seYA parizodhana kare; Aru antarata yi Ache sei samparke AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|

yidinA duYo dala parasparara sanmukhIna haichila seidinA tomAlokara mAjara parA yisakale pRSTha pradarzana karichila, siha~tara kichumAna kRtakarmara phalate caYatAne siha~tara padaskhalana ghaTAichila| nizcaYa AllAhe siha~taka kSamA kariche| niHsandehe AllAha kSamAparAYaNa Aru parama sahanazIla|

he muminasakala! tomAloke siha~tara dare naha’vA yisakale kuphurI kare Aru siha~tara bhAtRsakale yetiYA deza-videzalai bhramaNa kare vA yuddhata lipta haYa tetiYA siha~tara viSaYe kaYa, ‘siha~ta yadi AmAra lagata thAkilahe~tena tente siha~ta namarilahe~tena Aru nihata naha’lahe~tena’| phalata AllAhe ei viSaYaToka siha~tara manata dukha Aru cintA sRSTira kAraNata pariNata karile; darAcalate AllAhei jIৱna dAna kare Aru mRtyu ghaTAYa, Aru tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka draSTA|
yadi tomAloke AllAhara pathata nihata hoৱA athavA tomAloke mRtyuvaraNa karA, (tente jAni thoৱA) AllAhara kSamA Aru daYA siha~te saJcaYa karA sampadatakaio uttama|
Aru yadi tomAloke mRtyuvaraNa karA athavA tomAlokaka hatyA karA haYa tente tomAlokaka AllAhara ocaratei samaveta karA ha’va|

eteke AllAhara kRpAta tumi siha~tara prati komala-hRdaYa haichilA; yadi tumi rUDha় Aru kaThoracitta ha’lAhe~tena tente siha~ta nizcaYa tomAra saGga tyAga karilehe~tena| eteke tumi siha~taka kSamA kari diYA Aru siha~tara vAve kSamA prArthanA karA Aru kAma-kAjara vAve siha~tara lagata parAmarza karA, tAra pichata tumi kono saMkalpa karile AllAhara oparata nirbhara karA; nizcaYa AllAhe (teOMra oparata) nirbharakArIsakalaka bhAlapAYa|

AllAhe tomAlokaka sahAYa karile tomAlokara oparata koneo jaYI ha’va noৱAriva; AnahAte teOM yadi tomAlokaka parityAga kare, tente tetiYA teOMra vAhire kona Ache, yiYe tomAlokaka sahAYa kariva? eteke muminasakale AllAhara oparatei bharasA karA ucita|

Aru kono navIra vAve ucita nahaYa ye, teOM ‘galula’ (anyAYabhAৱe kono vastu gopana vA AtmasAt) kariva, eiTo asambhaৱ| yiYe anyAYabhAৱe kivA gopana kariva, kiYAmatara dinA si sei anyAYabhAৱe gopana karA vastu lagata lai upasthita ha’va| tAra pichata pratyekake tAra karma anusari pUrNa mAtrAta tAra pratiphala pradAna karA ha’va| siha~tara prati kono anyAYa karA naha’va|
yiYe AllAhara santuSTira anusaraNa kariche, teOM sei vyaktira dare ha’va pAre neki yiYe AllAhara krodhara pAtra haiche Aru jAhAnnAmei yAra AvAsa? seiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa pratyAৱrtanasthala!
AllAhara ocarata teOMloka vibhinna starara; teOMloke yi kare sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka draSTA|

nizcaYa AllAhe muminasakalara prati anugraha kariche ye, teOM siha~tara mAjara parAi siha~tara ocaralai ejana rAchula paThiYAiche, yijane teOMra AYAtasamUha siha~tara ocarata tilAৱta kare, siha~taka parizuddha kare lagate siha~taka kitAva Aru hikamatara zikSA diYe, yadio siha~ta Agate spaSTa vibhrAntita Achila|

ki ha’la tomAlokara! yetiYA tomAlokara oparata vipada Ahichila (uhudara yuddhata) tetiYA tomAloke kaichilA, ‘eiTo ka’ra parA Ahila’? athaca tomAloke (vadarara yuddhata) siha~tara oparata dviguNa vipada AnichilA| koৱA, ‘eiTo tomAlokara nijara (doSara) kAraNei Ahiche’; nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata pUrNa kSamatAৱAna|

Aru yidinA duYo dala paraspara sanmukhIna haichila, seidinA tomAlokara oparata yi viparyaYa ghaTichila seYA AllAhara anumatikramei haichila; yAte teOM prakAza kare, kona tomAlokara mAjata prakRta mumina|

Aru munAphikasakalaka prakAza karAra vAve; kAraNa siha~taka koৱA haichila, ‘AhA, tomAloke AllAhara pathata yuddha karivA athavA pratirakSA karivA’| tetiYA siha~te kaichila, ‘yadi yuddha ha’va vuli Ami jAnilohe~tena tente Ami nizcaYa tomAlokara anusaraNa karilohe~tena’| seidinA siha~ta ImAnatakai kupharIra vechi ocarata Achila| siha~te mukhere yivora kaYa Acalate seYA siha~tara antarata nAi Aru siha~te yivora gopana kari rAkhe, sei viSaYe AllAha adhika aৱgata|

yisakale gharate vahi nija bhAtRsakalara viSaYe kaichila ye, ‘yadi siha~ta AmAra anusaraNa karilehe~tena tente nizcaYa siha~ta nihata naha’lahe~tena’| siha~taka koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA tente nijake mRtyura parA rakSA karAcona’|
yisakale AllAhara pathata nihata haiche teOMlokaka ketiYAo mRta vuli dhAraNA nakarivA; varaM teOMloka nija pratipAlakara ocarata jIৱita Ache Aru teOMlokaka jIৱikAo diYA haYa|

AllAhe teOMlokaka yi anugraha pradAna kariche tAkalai teOMloka Anandita, Aru teOMloke teOMlokara pichaphAle eri thai yoৱA seisakala lokara viSaYeo Anandita haYa yisakale etiYAo teOMlokara saite milita hoৱA nAi, eikAraNe ye, teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va|
teOMloke AllAhara niYAmata Aru anugraha pAi Ananda prakAza kare| nizcaYa AllAhe muminasakalara zramaphala vinaSTa nakare|
yisakale Ahata hoৱAra pichato AllAha Aru rAchulara AhvAnata sa~hAri dichila| teOMlokara mAjara yisakale satkarma kariche Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariche, teOMlokara vAve Ache mahApuraskAra|

teOMlokaka mAnuhe kaichila, ‘tomAlokara viruddhe sainyavAhinI samaveta haiche, gatike tomAloke siha~taka bhaYa karA ucita’, kintu ei kathAi teOMlokara ImAna Aru adhika vRddhihe karile lagate teOMloke ka’le, ‘AllAhei AmAra vAve yatheSTa Aru teOM kimAna ye uttama karmavidhAYaka’!

tAra pichata teOMloka AllAhara niYAmata Aru anugrahasaha ubhati Ahichila, kono aniSTai teOMlokaka sparza karA nAchila Aru teOMloke AllAhara santuSTira anusaraNa karichila; (jAni thoৱA) AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

darAcalate sei (bhaYa dekhuৱA vyakti)jana Achila caYatAna| yiYe tomAlokaka tAra (kAphira) vandhusakalara bhaYa dekhuৱAYa; eteke yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA, tente siha~taka ketiYAo bhaYa nakarivA, keৱla mokei bhaYa karA|

yisakale kuphurIra phAle drutagAmI, siha~tara AcaraNe yena tomAka duzcintAgrasta nakare| siha~te ketiYAo AllAhara kSati kariva noৱAriva| AllAhe AkhirAtata siha~taka kono aMza diva nivicAre; Aru siha~tara vAve Ache mahA zAsti|
nizcaYa yisakale ImAnara vinimaYata kuphurI kini laiche siha~te ketiYAo AllAhara kono kSati kariva noৱAriva| siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

kAphirasakale yena kadApio eiTo dhAraNA nakare ye, Ami siha~taka yiTo aৱkAza diOM seYA siha~tara vAve maGgalajanaka; varaM Ami siha~taka eikAraNe aৱkAza diOM, yAte siha~tara pAparAzi vRddhi haYa| kAraNa siha~tara vAve Ache lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|

paৱitraka (muminaka) apaৱitrara (munAphikara) parA pRthaka nakarAlaike tomAloke yi aৱsthAta AchA sei aৱsthAta AllAhe muminasakalaka eri diva noৱAre| eidare gAYeva (adRzya) samparke tomAlokaka aৱhita karAToo AllAhara niYama nahaYa; kintu (eikSetrata) AllAhe teOMra rAchulasakalara mAjara parA yAka icchA manonIta kare| gatike tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulasakalara oparata ImAna poSaNa karA| yadi tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karA Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA tente tomAlokara vAve Ache mahA puraskAra|

Aru AllAhe nija anugrahara parA siha~taka yi dAna kariche tAkalai yisakale kRpaNatA kare siha~te yena ei dhAraNA nakare ye, siha~tara vAve eiTo kalyANakara| varaM ei (kRpaNatA) siha~tara vAve amaGgala| siha~te yi sampattikalai kRpaNatA kari Ache kiYAmatara dinA seiToৱe siha~tara galAৱddha kari diYA ha’va| AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra svatvAdhikArI haiche ekamAtra AllAha| tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|

nizcaYa AllAhe siha~tara kathA zuniche yisakale kaYa, ‘nizcaYa AllAha abhAৱgrasta Aru Amihe abhAৱmukta’| nizcaYa Ami likhi rAkhima siha~tara ei kathA Aru navIsakalaka anyAYabhAৱe hatyAra viSaYaToo; Aru Ami ka’ma, ‘tomAloke dahana yantraNAra soৱAda loৱA’|
eYAi haiche tomAlokara kRtakarmara phala Aru nizcaYa AllAha vAndAhasakalara prati anyAYakArI nahaYa|

yisakale kaYa, ‘nizcaYa AllAhe AmAka aGgIkAra dichila ye, Ami yAte kono rAchulara prati ImAna poSaNa nakaro~, yetiYAlaike teOM AmAra ocarata enekuৱA kuravAnI nakariva yiToka agni zikhAi khAi pelAva’| siha~taka koৱA, ‘mora Agata vahuto rAchula spaSTa nidarzanalai Ahichila Aru tomAloke yi kai AchA seiTosaha tomAlokara ocaralai Ahichila, yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA tente kiYa tomAloke teOMlokaka hatyA karichilA’|

eteke yadi siha~te tomAra prati mithyAropa kare, tente (jAni thoৱA) tomAra Agata yisakala rAchula spaSTa nidarzanalai, AcamAnI chahIphA Aru diptimAna kitAvalai Ahichila teOMlokara pratio mithyAropa karA haichila|

pratiTo prANIYei mRtyura soৱAda grahaNa kariva; Aru kiYAmatara dinA tomAlokara karmaphala paripUrNabhAৱe pradAna karA ha’va| eteke yAka juira parA A~tarata rakhA ha’va, Aru jAnnAtata praৱeza karoৱA ha’va, teৱe~i haiche saphala| pArthiৱ jIৱnaTo chalanAmaYa bhogara vAhire Ana eko nahaYa|

nizcaYa tomAlokaka tomAlokara dhana-sampada Aru nijara jIৱna samparke parIkSA karA ha’va| tomAlokara pUrve yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karA haichila siha~tara parA Aru muzvarikasakalara parA tomAloke vahuto kaSTadAYaka kathA zunivalai pAvA| yadi tomAloke dhairyya dhAraNa karA Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA tente nizcaYa seYA ha’va dRDha় saMkalpara kAma|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA AllAhe kitAvIsakalara parA pratizruti laichila ye, ‘nizcaYa tomAloke iYAka mAnuhara ocarata spaSTabhAৱe prakAza karivA Aru iYAka gopana nakarivA’| iYAra pichato siha~te iYAka (agrAhya kari) siha~tara pichaphAle pelAi dichila Aru tuccha mulyata vikrI karichila, gatike siha~te yiTo kraYa kare seYA kimAna ye nikRSTa!

yisakale nijara kRtakarmakalai Ananda prakAza kare Aru yiTo kAma nije karA nAi tenekuৱA kAmara vAveo prazaMsita ha’valai bhAlapAYa, tumi ketiYAo dhAraNA nakarivA ye, siha~te zAstira parA mukti pAva; siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra sArvabhauma rAjatva ekamAtra AllAharei; Aru AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
nizcaYa AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sRSTita, lagate rAti Aru dinara pariৱrtanara mAjata vivekasampanna lokasakalara vAve vahuto nidarzanAৱlI Ache|

yisakale thiYa hai, vahi Aru zui zui AllAhaka smaraNa kare Aru AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sRSTi samparke cintA kare, lagate kaYa, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi eivora anarthaka sRSTi karA nAi, tumi atyanta paৱitra, eteke tumi AmAka juira zAstira parA rakSA karA’|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! ‘tumi yAka juita nikSepa karivA, nizcaYa tumi tAka apamAna karivA; Aru yAlimasakalara vAve kono sahAYakArI nAi’|

he AmAra pratipAlaka! ‘Ami ejana AhvAYakaka ImAnara pine AhvAna karA zunicho~ ye, ‘tomAloke tomAlokara pratipAlakara prati ImAna poSaNa karA’| seYe Ami ImAna Anicho~| he AmAra pratipAlaka! ‘tumi AmAra pApasamUha kSamA kari diYA, Aru AmAra truTi-vicyutisamUha dUra kari diYA, lagate AmAka satkarmaparAYaNa lokasakalara sahagAmI kari mRtyu pradAna karA’|

he AmAra pratipAlaka! ‘tomAra rAchulasakalara mAdhyamata AmAka yiTo divalai pratizruti dichA seYA AmAka dAna karA Aru kiYAmatara dinA AmAka apamAna nakarivA| nizcaYa tumi pratizrutira vyatikrama nakarA’|

tAra pichata siha~tara pratipAlake siha~tara AhvAnata sa~hAri di ka’le, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara mAjara AmalakArI kono nara vA nArIra Amala vinaSTa nakaro~ tomAloke ijane sijanara aMza| eteke yisakale hijarata kariche, nija gharara parA utkhAta haiche, Aru mora pathata niryAtita haiche tathA yuddha kariche lagate nihatao haiche, nizcaYa mai siha~tara pApasamUha mocana kari dima Aru siha~taka jAnnAtata praৱeza karAma, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita thAkiva| eiToৱe haiche AllAhara taraphara parA puraskAra; Aru uttama puraskAra AllAhara ocaratei Ache’|
yisakale kuphurI kariche, deza-videzalai siha~tara avAdha vicaraNe yena tomAka vicalita nakare|
eivora haiche sAmAnya bhoga-vilAsa mAtra| iYAra pichata jAhAnnAmei haiche siha~tara AvAsa; Aru seiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa vizrAmasthala!

kintu yisakale nija pratipAlakaka bhaYa kare teOMlokara vAve Ache jAnnAta, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita thAkiva, tAta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va| eYA haiche AllAhara taraphara parA Atithya; Aru AllAhara ocarata yi Ache seYA satkarmaparAYaNasakalara vAve ati uttama|

Aru nizcaYa kitAvIsakalara mAjata enekuৱA loko Ache yisakale AllAhara prati vinaYAৱnata hai teOMra prati ImAna poSaNa kare Aru teOM yi tomAlokara Aru teOMlokara prati aৱtIrNa kariche tAra pratio ImAna Ane| teOMloke AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka tuccha mUlyata vikrI nakare| teOMlokara vAvei Ache AllAhara ocarata puraskAra| nizcaYa AllAha druta hicApa grahaNakArI|
he muminasakala! tomAloke dhairyya dhAraNa karA Aru dhairyya dhAraNata pratiyogitA karA, lagate sadAYa yuddhara vAve prastuta thAkivA| AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA yAte saphala ha’va pArA|

he mAnaৱjAti! tomAloke nija pratipAlakara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, yijane tomAlokaka eTA prANara parA sRSTi kariche Aru tAra parAi teOMra strI sRSTi kariche, Aru teOMloka dujanara parA vahuto nara-nArI vistAra kariche; tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, yAra nAmara dohAi di tomAloke paraspare adhikAra sAvyasta karA, lagate teja-samparkIYa AtmIYatA chinna karAra kSetrato bhaYa karA| nizcaYa AllAha tomAlokara oparata paryavekSaka|

Aru etImasakalaka tomAloke siha~tara dhana-sampada samarpaNa karA; Aru (zunA!) tomAloke apaৱitra vastuka paৱitra vastura dvArA salani nakarivA lagate tomAloke nijara sampadara saite siha~tara sampada mizrita kari grAsa nakarivA| nizcaYa eiTo mahApApa|

Aru yadi tomAloke azaMkA karA ye, etIma choৱAlIsakalara prati tomAloke suvicAra kariva noৱArivA, tente (svAdhIna) nArIsakalara mAjara parA yAka tomAlokara bhAla lAge dujanI, tinijanI athavA cArijanIka vivAha kariva pArA; Aru yadi AzaMkA karA ye, (siha~tara mAjata) suvicAra kariva noৱArivA teneha’le ejanIkei (vivAha karoৱA) athavA tomAlokara adhikArabhukta dAsIkei grahaNa karA| avicAra karAra parA rakSA poৱAra eiToৱei haiche sambhaৱpara upAYa|

Aru tomAloke nArIsakalaka santuSTacitte siha~tara mohara pradAna karA; iYAra pichata siha~te yadi santuSTacitte moharara kichu aMza rehAi diYe tente tomAloke seYA Anandara saite tRptisahakAre bhoga karA|

Aru tomAloke nirvodhasakalara hAtata tomAlokara dhana-sampada arpaNa nakarivA; yivoraka AllAhe tomAlokara jIৱikAra mAdhyama vanAiche| aৱzye tAra parAi siha~tara khoৱA-voৱA pindhAra vyaৱsthA karA Aru tomAloke siha~tara lagata sadAlApa karivA|

Aru tomAloke etImasakalaka siha~tara vivAhara vaYasata upanIta nohoৱAlaike parIkSA karivA; tAra pichata siha~tara mAjata bhAla veYA vicArara jJAna dekhivalai pAle siha~tara sampada siha~taka obhatAi divA, Aru siha~ta DAGara hai yAva vuli tomAloke (siha~tara sampada) larA-larikai apacaYa kari khAi zeSa nakarivA| yijana abhAৱmukta teOM yena nivRtta thAke Aru yijana vittahIna teOM yena saMyata parimANe bhoga kare| tAra pichata yetiYA tomAloke siha~tara sampada obhatAi divA tetiYA sAkSI rAkhivA; Aru hicApa grahaNata AllAhei yatheSTa|
pitR-mAtR Aru AtmIYa-svajanara parityakta sampattita puruSara aMza Ache Aru pitR-mAtR lagate AtmIYa-svajanara parityakta sampattita nArIro aMza Ache, seYA kama haoka vA vechi, eiTo nirdhArita aMza|
Aru sampatti vaNTana karAra samaYata AtmIYa-svajana, etIma Aru abhAৱgrasta loka upasthita thAkile siha~taka tAra parA alapa ha'leo pradAna karivA, Aru siha~tara lagata sadAlApa karivA|

Aru siha~tara bhaYa karA ucita ye, yadi siha~te nijara pichata niHsahAYa santAna eri thai yAYa tente siha~teo siha~tara viSaYe udvigna ha’lahe~tena| eteke siha~te yena AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare Aru saGgata kathA kaYa|
nizcaYa yisakale etImasakalara sampada anyAYabhAৱe grAsa kare, darAcalate siha~te nijara peTata agni bharAi laYa anatipalame siha~ta prajjvalita juita praৱeza kariva|

AllAhe tomAlokaka tomAlokara santAna samparke ei nirdeza diche ye, ejana putrara aMza dujanI kanyAra aMzara samAna; kintu yadi keৱla dujanItakai vechi kanyA thAke tente teOMlokara vAve parityakta sampattira tini bhAgara dubhAga, Aru keৱla ejanI kanyA thAkile tente tAira vAve ardhAMza| santAna thAkile (mRta vyaktira) pitR-mAtR ubhaYe parityakta sampattira chaYa bhAgara ebhAga pAva; AnahAte (mRta vyakti) niHsantAna ha’le, lagate pitR-mAtR uttarAdhikArI ha’le tAra mAkara vAve tini bhAgara ebhAga; Aru yadi tAra bhAi-bhanI thAke teneha’le mAkara vAve chaYa bhAgara ebhAga; eivora vaNTana ha’va tAra achiYata Aru RNa parizodha karAra pichata| tomAlokara pitA Aru santAnasakalara mAjata kona vechi upakArI seYA tomAloke nAjAnA| ei vidhAna AllAhara; nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomAlokara strIsakalara parityakta sampattira ardhAMza tomAloke pAvA, yadi siha~tara kono santAna nAthAke, kintu siha~tara santAna thAkile tomAlokara vAve siha~tara parityakta sampattira cAri bhAgara ebhAga; achiYata pAlana Aru RNa parizodha karAra pichata| tomAlokara santAna nAthAkile siha~tara vAve tomAlokara parityakta sampattira cAri bhAgara ebhAga, Aru tomAlokara santAna thAkile siha~tara vAve tomAlokara parityakta sampattira ATha bhAgara ebhAga; tomAloke yi achiYata karivA seYA pradAna karAra pichata Aru RNa parizodha karAra pichata| yadi kono puruSa athavA nArIra ‘kAlAlAha’ uttarAdhikArI haYa (arthAt pitR-mAtR Aru santAna-santati nathakA aৱsthAta kArovAra mRtyu haYa), Aru keৱla tAra ejana kakAYeka-bhAYeka athavA ejanI vAYeka-bhanIYeka thAke tente pratyekare (aMza ha’va) chaYa bhAgara ebhAga| AnahAte siha~ta iYAra adhika ha’le sakaloৱe tini bhAgara ebhAgata samAna aMzIdAra ha’va; kAro kSati nakarAkai eivora vaNTana karA ha'va achiYata pUraNa karAra pichata Aru RNa parizodha karAra pichata| eiTo haiche AllAhara nirdeza; Aru AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

eivora haiche AllAhara nirdhArita sImArekhA| yiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya kariva AllAhe teOMka jAnnAtata praৱeza karAva, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita, tAta teOMloka cirasthAYI ha’va; Aru eiToৱei haiche mahA saphalatA|

AnahAte yiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara avAdhyatA kariva Aru teOMra nirdhArita sImArekhA laMghana kariva AllAhe tAka juita nikSepa kariva, tAta si cirasthAYI ha’va; lagate tAra vAve Ache lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|

Aru tomAlokara nArIsakalara mAjara parA yiYe vyabhicAra kare siha~tara viruddhe tomAlokara mAjara parA cArijana (puruSa) sAkSI talava karA| eteke yadi siha~te sAkSI diYe tente siha~taka (nArIsakalaka) gharata aৱruddha kari rAkhA yetiYAlaike siha~tara mRtyu nahaYa athavA AllAhe siha~tara vAve Ana kono vyaৱsthA kari nidiYe|

Aru tomAlokara mAjara yi dujana (nara-nArI) ene apakarmata lipta ha’va siha~taka zAsti diYA| yadi siha~te tAovA kare Aru nijake saMzodhana kari laYa tente siha~taka eri diYA| nizcaYa AllAha parama tAovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYa AllAhe seisakala lokara tAovA kavula kare yisakale ajJatAvazataH veYA kAma kari pelAYa Aru lage lage tAovA kare, eOMlokei haiche seisakala loka yisakalara tAovA AllAhe kavula kare| (jAni thoৱA) AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

pakSAntare tAovA siha~tara vAve nahaYa yisakale AjIৱna veYA kAma kare, aৱzeSata siha~tara kArovAra mRtyu upasthita ha’le si kaYa, ‘mai etiYA tAovA karicho~’, eidare siha~tara vAveo nahaYa, yisakalara mRtyu kAphira aৱsthAta haYa| iha~tei seisakala loka yisakalara vAve Ami kaSTadAYaka zAsti prastuta kari rAkhicho~|

he ImAndArasakala! valapUrvakabhAৱe nijake nArIsakalara uttarAdhikArI vuli gaNya karATo tomAlokara vAve vaidha nahaYa| tomAloke siha~taka yi pradAna karichA tAra parA kichu aMza AtmasAt karAra uddazye siha~taka aৱruddha kari nArAkhivA, kintu yadi siha~te spaSTa veYA AcaraNa kare (yene- vyabhicAra vA giriYekara avAdhyAcaraNa tente seYA sukIYA kathA)| Aru tomAloke siha~tara lagata satbhAৱe jIৱna-yApana karivA; tomAloke yadi siha~taka apachanda karA tente enekuৱAo ha’va pAre ye, yiTota AllAhe vahu kalyANa nihita kari rAkhiche Aru tomAloke seiToke apachanda kari AchA|

Aru tomAloke yadi ejanI strIra ThAita Ana ejanI strI grahaNa karivalai thira karA Aru siha~tara ejanIka vahu parimANe arthao dichA, tathApio tAira parA ekoৱei obhatAi nala’vA| tomAloke michA apavAda Aru prakAzya pApAcaraNara dvArA seYA grahaNa karivAne?
Aru kenekai tomAloke seYA grahaNa karivA? athaca tomAloke ijane sijanara lagata saMgata haichilA (sambhoga karichA) Aru siha~teo tomAlokara parA dRDha় aGgIkAra laichila|

nArIsakalara mAjara parA yisakalaka tomAlokara pitR puruSe vivAha kariche, tomAloke siha~taka vivAha nakarivA, kintu pUrve yi saMghaTita haiche (seYA kSamA karA ha’la)| nizcaYa seYA Achila azlIlatA, mArAtmaka ghRNita viSaYa Aru nikRSTa patha|

tomAlokara oparata hArAma karA haiche, tomAlokara mAtRsakalaka, jIYekasakalaka, vAi-bhanIsakalaka, jeThAi-pehIsakalaka, jeThAi-mAhIsakalaka, bhatijIsakalaka, bhAginIsakalaka, dhAi mAtRsakalaka, piYAha samvandhIYa vAi-bhanIsakalaka, zAhuYeka Aru tomAlokara strIsakalara mAjata yAra lagata sambhoga karichA tAira Agara svAmIra dvArA garbhajAta choৱAlIka, yAka tomAloke lAlana-pAlana karichA; kintu yadi sei strIra saite sambhoga karA nAi tente tomAlokara vAve kono aparAdha nAi| tomAlokara vAve Aru niSiddha karA haiche tomAlokara auraSajAta putrara strIsakalaka Aru dujanI bhanIYeka-vAYekaka (vivAha vandhanata) ekatrita karA, atItata yi ha’la, seYA ha’la| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru nArIsakalara mAjara tomAlokara adhikArabhukta dAsIra vAhire Anara vivAha vandhanata thakA tirotAsakala tomAlokara vAve niSiddha karA haiche, tomAlokara vAve eivora haiche AllAhara vidhAna| ullekhita nArIsakalara vAhire anya sakalo nArIka vivAha karATo tomAlokara vAve vaidha karA haiche, ei cartata ye tomAloke siha~taka nijara sampadara vinimaYata (mohara pradAna kari) vivAhara mAdhyamata grahaNa karivA, avaidha yauna samparkara vAve nahaYa| siha~tara mAjara yisakalara saite tomAloke sambhoga karichA siha~taka siha~tara nirdhArita mohara arpaNa karivA| mohara nirdhAraNara pichata tomAloke kono (kama-vechi karAra) viSaYata paraspara sahamata ha’le tAta tomAlokara kono doSa nAi| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Aru tomAlokara mAjara yAra svAdhIna ImAndAra nArI vivAha karAra sAmartha nAi, si yena tomAlokara adhikArabhukta ImAndAra dAsIka vivAha kare; AllAhe tomAlokara ImAna samparke parijJAta| tomAloka ijane sijanara samAna; eteke tomAloke siha~taka siha~tara mAlikara anumatikrame vivAha karivA Aru siha~taka siha~tara mohara nyAYasaMgata hicApe pradAna karivA| siha~ta ha’va sajacaritrA, vyabhicAriNI nahaYa Aru upapati (gopana yaunasaGgI) grahaNakArINIo nahaYa| eteke vivAhitA hoৱAra pichata yadi siha~te vyabhicAra kare tente siha~tara zAsti ha’va svAdhIna nArIra zAstira arddheka; (dAsI vivAhara) ei vidhAna tomAlokara mAjara seisakala lokara vAve, yisakale vyabhicArata lipta hoৱAra AzaMkA kare; AnahAte yadi tomAloke dhairyya dhAraNa karA tente tomAlokara vAve maGgala Ache| AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|

AllAhe tomAlokara ocarata (teOMra vidhAna) vizadabhAৱe varNanA kariva vicAre, Aru tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara rItinIti tomAlokaka aৱhita kariva vicAre lagate tomAlokaka kSamA kariva vicAre| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
Aru AllAhe tomAlokara tAovA kavula kariva vicAre; AnahAte yisakale kupravRttira anusaraNa kare siha~te vicAre ye, tomAloke pravalabhAৱe (satya pathara parA) vicyuta hoৱA|
AllAhe tomAlokara parA (vojA) laghu kariva vicAre, kAraNa mAnuhaka sRSTi karA haiche ati durvala hicApe|

he muminasakala! tomAloke ijane sijanara sampatti anyAYabhAৱe grAsa nakarivA; kintu pArasparika sanmatikrame vyaৱsAYa-vANijyara mAdhyamata ha’le seYA bhinna kathA; Aru nijei nijaka hatyA nakarivA; nizcaYa AllAha tomAlokara prati parama daYAlu|
Aru yiYe sImAlaMghana kari anyAYabhAৱe enekuৱA kariva, anatipalame Ami tAka juita nikSepa karima, Aru ei kAma AllAhara vAve ati sahaja|

tomAlokaka yi niSedha karA haiche, tAra mAjara parA yivora kavIrA guNAha seivorara parA tomAloke yadi virata thAkA, tente Ami tomAlokara saru-surA pApasamUha kSamA kari dima, Aru tomAlokaka sanmAnajanaka sthAnata praৱeza karAma|

Aru tomAloke seivora vastura AkAMkSA nakarivA, yAra dvArA AllAhe tomAlokara mAjara ejanaka Anajanara oparata zreSThatva pradAna kariche| puruSasakale yi arjana kare seYA siha~tara prApya aMza Aru nArIsakale yi arjana kare seYA tAiha~tara prApya aMza; (gatike tomAloke) AllAhara ocarata teOMra anugraha prArthanA karA, nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastu samparke sarvajJa|

pitR-mAtR Aru AtmIYa-svajanara parityakta sampattita (nArI-puruSa) pratyekake Ami uttarAdhikArI karicho~ Aru yisakalara lagata tomAloke aGgIkArAৱddha siha~tara (prApya) aMza siha~taka di diYA| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo viSaYara pratyakSadarzI|

puruSasakala haiche nArIsakalara tattvAৱdhAYaka, kAraNa AllAhe siha~tara ejanaka Anajanara oparata zreSThatva pradAna kariche Aru eivAveo ye, puruSasakale (nArIsakalara oparata) nijara dhana-sampada vyaYa kare| seYe pUNyaৱtI strIsakala anugata hai thAke, lagate teOMloke mAnuhara dRSTira antarAlato (svAmIra sampada Aru nijara mAna-sanmAna) saMrakSaNa kare, yivora AllAhe saMrakSaNa kariche; Aru tomAloke strIsakalara mAjara yisakalakalai avAdhyatAra AzaMkA karA siha~taka sadupadeza diYA, Aru siha~tara zayyA varjana karA, lagate siha~taka (zAsanamUlaka) prahAra karA| yadi siha~te tomAlokara anugata haYa tente siha~tara viruddhe kono patha anveSaNa nakarivA| nizcaYa AllAha zreSTha, mahAna|

Aru yadi tomAloke siha~ta ubhaYara mAjata virodha AzaMkA karA tente tomAloke svAmIra pariYAlara parA ejana Aru strIra pariYAlara parA ejana vicAraka niyukta karA; siha~ta ubhaYe yadi niSpatti vicAre tente AllAhe siha~tara mAjata mImAMsAra anukUla aৱsthA sRSTi kari diva| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, savizeSa aৱhita|

tomAloke AllAhara ivAdata karA, Aru teOMra lagata Ana kAko aMzIdAra sthApana nakarivA; lagate pitR-mAtR Aru AtmIYa-svajana, etIma, abhAৱgrasta, nikaTa pratiৱezI, dUra-pratiৱezI, saGgI-sArathi, muchAphira Aru tomAlokara adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIsakalara prati sadvyaৱhAra karA| nizcaYa AllAhe dAmbhika, ahaMkArIka pachanda nakare|

(AllAhe siha~tako bhAla nApAYa) yisakale nije kRpaNatA kare Aru mAnuhako kRpaNatAra nirdeza diYe, Aru AllAhe nija anugrahata siha~taka yi pradAna kariche seYA gopana kare; Aru Ami kAphirasakalara vAve lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kari rAkhicho~|

Aru yisakale mAnuhaka dekhuৱAvalai nijara dhana-sampada vyaYa kare, lagate AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare (AllAhe siha~tako bhAla nApAYa) Aru caYatAna yAra saMgI haYa, tAra saMgI kimAna ye nikRSTa!
siha~te AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna Anile, Aru AllAhe siha~taka yi pradAna kariche tAra parA vyaYa karile, siha~tara ki kSati ha’lahe~tena? Aru AllAhe siha~tara viSaYe samyaka aৱgata|
nizcaYa AllAhe aNu parimANao anyAYa nakare Aru yadi seYA kono dharaNara pUNya haYa, tente teOM seiToka vahuguNa vRddhi kari diYe, Anaki nijara phAlara parA mahApratidAna pradAna kare|
eteke yetiYA Ami pratyeka ummatara parA ejana sAkSI (navI) upasthita karima Aru tomAko siha~tara viruddhe sAkSIrUpe upasthita karima tetiYA siha~tara ki aৱsthA ha’va?

yisakale kupharI kariche Aru rAchulara avAdhya haiche siha~te seidinA kAmanA kariva, siha~ta yadi mATira lagata mihali samAna hai ga’lahe~tena! Aru siha~te (seidinA) AllAhara parA kono kathAi gopana kariva noৱAriva|

he muminasakala! tomAloke nicAgrasta aৱsthAta mukhere yi koৱA seYA nuvujAlaike chAlAtara nikaTaৱrtI naha’vA, Aru junuvI (apaৱitra) aৱsthAto nahaYa, yetiYAlaike tomAloke gochala nakarA, kintu muchAphira ha’le seYA sukIYA kathA; Aru yadi tomAloke asustha hoৱA athavA bhramaNata thakA nAivA tomAlokara konovAi zaucasthAnara parA Ahi athavA tomAloke nArI sambhoga karAra pichata pAnI nopoৱA tente paৱitra mATira dvArA tAYAmmuma karA, eteke tomAloke nijara mukhamaNDala Aru hAta macheha karA; nizcaYa AllAha pApa mocanakArI, kSamAzIla|
tumi siha~taka dekhA nAine yisakalaka kitAvara eTA aMza pradAna karA haichila? siha~te pathabhraSTatA kraYa kare Aru siha~te vicAre ye, tomAlokeo pathabhraSTa hoৱA|
AllAhe tomAlokara zatrusakalaka bhAladarei cini pAYa; Aru abhibhAৱka hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa, lagate sahAYakArI hicApeo AllAhei yatheSTa|

iYAhudIsakalara mAjata enekuৱA kichumAna loko Ache yisakale (tAorAtara) kAlAmasamUhaka tAra sthAnara parA parivartana kari vikRta kare Aru (muhAmmadaka) kaYa, ‘Ami zunilo~ Aru amAnya karilo~, Aru (siha~te kaYa) zunivA nuzunAra dare’; Aru nijara jibhA ghUrAi lagate dvInara prati tAcchilya kari kaYa, ‘rA-InA’| kintu siha~te yadi ka’lehe~tena, ‘Ami zunilo~ Aru mAnilo~, Aru zunA Aru AmAra prati lakSya karA’, tente eYA siha~tara vAve bhAla Aru saGgata ha’lahe~tena| kintu siha~tara kupharIra vAve AllAhe siha~taka abhisampAta kariche| phalata siha~tara mAjara ati kama saMkhyaka loke ImAna poSaNa kare|

he kitAvaprAptasakala! Ami mukhamaNDalasamUhaka vikRta kari pazcAdaphAle ghUrAi diYAra Agate athavA AcahAvuca chAvataka(zanivAra amAnyakArIsakalaka) yidare abhisampAta karichilo~ seidare abhisampAta karAra Agate tomAlokara ocarata yi Ache tAra samarthakarUpe Ami yi aৱtIrNa karicho~ tAra prati tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karA; (jAni thoৱA) AllAhara Adeza kAryakarI ha’vai ha’va|

nizcaYa AllAhe teOMra lagata aMzI sthApana (zvirka) karAka kSamA nakare| iYAra vAhire anyAnya aparAdhasamUha yAka icchA kSamA kare Aru yiYe AllAhara lagata Anaka aMzI kare si nizcaYa mahApApa racanA kare|
tumi siha~taka dekhA nAine, yisakale nijake paৱitra vuli dhAraNA kare? athaca AllAhe yAka icchA kare paৱitra kare, Aru siha~tara oparata sUtA parimANo anyAYa karA naha’va|
coৱA, siha~te AllAha samparke kenekai michA udbhAৱna kari Ache, Aru prakAzya pApa hicApe eiToৱei yatheSTa|

tumi siha~tara prati lakSya karA nAine, yisakalaka kitAvara eTA aMza pradAna karA haichila? siha~te jiva’ta (caYatAna, zvirka Aru yAdu Adi) Aru tAgutaka (vAtila upAsyaka) vizvAsa kare, lagate siha~te kAphirasakalara viSaYe kaYa, ‘eOMlokei muminasakalatakai adhika saThika pathaprApta’|
iha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara oparata AllAhe abhisampAta kariche Aru AllAhe yAka abhisampAta kare tumi ketiYAo tAra kono sahAYakArI nApAvA|
(AllAhara) rAjatvata siha~tara kono aMza Ache neki? (sa~cAi yadi thAkilahe~tena) tetiYAha’le siha~te khejurara guTira oparata thakA mihi AৱraNa parimANo kono vastu mAnuhaka nidilehe~tena|

athavA AllAhe nija anugrahata mAnuhaka yi pradAna kariche seikAraNe siha~te mAnuhaka IrSA kare neki? teneha’le Amito ivrAhImara vaMzadharasakalako kitAva Aru hikamata pradAna karichilo~ Aru Ami teOMlokaka vizAla rAjya dAna karichilo~|
tAra pichata siha~tara kichumAne ImAna Anichila Aru Ana kichumAne iYAra parA vimukha haichila; prakRtate dagdha karivalai jAhAnnAmei yatheSTa|

nizcaYa yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kare, acirei Ami siha~taka juita praৱeza karAma; yetiYAi siha~tara chAla juita puri paki yAva (dagdha ha’va), tetiYAi iYAra ThAita natuna chAla salani kari dima, yAte siha~te zAsti bhoga kariva pAre| nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru neka Amala kariche, atizIghre Ami teOMlokaka enekuৱA jAnnAtata praৱeza karAma, yAra talata nijarAsamUha pravAhita; tAta teOMloka cirasthAYI ha’va, lagate tAta thAkiva teOMlokara vAve paৱitra strI, Aru teOMlokaka Ami vistRta ghana chA~ta AzraYa dAna karima|

nizcaYa AllAhe tomAlokaka AmAnatasamUha tAra garAkIlai ghUrAi diYAra nirdeza diche| tomAloke yetiYA mAnuhara mAjata vicArakArya paricAlanA karivA tetiYA tomAloke nyAYaparAYaNatAra saite vicAra karivA| AllAhe tomAlokaka yi upadeza diYe seYA kimAna ye utkRSTa! nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

he muminasakala! tomAloke AllAhara Anugatya karA Aru rAchulara Anugatya karA lagate Anugatya karA tomAlokara mAjara kSamatAzIlasakalara, tAra pichata tomAlokara mAjata kono viSaYa lai matabheda ghaTile seYA upasthApana karA AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara ocarata, yadi tomAloke AllAha Aru AkhirAtaka vizvAsa karA| ei panthAi uttama Aru pariNAmata prakRSTatara|

tumi siha~taka dekhA nAine? yisakale dAvI kare ye, tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa haiche Aru tomAra pUrve yi aৱtIrNa haiche tAta siha~te ImAna Aniche, athaca siha~te tAgutara ocarata vicAraprArthI ha’va vicAre, yadio seiToka pratyAkhyAna karAra vAve siha~taka nirdeza diYA haichila; Aru caYatAne siha~taka bhISaNabhAৱe pathabhraSTa kariva vicAre|
siha~taka yetiYA koৱA haYa, AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche tAra pine Aru rAchulara pine AhA, tetiYA tumi munAphikasakalaka dekhivA ye, siha~te tomAra parA phAlari kATi A~tari gaiche|

eteke tetiYA siha~tara ki aৱsthA ha’va, yetiYA siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve siha~te kono muchivatata patita ha’va? tAra pichata siha~te AllAhara zapatalai tomAra ocarata Ahi ka’va, ‘Ami kalyANa Aru samprItira vAhire Ana eko vicarA nAchilo~’|
eOMlokara antarata yi Ache seYA AllAhe bhAladarei jAne| seYe tumi siha~taka varjana karA, siha~taka sadupadeza diYA, Aru siha~tara saite siha~tara nijara viSaYe marmasparzakArI kathA koৱA|

Aru Ami pratijana rAchulake eikAraNe preraNa karicho~, yAte AllAhara anumatikrame teOMlokara Anugatya karA haYa| eteke yetiYA siha~te nijara prati anyAYa karichila tetiYA yadi siha~ta tomAra ocaralai Ahilahe~tena, Aru AllAhara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karilehe~tena, lagate rAchuleo yadi siha~tara hai kSamA prArthanA karilehe~tena, tente nizcaYa siha~te AllAhaka parama kSamAzIla Aru parama daYAlurUpe pAlehe~tena|

kintu nahaYa, tomAra pratipAlakara zapata! siha~ta (ketiYAo prakRta) mumina ha’va noৱAre yetiYAlaike siha~te nijara mAjata sRSTi hoৱA vivAda-visamvAdara vicAra kAryara vAve tomAka mImAMsAkArI hicApe mAni nala’va; tAra pichata tomAra mImAMsA samparke siha~tara manata kono dvidhA thAkiva nAlAge, lagate yetiYAlaike sarvAntakaraNe sei siddhAntaka mAni nala’va|

Aru yadi Ami siha~taka Adeza karilohe~tena ye, tomAloke nijei nijake hatyA karA athavA nija gharara parA olAi yoৱA tente siha~tara kichu saMkhyakei ei Adeza pAlana karilehe~tena| yiTo siha~taka Adeza karA haichila seYA siha~te pAlana karile, nizcaYa siha~tara vAve kalyANakara ha’lahe~tena Aru cittasthiratAta siha~ta dRDha়tara ha’lahe~tena|
Aru tetiYA Ami nizcaYa siha~taka AmAra taraphara parA mahApuraskAra pradAna karilohe~tena|
Aru nizcaYa siha~taka sarala pathata paricAlita karilohe~tena|

Aru yiYe AllAha Aru rAchulara Anugatya kariva, teOM seisakala lokara saGgI ha’va yisakalara prati AllAhe anugraha kariche, teOMloka haiche navI, chiddIkva (satyaniSTha), zvahIda Aru satkarmaparAYaNa- Aru teOMloka kimAna ye uttama saGgI!
eivora haiche AllAhara phAlara parA anugraha| sarvajJa hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa|
he muminasakala! tomAloke AtmarakSAra vAve satarkatA aৱlamvana karA, tAra pichata suvidhAnuyAYI dale dale vibhakta hai agrasara hoৱA athavA ekagoTa hai agrasara hoৱA|

Aru tomAlokara mAjata kichumAna enekuৱA loko Ache yiYe nizcaYa pichaho~hakA mAriva| tAra pichata tomAlokara oparata kono vipada Apatita ha’le si ka’va, ‘AllAhe mora oparata anugraha kariche ye, mai siha~tara lagata upasthita nAchilo~’|

Aru AllAhara taraphara parA tomAlokara prati kono anugraha Ahile nizcaYa si enekai ka’va yenivA tomAlokara Aru tAra mAjata kono samparkai nAchila, ‘hAYa, yadi siha~tara lagata thAkilo~he~tena tente maYo virATa sAphalya lAbha karilo~he~tena’|

eteke yisakale AkhirAtara vinimaYata pArthiৱ jIৱna vikrI kare teOMloke AllAhara pathata yuddha karA ucita| kAraNa yiYe AllAhara pathata yuddha kariva teOM zvahIda haoka athavA jaYalAbha karaka, Ami tAka mahA puraskAra pradAna karima|

tomAlokara ki ha’la ye, tomAloke AllAhara pathata yuddha nakarA, athaca niHsahAYa nara-nArI Aru zizusakale ei vuli prArthanA kari Ache ye, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka ei janapadara parA uddhAra karA, iYAra adhivAsIsakala haiche atyAcArI; tomAra phAlara parA AmAra vAve ejana abhibhAৱka nirdhAraNa karA Aru tomAra phAlara parA AmAra vAve ejana sahAYakArI nirdhAraNa karA|

yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMloke AllAhara pathata yuddha kare, Aru kAphirasakale tAgutara pathata yuddha kare| eteke tomAloke caYatAnara vandhusakalara viruddhe yuddha karA; caYatAnara cakrAnta nizcaYa durvala|

tumi siha~taka dekhA nAine? yisakalaka koৱA haichila, ‘tomAloke nijara hAta saMvaraNa karA, chAlAta kAYema karA Aru yAkAta pradAna karA’; tAra pichata yetiYA siha~taka yuddhara vidhAna diYA ha’la tetiYA siha~tara eTA dale mAnuhaka enekai bhaYa karichila yenekai AllAhaka bhaYa karA haYa athavA tAtokai vechi bhaYa karichila Aru kaichila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka yuddhara vidhAna kiYa pradAna karilA? AmAka keiTAmAna dinara aৱkAza kiYa nidilA? koৱA, ‘pArthiৱ bhoga-vilAsa ati sAmAnya Aru yiYe tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare tAra vAve AkhirAtei uttama, Aru tomAlokara prati sAmAnya parimANo anyAYa karA naha’va’|

tomAloke ya’tei nAthAkA kiYa mRtyuৱe tomAlokaka laga pAvai, yadio tomAloke suucca sudRDha় durgata aৱsthAna nakarA kiYa| yadi siha~tara kono kalyANa haYa tente siha~te kaYa, ‘eiTo AllAhara taraphara parA Ahiche’, Aru yadi siha~tara kono akalyANa haYa tente siha~te kaYa, ‘eiTo tomAra kAraNei haiche’| koৱA, ‘sakalo AllAhara taraphara parA haYa’| ei sampradAYara ki ha’la ye, iha~te ekevArei kono kathA nuvuje!

tomAra ocarata yi kalyANa Ahe seYA AllAhara taraphara parA Ahe, Aru tomAra yi akalyANa haYa seYA tomAra nijara kAraNe haYa Aru Ami tomAka mAnuhara vAve rAchula hicApe preraNa karicho~; sAkSI hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa|
yiYe rAchulara Anugatya kare, teOM darAcalate AllAharei Anugatya kare| AnahAte yiYe vimukha haYa, tente (jAni thoৱA) Ami tomAka siha~tara oparata tattvAৱdhAYakarUpe preraNa karA nAi|

Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘(Ami) Anugatya karo~’; tAra pichata yetiYA tomAra ocarara parA siha~ta guci yAYa, tetiYA siha~tara eTA dale yi kaYa rAtita tAra viparIta parAmarza kare| rAtita siha~te yi parAmarza kare AllAhe seYA lipivaddha kari rAkhe| seYe tumi siha~taka upekSA karA Aru AllAhara prati bharasA karA; Aru karmavidhAYaka hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa|
siha~te koraAnakalai gabhIrabhAৱe cintA-carcA nakare neki? yadi eYA AllAhara vAhire Ana kArovAra parA ahA ha’lahe~tena, tente nizcaYa siha~te iYAra mAjata vahuto asaGgati pAlehe~tena|

Aru yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai zAnti athavA zaMkAra kono saMvAda Ahe tetiYA siha~te seiTo pracAra kari phure| yadi siha~te sei saMvAdaTo rAchula athavA siha~tara mAjata yisakale nirdeza pradAnara adhikArI teOMlokaka janAlehe~tena tente siha~tara mAjata yisakale tathya anusandhAna kare teOMloke seiTora yathArthatA nirNaYa kariva pArilehe~tena| tomAlokara prati yadi AllAhara anugraha Aru rahamata nAthAkilahe~tena tente tomAlokara mAjara kichumAnara vAhire ATAYe caYatAnara anusaraNa karilehe~tena|

eteke tumi AllAhara pathata yuddha karA, tumi tomAra nijara vAhire Anara vAve dAYI nohoৱA Aru muminasakalaka (yuddhara vAve) udvuddha karA; sambhaৱtaH AllAhe kAphirasakalara zakti saMyata kariva; Aru AllAhara zakti sarvapekSA pravala Aru zAsti dAnata ati kaThora|

yiYe bhAla kAmara vAve cupAricha kariva tAra vAve tAta eTA aMza thAkiva Aru yiYe veYA kAmara vAve cupAricha kariva tAra vAveo tAta eTA aMza thAkiva| (jAni thoৱA) AllAha pratiTo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
Aru yetiYA tomAlokaka chAlAma diYA haYa tetiYA tomAloke tAtokai uttamarUpe chAlAmara uttara divA nAivA anurUpa pratyuttara divA| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo viSaYe pUrNa hicApa grahaNakArI|
AllAha, teOMra vAhire Ana kono (satya) ilAha nAi; nizcaYa teৱe~i tomAlokaka kviYAmatara dinA ekatrita kariva, iYAta kono sandeha nAi; Aru kathAta AllAhatakai adhika satyavAdI Aru kona ha’va pAre?

tomAlokara ki haiche ye, tomAloke munAphikasakalara viSaYe dui dalata vibhakta hai ga’lA? athaca siha~te yi arjana kariche tAra vAve AllAhe siha~taka pUrvAৱsthAlai obhatAi diche| AllAhe yAka pathabhraSTa kariche tomAloke tAka satpathata paricAlita kariva vicarA neki? Aru AllAhe kArovAka pathabhraSTa karile tumi tAra vAve ketiYAo kono patha vicAri nApAvA|
