siha~te eiToৱei kAmanA kare ye, siha~te yenekai kupharI kariche tomAlokeo tenekai kupharI karA, yAte tomAloke siha~tara samAna ha’va pArA| seYe AllAhara pathata hijarata nakarAlaike siha~tara kAko vandhurUpe grahaNa nakarivA| yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa, tente siha~taka ya’tei pAvA grephatAra karivA Aru hatyA karivA Aru siha~tara mAjara kAko vandhu Aru sahAYakarUpe grahaNa nakarivA|

kintu (siha~tara mAjara seisakala lokaka hatyA nakarivA) yisakale ene eTA sampradAYara lagata milita haYa yAra mAjata Aru tomAlokara mAjata sandhicukti Ache athavA yisakale tomAlokara ocarata enekuৱA aৱsthAta Agamana kare yetiYA siha~tara mana tomAlokara lagata vA siha~tara sampradAYara lagata yuddha karivalai saMkucita haYa| AllAhe yadi icchA karilehe~tena tente siha~taka tomAlokara oparata kSamatA dilehe~tena phalata siha~te tomAlokara lagata yuddha karilehe~tena| eteke siha~te yadi tomAlokara parA A~tari yAYa, tomAlokara lagata yuddha nakare Aru tomAlokara ocarata zAntira prastAৱ upasthApana kare tente AllAhe tomAlokara vAve siha~tara viruddhe kono vyaৱsthA aৱlamvanara patha rakhA nAi|

tomAloke anatipalame kichumAna lokaka dekhivalai pAvA, yisakale tomAlokara lagata Aru siha~tara sampradAYara lagata zAnti vicAriva| yetiYAi siha~taka phitanAra phAle manoniveza karoৱA haYa tetiYAi ei viSaYe siha~te siha~tara Agara aৱsthAlai ubhati yAYa| yadi siha~te tomAlokara parA virata nAthAke, tomAlokara ocarata zAnti prastAৱ nakare Aru siha~tara hasta saMvaraNa nakare tente siha~taka ya’tei pAvA grephatAra karivA Aru hatyA karivA, Aru Ami tomAlokaka iha~tara viruddhAcaraNara spaSTa adhikAra dicho~|

kono ejana mumine Ana kono muminaka hatyA karA vaidha nahaYa, kintu bhulavazataH karile seYA sukIYA kathA; Aru yiYe kono muminaka bhulavazataH hatyA kariche tente tAra kartavya haiche ejana mumina dAsa mukta karA Aru tAra pariYAlavargaka raktapaNa AdAYa karA kartavya, yadi siha~te kSamA nakare; Aru yadi seijana tomAlokara zatru pakSara loka haYa tente ejana mumina dAsa mukta karA kartavya; Aru yadi seijana ene sampradAYabhukta haYa yisakalara lagata tomAloka aGgIkArAৱddha tente tAra pariYAlavargaka raktapaNa AdAYa diYAra lagate ejana mumina dAsa mukta karA teOMra kartavya| AnahAte yadi (mukta karivalai kono dAsa) nApAYa (vA mukta karAra sAmartha nAthAke) tente teOM ekAdikrame dumAha chiYAma pAlana kariva| eiTo AllAhara taraphara parA kSamAsvarUpa; Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

pakSAntare yiYe icchAkRtabhAৱe kono muminaka hatyA kariva tAra zAsti haiche jAhAnnAma, tAta si sthAYI ha’va; Aru AllAhe tAra prati kruddha haYa, lagate tAra oparata abhisampAta kare Aru tAra vAve prastuta rAkhiche mahAzAsti|

he muminasakala! tomAloke yetiYA AllAhara pathata yAtrA karivA tetiYA pArthakya nirNaYa karivA Aru konovAi tomAlokaka chAlAma karile pArthiৱ jIৱnara sampadara AzAta tAka ei vuli naka’vA ye, ‘tumi mumina nahaYa’, kAraNa AllAhara ocarata anAYAsalabhya sampada pracura Ache| tomAlokeo Agate enekuৱAi AchilA, tAra pichata AllAhe tomAlokara prati anugraha kariche, seYe tomAloke pArthakya nirNaYa karivA| nizcaYa tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|

muminasakalara mAjata yisakala akSama nahaYa tathApio gharata vahi thAke, Aru yisakale AllAhara pathata nijara dhana-prANara dvArA jihAda kare teOMloka samAna nahaYa| yisakale nijara dhana-prANara dvArA jihAda kare AllAhe teOMlokaka siha~tara oparata maryAdA pradAna kariche yisakale gharata vahi thAke, AllAhe pratyekake kalyANara pratizruti diche| AllAhe mujAhidasakalaka mahApuraskArara jariYate gharata vahi thakA lokasakalara oparata zreSThatva pradAna kariche|
eivora haiche teOMra taraphara parA maryAdA, kSamA Aru rahamata; (jAni thoৱA) AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

nizcaYa yisakale nijara oparata anyAYa kare siha~tara prANagrahaNara samaYata phiristAsakale kaYa, ‘tomAloke ki aৱsthAta AchilA’? siha~te kaYa, ‘pRthiৱIta Ami niHsahAYa Achilo~’, siha~te kaYa, ‘AllAhara pRthiৱI imAna prazasta nAchilane ye tomAloke Ana ThAilai hijarata kari yAva noৱArilA’? iha~tarei AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma, Aru eiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa AvAsa!
kintu yisakala asahAYa puruSa, nArI Aru zizuৱe kono upAYa aৱlamvana kariva noৱAre Aru kono patha vicArio nApAYa (siha~tara viSaYaTo sukIYA)|
AllAhe haYato zIghrei siha~tara pApa mocana kariva, kAraNa AllAha pApa mocanakArI, kSamAzIla|

Aru yiYe AllAhara pathata hijarata kariva teOM pRthiৱIta vahuto AzraYasthala Aru prAcurya lAbha kariva; lagate AllAha Aru rAchulara uddezye nija gharara parA muhAjira hai olAi yoৱAra pichata yAra mRtyu ghaTiva tAra puraskArara dAYitva haiche AllAhara oparata; Aru AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru tomAloke yetiYA deza-videzalai chaphara karivA tetiYA yadi tomAlokara AzaMkA haYa ye, kAphirasakale tomAlokara vAve phitanA sRSTi kariva tente chAlAta kachara (saMkSipta) karile tomAlokara vAve kono doSaNIYa nahaYa| nizcaYa kAphirasakala tomAlokara prakAzya zatru|

Aru yetiYA tumi siha~tara mAjata aৱsthAna karivA tAra pichata siha~tara lagata chAlAta kAYema karivA, tetiYA siha~tara eTA dala yAte tomAra saite thiYa haYa Aru siha~ta yena sazastra thAke| eteke siha~tara chAjadAha (nAmAja paDha়A) karA ha’le siha~ta yena tomAlokara pichaphAle gai aৱsthAna kare, Aru Ana eTA dala yisakale chAlAtata aMza loৱA nAchila siha~te yena Ahi tomAra lagata chAlAtata aMza laYa Aru siha~te yena satarka Aru sazastra thAke| kAphirasakale kAmanA kare ye, tomAloke yAte tomAlokara astra-zastra Aru AcavAva-patra samparke asatarka hoৱA yAte siha~te tomAlokara oparata evAratei AkramaNa kariva pAre| yadi tomAloke varaSuNara vAve kaSTa poৱA athavA asustha aৱsthAta thakA tente ene aৱsthAta astra rAkhi thale tomAlokara vAve kono doSaNIYa nahaYa; kintu tomAloke satarkatA aৱlamvana karivA| nizcaYa AllAhe kAphirasakalara vAve lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kari thaiche|

eteke yetiYA tomAloke chAlAta samApta karivA tetiYA tomAloke thiYa hai, vahi Aru zui thakA aৱsthAto AllAhaka smaraNa karivA, tAra pichata yetiYA tomAloke nirApada ha’vA tetiYA yathAyathabhAৱe chAlAta kAYema karivA; nizcaYa nirdhArita samaYata chAlAta kAYema karATo muminasakalara vAve aৱzya kartavya|

Aru zatru sampradAYara anusandhAnata tomAloke durvala naha’vA| yadi tomAloke yantraNA pAi AchA tente siha~teo tomAlokara darei yantraNA pAi Ache kintu AllAhara ocarata tomAloke yiTo AzA karA siha~te seiTo AzA nakare; Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa Ami tomAra prati satya sahakAre kitAva aৱtIrNa karicho~, yAte AllAhe tomAka yi janAiche sei anuyAYI tumi mAnuhara mAjata vicAra mImAMsA kariva pArA; lagate (jAni thoৱA) tumi vizvAsa bhaMgakArIsakalara samarthanata tarka nakarivA|
Aru tumi AllAhara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karA| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Aru yisakale nijake pratArita kare tumi siha~tara samarthanata vitarka nakarivA; nizcaYa AllAhe vizvAsa bhaMgakArI pApIka pachanda nakare|

siha~te mAnuhara parA gopana kariva vicAre athaca AllAhara parA gopana nakare, athaca teOM siha~tara lagatei Ache, yetiYA siha~te rAtita enekuৱA kathAra parikalpanA kare yiTo teOM pachanda nakare, Aru siha~te yi kare seYA AllAhe pariveSTana kari Ache|

coৱA, tomAlokei seisakala loka yisakale pArthiৱ jIৱnata siha~tara samarthanata vitarka karichA; kintu kviYAmatara dinA AllAhara sanmukhata kone siha~tara samarthanata vitarka kariva athavA kona ha’va siha~tara tattvAৱdhAYaka?
AnahAte (yadi) konovAi pApa kAma kare athavA nijara oparata anyAYa kare, tAra pichata (yadi) AllAhara ocarata kSamA prArthanA kare tente teOM (nizcaYa) AllAhaka kSamAzIla, parama daYAlurUpe pAva|
eteke yiYe pApa kAma kare, prakRtate si nijarei kSati kare, Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
lagate yi vyaktiYe kono aparAdha kare vA pApa kAma kare, tAra pichata seiTo kono nirdoSa vyaktilai Aropa kare, tente si darAcalate michA apavAda Aru spaSTa guNAhara vojAhe vahana kare|

Aru tomAra oparata yadi AllAhara anugraha Aru daYA nAthAkilahe~tena tente siha~tara mAjara eTA dale tomAka pathabhraSTa karAra saMkalpa kariYe pelAichila| kintu siha~te nijara vAhire Ana kAko pathabhraSTa kariva noৱAre Aru tomAro kono kSati kariva noৱAre| AllAhe tomAra prati kitAva Aru hikamata aৱtIrNa kariche Aru tumi yi janA nAchilA seYA tomAka zikSA diche, tomAra prati AllAhara mahA anugraha Ache|

siha~tara adhikAMza gopana parAmarzare kono kalyANa nAi, kintu kalyANa Ache (tAra parAmarzata) yiYe chAdAkAha, satkarma Aru mAnuhara mAjata zAnti sthApanara nirdeza diYe, AllAhara santuSTi lAbhara AzAta yiYe eiTo pAlana kariva nizcaYa Ami tAka mahA puraskAra pradAna karima|

Aru yAra ocarata satpatha prakAza hoৱAra pichato rAchulara viruddhAcaraNa kare Aru muminasakalara pathara vAhire anya patha anusaraNa kare, tente Ami tAka seiphAlei obhatAi dima yiphAle si ubhati yAYa, Aru tAka jAhAnnAmata praৱeza karAma, Aru seYA kimAna ye veYA AvAsasthala!

nizcaYa AllAhe teOMra lagata aMzI sthApana (zvirka) karAka kSamA nakariva| iYAra vAhire anyAnya aparAdhasamUha yAka icchA kariva kSamA kari diva Aru yiYe AllAhara lagata Anaka aMzI kare si bhISaNabhAৱe pathabhraSTa haYa|
teOMra parivarte siha~te keৱla deৱIrei pUjA-pATha kare lagate vidrohI caYatAnara pUjA kare|
AllAhe tAka (caYatAnaka) abhisampAta kariche Aru si (caYatAne) kaYa, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAra vAndAsakalara parA eTA nirdiSTa aMzaka mora anusArI vanAi lama|

‘Aru mai nizcaYa siha~taka pathabhraSTa karima, lagate siha~tara hRdaYata michA vAsanAra sRSTi karima, Aru nizcaYa mai siha~taka nirdeza karima phalata siha~te pazura kANa phuTA kariva, Aru aৱzye mai siha~taka nirdeza karima phalata siha~te AllAhara sRSTiko vikRta kariva’| eteke yiYe AllAhara parivarte caYatAnaka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa kariva si nizcaYa spaSTa kSatigrasta ha’va|
si (caYatAne) siha~taka pratizruti diYe Aru siha~tara hRdaYata michA vAsanAra sRSTi kare, (jAni thoৱA) caYatAne siha~taka keৱla pratAraNAmUlaka pratizrutihe diYe|
eisakala lokarei AzraYasthala haiche jAhAnnAma, tAra parA siha~te niSkRtira upAYa vicAri nApAva|

Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru neka Amala kariche, anatipalame Ami teOMlokaka enekuৱA jAnnAtata praৱeza karAma, yAra talata nijarAsamUha pravAhita; tAta teOMloka cirasthAYI ha’va, AllAhara pratizruti satya, kathAta AllAhatakai adhika satyavAdI Aru kona ha’va pAre?

(zeSa pariNati) tomAlokara AzAra oparata athavA kitAvIsakalara kAmanAra oparata nirbhara nakare; varaM yiYe veYA Amala kariva si tAra pratiphala bhoga kariva, Aru si eikSetrata AllAhara vAhire Ana kono abhibhAৱka Aru sahAYaka vicAri nApAva|
AnahAte puruSei haoka vA nArI yiYei ImAnara aৱsthAta satkarma kariva, teOMlokei jAnnAtata praৱeza kariva Aru teOMlokara prati aNu parimANo anyAYa karA naha’va|

sei vyaktitakai dvInara mAjata Aru kona uttama ha’va pAre? yiYe satkarmaparAYaNa hai AllAhara ocarata AtmasamarpaNa kare Aru ekaniSThabhAৱe ivrAhImara millAtaka anusaraNa kare, (jAni thoৱA) AllAhe ivrAhImaka antaraGga vandhu hicApe grahaNa kariche|
AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei Aru AllAhe sakaloke (nijara jJAnara dvArA) pariveSTana kari Ache|

Aru mAnuhe tomAra ocarata nArIsakalara viSaYe samAdhAna vicAre| koৱA, ‘AllAhe tomAlokaka siha~tara viSaYe samAdhAna diche Aru kitAvara parA tomAlokaka yi pATha kari zunoৱA haYa, seiTo haiche seisakala pitRhIna nArIra vidhAna yisakalara nirdhArita prApya tomAloke pradAna nakarA, athaca tomAloke siha~taka vivAha karivalai AgrahI (nahaYa)| lagate asahAYa zizusakalara viSaYe vidhAna ei ye, nyAYaparAYaNatAra saite tomAloke etImasakalaka coৱAcitA karA| eteke (jAni thoৱA) tomAloke yi satkarmai nakarA kiYa nizcaYa AllAha sei samparke savizeSa aৱgata|

yadi kono strIYe tAira svAmIra phAlara parA durvyaৱhAra athavA upekSAra AzaMkA kare tente siha~ta ubhaYe Apoca-niSpatti kariva vicArile siha~tara kono guNAha nAi; Aru Apoca-niSpatti karAToৱei zreYa| mAnuhara antarata lobhaNIYa kRpaNatA Ache| yadi tomAloke satkarmaparAYaNa hoৱA Aru muttAkvI hoৱA, tente tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAheto jAnei|

Aru tomAloke yimAnei icchA nakarA kiYa tomAlokara strIsakalara mAjata tomAloke ketiYAo samAna vyaৱhAra kariva noৱArivA, kintu tomAloke kono ejanIra prati sampUrNarUpe dhAৱita naha’vA Aru AnajanIka olomA aৱsthAta eri nidivA; yadi tomAloke nijake saMzodhana karA Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA tente nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Aru yadi siha~te paraspare pRthaka hai yAYa tente AllAhe teOMra prAcuryara dvArA pratyekake abhAৱmukta kariva; AllAha prAcuryamaYa, prajJAmaYa|

AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei, tomAlokara pUrve yisakalaka kitAva diYA haichila siha~taka Aru tomAlokako nirdeza dicho~ ye, tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| Aru yadi tomAloke kupharI karA tathApio AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei, AllAha abhAৱmukta, prazaMsita|
AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei| (eteke jAni thoৱA) karma-vidhAYaka hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa|
he mAnaৱjAti! teOM icchA karile tomAlokaka apasArita kari anya lokaka Aniva pAre; Aru AllAha ei kAma karivalai sampUrNa sakSama|
yiYe pRthiৱIra pratidAna vicAre tente (si jAni loৱA ucita ye) pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtara puraskAra keৱla AllAhara ocaratei Ache; Aru AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

he muminasakala! tomAloke nyAYa vicArata dRDha় pratiSThita thAkivA, AllAhara uddezye sAkSI divA, yadio seYA tomAlokara nijara vA pitR-mAtR Aru AtmIYa-svajanara viruddhei nahaoka kiYa, si vittavAne haoka athavA vittahIna, AllAha ubhaYarei ghaniSTatara| seYe tomAloke nyAYa vicAra karivalai pravRttira anusaraNa nakarivA| tomAloke yadi pAka lagAi kathA koৱA Aru amonoyogI hoৱA tente tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱgata|

he muminasakala! tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karA AllAhara prati, teOMra rAchulara prati Aru sei granthara prati yikhana teOM teOMra rAchulara prati aৱtIrNa kariche Aru sei granthara pratio ImAna poSaNa karA yikhana teOM iYAra pUrve aৱtIrNa karichila| AnahAte yiYe AllAhaka, teOMra phiristAsakalaka, teOMra kitApasamUhaka, teOMra rAchulasakalaka Aru zeSa diৱsaka asvIkAra kariva, si darAcalate bhraSTatAta vahu dUra A~tari gaiche|

nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche tAra pichata kupharI kariche, Akau ImAna Aniche Akau kupharI kariche, tAra pichata siha~tara kupharI pravRtti vRddhi pAiche, AllAhe siha~taka ketiYAo kSamA nakariva Aru siha~taka kono patho nedekhuৱAva|
munAphikasakalaka susaMvAda diYA ye, nizcaYa siha~tara vAve kaSTadAYaka zAsti Ache|
muminasakalara parivarte yisakale kAphirasakalaka vandhurUpe grahaNa kare seisakala loke siha~tara ocarata sanmAna vicAre neki? athaca yAৱtIYa sanmAna AllAharei|

kitAvata teOM tomAlokara vAve (ei vidhAna) aৱtIrNa kariche ye, yetiYA tomAloke zunivA ye, AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karA hai Ache Aru vidrUpa karA hai Ache tetiYA tomAloke siha~tara lagata navahivA, yetiYAlaike siha~te velega kono prasaGgalai ghUri nAhe; anyathA tomAlokeo siha~tara darei gaNya ha’vA| nizcaYa AllAhe munAphikasakalaka Aru kAphirasakalaka jAhAnnAmata ekatrita kariva|

yisakale tomAlokara amaGgalara apekSAta thAke, tAra pichata AllAhara taraphara parA yadi tomAloke vijaYa lAbha karA tente siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami tomAlokara lagata nAchilone’? AnahAte yadi kAphirasakale AMzika jaYalAbha kare tente kaYa, ‘Ami tomAlokara viruddhe pravala nAchilone Aru Ami tomAlokaka muminasakalara parA rakSA karA nAine’? eteke AllAhe kviYAmatara dinA tomAlokara mAjata vicAra mImAMsA kariva Aru AllAhe kAphirasakalara vAve ketiYAo muminasakalara viruddhe kono patha (unmukta) nArAkhe|

nizcaYa munAphikasakale AllAhara lagata pratAraNA kariva vicAre, prakRtate teৱe~i siha~taka pratArita kare, Aru yetiYA siha~te chAlAtata thiYa haYa tetiYA alasatA kari keৱla mAnuhaka dekhuৱAvalai chAlAtata thiYa haYa| AllAhaka siha~te khuvei kama smaraNa kare|
siha~ta dodulyamAna aৱsthAta thAke, iphAleo nahaYa siphAleo nahaYa| AllAhe yAka pathabhraSTa kare, tumi tAra vAve ketiYAo kono patha vicAri nApAvA|
he muminasakala! tomAloke muminasakalara vAhire kAphirasakalaka vandhurUpe grahaNa nakarivA| tomAloke nijara oparata AllAhara prakAzya abhiyoga kAYema kariva vicarA neki?
nizcaYa munAphikasakale jAhAnnAmara sarvanimna starata thAkiva Aru siha~tara vAve tumi ketiYAo kono sahAYaka nApAvA|

kintu yisakale tAovA kare, nijake saMzodhana kare, Aru AllAhaka dRDha়bhAৱe aৱlamvana kare, lagate AllAhara uddezye nirbhejAlabhAৱe nijara dvIna pAlana kare, tente teOMloka muminasakalara lagata thAkiva| (jAni thoৱA) zIghrei AllAhe muminasakalaka mahApuraskAra pradAna kariva|
yadi tomAloke kRtajJatA prakAza karA Aru ImAna poSaNa karA, teneha’le tomAlokaka zAsti pradAna kari AllAhara ki ha’va? (jAni thoৱA) prakRtate AllAha haiche guNagrAhI, sarvajJa|
veYA kathA prakAza karAka AllAhe pachanda nakare, kintu yAra oparata atyAcAra karA haiche tAra viSaYaTo sukIYA; Aru AllAha sarvazrotA sarvajJAnI|
yadi tomAloke satkarma prakAza karA athavA gopana karA nAivA doSa kSamA karA tente AllAheo doSa mocanakArI, kSamatAৱAna|

nizcaYa yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara saite kupharI kare lagate AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulasakalara mAjata pArthakya kariva vicAre Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami kichumAnara oparata ImAna poSaNa karo~ Aru kichumAnara lagata kupharI karo~’; Aru siha~te iYAra madhyaৱrtI eTA patha aৱlamvana kariva vicAre|
iha~tei haiche prakRta kAphira; (jAni thoৱA) Ami kAphirasakalara vAve lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kari rAkhicho~|

AnahAte yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulasakalara prati ImAna Aniche Aru teOMlokara kAro mAjata kono pArthakya karA nAi, atisonakAle teOMlokaka teOMlokara pratidAna diYA ha’va, Aru AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

kitAvIsakale vicAre ye, tumi AkAzara parA siha~tara vAve ekhana kitApa aৱtIrNa karA, siha~te muchAra ocarata iYAtakaio DAGara dAvI karichila| siha~te kaichila, ‘AmAka prakAzyabhAৱe AllAhaka dekhuoৱA’| phalata siha~tara sImAlaMghanara kAraNe siha~taka vajrapAte dharichila, tAra pichata siha~tara ocarata spaSTa pramANa ahAra pichato siha~te dAmurI eTAka upAsyarUpe grahaNa karichila, tathApio Ami seYA kSamA karichilo~ Aru Ami muchAka spaSTa pramANa pradAna karichilo~|

Aru siha~tara aGgIkAra grahaNa karivalai tUra parvataka Ami siha~tara oparata uttolana karichilo~ Aru siha~taka kaichilo~, ‘zira nata kari duৱArere praৱeza karA’| Ami siha~taka Aru kaichilo~ ye, ‘zanivAre (vizrAmara dinA mAcha dhari) sImAlaMghana nakarivA’, lagate Ami siha~tara parA dRDha় aGgIkAra laichilo~|

tAra pichata (siha~taka zAsti diYA haichila) kAraNa siha~te aGgIkAra bhaMga karichila, AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichila Aru ei vuli kaichila ye, ‘AmAra hRdaYasamUha AcchAdita’| varaM siha~tara kupharIra vAve AllAhe siha~tara antarasamUhata mohara mAri dichila| gatike siha~tara keৱla kichusaMkhyaka lokei ImAna Aniva|
lagate siha~te kupharI karAra kAraNe Aru mAraYAmara viruddhe gurutara apavAda Aropa karAra kAraNe (abhizapta haichila)|

lagate siha~tara ei uktira kAraNe (abhizapta haichila) ye, AmiYei AllAhara rAchula mAraYAmara putra IchAka hatyA karichilo~| athaca siha~te teOMka hatyAo karA nAi Aru kruchaviddhao karA nAchila; varaM siha~tara vAve (velega ejana lokaka) teOMra sadRza kari diYA haichila| nizcaYa yisakale teOMra viSaYe matabheda karichila, siha~ta ei viSaYe sandehata Achila; ei viSaYe anumAnara vAhire siha~tara ocarata kono jJAnei nAi| eiTo nizcita ye siha~te teOMka hatyA karA nAchila|
varaM AllAhe teOMka nijara ocaralai uThAi laiche Aru AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
kitAvIsakalara mAjara parA pratyekei teOMra mRtyura pUrve teOMra oparata ImAna Aniva Aru kviYAmatara dinA teOM siha~tara viruddhe sAkSI ha’va|
vahuto paৱitra vastu Ami iYAhudIsakalara durAcArItAra kAraNe Aru AllAhara pathara parA vahutaka vAdhA diYAra kAraNe siha~tara oparata hArAma karichilo~ yivora siha~tara vAve hAlAla Achila|

lagate siha~tara suta grahaNara kAraNe, athaca iYAra parA siha~taka niSedha karA haichila; Aru anyAYabhAৱe mAnuhara dhana-sampada grAsa karAra kAraNeo| Aru Ami siha~tara mAjara kAphirasakalara vAve kaSTadAYaka zAsti prastuta kari rAkhicho~|

kintu siha~tara mAjara gabhIra jJAnI lokasakale Aru muminasakale tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa karA haiche Aru tomAra pUrve yi aৱtIrNa karA haichila tAra prati ImAna poSaNa kare| chAlAta pratiSThA kare, yAkAta pradAna kare lagate AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna poSaNa kare, atisonakAle Ami eisakala lokaka mahA puraskAra dAna karima|

nizcaYa Ami tomAra ocaralai ahI preraNa karicho~, yenekai nUha Aru teOMra paraৱrtI navIsakalara prati ahI preraNa karichilo~; Aru ivrAhIma, ichamAIla, ichahAkva, iYAkvUva Aru teOMra vaMzadhara, IchA, Aiuva, iunucha, hAruna Aru chulAimAnara ocarato ahI preraNa karichilo~, lagate dAUdaka pradAna karichilo~ yAvUra|
Aru vahuto rAchula, yisakalara varNanA Ami tomAka dicho~ Aru vahuto rAchula yisakalara varNanA Ami tomAka diYA nAi, (jAni thoৱA) AllAhe muchAra saite suspaSTarUpe kathA kaiche|
susaMvAdavAhI Aru sAৱdhAnakArI rAchula preraNa karicho~, yAte rAchulasakala ahAra pichata AllAhara viruddhe mAnuhara vAve kono abhiyoga nAthAke; Aru AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
kintu AllAhe tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa kariche teOM nijei tAra sAkSI| teOM seYA aৱtIrNa kariche nija jJAnara bhittita Aru phiristAsakaleo sAkSya diche, yadio sAkSIrUpe AllAhei yatheSTa|
nizcaYa yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AllAhara pathata vAdhA pradAna kariche, siha~ta nizcitarUpe bhISaNabhAৱe pathabhraSTa haiche|
nizcaYa yisakale kupharI kariche Aru anyAYa-atyAcAra kariche, AllAhe siha~taka kSamA nakariva Aru siha~taka kono patho nedekhAva|
keৱla jAhAnnAmara pathara vAhire| tAta siha~te cirakAla thAkiva Aru eiTo AllAhara vAve ati sahaja|

he mAnaৱjAti! nizcaYa rAchule tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA satya lai Ahiche, eteke tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karA, eiToৱe tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara ha’va| AnahAte yadi tomAloke kupharI karA tente (jAni thoৱA) AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei; Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

he Ahale kitAva! tomAloke nijara dharmata gulu (sImAlaMghana) nakarivA Aru AllAhara viSaYe satyara vAhire Ana eko naka’vA| mAraYAmara putra IchA machIha keৱla ejana AllAhara rAchula Aru teOMra vANIhe, yiTo teOM mAraYAmara ocarata preraNa karichila Aru teOMra taraphara parA eTA rUha| seYe tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulasakalara oparata ImAna poSaNa karA Aru (AllAhaka) tini vuli naka’vA, (ene ukti) parityAga karA, eiToৱei tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara| AllAhei haiche ekamAtra ilAha, teOMra santAna ha’va—teOM ene kathAra parA paৱitra-mahAna| AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei; Aru karma-vidhAYakarUpe AllAhei yatheSTa|

machIhe AllAhara vAndA ha’valai ketiYAo tAcchilya vodha nakare, Aru ghaniSTa phiristAsakaleo nakare| darAcalate yiYe teOMra ivAdataka tAcchilya jJAna kare Aru ahaMkAra kare, teOM siha~ta ATAike zIghrei teOMra ocarata ekatrita kariva|

AnahAte yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, AllAhe teOMlokaka teOMlokara puraskAra paripUrNabhAৱe dAna kariva, lagate nija anugrahata Aru vechikai pradAna kariva| AnahAte yisakale (AllAhara ivAdata karAka) tAcchilya jJAna kariche Aru ahaMkAra kariche, siha~taka teOM kaSTadAYaka zAsti diva| AllAhara vAhire siha~te kono abhibhAৱka Aru sahAYaka nApAva|
he mAnaৱjAti! tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara ocaralai pramANa Ahiche Aru Ami tomAlokara prati spaSTa jyoti aৱtIrNa karicho~|

eteke yisakale AllAhara prati ImAna Aniche Aru teOMka dRDha়bhAৱe aৱlamvana kariche, AllAhe teOMlokaka nizcaYa teOMra daYA Aru anugrahara mAjata praৱeza karAva Aru teOMlokaka sarala pathata teOMra phAle paricAlita kariva|

mAnuhe tomAra ocarata samAdhAna vicAre| koৱA, pitR-mAtRhIna niHsantAna vyakti samparke AllAhe tomAlokaka samAdhAna diche, kono puruSa mRtyuvaraNa karile si yadi santAnahIna haYa Aru tAra ejanI bhanIYeka vA vAYeka thAke tente tAi parityakta sampattira ardhAMza pAva| Aru yadi tAi (mRta nArI) santAnahInA haYa teneha’le tAira bhAYeka vA kakAYeka tAira uttarAdhikArI ha’va| eidare yadi dujanI bhanIYeka vA vAYeka thAke tente tAiha~te tAra parityakta sampattira tini bhAgara dubhAga pAva| Aru yadi keivAjano bhAi-kakAi vA vAi-bhanI thAke tente ejana puruSara aMza dujanI nArIra aMzara samAna| tomAloke pathabhraSTa ha’vA- ei AzaMkAta AllAhe tomAlokara vAve spaSTabhAৱe varNanA kariche; (jAni thoৱA) AllAha sakalo vastu samparke savizeSa aৱgata|

he muminasakala! tomAloke aGgIkArasamUha (Aru cuktisamUha) pUraNa karA| yivora (jantura kathA) tomAlokara ocarata pATha karA haiche seivorara vAhire tomAlokara vAve gharacIYA catuSpada jantu hAlAla karA haiche, kintu iharAma aৱsthAta cikAra karAka vaidha vuli nAbhAvivA| nizcaYa AllAhe yi vicAre Adeza diYe|

he muminasakala! tomAloke AllAhara nidarzanasamUhaka, paৱitra mAhaka, kuravAnIra vAve kA’vAlai preraNa karA pazuka, DiGita paridhAna karoৱA cihnaviziSTa pazuka Aru nija pratipAlakara anugrahaka lagate santuSTira anusandhAnata paৱitra gharara abhimukhe rAৱAnA hoৱA yAtrIsakalaka apamAna nakarivA| Aru yetiYA tomAloke iharAmamukta hoৱA tetiYA cikAra kariva pArA| tomAlokaka machajidula hArAmata praৱeza karivalai niSedha karAra kAraNe kono sampradAYara prati thakA zatrutAi tomAlokaka yAte ketiYAo sImAlaMghanata prarocita nakare| satkarma Aru tAkvaৱAra viSaYata tomAloke paraspare parasparaka sahAYa-sahayogitA karivA, AnahAte pApakarma Aru sImAlaMghanata ejane Anajanaka sahAYa-sahayogitA nakarivA, Aru AllAhara tAkvaৱA Aৱlamvana karA| nizcaYa AllAha zAsti dAnata ati kaThora|

tomAlokara vAve hArAma karA haiche mRta jantu, teja, gAharira mAMsa, AllAhara vAhire Anara nAmata javeha karA pazu, DiGi cepi vadha karA jantu, prahAra kari vadha karA jantu, oparara parA pari marA pazu, anya prANIra ziGara AghAtata marA jantu Aru hiMsra pazuৱe bhakSaNa karA jantu kintu yiToka tomAloke javeha kariva pArichA seiTora vAhire, Aru seiToo hArAma karA haiche yiTo mUrti pUjAra vedIta vali diYA haYa| tIra khelara juৱAre bhAgya nirNaYa karAo niSiddha karA haiche| ei sakalovora mahApApa| Aji kAphirasakala tomAlokara viruddhAcaraNata hatAza haiche, seYe siha~taka bhaYa nakarivA keৱla mokei bhaYa karA| Aji mai tomAlokara vAve tomAlokara dvInaka paripUrNa karilo~ Aru tomAlokara oparata mora anugraha sampUrNa karilo~, Aru tomAlokara vAve ichalAmaka dvIna hicApe manonIta karilo~| eteke yiYe pApakarmara phAle dhAৱita nahai keৱla bhokara tADa়nAta vAdhya hai (bhakSaNa kariche) tente nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

mAnuhe tomAka prazna kare, siha~tara vAve ki ki hAlAla karA haiche? koৱA, ‘tomAlokara vAve sakalo dharaNara paৱitra vastu hAlAla karA haiche, Aru cikArI jIৱ-jantu yivoraka tomAloke cikAra prazikSaNa dichA, tomAloke seivoraka sei zikSAi dichA, yi zikSA AllAhe tomAlokaka zikAiche| eteke enekuৱA (cikArI) jIৱ-jantuৱe tomAlokara vAve yi dhari Ane seivora tomAloke khoৱA, aৱzye tAra oparata (arthAt eri diYAra samaYata) AllAhara nAma la’vA, Aru (zunA) tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| nizcaYa AllAha ati druta hicApa grahaNakArI|

Aji tomAlokara vAve sakalo dharaNara paৱitra vastu hAlAla karA ha’la Aru yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karA haiche siha~tara khAdyadraৱyao tomAlokara vAve hAlAla karA haiche Aru tomAlokara khAdyadraৱyao siha~tara vAve hAlAla karA haiche| muminA saccaritrA nArI Aru tomAlokara Agata yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karA haichila siha~tara saccaritrA nArIsakalaka tomAlokara vAve vaidha karA haiche, yadihe tomAloke vivAhara vAvata mohara pradAna karA, prakAzya vyabhicAra vA gopana yaunasaGgInI hicApe nahaYa| (jAni thoৱA) yiYe ImAnara saite kupharI kariva, nizcaYa tAra Amala niSphala hai yAva, Aru si parakAlata kSatigrastasakalara antarbhukta ha’va|

he muminasakala! yetiYA tomAloke chAlAtara vAve thiYa ha’va vicarA tetiYA tomAloke nijara mukhamaNDala dhui la’vA lagate kilAkuTilaike hAta dhui la’vA, tomAlokara mUra macheha karivA Aru sarugA~Thilaike bhari dhui la’vA, AnahAte yadi tomAloke junuvI aৱsthAta thAkA teneha’le vizeSabhAৱe paৱitratA arjana kari la’vA| yadi tomAloke asustha hoৱA athavA bhramaNata thAkA nAivA tomAlokara mAjara yiYe mala-mutra tyAga kari Ahiche athavA strIra lagata sahavAsa kariche Aru (paৱitra ha’valai) pAnI poৱA nAi tente (tene samaYata) paৱitra mATira dvArA tAYAmmuma kari la’vA, arthAt tAra dvArA mukhamaNDala Aru hAta (ra sarugA~Thilaike) macheha karivA| AllAhe tomAlokara oparata kono dharaNara saMkIrNatA jApi diva nivicAre; varaM teOM tomAlokaka paৱitra kariva vicAre Aru tomAlokara oparata teOMra niYAmata sampUrNa kariva vicAre, yAte tomAloke kRtajJatA jJApana karA|

Aru smaraNa karA, tomAlokara oparata thakA AllAhara niYAmatavorara kathA Aru sei aGgIkArara kathA yiTo teOM tomAlokara parA laichila, yetiYA tomAloke kaichilA, ‘Ami zunilo~ Aru mAni la’lo~’, gatike tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| nizcaYa antarata yi Ache sei samparke AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|

he muminasakala! AllAhara uddezye nyAYa sAkSyadAnata tomAloke avicala thAkivA, kono sampradAYara prati thakA zatrutAi tomAlokaka yAte suvicAra varjanata prarocita nakare| tomAloke suvicAra karivA, eiToৱei tAkvaৱAra adhika nikaTaৱrtI| tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| nizcaYa tomAloke yi karA AllAha sei viSaYe samyaka aৱhita|
yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, AllAhe teOMlokaka pratizruti diche ye, teOMlokara vAve Ache kSamA Aru mahApuraskAra|
Aru yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche, siha~ta haiche prajvalita juira AdhivAsI|

he muminasakala! tomAlokara prati AllAhe karA niYAmata smaraNa karA yetiYA eTA sampradAYe tomAlokara viruddhe siha~tara hAta prasArita karivalai manastha karichila, tAra pichata AllAhei siha~tara hAta tomAlokara parA nivRta rAkhichila| tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru AllAhara oparatei muminasakale bharasA karA ucita|

Aru nizcaYa AllAhe vanI icharAIlara parA aGgIkAra grahaNa karichila, Aru siha~tara mAjara parA vArajana lokaka Ami dalapati niyukta kari preraNa karichilo~| AllAhe kaichila, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara lagata Acho~, yadi tomAloke chAlAta kAYema karA, yAkAta pradAna karA, Aru AmAra rAchulasakalara prati ImAna poSaNa karA, teOMlokaka sanmAna karA tathA sahAYa-sahayogitA karA Aru AllAhaka uttama RNa pradAna karA, tente nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara pApasamUha mocana karima Aru tomAlokaka aৱzye jAnnAtata praৱeza karAma yAra taladezata nadIsamUha pravAhita’| iYAra pichato yiYe kuphurI kariva si nizcitabhAৱe sarala pathara parA A~tari yAva|

tAra pichata siha~te aGgIkAra bhaMga karAra kAraNe siha~taka Ami abhisampAta karicho~ Aru siha~tara hRdaYaka kaThina kari dicho~, siha~te zavdavoraka sva-sthAnara parA vikRta kare Aru siha~taka yi upadeza diYA haichila tAre ekAMza siha~te pAhari gaiche| tumi sadAYa siha~tara kichusaMkhyakara vAhire adhikAMzakei vizvAsaghAtakatA karo~te dekhivalai pAvA, seYe siha~taka kSamA karA Aru upekSA karA| nizcaYa AllAhe satkarmaparAYaNakArIsakalaka bhAlapAYa|

Aru yisakale kaYa, ‘Ami nAchArA’, siha~taro Ami aGgIkAra grahaNa karichilo~; tAra pichata siha~taka yi upadeza diYA haichila tAre ekAMza siha~te pAhari gaichila| phalata Ami siha~tara mAjata kiYAmata paryanta sthAYI zatrutA Aru vidveSa sakriYa kari rAkhicho~| siha~te yi karichila seYA AllAhe acirei siha~taka janAi diva|

he kitAvIsakala! nizcaYa tomAlokara ocaralai AmAra rAchula Ahi pAiche, tomAloke kitAvara parA yi gopana karichilA tAre vechi bhAga teOM tomAlokara ocarata prakAza kariche Aru vahukhini eri diche| nizcaYa AllAhara taraphara parA eTA jyoti tathA spaSTa kitAva tomAlokara ocaralai Ahiche|

yisakale AllAhara santuSTira anusaraNa kare, iYAra mAdhyamata teOM siha~taka zAntira pathata paricAlita kare Aru siha~taka nija anumatikrame andhakArara parA poharalai uliYAi Ane lagate siha~taka sarala pathara hidAYata diYe|

nizcaYa siha~te kuphurI kariche yisakale kaYa ye, ‘mAraYAmara putra machIhei haiche AllAha’| koৱA, ‘yadi AllAhe machIha ivane mAraYAmaka Aru teOMra mAkaka lagate pRthiৱIta thakA sakaloke dhvaMsa kariva vicAre tente teOMka vAdhA divalai kAra zakti Ache’? AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjata yi Ache sei sakalovorara sArvabhaumatva keৱla AllAharei| teOM yi icchA kare seiToৱe sRSTi kare, Aru AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

iYAhUdI Aru nAchArAsakale kaYa, ‘Ami AllAhara putra Aru teOMra priYapAtra’| koৱA, ‘tente kiYa teOM tomAlokaka tomAlokara guNAhara kAraNe zAsti diva? varaM tomAlokeo siha~tara darei mAnuha, yisakalaka teOM sRSTi kariche| yAka icchA kare teOM kSamA kari diYe Aru yAka icchA kare teOM zAsti diYe, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta lagate ei duYore mAjata yi Ache sei sakalovorara sArvabhaumatva AllAharei, Aru teOMra ocaralaikei ubhati yAva lAgiva|

he kitAvIsakala! rAchula preraNara eTA (dIrgha) viratira pichata tomAlokara ocaralai AmAra rAchula (muhAmmada) Ahiche| teOM tomAlokara ocarata spaSTabhAৱe (carIYata) vyAkhyA kariche, yAte tomAloke eiTo ka’va noৱArA ye, ‘AmAra ocaralai kono susaMvAdavAhI Aru sAৱdhAnakArI ahA nAchila’| eteke (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa etiYA tomAlokara ocaralai susaMvAdadAtA Aru sAৱdhAnakArI Ahiche| AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA muchAi teOMra sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYara lokasakala! tomAloke tomAlokara oparata thakA AllAhara anugrahavora smaraNa karA yetiYA teOM tomAlokara mAjara parAi navI vanAichila Aru tomAlokaka rajA-vAdazvAha vanAichila| lagate tomAlokaka seiTo pradAna karichila yiTo sRSTijagatara kAko dAna karA nAchila’|
‘he mora sampradAYa! AllAhe tomAlokara vAve yiTo paৱitra bhUmi likhi diche tAta tomAloke praৱeza karA Aru pazcAdapasaraNa nakarivA, ene karile tomAloke kSatigrasta hai pratyAৱrtana karivA’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘he muchA! nizcaYa tAta eTA zaktizAlI sampradAYa Ache Aru siha~ta tAra parA olAi noyoৱAlaike Ami ketiYAo tAta praৱeza nakaro~| eteke siha~ta tAra parA olAi ga'le nizcaYa Ami tAta praৱeza karima’|

yisakale bhaYa karichila siha~tara mAjara dujane, yi dujanara prati AllAhe anugraha karichila, siha~te ka’le, ‘tomAloke siha~tara mukAvilA kari nagaradvArata praৱeza karA, praৱeza karilei tomAloke jaYalAbha karivA Aru yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA, teneha’le AllAhara oparatei bharasA karA’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘he muchA! siha~ta yetiYAlaike tAta thAkiva Ami ketiYAo tAta praৱeza nakaro~, eteke tumi Aru tomAra pratipAlake gai yuddha karAgai| nizcaYa Ami iYAtei vahi thAkima’|
teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! mora Aru mora bhAtRra vAhire Ana kAro oparate mora kono Adhipatya nAi, gatike tumi AmAra Aru phAchikva sampradAYara mAjata viccheda kari diYA’|

AllAhe ka’le, ‘teneha’le iYAka (ei bhUmika) siha~tara oparata calliza vacharalaike niSiddha karA ha’la, siha~te pRthiৱIta udbhrAnta hai ghUri phuriva, gatike tumi phAchikva sampradAYara vAve dukha nakarivA’|

Aru tumi Adamara dui putrara (hAvIla Aru kAvIlara) ghaTanATo siha~taka yathAyathabhAৱe varNanA kari zunoৱA| yetiYA siha~ta ubhaYe kuravAnI karichila, phalata ejanara parA (kuravAnI) kavula karA haichila Aru Anajanara parA kavula karA hoৱA nAchila|(yAra kuravAnI kavUla hoৱA nAchila) si ka’le, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAka hatyA karima’| Anajane ka’le, ‘nizcaYa AllAhe keৱla muttAkvIsakalara parAi (kuravAnI) kavula kare’|

‘moka hatyA karivalai tumi mora prati tomAra hAta prasArita karileo, tomAka hatyA karivalai mai kintu tomAra prati mora hAta prasArita nakaro~; nizcaYa mai AllAhaka bhaYa karo~, teৱe~i sRSTijagatara pratipAlaka’|
‘nizcaYa mai vicAro~ tumi mora Aru tomAra pApa lai ubhati yoৱA, iYAra phalata tumi jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI ha’vA, Aru eiToৱei haiche yAlimasakalara pratidAna’|
tathApio tAra bhAYekaka hatyA karivalai tAra naphache (pravRttiYe) tAka ucaTani dile| phalata si tAka hatyA karile Aru eidare si kSatigrastasakalara antarbhukta ha’la|

tAra pichata AllAhe eTA kAurI paThAle, yiToৱe tAra bhAYekara mRtadeha kenekai gopana kariva lAge seiTo dekhuoৱAvalai mATi khucarivalai dharile| (ei dekhi) si ka’le, ‘hAYa! mai ei kAurITora dareo ha’va noৱArilone ye mora bhAtRra mRtadehaTo DhAkiva pAro~? phalata si anutapta ha’la|

ei kAraNei vanI icharAIlara vAve ei vidhAna dichilo~ ye, hatyAra parivarte nAivA pRthiৱIta azAnti sRSTi rodha karAra vAhire yadi konovAi kArovAka hatyA kare si yenivA samagra mAnaৱ jAtikahe hatyA karile Aru yiYe kArovAra prANa rakSA karile si yenivA samagra mAnuhara prANa rakSA karile| nizcaYa siha~tara ocaralai AmAra rAchulasakale spaSTa pramANAdi lai Ahichila, iYAra pichato siha~tara adhikAMzai pRthiৱIta sImAlaMghana karichila|

yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara viruddhe yuddha kare Aru pRthiৱIta dhvaMsAtmaka kAma kari phure siha~tara zAsti keৱla eiToৱei ye, siha~taka hatyA karA ha’va athavA kruchaviddha karA ha’va nAivA viparIta dizara parA hAta bhari kATi peloৱA ha’va vA siha~taka dezara parA nirvAsita karA ha’va| pRthiৱIta eiToৱei haiche siha~tara lAJchanA Aru AkhirAtata siha~tara vAve Ache mahA zAsti|
kintu siha~tara vAhire, yisakale tomAlokara AYattAdhInata ahAra pUrvei tAovA kariche| eteke jAni thoৱA ye, nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru teOMra naikaTya lAbhara upAYa anveSaNa karA lagate teOMra pathata jihAda karA, yAte tomAloke saphala ha’va pArA|

nizcaYa yisakale kuphurI kariche, pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo yadi siha~tara haYa lagate iYAra samaparimANa Aru thAke, yAte siha~te iYAra mAdhyamata kviYAmatara dinA zAstira parA rakSA pAvalai muktipaNa hicApe diva pAre, tathApio siha~tara parA seYA grahaNa karA naha’va Aru siha~tara vAve Ache kaSTadAYaka zAsti|
siha~te juira parA olAva khujiva, kintu siha~te tAra parA olAva noৱAriva Aru siha~tara vAve Ache cirasthAYI zAsti|
cora puruSa Aru cora nArI ubhaYare hAta kATi diYA, eYA siha~tara kRtakarmara phala Aru AllAhara taraphara parA zikSaNIYa zAsti; (jAni thoৱA) AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
eteke sImAlaMghana karAra pichata yadi konovAi tAovA kare Aru nijake saMzodhana kare tente nizcaYa AllAhe tAra tAovA kavula kariva; nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tumi nAjAnA neki ye, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sArvabhaumatva keৱla AllAharei? teOM yAka icchA kare zAsti diYe Aru yAka icchA kare kSamA kari diYe Aru AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

he rAchula! tumi siha~tara vAve cintita naha’vA yisakale kuphurIra phAle druta gatita AguৱAi yAYa—yisakale mukhere kaYa, ‘ImAna Anicho~’, athaca siha~tara antare ImAna AnA nAi- Aru yisakale iYAhudI haiche, siha~ta (sakaloৱei) michA kathA zunivalai (Aru anusaraNa karivalai) adhika tatpara, anyAnya yivora sampradAYa tomAra ocaralai ahA nAi iha~te seisakala lokara vAve (tomAra kathAta) kANa pAti (corAMcoৱAgiri kari) thAke| (tAorAtara) zavdasamUha yathAyatha suvinyasta thakAra pichato siha~te seivorara artha vikRta kare| siha~te kaYa, ‘yadi tomAlokaka enekuৱA vidhAna diYe teneha’le grahaNa karivA Aru yadi enekuৱA vidhAna nidiYe teneha’le varjana karivA’| AllAhe yAka phitanAta pelAva vicAre tAra vAve AllAhara ocarata tomAra karivalai eko nAi| iha~tei haiche seisakala loka yisakalara hRdaYaka AllAhe vizuddha kariva nivicAre; siha~tara vAve Ache pRthiৱIta lAJchanA Aru AkhirAtata Ache mahAzAsti|

siha~te michA zunivalai vara AgrahazIla Aru avaidha sampada khAvalai atyanta Asakta; eteke siha~te yadi tomAra ocaralai Ahe tente siha~tara vicAra mImAMsA karivA athavA siha~taka upekSA karivA| tumi yadi siha~taka upekSA karA tente siha~te tomAra eko kSati kariva noৱAriva Aru tumi yadi siha~tara vicAra niSpatti karA tente siha~tara mAjata nyAYa vicAra karivA; nizcaYa AllAhe nyAYaparAYaNakArIsakalaka bhAlapAYa|
Aru siha~te kenekai tomAka phaYacAlAkArI vanAYa? athaca siha~tara ocarata Ache tAorAta, ya’ta Ache AllAhara vidhAna, tathApio siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa Aru siha~ta mumino nahaYa|

nizcaYa AmiYei tAorAta aৱtIrNa karichilo~, tAta Achila hidAYata Aru jyoti, iYAra mAdhyamata iYAhudisakalara vAve phaYacAlA pradAna karichila anugata navIsakale Aru rAvvAnIsakale lagate vidvAnasakaleo| kAraNa teOMlokaka AllAhara kitAvara rakSaka hicApe dAYitva diYA haichila Aru teOMloka Achila iYAra (satyatAra) sAkSI| seYe tomAloke mAnuhaka bhaYa nakarivA keৱla mokei bhaYa karA, Aru mora AYAtasamUhara vinimaYata tuccha mUlya kini nala’vA| AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche sei anuyAYI yisakale vidhAna nidiYe siha~tei haiche kAphira|

Aru tAta (tAorAtata) Ami siha~tara vAve (ei vidhAna) atyAৱzyaka kari dichilo~ ye, prANara parivarte prANa, cakura parivarte caku, nAkara parivarte nAka, kANara parivarte kANa, dA~tara parivarte dA~ta Aru AghAtara parivarte anurUpa AghAta| eteke konovAi kSamA karile tAra vAve seiTo kAphaphArA ha’va| Aru AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche sei anuyAYI yisakale vidhAna nidiYe siha~tei haiche yAlima|

Aru Ami teOMlokara pichatei mAraYAmara putra IchAka preraNa karichilo~, teOMra pUrve aৱtIrNa hoৱA tAorAtara samarthaka hicApe| Ami teOMka iJjIla pradAna karichilo~, tAta Achila hidAYata Aru jyoti, Aru eikhaneo tAra pUrve aৱtIrNa hoৱA tAorAtara satyatAra samarthanakArI Achila, lagate tAta Achila muttAkvIsakalara vAve hidAYata Aru upadeza|

iJjIlara anusArIsakale sei anusArei phaYacAlA karA ucita, yivora vidhAna AllAhe tAta aৱtIrNa kariche| kAraNa AllAhe yivora vidhAna aৱtIrNa kariche sei anuyAYI yisakale phaYacAlA nakare siha~tei haiche phAchikva|

Aru Ami tomAra prati satyasaha kitAva aৱtIrNa karicho~, iYAra pUrve aৱtIrNa hoৱA kitAvasamUhara satyatAra samarthanakArI Aru seivorara tadArakakArIrUpe| eteke AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche sei anuyAYI tumi siha~tara vicAra niSpatti karA Aru yi satya tomAra ocaralai Ahiche seiTo eri siha~tara pravRttira anusaraNa nakarivA| tomAlokara pratyekare vAve Ami ekoTAkai carIYata Aru spaSTa patha nirdhAraNa kari dicho~| AllAhe icchA karile tomAlokaka eTA ummata kariva pArilehe~tena, kintu teOM tomAlokaka yi pradAna kariche tAra dvArA tomAlokaka parIkSA kariva vicAre| seYe tomAloke satkarmata pratiyogitA karA| AllAhara pinei tomAloka sakaloৱe pratyAৱrtana kariva lAgiva| eteke tomAloke yi viSaYata matabheda karichilA, sei viSaYe teOM tomAlokaka aৱgata karAva|

(Akau kaicho~) AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche sei anuyAYI tumi siha~tara mAjata vicAra niSpatti karA, Aru siha~tara pravRttira anusaraNa nakarivA, lagate siha~tara viSaYe satarka thAkivA, kAraNa AllAhe tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa kariche siha~te yAte iYAra kono viSaYara parA tomAka vicyuta kariva noৱAre| yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa tente jAni thoৱA ye, AllAhe siha~taka keৱla siha~tara kichumAna guNAhara vAve zAsti diva vicAre| nizcaYa mAnuhara mAjara vahutei haiche phAchikva|
siha~te jAhiliYyAta yugara vicAra-vyaৱsthA kAmanA kare neki? dRDha় vizvAsI sampradAYara vAve vicAra-vyaৱsthA pradAnata AllAhatakai zreSTha Aru kona ha’va pAre?

he muminasakala! tomAloke iYAhudI Aru nAchArAsakalaka vandhurUpe grahaNa nakarivA, siha~ta haiche paraspare parasparara vandhu| tomAlokara mAjara konovAi siha~taka vandhurUpe grahaNa karile si nizcaYa siha~tarei ejana vuli gaNya ha’va| nizcaYa AllAhe atyAcArI sampradAYaka hidAYata nidiYe|

eteke yisakalara antarata vyAdhi Ache siha~taka tumi atisonakAle siha~tara saite milita hoৱA dekhivalai pAvA| siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami AzaMkA karicho~ ye, kono eTA vipade AmAka AkrAnta kariva’| eteke enekuৱAo ha’va pAre ye, AllAhe (tomAlokaka) vijaYa dAna kariva athavA teOMra phAlara parA enekuৱA kivA pradAna kariva yAte siha~te siha~tara antarata yi gopana rAkhichila sei vAve lajjita haYa|

Aru muminasakale ka’va, ‘iha~tei seisakala loka neki yisakale AllAhara nAmata dRDha়bhAৱe zapata karichila ye, nizcaYa siha~ta tomAlokara lagata Ache’? siha~tara AmalasamUha niSphala haiche, phalata siha~ta kSatigrasta haiche|

he muminasakala! tomAlokara mAjara konovAi yadi dvInara parA ubhati yAYa (tente jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAhe enekuৱA eTA sampradAYa Aniva yisakalaka teOM bhAlapAYa Aru teOMlokeo teOMka bhAla pAva; teOMloka muminasakalara prati komala Aru kAphirasakalara prati ati kaThora ha’va; teOMloke AllAhara pathata jihAda kariva Aru kono bhartsanAkArIra bhartsanAlai bhrUkSepa nakariva| eiTo AllAhara anugraha, teOM yAka icchA kare tAkei dAna kare| (jAni thoৱA) AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|
(jAni thoৱA) tomAlokara (prakRta) vandhu haiche keৱla AllAha Aru teOMra rAchula Aru muminasakala- yisakale vinIta hai chAlAta kAYema kare Aru yAkAta pradAna kare|
eteke yiYe AllAhaka Aru teOMra rAchulaka lagate muminasakalaka vandhurUpe grahaNa kariva (teৱe~i ha’va AllAhara dalabhukta)| (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAhara dalei jaYayukta ha’va|

he muminasakala! tomAlokara pUrve yisakalaka kitAva diYA haichila siha~tara mAjara yisakale tomAlokara dvInaka upahAsa Aru khela-dhemAlira vasturUpe grahaNa kare siha~taka Aru kAphirasakalaka tomAloke ketiYAo vandhurUpe grahaNa nakarivA Aru tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, yadi tomAloke prakRta mumina hoৱA|
Aru yetiYA tomAloke chAlAtara prati AhvAna karA tetiYA siha~te iYAka upahAsa Aru khela-dhemAlira vasturUpe grahaNa kare- eiTo eikAraNe ye, siha~ta haiche enekuৱA eTA sampradAYa yisakale ekoৱe navuje|

koৱA, ‘he kitAvIsakala! tomAloke AmAra saite eikAraNe zatrutA poSaNa karA neki ye, Ami AllAhara prati ImAna Anicho~ Aru AmAra prati yi aৱtIrNa haiche tathA yi AmAra pUrve aৱtIrNa haichila seivoraka Ami vizvAsa karo~| nizcaYa tomAlokara adhikAMzai haichA phAchikva’|

koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokaka iYAtakaio nikRSTa pariNAmara saMvAda dimane yiTo AllAhara ocarata Ache? yAra oparata AllAhe abhisampAta kariche Aru yAra oparata teOM krodhAnvita haiche| yisakalara mAjara parA kichumAnaka vAndara Aru kichumAnaka gAhari vanAichila Aru (siha~tara kichumAne) tAgutara upAsanA karichila| siha~tei aৱsthAnara dizara parA nikRSTa Aru sarala pathara parA ATAitakai vechi vicyuta’|

Aru siha~te yetiYA tomAlokara ocaralai Ahe tetiYA kaYa, Ami ImAna Anicho~, athaca siha~ta kuphurI lai praৱeza kariche Aru eiTo laiYe olAi gaiche| Aru siha~te yi gopana kare, sei samparke AllAhe bhAladarei jAne|
siha~tara mAjara vahutake tumi dekhivalai pAvA pApakarmata, sImAlaMghanata Aru avaidha bhakSaNara kSetrata tatpara; siha~te yi kare seYA kimAna ye nikRSTa!
rAvvAnIsakale Aru paNDitasakale siha~taka veYA kathA koৱAra parA Aru avaidha bhakSaNara parA kiYa niSedha nakare? iha~te yi kari Ache nizcaYa eYA kimAna ye nikRSTa!

Aru iYAhudIsakale kaYa, ‘AllAhara hAta ruddha’| varaM ruddha haoka siha~tara hAta Aru siha~te yi kaYa seikAraNe siha~ta abhizapta haoka, jAni thoৱA AllAhara ubhaYa hAtei prasArita; teOM yenekai icchA tenekai dAna kare| tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa karA haiche seYA nizcaYa siha~tara vahutare avAdhyatA Aru kuphurI vRddhi kariva| Ami siha~tara mAjata kviYAmata paryanta sthAYI zatrutA Aru vidveSa DhAli dicho~| yetiYAi siha~te yuddhara jui lagAYa tetiYAi AllAhe seYA numAi diYe Aru siha~te pRthiৱIta viparyaYa kari phure; Aru AllAhe viparyaYakArIsakalaka bhAla nApAYa|
Aru yadi kitAvIsakale ImAna Anilehe~tena Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karilehe~tena teneha’le nizcaYa Ami siha~tara pApasamUha maci dilohe~tena Aru siha~taka sukhamaYa jAnnAtata praৱeza karAlo~he~tena|

Aru siha~te yadi tAorAta, iJjIla Aru siha~tara pratipAlakara taraphara parA siha~tara prati yi aৱtIrNa karA haiche seYA pratiSThita karilehe~tena, teneha’le siha~te nizcitabhAৱe siha~tara oparara parA Aru bharira talara parA khAdya lAbha karilehe~tena| siha~tara mAjara eTA dala Ache madhyapanthI, kintu siha~tara mAjara adhikAMzai ati nikRSTa kAma kare!

he rAchula! tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa haiche seYA pracAra karA; Aru yadi tumi ene nakarA tente tumi teOMra vArtA pracAra nakarilA| (jAni thoৱA) AllAhei tomAka mAnuhara parA rakSA kariva| nizcaYa AllAhe kAphira sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|

koৱA, ‘he kitAvIsakala! tAorAta, iJjIla Aru tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara prati yi aৱtIrNa karA haiche seYA pratiSThA nakarAlaike tomAlokara kono bhitti nAi| AnahAte tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA (he muhAmmada) tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa karA haiche seYA siha~tara vahutare avAdhyatA Aru kuphurIhe vRddhi kariva| gatike tumi kAphira sampradAYakalai dukha nakarivA’|

nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche, eidare iYAhudI Aru chAveYI lagate nAchArAsakalara mAjara yisakale AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va|

nizcaYa Ami vanI icharAIlara parA aGgIkAra laichilo~ Aru siha~tara ocaralai vahuto rAchula preraNa karichilo~| yetiYAi kono rAchule siha~tara ocaralai enekuৱA kono vidhAna lai Ahichila yiTo siha~tara pravRttira viparIta Achila, tetiYAi siha~te kichumAna rAchulaka mithyAropa karichila Aru kichumAnaka hatyA karichila|

Aru siha~te bhAvichila ye, siha~tara kono zAsti naha’va, phalata siha~ta andha Aru vadhira hai parichila| tAra pichato AllAhe siha~tara tAovA kavula karichila| iYAra pichato siha~tara vahutei andha Aru vadhira haichila| siha~te yi Amala kare sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka draSTA|

yisakale kaYa, ‘machIha ivane mAraYAmei haiche AllAha’, nizcaYa siha~te kuphurI kariche| athaca machIhe kaiche, ‘he icharAIlara santAnasakala! tomAloke sei AllAhara ivAdata karA yijana mora pratipAlaka Aru tomAlokaro pratipAlaka’| nizcaYa yiYe AllAhara lagata aMzIdAra sthApana kariva AllAhe tAra oparata jAnnAta hArAma kari diche Aru tAra ThikanA ha’va jAhAnnAma; Aru yAlimasakalara vAve kono sahAYakArI nAi|

siha~teo nizcitabhAৱe kuphurI kariche- yisakale kaYa, ‘AllAha haiche tinijanara ejana’, athaca eka AllAhara vAhire Ana kono (satya) ilAha nAi; Aru siha~te yi kaYa tAra parA siha~te virata nAthAkile siha~tara mAjata yisakale kuphurI kariche, nizcaYa siha~tara oparata kaSTadAYaka zAsti Apatita ha’va|
siha~te AllAhara phAle ubhati nAhiva neki Aru teOMra ocarata kSamA prArthanA nakarivane? (jAni thoৱA) AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

mAraYAmara putra machIha haiche keৱla ejana rAchula| teOMra pUrve vahuto rAchula atIta haiche Aru teOMra mAka Achila atyanta satyavAdI| teOMloka dujanei khoৱA-voৱA karichila| coৱA, Ami siha~tara vAve AYAtasamUha kenekai vistAritabhAৱe varNanA karo~, tathApio coৱA, siha~ta kenekai satyavimukha haYa|
koৱA, tomAloke AllAhara vAhire ene vastura ivAdata karA neki yiYe tomAlokara kono kSati vA upakAra karAra kSamatA nArAkhe? Aru AllAhei sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

koৱA, ‘he kitAvIsakala! tomAloke satyara vAhire tomAlokara dharmIYa kSetrata sImAlaMghana nakarivA Aru iYAra pUrve yivora sampradAYe nije pathabhraSTa haiche Aru Ana vahutake pathabhraSTa kariche, lagate sarala pathara parA vicyuta haiche, siha~tara pravRttiro anusaraNa nakarivA’|
vanI icharAIlara mAjara yisakale kuphurI karichila siha~ta dAUda Aru mAraYAmara putra IchAra mukhere abhizapta haichila| eikAraNe ye, siha~te avAdhyatA karichila Aru siha~te sImAlaMghana karichila|
siha~te yivora garhita kAma karichila seivorara parA siha~te ijane sijanaka niSedha karA nAchila| siha~te karA kAmavora kimAna ye nikRSTa!

siha~tara mAjara vahutake tumi kAphirasakalara lagata vandhutva karA dekhivalai pAvA| siha~tara antare siha~tara vAve yi peca kariche (siha~tara kRtakarma) seYA kimAna ye nikRSTa! sei kAraNe AllAhe siha~tara oparata krodhAnvita haiche Aru siha~ta cirakAla zAstitei thAkiva|

siha~te yadi AllAhara prati ImAna Anilehe~tena Aru navIra prati lagate teOMra prati yi aৱtIrNa haiche tAra prati ImAna Anilehe~tena tente kAphirasakalaka (ketiYAo) vandhurUpe grahaNa nakarilehe~tena, kintu siha~tara vechibhAgei haiche phAchikva|

muminasakalara saite zatrutAra kSetrata mAnuhara mAjara parA iYAhudI Aru muzvarikasakalakei tumi adhika ugra dekhivalai pAvA| AnahAte muminasakalara vAve vandhutvara dizata ATAitakai nikaTaৱrtI pAvA seisakala lokaka yisakale kaYa, ‘Ami nAchArA’,| kAraNa siha~tara mAjata vahuto paNDita Aru saMsAravirAgI Ache, yisakale ahaMkAra nakare|

Aru rAchulara prati aৱtIrNa hoৱA vANI yetiYA siha~te zune, tetiYA siha~te yi satya upalavdhi kare tAra phalata tumi siha~tara caku azrusikta dekhivalai pAvA| siha~te kaYa, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami ImAna Anicho~, eteke tumi AmAka sAkSya dAnakArIsakalara tAlikAbhukta karA’|

‘Aru AmAra ki haiche, Ami kiYa AllAhara prati Aru yi satya AmAra ocaralai Ahiche tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana nakarima? yihetu Ami pratyAzA karo~ ye, AmAra pratipAlake AmAka pUNyaৱAna sampradAYara antarbhukta kariva’|

phalata siha~tara ei kathAra kAraNe AllAhe siha~tara vAve puraskAra nirdhAraNa kariche jAnnAta, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita, tAta siha~ta sthAYI ha’va; Aru eiTo haiche satkarmazIlasakalara puraskAra|
AnahAte yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AmAra AYAtasamUhaka mithyAropa kariche, siha~tei haiche jAhAnnAmI|
he muminasakala! AllAhe tomAlokara vAve utkRSTa yivora vastu hAlAla kariche seivoraka tomAloke hArAma nakarivA Aru sImAlaMghana nakarivA| nizcaYa AllAhe sImAlaMghanakArIsakalaka pachanda nakare|
Aru AllAhe tomAlokaka yivora jIৱikA pradAna kariche tAra parA tomAloke hAlAla Aru utkRSTa vastuvora khoৱA Aru AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, yAra prati tomAloke vizvAsa sthApana karichA|

tomAlokara anarthaka zapatara vAve AllAhe tomAlokara dAYa-doSa nadhariva, kintu yivora zapata tomAloke icchAkRtabhAৱe karA seivorara vAve teOM tomAlokara doSa dhariva| eteke iYAra kAphaphArA haiche, dahajana michakInaka madhyama dharaNara khAdya pradAna karA, yivora khAdya tomAloke nija pariYAlaka khuoৱA, athavA siha~taka vastra dAna karivA nAivA ejana dAsa mukta karivA| yAra sAmartha nAi si tini dina chiYAma pAlana kariva| tomAloke zapata karile eiToৱe tomAlokara zapatara kAphaphArA| tomAloke nijara zapata rakSA karivA| eidare AllAhe tomAlokara vAve teOMra AYAtasamUha varNanA kare, yAte tomAloke kRtajJatA jJApana karA|

he muminasakala! mada, juৱA, mUrtipUjAra vedI Aru bhAgya nirNaYa karA tIra eivora haiche keৱla ghRNAra vastu tathA caYatAnara kAma| seYe tomAloke eivora varjana karA, yAte tomAloke saphala ha’va pArA|

caYatAne tomAlokara mAjata mada Aru juৱAra dvArA zatrutA tathA vidveSa saJcAra kariva vicAre Aru tomAlokaka AllAhara smaraNata lagate chAlAtata vAdhA pradAna kariva vicAre| tathApio tomAloke virata nethAkivAne?

Aru tomAloke AllAhara Anugatya karA Aru rAchulara Anugatya karA lagate sAৱdhAnatA aৱlamvana karA; tathApio yadi tomAloke vimukha hoৱA tente jAni thoৱA ye, AmAra rAchulara dAYitva haiche keৱla suspaSTabhAৱe pracAra karA|

yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMloke iYAra Agate yivora pAnAhAra kariche tAra vAve teOMlokara kono guNAha naha'va, yadi teOMloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare, ImAna Ane Aru satkarma kare| tAra pichata teOMloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare Aru ImAna Ane| tAra pichata teOMloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare Aru ihachAna kare| tente (jAni thoৱA) AllAhe muhachInasakalaka pachanda kare|

he ImAndArasakala! AllAhe tomAlokaka nizcaYa parIkSA kariva cikArara enekuৱA vastura dvArA yivora tomAlokara hAtara Aru vallamara AotAta thAke, yAte AllAhe prakAza kari diYe ye, kone teOMka nedekhAkaiYe bhaYa pAYa| gatike iYAra pichato konovAi sImAlaMghana karile tAra vAve kaSTadAYaka zAsti Ache|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke iharAmata thakA aৱsthAta cikAra (jantu hatyA) nakarivA, Aru yadi tomAlokara mAjata konovAi seYA icchAkRtabhAৱe hatyA kare tente si yiTo hatyA kariche tAra vinimaYa haiche anurUpa gRhapAlita jantu, yAra phaYacAlA kariva tomAlokara mAjara dujana nyAYavicAraka loke- kuravAnIra jantu hicApe kA’vAlai pau~cAva lAgiva nAivA iYAra kAphaphArA ha’va daridraka khAdya dAna karA athavA sei anupAte chiYAma pAlana karA, yAte si nijara kRtakarmara phala bhoga kariva pAre| Agate yi haiche AllAhe seYA kSamA kariche| kintu konovAi yadi punara kare tente AllAhe tAra parA pratizodha grahaNa kariva Aru AllAha parAkramazAlI, pratizodha grahaNakArI|

tomAlokara vAve sAgarara parA cikAra karA Aru seYA bhakSaNa karATo hAlAla karA haiche, tomAlokara Aru paryaTakasakalara bhogara vAve| tomAloke yetiYAlaike iharAmata thAkivA tetiYAlaike tomAlokara vAve sthalara cikAra karA hArAma; Aru tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, yAra ocarata tomAlokaka ekatrita karA ha’va|

AllAhe paৱitra kAvA gharaka, paৱitra mAhaka, hAdaYi Aru galAৱddha jantuko mAnuhara kalyANara vAve nirdhArita kariche| eiTo eivAve ye, yAte tomAloke jAniva pArA, nizcaYa AkAzasamUhata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache AllAhe seYA jAne Aru nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastu samparke samyaka aৱgata|
jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha zAsti dAnata ati kaThora, Aru AllAha parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
rAchulara dAYitva haiche keৱla pracAra karA; Aru tomAloke yi prakAza karA Aru yi gopana karA seYA AllAhe jAne|
koৱA, apaৱitra Aru paৱitra samAna nahaYa, yadio apaৱitrara Adhikyai tomAka mugdha kare| seYe, he vodhasampanna vyaktisakala! tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA yAte tomAloke saphala ha’va pArA|

he muminasakala! tomAloke ene kono viSaYa samparke prazna nakarivA yiTo tomAlokara ocarata prakAza karA ha’le tomAloke kaSTa pAvA| koraAna aৱtIrNa hoৱAra samaYata tomAloke yadi tenekuৱA kono prazna karA tente tomAlokara ocarata prakAza kari diYA ha’va| (Agate yi haiche) AllAhe seivora kSamA kariche Aru AllAha kSamAzIla, sahanazIla|
tomAlokara Agateo eTA sampradAYe enekuৱA dharaNara prazna karichila; tAra pichata siha~te iYAra kAraNe kAphira hai gaichila|
vAhIrAha, chAYevAha, achIlAha Aru hAma (eivora vidhAna) AllAhe praৱrtana karA nAi; kintu kAphirasakale (eivora praNaYana kari) AllAhara prati mithyAropa kariche| siha~tara adhikAMzai nuvuje|

Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa, ‘AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche seipine Aru rAchulara pine AhA’, tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami AmAra pUrvapuruSasakalaka yiTota pAicho~ seiToৱei AmAra vAve yatheSTa’| yadio siha~tara pUrvapuruSasakale eko janA nAchila Aru satpatha prAptao nAchila, (tathApio siha~tara anusaraNa karivane?)

he muminasakala! tomAlokara dAYitva tomAlokara oparatei| tomAloke yadi satpathata paricAlita hoৱA tente yiYe pathabhraSTa haiche si tomAlokara kono kSati kariva noৱAriva| AllAhara pinei tomAloka sakalore pratyAৱrtana ha'va, tAra pichata tomAloke yi karichilA sei samvandhe teOM tomAlokaka aৱhita kariva|

he muminasakala! tomAlokara kArovAra yetiYA mRtyu upasthita haYa tetiYA achiYata karAra samaYata tomAlokara mAjara dujana nyAYaparAYaNa lokaka sAkSI rAkhivA; athavA yadi tomAloka bhramaNata thAko~te tomAlokaka mRtyura vipade Ahi dhare tente Ana mAnuhara (amuchalimasakalara) parA ha'leo dujana mAnuhaka sAkSI manonIta karivA| yadi tomAlokara sandeha haYa tente ubhaYake chAlAtara pichata apekSAta rAkhivA| tAra pichata siha~te AllAhara nAmata zapata kari ka’va, ‘Ami iYAra vinimaYata kono mUlya grahaNa nakaro~ yadio si AmAra kono AtmIYai nahaoka kiYa Aru Ami AllAhara sAkSI gopana nakaro~, (yadi Ami enekuৱA karo~ tente) nizcaYa Ami pApiSThasakalara antarbhukta hama’|

kintu yadi eiTo prakAza haYa ye, siha~ta dujana aparAdhata lipta haiche tente yisakalara svArthahAnI haiche siha~tara mAjara parA (mRta vyaktira) nikaTatama dujana vyakti siha~ta dujanara sthalAbhiSikta ha’va Aru AllAhara nAmata zapata kari ka’va, ‘AmAra sAkSya nizcaYa siha~tara sAkSyara parA adhika satya Aru Ami sImAlaMghana karA nAi, (Aru yadi Ami enekuৱA kari thAko~ tente) nizcaYa Ami yAlimasakalara antarbhukta hama’|

ei paddhatiYei haiche ati nikaTatama ye, siha~te sAkSya saThikabhAৱe upasthApana kariva athavA siha~te (michA sAkSya pradAnakArIsakale) bhaYa kariva ye, siha~tara (nikaTAtmIsakalara) zapatara pichata (pUrvokta) zapata pratyAkhyAna karA ha’va| tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru zunA, AllAhe phAchika sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|

(smaraNa karA) yidinA AllAhe rAchulasakalaka ekatrita kariva Aru sudhiva, ‘(ummatara phAlara parA) tomAlokaka ki uttara diYA haichila’? teOMloke ka’va, ‘ei viSaYe AmAra kono jJAna nAi, nizcaYa gAYeva samparke tumiYei sarvajJAnI’|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA AllAhe ka’va, ‘he mAraYAmara putra IchA! tomAra prati Aru tomAra mAkara prati mora niYAmata smaraNa karA, yetiYA ruhula kuducha pradAna kari mai tomAka zaktizAlI karichilo~ Aru tumi dolanAta thakA aৱsthAta lagate pariNata vaYasato mAnuhara lagata kathA ka’va pArichilA, tomAka kitAva, hikamata, tAorAta Aru iJjIla zikSA dichilo~, tumi vokA mATire mora anumatikrame carAira dare AkRti gaThaNa karichilA Aru tAta phu~ mArichilA, phalata mora anumatikrame seiTo carAi hai gaichila, janmAndha Aru kuSTha rogIsakalaka tumi mora anumatikrame nirAmaYa kariva pArichilA Aru tumi mora anumatikrame mRtaka jIৱita kariva pArichilA, Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA mai tomAra parA vanI icharAIlaka virata rAkhichilo~, yetiYA tumi siha~tara ocaralai spaSTa nidarzana AnichilA tetiYA siha~tara mAjara yisakale kuphurI karichila siha~te kaichila, ‘eYA spaSTa yAdura vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA mai hAৱArIsakalara manata ilahAma karichilo~ ye, ‘tomAloke mora prati Aru mora rAchulara prati ImAna poSaNa karA’, siha~te kaichila, ‘Ami ImAna Anilo~ Aru tumi sAkSI thAkA ye, nizcaYa Ami muchalima’|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA hAৱArIsakale kaichila, ‘he mAraYAmara putra IchA! tomAra pratipAlake AmAlai AkAzara parA khAdya vasture bharA pATI (DAiniM Tevula) preraNa karivalai sakSamane? teOM kaichila, ‘tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA’|
siha~te kaichila, ‘Ami tAra parA khAva vicAro~ yAte AmAra hRdaYe prazAnti lAbha kariva, Aru yAte Ami jAniva pAro~ ye, tumi koৱA kathAvora satya Aru Ami ei viSaYe sAkSI ha’va vicAro~’|

mAraYAmara putra IchAi ka’le, ‘he AllAha (tumi) AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra vAve AkAzara parA dastarakhAna (khAdya bharA pATI) aৱtIrNa karA; eiTo AmAra Aru AmAra pUrvaৱrtI lagate paraৱrtI sakalore vAve ha’va Anandotsaৱ svarUpa Aru eYA ha'va tomAra phAlara parA eTA nidarzana| AmAka jIৱikA dAna karA, tumiYeito zreSTha jIৱikAdAtA’|

AllAhe ka’le, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara oparata seYA aৱtIrNa karima, kintu iYAra pichata tomAlokara mAjara parA konovAi kuphurI karile tAka mai enekuৱA zAsti vihima yiTo zAsti sRSTijagatara Ana kAko nidiOM’|

Aru smaraNa karA, AllAhe yetiYA ka’va, ‘he mAraYAmara putra IchA! tumi mAnuhaka ei kathA kaichilA neki ye, tomAloke AllAhara vAhire moka Aru mora mAkaka upAsyarUpe grahaNa karA? teOM ka’va, ‘tumi mahimAnvita! yiTo koৱAra adhikAra mora nAi seiTo koৱA mora pakSe ketiYAo zobhanIYa nahaYa| yadi mai enekai ka’lohe~tena tente tumito seYA jAnilAhe~tena| mora antarara kathAto tumi jAnAi, kintu tomAra antarara kathA mai nAjAno, nizcaYa tumi adRzya samparke sarvajJAnI’|

‘tumi moka yi Adeza karichilA tAra vAhire mai siha~taka eko koৱA nAchilo~, seiTo Achila ei ye, tomAloke AllAhara ivAdata karA yijana moro pratipAlaka Aru tomAlokaro pratipAlaka; Aru yimAna dinalaike mai siha~tara mAjata Achilo~ simAna dinalaike mai siha~tara kAryakarmara sAkSI Achilo~, kintu yetiYA tumi moka uThAi AnilA tetiYA tumiYeito AchilA siha~tara kRtakarmara tattvAৱdhAYaka Aru tumiYei sakalo vastura paryavekSaka|
yadi tumi siha~taka zAsti diYA tente siha~tato tomArei vAndA, Aru yadi siha~taka kSamA kari diYA tente nizcaYa tumi mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAhe ka’va, ‘eiToৱe haiche sei dina, yidinA satyavAdIsakalara satyavAdItAi teOMlokaka upakRta kariva, teOMlokara vAve Ache jAnnAta, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita| teOMloke tAta cirasthAYI ha’va, AllAha teOMlokara prati santuSTa ha’va Aru teOMlokeo AllAhara prati santuSTa ha’va, eiToৱei haiche mahAsaphalatA|
AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱI lagate ei duYore mAjata yi Ache sei sakalovorara rAjatva AllAharei Aru teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAharei yijane AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche, Aru sRSTi kariche andhakAra Aru jyoti| iYAra pichato kAphirasakale siha~tara pratipAlakara samakakSa sthira kare|
teৱe~i tomAlokaka vokA mATire sRSTi kariche, tAra pichata eTA samaYa nirdiSTa kariche Aru Ana eTA nirdhArita samaYa Ache yiTo keৱla teৱe~i jAne, iYAra pichato tomAloke sandeha karA|
AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta keৱla teৱe~i AllAha, tomAlokara gopana Aru prakAzya sakalo teOM jAne Aru tomAloke yi arjana karA seYAo teOM jAne|
Aru siha~tara pratipAlakara taraphara parA siha~tara ocaralai kono nidarzana Ahilei siha~te tAra parA mukha ghUrAi laYa|

eteke siha~tara ocaralai yetiYAi satya Ahiche, tetiYAi siha~te tAka asvIkAra kariche| gatike yi viSaYe siha~te upahAsa karichila tAra (pariNAmara) yathArtha saMvAda anatipalame siha~tara ocaralai Ahi pAva|

siha~te coৱA nAine ye, Ami siha~tara pUrve vahu prajanmaka vinAza karicho~? siha~taka pRthiৱIta enekai pratiSThita karichilo~ ye, tenekai pratiSThita tomAlokako karA nAi Aru siha~tara oparata dhArASAra varaSuNa varSAichilo~, Aru sRSTi karichilo~ nadIsamUha yivora siha~tara talata pravAhita Achila, tAra pichata siha~tara pApakarmara vAve siha~taka vinAza karicho~ Aru siha~tara pichata Ana prajanmaka sRSTi karicho~|

Aru Ami yadi tomAra prati kAgajata likhita granthao aৱtIrNa karilohe~tena, phalata siha~te yadi seikhanaka hAtere sparzao karilehe~tena tathApio kAphirasakale ka’lehe~tena ye, ‘eikhana spaSTa yAdura vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’|

Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘teOMra ocaralai kono phiristA kiYa aৱtIrNa karA nahaYa?’ Aru yadi Ami phiristA aৱtIrNa karilo~he~tena, tente viSaYaTora cuDa়Anta phaYacAlAi hai ga’lahe~tena, tAra pichata siha~taka Aru kono aৱkAza diYA naha’lahe~tena|
Aru yadi teOMka phiristA vanAlo~he~tena tente teOMka puruSa mAnuhara AkRtitei paThiYAlo~he~tena, Aru siha~taka tenekuৱA vibhramatei rAkhilo~he~tena yenekuৱA vibhramata siha~ta etiYA Ache|
Aru tomAra pUrveo vahuto rAchulaka upahAsa karA haichila| phalata yisakale teOMlokara lagata upahAsa karichila siha~taka siha~tara upahAsei pariveSTana kari laichila|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke pRthiৱIta paribhramaNa karA, tAra pichata coৱA, yisakale mithyAropa karichila siha~tara pariNAma ki haichila’!

koৱA, ‘AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache seYA kAra’? koৱA, ‘AllAharei’, teOM nijara oparata 'daYAka' kartavya hicApe likhi laiche| kviYAmatara dinA teOM nizcaYa tomAlokaka ekatrita kariva, iYAta kono sandeha nAi| yisakale nijei nijara kSati kariche siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
rAti Aru dinata yi yi aৱsthAna kare sei sakalovora teOMrei, Aru teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

koৱA, ‘AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra sraSTA AllAhaka eri mai Anaka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa karima neki? teৱe~i AhAra pradAna kare kintu teOMka AhAra pradAna karA nahaYa’| koৱA, ‘nizcaYa moka Adeza karA haiche ye, yisakale ichalAma grahaNa kariche maYei yena siha~tara mAjata prathama haOM, (moka Aru Adeza karA haiche ye) tumi ketiYAo muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta naha’vA’|
koৱA, ‘mai yadi mora pratipAlakara avAdhyatA karo~, tente nizcaYa mai bhaYa karo~ ye, mahA diৱsara zAsti mora oparata Apatita ha’va’|
‘sei dinA yAra parA ei zAsti A~tarAi loৱA ha’va, tAra pratihe AllAhe daYA kariva, Aru eiToৱei haiche spaSTa saphalatA’|

Aru AllAhe yadi tomAka kono vipadara dvArA sparza kare, tente teOMra vAhire Ana koneo seYA dUra kariva noৱAriva, Aru yadi teOM tomAka kono kalyANara dvArA sparza kare, tente (jAni thoৱA) teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
Aru teৱe~i nija vAndAsakalara oparata pUrNa niYantraNakArI, Aru teOM prajJAmaYa, samyaka aৱhita|

koৱA, ‘konaTo vastu ATAitakai DAGara sAkSI’? tumi koৱA, ‘AllAha, (teৱe~i) mora Aru tomAlokara mAjata (zreSTha) sAkSI, Aru ei koraAna mora ocaralai ahI karA haiche yAte tomAlokaka Aru yAra ocaralaike i gai pAva siha~taka iYAra dvArA satarka kariva pAro~| tomAloke ei sAkSya vahana karA neki ye, AllAhara lagata Ana konovA ilAha (upAsya) Ache’? koৱA, ‘mai ei sAkSya nidiOM’| koৱA, ‘teৱe~i haiche ekamAtra prakRta ilAha Aru tomAloke yi aMzIdAra sthApana karA tAra lagata nizcaYa mora kono samparka nAi’|
Ami yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karicho~ siha~te teOMka enekai cini pAYa yenekai siha~te nija santAnaka cini pAYa| yisakale nijei nijara kSati sAdhana kariche siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
yi vyaktiYe AllAha samparke michA racanA kare athavA teOMra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kare, sei vyaktitakai DAGara yAlima Aru kona ha’va pAre? nizcaYa yAlimasakale saphalatA lAbha kariva noৱAriva|
Aru yidinA Ami siha~ta ATAike ekatrita karima, tAra pichata yisakale zvirka kariche siha~taka sudhima, ‘yisakalaka tomAloke mora lagata aMzI sthApana karichilA siha~ta etiYA ka’ta’?
tetiYA siha~tara ocarata ei kathAra vAhire Ana kono ajuhAta nAthAkiva ye, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka AllAhara zapata! Ami muzvarika nAchilo~’|
coৱA, siha~te kenekai nijei nijake michA pramANita kari Ache, lagate (coৱA) siha~te yi michA racanA karichila seYA kenekai siha~tara parA herAi ga’la|

Aru siha~tara mAjara kichumAne tomAra kathA kANa pAti zune, kintu Ami siha~tara antarata AৱraNa kari dicho~ yAte siha~te seYA upalavdhi kariva noৱAre, Aru siha~tara kANata Ache vadhiratA| yadi siha~te yAৱtIYa nidarzana pratyakSa kare tathApio siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva| Anaki siha~te yetiYA tomAra ocarata Ahi upasthita haYa, tetiYA siha~te tomAra lagata virkata lipta haYa, yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~te kaYa, ‘eYA dekhona Agara dinara upakathAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’|
Aru siha~te Anaka eivora zunAra parA virata rAkhe Aru nijeo eivora zunAra parA dUrata thAke| siha~ta nijei nijake dhvaMsa kare, athaca siha~te upalavdhi nakare|

tumi yadi dekhilAhe~tena yetiYA siha~taka juira oparata thiYa karoৱA ha’va tetiYA siha~te ka’va, ‘hAYa’! yadi AmAka (pRthiৱIlai) obhatAi diYA ha’lahe~tena, tente Ami AmAra pratipAlakara AYAtasamUhaka (dunAi) asvIkAra nakarilo~ haYa Aru Ami muminasakalara antarbhukta ha’lo~ haYa|

varaM pUrve siha~te yi gopana karichila seYA etiYA siha~tara ocarata prakAza pAiche; Aru siha~taka Akau (dunAi pRthiৱIlai) paThoৱA ha’leo siha~taka yi karivalai niSedha karA haichila Akau siha~te seiToke karile haYa; Aru nizcaYa siha~ta michalIYA|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘AmAra pArthiৱ jIৱnei haiche ekamAtra jIৱna, Aru AmAka punarutthita karA naha’va’|

Aru yadi tumi dekhilAhe~tena, yetiYA siha~taka siha~tara pratipAlakara sanmukhata thiYa karoৱA ha’va, teOM ka’va, ‘eiTo prakRta satya nahaYa jAno’? siha~te ka’va, ‘AmAra pratipAlakara zapata! nizcaYa eYA satya’| teOM ka’va, ‘tente tomAloke yi kuphurI karichilA tAra vAve tomAloke etiYA zAsti bhoga karA’|

yisakale AllAhara sAkSAtaka asvIkAra kariche, nizcaYa siha~ta kSatigrasta haiche, Anaki siha~tara ocaralai yetiYA haThAt kiYAmata Ahi upasthita ha’va tetiYA siha~te ka’va, ‘hAYa Aphacoca! iYAka Ami kimAna ye aৱhelA karichilo~’| siha~te siha~tara pApasamUha nijara piThita vahana kariva| sAৱdhAna! siha~te yi vahana kariva seYA ati nikRSTa!
Aru pArthiৱ jIৱna keৱla khela-dhemAlira vAhire Ana eko nahaYa Aru yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare teOMlokara vAve AkhirAtara AvAsei uttama; tathApio tomAloke nuvujAne?
Ami nizcaYa jAno ye, siha~te yi kaYa seYA tomAka kaSTa diYe; kintu siha~te tomAra prati mithyAropa nakare, varaM yAlimasakale AllAhara AYAtasamUhakahe asvIkAra kare|

nizcaYa tomAra pUrveo vahuto rAchulara oparata mithyAropa karA haichila, kintu teOMlokaka mithyAropa karAra pichato Aru kaSTa diYAra pichato teOMloke dhairyya dhAraNa karichila, aৱzeSata teOMlokara ocaralai AmAra sahAYa Ahichila| (jAni thoৱA) AllAhara (pratizruta) vANIsamUhaka pariৱrtana kariva parA kono nAi| nizcaYa rAchulasakalara kichu saMvAda tomAra ocaralaikeo Ahiche|

Aru yadi siha~tara upekSA (anAgraha) tomAra vAve kaSTakara haYa tente pArile bhUgarbhata suraMga athavA AkAzata jakhalA anveSaNa kari siha~tara vAve kono nidarzana lai AhA| (jAni thoৱA) yadi AllAhe icchA karilehe~tena tente siha~ta ATAike nizcaYa satpathata ekatrita karilehe~tena| seYe tumi mUrkhasakalara antarbhukta naha’vA|
yisakale zunA pAYa keৱla teOMlokei AhvAnata sa~hAri diYe| mRtasakalaka AllAhei punara jIৱita kariva; tAra pichata siha~taka teOMra pinei pratyAৱrtana karoৱA ha’va|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘teOMra pratipAlakara taraphara parA teOMra ocaralai nidarzana kiYa nAhe’? koৱA, ‘nidarzana aৱtIrNa karivalai AllAha nizcaYa sakSama’, kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai (ei kathA) nAjAne|

Aru pRthiৱIta vicaraNazIla pratiTo prANI Aru (vAYumaNDalata) dui DeukAre urA pratiTo carAi, tomAlokara darei eko ekoTA ummata| ei kitAvata (lAohe mAhaphujata) Ami eko eri diYA nAi; tAra pichata siha~taka siha~tara pratipAlakara pinei ekatrita karA ha’va|
Aru yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kare, siha~ta haiche kalA Aru vovA, andhakArata Ache| AllAhe yAka icchA kare vipathagAmI kare Aru yAka icchA kare teOM sarala pathata sthApana kare|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke ki vivecanA karA, yadi tomAlokara oparata AllAhara zAsti Apatita haYa athavA tomAlokara ocaralai kviYAmata Ahi pare, tathApio tomAloke AllAhara vAhire Ana kArovAka mAtivAne? yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA (tente koৱA)|

(nahaYa) varaM tomAloke keৱla teOMkei mAtivA| eteke tomAloke yi uddezye teOMka mAtivA teOM icchA karile tomAlokara sei uddezya pUraNa kariva Aru tomAloke yivoraka teOMra aMzI karichilA seivoraka pAhari yAvA|

nizcaYa Ami tomAra pUrve vahuto jAtira ocaralai rAchula preraNa karicho~, kintu (rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karAra kAraNe) siha~taka arthasaMkaTa Aru dukha-kaSTata patita karichilo~, yAte siha~ta vinIta haYa|

eteke yetiYA AmAra zAsti Ahi siha~tara oparata Apatita ha’la, tetiYA siha~te kiYa vinIta hoৱA nAchila? kAraNa siha~tara hRdaYa niSThura haichila Aru siha~te yi karichila seivoraka caYatAne siha~tara vAve zobhanIYa kari dichila|

siha~taka yi upadeza diYA haichila seYA yetiYA siha~te pAhari ga’la, tetiYA Ami siha~tara vAve sakalo vastura duৱAra mukali kari dilo~; aৱzeSata siha~taka yi pradAna karA haichila yetiYA siha~te seivorakalai utphullita ha’la tetiYA haThAt siha~taka ATaka karilo~, phalata tetiYAi siha~ta nirAza hai parila|
phalata yAlima sampradAYaka mUloccheda karA ha'la, Aru sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla sRSTijagatara pratipAlaka AllAhara vAvei|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke bhAৱi coৱA nAine, AllAhe yadi tomAlokara zraৱNazakti Aru dRSTizakti haraNa kari laYa Aru tomAlokara hRdaYata mohara mAri diYe tente AllAhara vAhire tomAlokara kona upAsya Ache yiYe eivora obhatAi Ani diva’? coৱA, kenekai Ami AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe varNanA karo~, iYAra pichato siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke koৱAcona yadi AllAhara zAsti haThAt athavA prakAzyabhAৱe tomAlokara oparata Ahi pare tente yAlima sampradAYara vAhire Ana konovAka dhvaMsa karA ha’vane’?
Aru Ami rAchulasakalaka keৱla susaMvAdavAhI Aru satarkakArIrUpei preraNa karo~| eteke yisakale ImAna Aniva Aru nijake saMzodhana kariva, teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru teOMloka cintatao naha’va|
Aru yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche, siha~taka zAstiYe sparza kariva, kAraNa siha~te avAdhyatA karichila|

koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokaka eiTo nakaOM ye, mora ocarata AllAhara dhana-bhANDAra Ache, Aru mai gAYevao nAjAno Aru tomAlokaka eiToo nakaOM ye, mai ejana phiristA, mora prati yi ahIrUpe preraNa karA haYa, mai keৱla seiTokei anusaraNa karo~’| koৱA, ‘andha Aru dRSTiৱAna vyakti ubhaYe samAna ha’va pArene? tomAloke cintA nakarA neki’?

Aru iYAra dvArA tumi seisakala lokaka satarka karA, yisakale bhaYa kare ye, siha~taka siha~tara pratipAlakara ocaralai enekuৱA aৱsthAta ekatrita karA ha’va ye, teOMra vAhire siha~tara vAve kono abhibhAৱka Aru kono cupArichakArI nAthAkiva| yAte siha~te tAkvaৱAra adhikArI haYa|

Aru yisakale nija pratipAlakaka puৱA-gadhUli teOMra santuSTi lAbhara vAve prArthanA kare teOMlokaka tumi A~tarAi nidivA| teOMlokara karmara javAvadihitAra dAYitva tomAra oparata nahaYa Aru tomAra kono karmara javAvadihitAra dAYitvao teOMlokara oparata nahaYa, yAra vAve tumi teOMlokaka A~tarAi divA, ene karile tumi yAlimasakalara antarbhukta ha’vA|

eidare Ami siha~tara kichumAnara dvArA Ana kichumAnaka parIkSA karicho~, yAte siha~te kaYa, ‘AmAra mAjara parA AllAhe iha~tara oparatei anugraha karilene’? (koৱAcona) AllAha kRtajJasakalara viSaYe savizeSa aৱgata nahaYane vAru?

Aru yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhara prati ImAna poSaNa kare, teOMloke yetiYA tomAra ocaralai Ahe tetiYA tumi teOMlokaka koৱA, ‘tomAlokara prati zAnti varSita haoka’, tomAlokara pratipAlake teOMra nijara oparata daYA dhAryya kari laiche| tomAlokara mAjara konovAi yadi ajJatAvazataH asatkarma kare, tAra pichata tAovA kare Aru nijake saMzodhana kare, tente nizcaYa teOM (AllAha) kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Aru enekaiYe Ami AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe varNanA karo~; yAte aparAdhIsakalara patha spaSTabhAৱe prakAza pAYa|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAhara vAhire yisakalaka AhvAna karA, siha~tara ivAdata karivalai moka niSedha karA haiche’| koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokara pravRttira anusaraNa nakaro~, karile mai vipathagAmI hama Aru satpathaprAptasakalara antarbhukta ha’va noৱArima’|

koৱA, ‘nizcaYa mai mora pratipAlakara taraphara parA spaSTa pramANara oparata pratiSThita; athaca tomAloke iYAka asvIkAra karichA| tomAloke yiTo tatAlike pAva vicarA seiTo mora ocarata nAi| kartRtva ekamAtra AllAharei, teOM satya varNanA kare Aru phaYacAlAkArI-sakalara mAjata teৱe~i zreSTha’|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke yiTo tatAlike pAva vicarA seiTo yadi mora ocarata thAkilahe~tena, tente mora Aru tomAlokara mAjata phaYacAlAi hai ga’lahe~tena, (jAni thoৱA) AllAha yAlimasakalara viSaYe adhika aৱgata’|

Aru teOMra ocaratei Ache gAYevara cAvi-kAThi, teOMra vAhire koneo seYA nAjAne| sthala Aru sAgarara andhakArasamUhata yi Ache seYA keৱla teৱe~i aৱgata, teOMra ajAnite gachara eTA pAto nasare| mATira andhakArata ene kono zasyakaNAo aMkurita nahaYa athavA rasayukta nAivA zukAna ene kono vastu nAi yiTo spaSTa kitAvata ullekha nAi|

teৱe~i rAtita tomAlokara mRtyu ghaTAYa Aru dinata tomAloke yi upArjana karA seYA teOM jAne| tAra pichata nirdhArita samaYa pUrNa karAra kAraNe dinata teOM tomAlokaka Akau jIৱita kare| tAra pichata teOMra pinei tomAlokara pratyAৱrtana ha’va| tAra pichata tomAloke yi karichilA sei viSaYe teOM tomAlokaka aৱhita kariva|

Aru teOM nija vAndAsakalara oparata pUrNa niYantraNAdhikArI Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara oparata hiphAyatakArIsakalaka preraNa kare| aৱzeSata tomAlokara kArovAra yetiYA mRtyukAla upasthita haYa tetiYA AmAra prerita dUtasakale (phiristAsakale) tAra mRtyu ghaTAYa Aru teOMloke (nijara kartavyata) kono truTi nakare|
tAra pichata siha~taka siha~tara prakRta pratipAlaka AllAhara phAle pratyAৱrtita karA ha’va| jAni thoৱA, hukuma (kartRtva) keৱla teOMrei Aru teOM ATAitakai druta hicApa grahaNakArI|

koৱA, ‘sthalabhAgara Aru sAgarara andhakArara parA kone tomAlokaka nAjAta diYe? yetiYA tomAloke anunaYa vinaYa kari Aru gopanabhAৱe teOMkei prArthanA karA ye, AmAka iYAra parA rakSA karile Ami nizcaYa kRtajJasakalara antarbhukta hama’|
koৱA, ‘AllAhei tomAlokaka tAra parA Aru sakalo dukha-kaSTara parA mukti diYe| iYAra pichato tomAloke zvirka karA’|

koৱA, ‘teOM tomAlokara oparara parA vA talara parA zAsti paThAvalai, nAivA tomAlokaka vibhinna (sandehapUrNa) dalata vibhakta karivalai athavA eTA dalaka Ana eTA dalara saMgharSara soৱAda grahaNa karAvalai pUrNa sakSama’| coৱA, Ami kenekai vibhinna dharaNe AYAtasamUha vivRta karo~ yAte siha~te bhAlakai vujiva pAre|
Aru tomAra sampradAYe iYAka michA vuli kaiche athaca eiTo satya| koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokara kAryanirvAhaka nahaYa’|
pratyeka saMvAdara vAve eTA nirdhArita samaYa Ache Aru anatipalame tomAloke jAnivalai pAvA|

Aru tumi yetiYA siha~taka dekhivalai pAvA, yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhakalai upahAsamUlaka AlocanAta magna haYa, tetiYA tumi siha~tara parA mUkha ghUrAi la’vA, yetiYAlaike siha~te Ana kono prasaMga Arambha nakariva; Aru yadi caYatAne tomAka pAharAi diYe tente smaraNa hoৱAra pichata yAlima sampradAYara lagata navahivA|
Aru siha~tara Amalara javAvadihira dAYitva muttAkvIsakalara oparata nahaYa| kintu upadeza diYATo teOMlokara kartavya, yAte siha~teo tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare|

Aru yisakale nijara dharmaka khela-dhemAlirUpe grahaNa kariche, lagate pArthiৱ jIৱne yisakalaka pratArita kariche tumi siha~taka parityAga karA| tumi ei koraAnara dvArA siha~taka upadeza diYA, yAte sei samaYata konovAi nija kRtakarmara vAve dhvaMsa nahaYa yetiYA AllAhara vAhire tAra kono abhibhAৱka Aru cupArichakArI nAthAkiva Aru vinimaYata sakalo vastu dileo seYA grahaNa karA naha’va| siha~tei nija kRtakarmara vAve dhvaMsa haiche; kuphurI karAra kAraNe siha~taka seৱna karoৱA ha’va ati uttapta pAnI tathA vihA ha’va kaSTadAYaka zAsti|

koৱA, ‘AllAhara vAhire Ami ene kArovAka AhvAna karima neki, yiYe AmAra kono upakAra athavA apakAra ekoৱei kariva noৱAre? Aru AllAhe AmAka hidAYata diYAra pichata Ami Akau sei vyaktira dare pUrvAৱsthAlai ubhati yAmane, yAka caYatAne pRthiৱIta enekai lambhiche ye si patha heruৱAi uৱAdiha nopoৱA haiche? tAra Ache kichumAna (ImAndAra) sahacaravRnda, teOMloke tAka hidAYatara prati AhvAna kari kaYa, ‘AhA AmAra phAle AhA’| koৱA, ‘AllAhara hidAYatei haiche saThika hidAYata Aru AmAka sRSTijagatara pratipAlakara ocarata AtmasamarpaNa karivalai Adeza diYA haiche’|
‘lagate (Adeza karA haiche) chAlAta pratiSThA karivalai Aru teOMra tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karivalai| teৱe~i haiche sei satvA, yAra ocaralai tomAlokaka ekatrita karA ha’va’|

teৱe~i yathAyathabhAৱe AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche| (sei diৱsaka smaraNa karA) yidinA teOM keৱla ka’va, ‘ha’, tetiYAi seYA hai yAva| teOMra kathAi satya| yidinA ziGAta phu~ diYA ha’va seidinAra kartRtva keৱla teOMrei| adRzya Aru prakAzya viSaYe teৱe~i parijJAta, Aru teOM prajJAmaYa, savizeSa aৱgata|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA ivrAhIme teOMra pitA Ajharaka kaichila, ‘Apuni mUrtivoraka ilAharUpe grahaNa kare neki? mai AponAka Aru AponAra sampradAYaka spaSTa bhraSTatAra mAjata dekhi Acho~’|
eidare Ami ivrAhImaka AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra rAjatva dekhuৱAicho~, yAte teOM dRDha় vizvAsIsakalara antarbhukta haYa|

tAra pichata rAtira andhakAre yetiYA teOMka Acchanna karile tetiYA teOM tarA eTA dekhi ka’le, ‘eiTo cAge mora pratipAlaka’| tAra pichata yetiYA seiTo astamita ha’la tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘astamita yoৱA vastuka mai bhAla nApAOM’|

tAra pichata yetiYA teOM candraka samujjalarUpe udaYa hoৱA dekhile tetiYA ka’le, ‘eiTo cAge mora pratipAlaka’| yetiYA seiToo astamita ga’la, tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘moka mora pratipAlake hidAYata nakarile mai nizcaYa pathabhraSTa sampradAYara antarbhukta hama’|
