tAra pichata yetiYA teOM sUryaka dIptimAnarUpe udaYa hoৱA dekhile tetiYA ka’le, ‘eiToৱe haiche mora pratipAlaka, eiTo ATAitakai DAGara’| yetiYA seiToo asta ga’la tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke yAka AllAhara lagata aMzI karA tAra lagata mora kono samparka nAi (tAra parA mai mukta)’|
mai ekaniSThabhAৱe teOMra phAle mukha karicho~ yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche Aru mai muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta nahaYa|

(ei zuni) teOMra sampradAYe teOMra lagata vitarkata lipta ha’la| teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke mora lagata AllAha samparke vitarkata lipta haichA? athaca teৱe~i moka hidAYata diche| tomAloke teOMra lagata yAka aMzIdAra sthApana kari AchA mai tAka (ketiYAo) bhaYa nakaro~ kintu mora pratipAlake yadi kivA kare (seYA sukIYA kathA)| mora pratipAlake jJAnara dvArA sakalo vastuke parivyApta kari Ache| tathApio tomAloke upadeza grahaNa nakarivAne’?

‘tomAloke yAka AllAhara lagata aMzI kari AchA mai tAka kiYa bhaYa karima? athaca tomAloke AllAhara lagata enekuৱA vastuka aMzI karivalai kono bhaYa nakarA, yAra sapakSe teOM tomAlokara ocarata kono pramANa aৱtIrNa karA nAi| eteke yadi tomAloke jAnA tente koৱAcona! dui dalara mAjata konaTo dala nirApattA lAbhara vechi hakadAra’|
yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru nijara ImAnaka yulumara (zvirkara) dvArA kaluSita karA nAi, nirApattA keৱla teOMlokara vAvei Aru teOMlokei haiche hidAYataprApta|

Aru eiToৱei haiche AmAra yukti-pramANa yiTo Ami ivrAhImaka dichilo~, tAra jAtira lagata mokAvilA karivalai, Ami yAka icchA karo~ ucca maryAdA dAna karo~| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

Aru Ami teOMka dAna karichilo~ ichahAkva Aru iYAkUva, eOMlokara pratyekake Ami satpathata paricAlita karichilo~; iYAra pUrve nuhako Ami hidAYata dichilo~ Aru teOMra vaMzadhara dAuda, chulAimAna, Aiuva, iuchupha, muchA Aru hArUnako; eidarei Ami muhachinasakalaka puraskRta karo~;
Aru yAkAriYyAha, iYAhaYA, IchA Aru ilaYAchako (Ami hidAYata dichilo~)| eOMlokara pratyekei satkarmaparAYaNa Achila;
lagate ichamAIla, Ala-YAchA, iunucha Aru lUtako (Ami hidAYata dichilo~); Aru teOMlokara pratyekake Ami sRSTijagatara oparata zreSThatva dAna karichilo~|
Aru (Ami hidAYata pradAna karichilo~) teOMlokara pitRpuruSa, vaMzadhara Aru bhAtRsakalara kichumAnaka; Aru Ami teOMlokaka manonIta karichilo~ Aru sarala pathata paricAlita karichilo~|

eiTo haiche AllAhara hidAYata, iYAra dvArA teOM nija vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yAka icchA kare hidAYata pradAna kare| kintu yadi teOMloke zvirka karilehe~tena tente teOMlokara sakalo Amala niSphala hai ga’lahe~tena|

eOMlokei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalaka Ami kitAva, kartRtva Aru navuoৱta dAna karichilo~, eteke yadi siha~te (kAphirasakale) iYAra lagata kuphurI kare, tente (jAni thoৱA) Ami iYAra dAYitvabhAra ene eTA sampradAYaka dicho~ yisakale iYAra lagata kuphurI nakariva|

eOMlokei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalaka AllAhe hidAYata kariche, eteke tumi teOMlokara pathara anusaraNa karA| koৱA, ‘iYAra vAve Ami tomAlokara ocarata kono pArizramika nivicAro~, eiTo keৱla sRSTijagatara vAve upadezamAtra’|

Aru siha~te AllAhaka teOMra yathArtha maryAdA pradAna karA nAi, yetiYA siha~te kaichila, ‘AllAhe kono mAnuhara prati eko aৱtIrNa karA nAi’| koৱA, ‘kone aৱtIrNa karichila seikhana kitAva yikhana muchAi Anichila, mAnuhara vAve Achila jyoti Aru hidAYatasvarUpa; yikhanaka tomAloke vibhinna pRSThAta lipivaddha kari kichu kathA prakAza karichA Aru vahutakhinike gopana karichA, Aru (sei granthara dvArA) tomAlokaka enekuৱA zikSA diYA haichila yiTo tomAloke Aru tomAlokara pitR-puruSasakale janA nAchilA| koৱA, (seikhanaka) ‘AllAhei (aৱtIrNa karichila)’, eteke siha~taka siha~tara avAntara samAlocanAra oparata eri diYA, siha~te kheli thAkaka|

Aru eikhana haiche varakatamaYa kitAva yikhanaka Ami aৱtIrNa karicho~, yikhana iYAra Agara sakalo granthara samarthaka Aru yikhanara dvArA tumi makkA Aru iYAra cAriophAle thakA mAnuhaka satarka karA| yisakale AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa kare teOMloke iYAra pratio ImAna poSaNa kare, lagate teOMloka chAlAtara pratio yatnaৱAna|

Aru sei vyaktitakai DAGara yAlima Aruno kona ha’va pAre? yiYe AllAha samparke michA raTanA kare, athavA kaYa, ‘mora ocaralai ahI Ahe’, athaca tAra ocaralai ekoৱei ahI karA nahaYa, Aru yiYe kaYa, ‘AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche maYo siTora dare aৱtIrNa kariva pAro~’; Aru yadi tumi dekhilAhe~tena, yetiYA yAlimasakala mRtyu yantraNAta thAkiva Aru phiristAsakale hAta vaDha়Ai ka’va, ‘tomAloke nijara prANa uliYAi AnA| Aji tomAlokaka lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti diYA ha’va, kAraNa tomAloke AllAhara oparata asatya kathA kaichilA Aru teOMra AYAtasamUhara prati ahaMkAra karichilA’|

nizcaYa (Aji) tomAloke AmAra ocaralai niHsaGga aৱsthAta AhichA, yidare Ami tomAlokaka prathamavAra sRSTi karichilo~, Aru Ami tomAlokaka yi pradAna karichilo~ seivora tomAloke nijara pichaphAle eri thai AhichA| tomAloke yisakalaka (AllAhara saite) aMzI vuli bhAৱichilA, sei cupArichakArI vilAko dekhona (Aji) tomAlokara lagata nAi| nizcaYa tomAlokara mAjara samparka Aji vicchinna haiche Aru tomAloke yiTo dhAraNA karichilA seiToo tomAlokara parA herAi gaiche|
nizcaYa AllAhei zasya-vIja Aru guTi Adika aMkurita kare, teৱe~i prANahInara parA jIৱntaka uliYAYa Aru jIৱntara parA prANahInaka uliYAYa| teৱe~i AllAha, eteke tomAloka ka’lai ubhati yAvA?
teৱe~i prabhAtara udbhAsaka, Aru teৱe~i rAtika prazAntira vAve lagate sUrya Aru candraka samaYara nirupaka vanAiche, eivora parAkramazAlI, mahAjJAnI AllAhara nirdhAraNa|

Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve tarAmaNDala sRSTi kariche yAte iYAra dvArA tomAloke sthalara Aru sAgarara andhakArata patha vicAri poৱA| nizcaYa Ami jJAnI sampradAYara vAve AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe vivRta karicho~|

Aru teৱe~i tomAlokaka ejana vyaktira parA sRSTi kariche, eteke (tomAlokara vAve) Ache sthAYI Aru asthAYI vAsasthAna| nizcaYa Ami anudhAৱnakArI sampradAYara vAve AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe varNanA karicho~|

teৱe~i AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa kare, tAra pichata iYAra dvArA Ami sakalo dharaNara udbhidara puli utpanna karo~, Aru utpanna karo~ seujIYA DAla-pAta, yAra parA Ami ghana sanniviSTa zasyadAnA utpAdana karo~, Aru khejura gachara mUrara parA uliYAOM olami thakA khejurara thoka, Aru utpAdana karo~ AGura, yAYatuna lagate DAlimara vAgichA| kichumAna Ache sadRzapUrNa Aru Ana kichumAna Ache amila| coৱA, sei phalavorara prati yetiYA seivora puraTha haYa Aru lakSya karA iYAra pakiva dharA aৱsthAra prati| nizcaYa mumina sampradAYara vAve Ache seivorara mAjata nidarzanAৱlI|

Aru siha~te jvinaka AllAhara saite zvarIka sAvyasta kare, athaca teৱe~i eivoraka sRSTi kariche; Aru siha~te ajJatAvazataH AllAhara prati putra-kanyA Aropa kare; teOM paৱitra mahimAnvita Aru siha~te yi kaYa teOM tAra parA vahu Urddhata|
teৱe~i AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sraSTA, teOMra santAna ha’va kenekai? athaca teOMra kono saGginIYei nAi! teৱe~i sakalo vastu sRSTi kariche Aru pratyeka vastu samparke teOM savizeSa aৱgata|
teৱe~i AllAha, tomAlokara pratipAlaka; teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| teৱe~i sakalo vastura sraSTA; eteke tomAloke keৱla teOMrei ivAdata karA; teৱe~i sakalo vastura tatvAৱdhAYaka|
dRSTisamUhe teOMka AYatva kariva noৱAre athaca teOM sakalo dRSTike AYatva kare Aru teOM sUkSmadarzI, samyaka aৱhita|

nizcaYa tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara ocaralai spaSTa pramANAdi cAva parA mAdhyama Ahi pariche| eteke yiYe seiTora dvArA pratyakSa kariva si nijei lAbhaৱAna ha’va, Aru yiYe andha sAjiva tAta si nijei kSatigrasta ha’va| gatike mai tomAlokara saMrakSaka nahaYa|
eidarei Ami nAnA dharaNe AYAtasamUha vivRta karo~| yAte siha~te kaYa ye, ‘tumi (pUrvaৱrtI granthara parA) ziki laichA’, lagate Ami iYAka suspaSTabhAৱe varNanA karo~ jJAnI sampradAYara vAve|
tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAra prati yi ahI haiche tumi keৱla seiToke anusaraNa karA, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi Aru muzvarikasakalara parA mukha ghUrAi loৱA|
AllAhe icchA karile siha~te zvirka nakarilehe~tena| lagate (jAni thoৱA) Ami tomAka siha~tara vAve saMrakSaka vanoৱA nAi Aru tumi siha~tara tatvAৱdhAYako nahaYa|

AllAhara vAhire siha~te yivoraka AhvAna kare seivoraka tomAloke gAli-zapani nApArivA| kiYano siha~te sImAlaMghana kari ajJAnatAvazataH AllAhako gAli diva pAre| eidare Ami pratyeka jAtira dRSTite siha~tara kAryakalApa zobhanIYa kari dicho~; tAra pichata siha~tara pratipAlakara ocaratei siha~tara pratyAৱrtana ha’va| iYAra pichata teOM siha~taka siha~tara kAryakalApa samparke janAi diva|

Aru siha~te AllAhara nAmata dRDha় zapata khAi kaYa, siha~tara ocarata yadi kono nidarzana Ahilahe~tena tente nizcaYa siha~te iYAra prati ImAna Anilehe~tena| koৱA, ‘nizcaYa nidarzanasamUha haiche AllAhara adhInastha’| (he ImAndArasakala!) kihe tomAlokaka upalavdhi karAva ye, yetiYA sei (nidarzana) Ahi pariva, tetiYAo siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva?

Aru siha~te yenekai prathamavArate iYAra prati ImAna poSaNa karA nAi, Thika tenekai Amio siha~tara antarasamUha Aru dRSTisamUha oloTAi dima Aru Ami siha~taka siha~tara avAdhyatAta udbhrAntara dare ghUrapAka khoৱA aৱsthAta eri dima|

Aru Ami siha~tara ocaralai phiristA preraNa karileo Aru mRtasakale siha~tara lagata kathA pAtileo tathA sakalo vastuka siha~tara sanmukhata samaveta karileo AllAhara icchA naha’le siha~te ketiYAo ImAna poSaNa nakariva; kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai haiche mUrkha|

Aru eidare Ami mAnaৱ Aru jvinara mAjara parA caYatAnasakalaka pratyeka navIra zatru vanAicho~, pratAraNAra uddezye siha~te ijane sijanaka camakaprada vAkyara dvArA kumantraNA diYe| tomAra pratipAlake icchA karile siha~te eivora nakarilehe~tena, gatike tumi siha~taka Aru siha~tara michA raTanAka parityAga karA|

Aru siha~te eikAraNe kumantraNA diYe ye, yisakale AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare siha~tara mana yAte sei camakaprada kathAra prati anurAgI haYa Aru yAte siha~te pachanda kare; Aru siha~te yi apakarma kare seiToৱei yena siha~te kari thAke|

(koৱA) ‘mai AllAhara vAhire Ana kArovAka phaYacAlAkArI hicApe anveSaNa karima neki? athaca teৱe~i tomAlokara prati vistArita kitAva aৱtIrNa kariche’! Aru Ami yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karicho~ siha~te jAne ye, nizcaYa eikhana tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA yathAyathabhAৱe nAyilakRta| gatike tumi sandeha poSaNakArI sakalara antarbhukta naha’vA|
satya Aru nyAYara phAlara parA tomAra pratipAlakara vANI paripUrNa| teOMra vAkyasamUha parivartana kariva parA kono nAi| teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
Aru yadi tumi pRthiৱIra adhikAMza lokara kathAmate calA, tente siha~te tomAka AllAhara pathara parA vicyuta kariva| siha~te keৱla dhAraNArahe anusaraNa kare, Aru keৱla anumAna bhittikahe kathA kaYa|
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka sei vyakti samparke adhika aৱgata yiYe teOMra pathara parA vipathagAmI haYa| lagate yisakala satpathata Ache teOMlokara viSaYeo teOM adhika aৱgata|
yadi tomAloke teOMra AYAtasamUhara prati vizvAsI hoৱA tente yiToka javeha karAra samaYata AllAhara nAma loৱA haiche seiTo bhakSaNa karA;

tomAlokara ki haiche, yiTora (jantura) oparata AllAhara nAma loৱA haiche tomAloke sei jantura (mAMsa) kiYa bhakSaNa nakarivA? tomAlokara vAve teOM yiTo hArAma kariche seYA teOM tomAlokara ocarata vizadabhAৱei varNanA kariche, kintu tomAloke nirupAYa ha’le seYA sukIYA kathA| nizcaYa vahute ajJatAvazataH nijara pravRttira dvArA Anaka vipathagAmI kare; nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka sImAlaMghanakArIsakalara viSaYe adhika aৱgata|
eteke tomAloke prakAzya Aru gopana ubhaYa prakAra pApa varjana karA, nizcaYa yisakale pApa arjana kare anatipalame siha~taka siha~tara pApa karmara pratiphala diYA ha’va|

Aru yiTora (jantura) oparata AllAhara nAma loৱA hoৱA nAi, tAra (mAMsara) parA tomAloke eko nAkhAvA; Aru nizcaYa seYA garhita| nizcaYa caYatAnasakale siha~tara vandhusakalaka tomAlokara saite vivAda karivalai prarocanA diYe; Aru yadi tomAloke siha~tara Anugatya karA, tente tomAlokeo muzvarika hai parivA|

yi vyakti mRta Achila (arthAt yAra astitva nAchila), yAka Ami pichata jIৱita karicho~ Aru tAra vAve nirdhAraNa karicho~ jyoti, yAra mAdhyamata teOM mAnuhara bhitarata calA-phurA kare, seijana vyakti sei vyaktira dare neki yijana enekuৱA andhakArata Ache ya’ra parA si ketiYAo olAva noৱAriva? eidarei kAphirasakalara kRtakarmaka zobhanIYa kari diYA haiche|
Aru eidare Ami pratiTo janapadara pradhAnaka aparAdhI hicApe eri dicho~, yAte siha~te tAta cakrAnta kare; kintu siha~te keৱla nijara viruddhehe cakrAnta kare, athaca siha~te upalavdhi nakare|

Aru yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai kono nidarzana Ahe tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘AllAhara rAchulasakalaka yi pradAna karA haichila seYA AmAka pradAna nakarAlaike Ami ketiYAo ImAna poSaNa nakaro~’| AllAhe teOMra richAlata ka’ta arpana kariva seiTo teৱe~i bhAlakai jAne| yisakale aparAdha kariche, siha~tara cakrAntara kAraNe AllAhara taraphara parA lAJchanA Aru kaThora zAsti anatipalame siha~tara oparata Apatita ha’va|

eteke AllAhe kArovAka satpathata paricAlita kariva vicArile teOM tAra vuku ichalAmara vAve prazasta kari diYe, Aru kArovAka vipathagAmI kariva vicArile teOM tAra vuku ati saMkIrNa kari diYe, (phalata sei vyaktira vAve ichalAmara anusaraNa) ene lAge yenivA si vahu kaSTare AkAzalai uThi Ache| eidarei AllAhe zAsti diYe siha~taka, yisakale ImAna poSaNa nakare|
Aru eiToৱei tomAra pratipAlakara nirdezita sarala patha| yisakale upadeza grahaNa kare Ami teOMlokara vAve nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAৱe varNanA karicho~|
teOMlokara vAve teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata Ache zAntira AvAsa Aru teOMloke yi Amala karichila, tAra vAve teৱe~i teOMlokara abhibhAৱka|

Aru yidinA teOM siha~ta sakaloke ekatrita kariva (Aru ka’va), ‘he jvina sampradAYa! tomAloke vahuto lokaka pathabhraSTa karichilA’, Aru mAnuhara mAjara parA siha~tara vandhusakale ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami ijane sijanara parA upakRta haichilo~ Aru tumi AmAra vAve yi samaYa nirdhAraNa karichilA etiYA Ami tAta upanIta haicho~’| AllAhe ka’va, ‘jAhAnnAmei haiche tomAlokara vAsasthAna, tomAloke tAta cirakAla thAkivA’, kintu AllAhe (ulioৱAra) icchA karile seYA sukIYA kathA| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
Aru eidarei Ami yAlimasakalara kichumAnaka Ana kichumAnara lagata vandhutva gaDha়Ai diOM, siha~te yi arjana karichila tAra kAraNe|

‘he jvina Aru mAnaৱ sampradAYa! tomAlokara mAjara parAi tomAlokara ocaralai rAchulasakala ahA nAchilane? yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUha tomAlokara ocarata viৱraNa dichila Aru tomAlokaka ei diৱsara sanmukhIna hoৱA samparke satarka karichila? siha~te ka’va, ‘Ami AmAra nijara viruddhei sAkSI dilo~’| prakRtate pArthiৱ jIৱnei siha~taka pratArita karichila, Aru siha~te nijara viruddhe ei sAkSIo diva ye, siha~ta kAphira Achila|
eiTo eikAraNe ye, adhivAsIsakala (dvIna samparke) udAsIna thakA aৱsthAta janapadasamUhara anyAYa AcaraNara kAraNe siha~taka dhvaMsa karATo tomAra pratipAlakara kAma nahaYa|
Aru siha~te yi Amala kare, sei anusAre pratyekare maryAdA Ache Aru siha~te yi kare sei samparke tomAra pratipAlaka amanoyogI nahaYa|

Aru tomAra pratipAlaka haiche abhAৱmukta tathA daYAzIla| teOM icchA karile tomAlokaka apasArita kariva pAre Aru tomAlokara pichata teOM nijara icchAmate velegaka tomAlokara sthalAbhiSikta kariva pAre, yidare teOM tomAlokaka Ana eTA sampradAYara vaMzara parA sRSTi kariche|
tomAlokara lagata yiTo pratizruti karA haiche seiTo nizcaYa Ahiva Aru tomAloke tAka vyartha kariva noৱArivA|

koৱA, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke tomAlokara aৱsthAnata thAki kAma karA, nizcaYa maYo mora kAma kari Acho~| tomAloke ati sonakAle jAniva pArivA, kAra pariNAma maGgalamaYa| nizcaYa yAlimasakala saphala nahaYa’|

AllAhe yi zasya Aru catuSpada jantu sRSTi kariche seivorara parA siha~te AllAhara vAve eTA aMza nirdiSTa kare Aru nijara dhAraNA anuyAYI kaYa, ‘eiTo AllAhara vAve Aru eiTo AmAra zvarIkasakalara vAve’| eteke yiTo siha~tara zvarIkasakalara aMza seYA AllAhara ocarata gai nApAYa kintu yiTo AllAhara aMza seYA siha~tara zvarIkasakalara ocarata pau~ci yAYa, siha~te yi phaYacAlA kare seYA kimAna ye nikRSTa!

Aru eidare vahuto muzvarikara dRSTita siha~tara zvarIkasakale siha~tara santAnasakalaka hatyA karA zobhanIYa kari diche, yAte siha~taka dhvaMsa kariva pAre Aru siha~tara dharma samparke siha~tara mAjata vibhrAnti sRSTi kariva pAre; Aru AllAhe icchA karile siha~te eivora nakarilehe~tena| gatike siha~taka siha~tara michA raTanA laiYe thAkiva diYA|

Aru siha~te siha~tara dhAraNA anuyAYI kaYa, ‘eivora catuSpada jantu Aru zasyakSetra niSiddha, Ami yAka icchA karo~ tAra vAhire koneo eivora khAva noৱAriva’, eidare kichusaMkhyaka catuSpada jantura piThita ArohaNa niSiddha karA haiche Aru kichusaMkhyaka jantuka javeha karAra samaYata siha~te AllAhara nAma nalaYa| eivora darAcalate siha~te AllAha samparke michA raTanAra uddezye kai phure; siha~tara ei michA raTanAra pratiphala teOM acirei siha~taka pradAna kariva|

siha~te Aru kaYa, ‘eivora catuSpada jantura peTata yi Ache seYA AmAra mAjara puruSasakalara vAve nirdiSTa Aru eiTo AmAra strIsakalara vAve avaidha, Aru seiTo yadi mRta haYa tente (nArI-puruSa) sakaloৱe iYAra aMzIdAra’| siha~tara eidare koৱAra pratiphala anatipalame teOM siha~taka pradAna kariva; nizcaYa teOM prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

nizcaYa siha~te kSatigrasta haiche yisakale nirvuddhitAra vAve Aru ajJatAvazataH nijara santAnasakalaka hatyA kariche Aru AllAhara oparata michA raTanA kari AllAhe pradAna karA jIৱikAka niSiddha gaNya kariche| nizcaYa siha~ta vipathagAmI haiche Aru siha~ta hidAYataprAptao nAchila|

Aru teৱe~i sRSTi kariche enekuৱA vAgichAsamUha yivorara kichumAna cAM nirbharazIla Aru Ana kichumAna cAM nirbharazIla nahaYa lagate khejura gacha Aru zasya, yAra soৱAda vibhinna dharaNara, yAYatuna Aru DAlima, eivorara kichumAna sadRza Aru kichumAna bhinna| yetiYA seivora pakiva tetiYA tAra parA khoৱA Aru phacala capoৱAra dinA seivorara haka pradAna karivA| apacaYa nakarivA, nizcaYa teOM apacaYakArIsakalaka pachanda nakare|

Aru (teৱe~i) catuSpada jantura mAjata kichumAnaka bhAra vahanakArI Aru kichumAnaka kSudrAkAra pazu hicApe sRSTi kariche| AllAhe tomAlokaka yi jIৱikA pradAna kariche tAra parA khoৱA Aru caYatAnara padAMka anusaraNa nakarivA; nizcaYa si tomAlokara prakAzya zatru|

(teৱe~i sRSTi kariche) matA-mAikI ATha yora, bherAra duTA Aru chAgalIra duTA; koৱA, ‘teOM matA duTAka niSiddha kariche ne mAikI dujanIka, ne mAikI dujanIra garbhata yi Ache seYA niSiddha kariche’? yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA tente pramANasaha moka aৱhita karA;

lagate uTara duTA Aru garura duTA| koৱA, ‘teOM matA duTAka niSiddha kariche ne mAikI dujanIka, ne mAikI dujanIra garbhata yi Ache seYA niSiddha kariche’? athavA AllAhe yetiYA tomAlokaka eivorara nirdeza dichila tetiYA tomAloka tAta upasthita AchilAne? gatike yi vyaktiYe jJAna nohoৱAkai mAnuhaka vibhrAnta karAra vAve AllAha samparke michA raTanA kare tAtakai DAGara yAlima Aruno kona ha’va pAre? nizcaYa AllAhe yAlima sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|

koৱA, ‘mora prati yi ahI haiche tAta, mAnuhe yi khAYa tAra mAjata mai ekoৱei hArAma poৱA nAi, kintu marA za, pravAhita teja Aru gAharira mAMsara vAhire| kiYano nizcitabhAৱe eivora haiche apaৱitra| athavA (javeha karAra samaYata) AllAhara vAhire Anara nAma loৱAra kAraNe yivora avaidha’| kintu yadi konovAi avAdhyatA nakari Aru sImAlaMghana nakari nirupAYa aৱsthAta seYA grahaNa karivalai vAdhya haYa (seYA velega kathA), tente nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru Ami iYAhudisakalara oparata nakhayukta sakalo jantukei hArAma karichilo~ Aru garu chAgalIra carvio siha~tara vAve hArAma karichilo~, kintu eivorara piThita thakA nAivA nADa়I-bhuruta thakA athavA asthisaMlagna carvira vAhire, siha~tara avAdhyatAra kAraNe siha~taka ei pratiphala dichilo~| nizcaYa Ami satyavAdI|
eteke siha~te yadi tomAra oparata mithyAropa kare, tente koৱA, ‘tomAlokara pratipAlaka sarvavyApI daYAra adhikArI Aru aparAdhI sampradAYara parA teOMra zAsti rada nahaYa’|

yisakale zvirka kariche atizIghre siha~te ka’va, ‘AllAhe yadi icchA karilehe~tena tente Ami Aru AmAra purvapuruSasakale zvirka nakarilo~he~tena Aru ekoৱei hArAma nakarilo~he~tena’| eidare siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo mithyAropa karichila, aৱzeSata siha~te AmAra zAsti bhoga karichila| koৱA, ‘tomAlokara ocarata kono jJAna Achene? thAkile AmAra ocarata prakAza karA| tomAloke keৱla dhAraNArahe anusaraNa karA Aru keৱla manesajA kathAhe koৱA’|
koৱA, ‘cUDa়Anta pramANa keৱla AllAharei, eteke teOM yadi icchA karilehe~tena, tente tomAloka ATAike nizcaYa hidAYata dilehe~tena’|

koৱA, ‘tomAlokara sAkSIsakalaka lai AhA, yisakale ei sAkSI diva ye, AllAhe eiTo hArAma kariche’| siha~te sAkSI dileo tumi siha~tara lagata sAkSI nidivA| tumi siha~tara pravRttira anusaraNa nakarivA, yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka mithyAropa kare Aru yisakale AkhirAtata vizvAsa sthApana nakare| siha~tei nija pratipAlakara samakakSa nirdhAraNa kare|

koৱA, ‘AhA, tomAlokara oparata tomAlokara pratipAlake yi hArAma kariche seYA tilAৱta kari zunAOM| seYA haiche ei ye, ‘tomAloke teOMra lagata kAko aMzIdAra sthApana nakarivA, pitR-mAtRra lagata sadvyaৱhAra karivA, daridratAra bhaYata tomAloke nijara santAnaka hatyA nakarivA, AmiYei tomAlokaka Aru siha~taka jIৱikA dAna karo~| prakAzya haoka athavA gopanei haoka, azlIla karmara ocaralaikeo nAyAvA| AllAhe hArAma karA kono naphachaka yathArtha kAraNavihIna tomAloke tAka hatyA nakarivA’| teOM tomAlokaka ei nirdeza diche yAte tomAloke vujiva pArA|

Aru etIma zizu prAptavaYaska nohoৱAlaike uttama vyaৱsthAra vAhire tomAloke tAra sampattira nikaTaৱrtI naha’vA Aru parimApa tathA ojana nyAYabhAৱe paripUrNarUpe pradAna karivA| Ami kono naphachaka tAra kSamatAtakai adhika bhAra arpaNa nakaro~| lagate yetiYA tomAloke kathA ka’vA tetiYA inacAphapUrNa kathA ka’vA, yadio seijana tomAra ghaniSTa AtmIYa nahaoka kiYa, Aru AllAhaka diYA pratizruti pUraNa karivA| eidare AllAhe tomAlokaka nirdeza pradAna kare yAte tomAloke upadeza grahaNa karA|

nizcaYa eiToৱei haiche mora sarala patha| eteke tomAloke iYAra anusaraNa karA Aru vibhinna pathara anusaraNa nakarivA, anyathA seivore tomAlokaka iYAra parA vicchinna kariva| eidare AllAhe tomAlokaka nirdeza pradAna kare, yAte tomAloke tAkvaৱAra adhikArI hoৱA|

eteke Ami muchAka pradAna karichilo~ kitAva, yiYe satkarma kariche tAra vAve paripUrNatAsvarUpa, pratiTo vastura vizada viৱraNa, hidAYata Aru rahamatasvarUpa—yAte siha~te siha~tara pratipAlakara sAkSAt samvandhe ImAna poSaNa kare|
Aru eikhana kitAva, yikhana Ami aৱtIrNa karicho~ – varakatamaYarUpe| seYe tomAloke iYAra anusaraNa karA Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, yAte tomAloke rahamataprApta hoৱA|
yAte tomAloke eiTo ka’va noৱArA ye, kitAva keৱla AmAra pUrve duTA sampradAYara pratihe aৱtIrNa haichila; Aru Ami siha~tara adhyaYana samparke gAphila Achilo~’,

athavA tomAloke yena eiTo ka’va noৱArA ye, ‘yadi AmAra prati kitAva aৱtIrNa ha’lahe~tena, tente Ami siha~tatakai vechi hidAYataprApta ha’lo~he~tena’| eteke nizcaYa tomAlokara ocaralai tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA spaSTa pramANa, hidAYata Aru rahamata Ahiche| iYAra pichato yiYe AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariva Aru tAra parA mukha ghUrAi lava, tAtakai DAGara yAlima Aruno kona ha’va pAre? yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhara parA mukha ghUrAi laYa, satya vimukhatAra vAve zIghrei Ami siha~taka nikRSTa zAsti pradAna karima|

siha~te keৱla eiTora pratIkSAta Ache neki ye, siha~tara ocaralai phiristA Ahiva, athavA tomAra pratipAlaka svaYaM aৱtaraNa kariva, nAivA tomAra pratipAlakara kono nidarzana Ahiva? (jAni thoৱA) yidinA tomAra pratipAlakara kono nidarzana Ahiva seidinA yiYe pUrve ImAna poSaNa karA nAchila tAra ImAna kono kAmata nAhiva, athavA yi vyaktiYe ImAnara mAdhyamata kalyANa lAbha karA nAchila (tAra ImAno kono kAmata nAhiva)| koৱA, ‘tomAloke pratIkSA karA, Amio pratIkSAta thAkilo~’|

nizcaYa yisakale nijara dvInaka vicchinna kariche Aru vibhinna dalata vibhakta haiche, siha~tara lagata tomAra kono samparka nAi; siha~tara viSaYaTo AllAhara adhInastha, tAra pichata teৱe~i siha~tara kRtakarma samparke siha~taka aৱgata karAva|
yiYe satkarma lai Ahiva teOM tAra dahaguNa (choৱAva) lAbha kariva, Aru yiYe asatkarma lai Ahiva tAka keৱla tAra samaparimANa pratidAnahe diYA ha’va Aru siha~tara prati kono anyAYa karA naha’va|
koৱA, ‘mora pratipAlake moka satpathata paricAlita kariche| eiToৱe supratiSThita dvIna, ivrAhImara millAta (Adarza), teOM ekaniSTha Achila, Aru teOM muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta nAchila’|
koৱA, ‘nizcaYa mora chAlAta, mora kuravAnI, mora jIৱna Aru mora maraNa, vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAhara vAvei’|
‘teOMra kono aMzIdAra nAi, Aru moka iYArei nirdeza diYA haiche, Aru muchalima (AtmasamarpaNakArI) sakalara mAjata maYei prathama’|

koৱA, ‘mai AllAhara vAhire Ana kono pratipAlaka anusandhAna karima neki? athaca teৱe~i sakalo vastura pratipAlaka’| pratyekei nija nija kRtakarmara vAve dAYI ha’va Aru konoৱei Anara vojA vahana nakariva| tAra pichata tomAlokara pratyAৱrtana tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocaratei ha’va, eteke yi viSaYe tomAloke matAnaikya karichilA, seYA teOM tomAlokaka aৱhita karAva|

teৱe~i tomAlokaka pRthiৱIta khaliphA (pratinidhi) niyukta kariche Aru teOM tomAlokaka yi pradAna kariche sei viSaYe parIkSAra uddezye tomAlokara kichumAnaka Ana kichumAnara oparata maryAdA pradAna kariche| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka druta zAsti pradAnakArI Aru nizcaYa teOM kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Alipha-lAma-mIma-cAda| [1]

eikhana kitAva tomAra prati aৱtIrNa karA haiche, yAte ei samparke tomAra manata kono saMkIrNatA nAthAke, lagate yAte tumi iYAra dvArA (mAnuhaka) satarka kariva pArA| muminasakalara vAve eikhana haiche upadeza|

tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara ocaralai yi aৱtIrNa karA haiche, tomAloke tAra anusaraNa karA Aru teOMra vAhire Ana kAko abhibhAৱkarUpe anusaraNa nakarivA| tomAloke khuva kamei upadeza grahaNa karA|
Aru enekuৱA vahuto janavasati Ami dhvaMsa karicho~| siha~tara oparata AmAra zAsti Apatita haichila ketiYAvA rAtita athavA dinadupurate, yetiYA siha~ta vizrAmarata aৱsthAta Achila|
eteke yetiYA AmAra zAsti siha~tara oparata Apatita haichila, tetiYA siha~tara kathA keৱla eiToৱe Achila ye, siha~te kaichila, ‘nizcaYa Ami yAlima Achilo~’|
eteke yisakalara ocaralai rAchula preraNa karA haichila nizcaYa Ami siha~taka sodha-poca karima Aru rAchula sakaloko prazna karima|
tAra pichata nizcaYa Ami siha~tara ocarata pUrNa jJAnara saite siha~tara karmasamUha vivRta karima, (jAni thoৱA) Ami anupasthita nAchilo~|
Aru sei dinA parimApa ha’va yathAyathabhAৱe| eteke yisakalara tulAcanI gadhura ha’va teOMlokei saphalatA arjana kariva|
AnahAte yisakalara tulAcanI pAtala ha’va, siha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakale nijei nijara kSati sAdhana kariche, yihetu siha~te AmAra AYAtasamUhara prati anyAYa karichila|
nizcaYa AmiYei tomAlokaka pRthiৱIta pratiSThita karicho~ Aru tAta tomAlokara vAve jIৱikAra vyaৱsthAo kari dicho~; (tathApio) tomAloke khuvei kama kRtajJatA jJApana karA|

nizcaYa AmiYei tomAlokaka sRSTi karicho~, tAra pichata AmiYei tomAlokaka AkRti pradAna karicho~, tAra pichata Ami phiristAsakalaka kaichilo~, ‘Adamaka chAjadA karA’| phalata ivalIchara vAhire sakaloৱe chAjadA karichila, si chAjadAkArIsakalara antarbhukta naha’la|

teOM ka’le, ‘mai yetiYA tomAka Adeza dilo~, tetiYA kihe tomAka vAdhA dile ye, tumi chAjadA nakarilA’? si ka’le, ‘mai eOMtakai (Adamatakai) zreSTha, tumi moka juYere sRSTi karichA Aru tAka sRSTi karichA vokA mATire’|
teOM ka’le, ‘tente tumi iYAra parA nAmi yoৱA, iYAta thAki tumi ahaMkAra karivA eiTo ketiYAo ha’va noৱAre| eteke tumi olAi yoৱA, nizcaYa tumi lAJchitavorara antarbhukta’|
si ka’le, ‘moka tumi sei diৱsalaike aৱkAza diYA, yidinA siha~ta punarutthita ha’va’|
teOM ka’le, ‘nizcaYa tumi aৱkAza prAptasakalara antarbhukta’|
si ka’le, ‘tumi moka yi kAraNe pathabhraSTa karichA, mai siha~tara vAve tomAra sarala pathata khApa pAti vahi thAkima’|

‘tAra pichata nizcaYa mai siha~tara ocaralai Ahima siha~tara sanmukhara parA Aru siha~tara pichaphAlara parA, siha~tara so~phAlara parA Aru siha~tara vAOMphAlara parA, Aru tumi siha~tara adhikAMzakei kRtajJarUpe nApAvA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘iYAra parA lAJchita apamAnita hai olAi yA, mAnuhara mAjata yiYe tora anusaraNa kariva, nizcaYa mai taha~ta ATAYere jAhAnnAma pUraNa karima’|
Aru he Adama! ‘tumi Aru tomAra strIYe jAnnAtata vasavAsa karA, Aru yi ThAira parA icchA AhAra karA kintu ei gachajopAra ocaralaike nAyAvA, anyathA tomAloka ubhaYe yAlimasakalara antarbhukta ha’vA’|

tAra pichata teOMlokara lajjAsthAna, yiToka teOMlokara ocarata gopana rakhA haichila seiToka teOMlokara ocarata prakAza karAra vAve caYatAne teOMlokaka kumantraNA dile Aru ka’le, ‘tomAlokara pratipAlake tomAlokaka ei gachajopAra parA eikAraNei niSedha kariche ye, (ei gachajopAra phala khAle) tomAloka ubhaYe phiristA hai yAvA athavA tomAloka sthAYIsakalara antarbhukta hai yAvA’|
Aru teOMloka ubhaYare ocarata si zapata khAi ka’le, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara zubhAkAMkSIsakalara ejana’|

phalata si teOMlokaka pravaJcanAra dvArA padaskhalita karile| iYAra pichata yetiYA teOMloke sei gachajopAra phala khAle, tetiYA teOMlokara lajjAsthAna teOMlokara ocarata dRzyamAna hai parila, Aru teOMloke jAnnAtara pAtere nijake AvRta karivalai dharile| tetiYA teOMlokara pratipAlake teOMlokaka mAti ka’le, ‘mai tomAlokaka ei gachajopAra parA niSedha karA nAchilo~ne? Aru mai tomAlokaka koৱA nAchilo~ne ye, nizcaYa caYatAna haiche tomAloka duYore prakAzya zatru?
teOMloke ka’le, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami nijare prati anyAYa karicho~, Aru yadi tumi AmAka kSamA kari nidiYA Aru AmAra prati daYA nakarA, tente nizcaYa Ami kSatigrastasakalara antarbhukta ha'ma’|
teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke nAmi yoৱA, tomAloke ijane sijanara zatru Aru pRthiৱIta Ache tomAlokara vAve kSaNasthAYI vasavAsa Aru jIৱikA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke tAtei jIৱna-yApana karivA Aru tAtei tomAloka mRtyuvaraNa karivA, Aru tAra parAi tomAlokaka uliYAi AnA ha’va’|

he Adama santAna! nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve pochAka aৱtIrNa karicho~, tomAlokara lajjAsthAna AvRta karAra vAve Aru saundaryara vAve| kintu tAkvaৱAra pochAkei haiche sarvottama| eiTo AllAhara nidarzanasamUhara anyatama, yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kare|

he Adama santAna! caYatAne yena tomAlokaka kono matei praluvdha kariva noৱAre—yidare si tomAlokara pitR-mAtRka (praluvdha kari) jAnnAtara parA uliYAichila, si teOMlokaka teOMlokara lajjAsthAna dekhuৱAra vAve vivastra karichila| nizcaYa si nije Aru tAra dale tomAlokaka dekhA pAYa kintu tomAloke siha~taka dekhiva noৱArA| nizcaYa Ami caYatAnaka seisakala lokara abhibhAৱka kari dicho~ yisakale ImAna poSaNa nakare|

Aru yetiYA siha~te kono azlIla AcaraNa kare tetiYA kaYa, ‘Ami AmAra pUrvapuruSasakalaka eidarei karA pAicho~, Aru AllAheo AmAka eiToৱei karAra nirdeza diche’| koৱA, ‘AllAhe ketiYAo azlIlatAra nirdeza nidiYe| tomAloke AllAhara viSaYe ene kathA koৱA neki yiTo tomAloke nAjAnA’?

koৱA, ‘mora pratipAlake nyAYa vicArara nirdeza diche’| Aru tomAloke pratyeka chAjadAra samaYata vA ivAdatata tomAlokara lakSya keৱla AllAhakei nirdhAraNa karA Aru teOMrei Anugatyata vizuddhacitta hai ekaniSThabhAৱe teOMra ocaratei prArthanA karA| teOM tomAlokaka yenekai prathamavAra sRSTi kariche tomAloke seidarei ubhati AhivA|

eTA dalaka teOM hidAYata diche, Aru saGgata kAraNatei Ana eTA dalara oparata pathabhraSTatA sAvyasta haiche| nizcaYa siha~te AllAhaka eri caYatAnaka siha~tara abhibhAৱka-rUpe grahaNa karichila Aru dhAraNA karichila ye siha~tei hidAYataprApta|
he Adama santAna! pratyeka chAlAtara samaYata tomAloke sundara pochAka paridhAna karA| pAnAhAra karA kintu apacaYa nakarivA| nizcaYa teOM apacaYakArIsakalaka pachanda nakare|

koৱA, ‘AllAhe teOMra vAndAsakalara vAve yivora zobhA-saundaryara vastu Aru vizuddha jIৱikA sRSTi kariche seivoraka kone niSiddha kariche’? koৱA, ‘pArthiৱ jIৱnata Aru vizeSakai kviYAmatara dinA eivora haiche teOMlokara vAve, yisakale ImAna Aniche’| eidare Ami jJAnI sampradAYara vAve AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe vivRta karo~|

koৱA, ‘nizcaYa mora pratipAlake prakAzya Aru gopana ubhaYa prakAra azlIlatAka hArAma kariche, Aru (hArAma kariche) pApa Aru anyAYabhAৱe sImAlaMghana Aru kono vastuka AllAhara aMzIdAra sthApana karAka—yAra kono dalIla- pramANa AllAhe aৱtIrNa karA nAi; Aru AllAha samparke ene kono kathA koৱAToo (hArAma) yiTo tomAloke nAjAnA’|
Aru pratyeka jAtira vAve eTA nirdiSTa samaYa Ache| eteke yetiYA siha~tara nirdiSTa samaYa Ahi pariva tetiYA siha~te eka pala samaYa palamo kariva noৱAriva Aru eTA muhUrta AguৱAio Aniva noৱAriva|

he Adama santAna! yetiYA tomAlokara ocaralai tomAlokara mAjara parAi rAchulasakala Ahi AmAra AYAtasamUha tomAlokara ocarata vivRta kariva, tetiYA yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariva Aru nijake saMzodhana kariva, teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAthAkiva Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va|
Aru yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche Aru ei viSaYata ahaMkAra kariche, siha~tei agnivAsI, tAta siha~ta cirakAla thAkiva|

eteke yi vyaktiYe AllAha samparke michA racanA kare athavA teOMra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kare seijanatakai DAGara yAlima Aru kona ha’va pAre? siha~tara bhAgyata likhita aMza siha~te pAvai| aৱzeSata yetiYA AmAra phiristAsakala siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara prANa haraNa karAra vAve Ahiva, tetiYA teOMloke sudhiva, ‘AllAhara vAhire yisakalaka tomAloke AhvAna karichilA siha~ta etiYA ka’ta’? siha~te ka’va, ‘siha~ta AmAra parA udhAo haiche’, Aru siha~te nijei nijara vipakSe sAkSI diva ye, nizcaYa siha~ta kAphira Achila|

AllAhe ka’va, ‘tomAlokara pUrve yisakala jvina Aru mAnaৱdala pAra haiche siha~tara saite tomAlokeo juita praৱeza karA’| yetiYAi kono dala tAta praৱeza kariva tetiYAi Ana dalaka siha~te abhisampAta kariva| aৱzeSata yetiYA siha~ta sakaloৱe tAta ekatrita ha’va, tetiYA siha~tara paravartIsakale pUrvaৱrtIsakalara viSaYe ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! iha~tei AmAka vibhrAnta karichila; gatike iha~taka tumi dviguNa juira zAsti diYA’| AllAhe ka’va, ‘pratyekare vAve Ache dviguNa zAsti kintu tomAloke nAjAnA’|
Aru siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakale paravartIsakalaka ka’va, AmAra oparata tomAlokara kono zreSThatva nAi, gatike tomAloke yi arjana karichilA tAra vAve etiYA zAsti bhoga karA’|

nizcaYa yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche Aru ei viSaYata ahaMkAra kariche, siha~tara vAve AkAzara duৱAra kholA naha’va Aru siha~te jAnnAtato praৱeza kariva noৱAriva yetiYAlaike uTa vejIra jalAre nosomAva| eidarei Ami aparAdhIsakalaka pratiphala diOM|
siha~tara zayyA ha’va jAhAnnAma Aru siha~tara oparato thAkiva juira AৱraNa; Aru eidarei Ami yAlimasakalaka pratidAna diOM|
Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, Ami kAro oparata tAra kSamatAra atirikta vojA arpana nakaro~- teOMlokei jAnnAtavAsI, tAta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va|

Aru Ami teOMlokara antarara parA IrSA dUra karima, teOMlokara talata nadIsamUha pravAhita ha’va| teOMloke ka’va, ‘yAৱtIYa prazaMsA AllAhara vAve yijane AmAka ei pathara hidAYata kariche| AllAhe AmAka hidAYata nakarile, Ami ketiYAo hidAYata nApAlo~he~tena| nizcaYa AmAra pratipAlakara rAchulasakale satya lai Ahichila’| teOMlokaka samvodhana kari koৱA ha’va, ‘tomAloke yi karichilA tAra vAvei tomAlokaka ei jAnnAtara uttarAdhikArI karA haiche’|

Aru jAnnAtIsakale jAhAnnAmIsakalaka samvodhana kari ka’va, ‘AmAra pratipAlake AmAra lagata yi pratizruti karichila seYA Ami sa~cAkaiYe pAicho~| kintu tomAlokara pratipAlake tomAlokaka yi pratizruti dichila seYA tomAloke sa~cAkaiYe pAichAne? siha~te ka’va, ‘haYa’| tAra pichata ejana ghoSaNAkArIYe siha~tara mAjata ghoSaNA kari ka’va, ‘yAlimasakalara oparata AllAhara lAnata--
‘yisakale AllAhara pathata (mAnuhaka) vAdhA pradAna karichila Aru sei pathata vakratA anusandhAna kari phurichila; Aru siha~ta Achila AkhirAtaka asvIkArakArI’|

Aru siha~ta ubhaYare mAjata thAkiva pardA, lagate A’rAphara mAjata thAkiva kichumAna loka, yisakale pratyekake tAra lakSaNara dvArA cini pAva| teOMloke jAnnAtIsakalaka samvodhana kari ka’va, ‘chAlAma varSita haoka AponAlokara oparata’| teOMloka tetiYAlaike jAnnAtata praৱeza karA nAi kintu praৱezara AkAMkSAta Ache|
Aru yetiYA teOMlokara dRSTi jAhAnnAmIsakalara phAle ghUrAi diYA ha’va, tetiYA teOMloke ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka ketiYAo yAlima sampradAYara saGgI nakarivA’|
Aru A’rAphara adhivAsIsakale enekuৱA kichumAna lokaka mAtiva, yisakalaka teOMloke siha~tara lakSaNara dvArA cini pAva| teOMloke ka’va, ‘tomAlokara dala Aru tomAlokara ahaMkAra kono kAmata nAhila’|

coৱAcona! eOMlokei seisakala lokane? yisakalara viSaYe tomAloke zapata khAi kaichilA ye, ‘AllAhe teOMlokaka rahamata nakariva’; (eOMlokakei koৱA ha’va) ‘tomAloke jAnnAtata praৱeza karA, tomAlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru tomAloke cintitao naha’vA’|

jAhAnnAmIsakale jAnnAtIsakalaka samvodhana kari ka’va, ‘AmAra oparata akaNamAna pAnI DhAli diYA, nAivA AllAhe tomAlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna kariche tAra parA alapa diYA’| teOMloke ka’va, ‘nizcaYa AllAhe kAphirasakalara vAve ei duTA hArAma kariche’|

yisakale nijara dharmaka khela-dhemAlirUpe grahaNa karichila, Aru pArthiৱ jIৱne yisakalaka pratArita karichila| eteke Aji Ami siha~taka (jAhAnnAmata) eri dima, yenekai siha~te siha~tara ei diৱsara sAkSAtara vAve Amala karA eri dichila, Aru (yenekai) siha~te AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichila|
nizcaYa Ami siha~tara ocaralai enekuৱA ekhana kitAva Anicho~, yikhanaka Ami jJAnara dvArA vizadabhAৱe vyAkhyA karicho~, Aru seikhana haiche mumina sampradAYara vAve hidAYata Aru rahamatasvarUpa|

siha~te keৱla sei pariNAmara (saMvAda-satyatA vA kiYAmatara) apekSAta Ache neki? yidinAkhana sei pariNAma prakAza pAva, seidinA yisakale Agate iYAra kathA pAhari gaichila, siha~te ka’va, ‘AmAra pratipAlakara rAchulasakale satya vANI lai Ahichila, AmAra vAve ene kono cupArichakArI Ache neki yiYe AmAra vAve cupAricha kariva athavA AmAka Akau ubhati yoৱAra aৱkAza diYA ha’vane—yAte Ami Agate yi karicho~ tAtakai velega kivA kariva pAro~’? nizcaYa siha~te nijei nijara kSati sAdhana kariche Aru siha~te yi michA racanA karichila, seYA siha~tara parA vilupta hai gaiche|

nizcaYa tomAlokara pratipAlaka haiche AllAha, yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIka chaYa dinata sRSTi kariche, tAra pichata teOM Arazvara oparata uThiche| teৱe~i dinaka rAtire Acchanna kare| seivorara eTAi AnaToka drutagatita anusaraNa kare| (lagate teৱe~i sRSTi kariche) sUrya, candra Aru nakSatrasamUhaka, yivora teOMra Adezarei anugata| jAni thoৱA, sRjana Aru Adeza keৱla teOMrei| vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAha mahA varakatamaYa!
tomAloke vinItabhAৱe Aru gopane nija pratipAlakaka AhvAna karA; nizcaYa teOM sImAlaMghanakArIsakalaka pachanda nakare|
Aru pRthiৱIta zAnti sthApanara pichata tomAloke tAta viparyaYa sRSTi nakarivA; Aru AllAhaka bhaYa Aru AzAra saite prArthanA karA| nizcaYa AllAhara anugraha satkarmazIlasakalara ati nikaTaৱrtI|

Aru teৱe~i sei sattvA, yijane teOMra rahamatara (varaSuNara) Agata vatAhaka susaMvAdarUpe pravAhita kare, aৱzeSata yetiYA sei vatAhe gadhura megha vahana kari lai Ahe, tetiYA Ami seiToka mRta janapada (mRta bhU-khaNDa)ra phAle prerita karo~, tAra pichata Ami tAra parAi pAnI varSaNa karo~, Aru tAra dvArAi Ami vibhinna dharaNara phalamUla utpAdana karo~| eidarei Ami mRtasakalaka jIৱita karo~, yAte tomAloke upadeza grahaNa kariva pArA|

Aru utkRSTa bhUmi- iYAra phacala tAra pratipAlakara Adezata utpanna haYa| AnahAte yiTo nikRSTa, tAta kaThora parizrama nakarAlaike ekoৱe najanme| eidare Ami kRtajJa sampradAYara vAve nidarzanasamUha vibhinnabhAৱe viৱraNa karo~|

nizcaYa Ami nUhaka teOMra sampradAYara ocaralai preraNa karichilo~| tAra pichata teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke ekamAtra AllAhara ivAdata karA, teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono (satya) ilAha nAi| nizcaYa mai tomAlokara oparata mahAdiৱsara zAstira AzaMkA kari Acho~’|
teOMra sampradAYara pradhAnasakale kaichila, ‘Ami tomAka spaSTa bhraSTatAra mAjata nipatita dekhi Acho~’|
teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! mora mAjata kono bhraSTatA nAi, varaM mai haicho~ vizvajagatara pratipAlakara taraphara parA (prerita) ejana rAchulahe’|

‘mai mora pratipAlakara richAlata (yiTo pradAna kari moka preraNa karA haiche seYA) tomAlokaka pau~cAi Acho~, lagate mai tomAlokara kalyANa kAmanA karo~, Aru tomAloke yivora nAjAnA seYA mai AllAhara parA jAno’|

tomAloke Azcaryavodha kari AchA neki ye, tomAlokarei ejanara mAdhyamata tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara ocaralai upadeza Ahiche, yAte teOM tomAlokaka satarka kariva pAre Aru tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariva pArA Aru yAte tomAloke rahamataprApta hoৱA?

tathApio siha~te teOMka asvIkAra karichila| phalata teOMka Aru teOMra saite yisakale nAৱ~ta ArohaNa karichila Ami teOMlokaka uddhAra karichilo~ Aru yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka michA pratipanna karichila siha~taka Ami DuvAi mArichilo~| nizcaYa siha~ta Achila eTA andha sampradAYa|

Aru ‘Ada jAtira ocaralai siha~tara bhAi hUdaka preraNa karichilo~| teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke ekamAtra AllAhara ivAdata karA, teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| (tathApio) tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne’?
teOMra sampradAYara kAphira netRvRndai kaichila, ‘AmAra dRSTita tumi haichA ejana nirvodha mAnuha Aru Ami tomAka michalIYAsakalara antarbhukta vuli gaNya karo~’|
teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! mora mAjata kono nirvuddhitA nAi, varaM mai haicho~ vizvajagatara pratipAlakara taraphara parA (prerita) ejana rAchula’|
‘mai mora pratipAlakara richAlata (yiTo pradAna kari moka preraNa karA haiche seYA) tomAlokara ocaralai pau~cAi Acho~, lagate mai haicho~ tomAlokara ejana vizvasta hitAkAMkSI|

‘tomAloke vismita haichA neki ye, tomAlokara ocaralai tomAlokarei ejanara mAdhyamata tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokaka satarka karAra vAve upadeza Ahiche? Aru smaraNa karA ye, AllAhe tomAlokaka nUhara sampradAYara (dhvaMsara) pichata (tomAlokara Agara lokasakalara) sthalAbhiSikta kariche Aru sRSTita (daihika gaThanata) tomAlokaka vechi parimANe hRSTapuSTa- valiSTha kariche| gatike tomAloke AllAhara anugrahasamUha smaraNa karA, yAte tomAloke saphala ha’va pArA’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi AmAra ocaralai ei uddezyata AhichA neki ye, Ami yAte keৱla eka AllAhara ivAdata karo~ Aru AmAra pitRpuruSasakale yivorara ivAdata karichila seivoraka eri diOM? gatike yadi tumi satyavAdI hoৱA tente sei (zAsti)To lai AhA yiTora parA tumi AmAka bhaYa dekhuৱAi AchA’|

teOM ka’le, ‘tomAlokara pratipAlakara zAsti Aru krodha tomAlokara oparata nirdhArita haiYe Ache; kintu tomAloke mora lagata vitarkata lipta ha’va vicarA neki enekuৱA kichumAna nAmakalai yivora nAma tomAloke Aru tomAlokara pitRpuruSasakale rAkhichA, yi viSaYe AllAhe kono dalIla-pramANa aৱtIrNa karA nAi? gatike tomAloke apekSA karA, maYo tomAlokara lagata apekSA kari Acho~|
tAra pichata Ami teOMka Aru teOMra saGgIsakalaka AmAra anugrahata uddhAra karichilo~; Aru AmAra AYAtasamUhaka yisakale asvIkAra karichila Aru yisakale mumina nAchila siha~taka nirmUla karichilo~|

Aru chAmUda jAtira ocaralai siha~tara bhAtR chalehaka preraNa karichilo~| teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke keৱla AllAhara ivAdata karA| teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| nizcaYa tomAlokara ocaralai tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA spaSTa nidarzana Ahi pariche| eijanI AllAhara uTa, tomAlokara vAve eTA nidarzana| eteke tomAloke iYAka AllAhara pRthiৱIta cari phuri khAvalai diYA Aru tAika kono dharaNara kaSTa nidivA, anyathA yantraNAdAYaka zAstiYe tomAlokaka Aguri dhariva’|

‘Aru smaraNa karA, Ada jAtira (dhvaMsara) pichata teৱe~i tomAlokaka (tomAlokara Agara lokasakalara ThAita) sthalAbhiSikta kariche, Aru teৱe~i tomAlokaka pRthiৱIta enekai pratiSThita kariche ye, tomAloke samatala bhUmita prAsAda nirmANa kariva pArA Aru pAhAra kATi vAsagRha taiYAra kariva pArA| gatike tomAloke AllAhara anugraha smaraNa karA Aru pRthiৱIta viparyaYa sRSTi kari nuphurivA’|

teOMra sampradAYara ahaMkArI netAsakale sei sampradAYara yisakale ImAna Anichila- yisakalaka durvala vuli bhaৱA haichila teOMlokaka ka’le, ‘tomAloke jAnAne ye, chaleha teOMra pratipAlakara taraphara parA prerita? teOMloke (uttarata) ka’le, ‘nizcaYa teOM yi lai prerita haiche, Ami tAra oparata vizvAsI’|
ahaMkArIsakale ka’le, ‘nizcaYa tomAloke yivora vizvAsa karichA Ami seivora avizvAsa karo~’|

tAra pichata siha~te sei uTajanIka hatyA karile Aru AllAhara Adeza amAnya karile Aru ka’le, ‘he chaleha! yadi tumi (sa~cAi) rAchulasakalara antarbhukta tente tumi AmAka yiTora bhaYa dekhuৱAichA seYA lai AhA’|
tAra pichata bhUmikampai siha~taka karAYatva karile, phalata siha~te nija nija gharate uvuri khAi pari (mari) thAkila|

iYAra pichata teOM siha~tara parA mukha ghUrAi lai ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! mai mora pratipAlakara richAlata (yiTo pradAna kari moka preraNa karA haiche seYA) tomAlokara ocaralai pau~cAi dichilo~ Aru tomAlokara kalyANa kAmanA karichilo~, kintu tomAlokehe kalyAnakAmIsakalaka pachanda nakarA’|
Aru (AmiYei) lUtaka preraNa karichilo~| teOM nija sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘tomAloke enekuৱA jaghanya azlIla kAma kari AchAne? yiTo tomAlokara pUrve sRSTijagatara koneo karA nAi’|
‘nizcaYa tomAloke yauna kAmanA-tRptira vAve nArIsakalara parivarte puruSasakalara ocaralai yoৱA, varaM tomAloka haichA sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa’|
uttarata teOMra sampradAYe keৱla ei vuli ka’le, ‘eOMlokaka tomAlokara janapadara parA uliYAi diYA, nizcaYa eOMloka haiche enekuৱA loka, yisakale ati paৱitra ha’va vicAre’|
tAra pichata Ami teOMka Aru teOMra pariYAlaka uddhAra karichilo~ keৱla teOMra strIra vAhire, tAi Achila pichata aৱsthAnakArIsakalara antarbhukta|
Aru Ami siha~tara oparata pravala dhArASAra varaSuNa varSAichilo~| eteke coৱA, aparAdhIsakalara pariNAma kenekuৱA Achila|

Aru mAdaiYAnavAsIsakalara ocaralai siha~tara bhAtR zvuAivaka (preraNa karichilo~)| teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke keৱla AllAhara ivAdata karA| teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono (satya) ilAha nAi| nizcaYa tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara ocaralai spaSTa pramANa Ahi pAiche| gatike tomAloke jokha-mApata ojana paripUrNarUpe pradAna karivA, mAnuhaka siha~tara prApya vastu kama nidivA, lagate pRthiৱIta zAnti sthApanara pichata viparyaYa sRSTi nakarivA, eiToৱei tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara, yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA’|

‘lagate yisakale AllAhara prati ImAna Aniche teOMlokaka bhaYa dekhuৱAvalai Aru AllAhara pathata teOMlokaka vAdhA pradAna karivalai tathA tAta vakratA (doSa-truTi) anusandhAna karivalai tomAloke pratiTo pathata vahi nAthAkivA| smaraNa karA, tomAloke yetiYA saMkhyAta kama AchilA, tetiYA teৱe~i tomAlokara saMkhyA vRddhi karichila| lagate lakSya kari coৱAcona, viparyaYa sRSTikArIsakalara pariNAma kenekuৱA Achila’|

mai yi lai prerita haicho~ tAta yadi tomAlokara kono eTA dale ImAna poSaNa kare Aru AnaTo dale ImAna poSaNa nakare, tente AllAhe AmAra mAjata phaYacAlA nakarAlaike dhairyya dhAraNa karA, Aru teৱe~i zreSTha phaYacAlAkArI|

teOMra sampradAYara ahaMkArI netAsakale ka’le, ‘he zvuAiva! nizcaYa Ami tomAka Aru tomAra lagata yisakale ImAna Aniche siha~taka AmAra janapadara parA uliYAi dima nAivA tomAloke AmAra dharmalai dharmAntarita ha’vai lAgiva’| teOM ka’le, ‘yadio Ami seiToka ghRNA karo~ tathApio (vAdhya karAvAne)’?

‘tomAlokara dharmAdarzara parA AllAhe AmAka uddhAra karAra pichata, yadi Ami tAta Akau ubhati yAOM tente Ami AllAhara oparata michA kathA Aropa karA ha’va| AmAra pratipAlaka AllAhe icchA nakarile tAta ubhati yoৱA AmAra vAve samIcIna nahaYa| AmAra pratipAlake jJAnara dvArA sakalo vastuke parivyapta kari Ache, Ami AllAhara oparatei nirbhara karo~| he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra Aru AmAra sampradAYara mAjata nyAYabhAৱe phaYacAlA kari diYA Aru tumiYei zreSTha phaYacAlAkArI’|
Aru teOMra sampradAYara kAphira netAsakale ka’le, ‘tomAloke yadi zvuAivaka anusaraNa karA tente nizcaYa tomAloke kSatigrasta ha’vA’|
tAra pichata bhUmikampai siha~taka AkrAnta karile, phalata siha~te nija nija gharate uvuri khAi pari (mari) thAkila|
zvuAivaka yisakale michalIYA vuli kaichila, ene lAgila yenivA siha~te tAta vasavAsei karA nAchila| zvuAivaka yisakale michalIYA vuli kaichila siha~tei kSatigrasta haichila|

tAra pichata teOM siha~tara parA mukha ghUrAi la’le Aru ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! mora pratipAlakara richAlata (prApta vANI) mai tomAlokara ocaralai pau~cAi dicho~ Aru tomAlokara kalyANa kAmanA karicho~| eteke mai kAphira sampradAYara vAve kenekai AkSepa karima’!
Aru Ami yi ThAitei navI preraNa karicho~ sei ThAira adhivAsIsakalaka artha-saMkaTa Aru dukha-kaSTara dvArA AkrAnta karicho~, yAte siha~te kAkUti-minati kare|

tAra pichata Ami (siha~tara) veYA aৱsthAka bhAla aৱsthAre parivartana kari diOM| aৱzeSata siha~te prAcuryara adhikArI haYa Aru kaYa, ‘AmAra pUrvapuruSasakaleo sukha-dukha bhoga kariche’| tAra pichata Ami haThAt siha~taka enekai dhari pelAOM ye, siha~te upalavdhio kariva noৱAre|

Aru yadi seivora janapadara adhivAsIsakale ImAna Anilehe~tena Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karilehe~tena tente nizcaYa Ami siha~tara vAve AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra varakatasamUha unmukta kari dilo~he~tena, kintu siha~te michA pratipanna karichila; seYe Ami siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve siha~taka karAYatva karicho~|
janapadara adhivAsIvilAke rAtira bhAgata siha~tara ocaralai AmAra zAsti nAhiva vuli nirApada haiche neki, yetiYA siha~ta Topanita thAkiva?
ne janapadara adhivAsIvilAke dinara bhagata AmAra zAsti nAhiva vuli nizcinta haiche, yetiYA siha~te khela-dhemAlita magna thAkiva?
siha~te AllAhara kauzalara parAo nirApada haichene? prakRtate kSatigrasta sampradAYara vAhire koneo AllAhara kauzalara parA (nijake) nirApada vuli nAbhAৱe|

kono dezara janagaNara (dhvaMsara) pichata yisakale sei dezara uttarAdhikArI haYa siha~tara ocarata eiTo pratIYamAna hoৱA nAine ye, Ami icchA karile siha~tara pApakarmara phalata siha~taka zAsti diva pAro~? Aru Ami siha~tara hRdaYata mohara mAri dima, phalata siha~te eko zunA nApAva|

seivora janapadara kichu viৱraNa Ami tomAra ocarata varNanA kari Acho~, siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara rAchulasakale spaSTa pramANasaha Ahichila; kintu pUrve siha~te yiToka michA vuli agrAhya karichila seiToka dunAi vizvAsa karivalai siha~te mAnti nahaYa| eidarei AllAhe kAphirasakalara antarata mohara mAri diYe|
Aru Ami siha~tara adhikAMzakei pratizruti rakSAkArI poৱA nAi, varaM Ami siha~tara adhikAMzakei phAchikva pAicho~|

siha~tara pichata Ami muchAka AmAra nidarzanasaha phiraAuna Aru tAra pariSadavargara ocaralai preraNa karichilo~; kintu siha~te seivorara lagata atyAcAra karichila| eteke viparyaYa sRSTikArIsakalara ki pariNAma haichila seYA lakSya kari coৱA|
muchAi ka’le, ‘he phiraAuna! nizcaYa mai haicho~ vizvajagatara pratipAlakara taraphara parA prerita ejana rAchula’|

‘eiTo sthira nizcita ye, mai AllAha samvandhe satyara vAhire eko nakaOM| tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA spaSTa nidarzana lai mai tomAlokara ocaralai Ahicho~, seYe vanI icharAIlaka tumi mora lagata yAvalai diYA’|
si (phiraAune) ka’le, ‘yadi tumi kono nidarzana lai AhichA, tente seYA upasthApana karA, yadihe tumi satyavAdI’|
tetiYA muchAi nijara hAtara lAkhuTiDAla nikSepa karile Aru lage lage seYA eDAla ajagara sApata pariNata ha’la|
Aru teOM nijara hAta vAhiralai uliYAi Anile Aru lage lage seYA darzakara dRSTita zubhra ujjvala dekhA ga’la|
phiraAuna sampradAYara netAsakale ka’le, ‘nizcaYa eOM ejana sudakSa yAdukara’,
‘eOM tomAlokaka nija dezara parA vahiSkAra kariva vicAre, etiYA tomAloke ki parAmarza diYA’?
siha~te ka’le, ‘teOMka Aru teOMra bhAtRka alapa aৱkAza diYaka, Aru cahare-nagare saMgrAhakasakalaka paThAi diYaka’,
‘yAte siha~te AponAra ocaralai pratijana sudakSa yAdukaraka upasthita kare’|
yAdukarasakale phiraAunara ocarata Ahi ka’le, ‘Ami yadi vijaYI haOM tente AmAra vAve puraskAra thAkiva ne nAi’?
si ka’le, ‘haYa, nizcaYa tomAloka mora ghaniSTasakalara antarbhukta ha’vA’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘he muchA! tumi (Agate) nikSepa karivA ne Ami (Agate) nikSepa karima’?
teOM (muchAi) ka’le, ‘tomAlokei (Agate) nikSepa karA’| yetiYA siha~te nikSepa karile, tetiYA siha~te mAnuhara cakuta yAdu karile, siha~taka AtaMkita karile Aru eTA DAGara yAdu pradarzana karile|

Aru Ami muchAra prati ahI karilo~ ye, ‘tumio tomAra lAkhuTiDAla nikSepa karA’| lage lage sei lAkhuTiDAle (ajagara sApata pariNata hai) siha~te yi alIka vastu vanAichila seivoraka gili pelAvalai dharile;
phalata satya pratiSThita ha’la Aru siha~te yi karichila seYA vAtila vuli pratipanna ha’la|
eteke siha~te tAta parAjita ha’la Aru lAJchita hai ubhati ga’la,
Aru yAdukaravilAka chAjadAৱnata ha’la|
teOMloke ka’le, ‘Ami ImAna Anilo~ vizvajagatara pratipAlakara prati’|
‘muchA Aru hArunara pratipAlakara prati’|

phiraAune ka’le, ‘ki! mai tomAlokaka anumati diYAra Agatei tomAloke iYAra oparata ImAna AnilA? nizcaYa eiTo eTA cakrAnta; tomAloke nagaravAsIsakalaka iYAra parA uliYAi diYAra vAve ei cakrAnta karichA| eteke tomAloke atizIghre iYAra pariNAma jAniva pArivA’|
‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara hAta-bhari viparIta phAlara parA kATi TukurA-Tukura kari dima; tAra pichata nizcaYa mai tomAloka ATAike zUlata dima’|
teOMloke ka’le, ‘nizcaYa Ami AmAra pratipAlakara ocaralaikehe ubhati yAma;

‘Aru tumi AmAka zAsti divalai olAichA keৱla eikAraNe ye, Ami AmAra pratipAlakara nidarzanara oparata ImAna Anicho~ yetiYA seYA AmAra ocaralai Ahi pAiche| he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka paripUrNarUpe dhairyya dAna karA, lagate muchalimarUpe AmAka mRtyu dAna karA’|

Aru phiraAuna sampradAYara netAsakale ka’le, ‘Apuni muchAka Aru teOMra sampradAYaka pRthiৱIta viparyaYa sRSTi karivalai Aru AponAka lagate AponAra upAsyasamUhaka varjana karivalai eri diva neki? si ka’le, ‘zIghrei Ami siha~tara putrasakalaka hatyA karima Aru siha~tara nArIsakalaka jIৱita rAkhima| nizcaYa Ami siha~tara oparata zaktidhara’|

muchAi teOMra sampradAYaka ka’le, ‘AllAhara ocarata sahAYa prArthanA karA Aru dhairyya dhAraNa karA; nizcaYa pRthiৱI AllAharei| teৱe~i nija vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yAka icchA kare iYAra uttarAdhikArI vanAYa| Aru zubha pariNAma keৱla muttAkvIsakalara vAvei’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi AmAra ocaralai ahAra Agateo Ami niryAtita haicho~ Aru tumi ahAra pichato’| teOM ka’le, ‘ati sonakAle tomAlokara pratipAlake tomAlokara zatruka dhvaMsa kariva Aru teOM tomAlokaka pRthiৱIta sthalAbhiSikta kariva, tAra pichata tomAloke ki karA seYA teOM lakSya kariva’|
Aru nizcaYa Ami phiraAunara anusArIsakalaka durbhikSa Aru phacalara kSatira dvArA AkrAnta karichilo~, yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kare|

eteke yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai kono kalyANa Ahichila, tetiYA siha~te kaichila, ‘eiTo AmAra prApya’| AnahAte yetiYA kono akalyANe sparza karichila tetiYA siha~te muchA Aru teOMra saGgIsakalaka amaGgala vuli gaNya karichila| sAৱdhAna! siha~tara akalyANa keৱla AllAhara niYantraNAdhIna, kintu siha~tara vahutei seYA nAjAne|
Aru siha~te kaichila, ‘AmAka yAdu karivalai tumi yikono nidarzanei AmAra ocaralai lai nAhA kiYa, Ami tomAra oparata ketiYAo vizvAsa sthApana nakaro~’|

tAra pichata Ami siha~tara oparata vistArita nidarzana hicApe plAৱna, kAkati phariM, okaNi, bhekulI Aru teja preraNa karichilo~| iYAra pichato siha~te ahaMkAra karichila; Aru siha~ta Achila eTA aparAdhI sampradAYa|

Aru yetiYAi siha~tara oparata zAsti Ahichila tetiYAi siha~te kaichila, ‘he muchA! tumi tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata AmAra vAve prArthanA karA tomAra lagata teOM yi aGgIkAra kariche sei anuyAYI; yadi tumi AmAra parA zAsti dUra kari diva pArA tente Ami nizcaYa tomAra oparata ImAna Anima Aru nizcaYa vanI icharAIlaka tomAra lagata yAvalai dima’|
eteke yetiYAi Ami siha~tara parA eTA nirdiSTa samaYara vAve zAsti dUra kari dichilo~ yiTo siha~tara vAve nirdhArita Achila, tetiYAi siha~te siha~tara aGgIkAra bhaMga karichila|
seYe Ami siha~tara parA pratizodha laichilo~ Aru siha~taka atala sAgarata DuvAi dichilo~| kAraNa siha~te AmAra nidarzanaka asvIkAra karichila Aru ei samvandhe siha~ta Achila amanoyogI|

Aru yi sampradAYaka durvala vuli gaNya karA haichila teOMlokaka Ami AmAra kalyANaprApta rAjyara pUৱ Aru pazcimara uttarAdhikArI karichilo~; Aru vanI icharAIla samparke tomAra pratipAlakara zubha vANI satyata pariNata haichila, yihetu teOMloke dhairyya dharichila; lagate phiraAuna Aru tAra sampradAYara zilpa Aru yivora prAsAda siha~te nirmANa karichila seYA dhvaMsa karichilo~|

Aru vanI icharAIlaka AmiYei sAgara pAra karAi dichilo~, tAra pichata siha~te mUrtipUjAta Asakta eTA jAtira ocarata upasthita haichila| siha~te kaichila, ‘he muchA! eOMlokara upAsyara dare AmAra vAveo ejana upAsya sthira kari diYaka’| teOM ka’le, ‘nizcaYa tomAloka eTA mUrkha sampradAYa’|
‘nizcaYa eisakala loka ya’ta lipta hai Ache seivora haiche dhvaMsazIla Aru siha~te yi kari Ache seivoro amUlaka’|
teOM Aru ka’le, ‘mai AllAhara vAhire tomAlokara vAve Ana konovA ilAha (upAsya) sandhAna karima neki athaca teৱe~i tomAlokaka vizvajagatara oparata zreSThatva pradAna kariche’?

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami tomAlokaka phiraAunara anusArIsakalara hAtara parA uddhAra karichilo~, yisakale tomAlokaka nikRSTa zAsti pradAna karichila| siha~te tomAlokara putra santAnasakalaka hatyA karichila Aru nArIsakalaka jIৱita rAkhichila; iYAta Achila tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA eTA mahA parIkSA|

Aru muchAka Ami triza rAtira pratizruti dichilo~ lagate daha yoga kari seYA pUrNa karichilo~| eidare teOMra pratipAlakara nirdhArita samaYa calliza rAtita pUrNa haichila| muchAi teOMra bhAtR hArunaka kaichila, ‘mora anupasthitita mora sampradAYara mAjata tumi mora pratinidhitva karivA, saMzodhana karivA Aru viparyaYa sRSTikArIsakalara patha anusaraNa nakarivA’|

Aru muchA yetiYA AmAra nirdhArita samaYata Ahi upasthita ha’la Aru teOMra pratipAlake teOMra lagata kathA pAtile, tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi moka darzana diYA, mai tomAka dekhima’| teOM ka’le, ‘tumi moka dekhiva noৱArivA| tumi varaM pAhArara phAlei coৱAcona, seikhana yadi nijara ThAite sthira thAke teneha’le tumi moka dekhiva pArivA’| yetiYA teOMra pratipAlake pAhArata jyoti prakAza karile tetiYA i pAhAraka cUrNa-vicUrNa karile Aru muchA saMjJAhIna hai parila| yetiYA teOM jJAna ubhati pAle tetiYA ka’le, ‘mahimAmaYa tumi, mai anutapta hai tomAra ocarata tAovA karicho~ Aru muminasakalara mAjata maYei prathama’|

teOM ka’le, ‘he muchA! mai tomAka mora richAlata Aru vAkyAlApara dvArA mAnuhara oparata nirvAcita karicho~; seYe mai tomAka yi pradAna karilo~ seYA grahaNa karA Aru kRtajJatA jJApanakArIsakalara antarbhukta hoৱA’|

Aru Ami tAra vAve phalakasamUhata sarva viSaYe upadeza Aru sakalo viSaYara spaSTa vyAkhyA likhi dicho~; gatike seYA dRDha়bhAৱe dhAraNa karA Aru tomAra sampradAYaka iYAra mAjara yi uttama seYA grahaNa karivalai nirdeza diYA| mai anatipalame phAchikvasakalara vAsasthAna tomAlokaka dekhuৱAma|

pRthiৱIta yisakale anyAYabhAৱe ahaMkAra kari phure siha~taka mai mora nidarzanasamUhara parA nizcaYa A~tarata rAkhima| darAcalate siha~te pratiTo nidarzana dekhileo ImAna poSaNa nakariva Aru siha~te satpatha dekhileo seiToka patha vuli grahaNa nakariva, kintu siha~te bhula patha dekhile seiToka patha vuli grahaNa kariva| eiTo eikAraNe ye, siha~te AmAra nidarzanasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche Aru sei samparke siha~ta Achila amanoyogI|
Aru yisakale AmAra nidarzanasamUhaka Aru AkhirAtara sAkSAtaka asvIkAra kariche siha~tara kRtakarma viphala haiche| siha~te yi kare sei anupAtei siha~taka pratiphala diYA ha’va|

Aru (smaraNa karA) muchAra sampradAYe teOMra anupasthitita nijara alaMkArere eTA dAmurI sAjichila, eTA deha (ra dare pratimA) yiTo (garura dare) ‘hAmvA’ zavda olAichila| siha~te coৱA nAi neki ye, eiToৱe siha~tara lagata kathA ka’va noৱAre Aru siha~taka kono pathara sandhAno diva noৱAre? (tathApio) siha~te iYAkei upAsyarUpe grahaNa karichila Aru siha~ta Achila yAlima|

Aru siha~te yetiYA anutapta ha’la Aru dekhile ye, siha~te vipathagAmI hai gaiche, tetiYA siha~te ka’le, ‘AmAra pratipAlake yadi AmAra prati daYA nakare Aru AmAka kSamA kari nidiYe tente nizcaYa Ami kSatigrastasakalara antarbhukta hai yAma’|

Aru muchAi yetiYA kruddha Aru vikSuvdha hai nija sampradAYara ocaralai ubhati Ahila, tetiYA ka’le, ‘mora anupasthitita tomAloke mora kimAna nikRSTa pratinidhitva karichA! tomAlokara pratipAlakara Adezara Agatei tomAloke kiYa kharakhedA karilA’? ei vuli teOM phalakasamUha daliYAi pelAle Aru teOMra bhAtRka culita dhari nijara pine TAni Aniva dharile| hArune ka’le, ‘he mora sahodara! mAnuhe moka durvala vuli bhAvichila Aru moka prAYa hatyA karAra upakrama haichila| seYe tumi mora lagata ene AcaraNa nakarivA, yi AcaraNa karile zatrusakale Anandita haYa| lagate moka yAlimasakalara antarbhukta vuli nAbhAvivA’|
muchAi ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka Aru mora bhAtRka kSamA kari diYA Aru AmAka tomAra rahamatara mAjata praৱeza karoৱA; Aru tumiYei sarvazreSTha daYAlu’|

(AllAhe ka’le) nizcaYa yisakale dAmurIToka (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karichila, zIghrei pArthiৱ jIৱnata siha~tara pratipAlakara krodha Aru lAJchanA siha~tara oparata Apatita ha’va| eidarei Ami michA raTanAkArIsakalaka pratiphala di thAko~|
AnahAte yisakale asatkarma kariche, kintu tAra pichata (yadi) siha~te tAovA kariche Aru ImAna Aniche, tente nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka iYAra pichato parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru yetiYA muchAra khaM prazamita ha’la, tetiYA teOM phalakasamUha tuli la’le| yisakale nija pratipAlakaka bhaYa kare siha~tara vAve sei phalakasamUhata yi likhA Achila seYA Achila hidAYata Aru rahamata|

Aru muchAi teOMra sampradAYara parA sattarajana lokaka AmAra nirdhArita sthAnata ekatrita hoৱAra vAve manonIta karile| tAra pichata siha~te yetiYA bhUmikampara dvArA AkrAnta ha’la, tetiYA muchAi ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi icchA karile Agatei iha~taka Aru moko dhvaMsa kariva pArilAhe~tena, AmAra mAjara nirvodhasakale yi kariche tArakAraNe tumi AmAka dhvaMsa karivAne? eiTo haiche keৱla tomAra parIkSA, yiTora dvArA tumi yAka icchA karA vipathagAmI karA Aru yAka icchA karA tumi satpathata paricAlita karA| tumiYei AmAra abhibhAৱka; seYe tumi AmAka kSamA karA Aru AmAra prati daYA karA| kSamAzIlasakalara bhitarata tumiYei zreSTha’|

‘lagate tumi AmAra vAve ei pRthiৱIta kalyANa likhi diYA Aru AkhirAtato| nizcaYa Ami tomAra ocaralai ubhati Ahicho~’| AllAhe ka’le, ‘mora zAsti mai yAka icchA karo~ tAkei diOM Aru mora daYA- seYAto pratyeka vastukei Aৱri Ache| gatike mai seiTo likhi dima keৱla siha~tara vAve yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare, yAkAta pradAna kare Aru AmAra AYAtasamUhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kare’|

yisakale anusaraNa kare rAchulara, nirakSara navIra, yAra ullekha siha~te siha~tara ocarata thakA tAorAta Aru iJjIlata lipivaddha pAYa, yijane siha~taka satkarmara Adeza diYe, asatkarmara parA niSedha kare, siha~tara vAve paৱitra vastuvora hAlAla kare Aru apaৱitra vastuvora hArAma kare| yiYe siha~taka siha~tara oparata thakA vojAra parA Aru zRMkhalara parA mukta kare| eteke yisakale teOMra prati ImAna poSaNa kare, teOMka sanmAna kare, teOMka sahAYa kare Aru yi nUra teOMra prati aৱtIrNa haiche seiTora anusaraNa kare, teOMlokei haiche sAphalyamaNDita|

koৱA, ‘he mAnaৱ! nizcaYa mai tomAloka sakalore prati AllAhara (prerita) rAchula, yijana AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sArvabhaumatvara adhikArI| teOMra vAhire Ana kono (satya) ilAha nAi; teৱe~i jIৱna dAna kare Aru teৱe~i mRtyu ghaTAYa| seYe tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karA AllAhara prati Aru teOMra rAchula nirakSara navIra prati, yijane AllAha Aru teOMra vANIsamUhara oparata ImAna poSaNa kare; Aru tomAloke teOMra anusaraNa karA yAte tomAloke hidAYataprApta hoৱA’|
Aru muchAra sampradAYara bhitarata enekuৱA eTA dalo Ache yisakale Anaka nyAYabhAৱe patha dekhuৱAYa Aru sei anuyAYI (vicArata) inacApha kare|

Aru siha~taka Ami vAraTA gotrata vibhakta karichilo~| muchAra sampradAYe yetiYA teOMra ocarata pAnI vicArile, tetiYA Ami teOMra prati ahI preraNa karilo~, ‘tomAra lAkhuTiDAlere zilata AghAta karA’; phalata tAra parA vAraTA jharNAra utpatti ha’la| pratyeka gotrai nijara nijara pAnI khoৱA sthAna nirNaYa kari la’le| Ami meghara dvArA siha~tara oparata chA~ kari dichilo~ Aru siha~tara oparata Ami mAnnA Aru chAlaৱA aৱtIrNa karichilo~| (kaichilo~) ‘tomAlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ tAra parA paৱitra vastuvora khoৱA’| siha~te AmAra prati kono anyAYa karA nAchila, varaM siha~te nijei nijara kSati sAdhana karichila|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haichila, ‘tomAloke ei janapadata vAsa karA Aru ya’ra parA icchA khoৱA lagate koৱA, ‘hittAtuna’ (kSamA vicAro~) Aru natazire duৱArere praৱeza karivA; Ami tomAlokara aparAdhasamUha kSamA karima| nizcaYa Ami satkarmazIlasakalaka adhika dAna karima’|

tathApio siha~tara mAjara yisakala yAlima Achila siha~taka yi koৱA haichila, tAra parivarte siha~te anya kathA ka’le| seYe Ami AkAzara parA siha~tara prati zAsti paThAlo~, kAraNa siha~te anyAYa karichila|

Aru siha~taka sAgarara saikatata vAsa karA janavasatira viSaYe sodhAcona, yetiYA siha~te zanivAre sImAlaMghana karichila, yetiYA zanivAra pAlanara dinA mAchavora pAnIta bhAhi bhAhi siha~tara ocaralai Ahichila| kintu yidinA siha~te zanivAra pAlana karA nAchila seidinA sei mAchavora siha~tara ocaralai ahA nAchila| eidare Ami siha~taka parIkSA karichilo~, kAraNa siha~te phAchekvI karichila|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA siha~tara dala eTAi kaichila, ‘AllAhe yisakalaka dhvaMsa kariva athavA kaThora zAsti diva, tomAloke siha~taka kiYa sadupadeza diYA? siha~te kaichila, ‘tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocarata dAYitva-muktira vAve Aru yAte siha~te tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare seikAraNe’|

tAra pichata yi upadeza siha~taka diYA haichila, siha~te yetiYA seYA pAhari ga’la, tetiYA yisakale asatkarmara parA niSedha karichila teOMlokaka Ami uddhAra karichilo~, Aru yisakale anyAYa karichila siha~taka Ami kaThora zAsti vihichilo~, kAraNa siha~te phAchekvI karichila|
iYAra pichato yetiYA siha~te niSiddha kAmata sImA cerAi ga'la tetiYA Ami siha~taka ka’lo~, ‘tomAloke nikRSTa vAndara hai yoৱA’!

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAra pratipAlake ghoSaNA karichila ye, nizcaYa teOM kviYAmata paryanta siha~tara oparata enekuৱA kichumAna lokaka (kSamatA pradAna kari) paThAva, yisakale siha~taka kaThina zAsti di thAkiva| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka zAsti dAnata tatpara Aru nizcaYa teOM kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru Ami siha~taka pRthiৱIta vibhinna dalata vibhakta karicho~, siha~tara kichumAna haiche satkarmaparAYaNa Aru kichumAna anya dharaNara| Ami siha~taka maGgala Aru amaGgalara dvArA parIkSA karicho~, yAte siha~te pratyAৱrtana kare|

siha~tara pichata ene kichumAna ayogya loka eTAra pichata eTAkai siha~tara sthalAbhiSiktarUpe kitAvara uttarAdhikArI haiche, yisakale pRthiৱIra ei tuccha asAra sAmagrI saJcaYata lipta thAke, Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘AmAka kSamA kari diYA ha’va’| kintu eivorara anurUpa sAmagrI siha~tara ocaralai Ahile seYAo siha~te grahaNa kariva; kitAvara aGgIkAra siha~tara parA loৱA hoৱA nAchilane ye, siha~te AllAha samparke satyara vAhire Ana eko naka’va? athaca siha~te tAta yi Ache seYA adhyaYano kare| kintu yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare siha~tara vAve AkhirAtara AvAsei haiche uttama; tomAloke eYA anudhAৱna nakarAne?
yisakale kitAvaka dRDha়bhAৱe dhAraNa kare Aru chAlAta kAYema kare; nizcaYa Ami satkarmaparAYaNasakalara zramaphala vinaSTa nakaro~|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami parvataka siha~tara oparata tuli dharichilo~, Aru seYA Achila yenivA meghara eTA khaNDa| siha~te bhAvichila ye, seYA siha~tara oparata pari yAva| (Ami ka’lo~) ‘Ami yi pradAna karicho~ seYA dRDha়bhAৱe dhAraNa karA Aru tAta yi Ache seYA smaraNa karA, yAte tomAloke tAkvaৱAra adhikArI ha’va pArA’|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAra pratipAlake Adama santAnara piThira parA tAra vaMzadharaka uliYAichila Aru siha~tara nijara viSaYe svIkArokti grahaNa karichila Aru kaichila, ‘mai tomAlokara pratipAlaka nahaYane? siha~te kaichila, ‘haYa nizcaYa, Ami sAkSI thAkilo~’| ei svIkArokti eikAraNe loৱA ha'la ye, yAte tomAloke kviYAmatara dinA ka’va noৱArA ye, Ami ei viSaYe janAi nAchilo~|

athavA tomAloke yAte eiTo ka’va noৱArA ye, AmAra pitRpuruSasakaleo AmAra Agata zvirka karichila, Aru Ami Achilo~ teOMlokara paravartI vaMzadhara; eteke (zvirkara mAdhyamata) yisakale nijara Amalaka vAtila kariche siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve tumi AmAka dhvaMsa karivAne?
Aru eidarei Ami AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe varNanA karo~ yAte siha~te ubhati Ahe|

Aru siha~taka sei vyaktira saMvAda pATha kari zunoৱA, yAka Ami nidarzanasamUha pradAna karichilo~, tAra pichata si tAra parA vicchinna hai gaichila, Aru caYatAne tAra picha laichila| phalata si vipathagAmIsakalara antarbhukta hai gaichila|

Aru Ami icchA karile iYAra dvArA tAka ucca maryAdA dAna karilo~he~tena, kintu si duniYAra pratihe AkRSTa haiche Aru nija pravRttira anusaraNa kariche| eteke tAra upamA haiche kukurara dare, tAra oparata vojA jApi dile si jibhA uliYAi he~pAi thAke Aru vojA nidileo si jibhA uliYAi he~pAi thAke| yi sampradAYe AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche siha~tara aৱsthAo eiToৱei| eteke tumi vRttAnta varNanA karA yAte siha~te cintA kare|
sei sampradAYara upamA kimAna ye nikRSTa! yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche, Aru siha~te nijara pratihe anyAYa karichila|
AllAhe yAka hidAYata diYe seijanahe hidAYataprApta, Aru teOM yisakalaka vipathagAmI kare siha~tei haiche kSatigrasta|

nizcaYa Ami vahuto jvina Aru mAnaৱka jAhAnnAmara vAve sRSTi karicho~, siha~tara hRdaYa Ache kintu tAra dvArA siha~te upalavdhi nakare, siha~tara caku Ache kintu tAra dvArA siha~te nedekhe Aru siha~tara kANa Ache kintu tAra dvArA siha~te nuzune, siha~ta catuSpada jantura dare, varaM tAtokai adhika vibhrAnta| siha~tei haiche udAsIna|

Aru AllAhara vAve Ache sundara sundara nAma| eteke tomAloke teOMka seivora nAmerei AhvAna karA; Aru yisakale teOMra nAmasamUhaka vikRta kare siha~taka varjana karA; siha~tara kRtakarmara phala anatipalame siha~taka diYA ha’va|
Aru yisakalaka Ami sRSTi karicho~ siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA eTA dala Ache yisakale nyAYabhAৱe patha dekhuৱAYa Aru sei anuyAYI (vicAra mImAMsAta) inacApho kare|
Aru yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche, anatipalame Ami siha~taka enekai lAhe lAhe dhvaMsara pine lai yAma ye, siha~te gamei nApAva|
Aru mai siha~taka aৱkAza dima| nizcaYa mora kauzala atyanta valiSTha|
siha~te ketiYAo cintA nakare neki ye, siha~tara sahacarajana kAhAnio unmAda nahaYa? teOM haiche keৱla ejana spaSTa satarkakArI|

siha~te AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra sArvabhauma kartRtva samparke lagate AllAhe yi sRSTi kariche sei viSaYe cintA-carcA karA nAine, Aru ei viSaYeo ye, sambhaৱtaH siha~tara nirdhArita samaYa ati nikaTaৱrtI haiche; gatike iYAra pichata siha~te Aru kona kathAta ImAna Aniva?
AllAhe yAka vipathagAmI kare tAra kono pathapradarzaka nAi; Aru teOM siha~taka siha~tara avAdhyatAta lakSyahInara dare ghUri phurivalai eri diYe|

siha~te tomAka kviYAmata samparke prazna kari kaYa, ‘seYA ketiYA saMghaTita ha’va’? koৱA, ‘ei viSaYara jJAna keৱla mora pratipAlakara ocaratahe Ache| keৱla teৱe~i yathAsamaYata seiTora prakAza ghaTAva| AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta seiTo ha’va eTA bhaYaMkara ghaTanA| AkasmikabhAৱe seYA tomAlokara oparata Ahi pariva’| siha~te tomAka prazna kariche yenivA tumi ei viSaYe savizeSa aৱhita| koৱA, ‘ei viSaYara jJAna keৱla AllAhara ocaratahe Ache, kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei (ei satyaTo) nAjAne’|

koৱA, ‘AllAhe yi icchA kare tAra vAhire mora nijara lAbha-lokacAnara oparato mora kono adhikAra nAi| gAYeva vA adRzyara jJAna yadi mora thAkilahe~tena tente mai vahuto kalyANa lAbha karilo~he~tena Aru kono dharaNara akalyANei moka sparza kariva noৱArilehe~tena| mai keৱla ImAndAra sampradAYara vAve satarkakArI Aru susaMvAdadAtAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’|

teৱe~i tomAlokaka ejana vyaktira parA sRSTi kariche Aru tAra parA teOMra strIka sRSTi kariche, yAte teOM strIra ocarata prazAnti lAbha kare| tAra pichata yetiYA teOM strIra saite milita ha’la tetiYA strIjanI eTi laghu garbhadhAraNa karile Aru eiTo lai anAYAse calA-phurA kariva dharile| aৱzeSata yetiYA gA-gadhUra ha’la, tetiYA teOMloka ubhaYe teOMlokara pratipAlaka AllAhara ocarata prArthanA kariva dharile, ‘yadi tumi AmAka ejana susantAna dAna karA tente nizcaYa Ami tomAra prati kRtajJa thAkima’|

tAra pichata yetiYA teOM siha~taka ejana pUrNAGga susantAna dAna kare, tetiYA siha~taka teOM yi pradAna kariche sei viSaYe siha~te vahuto aMzIdAra (zvarIka) nirdhAraNa kare| prakRtate siha~te yisakalaka (teOMra lagata) aMzI sthApana kare, AllAha seivorara parA vahu urddhata|
siha~te enekuৱA vastuka aMzI kare neki yisakale ekoৱei sRSTi karA nAi? varaM siha~ta nijei sRSTa|
eivore siha~taka kadApio sahAYa kariva noৱAre Anaki nijaro sahAYa kariva noৱAre|
Aru tomAloke siha~taka satpathara pine AhvAna karileo siha~te tomAlokaka anusaraNa nakariva; tomAloke siha~taka AhvAna karA vA niraৱe thAkA, tomAlokara vAve ubhaYei samAna|

AllAhara vAhire tomAloke yisakalaka AhvAna karA siha~ta tomAlokara darei vAndAha, gatike yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA tente siha~taka AhvAna karA, (coৱAcona) siha~te tomAlokara AhvAnata sa~hAri diYene nAi|

siha~tara bhari Achene yAra dvArA siha~te khoja kADha়e? siha~tara hAta Achene yAra dvArA siha~te dhariva pAre? siha~tara caku Achene yAra dvArA siha~te dekhe? siha~tara kANa Achene yAra dvArA siha~te zune? koৱA, ‘tomAloke yisakalaka AllAhara lagata aMzI karichA siha~taka mAti loৱA Aru tAra pichata mora viruddhe SaDa়yantra karA, Aru moka akaNo aৱkAza nidivA’|
‘nizcaYa mora abhibhAৱka haiche keৱla AllAha, yijane kitAva aৱtIrNa kariche Aru teৱe~i satkarmaparAYaNasakalara abhibhAৱkatva kare’|
Aru AllAhara vAhire tomAloke yisakalaka AhvAna karA siha~te tomAlokaka kadApio sahAYa kariva noৱAre Anaki siha~te nijaro sahAYa kariva noৱAre|
tumi yadi siha~taka satpathara pine AhvAna karA tente siha~te nuzuniva Aru tumi dekhivalai pAvA ye, vAhyikabhAৱe siha~te tomAra phAle cAi Ache, athaca siha~te nedekhe|
mAnuhara (caritra Aru karmara) utkRSTa aMza grahaNa karA, satkarmara Adeza diYA Aru ajJasakalaka erAi calA|
Aru yadi caYatAnara kumantraNAi tomAka prarocita kare, tente AllAhara AzraYa vicArivA| nizcaYa teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
nizcaYa yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariche, teOMlokaka caYatAne yetiYA kumantraNA diYe tetiYA teOMloke Atmasacetana haYa, Aru lage lage teOMlokara dRSTi prakaTa haYa|
Aru caYatAnara bhAtRsakale siha~taka bhrAntira pine TAni lai yAYa| ei kAmata siha~te akaNo truTi nakare|

tumi yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai (siha~te vicarA mate) kono AYAta lai nAhA, tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘tumi nijei eTA AYAta vanAi noloৱA kiYa’? koৱA, ‘mora pratipAlakara taraphara parA mora prati ahI hicApe yi preraNa karA haYa, mai keৱla tArei anusaraNa karo~| ei (koraAna)khana haiche tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA spaSTa pramANa; lagate eikhana ImAndAra sampradAYara vAve hidAYata Aru rahamata’|
Aru yetiYA koraAna tilAৱta karA haYa tetiYA tomAloke manoyoga sahakAre seYA zunivA Aru niraৱ-nistavdha hai thAkivA, yAte tomAlokara prati rahamata varSaNa haYa|
Aru tumi tomAra pratipAlakaka puৱA-gadhUli mane mane savinaYe, sazaMkacitte Aru anuccasvare smaraNa karA| lagate tumi udAsInasakalara antarbhukta naha’vA|

nizcaYa yisakala tomAra pratipAlakara sAnnidhyata Ache, teOMloke teOMra ivAdatara parA ahaMkAra nakare; Aru teOMloke keৱla teOMrei tAchavIha pATha kare Aru keৱla teOMkei chAjadA kare| (chAjadAha naM 1)

mAnuhe tomAka AnaphAla (yuddhalavdha sampada) samparke prazna kare; koৱA, ‘yuddhalavdha sampada AllAha Aru rAchulara vAve; eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru nijara mAjata sadbhAৱ sthApana karA lagate AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya karA, yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA’|

prakRta mumina haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara hRdaYa AllAhaka smaraNa karAra samaYata kampita haYa Aru yetiYA teOMlokara sanmukhata teOMra AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karA haYa, tetiYA i teOMlokara ImAna vRddhi kare, lagate teOMloke keৱla nija pratipAlakara oparatei bharasA kare|
yisakale chAlAta kAYema kare Aru Ami teOMlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ tAra parA vyaYa kare;
teOMlokei haiche prakRta mumina| teOMlokara vAve Ache teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata ucca maryAdA, kSamA Aru sanmAnajanaka jIৱikA|
eiTo enekuৱA, yenekai tomAra pratipAlake nyAYabhAৱe tomAka gharara parA uliYAi Anichila athaca muminasakalara eTA dale seYA apachanda karichila|
satya spaSTabhAৱe prakAzita hoৱAra pichato siha~te tomAra lagata vitarka kare| ene lAgichila yenivA siha~taka mRtyura phAle khedi lai yoৱA haiche Aru siha~te seiTo dekhi Ache|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA AllAhe tomAlokaka pratizruti dichila ye, dui dalara yikono eTA dala tomAlokara AYattAdhIna ha'va, athaca tomAloke vicArichilA ye, astrahIna dalaTo tomAlokara AYattAdhIna haoka, kintu AllAhe vicArichila teOM nijara vANIra dvArA satyaka pratiSThita kariva Aru kAphirasakalaka nirmUla kariva|
yAte teOM satyaka satyarUpe Aru vAtilaka vAtilarUpe pratipanna kariva pAre, yadio aparAdhIsakale eiToka apachanda kare|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAloke tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocarata uddhAra prArthanA karichilA, phalata teOM tomAlokara prArthanAta sahA~ri dichila ye, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAlokaka sahAYa karima ehejAra phiristAra dvArA, yisakale dale dale eTAra pichata eTAkai Ahiva’|

Aru AllAhe eiTo kariche susaMvAdasvarUpe lagate ei uddezye yAte tomAlokara antarasamUhe iYAra dvArA prazAnti lAbha kare; sahAYa keৱla AllAhara parAi Ahe; nizcaYa AllAha pravala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA teOM teOMra phAlara parA svastira vAve tomAlokaka tandrAcchanna karichila Aru AkAzara parA tomAlokara vAve pAnI varSaNa karichila yAte iYAra dvArA teOM tomAlokaka paৱitra kare, Aru tomAlokara parA caYatAnara kumantraNA dUra kare, tomAlokara hRdaYasamUha dRDha় rAkhe Aru iYAra mAdhyamata tomAlokara bharisamUha sthira rAkhe|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAra pratipAlake phiristAsakalara prati ahI preraNa karichila ye, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara lagata Acho~, eteke tomAloke muminasakalaka avicalita rAkhA’| yisakale kuphurI kariche acirei mai siha~tara hRdaYata bhItira saJcAra karima; seYe tomAloke siha~tara DiGita AghAta karA Aru siha~tara pratyeka gAThiYe gAThiYe AghAta karA|
eiTo eikAraNe ye, siha~te AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara virodhitA kariche; Aru yiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara virodhitA kariva tente (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAha zAsti dAnata ati kaThora|
eiToৱe tomAlokara zAsti, eteke tomAloke iYAra soৱAda loৱA| nizcaYa kAphirasakalara vAve Ache jAhAnnAmara zAsti|
he muminasakala! tomAloke yetiYA (yuddhara samaYata) kAphira vAhinIra sanmukhIna ha’vA paraspara nikaTaৱrtI aৱsthAta, tetiYA tomAloke siha~taka pRSTha pradarzana (kari palAYana) nakarivA;

Aru seidinA yuddhara vAve kauzalagata diza parivartana karivalai athavA nija dalata AzraYa grahaNara vAhire konovAi yadi pazcAdamukhI haYa tente si AllAhara gajava lai ubhativa Aru tAra AzraYasthala ha’va jAhAnnAma, Aru seiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa pratyAৱrtanasthala!

eteke tomAloke siha~taka hatyA karA nAchilA varaM AllAhei siha~taka hatyA karichila| yetiYA tumi nikSepa karichilA, tetiYA tumi nikSepa karA nAchilA varaM AllAhei nikSepa karichila| yAte teOM muminasakalaka nijara taraphara parA uttamarUpe parIkSA (kari ucca maryAdA pradAna) kariva pAre, nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
eYA Achila tomAlokara vAve, Aru nizcaYa AllAhe kAphirasakalara SaDa়yantra durvala kari diYe|

yadi tomAloke vijaYa kAmanA karichA teneha’le seYA tomAlokara ocarata Ahi pAichehi; Aru yadi tomAloke virata hoৱA tente seYA haiche tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara; kintu yadi tomAloke Akau yuddha karivalai AhA tente Amio Akau zAsti lai Ahima| tomAlokara dala saMkhyAgariSTha ha’leo tathApio tomAlokara kono kAmata nAhiva| nizcaYa AllAha muminasakalara lagata Ache|
he muminasakala! tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya karA Aru tomAloke teOMra kathA zunAra pichata tAra parA mukha ghUrAi nala’vA|
Aru tomAloke siha~tara dare naha’vA, yisakale kaYa, ‘Ami zunicho~’; Acalate siha~te nuzune|
nizcaYa AllAhara ocarata vicaraNazIla jIৱra mAjata ati nikRSTa haiche seisakala kalA, vovA, yisakale ekoৱe nuvuje|
AllAhe yadi siha~tara mAjata kivA bhAla guNa dekhilahe~tena tente nizcaYa siha~taka zunivalai (suyoga) dilehe~tena| kintu teOM siha~taka zunAleo siha~te upekSA kari mukha ghUrAi la’lehe~tena|

he muminasakala! rAchule yetiYA tomAlokaka enekuৱA kono viSaYara prati AhvAna kare yiToৱe tomAlokaka jIৱna dAna kariva, tetiYA tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara AhvAnata sa~hAri divA Aru jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa mAnuhara Aru tAra hRdaYara mAjata AllAha antarAYa hai yAYa| nizcaYa teOMra pinei tomAlokaka ekatrita karA ha’va|

Aru tomAloke phitanA-phAchAdara parA A~tarata thAkivA, (kiYano iYAra azubha pariNAma) keৱla tomAlokara mAjara yAlimasakalara mAjatei vizeSakai sImAvaddha nAthAke| lagate jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha zAsti dAnata ati kaThora|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAloke saMkhyAta ati tAkara AchilA, pRthiৱIta tomAlokaka durvala hicApe gaNya karA haichila| tomAloke AzaMkA karichilA ye, mAnuhe tomAlokaka akasmAt Ahi apaharaNa kariva| tAra pichata teৱe~i (AllAhei) tomAlokaka AzraYa diche, nijara sahAYara jariYate tomAlokaka zaktizAlI kariche Aru tomAlokaka uttama vastuvora jIৱikA hicApe dAna kariche yAte tomAloke kRtajJa hoৱA|
he muminasakala! tomAloke jAni-vuji AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara saite khiYAnata (vizvAsaghAtakatA) nakarivA Aru tomAlokara parasparara AmAnatato khiYAnata nakarivA|
Aru jAni thoৱA, tomAlokara dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati haiche eTA parIkSA; Aru (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAhara ocaratei Ache mahApuraskAra|

he muminasakala! yadi tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA tente teOM tomAlokaka phurakAna tathA nyAYa-anyAYa pArthakya karAra zakti pradAna kariva, tomAlokara pApa mocana kariva Aru tomAlokaka kSamA kariva Aru AllAha haiche mahA kalyANara adhikArI|
