Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA kAphirasakale tomAka vandI karAra vAve athavA hatyA karAra vAve nAivA nirvAsita karAra vAve SaDa়yantra karichila| siha~te SaDa়yantra karichila ipine AllAheo (siha~tara SaDa়yantrara vipakSe) tAra prativyaৱsthA karichila, Aru AllAha sarvazreSTha kauzalI|

Aru yetiYA siha~tara ocarata AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami zunilo~, icchA karile Amio eidare ka’va pAro~, eivora puraNi dinara lokasakalara upakathAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA siha~te kaichila, ‘he AllAha! eikhana (koraAna) yadi tomAra phAlara parA sa~cAi satya haYa, tente AmAra oparata tumi zilA-vRSTi varSaNa karA athavA AmAra oparata kono yantraNAdAYaka zAsti lai AhA’|

AllAha enekuৱA nahaYa ye, tumi siha~tara mAjata thakA aৱsthAte teOM siha~taka zAsti diva; lagate AllAhara nIti eiToo nahaYa ye, siha~te AllAhara ocarata kSamA prArthanA kari thAkiva Aru AllAhe siha~taka zAsti diva|

siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA ki (guNa) Ache, AllAhe siha~taka kiYa zAsti nidiva? athaca siha~te mAnuhaka machajidula hArAmara parA nivRtta kare; Anaki siha~ta sei machajidara abhibhAৱko nahaYa; iYAra abhibhAৱka haiche keৱla muttAkvIsakala; kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai (ei kathA) nAjAne|
Aru kAvA gharara ocarata uruli Aru hAta tAlira vAhire siha~tara Ana eko upAsanA nAchila| gatike tomAloke zAsti bhoga karA, kAraNa tomAloke kuphurI karichilA|

nizcaYa yisakale kupharI kariche, siha~te AllAhara pathara parA mAnuhaka nivRtta karivalai siha~tara dhana-sampada vyaYa kare, eteke siha~te eidare vyaYa kariYe thAkiva, aৱzeSata seYA siha~tara manastApara kAraNa ha’va; iYAra pichata siha~te parAbhUta ha’va; Aru yisakale kupharI kariche siha~taka jAhAnnAmata ekatrita karA ha’va|

yAte AllAhe apaৱitravoraka paৱitrasakalara parA pRthaka kariva pAre| teOM apaৱitravoraka eTAra pichata AnaToka rAkhi sakaloke stUpata pariNata kariva, tAra pichata sei stUpaka jAhAnnAmata nikSepa kariva| siha~tei haiche kSatigrasta|

yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~taka koৱA, ‘yadi siha~te (kuphurI) parihAra kare tente atItata yi (pApa) haiche seYA AllAhe kSamA kariva; kintu siha~te yadi anyAYara punarAvRtti kare tente purvaৱrtIsakalara rItito jAnAi (siha~tara ki pariNati haichila)’|

Aru tomAloke phitanAra aৱsAna naghaTAlaike siha~tara viruddhe saMgrAma kari thAkivA, lagate dvIna pUrNarUpe keৱla AllAhara vAve pratiSThA nohoৱAlaike (ei saMgrAma calAi yAvA)| tAra pichata yadi siha~te virata thAke tente siha~te yi kare sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka draSTA|
Aru yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa tente jAni thoৱA, AllAhei tomAlokara abhibhAৱka, teOM kimAna ye uttama abhibhAৱka Aru kimAna ye uttama sahAYakArI|

Aru jAni thoৱA, yuddha kSetrata tomAloke ganimata (yuddhalavdha sampada) hicApe yi lAbha karichA, tAra eka-paJcamAMza haiche AllAhara, rAchulara, rAchulara nikaTa AtmIYara, iYAtImasakalara, michakInasakalara Aru muchAphirasakalara vAve nirdiSTa, yadi tomAloke AllAhara prati vizvAsa karA Aru seiTora prati vizvAsa karA yiTo Ami mImAMsAra dinA AmAra vAndAra oparata aৱtIrNa karichilo~, yidinA duYo dale parasparara sanmukhIna haichila| AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAloke upatyakAra nikaTaৱrtI prAntata AchilA Aru siha~ta Achila dUraৱrtI prAntata Aru ArohI dala Achila tomAlokara parA nimnabhUmita| yadi tomAloke paraspare yuddha samparke kono pUrvasiddhAntata thAkilAhe~tena tente ei siddhAnta samparke tomAloke nizcaYa matabheda karilAhe~tena| kintu yi ghaTivalagIYA Achila, AllAhe seYA sampanna karile, yAte yiYe dhvaMsa ha’va si yena suspaSTa pramANa poৱAra pichata dhvaMsa haYa Aru yiYe jIৱita thAkiva si yena suspaSTa pramANa poৱAra pichata jIৱita thAke; Aru nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA AllAhe tomAka saponata dekhuৱAichila ye, siha~ta saMkhyAta tAkara ha’va; yadi tomAka siha~tara saMkhyA vechi dekhuৱAlehe~tena tente nizcaYa tomAloke sAhasa heruৱAlAhe~tena Aru yuddhara viSaYe nijara mAjate virodha sRSTi karilAhe~tena| kintu AllAhe tomAlokaka rakSA kariche| nizcaYa antarata yi Ache sei viSaYe teৱe~i savizeSa aৱgata|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAloke parasparara sanmukhIna haichilA tetiYA teOM tomAlokara dRSTita siha~tara saMkhyA kama dekhuৱAichila Aru siha~tara dRSTito tomAlokaka saMkhyAta kama dekhuৱAichila, yAte AllAhe sei kAmaTo sampanna kariva pAre yiTo ghaTivalagIYA Achila| (jAni thoৱA) sakalo viSaYa AllAhara pinei pratyAৱrtana karoৱA haYa|
he muminasakala! yetiYA tomAloke kono dalara sanmukhIna ha’vA tetiYA avicala thAkivA Aru AllAhaka vechi parimANe smaraNa karivA, yAte tomAloke saphalatA lAbha kariva pArA|

Aru tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya karA, lagate nijara mAjate vivAda nakarivA, ene karile tomAloke sAhasa heruৱAvA Aru tomAlokara zakti-sAmartha vilupta ha’va| tomAloke dhairyya dhAraNa karA; nizcaYa AllAha dhairyyazIlasakalara lagata Ache|

Aru tomAloke siha~tara dare naha’vA yisakale nija gharara parA ahaMkAra Aru mAnuhaka dekhuৱAvalai olAichila Aru siha~te mAnuhaka AllAhara pathara parA nivRtta kare| kintu siha~te yi kare AllAhe seYA pariveSTana kari Ache|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA caYatAne siha~tara vAve siha~tara kAryAৱlIka zobhanIYa karichila Aru kaichila, ‘Aji mAnuhara mAjata konoৱei tomAlokara oparata vijaYa lAbha kariva noৱAre, Aru nizcaYa mai tomAlokara kASatei aৱsthAna karima’| eteke yetiYA duYo dala paraspare dRzyamAna ha’la tetiYA si picha ho~hokile Aru ka’le, ‘nizcaYa tomAlokara saite mora kono samparka nAi, nizcaYa mai enekuৱA kivA dekhi Acho~ yiTo tomAloke dekhA nopoৱA| nizcaYa mai AllAhaka bhaYa karo~’, kAraNa AllAha zAsti pradAnata ati kaThora|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA munAphikasakale Aru yisakalara antarata vyAdhi Ache siha~te kaichila, ‘eOMlokara dvIne eOMlokaka vibhrAnta kariche’| prakRtate yiYe AllAhara oparata nirbhara kare (teOMhe jaYalAbha kare)| (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAha pravala parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|
Aru yadi tumi dekhilAhe~tena yetiYA phiristAsakale kAphirasakalara prANa haraNa karichila, tetiYA siha~tara mukhamaNDalata Aru piThita AghAta kari kaichila, ‘tomAloke dahanayantraNA bhoga karA’|
eYA haiche tomAloke pUrve nija hAtere paThoৱA karmara pratiphala| nizcaYa AllAhe teOMra vAndAsakalara oparata ketiYAo avicAra nakare|

phiraAuna vaMzadhara Aru siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara abhyAsara dare, siha~te AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche; phalata AllAhe siha~tara pApakarmara vAve siha~taka greptAra kariche| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazaktimAna, zAsti dAnata ati kaThora|

eiTo eikAraNe ye, yadi kono sampradAYe nijara aৱsthAra parivartana nije nakare tente AllAha ene nahaYa ye, teOM siha~taka yi niYAmata dAna kariche tAta kono parivartana Aniva; nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

phiraAunara vaMzadhara Aru siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara abhyAsara dare iha~te nija pratipAlakara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kare| phalata siha~tara pApakarmara vAve Ami siha~taka dhvaMsa karichilo~ Aru phiraAunara vaMzadharasakalaka DuvAi mArichilo~; Aru siha~ta ATAYe Achila yAlima|
nizcaYa vicaraNakArI prANIvorara mAjata AllAhara ocarata ATAitakai nikRSTa prANI haiche seisakala, yisakale kuphurI kariche| seYe siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
siha~tara mAjara parA yisakalara saite tumi cukti karichA, siha~te vAre vAre siha~tara sei cukti bhaMga kare, Aru siha~te tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakare|

eteke yadi tumi siha~taka yuddhata nijara AYattata la’va pArA tente siha~taka enekuৱA kaThora zAsti pradAna karivA, yAte siha~tara pichaphAle yisakala Ache siha~ta chatrabhaMga di palAYana kare, sambhaৱtaH siha~te (iYAra parA) zikSA lAbha kariva|
Aru yadi tumi kono sampradAYara cukti bhaMgara AzaMkA karA tente siha~tara cukti prakAzyabhAৱe siha~talai daliYAi divA, nizcaYa AllAhe vizvAsaghAtakasakalaka pachanda nakare|
Aru kAphirasakale yena eiTo ketiYAo nAbhAve ye, siha~ta (AmAra) AYatvara vAhirata guci gaiche; nizcaYa siha~te (AllAhaka) apAraga karivalai sakSama nahaYa|

Aru tomAloke siha~tara mukAvilAra vAve yathAsAdhya zakti-sAmartha Aru azva-vAhinI prastuta karA, yiTora dvArA tomAloke bhIta-santrasta karivA AllAhara zatruka Aru tomAlokara zatruka lagate iYAra vAhireo Ana Ana lokasakalaka yisakalaka tomAloke cini nopoৱA, kintu AllAhe siha~taka jAne| AllAhara pathata tomAloke yi vyaYa karivA tAra pUrNa pratidAna tomAlokaka pradAna karA ha’va Aru tomAlokara prati akaNo anyAYa karA naha’va|
Aru yadi siha~te (zAnti sthApanara vAve) sandhira pine DhAla khAYa tente tumio tAra vAve AgrahI ha’vA Aru AllAhara oparata nirbhara karivA; nizcaYa teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
AnahAte yadi siha~te tomAka pratArita kariva vicAre tente tomAra vAve AllAhei yatheSTa, nizcaYa teOM tomAka nija sahAYara dvArA Aru muminasakalara dvArA zaktizAlI kariche|

Aru teৱe~i siha~tara parasparara hRdaYara mAjata prIti sthApana kariche| pRthiৱIra yAৱtIYa sampada vyaYa karileo tumi siha~tara hRdaYata prIti sthApana kariva noৱArilAhe~tena; kintu AllAhe siha~tara mAjata prIti sthApana kariche, nizcaYa teOM parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
he navI! tomAra vAve Aru tomAra anusArIsakalara vAve AllAhei yatheSTa|

he navI! tumi muminasakalaka yuddhara vAve udvuddha karA, tomAlokara mAjara vizajana dhairyyazIla vyaktiYe duzajanaka parAsta kariva Aru tomAlokara mAjara ezajane ehejAra kAphirara oparata vijaYI lAbha kariva| kAraNa siha~ta (kAphirasakala) haiche enekuৱA eTA sampradAYa yisakalara vodhazakti nAi|

AllAhe etiYA tomAlokara bhAra lAghaৱ kariche Aru teOM aৱgata ye, tomAlokara mAjata durvalatA Ache, seYe tomAlokara mAjara ezajana dhairyyazIla vyaktiYe duzajanara oparata vijaYI lAbha kariva, Aru tomAlokara mAjata ehejAra thAkile AllAhara anujJAkrame siha~te duhejArara oparata vijaYI ha’va| prakRte AllAha dhairyyazIlasakalara lagata Ache|

pRthiৱIta sampUrNarUpe zatruka ucchanna nakarAlaike yuddhavandI rakhATo kono navIra vAvei saMgata nahaYa| tomAloke kAmanA karA pArthiৱ sampada kintu AllAhe vicAre AkhirAta; Aru AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
AllAhara pUrva vidhAna (lipivaddha) nAthAkile tomAloke yi grahaNa karichA, tArakAraNe tomAlokara oparata mahAzAsti Apatita ha’lahe~tena|
eteke tomAloke yi ganImata lAbha karichA seYA vaidha Aru uttama vuli bhoga karA Aru AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he navI! tomAlokara karAYatta yuddhavandIsakalaka koৱA, ‘AllAhe yadi tomAlokara hRdaYata bhAla kivA dekhe tente tomAlokara parA (muktipaNa hicApe) yi loৱA haiche tAtakaio uttama kivA teOM tomAlokaka pradAna kariva Aru tomAlokaka kSamA kariva, Aru AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

Aru siha~te yadi tomAra lagata vizvAsaghAtakatA kare, tente (jAni thoৱA) itipUrve siha~te AllAhara lagato vizvAsaghAtakatA kariche; tAra pichata teOM siha~tara oparata (tomAka) zaktizAlI kariche; Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche, hijarata kariche, jIৱna Aru sampadara dvArA AllAhara pathata jihAda kariche, Aru yisakale (muminasakalaka) AzraYa pradAna kariche Aru sahAYa kariche, teOMloke paraspare parasparara vandhu| kintu yisakale ImAna Aniche athaca hijarata karA nAi, siha~te hijarata nakarAlaike siha~tara abhibhAৱkatvara dAYitva tomAlokara oparata nAi; Aru yadi siha~te dvIna samparke tomAlokara ocarata sahAYa prArthanA kare tetiYA siha~taka sahAYa karATo tomAlokara kartavya, kintu yi sampradAYa Aru tomAlokara mAjata cukti Ache siha~tara viruddhe nahaYa| tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka draSTA|
AnahAte yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~te paraspare parasparara vandhu, seYe yadi tomAloke ene nakarA tente pRthiৱIta phitanA Aru mahAviparyaYe dekhA diva|

Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche, hijarata kariche Aru AllAhara pathata jihAda kariche, Aru yisakale (muminasakalaka) AzraYa pradAna kariche lagate sahAYa kariche, teOMlokei haiche prakRta mumina; teOMlokara vAvei Ache kSamA Aru sanmAnajanaka jIৱikA|

Aru yisakale pichata ImAna Aniche, hijarata kariche Aru tomAlokara lagata thAki jihAda kariche teOMlokeo tomAlokara antarbhukta Aru AllAhara vidhAnata nikaTaAtmIYasakala haiche (Anara tulanAta) ijane sijanara vechi hakvadAra| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo viSaYe samyaka aৱgata|
eiTo AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara taraphara parA samparkacchedara ghoSaNA, sei sakala muzvarikara prati yisakalara lagata tomAloke pArasparika cuktita Aৱddha haichilA|

eteke (he muzvarikasakala) tomAloke dezata cAri mAhalaike (nirApade) vicaraNa karA Aru jAni thoৱA, tomAloke (kadApio) AllAhaka hInavala kariva noৱArivA, Aru nizcaYa AllAhei kAphirasakalaka apadastha kariva|

mahAna hajjara dinA AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara taraphara parA mAnuhara prati eiTo eTA ghoSaNA ye, nizcaYa AllAhara saite muzvarikasakalara kono samparka nAi lagate teOMra rAchularo (kono samparka) nAi| eteke tomAloke yadi tAovA karA tente seYA tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara ha’va Aru yadi mukha ghUrAi loৱA tente jAni thoৱA ye, tomAloke (kadApio) AllAhaka akSama kariva noৱArivA| Aru (he navI!) kAphirasakalaka yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda diYA|

kintu muzvarikasakalara mAjara yisakalara saite tomAlokara cukti Ache, eteke siha~te tomAlokara cukti rakSAta kono truTio karA nAi Aru tomAlokara viruddhe Anaka sahAYao karA nAi, tente tomAloke siha~tara lagata nirdiSTa myAda paryanta cukti pAlana karA; nizcaYa AllAhe muttAkvIsakalaka pachanda kare|

eteke niSiddha mAhasamUha ativAhita hai yoৱAra pichata tomAloke muzvarikasakalaka ya’tei pAvA hatyA karivA, siha~taka greptAra karivA, aৱrodha karivA Aru ghA~TiYe ghA~TiYe siha~tara vAve khApa pAti rai thAkivA| kintu yadi siha~te tAovA kare, chAlAta kAYema kare Aru yAkAta pradAna kare tente siha~tara patha eri divA; nizcaYa AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru muzvarikasakalara mAjara konovAi yadi tomAra ocarata AzraYa vicAre tente tumi tAka AzraYa diYA, yAte si AllAhara vANI zuniva pAre, tAra pichata tAka nirApada sthAnalai pau~cAi divA; kAraNa siha~ta enekuৱA eTA sampradAYa yisakale ekoৱe nAjAne|

AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara ocarata muzvarikasakalara cukti kenekai valaৱt thAkiva? kintu yisakalara saite machajidula hArAmara sannikaTata tomAloke pAraspArika cuktita Avaddha haichilA, yetiYAlaike siha~te tomAlokara cuktita sthira thAkiva, tomAlokeo siha~tara cuktita sthira thAkivA, nizcaYa AllAhe muttAkvIsakalaka pachanda kare|

kenekai cukti valaৱt thAkiva? athaca siha~te yadi tomAlokara oparata vijaYa lAbha kare tente siha~te tomAlokara AtmIYatAra Aru aGgIkArara kono maryAdA nidiva; siha~te keৱla mukherehe tomAlokaka santuSTa kare; kintu siha~tara hRdaYe seYA asvIkAra kare; Aru siha~tara adhikAMzai haiche phAchikva|
siha~te AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka tuccha mUlyata vikrI kari diche phalata siha~te mAnuhaka teOMra pathara parA nivRtta kariche, nizcaYa siha~te yi kariche seYA ati nikRSTa!
siha~te kono muminara saite AtmIYatAra Aru aGgIkArara maryAdA rakSA nakare, Aru siha~tei haiche sImAlaMghanakArI|
eteke siha~te yadi tAovA kare, chAlAta kAYema kare Aru yAkAta pradAna kare, tente siha~ta ha’va tomAlokara dvIni bhAi; Aru Ami jJAnI sampradAYara vAve AYAtasamUha spaSTabhAৱe varNanA karo~|

Aru yadi siha~te siha~tara cuktira pichata nijara pratizruti bhaMga kare Aru tomAlokara dvIna samparke kaTukti kare, tente kupharara netAsakalara lagata yuddha karA; nizcaYa siha~ta haiche enekuৱA loka, yisakalara kono pratizruti (vA zapata) nAi; yAte siha~te virata thAke|

tomAloke sei sampradAYara lagata yuddha nakarivAne, yisakale nijara pratizruti bhaMga kariche Aru rAchulaka vahiSkAra karAra saMkalpa kariche? Aru siha~tei prathame tomAlokara lagata (yuddha) Arambha kariche| tomAloke siha~taka bhaYa karA neki? AllAhaka bhaYa karAhe tomAlokara vAve vechi samIcIna, yadi tomAloke (prakRta) mumina hoৱA|

tomAloke siha~tara lagata yuddha karA| tomAlokara hAtere AllAhe siha~taka zAsti diva, siha~taka apadastha kariva, siha~tara oparata tomAlokaka jaYayukta kariva Aru mumina sampradAYara antarasamUhaka prazAnti dAna kariva,
Aru teৱe~i teOMlokara antarara kSobha dUra kariva Aru AllAhe yAka icchA kariva tArei tAovA kavula kariva| kAraNa AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomAloke eiTo dhAraNA karichA neki ye, tomAlokaka enei eri diYA ha’va? athaca AllAhe etiYAo prakAza karA nAi ye, tomAlokara mAjara kone jihAda kariche Aru kone AllAha Aru teOMra rAchula lagate muminasakalara vAhire Ana kAko antaraGga vandhu hicApe grahaNa karA nAi; Aru tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka aৱgata|

muzvarikasakalara kono adhikAra nAi ye, siha~te AllAhara machajidasamUhara tatvAৱdhAYaka ha’va, yihetu siha~ta nijei nijara kuphurIra sAkSya diche| siha~tara sakalo Amala vinaSTa haiche Aru siha~ta jAhAnnAmatei sthAYIbhAৱe aৱsthAna kariva|

ekamAtra teOMlokei AllAhara machajidasamUhaka sucArurUpe paricAlanA kariva tathA tatvAৱdhAna la'va, yisakale ImAna Aniche AllAhara prati Aru zeSa diৱsara prati, chAlAta kAYema kare Aru yAkAta pradAna kare lagate AllAhara vAhire Ana kAko bhaYa nakare| eteke AzA karA yAYa ye, teOMlokei ha’va satpatha prAptasakalara antarbhukta|

hAjIsakalaka pAnI pAna karoৱA Aru machajidula hArAmara tatvAৱdhAna karA kAryaka tomAloke sei vyaktira dare dhAraNA karA neki, yiYe AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna Aniche Aru AllAhara pathata jihAda kariche? siha~ta AllAhara ocarata samAna nahaYa| AllAhe yAlima sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|

yisakale ImAna Aniche, hijarata kariche Aru nijara sampada Aru nijara jIৱnara dvArA AllAhara pathata jihAda kariche, teOMloka haiche AllAhara ocarata zreSTha maryAdAra adhikArI, Aru teOMlokei sAphalyamaNDita|
teOMlokara pratipAlake teOMlokaka susaMvAda diche, teOMra daYA Aru santuSTira Aru enekuৱA jAnnAtara ya’ta Ache teOMlokara vAve sthAYI niYAmata|
tAta teOMloka cirasthAYI ha’va| nizcaYa AllAhara ocarata Ache mahA puraskAra|

he ImAndArasakala! tomalokara pitRvarga Aru bhAtRvRndai yadi ImAnara mukAvilAta kuphurIka pachanda kare, tente siha~taka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa nakarivA| tomAlokara mAjara yisakale siha~taka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa kare siha~tei haiche yAlima|

koৱA, ‘tomAlokara ocarata yadi AllAha, teOMra rAchula Aru teOMra (AllAhara) pathata jihAda karAtakai vechi priYa haYa tomAlokara pitRvarga, tomAlokara santAna-santati, tomAlokara bhAtRsakala, tomAlokara strIsakala, tomAlokara nija vaMzagotra, tomAlokara arjita sampada, tomAlokara vyaৱsAYa-vANijya yAra kSatira AzaMkA tomAloke karA Aru tomAlokara vAsasthAna yiToka tomAloke bhAla poৱA tente apekSA karA AllAhe teOMra nirdeza lai nahAlaike’; Aru AllAhe phAchikva sampradAYaka hidAYata nidiYe|

nizcaYa AllAhe tomAlokaka vahu kSetrata sahAYa kariche Aru hunAinara yuddhara dinA yetiYA tomAlokara saMkhyAgariSThatAi tomAlokaka utphulla karichila, kintu seYA tomAlokara kono kAmata ahA nAchila Aru pRthiৱI prazasta hoৱA satveo tomAlokara vAve saMkIrNa hai gaichila| tAra pichata tomAloke pRSTha pradarzana kari palAYana karichilA|

tAra pichata AllAhe teOMra phAlara parA teOMra rAchulara oparata Aru muminasakalara oparata prazAnti nAyila karichila Aru enekuৱA eTA sainya vAhinI aৱtIrNa karichila yiTo tomAloke dekhA poৱA nAchilA, Aru teৱe~i kAphirasakalaka zAsti dichila, eiToৱei Achila kAphirasakalara pratiphala|
iYAra pichato yAra prati icchA AllAhe tAra tAovA kavula kariva; Aru AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAndArasakala! nizcaYa muzvarikasakala haiche apaৱitra, gatike ei vacharara pichata siha~te yAte machajidula hArAmara nikaTaৱrtI nahaYa; Aru yadi tomAloke daridratAra AzaMkA karA tente AllAhe icchA karile teOMra nija anugrahata tomAlokaka abhAৱmukta kariva| nizcaYa AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karA haichila siha~tara mAjara yisakale AllAhara prati vizvAsa nakare Aru zeSa diৱsara pratio ImAna poSaNa nakare, lagate AllAha Aru teOMra rAchule yi hArAma kariche tAka hArAma vuli gaNya nakare; Aru satya dvInara anusaraNa nakare; siha~te nata hai nija hAte jiyiYA (kara) nidiYAlaike siha~tara lagata yuddha karA|

Aru iYAhudIsakale kaYa, ‘uyAira haiche AllAhara putra’, Aru khrISTAnasakale kaYa, ‘machIha haiche AllAhara putra’| eiTo haiche keৱla siha~tara mukhara kathA| pUrve yisakale kuphurI karichila siha~tara darei iha~te kathA kaYa| AllAhe iha~taka dhvaMsa karaka| kona pine iha~taka obhatAi niYA haiche!

siha~te AllAhara vAhire siha~tara paNDita Aru saMsAra-virAgIsakalaka siha~tara prabhu vanAi laiche Aru mAraYAmara putra machIhako| athaca siha~taka eka ilAhara ivAdata karAra vAvei Adeza karA haichila| yAra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| siha~te yi aMzI sthApana kare tAra parA teOM ati paৱitra!
siha~te nijara mukhere phu~ mAri AllAhara nUraka numAi diva vicAre| kintu AllAhe teOMra nUra paripUrNa karAra vAhire Ana eko nivicAre| yadio kAphirasakale iYAka apachanda kare|
teৱe~i sei sattvA yijane teOMra rAchulaka hidAYata Aru satya dvInasaha preraNa kariche, yAte teOM iYAka sakalo dvInara oparata jaYayukta kariva pAre, yadio muzvarikasakale eiTo apachanda kare|

he ImAndArasakala! paNDita Aru saMsAra-virAgIsakalara mAjara vahutei janasAdhAraNara dhana-sampada anyAYabhAৱe bhakSaNa kare Aru mAnuhaka AllAhara pathara parA nivRtta kare| yisakale soNa-rUpa saJcaYa kare Aru seYA AllAhara pathata vyaYa nakare, tumi siha~taka yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda diYA|

yidinA seivoraka jAhAnnAmara agnita uttapta karA ha’va Aru seivorere siha~tara kapAla, zarIrara duYokASe Aru piThita dAga diYA ha’va, (lagate koৱA ha’va), ‘eivorei haiche tomAlokara seivora sampada yivoraka tomAloke nijara vAve saJcaYa karichilA| gatike tomAloke yi saJcaYa karichilA tAra soৱAda upabhoga karA’|

nizcaYa AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTira dinara parAi AllAhara vidhAnata mAhavorara gaNanA haiche vAraTA| tAre cAriTA mAha haiche niSiddha (paৱitra vA sanmAnIYa), eiToৱe haiche pratiSThita dvIna| eteke ei mAhavorata tomAloke nijara prati yuluma nakarivA, Aru tomAloke muzvarikasakalara lagata sarvAtmakabhAৱe yuddha karA, yenekai siha~te tomAlokara viruddhe sarvAtmakabhAৱe yuddha kari thAke; Aru jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha muttAkvIsakalara lagata Ache|

(ei mAhavorara paৱitratAka) anya kono mAhalai pichuৱAi diYATo haiche keৱla kupharIta vRddhi sAdhana karA, iYAra dvArA kAphirasakalaka vibhrAnta karA haYa| siha~te iYAka kono vacharata vaidha kare Akau kono vacharata avaidha kare, yAte siha~te AllAhe yivoraka niSiddha kariche seivorara gaNanA pUrNa kariva pAre; phalata AllAhe yi hArAma kariche seYA siha~te hAlAla kare| siha~tara veYA karmavora siha~tara vAve zobhanIYa kari diYA haiche, Aru AllAhe kAphira sampradAYaka hidAYata nidiYe|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAlokara ki ha’la, tomAlokaka yetiYA AllAhara pathata kono abhiyAnata olAvalai koৱA haYa, tetiYA kiYa tomAloke bhArAkrAnta hai mATika sAৱTi dharA? tomAloke AkhirAtara parivarte pArthiৱ jIৱnata santuSTa haichA neki? AkhirAtara tulanAta pArthiৱ jIৱnara bhogara upakaraNa ati nagaNya|

yadi tomAloke abhiyAnalai olAi noyoৱA, tente teOM tomAlokaka yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pradAna kariva Aru anya eTA jAtika tomAlokara parivarte pratiSThita kariva Aru tomAloke teOMra kono kSati kariva noৱArivA| kAraNa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

yadi tomAloke teOMka (AllAhara rAchulaka) sahAYa nakarA, tente AllAhei (teOMka sahAYa kariva yidare teOM) teOMka sahAYa karichila yetiYA kAphirasakale teOMka (makkAra parA) vahiSkAra karichila Aru teOM Achila dujanara dvitIYajana, yetiYA teOMloka ubhaYe guhAra mAjata Achila, tetiYA teOM nijara lagarajanaka kaichila, ‘viSaNNa naha’vA, AllAha Ache AmAra lagata’| tAra pichata AllAhe teOMra oparata nijara prazAnti aৱtIrNa karichila Aru teOMka zaktizAlI karichila enekuৱA eTA sainya vAhinIra dvArA yisakalaka tomAloke dekhA poৱA nAchilA Aru teOM kAphirasakalara kathAka tala pelAi dichila; Aru AllAhara kathAi samunnata Aru AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

abhiyAnalai olAi parA, pAtala aৱsthAtei haoka nAivA gadhUra aৱsthAta Aru jihAda karA AllAhara pathata tomAlokara sampada Aru jIৱnara dvArA| eiToৱe haiche tomAlokara vAve uttama, yadi tomAloke jAnilAhe~tena!

yadi sahajate sampada lAbhara AzA thAkilahe~tena Aru bhramaNa sugama ha’lahe~tena tente nizcaYa siha~te tomAra anusaraNa karilehe~tena; kintu siha~te yAtrApathaka sudIrgha vuli bhAvichila, Aru anatipalame siha~te AllAhara zapata lai ka’va, ‘AmAra sAdhya thAkile Ami nizcaYa tomAlokara lagata olAi ga’lo~he~tena’| darAcalate siha~te (michA kathA kai) nijei nijake dhvaMsa kare, Aru AllAhe jAne ye, nizcaYa siha~ta michalIYA|
AllAhe tomAka kSamA kariche| konasakala loka satyavAdI seYA tomAra ocarata spaSTa nohoৱAlaike Aru konasakala loka michalIYA sei kathA tumi najanAlaike kiYa siha~taka avyAhati pradAna karilA?

yisakale AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna poSaNa kare, teOMloke nijara sampada Aru jIৱnara dvArA jihAda karAra parA avyAhati pAvalai tomAra parA anumati nivicAriva; Aru AllAha muttAkvIsakalara viSaYe savizeSa aৱgata|

tomAra ocarata avyAhati vicAre keৱla seisakala loke yisakale AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare| kAraNa siha~tara antarasamUha saMzaYagrasta hai gaiche, eteke siha~te nijara saMzaYata dvidhAgrasta|

Aru yadi siha~te olAvalai icchA karilehe~tena tente nizcaYa siha~te tAra vAve prastutira vyaৱsthA karilehe~tena, kintu siha~tara abhiyAtrAka AllAhe apachanda kariche| seYe teOM siha~taka alasatAra mAdhyamata virata rAkhiche Aru siha~taka koৱA ha’la, ‘vahi thAkA (akSama) lokasakalara saite tomAlokeo vahi thAkA’|

yadi siha~ta tomAlokara saite olAlahe~tena, tente tomAlokara azAnti asuvidhAhe vRddhi karilehe~tena Aru tomAlokara mAjata phitanA sRSTi karivalai yathAsAdhya ceSTA karilehe~tena| lagate tomAlokara mAjata siha~tara kichumAna anugata (guptacara) Ache| AllAha yAlimasakalara viSaYe savizeSa aৱgata|

nizcaYa siha~te iYAra Agateo phitanA sRSTi kariva vicArichila Aru siha~te tomAra vahuto kAma olaTa-pAlaTa karichila, aৱzeSata satya samAgata ha’la Aru AllAhara Adeza jaYayukta ha’la, yadio siha~te iYAka apachanda karichila|

Aru siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA mAnuho Ache yiYe kaYa, ‘moka (yuddhata aMza grahaNa nakarivalai) anumati diYaka Aru moka phitanAta patita nakariva’| sAৱdhAna! siha~ta phitanAtei patita hai Ache; Aru nizcaYa jAhAnnAme kAphirasakalaka veSTana kariYe Ache|

yadi tomAra kono maGgala haYa tente eiToৱe siha~taka kaSTa diYe, Aru tomAra vipada ghaTile siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami Agatei AmAra nijara viSaYe satarkatA aৱlamvana karichilo~’, Aru siha~te utphulla citte mukha ghUrAi laYa|
koৱA, ‘AmAra lagata keৱla seiToৱe ghaTiva yiTo AllAhe AmAra vAve likhi rAkhiche; teৱe~i AmAra abhibhAৱka; Aru AllAhara oparatei muminasakale nirbhara karA ucita’|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke keৱla AmAra vAve duTA kalyANara parA yikono eTAra apekSA kari AchA, Aru Ami pratIkSA kari Acho~ ye, AllAhe tomAlokaka teOMra nijara phAlara parA athavA AmAra hatuৱAi zAsti pradAna kariva| eteke tomAloke pratIkSA karA, Amio tomAlokara lagata pratIkSA kari Acho~’|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke icchAkRtabhAৱe dAna karA athavA anicchAkRtabhAৱe, tomAlokara parA sei dAna ketiYAo grahaNa karA naha’va, nizcaYa tomAloka haichA phAchikva sampradAYa’|

Aru siha~tara arthasAhAyya grahaNa karivalai niSedha karA haiche ei kAraNe ye, siha~te AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara saite kuphurI kariche lagate siha~te chAlAtata upasthita haYa keৱla zaithilyara saite, Aru dAna kare keৱla anicchAkRtabhAৱe|
eteke siha~tara sampada Aru santAna-santatiYe yAte tomAka vimugdha nakare, AllAhe eivorara dvArAi siha~taka pArthiৱ jIৱnata zAsti diva vicAre; Aru kAphira aৱsthAtei siha~tara AtmAi deha tyAga kariva|
Aru siha~te AllAhara nAmata zapata khAi kaYa ye, siha~ta tomAlokarei antarbhukta, athaca siha~ta tomAlokara antarbhukta nahaYa; prakRtate siha~ta haiche eTA bhItu sampradAYa|
yadi siha~te kono AzraYasthala nAivA kono giri-guhA athavA lukAi thAkivalai kono praৱezasthala pAYa tente siha~te seiphAlei druta gatita dauri lukAva|

Aru siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA mAnuho Ache, yiYe chAdAkvA vanTana samparke tomAka doSAropa kare, eteke yadi siha~taka iYAra parA kichu diYA haYa tente siha~ta santuSTa haYa, Aru yadi iYAra parA kivA diYA nahaYa tente lage lage vikSuvdha haYa|

bhAla ha’lahe~tena AllAha Aru teOMra rAchule siha~taka yi pradAna kariche tAta yadi siha~te santuSTa thAkilahe~tena Aru yadi ka’lehe~tena, ‘AllAhei AmAra vAve yatheSTa, acirei AllAhe AmAka teOMra nija anugrahere pradAna kariva Aru teOMra rAchuleo (dAna kariva); nizcaYa Ami AllAharei prati anurakta’|

(pharaja) chAdAkvA haiche keৱla phakIra, michakIna Aru chAdAkvA AdAYara kAmata niYojita karmacArIsakalara vAve, Aru yAra antara (satyara prati) AkRSTa karAra Aৱzyaka tAra vAve, dAsamuktira vAve, RNagrastasakalara vAve, AllAhara pathara vAve lagate (vipadagrasta) muchAphirasakalara vAve| eiTo haiche AllAhara taraphara parA nirdhArita (pharaja vidhAna)| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Aru siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA kichumAna mAnuho Ache yisakale navIka kaSTa diYe Aru kaYa, ‘eOM dekhona pratyeka kathAte karNapAta kare’| koৱA, ‘tomAlokara vAve yi maGgala teOM keৱla seiToৱe zune’| teOM AllAhara oparata vizvAsa kare Aru muminasakalako vizvAsa kare; Aru tomAlokara mAjara yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokara vAve teOM haiche rahamata| yisakale AllAhara rAchulaka kaSTa diYe, siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
siha~te tomAlokaka santuSTa karivalaihe tomAlokara ocarata AllAhara zapata laYa| athaca AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulakahe vechi santuSTa karA ucita, yadihe siha~ta prakRta mumina|
siha~te nAjAne neki ye, yiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara virodhitA kariva tAra vAve Ache jAhAnnAmara jui, ya’ta si cirakAla thAkiva? eiToৱei haiche carama lAJchanA|

munAphikasakale (sadAYa) AzaMkA kare ye, jAnocA siha~tara viSaYe ene kono churA aৱtIrNa haYei neki, yiToৱe siha~tara antarara kathAvora prakAza kari diva! koৱA, ‘tomAloke vidrUpa kari thAkA; tomAloke yiTo viSaYaka bhaYa kari AchA nizcaYa AllAhe seiTo prakAza kari diva’|

Aru yadi tumi siha~taka sodhA tente nizcaYa siha~te ka’va, ‘Ami keৱla AlApa-AlocanA Aru hA~hi-dhemAlihe karichilo~’| koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra AYAtasamUhaka lagate teOMra rAchulakei vidrUpa karivalai pAlAne’?

‘tomAloke etiYA ojara-Apatti nakarivA| (kAraNa) nizcaYa tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karAra pichata Akau kuphurI karichA| Ami tomAlokara mAjara kichumAnaka kSamA karileo Ana kichumAnaka zAsti pradAna karimei—kAraNa nizcitabhAৱe siha~ta haiche aparAdhI’|

munAphika puruSa Aru munAphika nArIsakala ijane sijanara anurUpa, siha~te asatkarmara Adeza diYe Aru satkarmara parA virata rAkhe, lagate siha~te (AllAhara pathata vyaYa karAra kSetrata) nijara hAta saMkucita kari rAkhe, darAcalate siha~te AllAhaka pAhari gaiche, phalata AllAheo siha~taka eri diche; nizcaYa munAphikasakala haiche phAchikva (ati avAdhya)|

AllAhe munAphika puruSa, munAphika nArI Aru kAphirasakalaka jAhAnnAmara agnira pratizruti diche| ya’ta siha~te cirakAla thAkiva, eiToৱe siha~tara vAve yatheSTa; Aru AllAhe siha~taka abhizApa kariche Aru siha~tara vAve Ache sthAYI zAsti;

(tomAlokeo) siha~tara darei, yisakala tomAlokara pUrve Achila, siha~ta zakti-sAmarthata tomAlokatakaio adhika pravala Achila Aru siha~tara dhana-sampada tathA santAna-santati Achila tomAlokatakaio vechi| eteke siha~tara bhAgyata yi Achila seiTo siha~te bhoga kariche; Aru tomAlokeo tomAlokara bhAgyata yi Achila seiTo upabhoga karilA, yenekai tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakale siha~tara bhAgyata yi Achila bhoga kariche| tomAlokeo seidarei anarthaka AlApa-AlocanAta lipta AchA yenekuৱA anarthaka AlApa-AlocanAta siha~ta lipta Achila| siha~tara (neka) AmalasamUha pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata niSphala hai gaiche, Aru siha~tei haiche kSatigrasta|

siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara pUrvaৱrtI sampradAYasamUha yene nUha, Ada Aru chAmUda sampradAYa, lagate ivrAhImara sampradAYa Aru mAdaYAnara adhivAsIsakalara lagate vidhvasta nagarara adhivAsIsakalara saMvAda ahA nAine? siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara rAchulasakale spaSTa pramANa lai Ahichila| eteke AllAhe siha~tara oparata anyAYa karA nAi varaM siha~ta nijei nijara pratihe anyAYa karichila|

mumina puruSa Aru muminA nArI haiche ijane sijanara abhibhAৱka, teOMloke satkarmara Adeza diYe Aru asatkarmara parA vAdhA pradAna kare, chAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta pradAna kare, lagate AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya kare; eOMlokara oparatei AllAhe anatipalame daYA kariva| nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAhe mumina puruSa Aru muminA nArIsakalaka enekuৱA jAnnAtara pratizruti diche—yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita, tAta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va; Aru (pratizruti diche) sthAYI jAnnAtasamUhata uttama vAsasthAnara, Aru AllAhara santuSTiYei haiche sarvazreSTha| eiToৱei haiche mahAsaphalatA|
he navI! kAphira Aru munAphikasakalara viruddhe tumi jihAda karA, siha~tara prati kaThora hoৱA; siha~tara AvAsasthala haiche jAhAnnAma, Aru seiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa pratyAৱrtanasthala!

siha~te AllAhara zapata khAi kaYa ye, siha~te eko koৱA nAi; athaca siha~te kuphurI vAkya kaiche Aru ichalAma grahaNara pichata Akau kuphurI kariche; siha~te enekuৱA viSaYara saMkalpa karichila yiTo siha~te kAryakarI kariva parA nAi| AllAha Aru teOMra rAchule nija anugrahata teOMlokaka (muchalimasakalaka) abhAৱmukta karichila vuliYe siha~te (kAphira-munAphikasakale) virodhitA karichila| eteke yadi siha~te tAovA kare tente siha~tara vAve kalyANakara ha’va, Aru yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa tente AllAhe pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata siha~taka yantraNAdAYaka zAsti diva; bhU-pRSThata siha~tara kono abhibhAৱka nAi, Aru kono sAhAyyakArIo nAi|
Aru siha~tara kichumAne AllAhara ocarata aGgIkAra karichila ye, ‘AllAhe nija kRpAta AmAka dAna karile Ami nizcaYa chAdAkvA karima tathA satkarmazIlasakalara antarbhukta hama’|
tAra pichata yetiYA teOM siha~taka nija anugrahara parA dAna karile, tetiYA siha~te ei viSaYe kRpaNatA karile Aru vimukha hai ubhati ga'la|

pariNAmasvarUpe teOM siha~tara antarata niphAkva rAkhi dile sei diৱsalaike yidinA siha~te AllAhara lagata sAkSAt kariva| kAraNa siha~te AllAhara saite karA aGgIkAra bhaMga karichila, lagate michA kaichila|
siha~te nAjAne neki ye, nizcaYa AllAhe siha~tara antarara gopana kathA Aru siha~tara gopana parAmarzara viSaYe jAne? Aru nizcaYa AllAha gAYeva samparke samyaka aৱgata|

muminasakalara mAjara yisakale svataHsphUrtabhAৱe chAdAkvA diYe Aru yisakale nija zramara vAhire ekoৱe nApAYa, teOMlokaka yisakale doSAropa kare| tAra pichata siha~taka lai upahAsa kare, (ene prakRtira lokaka) AllAhe upahAsa kare Aru siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

tumi siha~tara vAve kSamA prArthanA karA vA nakarA ekei kathA; tumi yadi siha~tara vAve sattara vAro kSamA prArthanA karA tathApio AllAhe siha~taka ketiYAo kSamA nakare| eiTo ei kAraNe ye, siha~te AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara saite kuphurI kariche; Aru AllAhe phAchikva sampradAYaka hidAYata nidiYe|

(tAvukara abhiyAnata) pichata rai yoৱA lokasakale AllAhara rAchulara viruddhAcaraNa kari vahi thakAke Anandavodha karile Aru siha~tara dhana-sampada Aru jIৱnara dvArA AllAhara pathata jihAda karAka apachanda karile| iYAra opario siha~te ka’le, ‘garamara mAjata tomAloke abhiyAnalai olAi nAyAvA’| koৱA, ‘jAhAnnAmara jui iYAtakaio vechi uttapta’, yadi siha~te vujilehe~tena!
darAcalate siha~te yi arjana kariche tAra pratiphala hicApe siha~te kamakai ha~hA ucita Aru vechikai kAndA ucita|

eteke yadi AllAhe tomAka (mAdInAlai) siha~tara kono dalara ocarata ghUrAi Ane Aru siha~te (kono abhiyAnata) olAvalai tomAra ocarata anumati vicAre, tetiYA tumi (siha~taka) ka’vA, ‘tomAloke mora lagata ketiYAo olAva noৱArA Aru tomAloke mora saMgI haio ketiYAo zatrura lagata yuddha kariva noৱArivA| tomAloke prathamei vahi thakAka pachanda karichilA; seYe tomAloke pichata rai yoৱAvilAkara lagata vahi thAkA’|

Aru siha~tara mAjara kArovAra mRtyu ha’leo tumi ketiYAo tAra jAnAyAra chAlAta napaDha়ivA Aru tAra kavarara ocarato thiYa naha’vA; nizcaYa siha~te AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulaka asvIkAra karichila Aru phAchikva aৱsthAtei siha~tara mRtyu haiche|
siha~tara dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santatiYe yAte tomAka vimugdha nakare, AllAhe eivorara dvArAi siha~taka pArthiৱ jIৱnata zAsti diva vicAre; Aru siha~tara AtmAi kAphira aৱsthAtei deha tyAga kariva|

AllAhara prati ImAna poSaNa karA Aru rAchulara saMgI hai jihAda karA—ei viSaYe yetiYA kono churA aৱtIrNa haYa tetiYA siha~tara mAjara yisakalara zakti-sAmartha Ache siha~te tomAra ocaralai Ahi anumati vicAri kaYa, ‘AmAka rehAi diYaka, Ami vahi thakA vyaktisakalara lagate thAkima’|
siha~te antaHpura nivAsinIsakalara lagata aৱsthAna karAkei pachanda karile Aru siha~tara antarata mohara mAri diYA ha’la; phalata siha~te eko vuji nApAYa|

kintu rAchula Aru teOMra lagata yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMloke nijara sampada Aru jIৱnara dvArA AllAhara pathata jihAda kariche; teOMlokara vAvei Ache yAৱtIYa kalyANa Aru teOMlokei haiche sAphalyamaNDita|
AllAhe teOMlokara vAve jAnnAta prastuta kari rAkhiche, yAra talata pravAhita Ache nadIsamUha, teOMloke tAta (sei jAnnAtata) cirakAla thAkiva; eiToৱei haiche mahAsaphalatA|

Aru maruvAsIsakalara mAjara kichumAna loke ajuhAta lai Ahila yAte siha~tako avyAhati diYA haYa Aru yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara saite michA kaichila, siha~te vahiYe thAkila; siha~tara mAjara yisakale kuphurI kariche acirei siha~te yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pAva|

kono doSa nAi durvalasakalara, asusthasakalara Aru yisakala artha vyaYa karivalai asamartha, yadi siha~ta AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati hitAkAGkSI haYa| muhachinasakalara viruddhe abhiyogara kono patha nAi; Aru AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru seisakala lokaro kono doSa nAi, yisakale tomAra ocaralai vAhana poৱAra AzAta Ahichila, tumi kaichilA, ‘tomAlokara vAve mai kono vAhana poৱA nAi’; tetiYA teOMloke vAdhya hai cakulo Tuki ubhati gaichila ei dukhata ye, teOMlokara ocarata vyaYa kariva parA eko nAi|

kintu yisakala loke abhAৱmukta haio (yuddhata noyoৱAra) anumati vicArichila, nizcaYa siha~tara viruddhe abhiyogara kAraNa Ache| siha~te antaHpura nivAsinIsakalara lagata thakAkei pachanda karichila| seYe AllAhe siha~tara antarata mohara mAri diche, phalata siha~te jJAna lAbha kariva noৱAre|

yetiYA tomAloke siha~tara ocaralai ubhati yAvA, tetiYA siha~te tomAlokara ocarata ajuhAta dekhuৱAva| koৱA, ‘tomAloke ajuhAta nedekhuৱAvA, Ami tomAlokaka ketiYAo vizvAsa nakaro~; nizcaYa AllAhe AmAka tomAlokara viSaYe janAi diche Aru (bhaৱiSyateo) AllAhe tomAlokara kAryakalApa paryavekSaNa kariva Aru teOMra rAchuleo| tAra pichata tomAlokaka adRzya Aru prakAzya samparke aৱgata mahAjJAnIra ocaralaike obhatAi niYA ha’va, tetiYA teৱe~i tomAlokaka janAva tomAloke ki karichilA’|

tomAloke yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai ubhati yAvA, acirei siha~te tomAlokara sanmukhata AllAhara zapata khAva, yAte tomAloke siha~taka upekSA karA| seYe tomAlokeo siha~taka upekSA karA; nizcaYa siha~ta apaৱitra Aru siha~tara kRtakarmara phalasvarUpe jAhAnnAmei haiche siha~tara AvAsasthala|
siha~te tomAlokara sanmukhata zapata kariva, yAte tomAloke siha~tara prati santuSTa hoৱA| eteke tomAloke siha~tara prati santuSTa ha’leo AllAhe phAchikva sampradAYara prati ketiYAo santuSTa nahaYa|

A’rAva vA maruvAsIsakala kuphurI Aru niphAkvata dRDha়tara; Aru AllAhe teOMra rAchulara oparata yi aৱtIrNa kariche, tAra sImArekhA samparke ajJa thakAra siha~te adhika upayukta; Aru (jAni thoৱA) AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Aru maruvAsIsakalara mAjata enekuৱA kichumAna mAnuho Ache yisakale AllAhara pathata vyaYa karA dAnaka jarimanA vuli gaNya kare, lagate tomAlokara prati (kAlara) Aৱrtana (duHsamaYa)ra pratIkSA kare| siha~tara oparatei haoka nikRSTa viparyaYa; Aru AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|

Aru maruvAsIsakalara mAjata enekuৱA vyaktio Ache yiYe AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati ImAna poSaNa kare lagate yi vyaYa kare tAka AllAhara sAnnidhya Aru rAchulara duA lAbhara upAYa vuli gaNya kare| jAni thoৱA, niHsandehe teOMlokara ei dAna haiche (AllAhara) sAnnidhya lAbhara upAYa; acirei AllAhe teOMlokaka nijara rahamatata praৱeza karAva| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

muhAjira Aru AnachArasakalara mAjata yisakala (ImAna poSaNa karAra kSetrata) prathama agragAmI, lagate yisakale ihachAnara saite teOMlokaka anusaraNa kare, AllAhe teOMlokara prati santuSTa haiche Aru teOMlokeo AllAhara prati santuSTa haiche| AllAhe teOMlokara vAve prastuta kariche jAnnAta, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita, tAta teOMloka cirasthAYI ha’va| eiToৱe haiche mahAsaphalatA|

maruvAsIsakalara mAjara yisakale tomAlokara ocare pA~jare Ache siha~tara kichumAna haiche munAphika, lagate madInAvAsIra mAjato Ache (kichumAna munAphika), siha~te niphAkvara carama sImAta upanIta haiche| tumi siha~taka nAjAnA; kintu Ami siha~taka cini pAOM| anatipalame Ami siha~taka duvAra zAsti pradAna karima tAra pichata siha~taka mahAzAstira pine pratyAৱrtana karoৱA ha’va|

Aru Ana kichumAna loke nijara aparAdha nije svIkAra kariche, siha~te eTA satkarmara lagata Ana eTA asatkarmara mizraNa ghaTAiche; sambhaৱtaH AllAhe siha~taka kSamA kariva, nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tumi siha~tara sampadara parA cAdAkvA grahaNa karA| iYAra dvArA tumi siha~taka paৱitra karivA Aru parizodhita karivA| lagate tumi siha~tara vAve duA karA| niHsandehe tomAra duA haiche siha~tara vAve prazAntikara; Aru AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJAnI|
siha~te nAjAne neki ye, nizcaYa AllAhei teOMra vAndAsakalara tAovA kavula kare Aru cAdAkvAha grahaNa kare? Aru nizcaYa AllAha tAovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|

Aru koৱA, ‘tomAloke Amala karA, AllAhe tomAlokara Amala dekhiva Aru teOMra rAchuleo Aru muminasakaleo (dekhiva)| anatipalame tomAlokaka obhatAi niYA ha’va adRzya Aru prakAzya samparke sarvajJa sattvA (AllAha)ra ocaralai; aৱzeSata teৱe~i tomAlokaka janAi diva tomAloke ki karichilA’|
Aru Ana kichumAna lokara viSaYe siddhAnta AllAhara Adezara apekSAta pichuৱAi diYA ha’la --- teৱe~i siha~taka zAsti diva naha’le kSamA kariva| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Aru (kichumAna Ache) yisakale kSatisAdhana karAra uddezye, kuphurI karAra uddezye Aru muminasakalara mAjata vibheda sRSTi karAra uddezye, lagate itipUrve AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara viruddhe yisakale yuddha karichila siha~tara gopana ghA~Ti hicApe vyaৱhArara uddezye (ekhana natuna) machajida nirmANa kariche | siha~te nizcaYa zapata khAi ka’va, ‘Ami keৱla kalyANahe kAmanA karichilo~’; Aru AllAhe sAkSya diYe ye, niHsandehe siha~ta michalIYA|

tumi tAta ketiYAo (chAlAtara vAve) thiYa naha’vA; (AnahAte) yi machajidara bhitti prathama dinAra parAi sthApita haiche tAkvaৱAra oparata, seikhanatahe chAlAtara vAve thiYa hoৱA tomAra vAve vechi upayukta| tAta enekuৱA loka Ache yisakale uttamarUpe paৱitratA arjana karivalai bhAlapAYa, Aru paৱitratA arjanakArIsakalaka AllAhe bhAlapAYa|

eteke yi vyaktiYe tAra gharara bhitti AllAhara tAkvaৱA Aru santuSTira oparata sthApana kariche si uttama ne sei vyakti uttama yiYe tAra gharara bhitti sthApana kariche khahi pariva dharA garAra kASata? phalata i tAkalai jAhAnnAmara agnita khahi parila; Aru AllAhe yAlima sampradAYaka hidAYata nidiYe|
siha~tara nirmita gRha, siha~tara antarata sadAYa sandehara kAraNa hai thAkiva, yetiYAlaike siha~tara antara chinna-vichinna hai nAyAYa| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa AllAhe muminasakalara parA teOMlokara jIৱna Aru sampada jAnnAtara vinimaYata kini laiche| teOMloke AllAhara pathata yuddha kare, phalata teOMloke (zatruka) hatyA kare Aru nijeo nihata haYa| eteke tAorAta, IJjIla Aru koraAnata ei viSaYe satya pratizruti Ache; pratijJA pAlanata AllAhatakai zreSTha Ana kona Ache? seYe tomAloke AllAhara lagata yi vecA-kinA karichA tAra vAve susaMvAda grahaNa karA; kiYano eiToৱei haiche mahAsaphalatA|

teOMloka haiche tAovAkArI, ivAdatakArI, AllAhara prazaMsAkArI, chiYAma pAlanakArI, rukukArI, chAjadAkArI, satkarmara AdezadAtA, asatkarmara niSedhakArI Aru AllAhara nirdhArita sImArekhA saMrakSaNakArI, Aru tumi muminasakalaka zubha saMvAda diYA|

navI Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokara vAve ucita nahaYa muzvarikasakalara vAve kSamA prArthanA karA, yadio siha~ta nikaTAtmIYa nahaoka kiYa, yetiYA ei kathA suspaSTa hai gaiche ye, nizcaYa siha~ta prajvalita agnira adhivAsI|

Aru ivrAhIme teOMra pitRra vAve kSamA prArthanA karichila eTA pratizrutira kAraNe, tAra pichata yetiYA eiTo teOMra ocarata spaSTa ha’la ye, teOM (ra pitA haiche) AllAhara zatru, tetiYA ivrAhIme tAra lagata samparka vichinna karichila| nizcaYa ivrAhIma Achila adhika komala hRdaYara adhikArI, sahanazIla|

Aru AllAha enekuৱA nahaYa ye, teOM kono sampradAYaka hidAYata diYAra pichata siha~te virata thAkivalagIYA viSaYasamUha vitaMbhAৱe janAi nidiYAra Agatei siha~taka vibhrAnta kariva| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo viSaYe sarvajJa|
nizcaYa AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra rAjatva ekamAtra AllAharei; teৱe~i jIৱna dAna kare Aru teৱe~i mRtyu ghaTAYa| AllAhara vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono abhibhAৱko nAi Aru kono sahAYakArIo nAi|

nizcaYa AllAhe navIra, muhAjira Aru AnachArasakalara tAovA kavula kariche, yisakale saMkaTamaYa muhUrtata teOMra anusaraNa karichila– Anaki teOMlokara mAjara eTA dalara hRdaYa satyacuta hoৱAra upakrama haichila| tAra pichata AllAhe teOMlokara tAovA kavula kariche; nizcaYa AllAha teOMlokara prati ati snehazIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru sei tinijana vyaktiro teOM tAovA kavula karile, yisakalara viSaYe siddhAnta grahaNa sthagita rakhA haichila, Anaki pRthiৱI prazasta hoৱA satveo teOMlokara vAve saMkIrNa hai gaichila Aru teOMlokara jIৱna teOMlokara vAve durviSaha hai parichila Aru teOMloke nizcita upalavdhi karichila ye, AllAhara zAstira parA rakSA pAvalai teOMra vAhire Ana kono AzraYasthala nAi| tAra pichata teOM teOMlokara tAovA kavula karile yAte teOMloke tAovAta sthira thAke| nizcaYa AllAha adhika tAovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|
he muminasakala! tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru satyavAdIsakalara saMgI hoৱA|

AllAhara rAchulara lagata yoৱAra parA virata thAki pichata rai yoৱA Aru rAchulara jIৱnatakai nijara jIৱnaka vechi gurutva diYATo madInAvAsI Aru teOMlokara ocare-pA~jare thakA maruvAsIsakalara vAve ucita nahaYa; kAraNa AllAhara pathata teOMlokara yi tRSNA, klAnti Aru bhoka lAge Aru kAphirasakalara krodha udreka karA ThAita gamaNa karA teOMlokara pratiTo padakSepa yiToৱe zatrusakalaka kono kaSTa pradAna kare, seivora teOMlokara vAve satkarmarUpe lipivaddha karA haYa| nizcaYa AllAha muhachinasakalara karmara pratiphala vinaSTa nakare|

teOMloke saru-DAGara yiToৱe vyaYa nakaraka kiYa Aru yikono upatyakAi atikrama nakaraka kiYa seiToৱe teOMlokara vAve lipivaddha kari thoৱA haYa – yAte AllAhe teOMlokaka teOMlokara karmara utkRSTa puraskAra pradAna kariva pAre|

Aru muminasakale sakaloৱe ekelage abhiyAnata oloৱA ucita nahaYa| eteke teOMlokara pratyeka dalara parA ekAMzai kiYa nolAYa, yAte teOMloke dvInara gabhIra jJAna arjana kariva pAre, Aru yetiYA teOMloke nija sampradAYara ocaralai ubhati Ahiva tetiYA teOMlokaka bhItipradarzana kariva pAre, yAte teOMloko satarka ha’va pAre|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAlokara ocare-pA~jare thakA kAphirasakalara viruddhe yuddha karA Aru siha~te yena tomAlokara mAjata kaThoratA dekhivalai pAYa| jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha muttAkvIsakalara lagata Ache|

Aru yetiYAi kono churA aৱtIrNa haYa tetiYAi siha~tara kichumAne kaYa, ‘ei churAi tomAlokara mAjara kAra ImAna vRddhi karile’? eteke (koৱA) yisakale ImAna Aniche (ei churAi) teOMlokarei ImAna vRddhi kariche Aru teOMlokei Anandita haYa|
AnahAte yisakalara antarata vyAdhi Ache, ei churAi siha~tara kaluSara lagata adhika kaluSa vRddhi kariche; Aru siha~te kAphira aৱsthAtei mRtyuvaraNa kare|
siha~te dekhA nApAYane ye, siha~taka prati vachare evAra vA duvArakai viparyasta karA haYa? iYAra pichato kiYa siha~te tAovA nakare Aru upadeza grahaNa nakare|

Aru yetiYAi kono churA aৱtIrNa haYa tetiYAi siha~te ijane sijanara prati dRSTipAta kari kaYa, ‘tomAlokaka konovAi lakSya karA nAito’? tAra pichata siha~ta A~tari yAYa| AllAhe siha~tara hRdaYaka satyavimukha kari diche; kAraNa siha~ta enekuৱA eTA sampradAYa yisakalara vodhazakti nAi|

nizcaYa tomAlokara ocaralai tomAlokara mAjara parAi ejana rAchula Ahiche, tomAlokara yi dukha-kaSTa haYa teOM tAra vAve vara manokaSTa pAYa| teOM tomAlokara hitAkAMkSI, muminasakalara prati teOM karuNAzIla Aru ati daYAlu|

eteke siha~te yadi A~tari yAYa tente tumi koৱA, ‘mora vAve AllAhei yatheSTa, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| mai teOMra oparatei nirbhara karicho~ Aru teৱe~i haiche mahA Arachara pratipAlaka’|
Alipha lAma-rA|[1] eivora haiche prajJApUrNa kitAvara AYAta|

mAnuhara vAve eiTo vismaYakara viSaYa neki ye, Ami siha~tara mAjara parAi ejanara ocaralai ahI preraNa karicho~ ye, tumi mAnuhaka satarka karA Aru muminasakalaka susaMvAda diYA ye, teOMlokara vAve teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata Ache ucca maryAdA| kAphirasakale kaYa, ‘nizcaYa eOM ejana prakAzya yAdukara’|

nizcaYa tomAlokara pratipAlaka haiche (mahAna) AllAha, yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIka chaYa dinata sRSTi kariche, tAra pichata teOM Arachara oparata uThiche| teৱe~i sakalo viSaYa paricAlanA kare| teOMra anumati lAbha nakarAkai cupAricha karAra kSamatA kAro nAi| seijana (sraSTA Aru paricAlakei) haiche AllAha, tomAlokara pratipAlaka; gatike tomAloke teOMrei ivAdata karA| tathApio tomAloke upadeza grahaNa nakarivAne?

teOMra ocaratei tomAloka sakalore pratyAৱrtana, AllAhara pratizruti satya| nizcaYa teৱe~i sRSTira sUcanA kariche, tAra pichata teৱe~i seiTora punarAvRtti ghaTAva, yAte seisakala lokaka inacAphapUrNa pratiphala pradAna kariva pAre yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche| AnahAte yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~tara vAve Ache atyanta garama pAnI Aru ati kaSTadAYaka zAsti; kAraNa siha~te kuphurI karichila|

teৱe~i sUryaka dIptimAna Aru candraka jyotirmaYa kariche Aru tAra (gatira) vAve nirdiSTa kariche vibhinna manayila (kakSapatha), yAte tomAloke vachara gaNanA kariva pArA Aru samaYara hicApa jAniva pArA| AllAhe eivoraka yathAyathabhAৱei sRSTi kariche| teOM jJAnI sampradAYara vAve eivora nidarzana vizadabhAৱe varNanA kare|
nizcaYa dina Aru rAtira parivartanata Aru AllAhe AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi sRSTi kariche tAra mAjata vahuto nidarzana Ache ene sampradAYara vAve yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare|
nizcaYa yisakale AmAra sAkSAtara AzA poSaNa nakare, Aru pArthiৱ jIৱnaka laiYe santuSTa haiche, lagate iYAkalaiYe paritRpta, Aru yisakale AmAra nidarzanAৱlI samparke gAphila,
siha~tara kRtakarmara vAvei siha~tara ThikanA ha’va agni (jAhAnnAma)|

nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMlokara pratipAlake teOMlokaka patha nirdeza kariva, kAraNa teOMloke ImAna poSaNa kariche; niYAmatere paripUrNa jAnnAtata teOMlokara (vAsasthAnara) talata nadIsamUha pravAhita thAkiva|

tAta teOMlokara dhvani ha’vaH ‘he AllAha! tumi mahAna, paৱitra’! Aru tAta teOMlokara (parasparara) abhivAdana ha’va, ‘chAlAma’ lagate teOMlokara zeSa dhvani ha’vaH ‘sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA sRSTijagatara pratipAlaka AllAhara vAve’|

Aru yadi AllAhe mAnuhara akalyANa (prArthanAta sahA~ri diOMte) kharakhedA karilehe~tena, yenekai teOM siha~tara kalyANa (prArthanAta sahA~ri diOMte) kharadhara kare, tente nizcaYa siha~tara nirdiSTi samaYa ketiYAvAi Ahi ga’lahe~tena| gatike yisakale AmAra sAkSAtara AzA poSaNa nakare siha~taka Ami siha~tara avAdhyatAta udbhrAntara dare ghUri phurivalai eri diOM|

Aru mAnuhaka yetiYA dukha-dainyai sparza kare tetiYA si zui, vahi athavA thiYa haio AmAka AhvAna kare| tAra pichata yetiYA Ami tAra sei dukha-dainya dUra kari diOM, tetiYA si enekai calA-phurA kare ye tAka AkrAnta karA dukha-dainyara parA paritrANa karivalai si yenivA AmAka AhvAna karAi nAchila| eidarei sImAlaMghanakArIsakalara kRtakarmaka siha~tara ocarata zobhanIYa kari diYA haiche|

Aru nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara pUrve vahu prajanmaka dhvaMsa karicho~, yetiYA siha~te yuluma (sImAlaMghana) karichila; Aru siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara rAchulasakale spaSTa pramANAdisaha Agamana karichila, tathApio siha~te ImAna poSaNa karivalai prastuta nAchila| eidarei Ami aparAdhI sampradAYaka pratiphala di thAko~|
tAra pichata Ami tomAlokaka siha~tara pichata pRthiৱIta sthalAbhiSikta karicho~, yAte Ami eiTo cAva pAro~ ye tomAloke kenekuৱA Amala karA|

Aru yetiYA AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha siha~tara ocarata pATha karA haYa, tetiYA yisakale AmAra sAkSAtara AzA poSaNa nakare siha~te kaYa, ‘iYAra vAhire Ana ekhana koraAna lai AhA, athavA iYAke parivartana karA’| koৱA, ‘mai mora nijara phAlara parA iYAta sAla-salani karATo sambhaৱ nahaYa| mora prati yi ahI preraNa karA haYa mai keৱla seiTorahe anusaraNa karo~| yadi mai mora pratipAlakara avAdhyatA karo~ tente mai bhaYa karo~ nizcaYa mahA diৱsara zAstiYe moka AkrAnta kariva’|

koৱA, ‘AllAhe yadi vicArilehe~tena tente maYo tomAlokara ocarata eiTo tilAৱta nakarilo~he~tena Aru teৱo~ tomAlokaka ei viSaYe najanAlehe~tena| maito iYAra Agateo tomAlokara mAjata jIৱnara eTA dIrghakAla aৱsthAna karicho~, tathApio tomAloke vuji nopoৱAne’?
eteke yi vyaktiYe AllAha samparke michA racanA kare vA AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kare, seijanatakai DAGara yAlima Aruno kona ha’va pAre? nizcaYa aparAdhIsakala ketiYAo saphala ha’va noৱAre|

Aru siha~te AllAhaka eri velegara ivAdata kare yisakale siha~tara kSatio kariva noৱAre Aru upakAro kariva noৱAre; lagate siha~te kaYa, ‘eisakala haiche AllAhara ocarata AmAra cupArichakArI’| koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAhaka AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra enekuৱA kono viSaYara saMvAda di AchA neki, yi viSaYe teOM nAjAne?, teOM mahAna, paৱitra’, Aru siha~te yivoraka teOMra saite aMzI kare, teOM tAra parA vahu Urddhata|

Aru (ArambhaNita) mAnuhara eTAi ummata Achila, pichatahe siha~te matabheda sRSTi kariche| tomAra pratipAlakara pUrva-ghoSaNA nAthAkile, siha~te yivora viSaYata matabheda kariche seivorara mImAMsA haiYe ga’lahe~tena|

Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘eOMra pratipAlakara taraphara parA eOMra ocaralai kono nidarzana aৱtIrNa nahaYa kiYa’? eteke tumi koৱA, ‘gAYevara jJAna keৱla AllAhara ocaratahe Ache| gatike tomAloke apekSA karA, maYo tomAlokara lagata apekSA karicho~’|

dukha-danyai siha~taka sparza karAra pichata yetiYAi Ami mAnuhaka anugrahara soৱAda diOM tetiYAi siha~te AmAra AYAtasamUhara viruddhe apakauzala Arambha kare| koৱA, ‘AllAha kauzala aৱlamvanata Aru adhika tatpara’| tomAloke yi apakauzala karA, nizcaYa AmAra phiristAsakale seivora likhi rAkhe|

teৱe~i tomAlokaka jala-sthalata bhramaNa karAYa| Anaki tomAloke yetiYA nauyAnata ArohaNa karA, Aru sei nauyAnavore ArohIsakalakalai anukUla vatAhara sahAYata calAcala kare tetiYA siha~ta Anandita haYa, kintu haThAt yetiYA pravala dhumuhA Ahe, Aru cAriophAlara parA Dhau Ahivalai dhare tetiYA siha~te nizcita dhAraNA kare ye, siha~ta (vipadara dvArA) pariveSTita haiche, (tetiYA) siha~te saralacitte Anugatya sahakAre keৱla AllAhakei prArthanA kare ye, ‘tumi yadi AmAka iYAra parA rakSA karA, nizcaYa Ami kRtajJasakalara antarbhukta hai yAma’|

tAra pichata teOM yetiYA siha~taka vipadamukta kare tetiYA siha~te pRthiৱIta anyAYabhAৱe sImAlaMghana kari thAke| he mAnaৱ! (jAni thoৱA) tomAlokara sImAlaMghana keৱla tomAlokara viruddhei (kSatikara) haYa; pArthiৱ jIৱnara sukha upabhoga kari loৱA, pichata AmAra ocaralaikei tomAlokara pratyAৱrtana ha’va| tetiYA Ami tomAlokaka janAi dima tomAloke ki karichilA|

pArthiৱ jIৱnara udAharaNa pAnIra dare, yiTo Ami AkAzara parA varSaNa karo~, iYAra dvArA bhUmija udbhida ghana sanniviSTa hai utpanna haYa, yivora mAnuhe Aru jIৱ-jantuৱe khAYa| tAra pichata yetiYA bhUmi sujalA-suphalA Aru manomohA hai uThe Aru tAra giriha~te bhAৱe ye, seivora siha~tara AYattAdhIna, tetiYA dinate haoka vA rAtita AmAra Adeza Ahi pare, tAra pichata Ami seivora enekai nirmUla kari diOM yenivA yoৱAkAli iYAra kono astitvai nAchila| eidarei Ami cintAzIla sampradAYara vAve AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe varNanA karo~|
AllAhe (mAnuhaka) zAntira AvAsara phAle AhvAna kare Aru yAka icchA kare sarala pathata paricAlita kare|

yisakale ihachAnara saite Amala kare (uttamarUpe kAma kare) teOMlokara vAve Ache jAnnAta varaM Aru adhika (AllAhara sAkSAt)| malinatA Aru hInatAi teOMlokara mukhamaNDalaka Acchanna nakariva| teOMlokei haiche jAnnAtara adhivAsI, teOMloke tAta anantakAla vasavAsa kariva|

AnahAte yisakale veYA kAma kare, pratiTo veYA kAmara pratidAna ha’va sei anupAtei; lagate hInatAi siha~taka Acchanna kariva; AllAhara (zAstira) parA siha~taka rakSA karivalai kono nAthAkiva; siha~tara mukhamaNDala enekai andhakArAcchanna hai thAkiva yenivA rAtira andhakArara AৱraNe siha~taka chATi dhariche| siha~tei haiche jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI, tAta siha~ta cirasthAYI ha’va|

Aru (smaraNa karA) yidinA Ami siha~ta sakaloke ekatrita karima| tAra pichata muzvarikasakalaka sudhima, ‘tomAloka Aru tomAloke nirUpaNa karA aMzIvilAka (ATAYe) nijara nijara sthAnata aৱsthAna karA’; tAra pichata Ami siha~taka parasparara parA pRthaka kari dima, tetiYA siha~tara aMzIvilAke (siha~taka samvodhana kari) ka’va, ‘tomAloke AmAra ivAdata karA nAchilA’|
‘prakRtate AllAhei AmAra Aru tomAlokara mAjata sAkSI hicApe yatheSTa ye, nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara ivAdata samparke ajJAta Achilo~’|

seidinA pratyekei pUrve karA nijara kRtakarmasamUha parIkSA kari lava Aru siha~taka siha~tara prakRta abhibhAৱka AllAhara ocaralai obhatAi niYA ha’va, tetiYA siha~tara udbhAৱita michA AropIsakala siha~tara parA udhAo hai yAva|

koৱA, ‘kone tomAlokaka AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra parA jIৱnopakaraNa saravarAha kare athavA zraৱNa Aru dRSTizakti kAra kartRtvAdhIna; jIৱitara parA mRtaka kone uliYAYa Aru mRtaka jIৱitara parA kone uliYAYa, lagate sakalo viSaYa kone niYantraNa kare’? tetiYA siha~te nizcaYa ka’va, ‘AllAha’| eteke koৱA, ‘tathApio tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne’?
eteke teৱe~i AllAha, tomAlokara prakRta pratipAlaka| satya tyAga karAra pichata vibhrAntira vAhire Ana ki thAkiva pAre? gatike (satyaka eri) tomAlokaka kona phAle A~tarAi niYA haiche?
yisakale avAdhya haiche eidarei siha~tara viSaYe tomAra pratipAlakara vANI satya pratipanna haiche ye, siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke aMzI sthApana karA (upAsya)vilAkara mAjata enekuৱA konovA Ache neki yiYe sRSTira sUcanA kariva pAre Aru tAra pichata seiTora punarAvRttio kariva pAre’? koৱA, ‘keৱla AllAhei sRSTika astitvata Aniva pAre Aru teৱe~i punarAvRttio ghaTAva’| gatike (satyara parA) tomAlokaka kona pine obhatAi niYA haiche|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke yisakalaka aMzI sthApana karA siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA konovA Ache neki, yiYe satyara patha nirdeza kare’? koৱA, ‘AllAhei satyara patha nirdeza kare| teneha’le (koৱAcona) Anugatyara vechi hakadAra kona? yijane satyara pathara nirdeza diYe teOM, ne yAka patha nedekhuৱAle patha vicAri nApAYa seijana? eteke tomAlokara ki haiche? tomAloke kenekuৱA siddhAnta grahaNa karA?
Aru siha~tara adhikAMzai keৱla anumAnarahe anusaraNa kare, athaca satyara viparIte dhAraNA kono kAmata nAhe, siha~te yi kare nizcaYa AllAha sei viSaYe savizeSa aৱgata|

Aru ei koraAna AllAhara vAhire Ana kArovAra dvArA racanA hoৱATo sambhaৱ nahaYa| varaM eikhana haiche iYAra pUrve yi aৱtIrNa haiche seivorara satyatA sAvyastakArI Aru Ala-kitAvara vizada vyAkhyA| iYAta kono sandeha nAi ye, eikhana sRSTijagatara pratipAlakara taraphara parA (aৱtIrNa)|

siha~te ei kathA kaYa neki ye, ‘teOM nijei eikhana racanA kariche’? koৱA, ‘tente tomAloke iYAra anurUpa eTA churA lai AhAcona Aru AllAhara vAhire Ana yAkei icchA tAkei mAti loৱA, yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA’|

varaM siha~te enekuৱA eTA viSaYaka michA vuli dhAraNA kariche yiToka siha~te nijara jJAnara dvArA AYatta kariva parA nAi, Aru etiYAo siha~tara ocaralai iYAra prakRta pariNati Ahi poৱA nAi| eidarei siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo asvIkAra karichila, gatike coৱA, yAlimasakalara ki pariNAma haichila|
Aru siha~tara mAjara kichumAne iYAra prati ImAna poSaNa kare Aru kichumAne iYAra prati ImAna poSaNa nakare| (jAni thoৱA) tomAra pratipAlaka phAchAda sRSTikArIsakalara viSaYe bhAladarei aৱgata|

Aru yadi siha~te tomAka michA vuli asvIkAra kare tente tumi koৱA, mora kAmara dAYitva mora oparata Aru tomAlokara kAmara dAYitva tomAlokara oparata| mai yi kAma karo~ tAra lagata tomAlokara kono samparka nAi Aru tomAloke yi karA tAra lagata moro kono samparka nAi|
Aru siha~tara kichumAne tomAra prati kANa pAti thAke| kintu tumi vadhiravilAkaka kivA zunAva pArivAne yadio siha~te eko vuji nApAYa?
Aru siha~tara mAjara kichumAne tomAra prati cAi thAke| eteke tumi andhaka patha dekhuৱAva pArivAne, yadio siha~tara dRSTizakti nAthAke?
nizcaYa AllAhe mAnuhara prati kono anyAYa nakare, varaM mAnuhe nijei nijara prati anyAYa kari thAke|

Aru yidinA teOM siha~taka ekatrita kariva (sei dinA siha~tara ene lAgiva yenivA pRthiৱIta) keৱla siha~tara aৱsthiti dinara eTA muhUrtakAla mAtra Achila; siha~te parasparaka cini pAva| aৱzye siha~ta kSatigrasta haiche yisakale AllAhara sAkSAtaka michA vuli bhAvichila Aru siha~ta satpatha prApta nAchila|

Aru Ami siha~taka yi (zAstira) pratizruti dicho~ tAre alapa yadi tomAka (pRthiৱIte) dekhuৱAi diOM athavA (siha~tara oparata sei zAsti ahAra Agatei) tomAka mRtyu pradAna karo~, tathApio siha~te AmAra ocaralaikei ubhati Ahiva lAgiva; tadupari siha~te yi kare AllAhei tAra sAkSI|

Aru pratyeka ummatara vAvei ekojanakai rAchula Achila| eteke yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai rAchula Ahichila tetiYA siha~tara mAjata nyAYabhittika mImAMsA karA haichila Aru siha~tara prati kono anyAYa karA hoৱA nAchila|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA, (tente koৱA) ei pratizruti ketiYA pUrNa ha’va’?

koৱA, ‘AllAhe yi icchA kare tAra vAhire mora nijara kono apakAra vA upakAra karAro adhikAra nAi| pratyeka ummatara vAvei nirdhArita Ache eTA nirdiSTa samaYa-sImA; yetiYA siha~tara sei nirdiSTa samaYa Ahiva pariva, tetiYA siha~te muhUrtakAlo pichuৱAva noৱAriva Aru AguৱAvao noৱAriva’|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke koৱAcona, yadi teOMra zAsti tomAlokara oparata rAtita athavA dinatei Ahi pare, tente (sei zAstira mAjata) enekuৱA ki Ache yiToka apAradhIsakale ati sonakAle pAva vicAre’?
tente tomAloke eiTo saMghaTita hoৱAra pichata ImAna AnivA neki? (koৱA ha’va) etiYA (mAnilAne)?! athaca tomAloke iYAra Agamanakalai kharakhedA karichilA|
tAra pichata yAlimasakalaka koৱA ha’va, ‘sthAYI zAstira soৱAda loৱA; tomAloke yi karichilA tomAlokaka keৱla tArei pratiphala diYA haiche’|
Aru siha~te tomAra ocarata jAniva vicAre ye, ‘ei (zAsti)To sa~cAi neki’? koৱA, ‘haYa, mora pratipAlakara zapata! eiTo nizcaYa satya Aru tomAloke ketiYAo pratirodha kariva noৱArivA’|

yadi pratyeka anyAYakArI vyaktira ocarata pRthiৱIra samaparimANa sampada thAke, tente si sei goTeivora muktipaNa hicApe pradAna kari ha’leo nijake rakSA karivalai udyata ha’va Aru yetiYA siha~te zAsti pratyakSa kariva tetiYA siha~te (nijara) anutApa gopana kariva| tathApio siha~tara mImAMsA nyAYabhittika karA ha’va Aru siha~tara prati kono anyAYa karA naha’va|
jAni thoৱA! AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakalovora AllAharei| jAni thoৱA! AllAhara pratizruti satya, kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai nAjAne|
teৱe~i jIৱna dAna kare Aru teৱe~i mRtyu pradAna kare Aru teOMra ocaratei tomAlokaka obhatAi niYA ha’va|
he mAnaৱ! tomAlokara prati tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA upadeza Aru antarata yi (vyAdhi) Ache tAra pratiSedhaka lagate muminasakalara vAve hidAYata Aru rahamata Ahiche|
koৱA, ‘eiTo AllAhara anugraha Aru teOMra kRpAta (Ahiche); eteke siha~te ei viSaYe Anandita hoৱA ucita’| siha~te yi puJjIbhUta kare tAtakai eiTo adhika uttama|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke ei viSaYe ki koৱA, AllAhe tomAlokaka yi jIৱikA pradAna kariche tAra parA tomAloke kichumAnaka hAlAla Aru Ana kichumAnaka hArAma kari laichA’, koৱA, ‘AllAhe tomAlokaka iYAra anumati diche neki, ne tomAloke AllAha samparke michA racanA karA’?
Aru yisakale AllAha samparke michA raTanA kare, kviYAmata diৱsa samparke siha~tara dhAraNA ki? nizcaYa AllAha mAnuhara prati anugrahaparAYaNa, kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai kRtajJatA prakAza nakare|

Aru tumi yi aৱsthAtei nathakA kiYa Aru tumi sei samparke koraAnara parA yiToৱei tilAৱta karA Aru tomAloke yi Amalei nakarA kiYa, Ami tomAlokara sAkSI thAko~, yetiYA tomAloke tAta pravRtta hoৱA| AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra aNu parimANa vastuo tomAra pratipAlakara dRSTira agocara nahaYa Aru tAtakaio kSudra vA vRhata ekoৱei nAi yiTora viSaYe suspaSTa kitAvata (lAohe mAhaphujata lipivaddha) nAi|
jAni thoৱA! AllAhara vandhusakalara kono bhaYa nAi Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va|
yisakale ImAna Anichila Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karichila|
teOMlokara vAvei Ache susaMvAda pArthiৱ jIৱnata Aru AkhirAtato, AllAhara vANIra kono parivartana nAi; eiToৱei haiche mahAsaphalatA|
Aru siha~tara kathAi yAte tomAka cintita nakare| nizcaYa sakalo dharaNara mAna-maryAdA keৱla AllAhara vAvei; teOM sarvazrotA sarvajJa|

jAni thoৱA! nizcaYa yisakala AkAzata Ache Aru yisakala pRthiৱIta Ache siha~ta AllAharei; Aru yisakale AllAhara vAhire Anaka zvarIkarUpe AhvAna kare, siha~te kihara anusaraNa kare? siha~te keৱlamAtra dhAraNArahe anusaraNa kare, lagate siha~te keৱla michA kathAhe kaYa|

teৱe~i sei sattA, yijane tomAlokara vAve sRSTi kariche rAti, yAte tomAloke vizrAma kariva pArA Aru dekhivalai (sRSTi kariche) dina| yi sampradAYe kathA zune nizcaYa siha~tara vAve iYAta Ache vahuto nidarzana|

siha~te kaYa, ‘AllAhe santAna grahaNa kariche’| teOM mahAna paৱitra! teOM abhAৱmukta! AkAzasamUhata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo teOMrei| ei viSaYe tomAlokara ocarata kono pramANo nAi| tomAloke AllAha samparke ene kathA koৱA neki yiTo tomAloke nijei nAjAnA?
koৱA, ‘yisakale AllAha samparke michA raTanA kare, siha~ta ketiYAo saphala ha’va noৱAriva’|

pRthiৱItei siha~tara vAve Ache alapa bhogasAmagrI; tAra pichata AmAra ocaratei siha~te pratyAৱrtana kariva lAgiva| tetiYA Ami siha~taka kaThora zAstira soৱAda bhoga karAma; kAraNa siha~te kuphurI karichila|

Aru tumi siha~taka nUhara saMvAda pATha kari zunoৱA| yetiYA teOM nija sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! mora aৱsthiti Aru AllAhara AYAtasamUhara dvArA mora upadeza pradAna karATo yadi tomAlokara ocarata asahya haYa, tente maito keৱla AllAhara oparatei nirbhara karo~| eteke tomAloke nijara kartavya sthira kari loৱA Aru tomAloke yisakalaka aMzI karichA siha~tako mAtA, pichata yAte kartavya viSaYata tomAlokara kono aspaSTatA nAthAke| tAra pichata mora viSaYe tomAlokara yi karivalagIYA Ache karA Aru moka akaNo aৱkAza nidivA’|

‘tathApio yadi tomAloke mora parA phAlari kATi yoৱA tente maito tomAlokara ocarata kono pArizramika vicarA nAi, mora pArizramika Ache keৱla AllAhara ocarata, Aru mai muchalimasakalara antarbhukta ha’valai AdezaprApta haicho~’|

tathApio siha~te teOMka michA vuli asvIkAra karichila; phalata Ami teOMka Aru teOMra saite yisakale nAৱ~ta ArohaNa karichila teOMlokaka uddhAra karichilo~ Aru teOMlokaka pratinidhi vanAichilo~; AnahAte yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichila siha~taka DuvAi mArichilo~| gatike coৱA, yisakalaka satarka karA haichila siha~tara kenekuৱA pariNAma haichila?

nUhara pichata Ami vahuto rAchulaka teOMlokara nija nija sampradAYara ocaralai preraNa karichilo~; eteke teOMloke siha~tara ocaralai spaSTa pramANAdisaha Agamana karichila| kintu siha~te yiToka Agatei asvIkAra karichila tAta ImAna Anivalai siha~ta dunAi prastuta nAchila| eidarei Ami sImAlaMghanakArIsakalara hRdaYata mohara mAri diOM|
tAra pichata Ami muchA Aru hArunaka AmAra nidarzanasaha phiraAuna Aru tAra pariSadavargara ocaralai preraNa karichilo~| kintu siha~te ahaMkAra karichila, kAraNa siha~ta Achila aparAdhI sampradAYa|
eteke yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai AmAra taraphara parA satya Ahila tetiYA siha~te ka’le, ‘eYA nizcaYa spaSTa yAdu’|
muchAi ka’le, ‘satya yihetu tomAlokara ocaralai Ahiche, etiYA tomAloke eidare (yAdu vuli) kai AchA? eiTo yAdu neki? athaca yAdukarasakale ketiYAo saphala nahaYa’|

siha~te ka’le, tumi AmAka sei pathara parA vicyuta karivalai AhichA neki yi pathata Ami AmAra pitR-puruSasakalaka pAicho~, lagate pRthiৱIta tomAloka dujanara Adhipatya vistAra karivalai AhichA neki? tomAloka dujanara oparata Ami vizvAsa nakaro~’|
Aru phiraAune (nijara mantrIsabhAka samvodhana kari) ka’le, ‘mora ocaralai sakalo sudakSa yAdukaraka upasthita karA’|
eteke yetiYA yAdukarasakala Ahi upasthita ha’la tetiYA muchAi ka’le, ‘tomAlokara yi nikSepa karivalagIYA Ache nikSepa karA’|

phalata yetiYA siha~te nikSepa karile, tetiYA muchAi ka’le, ‘tomAloke yi lai AhichA seYA haiche yAdu, nizcaYa AllAhe eivoraka etiYAi asAra (vAtila) kari diva| nizcaYa AllAhe azAnti sRSTikArIsakalara karmaka sArthaka nakare’|
Aru AllAhe teOMra vANIra dvArA satyaka pratiSThita kariva yadio aparAdhIsakale iYAka apachanda kare|

kintu phiraAuna Aru tAra pariSadavargai niryAtana kariva vuli AzaMkA kari muchAra sampradAYara eTA saru yuৱka dalara vAhire Ana koneo teOMra prati ImAna poSaNa karA nAchila| kAraNa phiraAuna Achila dezara zaktizAlI vyakti Aru nizcaYa si Achila sImAlaMghanakArIsakalara antarbhukta|
Aru muchAi ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! yadi tomAloke AllAhara oparata ImAna AnichA, tente tomAloke keৱla teOMra oparatei nirbhara karA, yadi tomAloke (prakRta) muchalima’|
tetiYA teOMloke ka’le, ‘Ami AllAhara oparatei nirbhara karilo~| he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAka yAlima sampradAYara utpIDa়nara pAtra nakarivA’|
‘Aru tumi AmAka tomAra anugrahara dvArA kAphira sampradAYara parA rakSA karA’|

Ami muchA Aru teOMra bhAtRra prati ahI preraNa karilo~ ye, ‘micarata tomAlokara sampradAYara vAve kichumAna ghara nirmANa karA Aru tomAlokara gharavoraka ‘kivalA’ tathA ivAdatara sthAna kari loৱA, Aru chAlAta kAYema karA lagate muminasakalaka susaMvAda diYA’|

muchAi ka’le, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumiYei phiraAuna Aru tAra pariSadavargaka pArthiৱ jIৱnata saundarya Aru dhana-sampada pradAna karichA, he AmAra pratipAlaka! siha~te iYAra dvArAi mAnuhaka tomAra pathara parA vibhrAnta kare| he AmAra pratipAlaka! siha~tara ei dhana-sampada vinaSTa kari diYA Aru siha~tara hRdaYasamUhaka kaThina kari diYA, yAte siha~te yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pratyakSa nakarAlaike ImAna poSaNa kariva noৱAre’|
teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloka duYore duA kavula karA ha’la| eteke tomAloka dRDha় hai thAkA Aru tomAloke ketiYAo najanAsakalara patha anusaraNa nakarivA’|

Aru Ami vanI IcharAilaka sAgara pAra karAlo~| phiraAuna Aru tAra sainyavAhinIYe auddhatya sahakAre Aru vidveSavazataH teOMlokara picha la’le| aৱzeSata yetiYA si Duvivalai dharile tetiYA ka’le, ‘mai ImAna Anilo~ ye, nizcaYa teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, yAra prati vanI IcharAile ImAna Aniche, Aru mai muchalimasakalara antarbhukta’|
etiYA (ImAna AnichA)! athaca itipUrve tumi amAnya karichilA Aru tumi azAnti sRSTikArIsakalara antarbhukta AchilA|
‘eteke Aji Ami tomAra zarIraToka rakSA karima yAte tumi tomAra paravartIsakalara vAve nidarzana hai thAkA| nizcaYa mAnuhara mAjata vahutei AmAra nidarzana samparke udAsIna’|

Aru aৱzye Ami vanI icharAIlaka utkRSTa AvAsa bhUmita vAsasthAna pradAna karichilo Aru Ami siha~taka uttama jIৱikA pradAna karichilo~, tathApio siha~tara ocaralai jJAna ahAra pichata siha~te vibheda sRSTi karichila| nizcaYa siha~te yi viSaYe vibheda sRSTi karichila tomAra pratipAlake siha~tara mAjata kviYAmatara dinA seiTora mImAMsA kari diva|

eteke (he navI!) Ami tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa karicho~ sei viSaYe yadi tumi sandeha poSaNa karA tente tumi siha~taka sudhi coৱA yisakale tomAra pUrve aৱtIrNa hoৱA grantha pATha kare; nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAra ocaralai satya Ahiche| seYe tumi ketiYAo sandeha poSaNakArIsakalara antarbhukta naha’vA|
lagate seisakala lokaro antarbhukta naha’vA yisakale AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche- anyathA tumio kSatigrastasakalara antarbhukta hai yAvA|
nizcaYa yisakalara viruddhe tomAra pratipAlakara vANI sAvyasta hai gaiche, siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
yadio siha~tara ocaralai sakalo nidarzana Ahi yAYa tathApio siha~te yantraNAdAYaka zAsti nedekhAlaike (ImAna poSaNa nakariva)|

eteke (siha~tara) kono eTA janapadavAsIYe kiYa ImAna poSaNa nakarile, yisakalara ImAne siha~taka upakAra karilehe~tena? kintu iunuchara sampradAYara vAhire, teOMloke yetiYA ImAna Anichila tetiYA Ami teOMlokara parA pArthiৱ jIৱnara lAJchanAmUlaka zAsti dUra karichilo~ Aru siha~taka kichu samaYara vAve jIৱnopabhoga karivalai dichilo~|
Aru tomAra pratipAlake icchA karile pRthiৱIra sakaloৱei ImAna Anilehe~tena; tente tumi mAnuhaka mumina ha’valai vAdhya karivA neki?
athaca AllAhara anumati avihane kAro pakSe ImAna poSaNa karA sambhaৱ nahaYa, Aru yisakale nuvuje AllAhe siha~tara oparatei (kupharIra) apaৱitratA sthApana kari diYe|
koৱA, ‘AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache seivorara prati lakSya karA| (jAni thoৱA) yisakale ImAna poSaNa nakare, nidarzanAৱlI Aru bhIti pradarzana tenekuৱA lokara kono kAmata nAhe’|
tente siha~te keৱla siha~tara pUrve yi ghaTiche sei anurUpa ghaTanAra pratIkSA kari Ache neki? koৱA, ‘tomAloke pratIkSA karA, maYo tomAlokara lagata pratIkSA kari Acho~’|
tAra pichata Ami AmAra rAchulasakalaka Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokaka uddhAra karicho~| eidare muminasakalaka uddhAra karATo haiche AmAra dAYitva|

koৱA, ‘he mAnaৱjAti! tomAloke yadi mora dvIna samparke sandeha poSaNa karA tente jAni thoৱA! tomAloke AllAhara vAhire yisakalara ivAdata karA mai siha~tara ivAdata nakaro~| varaM mai ivAdata karo~ AllAhara, yijane tomAlokaka mRtyu pradAna kare; Aru mai AdiSTa haicho~ ye mai yAte muminasakalara antarbhukta haOM’|
lagate (ei nirdeza diche) ye, tumi ekaniSThabhAৱe nijake dvInara oparata pratiSThita rAkhA Aru ketiYAo muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta naha’vA|
Aru tumi AllAhara vAhire Ana kAko AhvAna nakarivA, yivore tomAra kono upakAro kariva noৱAre Aru apakAro kariva noৱAre; Aru yadi tumi enekuৱA karA tente nizcaYa tumi yAlimasakalara antarbhukta ha’vA|

Aru yadi AllAhe tomAka kono kSatira dvArA sparza karAYa, tente teOMra vAhire Ana koneo seiToka dUra kariva noৱAre; Aru yadi AllAhe tomAra maGgala vicAre, tente teOMra anugrahaka pratihata karivalaio kono nAi| teOMra vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yAka teOM icchA kare tAra ocaratei seiTo pau~cAi diYe; Aru teOM parama kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

koৱA, ‘he mAnaৱjAti! nizcaYa tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara ocaralai satya Ahi pAiche| gatike yiYe satpatha aৱlamvana kariva si nijara maGgalara vAvei satpatha dhariva Aru yiYe pathabhraSTa ha’va si nijara dhvaMsara vAvei pathabhraSTa ha’va; Aru mai tomAlokara oparata karmavidhAYaka nahaYa’|
Aru tomAra prati yi ahI aৱtIrNa haiche tumi keৱla tArei anusaraNa karA, lagate AllAhe phaYacAlA nakarAlaike tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA, Aru teৱe~i sarvottama phaYacAlA pradAnakArI|
Alipha-lAma-rA,[1] ei (koraAna) enekuৱA ekhana kitAva yAra AYAtasamUha suspaSTa, suvinyasta Aru tAra pichata vizadabhAৱe vivRta prajJAmaYa, savizeSa aৱhita sattAra taraphara parA (aৱtIrNa);
(ei kathA koৱA haiche) ye, tomAloke AllAhara vAhire Ana kAro ivAdata nakarivA, nizcaYa mai teOMra taraphara parA tomAlokara vAve satarkakArI Aru susaMvAdadAtA|

lagate tomAloke nija pratipAlakara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karA, tAra pichata teOMra pine ubhati AhA, teOM tomAlokaka eTA nirdiSTa samaYara vAve eTA uttama jIৱna upabhoga karivalai diva Aru teOM pratyeka guNI vyaktika tAra prApya maryAdA pradAna kariva; Aru yadi tomAloke mukha ghUrAi loৱA, tente nizcaYa mai tomAlokara oparata mahA diৱsara zAstira AzaMkA karo~|
AllAhara ocaratei tomAlokara pratyAৱrtana Aru teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

jAni thoৱA! siha~te teOMra parA lukAvalai nijara vuku japAi rAkhe| jAni thoৱA! siha~te yetiYA nijake vastrara dvArA AcchAdita kare tetiYA siha~te yi gopana kare Aru yi prakAza kare, teOM seYAo jAne| antarata yi Ache, nizcaYa teOM sei viSaYe savizeSa aৱgata|

Aru pRthiৱIta vicaraNakArI pratiTo prANIra jIৱikAra dAYitva haiche keৱla AllAharei, Aru teOM seivorara sthAYI o asthAYI aৱsthiti samparkeo aৱhita; pratiTo viSaYa suspaSTa kitAvata (laohe mAhaphujata lipivaddha) Ache|

Aru teৱe~i AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIka chaYa dinata sRSTi kariche; Aru teOMra Arazva Achila pAnIra oparata; yAte teOM tomAlokaka parIkSA kariva pAre ye, Amalara kSetrata tomAlokara mAjata uttama kona? Aru yadi tumi koৱA ye, ‘nizcaYa mRtyura pichata tomAlokaka punarutthAna karA ha’va’, tetiYA kAphirasakale aৱzye ka’va, ‘eYA haiche spaSTa yAdu’|

Aru yadi nirdiSTa samaYara vAve Ami siha~tara parA zAsti sthagita rAkho~ tente siha~te aৱzye ka’va, ‘zAstika kihe ATaka kariche’? sAৱdhAna! yidinA siha~tara ocaralai eiTo Ahiva, seidinA eiToka siha~tara parA nivRtta karA naha’va Aru yi viSaYaToka siha~te ThATTA-vidrUpa karichila seiToৱei siha~taka Aguri dhariva|
Aru yadi Ami mAnuhaka AmAra phAlara parA rahamatara soৱAda lavalai diOM Aru pichata tAra parA seYA kADha়i laOM tente nizcaYa si hatAza Aru akRtajJa hai pare|
Aru yadi dukha-dainyai sparza karAra pichata Ami tAka sukhara soৱAda lavalai diOM tetiYA si aৱzye ka’va, ‘mora parA vipada-Apada dUra haiche’, Aru (tetiYA) si utphullita ahaMkArI hai pare|
kintu yisakale dhairyya dhAraNa kariche Aru satkarma kariche (teOMloke enekuৱA nakare) teOMlokara vAvei Ache kSamA Aru mahApuraskAra|

tente tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa karA haiche tAra parA kivA tumi varjana karivA neki Aru siha~tara enekuৱA kathAra vAve tomAra mana saMkucita ha’va neki ye, ‘tAra ocaralai dhana-bhANDAra kiYa aৱtIrNa karA nahaYa athavA tAra lagata phiristA kiYa nAhe’? (kintu he navI!) tumi keৱla ejana satarkakArIhe Aru AllAha sakalo vastura oparata karmavidhAYaka|

athavA siha~te ei kathA kaYa neki ye, ‘teOM eikhana nijei racanA kariche’? koৱA, ‘tomAloke yadi (tomAlokara dAvIta) satyavAdI hoৱA tente tomAloke iYAra dare dahaTA churA racanA kari lai AhA Aru AllAhara vAhire Ana yAka icchA (ei viSaYe sahayogara vAve) mAti loৱA’|

tathApio yadi siha~te tomAlokara AhvAnata sa~hAri nidiYe tente jAni thoৱA, eiTo AllAhara jJAna anusArei aৱtIrNa karA haiche Aru teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| eteke tomAloke AtmasamarpaNakArI (muchalima) ha’vAne?
yiYe pArthiৱ jIৱna Aru iYAra saundarya kAmanA kare, Ami enekuৱA lokaka pRthiৱItei siha~tara Amalara paripUrNa phalAphala pradAna karo~ Aru eikSetrata siha~taka kama diYA nahaYa|

iha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara vAve AkhirAtata (jAhAnnAmara) juira vAhire Ana eko nAi; Aru siha~te pArthiৱ jIৱnata yi (Amala) karichila AkhirAtata seivora niSphala hai yAva Aru siha~te yi karichila seivora Achila nirarthaka|

yiYe nija pratipAlakara taraphara parA ahA spaSTa pramANara oparata pratiSThita Aru yAra lagata Ache teOMra prerita sAkSI lagate yAra Agata Achila muchAra kitAva Adarza Aru anugrahasvarUpa, (enekuৱA vyakti seisakala lokara dare ne yisakale pRthiৱIra kAmanAta vibhora) varaM ukta guNa sampanna vyaktisakalei ei (koraAnara) oparata ImAna poSaNa kare| AnahAte vibhinna dalara yisakale iYAka asvIkAra kariva, agniYei ha’va siha~tara pratizruta sthAna| eteke tumi ketiYAo iYAta sandeha poSaNa nakarivA| eikhana tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA prerita satya (grantha); kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei vizvAsa nakare|

sei vyaktitakai adhika anyAYakArI Aruno kona ha’va pAre yiYe AllAha samparke michA racanA kare? enekuৱA lokaka siha~tara pratipAlakara sanmukhata upasthita karoৱA ha’va Aru sAkSI (phiristA)sakale ka’va, ‘iha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakale nija pratipAlakara viSaYe michA kaichila’| sAৱdhAna! yAlimasakalara oparata AllAhara abhizApa|
yisakale AllAhara pathata (mAnuhaka) vAdhA diYe Aru tAta vakratA anusandhAna kare; Aru iha~tei haiche AkhirAta asvIkArakArI|

pRthiৱIta AllAhaka vyartha karAra kSamatA siha~tara nAchila Aru AllAhara vAhire siha~tara kono sahAYakArIo nAchila; siha~tara zAsti dviguNa karA ha’va; siha~tara zunivalaio sAmartha nAchila Aru dekhivalaio nAchila|
iha~tei haiche seisakala loka yisakale nijei nijara kSati sAdhana kariche Aru siha~te yivora michA (upAsyaka) kalpanA karichila seivora siha~tara parA udhAo hai gaiche|
eiTo sunizcita ye, niHsandehe siha~tei AkhirAtata sarvAdhika kSatigrasta ha’va|
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche lagate nija pratipAlakara prati vinIta haiche; teOMlokei ha’va jAnnAtara adhivAsI, tAta teOMloka cirakAla thAkiva|

duYo dalara udAharaNa haiche enekuৱA, ejana haiche andha Aru vadhira, Aru Anajana haiche dRSTi Aru zraৱNazaktisampanna| tulanAta ei duYojana vyakti samAna ha’va pArene? (ketiYAo nahaYa) tathApio tomAloke zikSA grahaNa nakarivAne?
nizcaYa Ami nUhaka teOMra sampradAYara ocaralai paThiYAichilo~| (teOM kaichila,) ‘nizcaYa mai haicho~ tomAlokara vAve prakAzya satarkakArI’|
tomAloke AllAhara vAhire Ana kAro ivAdata nakarivA, nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve eTA yantraNAdAYaka diৱsara zAstira AzaMkA karicho~|

tAra pichata teOMra sampradAYara kAphira netAsakale ka’le, ‘Amito tomAka ejana AmAra nicinAi mAnuha vulihe dekhi Acho~, lagate Ami dekhi Acho~ tomAka keৱla seisakala lokei anusaraNa kare, vAhyika dRSTita yisakala AmAra mAjata adhama Aru AmAra oparata tomAlokara kono zreSThatva Ami dekhA poৱA nAi, varaM Ami tomAlokaka michalIYA vuli gaNya karo~’|

teOM ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! koৱAcona tomAloke, yadi mai mora pratipAlakara taraphara parA prerita pramANara oparata pratiSThita thAko~ Aru teOM yadi moka teOMra taraphara parA anugraha (navuoৱta) dAna kari thAke, Aru seiTo yadi tomAlokara cakuta napare, tente mai tomAlokaka seiTo mAnivalai vAdhya karima neki, athaca tomAloke seiToka apachanda karA’?

‘he mora sampradAYa! iYAra vinimaYata mai tomAlokara ocarata kono dhana-sampada nivicAro~| mora pratidAna keৱla AllAhara ocarata| yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokaka khedi diYAToo mora kAma nahaYa; teOMloke nizcitabhAৱe teOMlokara pratipAlakaka sAkSAt kariva| kintu mora dRSTita tomAloka haichA eTA ajJa sampradAYa’|
‘he mora sampradAYa! mai yadi teOMlokaka khedi paThiYAOM tente AllAhara zAstira parA (rakSA karivalai) moka kone sahAYa kariva? tathApio tomAloke upadeza grahaNa nakarivAne?
