‘Aru mai tomAlokaka ei vulio nakaOM ye, ‘mora ocarata AllAhara dhana-bhANDAra Ache’| mai gAYeva nAjAno Aru mai ei vulio nakaOM ye, ‘mai ejana phiristA’| tomAlokara dRSTita yisakala hIna, siha~tara viSaYeo mai eiTo nakaOM ye, ‘AllAhe siha~taka ketiYAo kalyANa pradAna nakariva’; siha~tara antarata yi Ache sei viSaYe AllAhei adhika aৱgata| (yadi mai ukta kathAvora koৱAhe~tena) tente nizcaYa mai yAlimasakalara antarbhukta ha'ma’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘he nUha! tumi keৱla AmAra saite vAdAnuvAda karichA--- atimAtrA vAka-vitaNDA karichA; gatike yadi tumi satyavAdI hoৱA tente tumi AmAka yi pratizruti dichA, seYA AmAra ocaralai lai AhA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘seiTo AllAihe tomAlokara sanmukhata Aniva pAriva yadi teOM icchA kare, Aru teOMka tomAloke vyartha kariva noৱArivA’|

‘yadi AllAhe tomAlokaka vibhrAnta kariva vicAre tente mai tomAlokaka upadeza diva vicArileo mora upadeza tomAlokara kono kAmata nAhiva| teৱe~i tomAlokara pratipAlaka, teOMra ocaratei tomAlokaka obhatAi niYA ha’va’|

athavA siha~te ei kathA kaYa neki ye, ‘teOM eikhana nijei racanA kariche’? koৱA, ‘yadi mai eikhana nijei racanA karicho~ tente ei aparAdhara vAve maYei dAYI ha'ma| kintu tomAloke yi aparAdha karichA tAra lagata mora kono samparka nAi’|
Aru nUhara prati ahI karA ha’la, ‘yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokara vAhire tomAra sampradAYara Ana koneo ImAna poSaNa nakariva| gatike siha~te yi kare tAra vAve tumi cintita naha’vA’|

‘tumi AmAra cakura sanmukhata Aru AmAra ahI anuyAYI ekhana nAo nirmANa karA Aru yisakale aparAdha kariche siha~tara viSaYe tumi mora ocarata kono Avedana nakarivA; nizcaYa siha~taka pAnIta DuvoৱA ha’va’|

Aru teOM nAo nirmANa karivalai dharile, yetiYAi teOMra sampradAYara netAsakale teOMra ocaredi pAra haichila, tetiYAi teOMra prati upahAsa karichila; teOM kaichila, ‘tomAloke yadi AmAkalai upahAsa karA, tente nizcaYa Amio tomAlokaka upahAsa karima, yenekai tomAloke upahAsa kari AchA’|
eteke tomAloke zIghrei jAniva pArivA, kAra oparata Ahiva enekuৱA zAsti yiToৱe tAka lAJchita kariva, Aru tAra oparata Apatita ha’va sthAYI zAsti|

aৱzeSata yetiYA AmAra Adeza Ahi parila Aru caukA uthali uThila, Ami ka’lo~, ‘pratyeka jAtare eyora eyorakai (prANI) nAৱta tuli loৱA, lagate tomAra pariYAlako tuli loৱA kintu yisakalara viruddhe pUrva-siddhAnta haiche siha~tara vAhire, Aru anyAnya muminasakalako tuli loৱA| prakRtate teOMra saite kichusaMkhyaka lokehe ImAna Anichila’|
Aru teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke iYAta ArohaNa karA, iYAra gati Aru sthiti ha’va AllAhara nAmata, nizcaYa mora pratipAlaka, ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

Aru sei nAokhane parvatara dare taraGgara mAjata teOMlokaka lai gati karile; nUhe teOMra putraka mAtile, yijana Achila bhinna sthAnata, ‘he mora priYa putra! AmAra lagata ArohaNa karA Aru kAphirasakalara saMgI naha’vA’|

si ka’le, ‘ (nAlAge diYaka) mai kono ekhana parvatata gai AzraYa lama yiYe moka pAnIra parA rakSA kariva’| teOM ka’le, ‘Aji AllAhara Adezara parA rakSA karivalai kono nAi, kintu yAka AllAhe daYA kariva tAra vAhire’| enete taraGga eTA Ahi siha~tara mAjata antarAYa hai parila, phalata si Duvi marAsakalara antarbhukta hai ga’la’|

aৱzeSata koৱA ha’la, ‘he mATi! tumi tomAra pAnI grAsa kari loৱA, Aru he AkAza! kSenta hoৱA’| phalata pAnI hrAsa karA ha’la Aru siddhAnta vAstaৱAYita ha’la; Aru nAokhana Ala-judI parvatara oparata sthira ha’la, Aru koৱA ha’la, ‘yAlima sampradAYa dhvaMsa haoka’|

Aru nUhe teOMra pratipAlakaka AhvAna kari ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa mora putra mora pariYAlare antarbhukta Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratizruti satya, tumi vicArakasakalara mAjata ATAitakai zreSTha vicAraka’|

AllAhe ka’le, ‘he nUha! nizcaYa si tomAra pariYAlara antarbhukta nahaYa| aৱzye si haiche asatkarmaparAYaNa| seYe yi viSaYe tomAra kono jJAna nAi sei viSaYe tumi moka anurodha nakarivA| mai tomAka upadeza diOM ye, tumi ajJasakalara antarbhukta naha’vA’|

teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! yi viSaYe mora kono jJAna nAi sei viSaYe mai yAte tomAka anurodha nakaro~ tAra vAve mai tomAra ocarata AzraYa prArthanA karicho~| tumi yadi moka kSamA nakarA Aru moka daYA nakarA, tente mai kSatigrastasakalara antarbhukta hai yAma’|

koৱA ha’la, ‘he nUha! AmAra phAlara parA zAnti Aru kalyANara saite tumi aৱtaraNa karA (nAৱra parA), (ei zAnti Aru kalyANa dAna karA haiche) tomAra prati Aru tomAra lagata thakA jAtisakalara prati; Aru kichumAna enekuৱA sampradAYo Ache yisakalaka Ami kichukAla (pArthiৱ) jIৱna upabhoga karivalai dima, kintu pichata AmAra phAlara parA yantraNAdAYaka zAstiYe siha~taka sparza kariva;

‘eivora haiche gAYevara saMvAda, Ami tomAka ahIra jariYate aৱhita karicho~, yivora iYAra Agata tumi janA nAchilA Aru tomAra sampradAYeo janA nAchila| gatike tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA| nizcaYa zubha pariNAma keৱla muttAkvIsakalara vAvei (nirdhArita)’|

Aru Ada jAtira ocaralai siha~tara bhAtR hUdaka (navI hicApe) preraNa karichilo~, teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke keৱla AllAhara ivAdata karA| teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono (satya) ilAha nAi| tomAloke keৱla michAhe racanA karA’|

‘he mora sampradAYa! mai tomAlokara ocarata iYAra vinimaYata kono pArizramika nivicAro~| mora pArizramikara dAYitva haiche sei sattvAra oparata, yijane moka sRSTi kariche| tathApio tomAloke vuji nopoৱAne’?

‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke nija pratipAlakara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karA, Aru teOMra ocaratei tAovA karA (ubhati AhA)| teOM tomAlokara oparata dhArASAra varaSuNa aৱtIrNa kariva; Aru teৱe~i tomAlokaka zakti pradAna kari adhika zaktizAlI kariva| eteke tomAloke aparAdhI hai mukha ghUrAi nala’vA’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘he hUda! tumi AmAra ocaralai kono spaSTa pramANa lai AhA nAi| gatike tomAra kathAta Ami AmAra upAsyavoraka eri nidiOM Aru Ami tomAra prati vizvAso nakaro~’|

Ami keৱla eiToৱe kaOM ye, ‘haYato AmAra upAsyavorara konovAi tomAka hAni kariche’| teOM ka’le, ‘nizcaYa mai AllAhaka sAkSI karilo~ Aru tomAlokeo sAkSI thAkA ye, nizcaYa seivorara lagata mora kono samparka nAi yivoraka tomAloke aMzI karA’,
‘keৱla AllAhara vAhire| eteke tomAloka sakaloৱe mili mora viruddhe SaDa়yantra karA; Aru moka akaNo aৱkAza nidivA’|

‘nizcaYa mai keৱla nirbhara karo~ mora Aru tomAlokara pratipAlaka AllAhara oparata; (bhU-pRSThata vicaraNakArI) yimAnavora jIৱ-jantu Ache, pratyekare Agaculi teOM dhari Ache (arthAt seivora teOMra pUrNa AYattAdhIna); nizcaYa mora pratipAlaka sarala pathata Ache’|

‘eteke tomAloke yadi vimukha hoৱA, tente (jAni thoৱA) mai yi vArtAsaha tomAlokara ocaralai prerita haicho~ seYA mai tomAlokaka aৱgata karicho~; Aru mora pratipAlake tomAlokara ThAita velega kono jAtika tomAlokara sthalAbhiSikta kariva Aru tomAloke teOMra kono kSati sAdhana kariva noৱArivA| nizcaYa mora pratipAlaka sakalo vastura rakSaNAvekSaNakArI’|

eteke yetiYA AmAra (zAstira) nirdeza Ahila, tetiYA Ami hUda Aru teOMra lagata yisakale ImAna Anichila teOMlokaka AmAra anugrahara dvArA uddhAra karichilo~ Aru teOMlokaka rakSA karichilo~ kaThina zAstira parA|

Aru ei Ada jAtiYe siha~tara pratipAlakara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichila Aru amAnya karichila teOMra rAchulasakalaka| AnahAte siha~te pratyeka pratApazAlI svairAcArIra nirdezara anusaraNa karichila|

Aru ei pRthiৱItei siha~taka abhizapta karA haichila Aru kviYAmatara dinAo siha~ta abhizapta ha’va| jAni thoৱA! Ada sampradAYe nija pratipAlakake asvIkAra karichila| jAni thoৱA! dhvaMsai haiche hUdara sampradAYa Ada jAtira pariNAma|

Aru Ami chAmUda jAtira ocaralai siha~tara bhAtR chalehaka (navI hicApe) preraNa karichilo~| teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke AllAhara ivAdata karA, teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono (satya) ilAha nAi| teৱe~i tomAlokaka mATira parA sRSTi kariche Aru tAtei teOM tomAlokara vasavAsa karAra vyaৱsthA kariche| gatike tomAloke teOMra ocarata kSamA prArthanA karA Aru teOMra pinei ubhati AhA| nizcaYa mora pratipAlaka ati nikaTaৱrtI, AhvAnata sa~hAri pradAnakArI’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘he chaleha! iYAra pUrve tumi AchilA AmAra AzAra pAtra| (etiYA) tumi AmAka seivora (upAsya)ra upAsanAra parA niSedha kari AchA neki yivorara upAsanA AmAra pitR-puruSasakale karichila? prakRtate tumi AmAka yi dharmara prati AhvAna kari AchA, sei viSaYe nizcaYa Ami vibhrAntikara sandeha tathA dvidhAdvandara mAjata Acho~’|

teOM ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! koৱAcona tomAloke, mai yadi mora pratipAlakara parA prerita pramANara oparata pratiSThita thAko~ Aru teOM yadi moka teOMra taraphara parA anugraha (navuoৱta) dAna kare, iYAra pichato yadi mai AllAhara avAdhya haOM, tente AllAhara zAstira parA moka kone rakSA kariva? gatike tomAloke keৱla mora kSatihe vRddhi kari AchA’|

‘he mora sampradAYa! eijanI haiche AllAhara uTa, tomAlokara vAve nidarzanasvarUpa| eteke iYAka AllAhara bhUmita cari khAvalai diYA| iYAka kono dharaNara kaSTa nidivA, anyathA Azu zAstiYe tomAlokaka AkrAnta kariva’|
tathApio siha~te tAika hatyA karile| tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke nijara gharata tinidina paryanta jIৱna upabhoga kari loৱA| eiTo enekuৱA eTA pratizruti yiTo ketiYAo michA nahaYa’|

phalata yetiYA AmAra (zAstira) nirdeza Ahi pAle, tetiYA Ami chaleha Aru teOMra lagata yisakale ImAna Anichila teOMlokaka AmAra anugrahara dvArA uddhAra karilo~ Aru rakSA karilo~ seidinAra lAJchanAra parA| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i mahA zaktimAna, mahAparAkramazAlI|
Aru yisakale anyAYa karichila siha~taka eTA bhISaNa zavdai AkrAnta karile; phalata siha~ta nija nija gRhate (mRta aৱsthAta) natajAnu hai pari ra’la;
yenivA siha~te ketiYAo tAta vAsa karA nAchila| jAni thoৱA! chAmUda sampradAYe nija pratipAlakara lagata kuphurI karichila| jAni thoৱA! dhvaMsai haiche chAmUda sampradAYara pariNAma|
Aru nizcaYa AmAra phiristAsakale susaMvAda lai ivrAhImara ocarata Ahi ka’le, ‘chAlAma’| teৱo~ (uttarata) ka’le, ‘chAlAma’| tAra pichata teOM palama nakari eTA kAvAvakRta dAmuri lai Ahila|

eteke teOM yetiYA dekhile ye, teOMlokara hAta sei khAdyara phAle prasArita hoৱA nAi, tetiYA teOMlokaka avAJchita vuli bhAvile Aru teOMlokara viSaYe teOMra manata bhItira saJcAra ha’la| teOMloke ka’le, ‘bhaYa nakariva, Ami lUta sampradAYara pratihe prerita haicho~’|
Aru teOMra strI thiYa hai Achila, phalata teOM hA~hi uThila| tAra pichata Ami teOMka (ivrAhImara strIka) susaMvAda dilo~ ichahAkvara, Aru ichahAkvara pichata iYAkUvara|
teOM ka’le, ‘hAYa, ki Acarita! mai santAna janma dimane! athaca mai ejanI vRddhA nArI Aru mora svAmIo haiche vRddha, nizcaYa eiTo eTA adbhuda kathA’!

teOMloke ka’le, ‘AllAhara kAmata tumi vismaYavodha karichA neki? he navIra pariYAla! tomAlokara prati Ache AllAhara (vizeSa) anugraha Aru kalyANa| nizcaYa teOM prazaMsAra yogya Aru atyanta sanmAnita’|
tAra pichata yetiYA ivrAhImara sei bhaYa dUra ha’la Aru teOMra ocaralai susaMvAda Ahila, tetiYA teOM lUtara sampradAYara viSaYe AmAra (prerita phiristAsakalara) lagata vAdAnuvAda karivalai dharile|
nizcaYa ivrAhIma Achila atyanta sahanazIla, komala hRdaYa, sadAYa AllAha abhimukhI|
he ivrAhIma! tumi ei (vitarkara) parA virata hoৱA; nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlakara vidhAna Ahi pariche; Aru aৱzye siha~tara prati Ahiva enekuৱA eTA zAsti yiToka pratirodha karA sambhaৱ nahaYa|

Aru yetiYA AmAra prerita phiristAsakala lUtara ocaralai gai upasthita ha’la, tetiYA teOMlokara Agamanata teOM viSaNna ha’la Aru teOMlokara (surakSAra) viSaYaToka cintA kari teOMra hRdaYa saMkucita hai ga’la Aru ka’le, ‘Ajira dinaTo vara vipadara dina’!

Aru teOMra sampradAYara lokasakale teOMra ocaralai udbhrAnta hai dauri Ahila Aru Agara parAi siha~ta asatkarmata lipta Achila| teOM (lUte) ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! iha~ta mora kanyA, tomAlokara vAve iha~tahe vechi paৱitra| gatike tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru mora atithi samvandhe moka lajjita nakarivA| tomAlokara mAjata kono bhAla mAnuha nAine’?
siha~te ka’le, ‘tumito jAnAi, tomAra kanyAsakalara prati AmAra kono Agraha nAi; Aru Ami yiTo vicAro~ seiToo tumi nizcaYa jAnA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘hAYa! tomAlokara oparata yadi mora zakti thAkilahe~tena athavA mai yadi kono sudRDha় stambhara AzraYa lava pArilo~he~tena’!

teOMloke (phiristAsakale) ka’le, ‘he lUta! nizcaYa Ami AponAra pratipAlakara phAlara parA prerita phiristA| siha~te ketiYAo AponAra ocaralaike Ahiva noৱAriva| gatike Apuni rAtira kono eTA bhAgata AponAra pariYAlavargakalai olAi yAoka Aru AponAlokara konoৱei yena pichaphAle ghUri nAcAYa| keৱla AponAra strIra vAhire, kAraNa tAira oparato sei zAsti Ahiva yiTo siha~tara oparata Ahiva| nizcaYa prabhAta haiche siha~tara (zAstira) vAve nirdhArita samaYa| prabhAtara samaYa ati nikaTaৱrtI nahaYane vAru’?
eteke yetiYA AmAra (zAstira) Adeza Ahi parila tetiYA Ami janapadaka tala-opara kari dilo~ Aru siha~tara oparata kramAgata varSaNa karilo~ pakA mATira zila,
yiTo tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata (vizeSabhAৱe) cihnita Achila; Aru eiTo yAlimasakalara parA vechi A~tarata nAchila|

Aru mAdiYAnavAsIsakalara ocaralai siha~tara bhAtR zvuAivaka (navI hicApe) preraNa karichilo~| teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke keৱla AllAhara ivAdata karA, teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono satya ilAha nAi; Aru (zunA) jokha-mAkhata kama nakarivA; nizcaYa mai tomAlokaka sacchala aৱsthAta dekhi Acho~, kintu mai tomAlokara viSaYe eTA sarvagrAsI dinara zAstira AzaMkA karicho~’|
‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke nyAYa-saMgatabhAৱe jokha-mAkha karivA, mAnuhaka siha~tara prApya vastu kama nidivA Aru pRthiৱIta azAnti sRSTi kari nuphurivA’|
yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA tente AllAha pradatta aৱziSTa (lAbhAMza)khiniYe haiche tomAlokara vAve uttama; Aru mai tomAlokara tattvAৱdhAYaka nahaYa|

siha~te ka’le, ‘he zvuAiva! tomAra chAlAte tomAka ei nirdeza diYe neki ye, AmAra pitR-puruSasakale yisakalara ivAdata karichila Ami siha~taka varjana kariva lAgiva Aru Ami AmAra dhana-sampadata nijara icchAmate yi karo~ seYAo (varjana kariva lAgiva neki)? keৱla tumihe sahiSNu, sadAcArI’!

teOM ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke bhAvichAne, mai yadi mora pratipAlakara prerita spaSTa pramANara oparata pratiSThita thAko~ Aru teOM yadi moka teOMra taraphara parA utkRSTa jIৱikA dAna kare (tathApio mai mora kartavyara parA virata thAkimane?) Aru mai tomAlokaka yiTo niSedha karo~, mai nijeo tAra viparIta karivalai icchuka nahaYa| mai keৱla mora sakSama anuyAYI saMskArahe kariva vicAro~| mora kAryasAdhana keৱla AllAhara tAophIkata; mai keৱla teOMra oparatei nirbhara karo~ Aru mai teOMrei abhimukhI’|

‘Aru he mora sampradAYa! mora lagata karA vairitAi yena tomAlokaka ketiYAo ene aparAdha karivalai prarocita nakare yAra phalata tomAlokara oparato seidarei vipada Apatita ha’va yidare Apatita haichila nUhara sampradAYara oparata athavA hUdara sampradAYara oparata nAivA chalehara sampradAYara oparata; Aru lUta sampradAYa tomAlokara parA vechi dUrata nAchila’|
‘Aru tomAloke nija pratipAlakara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karA Aru teOMra pine ubhati AhA| nizcaYa mora pratipAlaka parama daYAlu, ati snehazIla’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘he zvuAiva! tumi yi koৱA tAre vahu kathA Ami vujiYe nApAOM, Aru niHsandehe Ami tomAka AmAra mAjata durvala vulihe gama pAOM| tomAra AtmIYa-svajana nAthAkile Ami tomAka zilaguTi daliYAi mAri pelAlo~he~tena| kAraNa tumi AmAtakai vechi zaktizAlI nahaYa’|

teOM ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAlokara ocarata mora AtmIYa-svajana AllAhatakai vechi zaktizAlI neki? athaca tomAloke teOMka sampUrNarUpe AokANa karichA| tomAloke yi karA nizcaYa mora pratipAlake seYA pariveSTana kari Ache’|

‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke nija nija aৱsthAnata kAma kari yoৱA, maYo mora kAma kari Acho~| tomAloke zIghrei jAniva pArivA kAra oparata Ahiva lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti Aru kona haiche michalIYA| eteke tomAloke pratIkSA karA, maYo tomAlokara lagata pratIkSA kari Acho~|

Aru yetiYA AmAra (zAstira) Adeza Ahi pAle tetiYA Ami zvuAiva Aru teOMra lagata yisakale ImAna Anichila teOMlokaka AmAra anugrahata rakSA karilo~; Aru yisakale anyAYa karichila siha~taka eTA bhISaNa zavdai AghAta karile, phalata siha~ta nija nija gharate natajAnu hai (mRta aৱsthAta) pari thAkila|
yenivA siha~te ketiYAo tAta vasavAsa karAi nAchila| jAni thoৱA! dhvaMsai Achila mAdiYAnavAsIra pariNAma, yenekai dhvaMsa haichila chAmUda sampradAYa|
Aru nizcaYa AmiYei muchAka AmAra nidarzanAৱlI tathA spaSTa pramANasaha preraNa karichilo~|
phiraAuna Aru tAra netRvRndasakalara ocaralai| kintu netAsakale phiraAunara kAryakalApara anusaraNa karichila; athaca phiraAunara kAryakalApa saThika nAchila|
kviYAmatara dinA si tAra sampradAYara sanmukhata thAkiva| tAra pichata siYei siha~taka juita upanIta kariva| ya’ta siha~ta upanIta ha’va seiTo atyanta nikRSTa upanIta hoৱAra sthAna!
Aru abhizApe siha~taka ei pRthiৱIto laga erA nAchila Aru kviYAmatara dinAo neriva| seiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa puraskAra yiTo siha~taka pradAna karA ha’va!
eivora haiche janapadasamUhara kichumAna saMvAda, yivora Ami tomAra ocarata varNanA karilo~| eivorara kichumAna etiYAo vidyamAna Ache Aru kichumAna nirmUla haiche|

Ami siha~tara prati akaNo anyAYa karA nAchilo~, siha~ta nijei nijara anyAYa karichila| darAcalate yetiYA tomAra pratipAlakara (zAstira) nirdeza Ahi pAichila, tetiYA AllAhara vAhire siha~te yivora upAsyara ivAdata karichila seivora siha~tara kono kAmata ahA nAchila; oloTA siha~te siha~tara dhvaMsara vAhire Ana eko vRddhi karA nAchila|
yetiYA tomAra pratipAlake kono anyAYakArI janapadaka AkramaNa kare tetiYA eidarei AkramaNa kare| niHsandehe teOMra AkramaNa ati yantraNAdAYaka, mahAkaThina|
nizcaYa iYAta Ache sei vyaktira vAve nidarzana, yiYe AkhirAtaka bhaYa kare| seiTo ha’va enekuৱA eTA dina yidinA sakalo mAnuhake ekatrita karA ha’va; Aru seidinA sakaloke upasthita karA ha’va;
Aru Ami seiToka keৱla nirdiSTa eTA samaYara vAve vilamvita karicho~|
yetiYA sei diৱsaTo Ahiva tetiYA AllAhara anumati avihane koneo kathAo ka’va noৱAriva; eteke siha~tara mAjara kichumAna ha’va durbhagIYA Aru kichumAna ha’va saubhAgyaৱAna|
phalata yisakala durbhagIYA ha’va siha~ta thAkiva (jAhAnnAmara) juita, Aru tAta siha~te bhISaNa ciJara Aru ArtanAda kari thAkiva|

tAta siha~ta cirakAla thAkiva, yimAna dina AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI vidyamAna thAkiva, aৱzye tomAra pratipAlake velega kono icchA nakarAlaike; nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlake seiToৱei kare yiTo teOM icchA kare|

AnahAte yisakala saubhAgyaৱAna teOMloka thAkiva jAnnAtata| tAta teOMloka cirasthAYI ha’va, yimAna dina AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI vidyamAna thAkiva, aৱzye tomAra pratipAlake velega kono icchA nakarAlaike; eiTo eTA niraৱcchinna puraskAra|

eteke siha~te yivorara ivAdata kare sei viSaYe tumi saMzaYata naparivA, siha~teo seidarei (michA upAsyara) upAsanA kare yidare siha~tara pitR-puruSasakale karichila| nizcaYa Ami siha~taka siha~tara prApya sampUrNarUpe pradAna karima--- akaNo hrAsa nakaro~|

Aru nizcaYa Ami muchAka kitAva pradAna karichilo~, tAra pichata tAta matabheda ghaTichila| tomAra pratipAlakara pUrva siddhAnta nAthAkile siha~tara mImAMsA haiYe ga’’lahe~tena| nizcaYa siha~ta ei (koraAna) samparke vibhrAntikara sandehata nipatita|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlake siha~tara pratyekake tAra karmaphala sampUrNarUpe pradAna kariva| siha~te yi kare teOM sei viSaYe savizeSa aৱhita|
eteke tumi yidare AdiSTa haichA tAta avicala thAkA Aru tomAra saite yisakale tAovA kariche teOMlokeo; Aru tomAloke sImAlaMghana nakarivA, tomAloke yi karA nizcaYa teOM sei viSaYe samyaka draSTA|

Aru yisakale anyAYa kariche siha~tara prati tomAloke DhAla nAkhAvA; ene karile tomAlokaka juYe sparza kariva| tene aৱsthAta AllAhara vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono sahAYaka nAthAkiva| phalata tomAlokaka kono sahAYa karA naha’va|
Aru tumi chAlAta kAYema karA, dinara duYo prAntabhAgata Aru rAtira prathamAMzata| nizcaYa satkarmai asatkarmaka dUra kare| upadeza grahaNakArIsakalara vAve eiTo eTA upadeza|
Aru tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA, kAraNa nizcaYa AllAhe satkarmazIlasakalara pratidAna vinaSTa nakare|

eteke tomAlokara pUrve yivora prajanma ativAhita haiche siha~tara mAjata enekuৱA prajJAৱAna kiYa hoৱA nAi, yisakale pRthiৱIta azAnti sRSTira parA niSedha karilehe~tena? kichusaMkhyaka lokara vAhire, yisakalaka Ami siha~tara mAjara parA rakSA karichilo~| AnahAte yisakale anyAYa karichila, siha~te vilAsitAra pichata pari Achila, Aru siha~ta Achila aparAdhI|
Aru tomAra pratipAlaka enekuৱA nahaYa ye, teOM anyAYabhAৱe kono janapadaka dhvaMsa kariva, athaca tAra adhivAsIsakala haiche saMzodhanakArI|
Aru tomAra pratipAlake icchA karile sakalo mAnuhakei eTA ummatata pariNata kariva pArileha~tena, kintu siha~te sadAYa mata-virodhahe kari thAkiva,

kintu teOMloka nahaYa, yisakalaka tomAra pratipAlake daYA kariche| kAraNa ei vAvei teOMlokaka teOM sRSTi kariche, lagate tomAra pratipAlakara ei kathAo cUDa়Anta haiche ye, ‘nizcitabhAৱe Ami jvina Aru mAnaৱ ubhaYara dvArA jAhAnnAma pUrNa karima’|

Aru rAchulasakalara eivora saMvAda Ami tomAra ocarata varNanA karicho~, yAra dvArA Ami tomAra manaka sudRDha় karo~, iYAra mAdhyamata tomAra ocaralai Ahiche satya Aru muminasakalara ocaralai Ahiche upadeza Aru smaraNa|
Aru (he navI!) yisakale ImAna poSaNa nakare siha~taka koৱA, ‘tomAloke nijara nijara aৱsthAnata kAma kari yoৱA, Amio AmAra kAma kari Acho~’|
‘eteke tomAlokeo pratIkSA karA, Amio pratIkSA kari Acho~’|

AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra gAYeva (ra saMvAda) keৱla AllAharei kartRtvAdhIna Aru teOMra ocaratei sakalo viSaYa pratyAৱrtana karoৱA ha’va| seYe tumi keৱla teOMrei ivAdata karA Aru teOMra oparatei nirbhara karA| kAraNa tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe tomAra pratipAlaka amanoyogI nahaYa|
Alipha-lAma-rA|[1] eivora haiche suspaSTa kitAvara AYAta|
nizcaYa Ami iYAka koraAna hicApe aravI bhASAta aৱtIrNa karicho~, yAte tomAloke vujiva pArA|
Ami tomAra ocarata uttama kAhinI varNanA karicho~, ahIra mAdhyamata tomAra ocaralai ei koraAna preraNa kari; yadio iYAra Agata tumi AchilA anaৱhitasakalara antarbhukta|
smaraNa karA, yetiYA iuchuphe teOMra pitAka kaichila, ‘he mora pitA! mai (saponata) eghAraTA nakSatra, sUrya Aru candraka dekhicho~, seivoraka mora prati chAjadAৱnata aৱsthAta dekhicho~’|
teOM ka’le, ‘he mora putra! tomAra saponara kathA ketiYAo tomAra bhAtRsakalaka naka’vA; anyathA siha~te tomAra viruddhe gabhIra SaDa়yantra kariva| nizcaYa caYatAna haiche mAnuhara prakAzya zatru’|

Aru eidare tomAra pratipAlake tomAka manonIta kariva Aru tomAka saponara vyAkhyA zikSA diva Aru tomAra oparata lagate iYAkUvara pariYAlara oparata teOMra anugraha pUrNa kariva, yenekai teOM eiTo pUrNa karichila iYAra Agata tomAra pitR-puruSa ivrAhIma Aru ichahAkvara oparata| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYa iuchupha Aru teOMra bhAtRsakalara kAhinIta praznakArIsakalara vAve vahuto nidarzana Ache|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA siha~te (teOMra bhAtRsakale) kaichila, ‘AmAra pitRra ocarata iuchupha Aru teOMra (sahodara) bhAihe AmAtakai vechi priYa, athaca Ami eTA saMhata dala; nizcaYa AmAra pitR spaSTa vibhrAntita Ache’|

‘tomAloke iuchuphaka hatyA karA athavA kono eTA (dUraৱrtI) ThAita tAka pelAi thai AhA, tetiYAhe tomAlokara pitRra dRSTi keৱla tomAlokara pinei niviSTa ha’va Aru tAra pichata tomAloke (tAovA kari) sat hai yAvA’|
siha~tara mAjara ejane ka’le, ‘tomAloke iuchuphaka hatyA nakarivA Aru yadi kivA karivai vicarA teneha’le tAka konovA eTA ku~ৱAta pelAi diYAgai, yAtrIdalara konovAi tAka tuli lai yAva’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘he AmAra pitA! AponAra ki ha’la, iuchuphara viSaYe AmAka Apuni kiYa nirApada vuli nAbhAve? athaca Ami tAra zubhAkAMkSI’|
‘Apuni kAilai tAka AmAra lagata paThAi diYaka, si Anandata khela-dhemAli kari ghUri phuriva Aru nizcaYa Ami tAra coৱAcitA karima’|

teOM (pitAi) ka’le, ‘tomAloke tAka lai ga’le sa~cAkaiYe eiTo mora vAve duzcintAra kAraNa hai pariva Aru mai AzaMkA karo~ ye, tomAloke tAra prati asAৱdhAna ha’le kukuranecIYA vAghe tAka khAi pelAva pAre’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘Ami eTA saMhata dala hoৱA satveo yadi kukuranecIYA vAghe tAka khAi pelAYa, tente nizcaYa Ami kSatigrasta’|

tAra pichata yetiYA siha~te tAka lai ga’la, Aru tAka ku~ৱAra mAjata nikSepa karivalai ekamata ha’la, (tetiYA) Ami tAra (iuchuphara) prati ahI preraNa kari janAi dilo~ ye, ‘nizcaYa tumi siha~taka siha~tara ei karma samparke (paraৱrtI samaYata) aৱgata karivA; tetiYA siha~te kalpanAi kariva noৱAriva’|
Aru siha~te rAtira prathama praharata kAndi kAndi siha~tara pitRra ocaralai Ahila|

siha~te ka’le, ‘he AmAra pitR! Ami daura pratiyogitA karivalai gaichilo~ Aru iuchuphaka AmAra vastu-vAhAnIra ocarata rAkhi thai gaichilo~; phalata kukuranecIYAi tAka khAi pelAiche, kintu Apunito vizvAsei nakariva, yadiOM Ami satyavAdI haOM|’

Aru siha~te tAra colAta michA teja lagAi Anichila| teOM ka’le, ‘(eiTo ha’va noৱAre), varaM tomAlokara ku-pravRttiYe tomAlokara vAve eTA kAhinI sajAi diche| gatike uttama dhairyya dhAraNa karAToৱe haiche mora vAve zreYa| tomAloke yi varNanA karichA sei viSaYe AllAhei haiche mora ekamAtra sAhAyyasthala’|

Aru ipine eTA yAtrIdala Ahila, siha~te siha~tara pAnI saMgrAhakaka pAnI Anivalai paThAi dile, si pAnI tulivalai nijara vAlTiTo namAi dile| si Anandata kai uThila, ‘ki sukhavara! eYA dekhona eTA zizu’! Aru siha~te tAka paNyadravya hicApe (vikrI karivalai) lukAi rAkhile| kintu siha~te yi karichila sei viSaYe AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|
Aru siha~te tAka ati nagaNya mUlyata, mAtra keiTAmAna dirahAmara vinimaYata vikrI kari dile Aru siha~ta Achila tAra viSaYe anAgrahI|

Aru micarara yijana vyaktiYe tAka kini laichila, teOM nijara strIka ka’le, ‘iYAra thakAra vAve sanmAnajanaka vyaৱsthA karA, sambhaৱtaH i AmAra upakArata Ahiva athavA Ami iYAka putrarUpeo grahaNa kariva pAri’| eidare Ami iuchuphaka sei dezata pratiSThita karilo~; yAte Ami tAka saponara vyAkhyA zikAva pAro~| kAraNa AllAha haiche nijara karma sampAdanata apratihata, kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei ei kathA nAjAne|
Aru teOM yetiYA pUrNa yauৱnata upanIta ha’la tetiYA Ami teOMka hikamata Aru jJAna dAna karilo~| eidarei Ami satkarmazIla lokasakalaka puraskRta karo~|

Aru teOM yijanI mahilAra gharata vAsa karichila, seijanIYe teOMka (upayAcikA hai yauna-milanara) kuprarocanA dile Aru duৱArasamUha vandha kari dile, Aru ka’le, ‘AhA’| teOM ka’le, ‘mai AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA karo~, nizcaYa teOM mora maniva; teৱe~i mora thakAra sundara vyaৱsthA kariche| nizcaYa yAlimasakala ketiYAo saphala nahaYa’|

Aru sei mahilAjanI teOMra prati Asakta haichila Aru teৱo~ tAira prati Asakta hai parilahe~tena yadi teOM teOMra pratipAlakara nidarzana nedekhilehe~tena| teOMka kukarma Aru azlIlatAra parA virata rakhAra vAvei Ami eidare teOMka nidarzana dekhuৱAichilo~| nizcaYa teOM Achila AmAra mukhalica vA vizuddhacitta vAndAsakalara antarbhukta|

Aru siha~ta ubhaYe dauri duৱArara pine ga’la, Aru mahilAjanIYe pichaphAlara parA (teOMka TAni dhari rakhAvalai laOMte) teOMra colA phAli pelAle, teOMloka ubhaYe mahilAgarAkIra svAmIka duৱArara sanmukhata pAle| mahilAjanIYe ka’le, ‘yiYe tomAra strIra lagata asatkarma karAra icchA kare tAra vAve kArAgAra athavA Ana kono yantraNAdAYaka zAstira vAhire Aruno ki daNDa ha’va pAre’?

iuchuphe ka’le, ‘eOMhe moka (yauna-milanara vAve) kuprarocanA dichila’| mahilAgarAkIra pariYAlara ejana sAkSIYe sAkSya dile ye, ‘yadi teOMra colATo sanmukhara parA phalA haiche tente mahilAgarAkIYe satya kathA kaiche Aru teOM (iuchupha) haiche michalIYA’|
Aru yadi teOMra colA pichaphAlara parA phalA thAke tente mahilAgarAkI haiche michalIYA Aru teOM (iuchupha) haiche satyavAdI|

eteke mahilAgarAkIra svAmIYe yetiYA dekhile ye, iuchuphara colA pichaphAlara parA phalA haiche tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘nizcaYa eiTo haiche tomAlokara (nArIsakalara) chalanA, nizcaYa tomAlokara chalanA ati sAMghAtika’|
‘he iuchupha! tumi ei viSaYaToka upekSA karA, Aru he nArI! tumi tomAra aparAdhara vAve kSamA prArthanA karA; nizcaYa tumi aparAdhIsakalara antarbhukta’|

Aru nagarara kichumAna mahilAi gAi phurichila ye, ‘AjIjara strIYe tAira kRtadAsa yuৱkara parA asatkarma kAmanA karichila, gabhIra preme tAika unmatta kariche, nizcaYa Ami tAika spaSTa vibhrAntita dekhi Acho~’|

ipine yetiYA mahilAjanIYe siha~tara ei cakrAntara kathA zunile, tetiYA siha~taka mAti paThiYAle Aru siha~tara vAve Asana prastuta karile| siha~tara pratyekake ekoTAkai churi-kaTArI pradAna karile Aru iuchaphaka ka’le, ‘siha~tara sanmukhalai olAi AhA’| phalata siha~te yetiYA teOMka dekhile tetiYA siha~te teOMra saundaryata abhibhUta ha’la Aru nijare hAta kATi pelAle Aru siha~te ka’le, ‘adbhuta AllAhara mAhAtmya! eOM mAnuha nahaYa| nizcaYa eOM haiche ejana mahimAnvita phiristA’|

mahilAgarAkIYe ka’le, ‘eOMৱei haiche sei vyakti yAra viSaYe tomAloke moka nindA karichilA| maYei teOMra parA asatkarma kAmanA karichilo~ kintu teOM nijake paৱitra rAkhiche; Aru mai teOMka yi Adeza karicho~ seiTo yadi teOM pAlana nakare, tente teOM aৱzye kArAruddha ha’va Aru nizcaYa teOM apadastasakalara antarbhukta ha’va’|

iuchuphe ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! ei nArIsakale moka yi kAmara prati AhvAna kari Ache tAtakai vandIzAlei haiche mora ocarata adhika priYa| tumi yadi moka siha~tara chalanAra parA rakSA nakarA tente mai siha~tara prati AkRSTa hai parima Aru ajJasakalara antarbhukta hai yAma’|
seYe teOMra pratipAlake teOMra prArthanAta sa~hAri janAle Aru teOMka siha~tara chalanAra parA rakSA karile| nizcaYa teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
phalata vibhinna nidarzanAৱlI dekhAra pichato siha~te bhAvile ye, teOMka kichu samaYara vAve kArAruddha karivai lAgiva|

teOMra saite Aru dujana yuৱka kArAgArata praৱeza karile| siha~tara ejane ka’le, ‘mai saponata dekhilo~ ye, mai AGura niHsAraNa kari mada prastuta kari Acho~’, Aru Anajane ka’le, ‘mai saponata dekhilo~ ye, mai mora mUrata ruTi kaDha়iYAi nicho~ Aru carAiYe tAra parA khAi Ache| Apuni AmAka iYAra tAtparya janAi diYaka, Ami dekhicho~ Apuni satkarmazIlasakalara antarbhukta’|

iuchuphe ka’le, ‘tomAlokaka yi khAdya diYA haYa sei khAdya ahAra Agatei mai tomAlokaka saponara vyAkhyA janAi dima| mai tomAlokaka yiTo janAma seiTo mora pratipAlake moka zikSA diche| (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa mai sei sampradAYara dharma mataka varjana karicho~ yisakale AllAhara oparata ImAna poSaNa nakare, Aru yisakale AkhirAtaka asvIkAra kare’|

‘mai mora pitR-puruSa ivrAhIma, ichahAkva Aru iYAkUvara millAtara anusaraNa karo~| AllAhara lagata Anaka aMzIdAra karATo AmAra vAve saMgata nahaYa| eiTo AmAra lagate samagra mAnaৱra prati AllAhara anugraha; kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei kRtajJatA prakAza nakare’|
‘he mora vandIzAlara saGgIdvaYa! bhina bhina asaMkhya pratipAlaka uttama ne eka AllAha uttama, yijana mahApratApazAlI’?

‘teOMra vAhire tomAloke kichumAna nAmarahe ivAdata kari AchA, yivora nAma tomAlokara pitRpuruSa nAivA tomAloke nijei rAkhichA; eivorara kono pramANa AllAhe aৱtIrNa karA nAi| vidhAna diYAra adhikAra keৱla AllAharei| teৱe~i nirdeza diche ye, ‘teOMra vAhire Ana kAro ivAdata nakarivA’| eiToৱei haiche zAzvata dvIna kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei seYA nAjAne’|

‘he mora vandIzAlara saGgIdvaYa! tomAloka dujanara ejane tAra manivaka surA pAna karAva Aru Anajanaka zUlaviddha karA ha’va; Aru carAiYe tAra magaju khuTi khuTi khAva| yi viSaYe tomAloke jAniva vicArichilA tAra siddhAnta hai gaiche’|

Aru siha~tara mAjara yijane mukti pAva vuli iuchuphe dhAraNA karile, tAka teOM ka’le, ‘tomAra manivara ocarata mora kathA ullekha karivA’| kintu caYatAne tAka teOMra viSaYe tAra manivara ocarata vyakta karivalai pAharAi dile| phalata iuchuphaka Aru keivA vachara kArAgArata thAkivalagIYA ha’la|

Aru rajAi (edinAkhana) ka’le, ‘mai saponata dekhilo~, sAtajanI hRSTa-puSTa gAi, siha~taka Ana sAtajanI kSINa gAYe bhakSaNa kari Ache Aru dekhilo~ sAtaTA sajIৱ zIha lagate Ana sAtaTA zukAna zIha| he pariSadavarga! yadi tomAloke saponara vyAkhyA kariva pArA tente mora saponara viSaYe abhimata diYA’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘eiTo arthahIna alIka sapona Aru enekuৱA saponara vyAkhyAta Ami abhijJa nahaYa’|
Aru sei dujana kArAruddhara mAjara yijane mukti pAichila, dIrghakAla pichata tAra smaraNa ha’la, si ka’le, ‘mai iYAra tAtparya AponAlokaka janAva pArima| seYe moka paThAi diYaka’|

si Ahi ka’le, ‘he iuchupha! he satyavAdI! sAtajanI hRSTa-puSTa gAi, seivoraka bhakSaNa kariche sAtajanI durvala gAYe Aru sAtaTA sajIৱ zIha lagate Ana sAtaTA zukAna zIha samvandhe Apuni AmAka vyAkhyA diYaka, yAte mai mAnuhara ocaralai ubhati yAva pAro~ Aru siha~te aৱgata ha’va pAre’|
teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke ekerAhe sAta vachara paryanta kheti-vAti karivA, tAra pichata tomAloke yi zasya kATivA tAre sAmAnya parimANa khAi vAkIkhini zIhasaha thai divA’;
‘iYAra pichata Ahiva sAtoTA kaThina (durbhikSara) vachara, ei sAta vacharata Agate yi saJcaYa kari rAkhivA, mAnuhe seYA khAva; keৱla sAmAnya parimANara vAhire, yiTo tomAloke saMrakSaNa kari rAkhivA’|
‘tAra pichata Ahiva enekuৱA eTA vachara, sei vacharata mAnuhara vAve pracura varaSuNa ha’va Aru sei vacharata mAnuhe phalara rasa cepi uliYAva’|

Aru rajAi ka’le, ‘tomAloke iuchuphaka mora ocaralai lai AhA’| tAra pichata yetiYA (rajAra) dUta teOMra ocarata Ahi upasthita ha’la tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘tumi tomAra manivara ocaralai ubhati yoৱA Aru teOMka sodhAgai, yi nArIsakale nijare hAta kATi pelAichila siha~tara aৱsthA ki! nizcaYa mora pratipAlaka siha~tara chalanA samparke samyaka aৱgata’|

rajAi nArIsakalaka (mAti Ani) ka’le, ‘yetiYA tomAloke iuchuphara parA asatkarma kAmanA karichilA, tetiYA tomAlokara ki haichila’ (teOM ei viSaYe sanmata haichilane)? siha~te ka’le, ‘adbhuta AllAhara mAhAtmya! Ami teOMra mAjata kono doSa dekhA poৱA nAchilo~’| AjIjara strIYe ka’le, ‘etiYAhe satya prakAza pAle, maihe teOMka prastAৱ dichilo~, Aru teOM nizcaYa satyavAdIsakalara antarbhukta’|
‘eiTo eikAraNe (karilo~) ye, yAte teOM jAniva pAre, teOMra anupasthitita mai teOMra prati vizvAsaghAtakatA karA nAchilo~ Aru nizcaYa AllAhe vizvAsaghAtakasakalara SaDa়yantra saphala nakare’|

‘Aru mai nijake nirdoSa vuli ka'va vicarA nAi, kiYano, nizcaYa mAnuhara naphace veYA kAmara nirdeza diYAToৱe svAbhAৱika, kintu sei vyaktira vAhire yAra prati mora pratipAlake daYA kare| nizcaYa mora pratipAlaka ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

rajAi ka’le, ‘iuchuphaka mora ocaralai lai AhA; mai teOMka mora nijara vAve Apona kari lama’| tAra pichata rajAi yetiYA teOMra lagata kathA pAtile, tetiYA rajAi ka’le, ‘nizcaYa Aji Apuni AmAra ocarata maryAdAzIla, pUrNa vizvasta’|
teOM ka’le, ‘moka dezara koSAgArara dAYitva arpaNa karaka| nizcaYa mai uttama rakSaka, suvijJa’|

Aru eidarei Ami iuchuphaka sei dezata pratiSThita karilo~; sei dezata teOMra ya’te icchA tAtei aৱsthAna karAra adhikAra Achila| Ami yAka icchA karo~ tAkei AmAra rahamata pradAna karo~; Aru Ami satkarmazIlasakalara zramaphala vinaSTa nakaro~|
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare teOMlokara vAve AkhirAtara puraskArei haiche uttama|
iuchuphara bhAtRsakala Ahila Aru teOMra ocarata praৱeza karile| phalata teOM siha~taka cini pAle, kintu siha~te teOMka cini nApAle|

Aru teOM yetiYA siha~taka siha~tara khAdya-sAmagrIra vyaৱsthA kari dile tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke mora ocaralai tomAlokara pitR pakSara vaimAtreYa bhAYekaka lai AhivAcona| tomAloke dekhA nAine, mai kenekai pUrNa mAtrAta pradAna karo~ Aru mai kimAna uttama athitiparAYaNa’|
‘Aru yadi tomAloke tAka lai nAhA tente tomAlokara vAve mora ocarata kono khAdya-sAmagrI nAi, Anaki tomAloke mora ocaralaikeo nAhivA’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘tAra viSaYe Ami tAra pitRka sanmata karivalai ceSTA karima Aru Ami eiTo nizcaYa karima’|

Aru iuchuphe teOMra karmacArIsakalaka ka’le, ‘siha~te yi paNyamUlya diche seYA siha~tara khAdya-sAmagrIra bhitarate rAkhi diYA, yAte siha~te pariYAlara ocaralai ubhati yoৱAra pichata seYA cini pAYa| phalata yAte siha~te Akau ubhati Ahe’|

eteke siha~te yetiYA siha~tara pitRra ocaralai ubhati Ahila, tetiYA siha~te ka’le, ‘he AmAra pitR! AmAra vAve parimApakRta khAdya-sAmagrI niSiddha karA haiche| gatike AmAra bhAYekaka AmAra lagata paThAi diYaka yAte Ami parimApakRta khAdya-sAmagrI pAOM| aৱzye Ami tAra hiphAjata karima’|

teOM ka’le, ‘mai tomAlokaka iYAra viSaYe tenekaiYe nirApada vuli bhAvima neki, yenekai iYAra Agata tomAlokaka nirApada vuli bhAvichilo~ iYAra bhAYekara viSaYe? kintu AllAhei rakSaNAvekSaNata zreSTha Aru teৱe~i sarvazreSTha daYAlu’|

Aru yetiYA siha~te siha~tara khAdya-sAmagrIra TopolA khulile tetiYA siha~te dekhivalai pAle ye, siha~tara paNyamUlya siha~taka obhatAi diYA haiche| siha~te ka’le, ‘he AmAra pitR! Ami Aru ki pratyAzA kariva pAro~? cAoka eYA Ami diYA paNyamUlya, AmAka Akau obhatAi diYA haiche| Ami AmAra pariYAlavargaka khAdya-sAmagrI Ani dima Aru Ami AmAra bhAtRra rakSaNAvekSaNa karima lagate Ami atirikta Aru eTA uTara (piThita) paNya Anima; ei parimANara zasya lai ahATo ati sahaja’|

pitAke ka’le, ‘mai tAka ketiYAo tomAlokara lagata napaThAOM yetiYAlaike tomAloke AllAhara nAmata ei aGgIkAra nakarivA ye, tomAloke tAka mora ocaralai ghUrAi AnivA, aৱzye yadi tomAlokaka ATaka karA haYa (tente seYA bhinna kathA)’| tAra pichata siha~te yetiYA teOMra ocarata pratijJA karile tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘Ami yi viSaYe kathA pAti Acho~, AllAhei iYAra vidhAYaka’|

Aru teOM ka’le, ‘he mora putrasakala! tomAloke eTA duৱArere praৱeza nakarivA, varaM bhina bhina duৱArere praৱeza karivA| AllAhara siddhAntara viparIte mai tomAlokara vAve eko kariva noৱAro~| Adeza keৱla mAtra AllAharei| mai teOMra oparatei nirbhara karo~, AllAhara oparatei nirbharakArIsakale nirbhara karA ucita’|

Aru yetiYA siha~te siha~tara pitRra Adeza mate praৱeza karile, tetiYA AllAhara Adezara viparIte seYA siha~tara kono kAmata ahA nAchila; iYAkUve keৱla teOMra manara eTi abhiprAYa pUrNa karichila, Aru aৱzye teOM Ami diYA zikSAre jJAnaৱAna Achila| kintu vechi bhAga mAnuhei aৱgata nahaYa|

Aru siha~te yetiYA iuchuphara ocarata praৱeza karile, tetiYA iuchuphe teOMra sahodara bhAYekaka nijara ocarate rAkhile Aru ka’le, ‘nizcaYa maYei tomAra sahodara bhAYeka, gatike siha~te yi karichila tAra vAve tumi dukha nakarivA’|

tAra pichata teOM yetiYA siha~tara sAmagrIra vyaৱsthA kari dile, tetiYA teOM nijara sahodara bhAYekara TopolAra mAjata pAnapAtra rAkhi dile| tAra pichata ejana AhvAYake ciJari ka’le, ‘he yAtrIdala! nizcaYa tomAloke curi karichA’|
siha~te teOMlokara phAle cAi sudhile, ‘AponAlokara ki herAiche’?
teOMloke ka’le, ‘Ami rajAra pAnapAtra herAicho~| yiYe seiTo Ani diva, si eTA uTara (piThita) vojAi parimANa khAdya-sAmagrI upahAra pAva; Aru iYAra nizcaYatAra dAYitva mora’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘AllAhara zapata! AponAloke jAnei dekhona ye, Ami ei dezata duSkRti karivalai ahA nAi Aru Ami coro nahaYa’|
teOMloke ka’le, ‘yadi tomAloke michalIYA hoৱA tente iYAra zAsti ki ha'va?
siha~te ka’le, ‘iYAra zAsti ha’va, yAra TopolAra mAjata sei pAtraTo poৱA yAva, siYei tAra vinimaYa’| eidarei Ami yAlimasakalaka zAsti pradAna karo~|

eteke teOM nijara sahodara bhAYekara TopolA coৱAra Agate siha~tara TopolAta tAlAcI Arambha karile, pichata teOMra sahodara bhAYekara TopolAra parA pAtraTo uliYAi Anile| enekai Ami iuchuphara vAve kauzala karichilo~| AllAhe icchA nakarile rajAra Ainata teOMra bhAtRka ATaka karATo saMgata nAchila| Ami yAka icchA karo~ maryAdAta ucca kari diOM| kAraNa pratyeka jJAnaৱAna vyaktira oparata Ache sarvajJAnI|

siha~te ka’le, ‘si yadi curi kariche tente (eYA kono Acarita kathA nahaYa) iYAra pUrve iYAra sahodareo curi karichila’| kintu iuchuphe prakRta viSaYaTo nijara manate gopana rAkhile Aru siha~tara sanmukhata prakAza nakarile| teOM (mane mane) ka’le, ‘tomAlokara aৱsthA ati jaghanya Aru tomAloke yi kai AchA sei viSaYe AllAhei adhika aৱgata’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘he AjIja! iYAra pitR atyanta vRddha; gatike iYAra ThAita AmAra mAjara konovA ejanaka rAkhi diYaka| AmAra dRSTita Apuni ejana satkarmazIla vyakti’|
teOM ka’le, ‘yAra ocarata Ami AmAra vastuTo pAicho~, tAra vAhire Anaka ATaka karAra aparAdhara parA Ami AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA karicho~| ene karile nizcaYa Ami yAlimata pariNata ha'ma’|

eteke yetiYA siha~ta tAra viSaYe sampUrNarUpe nirAza ha’la, tetiYA siha~te parAmarza karivalai ekAntabhAৱe goTa khAle| siha~tara mAjara DAGara jane ka’le, ‘tomAlokara manata Achene tomAlokara pitRYe tomAlokara parA AllAhara nAmata aGgIkAra laiche Aru iYAra Agateo tomAloke iuchuphara viSaYe anyAYa karichilA| gatike mai ketiYAo ei deza eri nAyAOM, yetiYAlaike mora pitRYe moka anumati nidiva athavA AllAhe mora vAve kono phaYacAlA nakariva Aru teৱe~i zreSTha phaYacAlAkArI’|

(gatike) tomAloke tomAlokara pitRra ocaralai ghUri yoৱA Aru koৱAgai, ‘he AmAra pitR! AponAra putrai curi kariche Aru Ami yi jAno tArei pratyakSa viৱraNa dilo~, Aru Ami gAYevI viSaYa samparke aৱgata nahaYa’|
‘(yadi vizvAsa nahaYa) tente yi janapadata Ami Achilo~ sei ThAira adhivAsIsakalaka sodhaka Aru yi yAtrIdalara lagata Ami Ahicho~ teOMlokako sodhaka| nizcaYa Ami sa~cA kathAke kai Acho~’|

teOM (iYAkUve) ka’le, ‘nahaYa, varaM tomAlokara ku-pravRttiYe tomAlokara vAve eTA kAhinI sajAi diche| gatike uttama dhairyyai haiche mora vAve zreYa; sambhaৱtaH AllAhe siha~ta ubhaYake ekelage mora ocaralai Ani diva| nizcaYa teOM sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa’|
teOM siha~tara parA mukha ghUrAi nile Aru ka’le, ‘hAYa Aphacoca! iuchuphara vAve’| zokata (kAndi kAndi) teOMra caku duTA gholA hai parichila Aru teOM Achila asahanIYa manastApata kliSTa|
siha~te ka’le, ‘AllAhara zapata! Apuni iuchuphara kathA sadAYa smaraNa kari thAkiva yetiYAlaike Apuni mumUrSa aৱsthAta upanIta nahaYa athavA AponAra mRtyu nahaYa’|
teOM ka’le, ‘mai mora asahanIYa vedanA Aru mora dukha keৱla AllAhara ocaratei nivedana karo~ Aru mai AllAhara taraphara parA seYA jAno yiTo tomAloke nAjAnA’|

‘he mora putrasakala! tomAloke yoৱA, iuchupha Aru tAra sahodarara sandhAna karAgai Aru AllAhara rahamatara parA tomAloke nirAza naha’vA| kAraNa AllAhara rahamatara parA kAphira sampradAYara vAhire Ana koneo nirAza nahaYa’|

eteke yetiYA siha~te gai iuchuphara ocarata upasthita ha’la, tetiYA siha~te ka’le, ‘he AjIja! Ami Aru AmAra pariYAlavarga vipanna hai paricho~ Aru Ami tuccha pu~ji lai Ahicho~; gatike Apuni AmAka khAdya-sAmagrI pUrNa mAtrAta pradAna karaka Aru AmAra prati anugraha karaka; nizcaYa AllAhe anugrahakArI-sakalaka puraskRta kare’|
iuchuphe ka’le, ‘tomAloke jAnAne, tomAloke iuchupha Aru teOMra sahodarara lagata ki AcaraNa karichilA, yetiYA tomAloka AchilA (pariNAma samparke) ajJa’?

siha~te ka’le, ‘tente tumiYei iuchupha neki’? teOM ka’le, ‘haYa, maYei iuchupha Aru eOM haiche mora bhAiTi; nizcaYa AllAhe AmAra oparata anugraha kariche| nizcaYa yi vyaktiYe tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare Aru dhairyya dhAraNa kare, (jAni thoৱA) nizcitabhAৱe AllAhe tenekuৱA satkarmazIla lokasakalara zramaphala vinaSTa nakare’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘AllAhara zapata! AllAhe nizcaYa tomAka AmAra oparata prAdhAnya diche Aru niHsandehe Ami Achilo~ aparAdhI’|
teOM ka’le, ‘Aji tomAlokara viruddhe kono garihaNA nAi| AllAhe tomAlokaka kSamA karaka Aru teৱe~i zreSTha daYAlu’|
‘tomAloke mora ei colATo lai yoৱA Aru eiTo mora pitRra mukhamaNDalara oparata rAkhivA; tetiYA teOM dRSTi zakti ghUrAi pAva| lagate tomAlokara pariYAlara sakaloke mora ocaralai lai AhAgai’|
Aru yetiYA yAtrIdala olAi parila sei samaYate (iYAta) teOMlokara pitRYe ka'le, tomAloke yadi moka bhArasAmyahIna vRddha vuli nabhavA tente mai kaOM ye, ‘mai iuchuphara ghrANa pAi Acho~’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘AllAhara zapata! Apuni etiYAo sei puraNi vibhrAntitei Ache’|

tAra pichata yetiYA susaMvAdavAhaka Ahi upasthita ha’la Aru teOMra mukhamaNDalara oparata colATo rAkhile, tetiYA teOM nijara dRSTi zakti ghUrAi pAle| teOM ka’le, ‘mai tomAlokaka koৱA nAchilone ye, mai AllAhara taraphara parA yi jAno tomAloke seYA nAjAnA’?
siha~te ka’le, ‘he AmAra pitR! AmAra gunAhara vAve kSamA prArthanA karaka; nizcaYa Ami aparAdhI’|
teOM ka’le, ‘acirei mai mora pratipAlakara ocarata tomAlokara vAve kSamA prArthanA karima| nizcaYa teOM ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|
tAra pichata teOMloka yetiYA iuchuphara ocarata Ahi upasthita ha’la, tetiYA teOM pitR-mAtRka nijara kASata sthAna dile, Aru ka’le, ‘AponAloke AllAhara icchAta nirApade micarata aৱsthAna karaka’|

Aru iuchuphe teOMra pitR-mAtRka ucca Asanata vahuৱAle Aru teOMloka sakaloৱe teOMra sanmAnata chAjadAৱnata ha’la| tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pitR! eiToৱei mora saponara vyAkhyA; mora pratipAlake iYAka satyata pariNata kariche Aru teৱe~i moka kArAgArara parA mukta kariche Aru caYatAne mora Aru mora bhAtRsakalara samparka vinaSTa karAra pichato AponAlokaka marubhUmi aJcalara parA iYAta Ani teOM mora prati anugraha kariche| nizcaYa mora pratipAlake yi icchA kare seYA nipuNatAra saite kare| nizcaYa teৱe~i sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa’|

‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumiYei moka rAjatva dAna karichA Aru saponara vyAkhyA zikSA dichA| he AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sraSTA! tumiYei pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata mora abhibhAৱka| tumi moka muchalima aৱsthAta mutyu pradAna karA Aru moka satkarmaparAYaNasakalara antarbhukta karA’|
eivora haiche gAYevara saMvAda, yivora Ami ahIra dvArA tomAka janAi Acho~, yetiYA siha~te aikyamatata upanIta hai SaDa়yantra racichila, tetiYA tumi siha~tara kASata nAchilA|
Aru tumi yimAnei AkAMkSA nakarA kiYa, adhikAMza mAnuhei ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
athaca tumi siha~tara parA kono pratidAno vicarA nAi| ei (koraAna) haiche sRSTijagatara vAve upadezamAtra|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta vahuto nidarzana Ache; siha~te eivora dekhe kintu siha~te eivorara prati udAsIna|
siha~tara sarahabhAga mAnuhei ImAna poSaNa karA satveo AllAhara lagata aMzIdAra sthApana (zvirka) kare|
tente siha~ta AllAhara sarvagrAsI zAstira parA, nAivA siha~tara ajAnite kviYAmatara Akasmika Agamanara parA siha~ta nirApada hai gaiche neki?
koৱA, ‘eiToৱei haiche mora patha, mai Aru mora anusArIsakale pUrNa vizvAsara saite jAni-vuji AllAhara prati AhvAna karo~| AllAha ati paৱitra, Aru mai muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta nahaYa’|

Aru Ami tomAra pUrveo janapadavAsIra mAjara parA keৱla puruSasakalakei richAlata pradAna kari preraNa karichilo~, yisakalara oparata Ami ahI aৱtIrNa karichilo~| ei lokasakale pRthiৱIta bhramaNa karA nAi neki? tetiYAhe dekhiva pArilehe~tena ye, siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara ki pariNAma haichila? nizcaYa yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariche teOMlokara vAve AkhirAtara AvAsei haiche uttama; tathApio tomAloke vuji nopoৱAne?

aৱzeSata yetiYA rAchulasakale (teOMlokara sampradAYara ImAnara parA) nirAza ha’la Aru mAnuhe dhAraNA karile ye, rAchulasakalaka michA pratizruti diYA haiche, tetiYA teOMlokara ocaralai AmAra sAhAyya Ahi pAle| tAra pichata Ami yAka icchA karilo~ tAka uddhAra karA ha’la| kintu aparAdhI sampradAYara parA AmAra zAsti ketiYAo rahita karA nahaYa|

siha~tara vRttAntata aৱzye vodhazakti sampanna vyaktisakalara vAve Ache zikSA| eikhana kono mane sajA racanA nahaYa| varaM eikhana haiche Agara granthavorata yi Ache tArei samarthaka Aru sakalo viSaYara vizada viৱraNa, lagate mumina sampradAYara vAve i haiche hidAYata Aru rahamata|
Alipha-lAma-mIma-rA,[1] eivora haiche kitAvara AYAta, Aru tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa karA haiche seYA satya; kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei ImAna poSaNa nakare|

AllAha seijana, yijane AkAzasamUhaka khu~TAvihIna oparata sthApana kariche, yiTo tomAloke dekhi AchA| tAra pichata teOM Arazvara oparata uThiche Aru sUrya Aru candraka niYamAdhIna kariche, pratyekaToৱe eTA nirdiSTa samaYalaike Aৱrtana kariva| teৱe~i sakalo viSaYa paricAlanA kare, AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe varNanA kare, yAte tomAloke tomAlokara pratipAlakara lagata sAkSAta samparke nizcita vizvAsa kariva pArA|

Aru teৱe~i bhU-pRSThaka vistRta kariche Aru tAta sudRDha় parvata Aru nadI sRSTi kariche Aru teৱe~i sakalo dharaNara phala-mUla yorA-yorAkai sRSTi kariche| teৱe~i dinaka rAtira dvArA DhAki diYe| nizcaYa iYAta cintAzIla sampradAYara vAve nidarzana Ache|

Aru pRthiৱIta Ache paraspara saMlagna bhUkhaNDa, AGgurara vAgicA, kheti pathAra, ekei mUlara parA udagata vA bhina bhina mUlara parA udagata khejura gacha yivoraka eke pAnIYei jIpAla kare, kintu soৱAdara kSetrata seivorara kichumAnaka Ami Ana kichumAnara oparata zreSThatva diOM| nizcaYa vodhazakti sampanna sampradAYara vAve iYAta Ache nidarzana|

Aru yadi tumi vismita hoৱA, tente (tAtokai) vismiYakara viSaYa haiche siha~tara ei kathAH ‘(mRtyura pichata) Ami yetiYA mATita pariNata ha'ma, tAra pichato Ami natuna jIৱna lAbha karimane’? iha~tei haiche seisakala loka yisakale nija pratipAlakara lagata kupharI kariche, Aru iha~tarei DiGita thAkiva zikali, Aru iha~tei ha’va agnira adhivAsI, tAta siha~ta sthAYI ha’va|

Aru siha~te maGgalara pUrvei amaGgala Anivalai tomAra ocarata kharakhedA kare| athaca siha~tara pUrve zAstira anurUpa vahu (zikSaNIYa) dRSTAnta pAra haiche| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka mAnuhara aparAdhara pichato siha~tara prati kSamAzIla, Aru (zunA) nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka zAsti pradAnato ati kaThora|

Aru yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~te kaYa, ‘eOMra pratipAlakara taraphara parA eOMra oparata kono nidarzana aৱtIrNa nahaYa kiYa’? nizcaYa tumi haichA ejana satarkakArI, Aru pratyeka sampradAYara vAve Ache patha pradarzaka|
pratyeka nArIYe garbhata yi dhAraNa kare Aru garbhAzaYata yi kame Aru vRddhi haYa seYA AllAhe jAne Aru teOMra ocarata pratyeka vasture eTA nirdiSTa parimANa Ache|
teOM gAYeva Aru prakAzya samparke aৱgata, mahAna, sarvocca|
tomAlokara mAjara yiYe gopane kathA kaYa Aru yiYe prakAzyabhAৱe kathA kaYa, rAtita yiYe Atmagopana kare Aru dinata yiYe prakAzyarUpe vicaraNa kare, (AllAhara jJAnata) siha~ta sakaloৱe samAna|

mAnuhara vAve tAra sanmukhata Aru pichata eTAra pichata eTAkai AgamanakArI praharI thAke, teOMloke AllAhara Adezata tAra rakSaNAvekSaNa kare| nizcaYa AllAhe kono sampradAYara aৱsthA tetiYAlaike parivartana nakare yetiYAlaike siha~te nijei nijara aৱsthA parivartana nakare| lagate kono sampradAYara vAve yadi AllAhe azubha kivA icchA kare tente tAka pratirodha kariva parA kono nAi Aru teOMra vAhire siha~tara kono abhibhAৱko nAi|
teৱe~i bhaYa Aru AzA saJcAra karAra vAve tomAlokaka vijulIra camaka dekhuৱAYa, Aru teৱe~i gadhUra megha sRSTi kare;

Aru rA’da (vajradhvani athavA phiristAra nAma) AllAhara prazaMsAra saite mahimA Aru paৱitratA ghoSaNA kare Aru phiristAsakaleo kare teOMra bhaYata| teৱe~i garjanakArI vajra preraNa kare, tAra pichata yAka icchA kare tAra dvArA AghAta kare, kAraNa siha~te AllAha samparke vAka-vitaNDA kare, Aru teৱe~i zaktita pravala, zAstita ati kaThora|

satyara AhvAna teOMrei| yisakale teOMra vAhire Anaka AhvAna kare, siha~te siha~tara AhvAnata akaNo sa~hAri nidiYe| varaM siha~tara dRSTAnta haiche sei vyaktira darei, yijane pAnIra phAle hAta prasArita (kari AhvAna) kare, yAte tAra mukhalai pAnI Ahe athaca enekai pAnI lAbha karATo sambhaৱ nahaYa| prakRtate kAphirasakalara AhvAna keৱla bhraSTatAtei nipatita|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta thakA sakalo vastuৱei svecchAi haoka nAivA anicchAi haoka AllAhaka chAjadAha kare, Aru puৱA-gadhUli seivorara chA~voreo (teOMkei chAjadAha kare)| (chAjadAha naM 2)

koৱA, ‘AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra pratipAlaka kona’? koৱA, ‘AllAha’| koৱA, ‘tente tomAloke teOMra vAhire ene vastuka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa karichA neki yisakale nijarei upakAra vA apakAra kariva noৱAre’? koৱAcona, ‘andha Aru dRSTisampanna vyakti samAna ha’va pArene? athavA andhakAra Aru pohara samAna ha’va pArene’? ne siha~te AllAhara lagata ene kichumAnaka aMzI kariche, yisakale AllAhara sRSTira darei sRSTi kariche, yAra vAve siha~tara ocarata sadRza vuli dhAraNA haiche? koৱA, ‘keৱla AllAhei sakalo vastura sraSTA, Aru teOM ekaka, mahA pratApazAlI’|

teৱe~i AkAzara parA pAnI varaSAYa, phalata upatyakAsamUha nija nija AYatana anuyAYI plAৱita haYa Aru plAৱne tAra oparara AৱrjanAvoraka vahana kari lai yAYa| eidarei AৱrjanAvora upari bhAgalai bhAhi Ahe yetiYA alaMkAra Aru saraJjAma taiYAra karivalai dhAtuka juita uttapta karA haYa| eidarei AllAhe satya Aru asatyara udAharaNa diYe| phalata AৱrjanAvora niHzeSa hai yAYa Aru yikhini mAnuhara vAve upakArI seikhini mATita sthiti laYa| eidarei AllAhe upamA diYe|

yisakale nija pratipAlakara AhvAnata sa~hAri diYe, teOMlokara vAve Ache zreSTha pratidAna; Aru yisakale teOMra AhvAnata sa~hAri diYA nAi, pRthiৱIra vukuta thakA sakalo sampada yadi siha~tara ha’lahe~tena lagate iYAra samaparimANa Aru kivAkivi thAkilahe~tena, teneha’le (AllAhara zAstira parA rakSA pAvalai) siha~te sei sakalo sampada muktipaNa hicApe divalai aৱzye prastuta ha’lahe~tena| (jAni thoৱA) siha~tara hicAva-nikAca ha’va ati kaThora Aru jAhAnnAma ha’va siha~tara AvAsasthala, Aru seiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa vizrAmasthala!

tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa haiche seiToka yi vyaktiYe satya vuli mAni laiche, seijana vyakti Aru andha vyakti samAna ne? nizcaYa keৱla vivekasampanna vyaktisakalei upadeza grahaNa kare|
yisakale AllAhara lagata karA aGgIkAra rakSA kare Aru cukti bhaMga nakare,
Aru AllAhe yi samparka aTuTa rAkhivalai Adeza kariche yisakale seYA aTuTa rAkhe, Aru nija pratipAlakaka bhaYa kare Aru bhaYa kare kaThora hicAva-nikAcaka,

Aru yisakale nija pratipAlakara mukhamaNDala (darzana vA santuSTi) lAbhara vAve dhairyya dhAraNa kare Aru chAlAta kAYema kare, lagate Ami teOMlokaka yi jIৱnopakaraNa dicho~ tAra parA gopane Aru prakAzyabhAৱe dAna kare, lagate bhAla karmara dvArA veYA karmaka pratihata kare, teOMlokara vAvei Ache AkhirAtara zubha pariNAma|

sthAYI jAnnAtasamUha, tAta teOMloka praৱeza kariva Aru teOMlokara pitR-mAtR, pati-patnI lagate santAna-santatisakalara mAjata yisakale satkarma kariche teOMlokeo (praৱeza kariva)| lagate phiristAsakale teOMlokara ocaralai upasthita ha’va pratyeka duৱArere,
(teOMloke Ahi ka’va) ‘zAnti varSita haoka tomAlokara oparata, kAraNa tomAloke dhairyya dhAraNa karichilA, AkhirAtara ei pariNAma kimAna ye uttama’!

AnahAte yisakale AllAhara lagata dRDha় aGgIkArata Aৱddha hoৱAra pichata seYA bhaMga kare, Aru yi samparka aTuTa rAkhivalai AllAhe Adeza kariche tAka chinna kare Aru pRthiৱIta azAnti sRSTi kari phure, siha~tara vAve Ache abhizApa, lagate siha~tara vAve Ache AkhirAtara nikRSTa AvAsasthala|

AllAhe yAka icchA kare tAra vAve jIৱnopakaraNa vRddhi kari diYe Aru saMkucita kare; kintu iha~ta pArthiৱ jIৱnaka laiYe Anandita, athaca pArthiৱ jIৱna haiche AkhirAtara tulanAta kSaNasthAYI bhogamAtra|

Aru yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~te kaYa, ‘eOMra pratipAlakara taraphara parA eOMra ocaralai kono nidarzana aৱtIrNa nahaYa kiYa’? koৱA, ‘nizcaYa AllAhe yAka icchA kare vibhrAnta kare, Aru teOM seisakala lokakahe teOMra patha dekhuৱAYa, yisakale teOMra abhimukhI haYa’|
‘yisakale ImAna Aniche, Aru teOMlokara mane AllAhara smaraNara dvArA prazAnti lAbha kare; jAni thoৱA! AllAhara smaraNara dvArAi antare zAnti lAbha kare’;
‘yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, teOMlokara vAvei Ache parama Ananda Aru sundara pratyAৱrtanasthala’|

eidare Ami tomAka preraNa karicho~ ene eTA jAtira prati yisakalara Agata vahuto jAti pAra haiche, Ami tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa karicho~, seYA yAte tumi siha~tara ocarata tilAৱta karA| tathApio siha~te rahamAnaka asvIkAra kare| koৱA, ‘teৱe~i mora pratipAlaka, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| teOMra oparatei mai nirbhara karo~ Aru teOMra ocaralaikei mora pratyAৱrtana’|

Aru yadi koraAnakhana enekuৱA ha’lahe~tena yAra dvArA parvataka gatizIla karA ga’lahe~tena Aru pRthiৱIka TukurA-Tukura karA ga’lahe~tena nAivA mRta vyaktira lagata kathA ka’va parA ga’lahe~tena, (tathApio siha~te tAka vizvAsa nakarilehe~tena)| varaM sakalo viSaYa AllAharei ikhatiYArabhukta| tente yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMloke nAjAne neki ye, AllAhe icchA karile sakaloke satpathata paricAlita kariva pArilehe~tena? Aru yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~tara karmakANDara kAraNe siha~tara viparyaYa ghaTiYei thAkiva, athavA viparyaYa siha~tara AvAsara ocare-pA~jare Apatita haiYe thAkiva, yetiYAlaike AllAhara pratizruti Ahi napare| nizcaYa AllAha pratizrutira vyatikrama nakare|

nizcaYa tomAra pUrveo vahu rAchulaka upahAsa karA haiche Aru yisakale kuphurI karichila siha~taka mai akaNamAna aৱkAza dichilo~, tAra pichata siha~taka karAYatva karichilo~| eteke kenekuৱA Achila mora zAsti!

tente pratyeka mAnuhe yi kare seivorara yijana paryavekSaka (teOM iha~tara ei akSama ilAhavorara dare neki?) athaca siha~te AllAhara lagata vahuto aMzIdAra vanAi laiche| koৱA, ‘tomAloke iha~tara paricaYa diYA| ne tomAloke pRthiৱIra mAjara enekuৱA kono saMvAda teOMka diva vicarA yiTo teOM nAjAne? ne (tomAloke keৱla) vAhyika kathAhe kai AchA’? varaM yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~tara dRSTita siha~tara cakrAntaka zobhanIYa kari diYA haiche Aru siha~taka satpathara parA A~tarata rakhA haiche, Aru AllAhe yAka vibhrAnta kare tAra kono pathapradarzaka nAi|
siha~tara vAve pArthiৱ jIৱnata Ache zAsti, Aru AkhirAtara zAsti iYAtakaio kaThora! AllAhara zAstira parA rakSA karivalai siha~tara kono nAi|

muttAkvIsakalaka yi jAnnAtara pratizruti diYA haiche, tAra upamA haiche enekuৱAH tAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita, tAra phala-mUla Aru chA~ ha’va cirasthAYI| yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariche, eiToৱe haiche teOMlokara pratiphala; AnahAte kAphirasakalara pratiphala haiche agni|

Aru Ami yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karicho~ teOMloke tomAra prati yi aৱtIrNa haiche tAkalai Ananda prakAza kare| kintu kichumAna dale iYAra kichu aMzaka asvIkAra kare| koৱA, ‘moka Adeza karA haiche mai yAte keৱla AllAharei ivAdata karo~ Aru teOMra lagata yAte Ana kAko aMzI nakaro~| mai teOMra pinei AhvAna karo~ Aru teOMra ocaratei mora pratyAৱrtana’|

eidarei Ami koraAnaka vidhAnarUpe AravI bhASAta aৱtIrNa karicho~| eteke jJAna poৱAra pichato yadi tumi siha~tara pravRttira anusaraNa karA tente AllAhara viruddhe tomAra kono abhibhAৱka Aru rakSaka nAthAkiva|

Aru nizcaYa Ami tomAra pUrveo vahuto rAchula preraNa karichilo~ Aru teOMlokako strI Aru santAna-santati pradAna karichilo~| AllAhara anumati avihane kono nidarzana upasthita karATo kono rAchulara dvArA sambhaৱ nahaYa| pratyeka viSaYara vAvei nirdhArita samaYa lipivaddha Ache|
(tAra mAjara parA) AllAhe yi icchA kare maci diYe, Aru yi icchA kare vAhAla rAkhe, Aru teOMra ocaratei Ache ummula kitAva|

Aru Ami siha~taka yi (zAstira) pratizruti diOM, tAre alapa yadi tomAka (pRthiৱIte) dekhuৱAi diOM athavA (siha~tara oparata seYA ahAra Agatei) tomAka yadi mRtyu pradAna karo~, -- tente tomAra kartavyato haiche keৱla pracAra karA, Aru AmAra dAYitva haiche hicAva-nikAca grahaNa karA|
siha~te dekhA nAine ye, Ami pRthiৱIka keuphAlara parA saMkucita kari Ani Acho~? Aru AllAhei Adeza kare, teOMra Adeza rada kariva parA kono nAi Aru teOM hicAva grahaNata ati tatpara|

siha~tara pUrve yisakala Achila siha~teo cakrAnta karichila; kintu sakalo cakrAnta AllAhara adhInastha| pratyeka vyaktiYe yi upArjana kare sei viSaYe teOM aৱgata, Aru kAphirasakale anatipalame jAniva pAriva ye, AkhirAtara zubha pariNAma kAra vAve|

Aru yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~te kaYa, ‘tumi AllAhara prerita nahaYa’| koৱA, ‘mora Aru tomAlokara mAjata sAkSI hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa, Aru yisakalara ocarata kitAvara jJAna Ache, teOMlokeo (ei viSaYe sAkSI)’|

Alipha-lAma-rA,[1] eikhana ekhana kitAva, yikhana Ami tomAra prati aৱtIrNa karicho~, yAte tumi mAnuhaka siha~tara pratipAlakara anumatikrame andhakArara parA poharalai uliYAi Aniva pArA, sei sattAra pathara pine yijana parAkramazAlI, sarvaprazaMsita|
AllAhara pathalai, yijana AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sakalo vasturei garAkI, Aru kAphirasakalara vAve Ache kaThina zAstira durbhoga,
yisakale pArthiৱ jIৱnaka AkhirAtatakai adhika bhAlapAYa Aru mAnuhaka AllAhara pathara parA virata rAkhe, Aru tAta vakratA anusandhAna kare; siha~tei haiche ghora vibhrAntita nipatita|

Aru Ami pratijana rAchulake teOMra sva-jAtira bhASAtei preraNa karicho~, yAte teOM siha~tara ocarata spaSTarUpe vyAkhyA kariva pAre| eteke AllAhe yAka icchA kare vibhrAnta kare Aru yAka icchA kare satpathata paricAlita kare; Aru teOM parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Aru nizcaYa Ami muchAka AmAra nidarzanasaha preraNa karichilo~ (Aru kaichilo~,) ‘tumi tomAra sampradAYaka andhakArara parA poharalai uliYAi AnA, Aru siha~taka AllAhara dinavorara (arthAt vibhinna sampradAYara zAstira dinavorara) dvArA upadeza diYA’| iYAta nidarzana Ache pratyeka parama dhairyyazIla Aru parama kRtajJa vyaktira vAve|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA mUchAi teOMra sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘AllAhe tomAlokara oparata karA anugrahavoraka tomAloke smaraNa karA, yetiYA teOM tomAlokaka rakSA karichila phiraAuna goSThIra kavalara parA, yisakale tomAlokaka nikRSTa zAsti pradAna karichila, tomAlokara putra santAnasakalaka javeha karichila Aru tomAlokara nArIsakalaka jIৱita rAkhichila; Aru iYAta Achila tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA eTA mahAparIkSA’|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAlokara pratipAlake ghoSaNA karichila, yadi tomAloka kRtajJa hoৱA tente nizcaYa mai tomAlokaka Aru adhika pradAna karima, Aru yadi akRtajJa hoৱA tente (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa mora zAsti ati kaThora|
Aru mUchAi kaichila, ‘yadi tomAloke Aru pRthiৱIra sakaloৱe akRtajJa hoৱA, tathApio nizcaYa AllAha abhAৱmukta, sarvaprazaMsita’|

tomAlokara ocaralai tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara saMvAda Ahi poৱA nAine, nUha sampradAYara, Ada Aru chAmUdara lagate siha~tara paravartIsakalara? yisakalara viSaYe AllAhara vAhire Ana koneo nAjAne| siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara rAchulasakale spaSTa pramANAdi lai Ahichila, tetiYA siha~te nijara hAta nijare mukhata sthApana kari kaichila, ‘tomAloke yi lai prerita haichA tAka Ami nizcitabhAৱe asvIkAra karicho~, lagate nizcaYa Ami vibhrAntikara sandehata Acho~ sei viSaYe, yAra pine tomAloke AmAka AhvAna kari AchA’|

siha~tara rAchulasakale kaichila, ‘AllAha samparke kono sandeha Ache neki, yijana AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sRSTikartA? teOM tomAlokaka AhvAna kare tomAlokara pApasamUha mocana karivalai Aru tomAlokaka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta aৱkAza divalai’| siha~te ka’le, ‘tomAloke dekhona AmAra darei mAnuha| AmAra pitR-puruSasakale yisakalara ivAdata karichila tomAloke keৱla siha~tara ivAdatara parA AmAka virata rAkhiva vicarA| eteke tomAloke AmAra ocaralai kono akATya pramANa lai AhA’|

siha~tara rAchulasakale siha~taka ka’le, ‘(sa~cA kathA) Ami tomAlokara darei mAnuha, kintu AllAhe teOMra vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yAka icchA kare anugraha pradAna kare Aru AllAhara anumati avihane tomAlokara ocarata pramANa upasthita karivalai AmAra kono kSamatA nAi’| AllAhara oparatei muminasakalara tAৱAkkula (bharasA) karA ucita|

‘Aru AmAra ki haiche, Ami kiYa AllAhara oparata bharasA nakarima? athaca teৱe~i AmAka patha dekhuৱAiche| (Aru zunA) tomAloke AmAka yi kaSTa di AchA, nizcaYa Ami ei kSetrata dhairyya dhAraNa karima| eteke nirbharakArIsakalara keৱla AllAhara oparatei nirbhara karA ucita’|

Aru kAphirasakale siha~tara rAchulasakalaka kaichila, ‘Ami tomAlokaka AmAra dezara parA nizcitabhAৱe vahiSkAra karima nAivA tomAloke AmAra dharmAdarzalai dharmAntarita ha’va lAgiva’| tAra pichata rAchulasakalaka teOMlokara pratipAlake ahI preraNa karile, ‘yAlimasakalaka Ami aৱzyei vinAza karima’;
nizcaYa Ami siha~tara pichata tomAlokaka ei dezata vAsa karAma; eiTo sei vyaktira vAve, yiYe AmAra sanmukhata upasthita ha’valai bhaYa kare Aru bhaYa kare AmAra zAstika|
Aru siha~te vijaYa kAmanA karile kintu pratyeka uddhata svairAcArI vyartha manoratha ha’la|
siha~tara pratyekare sanmukhata Ache jAhAnnAma Aru pratyekake seৱna karoৱA ha’va pU~jamizrita pAnI;

yiTo si ati kaSTare Dhoke Dhoke gili khAvalai ceSTA kariva, kintu sahaje giliva noৱAriva| keuphAlara parA tAra ocaralai Ahiva mRtyu-yantraNA, athaca tAra mRtyu naha’va, lagate iYAra pichata Ache ati kaThora zAsti|

yisakale nija pratipAlakara lagata kuphurI kariche siha~tara upamA ei ye, siha~tara Amalavora haiche bhasmara dare, yivoraka dhumuhAra dinata pravala vatAhe pracaNDa gatita uruৱAi lai yAYa| siha~te yi upArjana kare tAra ekoৱei siha~te nijara kAmata lagAva noৱAre| eiToৱei haiche carama vibhrAnti|
tumi lakSya karA nAine ye, AllAhe AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI yathAyathabhAৱei sRSTi kariche? teOM icchA karile tomAlokara astitva vilopa kariva pAre Aru eTA natuna sRSTika astitvalai Aniva pAre,
Aru eiTo AllAhara vAve eko TAna kAma nahaYa|

Aru siha~ta sakaloৱe AllAhara ocarata prakAzita ha’va| tetiYA durvalasakale ahaMkArIsakalaka ka’va, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara anusArI Achilo~, etiYA tomAloke AmAka AllAhara zAstira parA alapa ha’leo rakSA kariva pArivAne’? siha~te ka’va, ‘AllAhe yadi AmAka satpathata paricAlita karilehe~tena tente Amio tomAlokaka satpathata paricAlita karilo~he~tena| etiYA Ami dhairyyacyuta haOM athavA dhairyyazIla- ubhaYa aৱsthAi AmAra vAve samAna; AmAra paloৱAra kono ThAi nAi’|

Aru yetiYA vicArakArya sampanna ha’va tetiYA caYatAne ka’va, ‘nizcaYa AllAhe tomAlokaka pratizruti dichila, satya pratizruti; maYo tomAlokaka pratizruti dichilo~, kintu mai tomAlokaka diYA pratizruti bhaMga karicho~| tomAlokara oparata mora kono Adhipatya nAchila, mai keৱla tomAlokaka AhvAna karichilo~ phalata tomAloke mora AhvAnata sa~hAri dichilA| gatike tomAloke moka doSa nidivA, tomAloke nijei nijake doSa diYAgai| mai tomAlokara uddhArakArI nahaYa Aru tomAlokeo mora uddhArakArI nahaYa| tomAloke moka ye iYAra Agata AllAhara aMzI kari laichilA sei viSaYaToka nizcitabhAৱe mai asvIkAra karicho~’| nizcaYa yAlimasakalara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMlokaka praৱeza karoৱA ha’va jAnnAtata, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita| tAta teOMloke nija pratipAlakara anumatikrame sthAYitva lAbha kariva, tAta teOMlokara abhivAdana ha’va ‘chAlAma’|
tumi lakSya karA nAine, AllAhe kenekai upamA dAGi dhariche? kalimA tAYyivA (satvAkya)ra upamA haiche utkRSTa gachara dare, yAra mUla sudRDha় Aru yAra zAkhA-prazAkhA haiche AkAzata vistRta,
yiToৱe tAra pratipAlakara anumatikrame sadAYa tAra phala dAna kare; Aru AllAhe mAnuhara vAve upamA dAGi dhare, yAte siha~te zikSA grahaNa kare|
AnahAte asat vAkyara upamA haiche eTA veYA gachara dare, yAra mUla bhUpRSThara parA vicchinnakRta, yAra kono sthAYitva nAi|

yisakale ImAna Aniche, AllAhe teOMlokaka sudRDha় vAkyara dvArA pArthiৱ jIৱnata Aru AkhirAtata supratiSThita rAkhiva, Aru AllAhe yAlimasakalaka vibhrAntita rAkhiva| kAraNa AllAhara yi icchA seiToৱei kare|
tumi siha~tara prati lakSya karA nAine, yisakale AllAhara anugrahaka kuphurIra dvArA parivartana kariche? Aru siha~te nijara sampradAYaka namAi Aniche dhvaMsara AvAsata---
jAhAnnAmata, yAra mAjata siha~ta dagdha ha’va, Aru kimAna ye nikRSTa ei AvAsasthala!
Aru siha~te AllAhara vAve samakakSa nirdhAraNa kare, yAte siha~te teOMra pathara parA (mAnuhaka) vibhrAnta kariva pAre| koৱA, bhoga kari loৱA, aৱzeSata jAhAnnAmei haiche tomAlokara gantavyasthala|

mora vAndAsakalara mAjara yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokaka tumi koৱA, ‘chAlAta kAYema karivalai Aru mai teOMlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ tAra parA gopane Aru prakAzyabhAৱe vyaYa karivalai—sei diৱsa ahAra pUrvei yidinA kono kraYa-vikraYara suvidhA nAthAkiva Aru kono vandhutvao nAthAkiva’|

AllAha seijana, yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche, yijane AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa kare Aru tAra dvArA tomAlokara jIৱikAra vAve phalamUla utpAdana kare Aru teৱe~i nauyAnaka tomAlokara anugata kari diche, yAte teOMra nirdezata seivora sAgarata vicaraNa kare Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara kalyANata niYojita kariche nadIsamUhaka|
Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara kalyANata niYojita kariche sUrya Aru candraka, yivora avirAmabhAৱe ekei niYamara anuvartita, lagate tomAlokara kalyANata niYojita kariche dina Aru rAtika|

Aru teOM tomAlokaka pratyeka sei vastu pradAna kariche yiTo tomAloke teOMra ocarata vicArichA| yadi tomAloke AllAhara anugraha gaNanA karA tente (ketiYAo) tAra saMkhyA nirNaYa kariva noৱArivA| nizcaYa mAnuha atimAtrA yAlima, akRtajJa|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA ivrAhIme kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! ei caharakhanaka (makkAka) nirApada kari diYA, lagate moka Aru mora putrasakalaka mUrti pUjAra parA dUraita rakhA’|
‘he mora pratipAlaka! eivora mUrtiYe vahu mAnuhaka vibhrAnta kariche| eteke yiYe mora anusaraNa kariva teOMhe mora dalabhukta, Aru yiYe mora avAdhya ha’va tente tumito kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! nizcaYa mai mora vaMzara kichumAna lokaka anurvara upatyakAta, tomAra paৱitra gharara ocarata vasavAsa karAlo~| he AmAra pratipAlaka! ei kAraNe ye, teOMloke yena chAlAta kAYema kare| eteke tumi kichumAna lokara antara teOMlokara prati anurAgI kari diYA Aru phalamUlere teOMlokara jIৱikAra vyaৱsthA karA, yAte teOMloke kRtajJatA prakAza kare’|
‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! yivora Ami gopana karo~ Aru yi Ami prakAza karo~ nizcaYa seivora tumi jAnA, AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra kono vastuৱei AllAhara parA gopana nahaYa’|
sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAharei prApya, yijane moka mora vRddha aৱsthAta ichamAIla Aru ichahAkva dAna kariche| nizcaYa mora pratipAlaka duA zraৱNakArI|
‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka chAlAta pratiSThAkArI vanAi diYA lagate mora vaMzadharasakalara parAo| he mora pratipAlaka! Aru mora duA kavula karA’|
‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! yidinA hicApa-nikAca anuSThita ha’va seidinA moka Aru mora pitR-mAtRka lagate muminasakalaka kSamA kari divA’|
yAlimasakale yi kare sei viSaYe tumi ketiYAo AllAhaka amanoyogI vuli nAbhAvivA, darAcalate teOM siha~taka sei diৱsalaike aৱkAza diYe, yidinA siha~tara caku (AtaMkata) sthira hai pariva|
bhIta-vihvala citte oparara pine cAi siha~te palAvalai dauriva, nijara prati siha~tara dRSTi ubhati nAhiva, Aru siha~tara antara ha’va udAsa, (jJAna)zUnya|

Aru yidinA siha~tara zAsti Ahiva seidina samparke tumi mAnuhaka satarka karA, tetiYA anyAYakArIsakale ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAka alapa samaYara vAve aৱkAza diYA, Ami tomAra AhvAnata sa~hAri dima Aru rAchulasakalara anusaraNa karima’| (uttarata koৱA ha’va) kiYa tomAloke jAno iYAra Agata zapata khAi koৱA nAchilA ye, tomAlokara ketiYAo patana nahaYa?

Aru tomAloke vAsa karichilA siha~tara bhUmita, yisakale nijare prati anyAYa karichila Aru siha~tara lagata Ami ki dharaNara (AcaraNa) karichilo~ seYAo tomAlokara ocarata spaSTa Achila| lagate Ami tomAlokara vAve vahuto dRSTAntao upasthApana karichilo~|
Aru siha~te bhISaNa cakrAnta karichila, kintu AllAhara ocarata siha~tara cakrAnta (janA) Achila, siha~tara cakrAnta enekuৱA nAchila ye, parvatako TalAva pAriva|
eteke tumi ketiYAo nAbhAvivA ye, AllAhe teOMra rAchulasakalaka diYA pratizruti bhaGga kariva| nizcaYa AllAha parAkramazAlI, pratizodha grahaNakArI|

(smaraNa karA) yidinA eikhana pRthiৱI bhinna pRthiৱIlai rUpAntarita ha’va Aru AkAzasamUhao (rUpAntarita ha’va); Aru mAnuhe (kavarara parA) unmuktabhAৱe upasthita ha’va mahAparAkramazAlI eka AllAhara sanmukhata|
seidinA tumi aparAdhIvilAkaka zikalire vAndhi thoৱA aৱsthAta dekhivalai pAvA,
siha~tara pochAka ha’va AlakAtarAra Aru juYe siha~tara mukhamaNDala Acchanna kari rAkhiva;
eikAraNe ye, AllAhe pratyekake siha~tara kRtakarmara pratidAna diva| nizcaYa AllAha hicApa grahaNata ati tatpara|

eiTo haiche mAnuhara vAve eTA vArtA, yAte iYAra dvArA siha~taka satarka karA haYa Aru yAte siha~te jAniva pAre ye, keৱla teৱe~i ekaka satya ilAha, lagate yAte vivekasampanna lokasakale upadeza grahaNa kariva pAre|
Alipha-lAma-rA,[1] eivora haiche mahAgrantha tathA suspaSTa koraAnara AYAta|
kAphirasakale eTA samaYata AkAMkSA kariva ye, yadi siha~ta muchalima ha’lahe~tena!
eri diYA siha~taka, siha~ta khAi thAkaka Aru bhoga kari thAkaka, lagate AzA-AkAMkSAi siha~taka mohAcchanna kari rAkhaka, eteke acirei siha~te jAniva pAriva|
Aru Ami yi janapadakei dhvaMsa karicho~, tAra vAve eTA nirdiSTa kAla lipivaddha Achila|
kono jAtiYei tAra nirdiSTa (dhvaMsara) kAlaka AguৱAi Aniva noৱAre Aru pichuৱAiYo niva noৱAre|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘herA mAnuhajana! yAra prati yikira (koraAna) aৱtIrNa haiche, nizcaYa tumi haichA ejana unmAda’|
yadi tumi satyavAdIsakalara antarbhukta hoৱA tente AmAra ocaralai phiristA upasthita nakarA kiYa?
Ami phiristAsakalaka yathArtha kAraNa nohoৱAkai preraNa nakaro~, Aru (phiristAsakalaka aৱtIrNa karile) tetiYA siha~te aৱkAza nApAlehe~tena|
nizcaYa AmiYei koraAna aৱtIrNa karicho~ Aru nizcaYa AmiYei iYAra saMrakSaka|
niHsandehe Ami tomAra pUrve atIta sampradAYasamUhara mAjata rAchula preraNa karichilo~|
siha~tara ocaralai ene kono rAchula ahA nAchila, yAka siha~te upahAsa karA nAchila|
eidarei Ami aparAdhIsakalara antarata seYA saJcAra karo~,
iha~te koraAnara prati ImAna poSaNa nakariva, Aru aৱzye pAra haiche pUrvaৱrtIsakalara rIti|
Aru yadi Ami siha~tara vAve AkAzara duৱAro khuli dilo~he~tena, Aru siha~te tAta ArohaNa karilehe~tena,
tathApio siha~te ka’lehe~tena ye, ‘AmAra dRSTika sanmohita karA haiche, varaM Ami eTA yAdugrasta sampradAYa’|
Aru nizcaYa Ami AkAzata varujasamUha (graha-nakSatrasamUha) sRSTi karicho~ Aru darzakasakalara vAve seivoraka saundaryamaYa karicho~|
Aru pratyeka abhizapta caYatAnara parA Ami tAka surakSita karicho~;
kintu konovAi lukAi-curakai zuniva dharile pradIpta zikhAi tAka co~cA laYa|
Aru pRthiৱIka Ami vistRta karicho~, Aru tAta Ami sthApana karicho~ parvatamAlA; lagate tAta Ami pratyeka vastu udagata karicho~ suparimitabhAৱe,
Aru Ami tAta tomAlokara vAve jIৱikAra vyaৱsthA karicho~ Aru tomAloke yivorara jIৱikAdAtA nahaYa seivorara vAveo (jIৱikAra vyaৱsthA karicho~)|
Aru AmAra ocaratei Ache pratyeka vastura bhANDAra, Aru AmiYei seYA parijJAta parimANe aৱtIrNa karo~|
Aru AmiYei urvara vAYu preraNa karo~, tAra pichata AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa karo~, sei pAnI tomAlokaka seৱna karAOM; athaca tomAloke iYAka (sei) bhANDArata saJcaYa nakarA|
nizcaYa AmiYei jIৱna dAna karo~ Aru mRtyu ghaTAOM, Aru AmiYei cuDa়Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI|
Aru nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara mAjara parA yisakale agragAmI haiche siha~tako jAno, lagate seisakalako jAno yisakale pazcAdagAmI haiche|
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlakei siha~taka samaveta kariva; nizcaYa teOM prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
nizcaYa Ami mAnuhaka sRSTi karicho~ gandhayukta zukAna TiMTiM zavda karA ka’lAvaraNIYA vokA mATira parA,
Aru iYAra Agata Ami jvinavoraka sRSTi karichilo~ uttapta agnizikhAra parA|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAra pratipAlake phiristAsakalaka kaichila, ‘nizcaYa mai gandhayukta zukAna TiMTiM zavda karA ka’lAvaraNIYA vokA mATire mAnuha sRSTi karivalai thirAM karicho~;
eteke yetiYA mai tAka suThAma karima Aru tAra mAjata mora phAlara parA rUha saJcAra karima tetiYA tomAloke tAra prati chAjadAৱnata ha’vA,
tAra pichata phiristAsakale sakaloৱe ekelage chAjadAha karile,
keৱla ivalIchara vAhire, si chAjadAhakArIsakalara antarbhukta ha’valai asvIkAra karile|
AllAhe ka’le, ‘he ivalIcha! tomAra ki ha’la, tumi kiYa chAjadAhakArI sakalara antarbhukta naha’lA’?
si ka’le, ‘(he AllAha!) tumi gandhayukta zukAna TiMTiM zavda karA ka’lAvaraNIYA vokA mATira parA yi mAnuha sRSTi karichA mai tAka chAjadAha nakaro~’|
teOM ka’le, ‘tente tai iYAra parA olAi yA, kAraNa nizcaYa tai abhizapta;
Aru nizcaYa pratidAna diৱsalaike tora oparata thAkila abhisampAta|
si ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! teneha’le moka aৱkAza diYA sei diৱsalaike, yidinA siha~taka punarujjIৱita karA ha’va’|
teOM ka’le, ‘yA, nizcaYa toka aৱkAza diYA ha’la,
‘sunirdiSTa samaYa ahAra dina paryanta’|

si ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi ye moka vipathagAmI karilA seikAraNe nizcitabhAৱe mai pRthiৱIta pApakarmasamUhaka mAnuhara ocarata zobhanIYa kari upasthApana karima Aru nizcaYa mai siha~tara ATAike vipathagAmI karima,
‘kintu siha~tara mAjata tomAra ekaniSTha vAndAsakalara vAhire’|
AllAhe ka’le, ‘eiToৱe haiche mora ocaralai ahAra sarala patha’|
‘nizcaYa mora vAndAsakalara oparata tomAra kono kSamatA nAi, kintu pathabhraSTasakalara vAhire yisakale tomAka anusaraNa kariva’;
‘nizcaYa jAhAnnAma haiche siha~ta (tomAra anusArIsakalara) ATAYere pratizruta sthAna’,
‘sei(jAhAnnAma)ra sAtakhana duৱAra Ache, pratyeka duৱArere praৱeza karivalai siha~tara (caYatAnara anusArIsakalara) vAve nirdiSTa aMza Ache’|
nizcaYa muttAkvIsakala thAkiva jAnnAtata Aru prasraৱNasamUhara mAjata|
(teOMlokaka koৱA ha’va,) ‘tomAloke zAnti Aru nirApattAra saite iYAta praৱeza karA’|
Aru Ami teOMlokara antarara parA hiMsA vidveSa A~tarAi dima; teOMloke bhAtRra dare paraspare ijane sijanara sanmukhara Asanata aৱsthAna kariva,
tAta teOMlokaka aৱsAde (klAntiYe) sparza nakariva Aru tAra parA teOMlokaka vahiSkAro karA naha’va|
mora vAndAsakalaka janAi diYA ye, nizcaYa mai ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu,
Aru nizcaYa mora zAstiYei haiche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti!
Aru tumi siha~taka janAi diYA, ivrAhImara atithisakalara kathA,
yetiYA teOMloke (phiristAsakale) teOMra ocarata upasthita hai kaichila, ‘chAlAma’, tetiYA teOM kaichila, ‘nizcaYa Ami AponAlokara viSaYe zaMkita’|
teOMloke ka’le, ‘bhaYa nakirava, Ami AponAka ejana jJAnI putrara susaMvAda divalaihe Ahicho~’|
teOM ka’le, ‘moka vArddhakyai sparza karA satveo AponAloke moka (santAna lAbhara) susaMvAda diche neki? eteke AponAloke kihara (kenekai) susaMvAda di Ache’?
teOMloke ka’le, ‘Ami AponAka satya susaMvAda di Acho~; eteke Apuni nirAza naha’va’|
teOM ka’le, ‘pathabhraSTasakalara vAhire nija pratipAlakara rahamatara parA koneno nirAza haYa’?
teOM ka’le, ‘he prerita (phiristA)sakala! AponAlokara Aru kivA vizeSa uddezya Ache neki’?
teOMloke ka’le, ‘nizcaYa AmAka eTA aparAdhI sampradAYara prati preraNa karA haiche---
kintu lUtara pariYAlara viruddhe nahaYa, nizcaYa Ami teOMloka ATAike rakSA karima,
keৱla teOMra strIra vAhire; Ami siddhAnta laicho~ ye, nizcaYa tAi pichata aৱsthAnakArIsakalara antarbhukta ha’va’|
tAra pichata phiristAsakale yetiYA lUta pariYAlara ocaralai Ahila,
tetiYA lUte ka’le, ‘AponAloka dekhona aparicita’|
teOMloke ka’le, ‘nahaYa, varaM Ami AponAra ocaralai seiTohe lai Ahicho~ yAkalai siha~te sandeha poSaNa karichila’;
‘Aru Ami AponAra ocaralai satya saMvAda lai Ahicho~ Aru nizcaYa Ami satyavAdI’;

‘eteke Apuni rAtira kono eTA bhAgata AponAra pariYAlavargaka lai olAi yAoka, Aru Apuni siha~tara piche piche gai thAkiva| AponAlokara konoৱei yAte pichalai ghUri nAcAYa; AponAlokaka ya’laike yoৱAra Adeza karA haiche tAlaike guci yAoka’|
Aru Ami teOMka ei viSaYe phaYacAlA janAi dichilo~ ye, nizcaYa siha~taka USAra bhAgata lage lage samUli vinAza karA ha’va|
Aru ipine nagaravAsIsakala ullAsita hai upasthita ha’la|
teOM ka’le, ‘nizcaYa eOMloka haiche mora atithi; eteke tomAloke moka apamAna nakarivA’|
‘tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru moka lAJchita nakarivA’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘Ami pRthiৱIra (yi si) lokaka AzraYa divalai tomAka niSedha karA nAchilo~ne’?
lUte ka’le, ‘yadi tomAloke kivA karivai vicarA tente mora ei choৱAlIvora Ache (vivAhara mAdhyamata vaidha upAYere karA)’|
(he navI) tomAra AYura zapata! nizcaYa siha~ta nijara nicAta matalIYA hai ghUri Achila|
phalata sUryodaYara samaYata pracaNDa ciJare siha~taka Ahi dharile;
tAra pichata Ami (siha~tara) janapadaka oloTAi tala-opara kari dilo~ Aru siha~tara oparata porA mATira zila varSaNa karilo~|
nizcaYa iYAta nidarzana Ache paryavekSaNa-zaktisampanna vyaktisakalara vAve|
Aru nizcaYa seYA mAnuhara calAcala pathara kASatei vidyamAna|
nizcaYa iYAta muminasakalara vAve Ache nidarzana|
Aru AikAhavAsIo Achila sImAlaMghanakArI,
eteke Ami siha~tara parAo pratizodha laichilo~, Aru duYoTA janapadei haiche prakAzya pathara dA~tite aৱsthita|
Aru nizcaYa hijaravAsIYeo rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karichila;
Ami siha~taka AmAra nidarzanasamUha pradAna karichilo~, kintu siha~te seivoraka upekSA karichila|
Aru siha~te nirApade pAhAra kATi ghara nirmANa kariva pArichila|
tathApio puৱAra bhAgata pracaNDa zavdai siha~taka Ahi dharichila|
eteke siha~te yi arjana karichila seYA siha~tara kono kAmata ahA nAchila|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI, lagate ei duYore mAjata thakA kono vastukei Ami ayathA sRSTi karA nAi, Aru nizcaYa kiYAmata Ahiva| eteke tumi parama saujanyara saite siha~taka kSamA kari diYA|
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i haiche mahAsraSTA, mahAjJAnI|
Aru Ami tomAka pradAna karicho~ punaH punaH paThita sAtoTA AYAta Aru mahA koraAna|

Ami siha~tara vibhinna zreNIka bhoga-vilAsara yi upakaraNa dicho~ tAra prati tumi ketiYAo tomAra ducaku prasArita nakarivA| siha~tara vAve tumi dukha nakarivA; Aru tumi muminasakalara vAve tomAra vAhu nata karA (arthAt sadaYa hoৱA),
Aru koৱA, ‘nizcaYa mai haicho~ prakAzya satarkakArI’|
yidare Ami aৱtIrNa karichilo~ vibhaktakArIsakalara oparata;
yisakale koraAnaka vibhinnabhAৱe vibhakta kariche|
eteke tomAra pratipAlakara zapata! nizcaYa Ami siha~ta sakaloke jerA karima,
sei viSaYe, yiTo siha~te Amala karichila|
eteke tumi yi viSaYe AdezaprApta haichA seYA prakAzyabhAৱe pracAra karA Aru muzvarikasakalara parA mukha ghUrAi loৱA|
nizcaYa vidrUpakArIsakalara viruddhe AmiYei tomAra vAve yatheSTa,
yisakale AllAhara saite Ana kono upAsya nirdhAraNa kare| nizcaYa atizIghrei siha~te (iYAra pariNAma) jAniva pAriva|
Ami ei kathA nizcitabhAৱe jAno ye, siha~tara kathAra dvArA tomAra mana saMkucita haYa;
eteke tumi tomAra pratipAlakara tachavIha pATha karA Aru chAjadAhakArIsakalara antarbhukta hoৱA|
Aru tomAra mRtyu nahAlaike tumi tomAra pratipAlakara ivAdata karA|
AllAhara Adeza Ahivai; eteke tomAloke tAka sonakAle Anivalai kharakhedA nakarivA| teOM ati paৱitra mahimAmaYa, Aru siha~te yi aMzIdAra sthApana kare tAra parA teOM (vahu) urddhata|

teOM nija vAndAsakalara mAjara yAka icchA kare tAra prati nirdeza pradAna kari rUha (ahIsaha phiristA) preraNa kare ei vuli ye, tomAloke satarka karA, mai vine Ana kono satya ilAha nAi; seYe tomAloke mora tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA|
teৱe~i yathAyathabhAৱe AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIka sRSTi kariche; siha~te yi aMzIdAra sthApana kare teOM tAra parA (vahu) urddhata|
teৱe~i mAnuhaka zukrakITara parA sRSTi kariche; athaca coৱA, sei mAnuhei prakAzya vitaNDAkArI!
Aru catuSpada jantuvora teৱe~i sRSTi kariche, tomAlokara vAve tAta Ache zIta nivAraNara upakaraNa lagate Aru nAnA dharaNara upakAra Ache Aru seivorara kichumAnaka tomAloke bhakSaNo karA|
Aru tomAlokara vAve tAta Ache upabhoga kariva parA saundarya, yetiYA tomAloke seivoraka sandhiYAra samaYata cAraNabhUmira parA obhatAi AnA Aru puৱAra bhAgata seivoraka cAraNabhUmilai khedi niYA|
