Aru seivore tomAlokara gadhura vojAvora vahana kari lai yAYa enekuৱA ThAilai, ya’ta prANAntara kaSTa nohoৱAkai tomAloke tAlaike yAva noৱArilAhe~tena| nizcaYa tomAlokara pratipAlaka ati snehazIla, parama daYAlu|
Aru tomAlokara ArohaNara vAve lagate zobhAra vAve teOM sRSTi kariche gho~rA, khaccara Aru gAdha Aru teOM enekuৱA vahuto vastu sRSTi kare (Aru kariva) yivora tomAloke nAjAnA|
Aru sarala pathe AllAhara ocaralaike lai yAYa, kintu pathavorara mAjata vakra patho Ache| teOM icchA karile tomAloka ATAike satpathata paricAlita kariva pArilehe~tena|
teৱe~i AkAzara parA pAnI varaSAYa| tAta tomAlokara vAve Ache pAnIYa Aru tAra parAi janmAYa udbhida, yAra mAjata tomAloke pazucAraNa karA|
iYAra mAdhyamata teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve utpanna kare zasya, yAYatuna, khejura gacha, AGgura Aru nAnA dharaNara phalamUla| nizcaYa iYAta Ache cintAzIla sampradAYara vAve nidarzana|

Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara kalyANata niYojita kariche rAti, dina, sUrya Aru candraka; Aru nakSatrarAjio teOMrei nirdezata niYojita| nizcaYa iYAta vodhazakti sampanna sampradAYara vAve Ache vahuto nidarzana|
Aru teOM tomAlokara vAve pRthiৱIta vicitra raGa-viraGara yi yi sRSTi kariche, nizcaYa tAto Ache sei sampradAYara vAve nidarzana, yisakale upadeza grahaNa kare|

Aru teৱe~i sAgaraka niYojita kariche, yAte tomAloke tAra parA (mAchara) sateja mAMsa khAva pArA, lagate yAte tomAloke tAra parA ratnAৱlI AharaNa kariva pArA yivora tomAloke alaMkArarUpe paridhAna karA; Aru tomAloke dekhivalai poৱA ye, sAgarara vuku bheda kari nauyAnasamUha calAcala kare, yAte tomAloke teOMra anugraha sandhAna kariva pArA Aru yAte tomAloke kRtajJatA prakAza kariva pArA;

Aru teৱe~i pRthiৱIta sudRDha় parvatamAlA sthApana kariche, yAte pRthiৱIYe tomAlokaka lai tharaka-varaka kariva noৱAre, Aru sthApana kariche nada-nadI Aru pathasamUha, yAte tomAloke nijara gantavyasthalata yAva pArA;
Aru (teৱe~i) patha nirdezaka cihnasamUha (sthApana kariche)| lagate tarA nakSatrara dvArAo (mAnuhe) patha nirdeza pAYa|
eteke yijane sRSTi kare, teOM tAra dare neki yijane sRSTi kariva noৱAre? tathApio tomAloke zikSA grahaNa nakarivAne?
Aru tomAloke AllAhara anugraha gaNanA karile ketiYAo tAra saMkhyA nirNaYa kariva noৱArivA| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|
Aru tomAloke yi gopana karA Aru yi prakAza karA seYA AllAhe (bhAladarei) jAne|
Aru siha~te AllAhara vAhire yivoraka AhvAna kare siha~te ekoৱei sRSTi kariva noৱAre, varaM siha~takei sRSTi karA haiche|
(varaM siha~ta) niSprANa, nirjIৱ Aru siha~taka ketiYA punarutthita karA ha’va sei viSaYeo siha~tara kono cetanA (vodha) nAi|
tomAlokara ilAha keৱla ejana ilAha, eteke yisakale AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare siha~tara antara haiche asvIkArakArI Aru siha~ta haiche ahaMkArI|
iYAta kono sandeha nAi ye, AllAhe (bhAladarei) jAne siha~te yi gopana kare Aru yi prakAza kare| nizcaYa teOM ahaMkArIsakalaka pachanda nakare|
Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa, ‘tomAlokara pratipAlake ki aৱtIrNa kariche’? tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘pUrvaৱrtIsakalara upakathA’!

phalata kiYAmatara dinA siha~te nijara pApakarmara vojA sampUrNarUpe vahana kariva Aru siha~tara vojAo vahana kariva yisakalaka siha~te ajJatAvazataH vibhrAnta kariche| coৱA, siha~te yi vahana kariva seYA kimAna nikRSTa!

nizcaYa siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakale cakrAnta karichila, phalata AllAhe siha~tara prAsAdara bhittimUlata AghAta karichila; iYAra phalata prAsAdara cAda siha~tara oparata khahi parichila Aru siha~tara prati zAsti enekai Ahichila ye, siha~te ekoৱei upalavdhi kariva parA nAchila|

iYAra pichata kiYAmatara dinA teOM siha~taka lAJchita kariva Aru teOM ka’va, ‘mora sei aMzIdAravora ka’ta, yivorara viSaYe tomAloke ghora vAka-vitaNDA karichilA’? yisakalaka jJAna dAna karA haichila, teOMloke ka’va, ‘nizcaYa Aji lAJchanA Aru amaGgala kAphirasakalara oparata’--

nijara prati anyAYa kari thakA aৱsthAtei phiristAsakale yetiYA siha~tara prANa haraNa kariva, tetiYA siha~te AtmasamarpaNa kari ka’va, ‘Ami kono veYA kAma karA nAchilo~’| haYa, tomAloke yi karichilA sei viSaYe nizcaYa AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|
eteke tomAloke jAhAnnAmara duৱArasamUhare tAta sthAYIbhAৱe thAkivalai praৱeza karA| eteke coৱA, ahaMkArIsakalara AvAsasthala kimAna ye nikRSTa!

Aru yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karichila teOMlokaka koৱA ha’va, ‘tomAlokara pratipAlake ki aৱtIrNa kariche’? teOMloke ka’va, ‘mahAkalyANa’| yisakale satkarma kariche teOMlokara vAve Ache ei pRthiৱIta maGgala Aru AkhirAtara AvAsa iYAtakaio utkRSTa; Aru muttAkvIsakalara AvAsasthala kimAna ye utkRSTa!

ya’ta teOMloke praৱeza kariva seiTo haiche sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita; teOMloke yiTo vicAriva seiToৱei teOMlokara vAve tAta thAkiva| eidarei AllAhe muttAkvIsakalaka puraskRta kare,
phiristAsakale teOMlokara mRtyu ghaTAYa uttamabhAৱe| phiristAsakale kaYa, ‘tomAlokara oparata chAlAma (varSita haoka)! tomAloke yi karichilA tAra vinimaYata jAnnAtata praৱeza karA’|

siha~te (kAphirasakale) keৱla siha~tara ocaralai phiristA ahAra pratIkSA kari Ache athavA tomAra pratipAlakara kono nirdeza ahArahe pratIkSA kari Ache| siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo enekuৱAi karichila| AllAhe siha~tara prati kono anyAYa karA nAchila, varaM siha~ta nijei nijara prati anyAYa karichila|
eteke siha~tara oparata Apatita haichila siha~tarei veYA karmara pariNati Aru siha~te yi viSaYaToka lai upahAsa karichila seiToৱe siha~taka pariveSTana karichila|

Aru yisakale zvirka kariche siha~te kaYa, ‘AllAhe icchA karile Ami Aru AmAra pitR-puruSasakale teOMra vAhire Anara ivAdata nakarilo~he~tena, Aru teOMra nirdeza avihane Ami kono vastuka hArAmo nakarilo~he~tena’| siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo enekuৱAi karichila| eteke rAchulasakalara kartavya keৱla suspaSTa vANI pau~cAi diYA nahaYa jAno?

Aru nizcaYa Ami pratyeka jAtira ocaralai eko ekojana rAchula preraNa karichilo~, ei nirdeza pradAna kari ye, tomAloke AllAhara ivAdata karA Aru tAgutaka parihAra karA| tAra pichata AllAhe siha~tara mAjara kichumAnaka hidAYata dichila, Aru kichumAnara oparata pathabhraSTatA aৱdhArita haichila; eteke tomAloke pRthiৱIta paribhramaNa kari coৱA michalIYAsakalara pariNAma ki haichila?
tumi siha~tara hidAYatara vAve aikAntikabhAৱe AgrahI ha’leo AllAhe yAka vibhrAnta kare tAka teOM ketiYAo hidAYata nidiYe, Aru siha~tara vAve kono sahAYakArIo nAi|

Aru siha~te dRDha়tAra saite AllAhara zapata khAi kaYa, ‘yAra mRtyu haYa tAka AllAhe ketiYAo punarjIৱita nakariva’| (zunA) kiYa nakariva! nizcaYa teOMra oparata kRta pratizruti teOM satyata pariNata kariva| kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei nAjAne|

(punarjIৱita ei kAraNe kariva ye) yi viSaYe siha~te matAnaikya karichila, seYA yAte siha~tara ocarata spaSTa kariva pAre, lagate kAphirasakalaka ei kathA janAvalai ye, nizcaYa siha~ta Achila michalIYA|
(jAni thoৱA!) Ami kono vastuka (astitvata Anivalai) icchA karile Ami keৱla kaOM ye, ‘ha’; phalata i hai yAYa|

Aru yisakale niryAtita hoৱAra pichata AllAhara pathata hijarata kariche, nizcaYa Ami teOMlokaka pRthiৱIta uttama AvAsa pradAna karima; Aru AkhirAtara puraskAra nizcaYa iYAtakaio zreSTha| yadi siha~te jAnilehe~tena!
yisakale dhairyya dhAraNa kare Aru teOMlokara pratipAlakara oparata bharasA (tAৱAkkula) kare|
Aru Ami tomAra pUrve keৱla puruSasakalakei (rAchula hicApe) preraNa karichilo~, yisakalara prati Ami ahI paThiYAichilo~, eteke yadi tomAloke nAjAnA tente jJAnIsakalaka sudhi loৱA,

spaSTa pramANAdi Aru granthAৱlI sahakAre| Ami tomAra prati koraAna aৱtIrNa karicho~, yAte tumi mAnuhaka spaSTabhAৱe vujAi diva pArA yikhana siha~tara prati aৱtIrNa karA haiche, lagate yAte mAnuhe (ei viSaYe) cintA-carcA kare|

yisakale veYA karma karivalai SaDa়yantra race, AllAhe siha~taka bhUgarbhata vilIna nakariva vuli siha~te nirbhaYa haiche neki, athavA upalavdhi kariva noৱArA ThAira parA siha~tara oparata zAsti nAhiva vuli siha~te nizcinta haiche neki?
athavA siha~te calA-phurA karA aৱsthAta teOM siha~taka karAYatva nakariva vuli siha~te nizcinta haiche neki? athaca siha~te seYA vyarthao kariva noৱAriva|
athavA teOM siha~taka bhIta-santrasta aৱsthAta greptAra nakariva vuli nirbhaYa haiche neki? nizcaYa tomAlokara pratipAlaka ati snehazIla, parama daYAlu|
siha~te AllAhe sRSTi karA vastura prati lakSya nakare neki, yAra chA~ so~phAle Aru vAOMphAle AllAhara prati chAjadAৱnata hai Dhali pare, Aru seivora ekAnta vinIta?
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yimAna jIৱ-jantu Aru phiristA Ache sei sakaloৱe keৱla AllAhakei chAjadAha kare, teOMloke ahaMkAra nakare|
teOMloke teOMlokara oparata thakA pratipAlakaka bhaYa kare Aru teOMlokaka yi nirdeza diYA haYa teOMloke seiToৱe kare|
Aru AllAhe kaiche, ‘tomAloke dujana ilAha grahaNa nakarivA; keৱla teৱe~i ekamAtra ilAha| gatike tomAloke keৱla mokei bhaYa karA’|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache seivora teOMrei Aru sArvakSaNika Anugatya keৱla teOMrei prApya| tathApio tomAloke AllAhara vAhire Anaka bhaYa karivAne?
Aru tomAlokara ocarata yivora niYAmata Ache seivora AllAhara parAi Ahiche| tAra pichata yetiYA tomAlokaka dukha-dainyai sparza kare tetiYA tomAloke vyAkulabhAৱe teOMkei AhvAna karA|
tAra pichata yetiYA AllAhe tomAlokara dukha-dainya dUrIbhUta kare tetiYA tomAlokara eTA dale nija pratipAlakara saite zvirka kare--
Ami siha~taka yi pradAna karicho~ seYA asvIkAra karAra vAve| gatike tomAloke bhoga kari loৱA, acirei tomAloke (iYAra pariNAma) jAniva pArivA|

Aru Ami siha~taka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ siha~te tAra parA eTA aMza nirdhAraNa kare seivora (upAsya)ra vAve yivorara viSaYe siha~te ekoৱei nAjAne| zapata AllAhara! tomAloke yi michA udbhAৱna karA sei viSaYe aৱzye tomAlokaka prazna karA ha’va|
Aru siha~te AllAhara vAve kanyA santAna nirdhAraNa kare--athaca teOM paৱitra, mahimAmaYa| AnahAte siha~te nijara vAve seiToৱe nirdiSTa kare yiToka siha~te pachanda kare|
siha~tara kArovAka yetiYA kanyA santAnara susaMvAda diYA haYa tetiYA tAra mukhamaNDala ka’lA pari yAYa Aru si asahanIYa mAnasika yantraNAta kliSTa hai pare|

tAka yi susaMvAda diYA haYa, tAra glAnira kAraNe si nija sampradAYara parA Atmagopana kare| si cintA kare ye, hInatA satveo tAika rAkhi diva ne mATita puti thava? sAৱdhAna! siha~te yi siddhAnta kare seYA kimAna ye nikRSTa!
yisakale AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare, yAৱtIYa veYA udAharaNa siha~tara vAvei, Aru keৱla AllAhara vAvei haiche yAৱtIYa utkRSTa udAharaNa (guNAৱlI), Aru teৱe~i parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Aru AllAhe yadi mAnuhaka siha~tara sImAlaMghanara vAve zAsti dilehe~tena tente bhU-pRSThata kono jIৱ-jantukei rehAi nidilehe~tena; kintu teOM eTA nirdiSTa samaYalaike siha~taka aৱkAza diYe| eteke yetiYA siha~tara samaYa Ahi pare tetiYA siha~te eTA muhUrttao agA-pichA kariva noৱAre|

Aru siha~te yi apachanda kare seiToৱei AllAhara prati Aropa kare| siha~tara jibhAi michA viৱraNa diYe ye, maGgala keৱla siha~tara vAvei nirdiSTa| niHsandehe siha~tara vAve Ache agni, Aru nizcaYa siha~takei sarvaprathama tAta nikSepa karA ha’va|

AllAhara zapata! Ami tomAra pUrveo vahu jAtira ocaralai rAchula preraNa karichilo~; kintu caYatAne siha~tara dRSTita siha~tara kAryakalApaka zobhanIYa kari dichila, seYe Aji si haiche siha~tara abhibhAৱka Aru siha~tara vAvei Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

Aru Ami tomAra prati kitAva eikAraNe aৱtIrNa karicho~ yAte tumi seisakala lokaka suspaSTabhAৱe vujAi diva pArA yisakale matabheda kariche, lagate eikhana haiche muminasakalara sampradAYara vAve hidAYata Aru rahamata|
Aru AllAhei AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa kare Aru tAra dvArA teOM mRta bhUmika punarjIৱita kare| nizcaYa iYAta nidarzana Ache ene sampradAYara vAve yisakale (AllAhara) kathA zune|

nizcaYa gharacIYA jantura mAjato tomAlokara vAve Ache zikSA| tAra peTara govara Aru tejara mAjara parA tomAlokaka seৱna karAOM vizuddha Aru nirbhejAla gAkhIra, yiTo seৱnakArIsakalara vAve ati tRptikara|
Aru khejura gachara phala Aru AGurara parA tomAloke mAdaka Aru uttama khAdya grahaNa karA; nizcaYa iYAta vodhazakti sampanna sampradAYara vAve Ache nidarzana|
Aru tomAra pratipAlake mau-mAkhika pratyAdeza kariche ye, ‘tumi pAhArata, gachata Aru mAnuhe taiYAra karA hedAlita maucAka sAji loৱA;

‘iYAra pichata pratyeka phalara parA alapa alapa khoৱA, Aru tomAra pratipAlakara sahaja patha anusaraNa karA’| tAra peTara parA nirgata haYa vibhinna raGara pAnIYa, iYAra mAjata mAnuhara vAve Ache Arogya| nizcaYa iYAta Ache cintAzIla sampradAYara vAve nidarzana|

Aru AllAhei tomAlokaka sRSTi kariche, tAra pichata teৱe~i tomAlokara mRtyu ghaTAva Aru tomAlokara mAjara kichumAnaka pratyAৱrtita karA ha’va nikRSTatama vaYasata; yAte jJAna lAbhara pichata Akau si sakalo najanA haYa| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, pUrNa kSamatAৱAna|

Aru AllAhe jIৱnopakaraNata tomAlokara mAjara kichumAnaka Ana kichumAnara oparata zreSThatva pradAna kariche| kintu yisakalaka zreSThatva diYA haiche siha~te siha~tara adhInastha dAsa-dAsIsakalaka nijara jIৱnopakaraNara parA paryApta parimANara dAna ketiYAo nidiYe, (eikAraNe ye,) yAte siha~teo ei kSetrata siha~tara samAna hai nAyAYa| eteke siha~te AllAhara anugrahaka asvIkAra kare neki?

Aru AllAhe tomAlokara parAi tomAlokara saGginI sRSTi kariche Aru tomAlokara saGginIra parAi tomAlokara vAve santAna Aru nAtiputi sRSTi kariche Aru teৱe~i tomAlokaka uttama jIৱnopakaraNa dAna kariche| tathApio siha~te vAtilaka vizvAsa karivane Aru AllAhara anugrahaka asvIkAra karivane?
Aru siha~te AllAhara vAhire yivorara upAsanA kare, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra parA siha~taka jIৱnopakaraNa saravarAha karivalai sei upAsyavorara kono kSamatA nAi Aru karivao noৱAriva|
seYe tomAloke AllAhara kono sadRza sthira nakarivA| nizcaYa AllAhe jAne Aru tomAloke nAjAnA|

AllAhe upamA dAGi dhariche, Anara adhikArabhUkta ejana dAsara, yAra kono vastura oparata adhikAra nAi Aru ene ejana vyaktira yAka Ami AmAra taraphara parA uttama jIৱikA dAna karicho~ Aru teOM tAra parA gopane Aru prakAzyabhAৱe vyaYa kare; (eteke koৱAcona!) ubhaYa vyakti samAna ha’va pArene? sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAharei prApya; varaM siha~tara adhikAMzai (ei kathA) nAjAne|

AllAhe Aru upamA diche dujana vyaktiraH siha~tara ejana haiche vovA, kono vastura oparata tAra adhikAra nAi Aru si tAra abhibhAৱkara oparata vojA hai Ache; ya’tei tAka paThoৱA nahaoka kiYa si kono kalyANa lai Ahiva noৱAre; teneha’le ei vyakti sei vyaktira samAna ha’va pArene yiYe nyAYara nirdeza diYe Aru yijana Ache sarala pathata?

AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra adRzya viSaYAdi (ra jJAna keৱla) AllAharei| kiYAmata (saMghaTita hoৱA)ra viSaYaTo cakura palakara dare, athavA tAtokai kama samaYara| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

Aru AllAhe tomAlokaka tomAlokara mAtRgarbhara parA enekuৱA aৱsthAta uliYAiche, yetiYA tomAloke ekoৱe janA nAchilA Aru teৱe~i tomAlokaka diche zraৱNazakti, dRSTizakti Aru hRdaYa, yAte tomAloke kRtajJatA prakAza karA|
siha~te lakSya karA nAine AkAzara zUnya garbhata niYantraNAdhIna carAi-cirikaTira prati? AllAhara vAhire Ana koneo seivoraka dhari nArAkhe| nizcaYa iYAta mumina sampradAYara vAve Ache nidarzana|

Aru AllAhe tomAlokara gRhasamUhaka tomAlokara vAve AvAsasthala vanAiche Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve pazura cAmarAre ghara, tamvura vyaৱsthA kariche, tomAloke seiToka bhramaNakAlata Aru aৱsthAnakAlata sahajei sthAnAntara kariva pArA| (teৱe~i vyaৱsthA kariche) seivorara pacama, noma Aru culira parA prastuta kariva parA kichu kAlara vAve gRha-sAmagrI Aru vyaৱhArika-upakaraNa|

Aru AllAhe yi sRSTi kariche tAra parAi teOM tomAlokara vAve chA~ra vyaৱsthA kariche Aru tomAlokara vAve pAhArata AzraYasthala vanAiche Aru tomAlokara vAve vyaৱsthA kariche paridheYa vastrara; yivore tomAlokaka garamara tApara parA rakSA kare Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve varmara vyaৱsthA kariche, yiYe tomAlokaka yuddha kSetrata rakSA kare| eidarei teOM tomAlokara prati teOMra anugraha pUrNa kariche yAte tomAloke AtmasamarpaNa karA|
eteke yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa tente tomAra kartavya haiche keৱla suspaSTabhAৱe pau~cAi diYA|
siha~te AllAhara niYAmataka cini pAYa; tathApio siha~te seivoraka asvIkAra kare Aru siha~tara adhikAMzai haiche kAphira|

Aru yidinA Ami pratyeka sampradAYara parA ekojanakai sAkSI utthita karima, tAra pichata yisakale zvirka kariche siha~taka (ojara-Apatti dAGi dharivalai) anumati diYA naha’va Aru siha~taka (AllAhara) santuSTi lAbhara suyogo diYA naha’va|
Aru yetiYA yAlimasakale zAsti dekhA pAva, tetiYA Aru siha~tara zAsti lAghaৱ karA naha’va Aru siha~taka aৱkAzo diYA naha’va|

Aru muzvarikavilAke yetiYA siha~tara aMzIdArasakalaka dekhiva tetiYA siha~te ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! iha~tei haiche seisakala loka yisakalaka Ami tomAra aMzI karichilo~, yisakalaka tomAra parivarte Ami AhvAna karichilo~’; tetiYA aMzIsakale ei kathA muzvarikasakalara pine obhatAi di ka’va, ‘nizcaYa tomAloka haichA michalIYA’|
seidinA siha~te AllAhara ocarata AtmasamarpaNa kariva Aru siha~te yivora michA udbhAৱna karichila seivora siha~tara parA udhAo hai yAva|
yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AllAhara pathara parA (mAnuhaka) virata rAkhiche, Ami siha~tara zAstira oparata zAsti vRddhi karima; kAraNa siha~te azAnti sRSTi karichila|

(Aru smaraNa karA,) yidinA Ami pratyeka ummatara parA, siha~tara mAjara parAi siha~tara viruddhe eko ekojanakai sAkSI utthita karima Aru tomAka Ami teOMlokara oparata sAkSIrUpe lai Ahima; kAraNa Ami tomAra prati kitAva aৱtIrNa karicho~ pratyeka viSaYara spaSTa vyAkhyA hicApe, lagate muchalimasakalara vAve patha nirdeza, rahamata Aru susaMvAdasvarUpe|

nizcaYa AllAhe Adala (nyAYaparAYaNatA), ihachAna (sadAcaraNa) Aru AtmIYa-svajanaka dAnara nirdeza diYe, lagate teOM azlIlatA, asatkarma Aru sImAlaGghanara parA niSedha kare, teOM tomAlokaka upadeza diYe yAte tomAloke zikSA grahaNa karA|

Aru tomAloke AllAhara aGgIkAra pUraNa karivA yetiYA tomAloke aGgIkAra karA, Aru tomAloke AllAhaka sAkSI kari zapata dRDha় karAra pichata seYA bhaGga nakarivA| nizcaYa tomAloke yi karA seYA AllAhe jAne|

tomAloke sei nArIra dare naha’vA, yi nArIYe majavutakai sUtA kaTAra pichata sei sUtA tAi nijei TukurA-Tukura kari pelAYa| (kiYano) tomAloke tomAlokara zapataka parasparaka pravaJcanA karAra vAve vyaৱhAra kari thAkA, yAte eTA dale AnaTo dalatakai vechi lAbhaৱAna haYa| nizcaYa AllAhe iYAra dvArA tomAlokaka parIkSA kare| aৱzye AllAhe kiYAmatara dinA seYA tomAlokara ocarata spaSTa varNanA kari diva yi viSaYe tomAloke matAnaikya karichA|

Aru AllAhe icchA karile tomAlokaka eTA jAtita pariNata kari diva pArilehe~tena, kintu teOM yAka icchA kare vibhrAnta kare Aru yAka icchA kare satpathata paricAlita kare| tomAloke yi karichilA sei viSaYe nizcaYa tomAlokaka prazna karA ha’va|

Aru parasparaka pravaJcanA karAra vAve tomAloke nijara zapataka vyaৱhAra nakarivA; ene karile, bhari sthira hoৱAra pichata Akau picali yAva Aru AllAhara pathata vAdhA diYAra kAraNe tomAloke zAstira soৱAda grahaNa kariva lAgiva; Aru tomAlokara vAve Ache mahAzAsti|
Aru tomAloke AllAhara aGgIkAraka tuccha mUlyata vikrI nakarivA| AllAhara ocarata yi Ache seiToৱe tomAlokara vAve uttama—(hAYa!) yadi tomAloka jAnilAhe~tena!

tomAlokara ocarata yi Ache seYA niHzeSa ha’va Aru AllAhara ocarata yi Ache seYA haiche sthAYI| seYe yisakale dhairyya dhAraNa kariche, nizcaYa Ami teOMlokaka teOMloke yi karichila tAtokai zreSTha pratidAna dAna karima|

puruSa haoka vA nArI ImAnara aৱsthAta yiYei satkarma kariva, nizcaYa Ami tAka paৱitra jIৱna dAna karima| lagate aৱzye Ami teOMlokaka teOMloke yi Amala karichila tAtokai zreSTha pratidAna pradAna karima|
eteke yetiYA tumi koraAna pATha karivA, tetiYA abhizapta caYatAnara parA AllAhara ocarata AzraYa prArthanA karivA;
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru nija pratipAlakara oparatei bharasA kare, teOMlokara oparata tAra (caYatAnara) kono Adhipatya nAi|
tAra Adhipatya keৱla seisakala lokara oparata, yisakale tAka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa kare Aru yisakale AllAhara lagata zvirka kare|

Aru Ami yetiYA eTA AYAtara sthAna parivartana kari Ana eTA AYAta aৱtIrNa karo~—Aru AllAhei bhAladare jAne teOM ki aৱtIrNa kariva--, tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘nizcaYa tumi haichA ejana michA racanAkArI’, varaM siha~tara adhikAMzai nAjAne|

koৱA, ‘tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA rUhula-kuduche (jIvrIle) yathAyathabhAৱe iYAka aৱtIrNa kariche, yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokaka sudRDha় karAra vAve, Aru i haiche hidAYata lagate muchalimasakalara vAve susaMvAdasvarUpa’|
Aru nizcaYa Ami jAno siha~te kaYa, ‘tAka ejana mAnuhe zikSA diYe’| siha~te yAra prati iMgita kare tAra bhASAto AravI nahaYa; athaca ei (koraAna) haiche suspaSTa AravI bhASA|
nizcaYa yisakale AllAhara AYAtasamUhara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare, AllAhe siha~taka hidAYata nakare Aru siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
keৱla siha~tei michA raTanA kare yisakale AllAhara AYAtasamUhara prati vizvAsa sthApana nakare, Aru siha~tei haiche michalIYA|

konovAi ImAna poSaNa karAra pichata yadi tAka kupharI karivalai vAdhya karoৱA haYa athaca tAra antara ImAnata avicala (tente tAra kono doSa nAi)| kintu yiYe unmukta hRdaYara saite kupharI kariva, siha~tara prati Apatita ha’va AllAhara gayava Aru siha~tara vAvei Ache mahAzAsti|
eiTo eikAraNe ye, siha~te pArthiৱ jIৱnaka AkhirAtara oparata prAdhAnya diYe; Aru nizcaYa AllAhe kAphira sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|
iha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara antarata, kANata Aru cakuta AllAhe mohara mAri diche; Aru siha~tei haiche udAsIna|
niHsandehe, ei kathA nizcita ye, siha~tei AkhirAtata ha’va kSatigrasta|
eteke yisakale niryAtita hoৱAra pichata hijarata kare, tAra pichata jihAda kare Aru dhairyya dhAraNa kare, nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka iYAra pichata teOMlokara prati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

(smaraNa karA) sei dinaToka, yidinA pratyeka vyaktiYe AtmapakSa samarthanata yukti-tarka lai upasthita ha’va Aru pratyekake tAra karmara pratiphala paripUrNarUpe diYA ha’va Aru siha~tara prati (kono dharaNara) anyAYa karA naha’va|

Aru AllAhe upamA dAGi dhariche eTA janapadara yiTo Achila nirApada Aru nizcinta, ya’ta keuphAlara parA tAra vAve pracura jIৱnopakaraNa Ahichila| tathApio sei janapadavAsIYe AllAhara anugrahaka asvIkAra karichila, phalata AllAhe siha~taka kSudhA Aru AtaMkara AৱraNa jApi di siha~tara kRtakarmara soৱAda grahaNa karAichila|
Aru nizcaYa siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara mAjara parAi ejana rAchula Ahichila, kintu siha~te teOMka asvIkAra karichila| phalata anyAYakArI aৱsthAtei zAstiYe siha~taka grAsa karichila|
eteke AllAhe tomAlokaka hAlAla Aru paৱitra yi jIৱikA dAna kariche tAra parA tomAloke bhakSaNa karA Aru AllAhara anugrahara vAve kRtajJatA prakAza karA, yadi tomAloke keৱla teOMrei ivAdata karA|

AllAhe keৱla mRta jantu, teja, gAharira mAMsa Aru yiToka javeha karAra samaYata AllAhara parivarte Anara nAma loৱA haiche seivorakahe tomAlokara vAve hArAma kariche, kintu konovAi avAdhya vA sImAlaMghanakArI nahai upAYahIna ha’le (tAra kono doSa nAi) tente nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Aru tomAlokara jibhAra dvArA vanAi michAra oparata nirbhara kari ‘eiTo hAlAla Aru eiTo hArAma’ vuli naka’vA| nizcaYa yisakale AllAhara prati michA Aropa kare siha~te ketiYAo saphala ha'va noৱAre|
(pArthiৱ jIৱnata) siha~tara sukha-sambhoga ati sAmAnya, (kintu AkhirAtata) siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

Aru iYAhudIsakalara vAve Ami keৱla seiToৱe hArAma karicho~ yiTo tomAra ocarata Ami itipUrve ullekha karicho~; Aru Ami siha~tara oparata kono anyAYa karA nAchilo~, varaM siha~te nijei nijara prati anyAYa karichila|
yisakale ajJatAvazataH veYA kAma kare, pichata (yadi) siha~te tAovA kare Aru nijake saMzodhana kare, tente teOMlokara vAve tomAra pratipAlaka nizcaYa ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa ivrAhIma Achila eTA ummata, AllAhara ekAnta anugata, ekaniSTha Aru teOM muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta nAchila;
teOM Achila AllAhara anugrahara vAve kRtajJa, AllAhe teOMka manonIta karichila Aru teOMka satpathata paricAlita karichila|
Aru Ami teOMka pRthiৱIta kalyANa dAna karichilo~, Aru nizcaYa teOM AkhirAtato ha’va satkarmaparAYaNasakalara antarbhukta|
tAra pichata Ami tomAra prati ahI karilo~ ye, ‘tumi ekaniSTha ivrAhImara millAta (Adarza)ra anusaraNa karA’; Aru teOM muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta nAchila|

zanivAra pAlana karATo keৱla siha~tara oparata vAdhyatAmUlaka karA haichila, yisakale ei viSaYe matabheda karichila| yi viSaYe siha~te matabheda karichila nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlake kiYamAtara dinA sei viSaYe siha~tara mAjata vicAra-mImAMsA kari diva|

tumi tomAra pratipAlakara pathata mAnuhaka AhvAna karA hikamata Aru sadupadezara dvArA Aru siha~tara saite uttama panthAta tarka karivA| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i bhAladare jAne kone teOMra pathara parA vibhrAnta haiche, Aru kone satpathata paricAlita haiche sei viSaYeo teOM aৱgata|

yadi tomAloke pratizodha grahaNa karA, tente keৱla seikhiniYe zAsti pradAna karivA yimAnakhini anyAYa tomAlokara prati karA haiche| AnahAte yadi tomAloke dhairyya dhAraNa karA tente dhairyyazIlasakalara vAve seiTo aৱzye uttama|
Aru tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA, tomAra dhairyya keৱla AllAharei sahAYara phala| tumi siha~tara vAve dukha nakarivA Aru siha~tara SaDa়yantrata tumi atiSThao naha’vA|
nizcaYa AllAha teOMlokara lagata Ache yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariche Aru yisakala satkarmaparAYaNa|

paৱitra mahimAmaYa teOM, yijane teOMra vAndAka rAtira bhitarate bhramaNa karAiche, (makkAra) Ala-mAchajidula hArAmara parA (peliSTAinara) Ala-mAchajidula AkvachAlai, yAra keuphAle Ami varakata pradAna karicho~, yAte Ami teOMka AmAra nidarzanasamUha dekhuৱAva pAro~; nizcaYa teOM sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
Aru Ami muchAka kitAva pradAna karichilo~ Aru seikhanaka Ami vanI icharAIlara vAve pathanirdezaka kari dichilo~| yAte tomAloke mora vAhire Ana kAko karmavidhAYakarUpe grahaNa nakarA|
(tomAlokei haichA) teOMlokara vaMzadhara! yisakalaka Ami nUhara saite (nAৱta) ArohaNa karAichilo~; nizcaYa teOM Achila parama kRtajJa vAndA|
Aru Ami (tAorAtata) kitAvata vanI icharAIlaka janAi dichilo~ ye, ‘nizcaYa tomAloke pRthiৱIta duvArakai viparyaYa sRSTi karivA Aru tomAloke atizaYa ahaMkArasphIta ha’vA’|

tAra pichata ei duTAra prathamaTora nirdhArita samaYa yetiYA upasthita ha’la tetiYA tomAlokara viruddhe yuddha karivalai Ami AmAra atyanta zaktizAlI vAndAsakalaka preraNa karichilo~, phalata teOMloke ghare ghare praৱeza kari dhvaMsayajJa calAichila| eiTo Achila enekuৱA pratizruti yiTo kAryakarI hoৱATo nizcita Achila|
tAra pichata Ami tomAlokaka Akau siha~tara oparata pratiSThita karilo~, tomAlokaka dhana Aru santAna-santatira dvArA sahAYa karilo~ Aru tomAlokaka saMkhyAgariSThatA pradAna karilo~|

yadi tomAloke satkarma karA, tente seYA tomAlokara nijare upakAra ha’va Aru yadi veYA karma karA tente seYA tomAlokare apakAra ha’va| tAra pichata paraৱrtI nirdhArita samaYa upasthita hoৱAta (mai mora vAndAsakalaka preraNa karilo~) tomAlokara mukhamaNDalaka kAlimAcchanna karAra vAve, prathamavAra siha~te yenekai machajidata praৱeza karichila Akau tenekai tAta praৱeza karAra vAve Aru siha~tara kartRtvata yi Achila tAka sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa karAra vAve|

sambhaৱtaH tomAlokara pratipAlake tomAlokara prati daYA kariva, kintu tomAloke yadi tomAlokara Agara AcaraNara punarAvRtti karA tente Amio (AmAra zAstira) punarAvRtti karima| lagate jAhAnnamaka Ami kAphirasakalara vAve kArAgAra kari rAkhicho~|
nizcaYa ei koraAne hidAYata kare sei pathara pine yiTo patha AkvaৱAma (sarala, sudRDha়), Aru satkarmaparAYaNa muminasakalaka susaMvAda diYe ye, teOMlokara vAve Ache mahA puraskAra|
Aru yisakale AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare, Ami siha~tara vAve prastuta rAkhicho~ yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Aru mAnuhe kalyANa kAmanAra darei akalyANa kAmanA kare; darAcalate mAnuha prakRtigatabhAৱei vara vechi zIghratApriYa|

Ami rAti Aru dinaka duTA nidarzana vanAicho~, tAra pichata rAtira nidarzanaka maci dicho~ Aru dinara nidarzanaka Alokaprada karicho~; yAte tomAloke tomAlokara pratipAlakara anugraha sandhAna kariva pArA Aru yAte tomAloke vacharara saMkhyA Aru hicApa sthira kariva pArA; Aru Ami sakalo viSaYa vizadabhAৱe varNanA karicho~|
Aru Ami pratyeka mAnuhare kRtakarma tAra DiGita A~ri thaicho~, Aru kiYAmatara dinA Ami tAra vAve uliYAma ekhana kitAva, yikhanaka si unmukta aৱsthAta pAva|
(tAka koৱA ha’va) tumi tomAra kitAva (AmalanAmA) pATha karA, Aji tumi nijei tomAra hicApa-nikAcara vAve yatheSTa|

yiYe satpatha aৱlamvana kare nizcaYa si nijara maGgalara vAvei satpatha aৱlamvana kare Aru yiYe pathabhraSTa haYa nizcaYa si nijara dhvaMsara vAvei pathabhraSTa haYa| kono vahanakArIYei Anara (pApakarmara) vojA vahana nakariva, Aru Ami rAchula preraNa nakarAkai zAsti pradAna nakaro~|

Aru yetiYA Ami kono janapadaka dhvaMsa kariva vicAro~ tetiYA sei ThAira samRddhazAlI vyaktisakalaka (satkarmara) Adeza karo~; kintu siha~te tAta asatkarma kare; tAra pichata sei ThAira prati daNDAjJA nyAYasaMgata hai yAYa Aru Ami sei ThAika sampUrNarUpe vidhvasta kari diOM|
Aru nUhara pichata Ami vahuto prajanmaka dhvaMsa karicho~| tomAra pratipAlakei teOMra vAndAsakalara pApakarmara saMvAda rAkhivalai Aru paryavekSaNara vAve yatheSTa|

konovAi Azu sukha-sambhoga kAmanA karile, Ami yAka icchA karo~ iYAtei tatAlike di diOM, tAra pichata tAra vAve jAhAnnAma nirdhArita karo~, tAta si lAJchita Aru anugrahara parA vaJcita hai praৱeza kariva|
AnahAte yisakale mumina hai AkhirAta kAmanA kare Aru tAra vAve yathAyatha ceSTA kare, teOMlokara praceSTA puraskArayogya|

tomAra pratipAlakara dAnara parA Ami iha~tara Aru siha~tara (pArthiৱ jIৱna kAmanAkArI Aru AkhirAta kAmanAkArI) pratyekake sahAYa karo~ Aru tomAra pratipAlakara dAna avArita (koneo pratirodha kariva noৱAre)|
lakSya karA, Ami kenekai siha~tara kichumAnaka Ana kichumAnara oparata zreSThatva pradAna karicho~| nizcaYa AkhirAta haiche maryAdAra kSetrata ATAitakai mahat Aru zreSThatvara kSetrato vRhattara!
AllAhara lagata Ana kono ilAha sAvyasta nakarivA, ene karile tumi nindita Aru lAJchita hai vahi parivA|

Aru tomAra pratipAlake Adeza kariche ye, teOMra vAhire Ana kAro ivAdata nakarivA Aru pitR-mAtRra saite sadvyaৱhAra karivA| teOMlokara konovA ejana athavA ubhaYei yadi tomAra jIৱnakAlata vRddhAৱsthAta upanIta haYa tente tumi teOMlokaka ‘upha’ zavdao nakarivA, Aru teOMlokaka dhamako nidivA; teOMlokara lagata sanmAnasUcaka namra kathA ka’vA|

Aru teOMlokara prati mAYA-mamatAra saite namratAra vAhu aৱnamita karivA Aru (ei vuli duA kari) koৱA, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! teOMlokara prati daYA karA, yenekai zaizaৱta teOMloke moka pratipAlana karichila’|

tomAlokara antarata yi Ache seYA tomAlokara pratipAlake bhAladarei jAne; yadi tomAloka satkarmaparAYaNa hoৱA tente (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa teOM seisakala lokara prati ati kSamAzIla, yisakala sadAYa AllAha abhimukhI|
Aru AtmIYa svajanaka siha~tara prApya pradAna karA, lagate abhAৱgrasta Aru muchAphirasakalako dAna karA Aru ketiYAo apavyaYa nakarivA|
nizcaYa apavyaYakArIsakala haiche caYatAnara bhAi Aru caYatAna tAra pratipAlakara prati vara akRtajJa|
Aru tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA anugraha lAbhara pratyAzAta yadi siha~tara parA tomAra vimukha thAkivalagIYAi haYa, tetiYA siha~tara lagata namrabhAৱe kathA ka'vA|
Aru tumi tomAra hAta DiGita vAndhi nArAkhivA (kRpaNa naha’vA) Aru sampUrNarUpe mukalio kari nidivA (apavyaYa nakarivA), ene karile tumi nindanIYa niHsva hai vahi parivA|
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlake yAka icchA kare tAra jIৱikA vRddhi kari diYe Aru yAka icchA kare sImita kari diYe; nizcaYa teOM nija vAndAsakalara viSaYe samyaka parijJAta, sarvadraSTA|
abhAৱ-anATanara bhaYata tomAloke nijara santAnasakalaka hatyA nakarivA| AmiYei siha~taka jIৱikA diOM Aru tomAlokako| nizcaYa siha~taka hatyA karA mahApApa|
Aru tomAloke yinAra (vyabhicArara) ocaralaiko nAyAvA, nizcaYa seYA haiche azlIla Aru nikRSTa AcaraNa|

Aru AllAhe yAka hatyA karivalai niSiddha kariche yathArtha kAraNavihIna tomAloke tAka hatyA nakarivA! Aru konovAi anyAYabhAৱe nihita ha’le tAra uttarAdhikArIka Ami tAra pratizodha loৱAra adhikAra dicho~; kintu hatyA samparke si yena sImAlaGghana nakare; nizcaYa si sAhAyyaprApta ha’va|
Aru iYAtIma (anAtha) prApta vaYaska nohoৱAlaike sat uddezya vyatIta tAra sampattira nikaTaৱrtI naha’vA Aru tomAloke pratizruti pAlana karA; nizcaYa pratizruti samparke kaiphiYata talava karA ha’va|
Aru ojana kari diYAra samaYata pUrNamAtrAta ojana kari divA, Aru ojana karivA saThika tulAcanIta, eiToৱe haiche uttama Aru pariNAmata utkRSTa|
Aru yi viSaYe tomAra kono jJAna nAi tAra anusaraNa nakarivA; nizcaYa kANa, caku Aru hRdaYa- iYAra pratyekaTora viSaYe kaiphiYata talava karA ha’va|
Aru pRthiৱIta phuTanimAri nuphurivA, nizcaYa tumi ketiYAo bharire bhUpRSThaka vidIrNa kariva noৱArivA Aru kadApio parvata-samAna uccatA lAbha kariva noৱArivA|
ei sakalovora haiche veYA karma, tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata ghRNanIYa|

tomAra pratipAlake ahIra mAdhyamata tomAka yi hikamata dAna kariche eivora tArei antarbhukta; Aru AllAhara lagata Ana kono ilAha sthira nakarivA, anyathA nindita Aru lAJchita aৱsthAta jAhAnnAmata nikSipta ha’vA|
(ki Acarita!) tomAlokara pratipAlake tomAlokaka putra santAnara vAve nirvAcita kariche Aru teOM nije phiristAsakalaka kanyArUpe grahaNa kariche neki? nizcaYa tomAloke sAMghAtika kathA kai AchA|
Aru nizcaYa Ami ei koraAnata (vahu viSaYa) vAre vAre vivRta karicho~ yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kare| kintu siha~tara vimukhatAhe vRddhi pAYa|
koৱA, ‘yadi teOMra lagata Ana kono ilAha thAkilahe~tena, yidare siha~te dAvI kari kaYa, tente siha~teo Aracha-adhipatira (naikaTya lAbhara) upAYa anveSaNa kari phurilehe~tena’|
teOM paৱitra mahimAmaYa Aru siha~te yi kaYa tAra parA teOM vahu urdhvata|

sAtokhana AkAza Aru pRthiৱI lagate iYAra mAjata yi Ache sei sakalo teOMrei paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare Aru ene kono vastu nAi yiToৱe teOMra prazaMsA sahakAre paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA nakare; kintu siha~tara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karA viSaYaTo tomAloke vuji nopoৱA; nizcaYa teOM sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|
Aru tumi yetiYA koraAna pATha karA tetiYA Ami tomAra Aru seisakala lokara mAjata yisakale AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare eTA adRzya pardA A~ri diOM|

Aru Ami siha~tara antarara oparata AৱraNa rAkhi dicho~ yAte siha~te seYA vujiva noৱAre Aru siha~tara kANata dicho~ vadhiratA; seYe yetiYA tumi koraAnara parA ullekha karA ye, ‘tomAra pratipAlaka keৱla ejana’, tetiYA siha~te piThi dekhuৱAi A~tari yAYa|

yetiYA siha~te tomAra prati kANapAti zune, tetiYA siha~te kiYa kANapAti zune sei kathA Ami bhAladarei jAno Aru eiToo jAno yetiYA gopane AlocanA karAra samaYata yAlimasakale kaYa, ‘nizcaYa tomAloke ejana yAdugrasta vyaktira anusaraNa kari AchA’|
coৱA, siha~te tomAra viSaYe kenevora upamA diYe! phalata siha~te pathabhraSTa haiche, gatike siha~ta satpatha pAvalai sakSama nahaYa|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami yetiYA asthita pariNata hama Aru cUrNa-vicUrNa hoৱAra pichata Akau AmAka natuna sRSTirUpe utthita karA ha’va neki’?
koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke zila vA lo hai yoৱA,

‘athavA ene kono sRSTita pariNata hoৱA yiTo tomAlokara antarata vara DAGara vuli bhavA’; (tathApio tomAlokaka punarutthita karA ha’va) iYAra pichato siha~te ka’va, ‘kone AmAka punarutthita kariva’? koৱA, ‘teৱe~i kariva, yijane prathamavAra tomAlokaka sRSTi karichila’| tetiYA siha~te mUra jokAri sudhiva, ‘seiTono ketiYA ha’va? koৱA, ‘sambhaৱtaH seYA ati zIghrei ha’va’|
yidinA teOM tomAlokaka AhvAna kariva, Aru tomAloke teOMra prazaMsAra saite teOMra AhvAnata sa~hAri divA, lagate tomAloke dhAraNA karivA ye, tomAloke (tAta) ati kama samaYahe aৱsthAna karichilA|
Aru mora vAndAsakalaka koৱA, teOMloke yena enekuৱA kathA kaYa, yiTo uttama| nizcaYa caYatAne teOMlokara mAjata virodha sRSTi kare| nizcaYa caYatAna haiche mAnuhara prakAzya zatru|

tomAlokara pratipAlaka tomAlokara viSaYe adhika aৱgata| teOM icchA karile tomAlokara prati daYA kariva pAre, athavA icchA karile tomAlokaka zAstio diva pAre, (Aru he navI!) Ami tomAka siha~tara oparata karmavidhAYaka kari paThoৱA nAi|

AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yisakala Ache, siha~tara viSaYeo tomAra pratipAlaka adhika aৱgata| nizcaYa Ami navIsakalara mAjara kichumAnaka Ana kichumAnara oparata maryAdA pradAna karicho~ Aru dAudaka pradAna karichilo~ jhAvUra|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAhara vAhire yivoraka ilAha vuli dhAraNA karA siha~taka mAtAcona, tetiYAhe gama pAvA, tomAlokara dukha-dainya dUra karAra vA parivartana karAra kSamatA siha~tara nAi’|

siha~te yivoraka AhvAna kare siha~ta nijei siha~tara pratipAlakara naikaTya lAbhara upAYa sandhAna kare ye, siha~tara mAjata kona kimAna teOMra nikaTaৱrtI ha’va pAre, Aru siha~te teOMra daYA pratyAzA kare Aru teOMra zAstika bhaYa kare| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlakara zAsti ati bhaYAৱha|
Aru ene kono janavasati nAi yAka Ami kiYAmatara pUrve dhvaMsa nakarima athavA yAka Ami kaThora zAsti nivihima; eYAto kitAvata lipivaddha Ache|

Aru Ami nidarzana preraNa nakarAra keৱla eiToৱe kAraNa ye, siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakale iYAka asvIkAra karichila| Ami zikSAmUlaka nidarzana svarUpe chAmUda jAtika uTa pradAna karichilo~, kintu siha~te seiTora prati atyAcAra karichila| Ami keৱla bhaYa dekhuৱAra kAraNehe nidarzana preraNa karo~|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami tomAka kaichilo~ ye, nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlake mAnuhaka pariveSTana kari Ache| Ami yi dRzya tomAka dekhuৱAicho~ seiTo Aru koraAnata ullekhita abhizapta gachaToo keৱla mAnuhara parIkSAra vAve nirdhAraNa karicho~| Ami siha~taka bhaYa dekhuৱAOM, kintu i siha~tara ghora avAdhyatAhe vRddhi kare|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami phiristAsakalaka kaichilo~, ‘Adamaka chAjadAha karA’, tetiYA ivalIchara vAhire sakaloৱe chAjadAha karichila| si kaichila, ‘mai iYAka chAjadAha karimane, yAka tumi vokA mATire sRSTi karichA’?

si (Aru) kaichila, ‘coৱAcona! eijana yAka tumi mora oparata maryAdA dAna karilA, kiYAmatara diৱsalaike yadi tumi moka aৱkAza diYA, teneha’le zapata kari kaicho~, mai kichu saMkhyakara vAhire iYAra goTei vaMzadharaka nizcaYa mora kartRtvAdhIna kari pelAma’|
AllAhe ka’le, ‘yoৱA, eteke siha~tara mAjara yiYe tomAra anusaraNa kariva, nizcaYa pUrNa pratidAna hicApe jAhAnnAmei ha’va tomAloka sakalore pratidAna’|

‘Aru tomAra kaNThare siha~tara mAjara yAke pArA padaskhalita karAgai, tomAra azvArohI Aru padAtika vAhinIra dvArA siha~taka AkramaNa karA Aru siha~tara dhana-sampada lagate santAna-santatita aMzI hoৱAgai, Aru siha~taka pratizruti diYA’| aৱzye caYatAne chalanAra vAhire siha~taka kono pratizrutiYe nidiYe|
‘nizcaYa mora vAndAsakalara oparata tomAra kono kSamatA nAi’| karmavidhAYaka hicApe tomAra pratipAlakei yatheSTa|
teৱe~i tomAlokara pratipAlaka, yijane tomAlokara vAve sAgarata nauyAna paricAlita karAYa, yAte tomAloke teOMra anugraha sandhAna kariva pArA| nizcaYa teOM tomAlokara prati parama daYAlu|

Aru yetiYA tomAlokaka sAgarata vipade sparza kare, tetiYA teOMra vAhire tomAloke yivoraka AhvAna karA, seivora sei samaYata (tomAlokara manara parA) udhAo hai yAYa; eteke teOM yetiYA tomAlokaka uddhAra kari sthalata Ane, tetiYA tomAloke mukha ghUrAi loৱA| prakRtate mAnuha vara akRtajJa|

tomAloke ei viSaYe nizcinta AchA neki ye, teOM tomAlokaka sthalara kono aJcalatei bhUgarbhastha nakariva, athavA tomAlokara oparata zilA varSaNakArI pravala dhumuhA napaThAva? tetiYA kintu tomAloke nijara vAve kono karmavidhAYaka vicAri nApAvA|

athavA tomAloke ei viSaYata nizcinta haichA neki ye, teOM tomAlokaka dvitIYavAra sAgaralai lai nAyAva Aru tomAlokara viruddhe pracaNDa dhumuhA preraNa nakariva Aru tomAlokara kupharI karAra vAve tomAlokaka teOM DuvAi nAmAriva? tAra pichata tomAloke AmAra viruddhe kono sahAYakArI vicAri nApAvA|

nizcaYa Ami Adama santAnaka maryAdA dAna karicho~, AmiYei siha~taka sthalata Aru sAgarata calAcala karivalai vAhana dicho~; Aru siha~taka uttama jIৱikA dAna karicho~ Aru AmAra sRSTira vahutare oparata siha~taka zreSThatva pradAna karicho~|

(smaraNa karA sei diৱsaToka,) yidinA Ami pratyeka sampradAYaka siha~tara imAmasaha AhvAna karima| tAra pichata yisakalaka siha~tara so~ hAtata AmalanAmA diYA ha’va, siha~te nijara AmalanAmA paDha়iva Aru siha~tara oparata khejurara guTira oparata thakA mihi sUtA parimANo (akaNo) anyAYa karA naha’va|
Aru yijana iYAta andha, si AkhirAtato andha, tathA ATAitakai vechi pathabhraSTa|

Aru Ami tomAra prati yi ahI preraNa karicho~ tAra parA siha~te tomAka padaskhalana ghaToৱAra ceSTA prAYa cuDa়Anta karichila, yAte tumi AmAra nAmata iYAra viparIte michA raTAva pArA; Aru tetiYA niHsandehe siha~te tomAka vandharUpe grahaNa karilehe~tena|
Aru Ami tomAka avicalita nArAkhile tumi nizcaYa siha~tara phAle kiJcita ha’leo DhAla khAlAihe~tena;
yadi ene karilAhe~tena tente nizcaYa Ami tomAka ei jIৱnata dviguNa Aru parakAlato dviguNa zAstira soৱAda dilo~he~tena; tetiYA tumi AmAra viruddhe tomAra vAve kono sahAYakArIo nApAlehe~tena|

Aru siha~te tomAka dezara parA utkhAta karivalai prAYa cUDa়Anta ceSTA karichila, yAte tomAka tAra parA vahiSkAra kariva pAre, ene karile siha~teo tomAra pichata vechi samaYa tiSThi thAkiva noৱArilehe~tena|
AmAra rAchulasakalara mAjara parA tomAra pUrve yisakalaka preraNa karichilo~ teOMlokara kSetrato Achila eiToৱei niYama Aru tumi AmAra niYamara kono parivartana nApAvA|
sUrya DhAlakhoৱAra pichara parA rAtira ghana andhakAra paryanta chAlAta kAYema karA Aru phajarara chAlAta (AdAYa karA)| nizcaYa phajarara chAlAta haiche (phiristAsakalara) upasthitira samaYa|
Aru rAtira kichu aMzata (koraAnara dvArA) tAhAjjuda AdAYa karA, eiTo haiche tomAra vAve eTA atirikta kartavya| AzA karA yAYa tomAra pratipAlake tomAka pratiSThita kariva prazaMsita sthAnata|
Aru koৱA, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi moka satyatAra saite praৱeza karoৱA Aru moka vAhira karA satyatAra saite Aru tomAra phAlara parA moka dAna karA sAhAyyakArI zakti’|
Aru koৱA, ‘satya Ahi pAiche Aru vAtila (asatya) vilupta haiche; nizcaYa vAtila vilupta ha’valagIYAi Achila’|
Aru Ami koraAna aৱtIrNa karo~, yikhana muminasakalara vAve Arogya Aru rahamata, kintu i yAlimasakalara kSatihe vRddhi kare|
Aru yetiYA Ami mAnuhara prati anugraha karo~ tetiYA si mukha ghUrAi laYa Aru A~tara hai yAYa| kintu yetiYA tAka aniSTai sparza kare tetiYA si ekevAre hatAza hai pare|
koৱA, ‘pratyekei nija nija prakRti anuyAYI kAma kare kintu tomAra pratipAlakahe adhika aৱgata ye, kona sarvAdhika nirbhula pathata paricAlita’|
Aru siha~te tomAka rUha samparke prazna kare| koৱA, ‘rUha haiche mora pratipAlakara Adeza vizeSa, Aru tomAlokaka ati sAmAnya jJAnahe diYA haiche’|
Aru Ami icchA karile tomAra prati yi ahI karicho~ tAka nizcaYa pratyAhAra kariva pArilo~he~tena; tAra pichata ei viSaYe tumi AmAra viruddhe kono karmavidhAYaka nApAlAhe~tena|
kintu eYA pratyAhAra nakarATo haiche tomAra pratipAlakara daYA; nizcaYa tomAra prati Ache teOMra mahA anugraha|
koৱA, ‘yadi ei koraAnara anurUpa koraAna Anivalai mAnuha Aru jina samaveta haYa tathApio iYAra anurUpa Aniva noৱAriva, yadio siha~te paraspare parasparaka sahAYa kare’|
Aru nizcaYa Ami ei koraAnata mAnuhara vAve vibhinna upamA vizadabhAৱe varNanA karicho~; kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei kupharI nakarAkai kSAnta hoৱA nAi|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami ketiYAo tomAra oparata ImAna poSaNa nakaro~, yetiYAlaike tumi AmAra vAve bhUmira parA eTA prasraৱna utsArita nakarivA;
‘athavA tomAra vAve khejura Aru AGurara eTA vAgicA ha’va, yAra mAjata tumi nijarA pravAhita karivA’,
‘athavA tumi yenekai koৱA sei anuyAYI AkAzaka khaNDa-vikhaNDa kari AmAra oparata pelAi diYA, nAivA AllAha Aru phiristAsakalaka AmAra sanmukhata upasthita karA’,

‘athavA tomAra vAve eTA soNara ghara ha’va nAivA tumi AkAzata ArohaNa karivA kintu tomAra AkAza ArohaNata Ami ketiYAo ImAna poSaNa nakaro~ yetiYAlaike tumi AmAra vAve ekhana kitAva aৱtIrNa nakarivA, yikhana Ami paDha়ima| koৱA, ‘paৱitra mahAna mora pratipAlaka! mai haicho~ keৱla ejana mAnuha, tathA rAchula’|
Aru yetiYA mAnuhara ocaralai hidAYata Ahila, tetiYA siha~taka keৱla ei kathAi ImAna Anivalai vAdhA dile ye, ‘AllAhe ejana mAnuhaka rAchula hicApe preraNa kariche neki’?
koৱA, ‘phiristAsakala yadi nizcinta hai pRthiৱIta vicaraNa kariva pArilehe~tena tente nizcaYa Ami AkAzara parA siha~tara ocaralai phiristAkei rAchula hicApe preraNa karilo~he~tena’|
koৱA, ‘mora Aru tomAlokara mAjata sAkSI hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa; nizcaYa teOM nijara vAndAsakalara viSaYe pUrNa aৱhita, pUrNadraSTA’|

Aru AllAhe yisakalaka hidAYata diYe siha~tehe hidAYataprApta haYa Aru yisakalaka teOM pathabhraSTa kare siha~tara vAve tumi ketiYAo teOMra vAhire Ana kono abhibhAৱka vicAri nApAvA| kiYAmatara dinA Ami siha~taka uvari khoৱA aৱsthAta andha, vovA Aru vadhira kari samaveta karima| siha~tara AvAsasthala ha’va jAhAnnAma; yetiYA i nisteja ha’va tetiYAi Ami siha~tara vAve juira zikhA vRddhi karima|
eiToৱei haiche siha~tara pratidAna, kAraNa siha~te AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra karichila Aru kaichila, ‘asthita pariNata Aru cUrNa-vicUrNa hoৱAra pichato Ami Akau natuna sRSTirUpe punarutthita hamane’?

siha~te lakSya nakare neki ye, nizcaYa AllAha, yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche teOM siha~tara anurUpa sRSTi karivalai kSamatAৱAna? Aru teৱe~i siha~tara vAve sthira kariche eTA nirdiSTa kAla, ya’ta kono sandeha nAi, tathApio yAlimasakale kupharI nakarAkai kSenta hoৱA nAi|
koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke mora pratipAlakara daYAra bhANDArara adhikArI ha’lAhe~tena, tathApio sei bhANDAra vyaYa hai yoৱAra AzaMkAta tomAloke tAka dhari rAkhilAhe~tena; aৱzye mAnuha vara kRpaNa’|

nizcaYa Ami muchAka naTA spaSTa nidarzana pradAna karichilo~; eteke tumi vanI icharAIlaka sudhi cAva pArA; yetiYA teOM siha~tara ocaralai Ahichila, Aru phiraAune teOMka kaichila, ‘he muchA! nizcaYa mora mate tumi haichA ejana yAdugrasta vyakti’|

muchAi kaichila, ‘tumi nizcitabhAৱe jAnA ye, eivora spaSTa nidarzana AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra pratipAlakei aৱtIrNa kariche—pratyakSa pramANasvarUpe| ‘he phiraAuna! mora mate tumi haichA ejana dhvaMsaprApta vyakti’|
aৱzeSata phiraAune teOMlokaka dezara parA uccheda karivalai icchA karile; tetiYA Ami tAka Aru tAra saGgIsakalara ATAike DuvAi mArilo~|
iYAra pichata Ami vanI icharAIlaka ka’lo~, ‘tomAloke pRthiৱIta vasavAsa karA Aru yetiYA AkhirAtara pratizruti vAstavAYita ha’va tetiYA Ami tomAloka ATAike ekatrita kari upasthita karima|
Aru Ami satya sahakAre koraAna aৱtIrNa karicho~ Aru i satya sahakArei aৱtIrNa haiche| Ami keৱla tomAka susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArIrUpehe preraNa karicho~|
Aru Ami koraAnaka alapa alapakai aৱtIrNa karicho~; yAte tumi seYA mAnuhara ocarata krame krame pATha kariva pArA Aru Ami iYAka paryAYakrame aৱtIrNa karicho~|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke koraAnara oparata ImAna poSaNa karA vA nakarA, nizcaYa yisakalaka iYAra pUrve jJAna diYA haichila, teOMlokara ocarata yetiYA iYAka tilAৱta karA haYa tetiYAi teOMloke chAjadAta pari yAYa’|
Aru teOMloke kaYa, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka paৱitra mahAna| AmAra pratipAlakara pratizruti kAryakarI ha’vai ha’va’|
‘Aru teOMloke kAndi kAndi natazire (chAjadAta) pari yAYa, lagate i teOMlokara vinaYa Aru adhika vRddhi kare’| (chAjadAha 4)

koৱA, ‘tomAloke (nija pratipAlakaka) ‘AllAha’ nAmere mAtA vA ‘rahamAna’ nAmerei mAtA, kAraNa tomAloke yi nAmerei nAmAtA kiYa, sakalo sundara nAma teOMrei| lagate chAlAtata tumi nijara svara khuva uccao nakarivA Akau vechi nimnao nakarivA; varaM ei duTAra madhyaৱrtI patha aৱlamvana karivA|

Aru koৱA, ‘sakalo prazaMsA keৱla AllAharei, yijane kono santAna grahaNa karA nAi, Aru teOMra sArvabhaumatvata kono aMzIdAro nAi, lagate teOM durdazAgrasthao nahaYa ye, tAra parA vAcivalai teOMra kono abhibhAৱkara praYojana ha’va, seYe tumi sa-sambhrame teOMra mAhAtmya ghoSaNA karA’|
yAৱtIYa prazaMsA keৱla AllAhara vAvei, yijane teOMra vAndAra prati kitAva aৱtIrNa kariche Aru tAta teOM kono dharaNara vakratA rakhA nAi,

saralarUpe (varNanA kariche), teOMra kaThina zAsti samparke satarka karAra vAve Aru muminasakalara yisakale satkarma kare, teOMlokaka ei susaMvAda diYAra vAve ye, teOMlokara vAve Ache uttama puraskAra,
tAta teOMloke sthAYIbhAৱe aৱsthAna kariva,
Aru seisakala lokako satarka karAra vAve yisakale kaYa, ‘AllAhe santAna grahaNa kariche’,
ei viSaYe siha~tara kono jJAna nAi, lagate siha~tara pitR-puruSaro kono jJAna nAchila| ki sAMghAtika vAkya yiTo siha~tara mukhara parA olAYa! siha~ta michAra vAhire Ana eko nakaYa|
eteke siha~te ei vANIta ImAna poSaNa nakarile siha~tara piche piche ghUri sambhaৱtaH tumi dukhate Atma-vinAzI hai parivA|
nizcaYa bhU-pRSThata yi yi Ache Ami seivoraka iYAra zobhA kari dicho~, mAnuhaka ei parIkSA karAra vAve ye, siha~tara mAjata kone zreSTha Amala kare|
Aru iYAra oparata yi yi Ache tAka nizcaYa Ami udbhidazUnya pathArata pariNata karima|
tumi kAhApha (guhA) Aru rAkvImara adhivAsIsakalaka AmAra nidarzanAৱlIra mAjata vismaYakara vuli bhavA neki?

yetiYA yuৱkasakale guhAta AzraYa la’le tetiYA teOMloke ka’le, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi tomAra nijara phAlara parA AmAka anugraha dAna karA Aru AmAra vAve AmAra karmarAjika saThikabhAৱe paricAlanAra vyaৱsthA karA’|
phalata Ami siha~taka guhAra mAjata keivA vacharo ghumanta aৱsthAta rAkhilo~,
tAra pichata Ami siha~taka sajAga karilo~ eiTo janoৱAra vAve ye, dui dalara mAjata konaToৱe siha~tara aৱsthitikAla saThikabhAৱe nirNaYa kariva pAre|

Ami tomAra ocarata siha~tara vRttAnta saThikabhAৱe varNanA karicho~, siha~ta Achila keijanamAna yuৱka, siha~te nija pratipAlakara oparata ImAna Anichila Aru Ami siha~tara hidAYata vRddhi kari dichilo~,

Aru Ami siha~tara antara dRDha় kari dichilo~; siha~te yetiYA (sAra pAi) uThi ka’le, ‘AmAra pratipAlakei AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra pratipAlaka| Ami ketiYAo teOMra parivarte Ana kono ilAhaka AhvAna nakaro~; yadi AhvAna karo~ tente eYA ha’va vara garhita kathA|

AmAra ei svajAtisakale teOMra parivarte vahuto ilAha grahaNa kariche| iha~te eivora ilAha samparke spaSTa pramANa upasthita nakare kiYa? eteke yiYe AllAha samparke michA udbhAৱna kare seijanatakai DAGara yAlima Aruno kona ha’va pAre?

etiYA yihetu tomAloke siha~tara parA Aru siha~te yivorara ivAdata kare seivorara parA vicchinna haichA, seYe etiYA tomAloke guhAta AzraYa grahaNa karA| tomAlokara pratipAlake tomAlokara vAve teOMra rahamata vistAra kariva Aru tomAlokara vAve tomAlokara jIৱnopakaraNara viSaYaTo sahaja kari diva|

Aru yadi tumi siha~taka dekhAhe~tena, sUryya udaYa hoৱAra samaYata siha~tara guhAra so~ phAle DhAla khAYa Aru asta yoৱAra samaYata siha~taka atikrama kari vAOM phAle DhAla khAYa, athaca siha~ta guhAra prazasta cotAlata (zui Ache), eivora AllAhara nidarzanasamUhara mAjata anyatama| AllAhe yAka satpathata paricAlita kare, si satpathaprApta Aru teOM yAka pathabhraSTa kare, tumi ketiYAo tAra vAve kono pathanirdezakArI abhibhAৱka vicAri nApAvA|

Aru tumi bhAvilAhe~tena siha~ta sAre Ache, athaca siha~ta Achila Topanita| Ami siha~taka kAti salAi dichilo~ so~phAle Aru vAOMphAle Aru siha~tara kukure sanmukhara bhari duTA guhAra duৱArata prasArita kari Achila| yadi tumi siha~tara phAle bhumuki mAri dekhilAhe~tena, tente aৱzye tumi bhirAi lara mArilAhe~tena Aru nizcaYa tumi siha~tara bhaYata AtaMkagrasta hai parilAhe~tena;

Aru eidarei Ami siha~taka jAgrata kari tulilo~, yAte siha~te parasparara mAjata sodha-poca kariva pAre| siha~tara ejane ka’le, ‘tomAloke kimAna samaYa aৱsthAna karichA’? siha~te ka’le, ‘Ami edina vA edinara kichu aMzahe aৱsthAna karicho~’| siha~te ka’le, ‘tomAloke kimAna samaYa aৱsthAna karichA seYA tomAlokara pratipAlakei bhAladare jAne| eteke tomAloke etiYA tomAlokara mAjara parA ejanaka ei mudrAsaha vajAralai paThAi diYA| si yena bhAlakai cAi-citi konaTo uttama khAdya tAra parA yena tomAlokara vAve kichu khAdya lai Ahe| lagate si yena vicakSaNatAra saite kAma kare| konomatei yAte tomAlokara viSaYe kAko eko jAniva nidiYe|

nizcaYa siha~te yadi tomAlokara viSaYe jAniva pAre tente siha~te tomAlokaka zila daliYAi hatyA kariva athavA tomAlokaka siha~tara dharmalai obhatAi niva| tetiYA tomAloke ketiYAo saphala ha’va noৱArivA|

Aru eidare Ami mAnuhaka teOMlokara viSaYe janAi dilo~, yAte siha~te jAne ye, AllAhara pratizruti satya Aru nizcaYa kiYAmata samparke kono sandeha nAi| yetiYA siha~te (nagaravAsIYe) siha~tara kartavyara viSaYe nijara mAjate vitarka karichila tetiYA siha~tara kichumAne kaichila, ‘teOMlokara oparata saudha nirmANa karA’| siha~tara pratipAlakei siha~tara viSaYe bhAlakai jAne| siha~tara kartavyara viSaYe yisakalara mata pravala haichila siha~te kaichila, ‘nizcaYa Ami teOMlokara oparata machajida nirmANa karima’|

acirei kichumAne ka’va, ‘teOMloka Achila tinijana, teOMlokara caturthaTo Achila teOMlokara kukura’, Aru Ana kichumAne ka’va, ‘teOMloka Achila pA~cajana, teOMlokara SaSThaTo Achila teOMlokara kukura’, ei sakaloৱe gAYevI viSaYata anumAnara oparata nirbhara kare| Akau kichumAne ka’va, ‘teOMloka Achila sAtajana, teOMlokara aSTamaTo haiche teOMlokara kukura’| koৱA, ‘mora pratipAlakehe teOMlokara saMkhyATo bhAlakai jAne; teOMlokara prakRta saMkhyA keৱla kichusaMkhyaka lokehe jAne| eteke sAdhAraNa AlocanAra vAhire tumi teOMlokara viSaYe vitarka nakarivA Aru iha~tara kAko teOMlokara viSaYe nusudhivA|
Aru ketiYAo tumi kono viSaYata ei vuli naka'vA ye, nizcaYa mai eiTo kAilai karima,

ina zvA AllAha nokoৱAkai, (arthAt yadi AllAhe vicAre), Aru yadi pAhari yoৱA tente tomAra pratipAlakaka smaraNa karivA Aru koৱA, ‘sambhaৱtaH mora pratipAlake moka iYAtakaio satyara nikaTaৱrtI patha dekhuৱAva’|
Aru siha~te guhAta Achila tini za vachara, lagate atirikta na vachara|

koৱA, ‘siha~te kimAna samaYa aৱsthAna karichila seYA AllAhei bhAlakai jAne’, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra gAYevara jJAna keৱla teOMrei| teOM kimAna sundara draSTA Aru zrotA! teOMra vAhire siha~tara Ana kono abhibhAৱka nAi| teOM kAko nija kartRtvata aMzIdAra nakare|

Aru tomAra pratipAlakara kitAvara parA tomAra ocaralai yi ahI karA haYa seYA tumi pATha kari zunoৱA| teOMra vAkyasamUhara kono parivartanakArI nAi; Aru tumi ketiYAo teOMra vAhire Ana kono AzraYa vicAri nApAvA|

Aru tumi nijake dhairyyazIla rAkhivA seisakala lokara saite, yisakale puৱA-gadhUli teOMlokara pratipAlakaka AhvAna kare, teOMra santuSTira uddezye; Aru tumi pArthiৱ jIৱnara zobhA kAmanA kari siha~tara parA tomAra dRSTi A~tarAi ninivA| lagate tumi sei vyaktira anusaraNa nakarivA—yAra antaraka Ami AmAra smaraNara parA amanoyogI kari dicho~, yiYe nija pravRttira anusaraNa kariche Aru yAra karma vinaSTa haiche|

Aru koৱA, ‘satya tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA (Ahiche), eteke yAra icchA si ImAna poSaNa kariva pAre Aru yAra icchA si kupharI kariva pAre’| nizcaYa Ami yAlimasakalara vAve prastuta kari rAkhicho~ agni (jAhAnnAma), yAra prAcIravore siha~taka pariveSTana kari rAkhiva| siha~te pAnIYa vicArile siha~taka diYA ha’va galita dhAtura dare pAnIYa, yiTo siha~tara mukhamaNDala dagdha kariva, eiTo vara nikRSTa pAnIYa! Aru jAhAnnAma kimAna ye nikRSTa vizrAmasthala!
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche – nizcaYa Ami uttamarUpe karma sampAdana karA vyaktira zramaphala vinaSTa nakaro~|

teOMlokara vAvei Ache sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita thAkiva, tAta teOMlokaka soNara kaMkanere alaMkRta karA ha’va, teOMloke paridhAna kariva mihi Aru sthUla recamara seujIYA vastra, Aru teOMloke tAta susajjita Asanata Auji vahiva, kimAna ye zreSTha puraskAra Aru uttama vizrAmasthala!

Aru tumi siha~tara vAve eTA dRSTAnta dAGi dharA, dujana vyakti Achila, siha~tara ejanaka Ami pradAna karichilo~ dukhana AGurara vAgAna Aru duYokhanake Ami khejura gachere pariveSTita karichilo~ Aru duYoTAre madhyaৱrtI sthAnata rAkhichilo~ zasyakSetra|
ubhaYa udyAnei phala dAna karichila Aru tAta kono truTi karA nAchila Aru Ami ubhaYa udyAnara mAjere pravAhita karichilo~ eTA nijarA|
Aru tAra pracura phala-sampada Achila| tAra pichata kathA prasaGgata si tAra vandhuka ka’le, ‘tomAtakai mora dhana-sampada vechi Aru janavalato mai tomAtakai adhika zaktizAlI’|
Aru si ahaMkAra kari tAra udyAnata praৱeza karile| si ka’le, ‘eikhana ketiYAo dhvaMsa ha’va vuli mora dhAraNA nahaYa;
‘Aru kiYAmata saMghaTita ha’va vulio mora dhAraNA nahaYa, Aru moka yadi mora pratipAlakara ocaralaike obhatAi niYAo haYa, tathApio mai nizcaYa iYAtakaio utkRSTa pratyAৱrtana sthala pAma’|

iYAra uttarata tAra vandhujane vitarkamUlakabhAৱe tAka ka’le, ‘tumi sei sattvAra lagata kupharI karichA neki, yijane tomAka sRSTi kariche mATira parA Aru tAra pichata vIryara parA Aru tAra pichata tomAka purNAMGga puruSa AkRti dAna kariche’?
‘kintu (mai kaOM) teৱe~i AllAha, teৱe~i mora pratipAlaka; Aru mai mora pratipAlakara lagata kAko aMzI nakaro~’|

‘yadi tumi tomAra dhana-sampatti Aru santAna-santatira kSetrata moka hIna vuli dhAraNA karA tente tumi yetiYA tomAra udyAnata praৱeza karilA tetiYA tumi kiYa eidare naka’lA ye, AllAhe yiTo vicAre seiToৱei haYa, AllAhara sahAYa avihane kono zakti nAi?

‘tathApio eYA asambhaৱ nahaYa ye, haYato mora pratipAlake moka tomAra udyAnatakaio utkRSTa kivA dAna kariva Aru tomAra udyAnata AkAzara parA nirdhArita viparyaYa preraNa kariva pAre, yAra phalata i udbhidazUnya pathArata pariNata ha’va pAre|
‘athavA iYAra pAnI bhUgarbhalai guci yAva pAre Aru tumi ketiYAo seiTora sandhAna lAbhata sakSama ha’va noৱArivA’|

eteke tAra phala-sampadaka viparyaYe veri dharile, Aru gachavora hendAlira saite bhAGi-ciGi pari thakA dekhi, si tAta yi vyaYa karichila tAra vAve hAta mohAri mohAri AkSepa kari ka’le, ‘hAYa, mai yadi mora pratipAlakara lagata kAko aMzI nakarilohe~tena’!
Aru AllAhara vAhire tAka sahAYa karivalai kono nAchila Aru si nijeo pratikArata samartha nAchila|
iYAta kartRtva keৱla AllAharei, yijana satya| puraskAra pradAnata Aru pariNAma nirdhAraNata teৱe~i zreSTha|

Aru tumi siha~tara ocarata pArthiৱ jIৱnara upamA dAGi dharA, (pArthiৱ jIৱnara upamA haiche) pAnIra dare, yiTo Ami AkAzara parA varSaNa karo~, yAra dvArA bhUmija udbhida ghana sanniviSTa hai utpanna haYa, tAra pichata eivora zukAi enekai cUrNa-vicUrNa haYa ye, vatAhe seivoraka uruৱAi lai yAYa| AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati haiche pArthiৱ jIৱnara zobhAmAtra, Aru satkarmara pratiphala haiche sthAYI, eiTo tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata puraskAra prAptira vAve zreSTha Aru pratyAzAra kSetrato utkRSTa|

Aru (smaraNa karA,) yidinA Ami parvatasamUhaka saJcAlana karima Aru tumi pRthiৱIka unmukta prAntara hicApe dekhivalai pAvA, seidinA Ami siha~ta sakaloke ekatrita karima; phalata siha~tara ejanako eri nidiOM|

Aru siha~taka tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata zArIvaddhabhAৱe upasthita karA ha’va Aru AllAhe ka’va, ‘tomAlokaka Ami prathamavAra yenekai sRSTi karichilo~ Thika tenekaiYe tomAloke mora ocarata upasthita haichA, athaca tomAloke bhAvichilA ye, tomAlokara vAve Ami kono pratizruti samaYa nirdhAraNa nakarima’|

lagate (seidinA pratyekare hAtata) rakhA ha’va AmalanAmA, tetiYA tAta yi lipivaddha Ache tAra vAve tumi aparAdhIvilAkaka AtaMkagrasta dekhivalai pAvA Aru siha~te ka’va, ‘hAYa, durbhAgya AmAra! eikhana kenekuৱA grantha! ya’ta saru-vara kono viSaYei vAda parA nAi’| siha~te yi Amala karichila seivora siha~te sanmukhata upasthita pAva; Aru tomAra pratipAlake kAro prati anyAYa nakare|

Aru (smaraNa karA) Ami yetiYA phiristAsakalaka kaichilo~, ‘Adamara prati chAjadAha karA’, tetiYA ivalIchara vAhire sakaloৱe chAjadAha karichila, si Achila jinasakalara vaMzadhara, si tAra pratipAlakara Adeza amAnya karichila| tathApio tomAloke mora parivarte tAka Aru tAra vaMzadharasakalaka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa karivA neki? athaca siha~ta haiche tomAlokara zatru| yAlimasakalara ei vinimaYa kimAna ye nikRSTa!

AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTira samaYata mai siha~taka sAkSI karA nAchilo~ Aru svaYaM siha~tara sRSTira samaYato sAkSI karA nAchilo~, Aru Ami pathabhraSTakArIsakalaka sahAYakarUpeo grahaNa karA nAchilo~|

Aru seidiৱsara kathA smaraNa karA, yidinA teOM ka’va, ‘tomAloke yivoraka mora aMzI vuli dhAraNA karichilA seivoraka mAti AnA’| siha~te tetiYA seivoraka mAtiva kintu seivore siha~tara AhvAnata sa~hAri nidiva Aru Ami siha~ta ubhaYare madhyaৱrtI ThAita eTA dhvaMsa-gahvara rAkhi dima|
Aru aparAdhIvilAke jui dekhiYei gama pAva ye, siha~te tAta nikSipta ha’va kintu siha~ta sei ThAira parA (vAcivalai) kono paritrANasthala vicAri nApAva|
nizcaYa Ami mAnuhara vAve ei koraAnata sakalo dharaNara upamA vizadabhAৱe varNanA karicho~| kintu mAnuha ATAitakai vechi vitarkapriYa|

Aru yetiYA mAnuhara ocaralai pathanirdeza Ahe, tetiYA siha~taka ImAna poSaNara parA Aru siha~tara pratipAlakara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karAra parA keৱla eiToৱei virata rAkhe ye, siha~taro sei aৱsthAi haoka yi aৱsthA siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara haichila nAivA siha~tara ocaralai pratyakSabhAৱe kono zAsti Ahaka|

Aru Ami keৱla susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArIrUpehe rAchulasakalaka preraNa karo~, kintu kAphirasakale vAtilara dvArA tarka kare, yAte tAra mAdhyamata satyaka vyartha kari diva pAre| lagate siha~te mora nidarzanAৱlIka Aru yivorara dvArA siha~taka satarka karA haiche seivoraka vidrUpara viSaYarUpe grahaNa kare|

Aru seijanatakai adhika yAlima Aruno kona ha’va pAre, yAka tAra pratipAlakara AYAtasamUha smaraNa karAi diYA haiche kintu si tAra parA vimukha haiche Aru si pAhari gaiche tAra duhAte yi upasthita kariche? nizcaYa Ami siha~tara antarara oparata AৱraNa kari dicho~ yAte siha~te koraAna vujiva noৱAre Aru siha~tara kANata Ache vadhiratA| tumi siha~taka satpathata AhvAna karileo siha~te ketiYA satpathata nAhiva|

Aru tomAra pratipAlaka parama kSamAzIla, daYAlu| siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve yadi teOM siha~taka dharilehe~tena, tente teOM nizcaYa siha~taka ati sonakAle zAsti vihilehe~tena; kintu siha~tara vAve Ache eTA pratizruta muhUrta, yAra parA vAcivalai siha~te kadApio kono AzraYasthala vicAri nApAva|
Aru eivora haiche seivora janapada yivoraka Ami dhvaMsa karicho~, yetiYA siha~te anyAYa karichila Aru Ami siha~tara dhvaMsara vAve eTA nirdiSTa samaYa nirdhAraNa karichilo~|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA muchAi teOMra sahacara yuৱkaka kaichila, ‘mai dukhana naira saGgamasthalata upanIta nohoৱAlaike narakho~, lAgile mai yuga yuga samaYa (eidare kho~jakADha়i) gai thAkima’|

eteke yetiYA teOMloka ubhaYe dukhana naira saGgama sthalata Ahi upanIta ha’la, tetiYA teOMloke nije lai yoৱA mAchara kathATo pAharile, phalata mAchaToৱe suraGgara dare nijara patha vanAi sAgaralai nAmi ga’la|
eteke yetiYA teOMloke bhAlekhini ThAi atikrama karile tetiYA muchAi teOMra sahacarajanaka ka’le, ‘AmAra dupurIYAra bhojana lai AhA, nizcaYa Ami ei bhramaNata klAnta hai paricho~’|

si ka’le, ‘Apuni lakSya karichilane, yetiYA Ami zilAkhaNData vizrAma laichilo~ tetiYA mAchara saite yi ghaTichila sei kathA mai AponAka janAvalai pAhariYe gaichilo~, caYatAnei sei kathA moka pAharAi dichila; Aru mAchaToৱe AzcaryajanakabhAৱe nijara patha vanAi sAgarata nAmi gaichila|
teOM ka’le, ‘Ami sei sthAnaTorei anusandhAna kari Acho~’| tAra pichata teOMloke nijara padacihna anusaraNa kari ubhati ga’la|
iYAra pichata teOMloke mora ejana vAndAra sAkSAt pAle, yAka Ami AmAra phAlara parA anugraha dAna karichilo~ Aru AmAra phAlara parA eTA vizeSa jJAnara zikSA dichilo~|
muchAi teOMka ka’le, ‘mai ei cartata AponAra anusaraNa kariva pArimane ye, yi jJAna AponAka dAna karA haiche tAra parA moka zikSA diva, yAra dvArA mai saThika patha pAma’?
teOM ka’le, ‘Apuni ketiYAo mora lagata dhairya dhAraNa kari thAkiva noৱAriva,
‘kAraNa yi viSaYe AponAra jJAnAYatta nAi sei viSaYe Apuni kenekai dhairyya dhAraNa kariva pAriva’?
muchAi ka’le, ‘ina zvA AllAha Apuni moka dhairyyazIla pAva Aru AponAra kono Adeza mai amAnya nakarima’|
teOM ka’le, ‘Thika Ache, yadi Apuni mora anusaraNa karei tente kono viSaYe moka prazna nakariva, yetiYAlaike mai AponAka sei viSaYe khuli nakaOM’|

tAra pichata duYo yAtrA Arambha karile, aৱzeSata yetiYA teOMloke nAৱta ArohaNa karile tetiYA teOM nAokhana vidIrNa kari dile| muchAi ka’le, ‘Apuni ArohIsakalaka DuvAi mArivalai iYAka vidIrNa karile neki? nizcaYa Apuni eTA vara garhita anyAYa kAma karile’|
teOM ka’le, ‘mai koৱA nAchilo~ne ye, Apuni mora lagata ketiYAo dhairyya dhAraNa kariva noৱAriva’?
muchAi ka’le, ‘mai pAhari yoৱAra kAraNe mora doSa nadhariva, lagate mora viSaYe atyAdhika kaThoratA aৱlamvana nakariva’|

tAra pichata duYo gai thAkila, aৱzeSata teOMlokara lagata eTi zizura sAkSAt ha’la, tetiYA teOM tAka hatyA karile| muchAi ka’le, ‘hatyAra aparAdha nohoৱAkai Apuni eTA niSpApa jIৱnaka kiYa nAza karile? nizcaYa Apuni eTA garhita anyAYa kAma karile’|
teOM ka’le, ‘mai AponAka koৱA nAchilo~ne ye, Apuni mora lagata ketiYAo dhairyya dhAraNa kariva noৱAriva’?
muchAi ka’le, ‘iYAra pichata yadi mai AponAka kono viSaYe prazna karo~ tente Apuni moka lagata nArAkhiva; AponAra ocarata mora ojara-ApattiYe cUDa়Anta sImA pAichegai’|

tAra picata duYo Akau yoৱA Arambha karile, aৱzeSata yetiYA teOMloke eTA janapadara adhivAsIsakalara ocaralai gai upasthita ha’la, tetiYA teOMloke siha~tara ocarata khAdya vicArile; kintu siha~te teOMlokaka Atithya karivalai asvIkAra karile| tAra pichata teOMloke tAta ekhana prAcIra dekhA pAle, yikhana vAgari yoৱAra upakrama haichila, tetiYA teOM seiToka sudRDha় kari dile| muchAi ka’le, ‘Apuni icchA karile iYAra vAve pArizramika grahaNa kariva pArilehe~tena’|
teOM ka’le, ‘iYAtei mora Aru AponAra mAjata samparkaccheda hai ga’la, yivora viSaYata Apuni dhairyya dhAraNa kariva parA nAi, acirei mai seivorara tAtparya vyAkhyA karima|

‘nAokhanara viSaYaTo ha’la—eikhana Achila kichumAna daridra vyaktira, siha~te sAgarata kAma karichila; mai nAokhanaka truTiyukta karivalai icchA karilo~; kAraNa siha~tara sanmukhata Achila ene ejana rajA, yiYe valapraYoga kari pratikhana (nikhu~ta) bhAla nAo kADha়i niYe|
‘AnahAte sei zizuTi--- tAra pitR-mAtR Achila mumina| phalata Ami AzaMkA karilo~ ye, si sImAlaMghana kari Aru kupharIra dvArA teOMlokaka atiSTha kari tuliva|
‘seYe Ami vicArilo~ ye, teOMlokara pratipAlake yena teOMlokaka iYAra parivarte ejana susantAna dAna kare, yijana ha’va paৱitratAta uttama Aru marama-cenehata ati ghaniSTha|

‘Aru sei prAcIraTo—seiTo Achila nagaravAsI dujana etIma zizura Aru iYAra talata Achila siha~tara guptadhana Aru siha~tara pitR Achila ejana satkarmaparAYaNa loka| seYe AponAra pratipAlake icchA karile ye, siha~ta dujana prAptavaYaskata upanIta haoka Aru siha~tara sei guptadhana uddhAra karaka| Aru (eivora) mai nijara phAlara parA eko karA nAi; Apuni yi viSaYe dhairyya dhAraNa karivalai apAraga haichila, eiToৱei haiche tAra vyAkhyA’|
Aru siha~te tomAka jula-kAranAina samparke prazna kare| koৱA, ‘acirei mai tomAlokara ocarata teOMra viSaYe varNanA karima’|
nizcaYa Ami teOMka pRthiৱIta kartRtva pradAna karichilo~ Aru pratyeka viSaYara upAYa-upakaraNa dAna karichilo~|
tAra pichata teOM eTA patha aৱlamvana karile|

gai gai aৱzeSata teOM yetiYA sUryya asta yoৱAra sthalata upasthita ha’la, tetiYA teOM sUryyaka eTi paMkila jalAzaYata asta yoৱA dekhile Aru teOM tAta eTA sampradAYaka laga pAle| Ami ka'lo~, ‘he jula-kAranAina! tumi iha~taka zAsti diva pArA nAivA iha~tara viSaYaTo sadaYabhAৱe grahaNa kariva pArA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘yiYe anyAYa kariva acirei Ami tAka zAsti pradAna karima; tAra pichata tAka tAra pratipAlakara ocaralai obhatAi niYA ha’va, tetiYA teOM tAka kaThina zAsti pradAna kariva|
‘kintu yiYe ImAna Aniva Aru satkarma kariva teOMra vAve pratidAna svarUpe Ache kalyANa Aru Ami AmAra vyaৱhArato teOMra saite namrabhAৱe kathA kama’|
tAra pichata teOM Ana eTA (abhiyAnara vAve) patha dharile|

gai gai aৱzeSata teOM yetiYA sUryodaYara ThAi pAle, tetiYA teOM dekhA pAle ye, sUryya enekuৱA eTA sampradAYara oparata udaYa haYa, yisakalara vAve sUryyara tApara parA kono antarAla Ami sRSTi karA nAi;
prakRta ghaTanA eiToৱei, Aru teOMra ocarata yi Achila, sei samparke Ami samyaka aৱgata|
tAra pichata teOM Ana eTA (abhiyAnara vAve) patha dharile|
aৱzeSata teOM yetiYA dui parvatara madhyaৱrtI sthalata Ahi upanIta ha’la, tetiYA tAta teOM enekuৱA eTA sampradAYaka laga pAle, yisakale teOMra kathA bhAlakai vujiva parA nAchila|

siha~te ka’le, ‘he jula-kAranAina! iYA’juja Aru mA’juje pRthiৱIta azAnti sRSTi kari Ache| seYe Ami AponAka ei cartata kara AdAYa dimane, yAte Apuni AmAra Aru siha~tara mAjata eTA prAcIra nirmANa kari diYe’?

teOM ka’le, ‘mora pratipAlake moka yi sAmartha diche seiToৱe utkRSTa| gatike tomAloke moka daihika zramara dvArA sahAYa karA, mai tomAlokara Aru siha~tara mAjata ekhana majavuta prAcIra nirmANa kari dima’|

‘tomAloke mora ocaralai lora pAtasamUha Ani diYA’, aৱzeSata madhyaৱrtI khAlI ThAi pUrNa hai yetiYA lauhastUpa duYo parvatara samAna ha’la tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘etiYA phu~ di thakA’| tAra pichata yetiYA seiTo juita pariNata ha’la, tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke mora ocaralai galita tAma lai AhA, mai iYAra oparata DhAli diOM’|
tAra pichata siha~te (iYA’juja Aru mA’juje) seiTo atikrama kariva noৱArile Anaki phuTA karivao noৱArile|
teOM ka’le, ‘eiTo haiche mora pratipAlakara anugraha| kintu yetiYA mora pratipAlakara pratizruta samaYa Ahiva tetiYA teOM iYAka cUrNa-vicUrNa kari diva, Aru mora pratipAlakara pratizruti satya’|
Aru seidinA Ami siha~taka eri dima enekuৱA aৱsthAta ye, eTA dale AnaTo dalara oparata taraGgara dare khundiYAi pariva; Aru ziGAta phu~ diYA ha’va| tAra pichata Ami siha~ta sakaloke ekatrita karima|
Aru seidinA Ami jAhAnnAmaka pratyakSabhAৱe upasthApana karima kAphirasakalara ocarata,
AmAra nidarzanara prati yisakalara caku AৱraNere DhAki thoৱA Achila Aru yisakale zunivalaio apAraga Achila|

yisakale kupharI kariche, siha~te dhAraNA kare neki ye, siha~te mora parivarte mora vAndAsakalaka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa kariva? nizcaYa Ami kAphirasakalara ApyAYanara vAve prastuta kari rAkhicho~ jAhAnnAma|
koৱA, ‘Ami tomAlokaka ene lokara viSaYe saMvAda dimane, yisakala Amalara phAlara parA ATAitakai vechi kSatigrasta’?
siha~tei haiche seisakala loka, pArthiৱ jIৱnata yisakalara praceSTA vyartha haiche, athaca siha~te dhAraNA kare ye, siha~te bhAla kAmei kari Ache|

siha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakale nija pratipAlakara nidarzanAৱlIka Aru teOMra sAkSAtaka asvIkAra kariche| phalata siha~tara sakalo Amala niSphala hai gaiche; seYe Ami siha~tara vAve kiYAmatara dinA kono ojanara vyaৱsthA nakarima|
‘jAhAnnAmei haiche siha~tara pratiphala| yihetu siha~te kupharI kariche lagate mora nidarzanAৱlIka Aru rAchulasakalaka vidrUpara viSaYa hicApe grahaNa kariche’|
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMlokaka Atithya-abhyarthanA karivalai Ache jAnnAtula phiradAucha|
tAta teOMloka cirakAla thAkiva, tAra parA teOMloka (ketiYAo) sthAnAntarita ha’va nivicAriva|

koৱA, ‘mora pratipAlakara kathA lipivaddha karivalai sAgara yadi ciYA~hI haYa, tente mora pratipAlakara kathA zeSa hoৱAra Agatei sAgara niHzeSa hai yAva—yadio iYAra sAhAyyArthe anurUpa Aru sAgara lai Aho~’|

koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokara darei ejana mAnuha, mora prati ahI haYa ye, tomAlokara ilAha ekamAtra satya ilAha| seYe yiYe tAra pratipAlakara sAkSAt kAmanA kare, tAra ucita satkarma karA Aru tAra pratipAlakara ivAdatata Ana kAko aMzIdAra sthApana nakarA’|
kApha-hA-iYA-AIna- ca’da;[1]
eiTo haiche tomAra pratipAlakara anugrahara viৱraNa teOMra vAndA yAkAriYyAra prati,
yetiYA teOM nija pratipAlakaka gopane AhvAna karichila,
teOM kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! mora asthi durvala haiche, vArdhakyata mora mUra(ra culi) zubhrojjvala haiche; he mora pratipAlaka! tomAra ocarata duA kari mai ketiYAo vyartha hoৱA nAi|
nizcaYa mai mora pichata mora svagotrIYasakalara viSaYe AzaMkAvodha karicho~; Aru mora strIo haiche vandhyA| gatike tumi tomAra phAlara parA moka ejana uttarAdhikArI dAna karA,
‘yiYe mora uttarAdhikArI ha’va Aru uttarAdhikArI lAbha kariva iYAkUvara vaMzara, lagate he mora pratipAlaka! tumi tAka santoSabhAjana karivA’|
(AllAhe ka’le,) ‘he yAkAriYyA! nizcaYa Ami tomAka ejana putra santAnara susaMvAda dicho~, yAra nAma ha’va iYAhaYA; ei nAmere Ami Agate kAko nAmakaraNa karA nAchilo~’|
teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! kenekai mora putra santAna ha’va pAre, athaca mora strI haiche vandhyA Aru maYo vArdhakyara zeSa sImAta upanIta haicho~’!
(uttarata teOM) ka’le, ‘eidarei ha’va’| tomAra pratipAlake kaiche, ‘eiTo mora vAve ati sahaja; iYAra pUrve mai tomAko sRSTi karicho~ yetiYA tumi ekoৱei nAchilA’|

yAkAriYyAi ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka eTA nidarzana diYA’| teOM ka’le, ‘tomAra nidarzana eiToৱe ye, tumi sustha thakA satveo kramAgata tini rAti (dina) paryanta kAro lagata kathA ka’va noৱArivA’|
tAra pichata teOM (ivAdatara vAve nirdiSTa) kakSara parA olAi teOMra sampradAYara ocaralai Ahila Aru iGgitere siha~taka ka’le, ‘tomAloke puৱA-gadhUli AllAhara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karA’|
‘he iYAhaYA! tumi kitAvakhana dRDha়tAra saite grahaNa karA,’ Aru Ami teOMka zaizaৱtei prajJA dAna karichilo~,
Aru AmAra phAlara parA teOMka hRdaYara komalatA Aru paৱitratA dAna karicho~; Aru teOM Achila ejana muttAkvI|
Aru teOM Achila pitR-mAtRra prati anugata, tathA teOM ahaMkArI, avAdhya nAchila|
zAnti teOMra oparata anivArya, yidinA teOM janma lAbha kariche, yidinA teOM mRtyuvaraNa kariva Aru yidinA teOM jIৱita aৱsthAta utthita ha’va|
Aru (he rAchula!) tumi ei kitAvata (ullikhita) mAraYAmara kathA varNanA karA, yetiYA teOM nija pariYAlavargara parA pRthaka hai pUৱ dizara eTA nirjana sthAnata AzraYa nile,
tAra pichata teOM siha~tara parA nijake pardA karile| tetiYA Ami teOMra ocaralai AmAra rUha (jIvrIla)ka preraNa karilo~, phalata teOM mAraYAmara ocarata pUrNa mAnaৱAkRtita Ahi AtmaprakAza karile|
mAraYAme ka’le, ‘mai tomAra parA rahamAnara AzraYa prArthanA karicho~, (AllAhaka bhaYa karA Aru A~tari yoৱA) yadi tumi muttAkvI hoৱA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘maito tomAra pratipAlakara dUtahe, tomAka ejana paৱitra putra dAna karAra vAve Ahicho~’|
mAraYAme ka’le, ‘mora putra kenekai ha’va yihetu moka kono puruSe sparzai karA nAi Aru mai vyabhicAriNIo nahaYa’?

teOM ka’le, ‘eidarei ha’va’| tomAra pratipAlake kaiche, ‘eiTo mora vAve sahaja; Aru Ami teOMka eikAraNe sRSTi karima yAte teOM mAnuhara vAve eTA nidarzana haYa Aru AmAra phAlara parA eTA anugraha; eiTo eTA siddhAntakRta viSaYa’|
tAra pichata mAraYAme teOMka garbhata dhAraNa karile Aru sei garbhasaha dUraৱrtI eDokhara ThAilai guci ga’la;

tAra pichata prasaৱ-vedanAi teOMka ejopA khejura gachara talata AzraYa nivalai vAdhya karAle| teOM ka’le, ‘hAYa, iYAra Agatei yadi mai mRtyuvaraNa karilo~he~tena Aru mAnuhara smRtira parA sampUrNarUpe herAi ga’lo~he~tena!’
tetiYA talara parA teOM mAraYAmaka mAti ka’le, ‘tumi cintA nakarivA, tomAra pAdadezata tomAra pratipAlake eTA nijarA sRSTi kariche;
Aru tumi khejura gachara kANDa dhari jokAri diYA, i tomAra oparata tAjA pakA khejura pelAva|

eteke khoৱA, seৱna karA Aru caku jura peloৱA| yadi kono mAnuhara lagata tomAra dekhA haYa tente ka’vA, ‘mai rahamAnara uddezye maunatA aৱlamvanara mAnata karicho~| seYe mai Aji kAro lagata kathA nakaOM’|
tAra pichata teOM ke~cuৱATika lai nija sampradAYara ocarata Ahi upasthita ha’la, siha~te ka’le, ‘he mAraYAma! nizcaYa tumi eTA adbhUta kANDa karichA’|
‘he hArUnara bhagnI! tomAra pitA kintu asat vyakti nAchila Aru tomAra mAtRo vyabhicAriNI nAchila’|
tetiYA mAraYAme ke~cuৱATira prati iMgita karile| siha~te ka’le, ‘kolAta thakA eTi ke~cuৱAra saite Ami kenekai kathA pAtima’?
ke~cuৱAToৱe mAta lagAle, ‘nizcaYa mai ejana AllAhara vAndA| teৱe~i moka kitAva pradAna kariche Aru moka navI vanAiche,
‘mai ya’tei nAthAko~ kiYa teOM moka varakatamaYa kariche, lagate teOM moka AjIৱna chAlAta Aru yAkAta AdAYa karivalai nirdeza diche--
‘Aru moka mora mAtRra prati anugata kariche, lagate teOM moka ahaMkArI, avAdhya vanoৱA nAi;
‘Aru mora oparata zAnti anivArya yidinA mai janma lAbha karicho~, yidinA mora mRtyu ha’va Aru yidinA mai jIৱita aৱsthAta utthita ha'ma’|
eiToৱei haiche mAraYAmara putra IchA (ra ghaTanA)| (mai yi varNanA karilo~) eiToৱe haiche satya kathA, yi viSaYata siha~te sandeha poSaNa kare|
santAna grahaNa karATo AllAhara kAma nahaYa| teOM paৱitra mahimAmaYa| teOM yetiYA kivA karivalai sthira kare, tetiYA keৱla ei vuli kaYa ‘ha’ seiTo tatkSaNAta hai yAYa|
nizcaYa AllAhei haiche mora pratipAlaka Aru tomAlokaro pratipAlaka; seYe tomAloke teOMra ivAdata karA, eiToৱei haiche sarala patha|
tathApio dalasamUhe nijara mAjate matAnaikya sRSTi karile, seYe mahAdiৱsa pratyakSakAlata kAphirasakalara vAve dhvaMsa anivArya|
siha~te yidinA AmAra ocarata upasthita ha’va sidinA siha~te kimAna ye spaSTakai zunA pAva Aru dekhA pAva! kintu yAlimasakala Aji spaSTa vibhrAntita Ache|

(he rAchula!) tumi siha~taka paritApara dina samparke satarka kari diYA, yidinA sakalo siddhAnta cUDa়Anta hai yAva| athaca (etiYA) siha~te udAsInatAta vibhora hai Ache Aru siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakare|
nizcaYa pRthiৱI Aru iYAra oparata yi yi Ache sei sakalovorara cUDa়Anta mAlikAnAsvatva keৱla AmArei, Aru AmAra ocaratei siha~te pratyAৱrtana kariva lAgiva|
lagate varNanA karA ei kitAvata (ullikhita) ivrAhImara kathA, nizcaYa teOM Achila parama satyavAdI, navI|
yetiYA teOM teOMra pitAka ka’le, ‘he mora pitR! Apuni kiYa ene vastura ivAdata kare yiYe eko zunA nApAYa, dekhA nApAYa Aru AponAra kono kAmato nAhe’?
‘he mora pitR! mora ocaralai enekuৱA jJAna Ahiche yiTo AponAra ocarata AhA nAi; seYe mora anusaraNa karaka, mai AponAka saThika patha dekhuৱAma|
‘he mora pitR! caYatAnara ivAdata nakariva| nizcaYa caYatAna haiche rahamAnara avAdhya|
‘he mora pitR! mora AzaMkA haiche ye, rahamAnara zAstiYe AponAka sparza kariva, phalata Apuni caYatAnara vandhu hai pariva’|

pitAi ka’le, ‘he ivrAhIma! tumi mora upAsyavorara parA vimukha haichA neki? yadi tumi (ene AcaraNara parA) virata nohoৱA tente nizcaYa mai tomAka zila daliYAi tomAra prANa nAza karima; Aru tumi dIrgha samaYara vAve moka eri guci yoৱA’|
ivrAhIme ka’le, ‘AponAra prati chAlAma| mai mora pratipAlakara ocarata AponAra vAve kSamA prArthanA karima; nizcaYa teOM mora prati vara anugrahazIla|

‘lagate mai AponAlokara parA Aru AponAloke AllAhara vAhire yivorara ivAdata kare seivorara parA pRthaka ha'lo~; Aru mai keৱla mora pratipAlakake AhvAna karima; AzA karo~ mai mora pratipAlakaka AhvAna kari vyartha nahama’|

tAra pichata teOM yetiYA siha~tara parA Aru siha~te AllAhara vAhire yivorara ivAdata karichila seivorara parA pRthaka hai ga’la, tetiYA Ami teOMka dAna karilo~ ichahAkva Aru iYAkUva Aru pratyekake navI vanAicho~|
Aru Ami teOMlokaka AmAra anugraha dAna karilo~, Aru teOMlokara nAma-yazasyA ucca karilo~|
Aru ei kitAvata (ullikhita) muchAra kathA varNanA karA, teOM Achila vizeSa manonIta Aru teOM Achila rAchula, navI|
Aru teOMka Ami mAtichilo~ tUra parvatara so~phAlara parA, lagate antaraGga AlApara uddezye Ami teOMka nikaTaৱrtI karichilo~|
Aru Ami AmAra nija anugrahata teOMra vAve teOMra bhAtR hArUnaka navIrUpe dAna karichilo~|
lagate (he navI!) ei kitAvata (ullikhita) ichamAIlara kathA varNanA karA, nizcaYa teOM Achila pratizruti pAlanata satyAzraYI Aru teOM Achila rAchula, navI;
teOM nija pariYAlavargaka chAlAta Aru yAkAtara nirdeza dichila Aru teOM Achila nija pratipAlakara ocarata santoSabhAjana|
Aru ei kitAvata (ullikhita) idrIchara kathA varNanA karA, nizcaYa teOM Achila satyaniSTha navI;
Aru Ami teOMka ucca maryAdAta unnIta karichilo~|

eOMlokei haiche seisakala navI, Adama santAnara mAjara parA AllAhe yisakalaka anugraha kariche Aru (eOMloka seisakala lokara vaMzadhara) yisakalaka Ami nUhara lagata nAৱ~ta ArohaNa karoৱAichilo~| lagate eOMloka haiche ivrAhIma Aru icharAIlara vaMzodbhUta, tathA (teOMlokaro vaMzadhara) yisakalaka Ami hidAYata pradAna karichilo~ Aru manonIta karichilo~; teOMlokara ocarata rahamAnara AYAta tilAৱta karA ha’le teOMloke kAndi kAndi chAjadAta parichila| (chAjadAha 5)
teOMlokara pichata Ahila ayogya vaMzadhara, yisakale chAlAta vinaSTa karichila Aru kupravRttira anusaraNa karichila| seYe acirei siha~te kSatigrastatAra sanmukhIna ha’va|
kintu seisakala lokara vAhire, yisakale tAovA kariche, ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche| teOMlokei jAnnAtata praৱeza kariva| teOMlokara prati kono anyAYa karA naha’va|
eiTo cirasthAYI jAnnAta, yAra gAYevI pratizruti parama karuNAmaYe teOMra vAndAsakalaka pradAna karichila| nizcaYa teOMra pratizruta viSaYa aৱzyambhAৱI|
tAta teOMloke chAlAma tathA zAntira vAhire Ana kono asAra vAkya zunivalai nApAva Aru tAta puৱA-gadhUli teOMlokara vAve thAkiva teOMlokara rijikva (AhAra)|
eiToৱe haiche sei jAnnAta, yAra adhikArI Ami AmAra vAndAsakalara mAjara muttAkvIsakalaka karima|

(jivrIle ka’le) Ami AponAra pratipAlakara Adeza avihane aৱtaraNa nakaro~; AmAra sanmukhata yi Ache Aru pichaphAle yi Ache, lagate ei duYore mAjata yi yi Ache sei sakalo teOMrei; Aru AponAra pratipAlaka vismRta nahaYa|

teৱe~i AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjata thakA sakalore pratipAlaka| seYe keৱla teOMrei ivAdata karaka Aru teOMra ivAdatata dhairyya dhAraNa karaka| Apuni teOMra samanAma guNa sampanna kArovAka jAnene?
Aru mAnuhe kaYa, ‘mai mRtyuvaraNa karile moka Akau jIৱita aৱsthAta uThoৱA ha’va neki’?
mAnuhe smaraNa nakare neki ye, nizcaYa AmiYei tAka iYAra pUrve sRSTi karicho~, yetiYA si ekoৱei nAchila?
eteke tomAra pratipAlakara zapata! nizcaYa Ami siha~taka Aru caYatAnasakalaka ekelage samaveta karima, tAra pichata Ami siha~taka natajAnu aৱsthAta jAhAnnAmara cAriophAle upasthita karima|
tAra pichata pratyeka dalara mAjara parA yijana rahamAnara sarvAdhika avAdhya Achila, Ami tAka TAni uliYAi Anima|
Aru Amihe bhAlakai jAno siha~taka, yisakala jAhAnnAmata dagdha hoৱAra vechi upayukta|
Aru tomAlokara pratyekei tAra (jAhAnnAmara) oparedi atikrama kariva lAgiva; eiTo tomAra pratipAlakara cUDa়Anta siddhAnta|
tAra pichata Ami uddhAra karima teOMlokaka, yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karichila Aru yAlimasakalaka tAta natajAnu aৱsthAta rAkhi dima|
Aru siha~tara ocarata AmAra spaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karA ha’le kAphirasakale muminasakalaka kaYa, ‘(AmAra) dui dalara mAjata maryAdAta kona zreSTha Aru kAra sabhA vechi jAkajamakatApUrNa’?
Aru siha~tara pUrve Ami vahu mAnaৱgoSThIka vinAza karicho~—yisakala sampada Aru vAhyadRSTita siha~tatakaio zreSTha Achila|
