koৱA, ‘yisakale vibhrAntita Ache, parama karuNAmaYe siha~taka pracura aৱkAza diva, aৱzeSata yetiYA siha~te seYA pratyakSabhAৱe dekhivalai pAva yi viSaYe siha~taka satarka karA haichila, seYA zAstiYei haoka vA kiYAmatei haoka, tetiYAhe siha~te jAnivalai pAva maryAdAra kSetrata kona ati nikRSTa Aru dalavalara kSetrata kona vechi durvala’|
Aru yisakale satpathata cale AllAhe teOMlokara hidAYata vRddhi kari diYe; Aru sthAYI satkarmasamUha tomAra pratipAlakara puraskAra prAptira vAve zreSTha Aru pariNatira phAlereo ati uttama|
tumi seijana vyaktika dekhichAne, yiYe AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kare Aru kaYa, ‘nizcaYa moka dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati diYA ha’va’|
si gAYeva samparke aৱhita haiche neki, ne rahamAnara parA kono pratizruti lAbha kariche?
ketiYAo nahaYa, si yi kaYa Ami seYA likhi rAkhima Aru tAra zAstihe vRddhi kari thAkima|
Aru si yi (dhana-sampada, janavalara kathA) kaYa, (tAra mRtyura pichata) seYA thAkiva AmAra adhikArata Aru si akalazarIYA hai AmAra ocaratei upasthita ha'vahi|
Aru siha~te AllAhara vAhire vahuto ilAha grahaNa kariche, yAte seivora siha~tara vAve sanmAnara kAraNa haYa (Aru sahAYaka haYa);
ketiYAo nahaYa, anatipalame siha~te (upAsyavore) siha~tara ivAdataka asvIkAra kariva Aru siha~tara virodhI hai yAva|
tumi lakSya karA nAine, Ami kAphirasakalara vAve caYatAnavoraka eri thaicho~, siha~taka veYA kAmata vizeSabhAৱe praluvdha karAra vAve?
eteke siha~tara viSaYe tumi kharakhedA nakarivA| nizcaYa Ami siha~tara nirdhArita kAla gaNanA karicho~,
(smaraNa karA) yidinA Ami rahamAnara ocarata muttAkvIsakalaka sanmAnita atithirUpe samaveta karima,
Aru aparAdhIvilAkaka tRSNAtura aৱsthAta jAhAnnAmara phAle khedi lai yAma|
yisakale rahamAnara parA pratizruti laiche, teOMlokara vAhire koneo cupAricha kariva noৱAriva|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘rahamAne santAna grahaNa kariche’|
nizcaYa tomAloke eTA vIbhatsa viSaYara aৱtAraNA karichA;
(enekuৱA viSaYa) yAra phalata AkAzasamUha vidIrNa hai yoৱAra upakrama haYa, lagate pRthiৱI khaNDa-vikhaNDa Aru pAhAra-parvata cUrNa-vicUrNa hai yoৱAra upakrama haYa,
eikAraNe ye, siha~te rahamAnara prati santAna Aropa kariche|
athaca santAna grahaNa karA rahamAnara vAve zobhanIYa nahaYa|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta enekuৱA kono nAi yiYe rahamAnara ocarata vAndArUpe upasthita naha’va|
teOM siha~tara saMkhyA jAne Aru teOM siha~taka vizeSabhAৱe gaNanA kari thaiche,
Aru kiYAmatara dinA siha~ta sakaloৱe teOMra ocaralai akalazarIYA hai Ahiva|
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, rahamAne aৱzye teOMlokara vAve (pAraspArika) samprIti sRSTi kariva|
Aru Ami tomAra bhASAta koraAnaka sahaja kari dicho~, yAte tumi iYAra dvArA muttAkvIsakalaka susaMvAda diva pArA Aru vitaNDApriYa sampradAYaka iYAra dvArA satarka kariva pArA|
Aru siha~tara pUrve Ami kimAna ye prajanmaka vinAza karicho~! tumi siha~tara kArovAra astitva anubhaৱ karichAne athavA kSINatakaio kSINa (riNikA ahA) kono zavda zunivalai poৱAne?
tvA-hA [1]
tomAka dukha-kaSTata patita karivalai Ami tomAra prati koraAna aৱtIrNa karA nAi;
varaM yiYe (AllAhaka) bhaYa kare tAra vAve upadeza svarUpa (aৱtIrNa karicho~),
eikhana teOMra phAlara parA aৱtIrNa; yijane pRthiৱI Aru suucca AkAzasamUha sRSTi kariche,
parama karuNAmaYa (rahamAna) Arachara oparata uThiche|
AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjata yi yi Ache lagate bhU-garbhata yi Ache sei sakalo teOMrei|
Aru yadi tumi ucca kaNThata kathA koৱA (yadio iYAra kono praYojana nAi), tente (jAni thoৱA) teOM gopana Aru avyakta sakalo viSaYe aৱgata|
AllAha, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, sundara nAmasamUha keৱla teOMrei|
Aru muchAra vRttAnta tomAra ocaralai Ahi pAichene?

teOM yetiYA jui dekhA pAle tetiYA teOM nijara pariYAlavargaka ka’le, ‘tomAloke apekSA karA, nizcaYa mai jui dekhA pAicho~| AzA karo~ mai tomAlokara vAve tAra parA alapa jvalanta eGAra Aniva pArima nAivA juira ocarata kono pathanirdeza pAva pAro~’|
yetiYA teOM juira ocara Ahi pAle tetiYA teOMka AhvAna karA ha’la, ‘he muchA!
‘nizcaYa maYei haicho~ tomAra pratipAlaka, eteke tomAra jotAyora khuli peloৱA, kAraNa tumi etiYA paৱitra toৱA upatyakAta AchA|
‘Aru mai tomAka manonIta karicho~| eteke yi ahI preraNa karA haYa seYA manoyoga sahakAre zunA|
‘nizcaYa maYei AllAha, mora vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| eteke keৱla morei ivAdata karA Aru mora smaraNArthe chAlAta kAYema karA|
‘nizcaYa kiYAmata aৱzyambhAৱI, mai eiTo gopana rAkhiva vicAro~, yAte pratyekake nija nija ceSTA-sAdhanA anuyAYI pratidAna diva parA yAYa|
‘eteke yi vyaktiYe kiYAmatara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare Aru nijara pravRttira anusaraNa kare, si yena tomAka iYAra prati ImAna Anivalai virata rAkhiva noৱAre, anyathA tumi dhvaMsa hai yAvA|
‘Aru he muchA! tomAra so~hAtata seiDAla ki’?
teOM ka’le, ‘eiDAla haiche mora lAkhuTi, iYAra oparata mai bhara diOM, Aru iYAra dvArA mai mora chAgalIvorara vAve gachara pAta sarAOM, lagate eiDAla mora anyAnya kAmato Ahe’|
AllAhe ka’le, ‘he muchA! tumi eiDAla (mATita) nikSepa karAcona’|
tAra pichata teOM sei lAkhuTiDAla nikSepa karile, lage lage seYA eDAla sApa hai daurivalai dharile,
AllAhe ka’le, ‘tumi iYAka dharA, bhaYa nakarivA, Ami iYAka iYAra Agara aৱsthAlai obhatAi dima|
‘Aru tumi tomAra hAtakhana kASalatita rAkhA, kono dharaNara truTi nohoৱAkai ujjvala hai olAi Ahiva, eiTo haiche Ana eTA nidarzana|
‘eiTo eikAraNe ye, Ami tomAka AmAra kichumAna mahAna nidarzanAৱlI dekhuৱAma|
‘tumi phiraAunara ocaralai yoৱA, nizcaYa si sImAlaGghana kariche’|
muchAi ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! mora vuku prazasta kari diYA|
‘Aru mora kAma sahaja kari diYA,
‘Aru mora jibhAra jaDa়tA dUra kari diYA-

Aru yadi Ami siha~taka iYAra pUrvei zAstira dvArA dhvaMsa karilo~he~tena, tente nizcaYa siha~te ka’lehe~tena, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAra ocaralai rAchula napaThAlA kiYa? tetiYA Ami lAJchita Aru apamAnita hoৱAra Agatei tomAra nidarzanAৱlIra anusaraNa karilo~he~tena’|
koৱA, ‘pratyekei pratIkSA kari Ache, gatike tomAlokeo pratIkSA karA| tAra pichata acirei tomAloke jAniva pArivA sarala pathata kona Ache Aru kone satpatha aৱlamvana kariche’|
mAnuhara hicApa-nikAcara samaYa samIpaৱrttI, athaca siha~te udAsinatAta vimukha hai Ache|
yetiYAi siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara pratipAlakara taraphara parA kono natuna upadeza Ahe, tetiYAi siha~te tAka kautukacchalere zraৱNa kare,
siha~tara antara thAke amanoyogI| yisakale anyAYa kariche siha~te gopane parAmarza kare, ‘eOM dekhona tomAlokara darei ejana mAnuha, tathApio tomAloke dekhi-zuni yAdura kavalata parivAne’?
teOM (rAchule) ka’le, ‘AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sakalo kathAi mora pratipAlakara janA Ache Aru teৱe~i sarvazrotA, sarvajJa’|

varaM siha~te kaYa, ‘eivora haiche alIka kalpanA, haYato si eivora nijei racanA kariche, nahaYa si ejana kavi| naha’le si AmAra ocaralai kono eTA nidarzana lai Ahaka, yenekai pUrvaৱrtIsakala nidarzanasaha prerita haichila’|
iha~tara pUrve yivora janapada Ami dhvaMsa karicho~, seivora ThAira adhivAsIsakaleo ImAna poSaNa karA nAchila; tente iha~te ImAna poSaNa karivane?
Aru tomAra pUrve Ami keৱla puruSasakalakei (rAchula hicApe) preraNa karichilo~; teOMlokara prati Ami ahI preraNa karichilo~| eteke yadi tomAloke nAjAnA teneha’le jJAnIsakalaka sudhi loৱA|
Ami teOMlokaka enekuৱA kono dehaviziSTa karA nAchilo~ ye, teOMloke khAdya grahaNa karA nAchila, lagate teOMloka ciraJjIৱIo nAchila|
tAra pichata Ami teOMlokara prati karA pratizruti satya kari dekhuৱAlo~, phalata Ami teOMlokaka Aru yisakalaka icchA rakSA karichilo~ Aru sImAlaMghana kArIsakalaka dhvaMsa karichilo~|
nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara prati kitAva aৱtIrNa karicho~, ya’ta Ache tomAlokara vAve upadeza Aru maryAdA, tathApio tomAloke vuji nopoৱAne?
Aru Ami kimAna ye janapada dhvaMsa karicho~, yAra adhivAsIsakala Achila yAlima Aru siha~tara pichata sRSTi karicho~ Ana eTA jAti!
eteke siha~te yetiYA AmAra zAsti ahA vuli anubhaৱ karile, tetiYAi siha~te tAra parA palAYana karivalai dharile|

(siha~taka koৱA ha’la) ‘palAYana nakarivA, tomAloke ya’ta bhoga-vilAsata matta AchilA sei ThAilai ubhati yoৱA tathA tomAloke nijara ghara-duৱAralai ubhati yoৱA, yAte ei viSaYe tomAlokaka sudhiva parA yAYa’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘hAYa! durbhAgya AmAra! nizcaYa Ami yAlima Achilo~’|
eteke siha~tara ei ArtanAda caliYe Achila yetiYAlaike Ami siha~taka dAi niYA zasya Aru numAi yoৱA juira dare karA nAchilo~|
AkAza Aru pRthiৱI lagate ei duYore mAjata yi Ache seivoraka Ami khela-dhemAlira chalere sRSTi karA nAi|
khela-dhemAlira vastu sRSTi karAi yadi AmAra abhiprAYa ha’lahe~tena, tente AmAra (ocarata yi Ache tAra) parAi Ami karilo~he~tena; kintu Ami seYA karA nAi|

varaM Ami satyara dvArA asatyaka AghAta karo~, phalata i asatyaka cUrNa-vicUrNa kari diYe Aru tatkSaNAta asatya nicihna hai yAYa, Aru tomAloke AllAhaka yi guNere AkhyAYita karichA tAra kAraNe tomAlokara vAve Ache durbhoga!
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo teOMrei; Aru teOMra sAnnidhyata yisakala Ache teOMloke ahaMkAra kari teOMra ivAdatara parA vimukha nahaYa Aru teOMloke virakti vodho nakare|
teOMloke dine-rAti teOMrei paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare, teOMloke alasatA nakare|
siha~te (kAphirasakale) pRthiৱIra parA yivoraka upAsya hicApe grahaNa kariche seivore kono mRtaka jIৱita karivalai sakSamane?

yadi ei duYore (AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra) mAjata AllAhara vAhire vahu ilAha thAkilahe~tena, tente ubhaYei vizRMkhala hai ga’lahe~tena| eteke siha~te yi varNanA kare tAra parA Arachara adhipati AllAha ati paৱitra|
teOM yi kare sei viSaYe teOM javAvadihi naha’va; varaM siha~takei prazna karA ha’va|

siha~te teOMra vAhire vahu ilAha grahaNa kariche neki? koৱA, ‘(tente) tomAloke iYAra pramANa lai AhA| mora lagata yi Ache eiTohe teOMra upadeza Aru eiToৱei upadeza Achila mora pUrvaৱrtIsakalara’| kintu siha~tara vechi bhAgei prakRta satya nAjAne; phalata siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa|
Aru tomAra pUrve Ami yi rAchulakei preraNa karicho~ teOMra ocarata eiToৱei ahI karicho~ ye, ‘mora vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, seYe tomAloke keৱla morei ivAdata karA’|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘rahamAne (AllAhe phiristAsakalaka) santAna (hicApe) grahaNa kariche’| teOM paৱitra mahAna! varaM teOMloka haiche teOMra sanmAnita vAndA|
teOMloke teOMra Agadhari nAmAte; teOMloke keৱla teOMra Adeza anusArei kAma kare|
teOMlokara sanmukhata Aru pichata yi Ache sei sakalo teOM jAne| teOMloke cupAricha kare keৱla seisakala lokara vAvei yisakalara prati AllAha santuSTa Aru teOMloke teOMra bhaYata bhIta santrasta|
Aru teOMlokara mAjara yiYe ka’va ye, ‘AllAhara vAhire maYei ilAha’, tAka Ami jAhAnnAmara zAsti pradAna karima; eidarei Ami yAlimasakalaka pratidAna diOM|

yisakale kupharI kare siha~te (bhAvi-cinti) coৱA nAi neki ye, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI otaprotabhAৱe milita hai Achila, tAra pichata Ami ubhaYaka pRthaka kari dicho~; lagate pratyeka sajIৱ vastuke Ami pAnIra parA sRSTi karicho~; tathApio siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakarivane?
Aru Ami pRthiৱIta sRSTi karicho~ sudRDha় parvata, yAte pRthiৱIYe siha~taka lai tharaka-varaka nakare, Aru tAta Ami taiYAra karicho~ prazasta patha, yAte siha~te gantavyasthalata gai pAYa|
Aru Ami AkAzaka karicho~ surakSita cAda; kintu siha~te AkAzata aৱsthita nidarzanAৱlIra parA mukha ghurAi laYa|
Aru AllAhei sRSTi kariche rAti Aru dina, sUrya Aru candra; pratyekei nija nija kakSapathata vicaraNa kare|
Aru Ami tomAra pUrveo kono mAnuhakei cirajIৱI karA nAchilo~, gatike tumi yadi mRtyuvaraNa karA tente siha~te cirajIৱI hai thAkiva neki?
pratiTo jIৱi mRtyura soৱAda grahaNa kariva; Ami tomAlokaka bhAla Aru veYAra dvArA vizeSabhAৱe parIkSA kari thAko~, Aru AmAra ocaratei tomAloke ubhati Ahiva lAgiva|

Aru yisakale kupharI kare siha~te yetiYA tomAka dekhe tetiYA siha~te keৱla tomAka upahAsara pAtra hicApehe grahaNa kare| siha~te kaYa, ‘eOMৱei seijana neki, yiYe tomAlokara upAsyavoraka lai samAlocanA kare’?, athaca siha~tei rahamAnara AlocanAra virodhitA kare|
mAnuha sRSTigatabhAৱei kSIpratA-praৱNa, zIghrei mai tomAlokaka mora nidarzanAৱlI dekhuৱAma; seYe tomAloke kharadhara nakarivA|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA tente koৱA ei pratizruti ketiYA pUrNa ha’va’?

yadi kAphirasakale sei samaYara kathA jAnilehe~tena, yetiYA siha~te siha~tara mukhamaNDala Aru piThira parA jui pratirodha kariva noৱAriva Aru siha~taka sahAYao karA naha’va (tente siha~te sei zAstika kharakhedAkai nivicArilehe~tena)|
varaM seYA siha~tara oparata AkasmikabhAৱe Ahiva Aru siha~taka hatabhamva kari diva| phalata siha~te tAka rodha karivao noৱAriva Aru siha~taka aৱkAzo diYA naha’va|
nizcaYa tomAra pUrve vahuto rAchulaka upahAsa karA haichila| phalata yisakale teOMlokara lagata upahAsa karichila siha~taka siha~tara upahAsei pariveSTana kari laichila|
koৱA, ‘rAtite haoka vA dinate haoka rahamAnara (zAstira) parA kone tomAlokaka rakSA kariva’? tathApio siha~te nija pratipAlakara smaraNara parA mukha ghUrAi laYa|

tente AmAra vAhire siha~tara enekuৱAo kichumAna ilAha Ache neki yivore siha~taka rakSA kariva pAriva? siha~te dekhona nijakei sahAYa kariva noৱAre Aru AmAra (zAstira) parA rakSA pAvalaio siha~te kono AzraYadAnakArI nApAva|

varaM AmiYei siha~taka Aru siha~tara pitR-puruSasakalaka bhoga-sambhAra dAna karichilo~, lagate siha~tara AYu kAlao Achila dIghalIYA| siha~te dekhA nAine ye, Ami siha~tara bhUmika cAriophAlara parA saMkucita kari Ani Acho~| tathApio siha~tei vijaYI ha’vane?
koৱA, ‘mai keৱla ahIra dvArAhe tomAlokaka satarka karo~’; kintu yisakala vadhira siha~taka yetiYA satarka karA haYa tetiYA siha~te sei AhvAna nuzune|
Aru tomAra pratipAlakara zAstira akaNamAno yadi siha~taka sparza kare tente nizcaYa siha~te kai uThiva, ‘hAYa! durbhAgya AmAra, nizcaYa Ami yAlima Achilo~!

Aru kiYAmatara dinA Ami nyAYavicArara tulAcanI sthApana karima, seYe kAro prati kono dharaNara anyAYa karA naha’va Aru Amala yadi sariYaha dAnA parimANa ojanaro haYa tathApio Ami seYA upasthita karima; Aru hicApa grahaNakArIrUpe AmiYei yatheSTa|
nizcaYa Ami muchA Aru hArUnaka dAna karichilo~ phurakvAna (satya-asatya pArthakya kariva parA grantha), yikhana Achila muttAkvIsakalara vAve jyoti Aru upadeza--
yisakale nedekhAkaiYe teOMlokara pratipAlakaka bhaYa kare Aru teOMloke kiYAmata samparke bhIta-santrasta|
Aru eikhana haiche varakatamaYa upadeza, yikhana Ami aৱtIrNa karicho~| tathApio tomAloke iYAka asvIkAra karivAne?
Aru Ami iYAra Agata ivrAhImaka zubhavuddhi Aru saThika jJAna dAna karichilo~ Aru Ami teOMra viSaYe Achilo~ samyaka parijJAta|
yetiYA teOM teOMra pitRka Aru nija sampradAYaka ka’le, ‘ei mUrtivora ki? yivorara pUjAta tomAloke Asakta haichA!’
siha~te ka’le, ‘Ami AmAra pitR-puruSasakalaka eivorara ivAdata karA dekhicho~’|
teOM ka’le, ‘nizcaYa tomAloka Aru tomAlokara pitR-puruSasakala spaSTa vibhrAntita AchA’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi AmAra ocaralai satya AnichA, ne AmAra lagata dhemAli kari AchA?
teOM ka’le, ‘varaM tomAlokara pratipAlaka haiche seijana, yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra pratipAlaka, yiYe eivoraka sRSTi kariche, Aru ei viSaYata mai anyatama sAkSI’|
‘AllAhara zapata! tomAloke guci yoৱAra pichata mai nizcaYa tomAlokara mUrtivorara viSaYe kauzala aৱlamvana karima’|
tAra pichata teOM mUrtivora cUrNa-vicUrNa kari dile keৱla DAGara mUrtiTora vAhire; yAte siha~te tAra ocaralai ubhati yAYa|
siha~te ka’le, ‘AmAra upAsyavorara saite kone ei kAma kariche? nizcaYa si haiche anyatama yAlima’|
kichumAne ka’le, ‘Ami ejana yuৱkaka eivorara samAlocanA karo~te zunicho~; yAka ivrAhIma vuli koৱA haYa’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘teneha’le tAka janasanmukhata upasthita karA~, yAte siha~te sAkSya haYa’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘he ivrAhIma! AmAra upAsyavorara saite tumiYei ei kAma karichA neki’?
teOM ka’le, ‘varaM iha~tara ei pradhAnajanei kijAni ei kAma kariche, eteke eivoraka sudhi coৱA, yadi eivore kathA ka’va pAre’|
tetiYA siha~te nijei punara vivecanA kari dekhile Aru ijane sijanaka ka’le, ‘nizcaYa tomAlokei Acala anyAYakArI’|
tAra pichata siha~tara zira nata ha’la Aru ka’le, ‘tumi dekhona jAnAi ye, eivore kathA ka'va noৱAre’|
teOM ka’le, ‘teneha’le tomAloke AllAhara parivarte enekuৱA vastura ivAdata karA neki yiYe tomAlokara kono upakArao kariva noৱAre Aru apakAro kariva noৱAre?
‘dhika tomAlokara prati Aru AllAhara parivarte tomAloke yivorara ivAdata karA seivorara prati! tathApio tomAloke nuvujAne’?
siha~te ka’le, ‘yadi tomAloke kivA kariva vicarA tente iYAka jvalAi diYA Aru tomAlokara upAsyavoraka sahAYa karA’|
Ami ka’lo~, ‘he jui! tumi ivrAhImara vAve zItala Aru nirApada hai yoৱA’|
siha~te teOMka kSati sAdhana karivalai cakrAnta karichila| kintu Ami siha~takei vechi kSatigrasta kari dilo~|
Ami teOMka Aru lUtaka uddhAra kari sei (zvAma vA ciriYA) dezata lai ga’lo~, ya’ta vizvAvAsIra vAve Ami kalyANa rAkhicho~|
Ami teOMka (ivrAhImaka) dAna karichilo~ ichahAkva, lagate atirikta puraskArasvarUpe dAna karichilo~ iYAkUva; Aru pratyekake Ami satkarmaparAYaNa vanAichilo~|

Aru Ami teOMlokaka netRtva dAna karichilo~, teOMloke AmAra nirdeza anusAre mAnuhaka saThika patha dekhuৱAichila; Aru Ami teOMlokaka satkarma karivalai, chAlAta kAYema karivalai Aru yAkAta pradAna karivalai ahI preraNa karichilo~; Aru teOMloka AmArei ivAdatakArI Achila|

Aru lUtaka Ami dAna karichilo~ prajJA Aru jJAna, Aru teOMka Ami uddhAra karichilo~ enekuৱA eTA janapadara parA yAra adhivAsIvilAka lipta Achila azlIla kAmata; nizcaYa siha~ta Achila eTA veYA phAchikva sampradAYa|
Aru Ami teOMka AmAra anugrahara antarbhukta karichilo~; nizcaYa teOM Achila satkarmaparAYaNasakalara anyatama|
Aru (smaraNa karA) nUhara kathA; itipUrve teOM yetiYA AhvAna karichila tetiYA Ami teOMra AhvAnata sa~hAri dichilo~, lagate teOMka Aru teOMra pariYAlavargaka mahAsaMkaTara parA uddhAra karichilo~,

Aru Ami teOMka sahAYa karichilo~ sei sampradAYara viruddhe yisakale AmAra nidarzanAৱlIka asvIkAra karichila; nizcaYa siha~ta Achila eTA phAchikva sampradAYa| eikAraNei Ami siha~ta sakaloke DuvAi mArichilo~|

lagate smaraNa karA dAuda Aru chulAimAnaka, yetiYA teOMloke zasyakSetra samparke vicAra karichila; yi zasyakSetrata rAti mAnuhara bherA-chAgalI praৱeza karichila; Aru Ami teOMlokara vicAra paryavekSaNa kari Achilo~|

eteke Ami chulAimAnaka ei viSaYara mImAMsA vujAi dichilo~ Aru teOMloka duYoke prajJA Aru jJAna dAna karichilo~, lagate parvata Aru carAivoraka Ami dAudara anugata kari dichilo~, seivore teOMra lagata paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karichila; Aru AmiYei Achilo~ eivorara kartA|
Aru Ami teOMka tomAlokara vAvei kaৱca nirmANara zikSA dichilo~, yAte i yuddhata tomAlokaka rakSA kare; gatike tomAloke kRtajJa ha’vAne?

Aru pravala vAYuka chulAimAnara vazIbhUta kari dichilo~; yiTo teOMra nirdezata pravAhita haichila sei dezara pine yi dezata Ami prabhUta kalyANa rAkhi thaicho~; Aru pratyeka viSaYa samparke AmiYei samyaka jJAnI|

Aru caYatAnasakalara mAjara parAo (kichumAnaka teOMra vazIbhUta karichilo~), siha~te teOMra vAve DuvArura kAma karichila, iYAra vAhireo bhina bhina kAma karichila; Aru AmiYei siha~tara rakSAkArI Achilo~|
lagate smaraNa karA AiYUvara kathA, yetiYA teOM nija pratipAlakaka AhvAna kari kaichila, ‘nizcaYa mai dukha-kaSTata patita haicho~, Aru tumi sarvazreSTha daYAlu’|

tetiYA Ami teOMra AhvAnata sa~hAri dichilo~, teOMra dukha-kaSTa dUra kari dichilo~, Aru teOMka teOMra pariYAlavarga obhatAi dichilo~ Aru pradAna karichilo~ teOMlokara lagate teOMlokara samaparimANa, AmAra phAlara parA vizeSa rahamatasvarUpe Aru ivAdatakArIsakalara vAve upadeza hicApe|
Aru smaraNa karA ichamAIla, idrIcha Aru jula-kiphlaka, teOMlokara pratyekei Achila dhairyyazIla;
Aru Ami teOMlokaka AmAra anugrahara antarbhukta karichilo~| nizcaYa teOMloka Achila satkarmaparAYaNa|

Aru smaraNa karA juna-nunaka (mAchara garAkI iunuchaka), yetiYA teOM krodha aৱsthAta guci gaichila Aru dhAraNA karichila ye, Ami teOMra prati saMkIrNatA nakarima| tAra pichata teOM andhakArara parA AhvAna kari kaichila ye, ‘tomAra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, tumi paৱitra mahAna, nizcaYa mai anyAYa karichilo~’|
tetiYA Ami teOMra AhvAnata sa~hAri dichilo~ Aru teOMka duzcintAra parA uddhAra karichilo~, Aru eidarei Ami muminasakalaka uddhAra karo~|
Aru smaraNa karA yAkAriYyAra kathA, yetiYA teOM nija pratipAlakaka AhvAna kari kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka akalazarIYAkai (niHsantAna) eri nidivA, tumiYeito zreSTha uttarAdhikArI’|

phalata Ami teOMra AhvAnata sa~hAri dichilo~ Aru teOMka dAna karichilo~ iYAhaiYA, Aru teOMra vAve teOMra strIka (garbhadhAraNara) yogya karichilo~| teOMloke satkarmata pratiyogitA karichila, lagate teOMloke AmAka Agraha Aru bhItira saite AhvAna karichila Aru teOMloka AmAra prati vinIta Achila|

Aru smaraNa karA seijanI nArIra kathA, yiYe nijara lajjAsthAnaka hiphAjata karichila, seYe tAra mAjata Ami AmAra rUha phu~ৱAi dichilo~| teOMka Aru teOMra putraka vizvavAsIra vAve eTA nidarzana vanAichilo~|
nizcaYa tomAlokara ei jAti prakRtate eTAi jAti Aru maYei tomAlokara pratipAlaka, eteke tomAloke keৱla morei ivAdata karA|
kintu siha~te nijara kAryakalApara mAjata vibheda sRSTi kariche| pratyekei AmAra ocarata pratyAৱrtanakArI|
eteke yadi konovAi mumina hai satkarma kare tente tAra praceSTA ketiYAo asvIkAra karA naha’va Aru nizcaYa Ami iYAra lipivaddhakArI|
Aru Ami yi janapadaka dhvaMsa karicho~ tAra vAve niSedhAjJA Ache ye, nizcaYa tAra adhivAsIsakale ketiYAo ghUri nAhiva,
aৱzeSata yetiYA iYA’juja Aru mA’jujaka mukti diYA ha’va Aru siha~te pratiTo uccabhUmira parA dauri Ahiva|

Aru amogha pratizruta samaYa nikaTaৱrtI ha’le AkasmikabhAৱe kAphirasakalara caku sthira hai yAva, siha~te ka’va, ‘hAYa! durbhAgya AmAra! nizcaYa Ami ei viSaYe udAsIna Achilo~; varaM Ami Achilo~ anyAYakArI’|
nizcaYa tomAloke Aru AllAhara parivarte tomAloke yivorara ivAdata karA sei sakalovora haiche jAhAnnAmara indhana; tomAloka ATAYe tAta praৱeza karivA|
yadi siha~ta ilAha ha’lahe~tena tente siha~ta jAhAnnAmata praৱeza nakarilehe~tena; Aru siha~ta ATAYe tAta sthAYI ha’va,
tAta thAkiva siha~tara ciJara-vAkhara Aru ArtanAda, sei kAraNe siha~te tAta ekoৱe zunA nApAva;
nizcaYa yisakalara vAve pUrvare parA AmAra kalyANa nirdhArita Ache teOMlokaka iYAra parA A~tarata rakhA ha’va|
teOMloke jAhAnnAmara kSiNa zavdao zunA nApAva, Aru tAta teOMloke manaHputa vastura mAjata cirakAla thAkiva|
mahA bhItiYeo teOMlokaka cintita nakariva Aru phiristAsakale teOMlokaka abhyarthanA kariva ei vuli ye, ‘eiToৱe haiche tomAlokara sei diৱsa, yAra pratizruti tomAlokaka diYA haichila’|

seidinA Ami AkAzaka meriYAi pelAma, yenekai merioৱA haYa likhita dalIla-patra| yidare Ami prathamavAra sRSTira sUcanA karichilo~ seidare punara sRSTi karima; eiTo AmAra kRta pratizruti, nizcaYa Ami seYA pAlana karimei|
Aru nizcaYa Ami upadezara pichata yAvUrata likhi dicho~ ye, ‘keৱla mora satkarmazIla vAndAsakalei pRthiৱIra uttarAdhikArI ha’va’|
nizcaYa iYAta Ache ivAdatakArI sampradAYara vAve paryApta viSaYavastu|
Aru Ami tomAka vizvavAsIra vAve keৱla rahamata hicApehe preraNa karicho~|
koৱA, ‘mora prati ahI karA haYa ye, tomAlokara ilAha keৱla ekaka ilAha| eteke tomAloke AtmasamarpaNakArI ha’vAne?’
tathApio yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa tente tumi kai diYA, ‘mai tomAlokaka yathAyathabhAৱe janAi dicho~ Aru tomAlokaka yi viSaYara pratizruti diYA haiche, mai nAjAno seYA nikaTaৱrtI ne dUraৱrtI|
‘nizcaYa teOM prakAzya kathA samparkeo jAne Aru tomAloke yi gopana karA seYAo jAne|
‘Aru mai nAjAno haYato eiTo (vilamva hoৱATo) tomAlokara vAve eTA parIkSA, Aru kichusamaYara vAve jIৱnopabhogara suyoga’|

rAchule kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi nyAYasaGgatabhAৱe phaYacAlA kari diYA’, Aru AmAra pratipAlaka haiche daYAmaYa, tomAloke yi sAvyasta karichA sei viSaYe ekamAtra sahAYasthala keৱla teৱe~i’|
he mAnaৱjAti! tomAloke nija pratipAlakara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| nizcaYa kiYAmatara prakampana eTA vara bhaYaMkara viSaYa!

yidinA tomAloke seYA dekhivalai pAvA seidinA pratyeka piYAha khuuৱA tirotAi nijara ke~cuৱAka pAhari yAva Aru pratyeka garbhaৱtI nArIYe garbhapAta kariva; Aru tumi mAnuhaka nicAgrasta sadRza dekhivalai pAvA, athaca siha~ta nicAgrasta nahaYa| varaM AllAhara zAsti ati kaThina|
mAnuhara mAjata kichumAna enekuৱA mAnuho Ache yivilAke nAjAni AllAha samparke vAka-vitaNDA kare Aru si pratyeka vidrohI caYatAnara anusaraNa kare,
tAra viSaYe likhi diYA haiche ye, yiYe tAra lagata vandhutva kariva si nizcaYa tAka pathabhraSTa kariva Aru tAka prajjvalita agnira zAstira pine paricAlita kariva|

he mAnaৱjAti! yadi tomAloke punarutthAna samparke sandehata AchA tente jAni thoৱA, Ami tomAlokaka sRSTi karicho~ mATira parA, tAra pichata zukrakITara parA, tAra pichata AlAkvA (raktapiNDa)ra parA, tAra pichata pUrNAkRti athavA apUrNAkRti mAMsapiNDara parA—yAte Ami viSaYaTo tomAlokara ocarata suspaSTarUpe prakAza kari diva pAro~| AmAra icchAnusari tAka (zukrakITaka) eTA nirdiSTa samaYara vAve mAtRgarbhata sthita rAkho~, tAra pichata Ami tomAlokaka zizurUpe uliYAi Ano| yAte tomAloke prAptavaYasata upanIta ha’va pArA| tomAlokara mAjara kichumAnaka (Agatei) mRtyu diYA haYa, Akau Ana kichumAnaka vuDha়A vaYasara jarAjIrNa aৱsthAlai pratyArpaNa karA haYa, yAra phalata si janAra pichato eko najanA hai pare| tumi dekhA poৱA ye, bhUmiDarA zukAna hai pari Ache, tAra pichata Ami tAta pAnI varSaNa karo~, phalata sei bhUmi sajIৱ hai Thana dhari uThe Aru sakalo dharaNara sudRzya udbhida utpanna haYa;
eiTo eikAraNe ye, AllAhei satya Aru teৱe~i mRtaka jIৱita kare Aru teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna;
lagate eikAraNeo ye, nizcaYa kiYAmata Ahiva, iYAta kono sandeha nAi; Aru yisakala kavarata Ache nizcaYa AllAhe teOMlokako punarutthita kariva|
Aru mAnuhara mAjata enekuৱA kichumAna mAnuho Ache, yisakalara kono jJAna nAi, pathanirdezao nAi Aru dIptimAna kono puthio nAi| tathApio AllAha samparke vAka-vitaNDA kare|

enekuৱA svabhAৱra vyaktiYe mAnuhaka AllAhara pathara parA pathabhraSTa karivalai ahaMkAra kari dAM khAi uThe| enekuৱA lokara vAve pRthiৱIta Ache lAJchanA Aru kiYAmatara dinA Ami tAka bhoga karAma dahana yantraNA|
(seidinA tAka koৱA ha’va) ‘eiTo tomArei kRtakarmara phala, nizcaYa AllAhe vAndAsakalara prati vindumAtrao anyAYa nakare’|

mAnuhara mAjata kichumAna enekuৱA mAnuho Ache, yisakale dvidhAra saite AllAhara ivAdata kare; tAra maGgala ha’le tetiYA si prazAnti lAbha kare Aru kono viparyaYa ghaTile si tAra pUrvara ceherAlai ubhati yAYa| si kSatigrasta haYa pRthiৱIta Aru AkhirAtato; eiToৱei haiche suspaSTa kSati|
si AllAhara parivarte seivoraka AhvAna kare yivore tAra kono kSatio kariva noৱAre Aru tAra kono upakAro kariva noৱAre; eiToৱe haiche carama pathabhraSTatA!
si yivoraka AhvAna kare seivorara kSati tAra lAbhatakaio vechi| kimAna ye nikRSTa ei abhibhAৱka Aru kimAna ye nikRSTa ei sahacara!
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche AllAhe teOMlokaka jAnnAtata praৱeza karAva, yAra pAdadezata nadIsamUha pravAhita; nizcaYa AllAhe yi icchA kare seiToৱei kare|

yiYe dhAraNA kare ye, AllAhe teOMka (rAchulaka) ketiYAo ihakAla Aru parakAlata sahAYa nakariva, si AkAzara phAle eTA rachI prasArita karaka, tAra pichata tAka kATi diYaka, tAra pichata cAoka tAra ei kauzale tAra Akroza dUra kare ne nAi|
eidarei Ami suspaSTa nidarzana hicApe iYAka aৱtIrNa karicho~| nizcaYa AllAhe yAka icchA kare hidAYata pradAna kare|

nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru yisakale iYAhudI haiche, Aru yisakale chAveYI, khrISTAna Aru agnipUjaka haiche lagate yivilAke muzvarika haiche, kiYAmatara dinA AllAhe siha~tara mAjata phaYacAlA kari diva| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata samyaka pratyakSakArI|

tumi dekhA nAine ye, AkAzasamUhata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakaloৱe AllAhakei chAjadAha kare, Aru sUrya, candra, nakSatramaNDalI, parvatarAji, vRkSalatA, jIৱ-jantu lagate vahuto mAnuheo chAjadAha kare? AnahAte vahutare prati sAvyasta haiche zAsti| AllAhe yAka apamAnita kare tAka sanmAnadAtA kono nAi; nizcaYa AllAhe yi icchA kare seiToৱe kare| (chAjadAha)

ei duTA vivadamAna pakSa, siha~te nija pratipAlaka samparke vitarkata lipta haiche; eteke yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara vAve juira kApora kATi pochAka taiYAra karA haiche, siha~tara mUrata DhAli diYA ha’va utalA pAnI|
iYAra dvArA siha~tara peTara bhitarata yi Ache tAka, lagate siha~tara chAlavoraka vigalita karA ha’va|
Aru siha~tara vAve thAkiva lora hAturI|
yetiYAi siha~te yantraNAta kAtara hai jAhAnnAmara parA olAva vicAriva, tetiYAi siha~taka tAlaike obhatAi diYA ha’va; Aru (siha~taka koৱA ha’va,) ‘bhoga karA dahana yantraNA’|

nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche AllAhe teOMlokaka enekuৱA jAnnAtata praৱeza karAva, yAra pAda dezata nadIsamUha pravAhita; tAta teOMlokaka alaMkRta karA ha’va soNara khAru Aru mukutAra dvArA, Aru tAta teOMlokara pochAka ha’va recamara|
teOMlokaka paৱitra vAkyara anugAmI karA haichila Aru teOMloka paricAlita haichila parama prazaMsita AllAhara pathata|

nizcaYa yisakale kupharI kariche siha~te AllAhara pathara parA lagate machajide hArAmara parA mAnuhaka vAdhA diYe, ya’ta Ami sthAnIYa Aru vahirAgata sakalo mAnuhara vAvei sama adhikAra dAna karicho~, tAta yiYe anyAYabhAৱe ilahAda tathA dvInavirodhI pApa karmara icchA kare, Ami tAka yantraNAdAYaka zAsti bhoga karAma|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami ivrAhImara vAve gharara (vAitullAhara) sthAna nirdhAraNa kari dichilo~, tetiYA kaichilo~, ‘mora lagata Ana kAko aMzI nakarivA Aru mora gharakhanaka tAৱAphakArIsakalara vAve, chAlAta AdAYakArIsakalara vAve Aru ruku-chAjadAkArIsakalara vAve paৱitra kari rAkhivA|
‘Aru mAnuhara mAjata hajjara vAve ghoSaNA kari diYA, teOMloke tomAra ocaralai Ahiva khojakADha়i Aru sakalo dharaNara uTara piThita ArohaNa kari, teOMloka Ahiva dUra-dUraNira patha atikrama kari;

‘yAte teOMloke nijara kalyANara ThAivorata upasthita ha’va pAre Aru AllAhe teOMlokaka catuSpada jantura parA yivora jIৱikA hicApe dAna kariche seivorara oparata nirdiSTa dinavorata AllAhara nAma uccAraNa (kari javeha) kariva pAre| eteke (sei kurAvanIra parA) tomAloke nije khoৱA Aru dukhIYA-nicalA, abhAৱgrastaka AhAra karoৱA|
‘tAra pichata teOMloke yena aparicchannatA dUra kare Aru teOMlokara mAnata pUrNa kare, lagate prAcIna (kA’vA) gharara tAৱApha kare’|

eiToৱe vidhAna, yiYe AllAhara sanmAnita vidhAnAৱlIra prati sanmAna kariva tente tAra pratipAlakara ocarata tAra vAve eiToৱe uttama| tomAlokara vAve (gharacIYA) catuSpada jantuvora hAlAla karA haiche kintu seivorara vAhire yivorara viSaYe tomAlokaka tilAৱta kari (niSiddha vuli) janoৱA haiche| seYe tomAloke mUrtipUjAra apaৱitratAra parA A~tari thAkA Aru michA kathA varjana karA|

AllAhara prati ekaniSTha hai Aru teOMra lagata Anaka aMzIdAra nakari (ukta kAmavora karA)| kAraNa yiYe AllAhara lagata aMzIdAra sthApana (zvirka) kare, (tAra aৱsthA haiche enekuৱA) si yenivA AkAzara parA parila Aru carAiYe tAka thApa mAri lai ga’la, nAivA vatAhe tAka uruৱAi ni kono dUraৱrtI ThAita nikSepa karile|
eiToৱe haiche AllAhara vidhAna, Aru yiYe AllAhara nidarzanAৱlIka sanmAna kare, niHsandehe seiTo haiche tAra hRdaYara tAkvaৱAra vahiHprakAza|
ei (gharacIYA) catuSpada jantuvorara mAjata tomAlokara vAve nAnAvidha upakAra Ache eTA nirdiSTa samaYalaike; tAra pichata eivorara kuravAnIra sthAna haiche prAcIna gharakhanara nikaTaৱrtI ThAita|

Aru Ami pratyeka sampradAYara vAve kuravAnIra niYama vanAi dicho~; Ami siha~taka jIৱnopakaraNa hicApe yivora catuSpada jantu pradAna karicho~, (javeha karAra samaYata) seivorara oparata yAte teOMloke AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare| eteke tomAlokara ilAha haiche keৱla ekaka ilAha, seYe tomAloke keৱla teOMra ocaratei AtmasamarpaNa karA, Aru susaMvAda diYA vinIta lokasakalaka,

yisakalara ocarata AllAhara kathA ullekha karA ha’le teOMlokara hRdaYa bhaYate kampita haYa, yisakale nijara vipada-Apadata dhairyya dhAraNa kare Aru chAlAta kAYema kare, lagate Ami teOMlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ tAra parA dAna kare|

Aru (kuravAnIra) uTaka Ami AllAhara (dvInara) pratIkasamUhara mAjata anyatama pratIka vanAicho~, tomAlokara vAve tAra mAjata vahuto kalyANa Ache| seYe eTA bhari vAndhi Aru vAkI tiniTA bharita thiYa di thakA aৱsthAta tomAloke tAra oparata AllAhara nAma uccAraNa (kari nahara) karA| tAra pichata yetiYA siha~ta kAti hai pari yAva, tetiYA tomAloke tAra parA (mAMsa) khoৱA Aru AhAra karoৱA dhairyyazIla abhAৱgrastaka lagate sahAYaprArthI nicalAsakalaka; eidarei Ami seivoraka tomAlokara vazIbhUta kari dicho~ yAte tomAloke kRtajJatA prakAza karA|

seivora pazura teja Aru mAMsa AllAhara ocaralai ekoৱei gai nApAYa, varaM teOMra ocaralai gai pAYa keৱla tomAlokara tAkvaৱA| eidarei teOM eivoraka tomAlokara vazIbhUta kari diche yAte tomAloke AllAhara zreSThatva ghoSaNA karA, kAraNa teৱe~i tomAlokaka hidAYata kariche, seYe tumi susaMvAda diYA satkarmaparAYaNasakalaka|
nizcaYa AllAhe muminasakalaka (teOMlokara zatrura parA) pratirakSA di thAke, nizcaYa teOM kono vizvAsaghAtaka, akRtajJa vyaktika pachanda nakare|
yuddhara anumati diYA ha’la teOMlokaka, yisakale AkrAnta haiche, kAraNa teOMlokaka niryAtana karA haiche| nizcaYa AllAhe teOMlokaka sahAYa karivalai samyaka sakSama;

teOMlokaka nijara ghara-vArIra parA anyAYabhAৱe vahiSkAra karA haiche, teOMlokara aparAdha keৱla eiToৱe Achila ye, teOMloke kaYa, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka haiche AllAha’| AllAhe yadi mAnuhara eTA dalaka Ana eTA dalara dvArA pratihata nakarilehe~tena, tente vidhvasta hai ga’lahe~tena khRSTAna sanyAsIsakalara upAsanAlaYa, gIrjA, iYAhudIsakalara upAsanAlaYa lagate machajidasamUha—ya’ta vechi vechi AllAhara nAma smaraNa karA haYa| nizcaYa AllAhe tAka sahAYa kare yiYe AllAhaka sahAYa kare| nizcaYa AllAha mahAzaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

eOMlokei haiche seisakala loka yisakalaka Ami pRthiৱIra vukuta pratiSThita karile teOMloke chAlAta kAYema kariva, yAkAta pradAna kariva Aru satkarmara nirdeza diva lagate asatkarma niSedha kariva; Aru sakalo karmara cUDa়Anta pariNati AllAhara ikhatiYArata|
Aru siha~te yadi tomAka asvIkAra kare, tente (eYA kono natuna kathA nahaYa) siha~tara pUrveo nUha, Ada Aru chAmUda sampradAYeo asvIkAra karichila,
lagate ivrAhIma Aru lUtara sampradAYeo (asvIkAra karichila),

Aru mAdAinara adhivAsIvilAkeo (asvIkAra karichila)| eidare asvIkAra karA haichila muchAko| eteke kAphirasakalaka mai aৱkAza dichilo~, tAra pichatahe Ami siha~taka dharichilo~| eteke (pratyakSa karA) mora pratyAkhyAna (zAsti) kenekuৱA (bhaYaMkara) Achila!

Aru Ami kimAna ye janapada dhvaMsa karicho~ yivorara adhivAsIvilAka Achila yAlima| phalata eivora janapade siha~tara gharara cAdara saite dhvaMsastUpata pariNata haiche| eidare kimAna ye ku~ৱA parityakta haiche Aru kimAna ye sudRDha় prAsAda dhvaMsa haiche!

siha~te pRthiৱIta bhramaNa karA nAine? tetiYAhe siha~te jJAna vuddhi sampanna hRdaYa Aru zrutizakti sampanna zraৱNara adhikArI ha’va pArilehe~tena| prakRtate caku andha nahaYa, varaM andha haiche vukura mAjata aৱsthita hRdaYa|

Aru siha~te zAsti Anivalai tomAka kharakhedA karivalai kaYa, athaca AllAhe teOMra pratizruti ketiYAo bhaGga nakare| nizcaYa tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocarata edina, tomAlokara gaNanAta seYA ehejAra vacharara samAna;
Aru Ami vahuto janapadaka aৱkAza dichilo~ athaca siha~ta Achila atyAcArI, tAra pichata Ami siha~taka greptAra karichilo~, Aru AmAra ocaratei pratyAৱrtanasthala|
koৱA, ‘he mAnaৱ sampradAYa! mai keৱla tomAlokara vAve ejana suspaSTa satarkakArIhe’;
eteke yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMlokara vAve Ache kSamA Aru sanmAnajanaka jIৱikA;
Aru yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka vyartha karivalai ceSTA kare, siha~tei ha’va jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI|

Aru Ami tomAra pUrve yi rAchula athavA navI preraNa karicho~, teOMlokara konovAi yetiYA (ahIra vANI) tilAৱta kariche, tetiYAi caYatAne teOMlokara tilAৱtata (kivA) nikSepa kariche, kintu caYatAne yi nikSepa kare AllAhe seYA vidUrita kare| tAra pichata AllAhe teOMra AYAtasamUhaka supratiSThita kare, Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

eiTo eikAraNe ye, caYatAne yi prakSipta kare, seiToka teOM seisakala lokara vAve parIkSAra vastu vanAi diYe yisakalara antarata vyAdhi Ache Aru yisakalara antara ati kaThora| nizcaYa yAlimasakala ghora virodhitAta lipta hai Ache|

Aru eiTo eivAveo ye, yisakalaka jJAna diYA haiche teOMloke yena jAniva pAre ye, eiTo tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA prerita satya; phalata teOMloke yena iYAra oparata vizvAsa sthApana kare Aru teOMlokara antara yena iYAra prati vinaYAৱnata haYa| nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche AllAhe teOMlokaka sarala patha dekhuৱAva|
Aru yisakale kupharI kariche siha~te iYAra prati sandeha poSaNa kariYei thAkiva, siha~tara ocaralai AkasmikabhAৱe kiYAmata nahAlaike athavA siha~tara ocaralai eTA vandhyA dinara zAsti nahAlaike|
seidinA keৱla AllAharei Adhipatya thAkiva; teৱe~i siha~tara mAjata vicAra kariva| eteke yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMloke niYAmatapUrNa jAnnAtata aৱsthAna kariva|
AnahAte yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche, siha~tara vAvei Ache lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|

Aru yisakale AllAhara pathata hijarata kariche, tAra pichata (zatrura hAtata) nihata haiche nAivA mRtyuvaraNa kariche, teOMlokaka nizcitabhAৱe AllAhe utkRSTa jIৱikA pradAna kariva; Aru nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i haiche sarvotkRSTa jIৱikAdAtA|
teOM nizcaYa teOMlokaka enekuৱA eTA sthAnata praৱeza karAva, yiToka teOMloke pachanda kariva| nizcaYa AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama sahanazIla|

eiToৱei haiche prakRta rIti, Aru yi vyaktiYe niryAtita hai tAra samaparimANa pratizodha grahaNa kare, tAra pichata punara (yadi) si niryAtita haYa tente nizcaYa AllAhe teOMka sahAYa kariva; nizcaYa AllAha pApa mocanakArI, kSamAzIla|
eiTo eikAraNe ye, nizcaYa AllAhe rAtika dinara mAjata praৱeza karAYa Aru dinaka praৱeza karAYa rAtira mAjata| nizcaYa AllAha sarva zrotA, sarva draSTA,
Aru eikAraNeo ye, nizcaYa AllAha, keৱla teৱe~i satya Aru teOMra vAhire siha~te yivoraka AhvAna kare, sei sakalovora haiche asatya| nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i suucca, sumahAna|
tumi lakSya karA nAine ye, AllAhe AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa kare? yAra phalata pRthiৱI seujIYA hai uThe? nizcaYa AllAha sukSmadarzI, samyaka aৱhita|
AkAzasamUta yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo teOMrei| nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i abhAৱmukta, parama prazaMsita|

tumi lakSya karA nAine, pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalovoraka AllAhe tomAlokara kalyANata niYojita kariche Aru nauyAnasamUhako, yivora teOMra nirdezatei sAgarata vicaraNa kare? Aru teৱe~i AkAzaka dhari rAkhiche, yAte teOMra anumati nohoৱAkai pRthiৱIra oparata pari nAyAYa| nizcaYa AllAha mAnuhara prati snehazIla, parama daYAlu|
teৱe~i tomAlokaka jIৱita kariche Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara mRtyu ghaTAva, Akau teৱe~i punara tomAlokaka jIৱita kariva| nizcaYa mAnuha vara vechi akRtajJa|

Ami pratyeka ummatara vAve ivAdatara niYama-paddhati nirdhAraNa kari dicho~ yiTo siha~te pAlana kare| eteke siha~te yena ei viSaYe tomAra lagata vitarka nakare| tumi tomAra pratipAlakara pine AhvAna karA| nizcaYa tumi sarala pathata pratiSThita|
Aru siha~te yadi tomAra lagata vitarka kare tente koৱA, ‘tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱgata’|
‘tomAloke yi viSaYe matAnaikya karichA AllAhe kiYAmatara dinA sei viSaYe tomAlokara mAjata vicAra-mImAMsA kari diva’|
tumi nAjAnAne ye, AkAza Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo viSaYe AllAha aৱgata| nizcaYa sei sakalo (likhA) Ache ekhana puthita| nizcaYa AllAhara ocarata eYA ati sahaja|

Aru siha~te AllAhara parivarte enekuৱA vastura ivAdata kare yivorara viSaYe teOM kono dalila-pramANa aৱtIrNa karA nAi, Aru yAra viSaYe siha~tara kono jJAno nAi| (jAni thoৱA) yAlimasakalara kono sahAYakArI nAi|

Aru siha~tara ocarata AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karA ha’le tumi kAphirasakalara mukhamaNDalata asantuSTa bhAৱ dekhivalai pAvA| yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka siha~tara ocarata tilAৱta kare, teOMlokaka siha~te AkramaNa karivalai udyata haYa| koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokaka iYAtakaio nikRSTa vastura saMvAda dimane?--- seYA ha’la jui (jAhAnnAma)| yisakale kupharI kariche AllAhe siha~taka iYAra pratizruti diche| eiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa pratyAৱrtanasthala!’

he mAnaৱ sampradAYa! eTA udAharaNa dAGi dharA haiche, tomAloke manoyoga sahakAre zunAH tomAloke AllAhara parivarte yivoraka AhvAna karA siha~te ATAYe mili ketiYAo eTA mAkhio sRSTi kariva noৱAre| varaM mAkhiYe yadi siha~tara parA kono vastu eTA kADha়i niYe, tathApio siha~te tAra parA sei vastuToka uddhAra kariva noৱAriva| prArthanAkArI Aru yAra ocarata prArthanA karA haYa siha~ta ubhaYei durvala|
siha~te AllAhaka yathAyogya maryAdA diYA nAi yenekuৱA maryAdA diYA ucita Achila| nizcaYa AllAha kSamatAৱAna, mahAparAkramazAlI|
AllAhe phiristAsakalara mAjara parA Aru mAnuhara mAjara parA rAchula manonIta kare| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA|
teOMlokara sanmukhata Aru pichata yi yi Ache sei sakalo teOM jAne, Aru sakalo viSaYa AllAhara ocaratei pratyAৱrtita karA ha’va|
he muminasakala! tomAloke ruku karA, chAjadAha karA Aru tomAlokara pratipAlakara ivAdata karA, lagate satkarma karA, yAte tomAloke saphala ha’va pArA|(chAjadAha)

Aru AllAhara pathata jihAda karA yenekai jihAda karA ucita| teOM tomAlokaka manonIta kariche| teOM dvIna samparke tomAlokara oparata kono kaThoratA Aropa karA nAi| eiTo tomAlokara pitA ivrAhImara dvIna| teৱe~i tomAlokaka iYAra pUrvei nAmakaraNa kariche ‘muchalima’ hicApe, Aru ei kitAvato (ei nAmere nAmakaraNa karA haiche); yAte rAchula tomAlokara vAve sAkSI haYa Aru tomAloke mAnaৱjAtira vAve sAkSI hoৱA| seYe tomAloke chAlAta kAYema karA, yAkAta pradAna karA Aru AllAhaka majavutakai aৱlamvana karA; teৱe~i tomAlokara abhibhAৱka, teOM kimAna ye uttama abhibhAৱka Aru kimAna ye uttama sahAYakArI!
nizcaYa muminasakala saphala haiche,
yisakala nijara cAlAtara kSetrata bhIti-aৱnata,
Aru yisakala asAra kathA-vatarAra parA vimukha,
Aru yisakala yAkAtara kSetrata sakriYa,
Aru yisakala nijara yaunAGgasamUhara hiphAjatakArI,
kintu teOMlokara patnI athavA adhikArabhukta dAsIra vAhire, ene kSetrata teOMloka nindanIYa naha’va--
kintu yisakale iYAra vAhire Anaka kAmanA kare, siha~tei haiche sImAlaGghanakArI|
Aru yisakale nijara AmAnata Aru pratizruti rakSA kare,
Aru yisakale nijara cAlAtata thAke yatnaৱAna,
teOMlokei ha’va uttarAdhikArI--
teOMloke uttarAdhikArI ha’va phiradAuchara, ya’ta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va|
nizcaYa Ami mAnuhaka sRSTi karicho~ mATira upAdAnara parA,
tAra pichata Ami tAka sthApana karo~ zukravindurUpe eTA nirApada bhANDArata (jarAYuta);

tAra pichata Ami zukravinduka AlAkAta pariNata karo~, pichata AlAkAka pariNata karo~ mAMsapiNData, mAMsapiNDaka pariNata karo~ asthita, tAra pichata asthika DhAki diOM mAMsare, aৱzeSata Ami tAka gaDha়i tolo~ Ana eTA sRSTirUpe| eteke (coৱA) sarvottama sraSTA AllAha kimAna varakatamaYa!
iYAra pichata nizcaYa tomAloke mRtyuvaraNa karivA,
tAra pichata kiYAmatara dinA tomAlokaka nizcaYa utthita karA ha’va|
Aru nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara oparata sRSTi karicho~ sAtakhana AkAza Aru Ami sRSTi samparke kadApio udAsIna nahaYa,
Aru Ami AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa karo~ parimitabhAৱe, phalata seYA Ami mATita saMrakSita karo~, Aru Ami tAka apasAraNa karivalaio sampUrNa sakSama|
iYAra pichata Ami tAra dvArA tomAlokara vAve khejura Aru AGurara vAgAna sRSTi karo~, ya’ta tomAlokara vAve thAke pracura phala, yivora tomAloke khoৱA;
Aru (iYAra dvArAi) sRSTi karo~ eTA gacha yiTo utpanna haYa cinAi parvatata, yiTora parA utpanna haYa AhArakArIsakalara vAve tela Aru tarakAri|

Aru nizcaYa tomAlokara vAve gharacIYA jantuvorara mAjata Ache zikSaNIYa viSaYa, seivorara peTata yi (gAkhIra) Ache tAra parA Ami tomAlokaka seৱna karAOM Aru tAta tomAlokara vAve Ache pracura upakAritA, seivora (jantu)ka tomAloke bhakSaNo karA|
lagate eivora pazu (ra piThita) Aru nauyAnata tomAlokaka ArohaNa karoৱA haYa|

nizcaYa Ami nUhaka preraNa karichilo~ teOMra sampradAYara ocaralai| teOM kaichila he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke keৱla AllAhara ivAdata karA, teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, tathApio tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne?

tAra pichata teOMra sampradAYara netA zreNIra yisakala loke kupharI karichila siha~te kaichila, eOM dekhona tomAlokara darei ejana mAnuha, eOM keৱla tomAlokara oparata zreSThatva lAbha kariva vicAriche, yadi AllAhe icchA karilehe~tena tente phiristAkei aৱtIrNa karilehe~tena, Ami AmAra pUrvapUruSasakalara ocarata enekuৱA ghaTanA ketiYAo zunA nAi|
nizcaYa eOM valiYA haiche| gatike tomAloke eOMra viSaYe kichudina dhairyya dharA|
nUhe (AllAhara ocarata prArthanA kari) kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka sahAYa karA, kAraNa siha~te moka michalIYA vuli asvIkAra kariche’|

tAra pichata Ami teOMra ocaralai ahI preraNa karichilo~, tumi AmAra cAkSuSa tattvAৱdhAYanata Aru AmAra ahI anuyAYI nauyAna nirmANa karA, iYAra pichata yetiYA AmAra Adeza Ahiva Aru caukAra pAnI uthali uThiva, tetiYA pratyeka jIৱ-janture eko ekoyorakai lai (nAৱta) uThivA Aru tomAra pariYAlavargako lagata lavA, keৱla seisakala lokara vAhire yisakalara viruddhe pUrvei siddhAnta loৱA haiche| lagate yisakale anyAYa kariche siha~tara viSaYa lai tumi moka samvodhana nakarivA| nizcaYa siha~ta Duvi mariva|
eteke yetiYA tumi Aru tomAra saGgIsakala nauyAnara oparata sthira ha’vA tetiYA ka’vA, ‘sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAhara vAvei, yiYe AmAka yAlima sampradAYara parA uddhAra kariche’|
tumi Aru koৱA, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka varakatamaYa aৱtaraNasthalata aৱtaraNa karoৱA; yihetu tumiYei zreSTha aৱtAraNakArI’|
nizcaYa iYAta Ache vahuto nidarzana; Aru Ami siha~taka parIkSAhe karichilo~|
eteke Ami siha~tara pichata Ana eTA prajanma sRSTi karichilo~,

iYAra pichata Ami siha~tara mAjara parAi ejanaka rAchula hicApe preraNa karichilo~, teOM kaichila, ‘tomAloke keৱla AllAharei ivAdata karA, teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, tathApio tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne?

Aru teOMra sampradAYara netAsakale, yisakale kupharI karichila Aru AkhirAtara sAkSAtaka asvIkAra karichila Aru yisakalaka Ami pradAna karichilo~ pArthiৱ jIৱnara pracura bhoga-sambhAra, siha~te kaichila, ‘eOM dekhona tomAlokara darei ejana mAnuha, tomAloke yi khoৱA teৱo~ tAkei khAYa Aru tomAloke yi pAna karA teৱo~ tAkei pAna kare;
‘yadi tomAloke tomAlokara darei ejana mAnuhara Anugatya karA tente nizcaYa tomAloke kSatigrasta ha’vA;
‘eOM tomAlokaka ei pratizruti diYe neki ye, tomAloke yetiYA mRtyuvaraNa karivA Aru tomAloka mATi Aru asthita pariNata ha’vA; tAra pichato tomAlokaka Akau utthita karA ha’va?
‘asambhaৱ, tomAlokaka yi viSaYe pratizruti diYA haiche seYA asambhaৱ|
‘ekamAtra pArthiৱ jIৱnei haiche AmAra jIৱna, AmAra jIৱna-maraNa iYAtei; Aru Ami ketiYAo punarutthita nahaOM|
‘eOM enekuৱA ejana vyakti yiYe AllAha samparke michA apavAda di Ache, Ami teOMka ketiYAo vizvAsa nakaro~’|
nUhe (AllAhara ocarata prArthanA kari) ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka sahAYa karA, kAraNa siha~te moka michalIYA vuli asvIkAra kariche’|
AllAhe ka’le, ‘kichu samaYara mAjatei siha~ta nizcitarUpe anutapta ha’va’|
tAra pichata eTA vikaTa zavdai satya-nyAYara saite siha~taka AkrAnta karile, phalata Ami siha~taka vatAhe uruৱAi niYA AৱrjanAra dare kari dilo~| eteke yAlima sampradAYara vAve Ache keৱla dhvaMsa|
iYAra pichata Ami Aru vahuto prajanma sRSTi karichilo~|
kono jAtiYei siha~tara nirdiSTa samaYaka AgatIYAkai Aniva noৱAre Aru pichalaio Theli diva noৱAre|

iYAra pichata Ami ejanara pichata ejanakai AmAra rAchulasakalaka preraNa karichilo~| yetiYAi kono jAtira ocaralai siha~tara rAchula Ahichila tetiYAi siha~te teOMka asvIkAra karichila| phalata Ami siha~taka eTAra pichata eTAkai dhvaMsa kari kAhinIta pariNata karichilo~| eteke yisakale ImAna poSaNa nakare seivora sampradAYara vAve keৱla dhvaMsai dhvaMsa!
tAra pichata Ami muchA Aru teOMra bhAtR hArUnaka AmAra nidarzanAৱlIsaha lagate suspaSTa pramANasaha preraNa karilo~,
phiraAuna Aru tAra pariSadavargara ocaralai| kintu siha~te ahaMkAra karile; Aru siha~ta Achila uddhata sampradAYa|
tAra pichata siha~te ka’le, ‘Ami AmAra darei dujana vyaktira prati ImAna poSaNa karima neki, athaca teOMlokara jAtira mAnuhavilAka haiche AmAra dAsa’?
eteke siha~te teOMloka ubhaYake asvIkAra karile, phalata siha~ta dhvaMsaprAptasakalara antarbhukta ha’la|
Aru nizcaYa Ami muchAka kitAva pradAna karichilo~; yAte siha~te hidAYata pAva pAre|
lagate Ami ivane mariYama Aru teOMra mAtRka eTA nidarzana vanAichilo~ Aru teOMlokaka AzraYa dichilo~ eTA aৱsthAnayogya Aru prasraৱNaviziSTa ucca bhUmita|
‘he rAchulasakala! tomAloke paৱitra vastura parA khAdya grahaNa karA Aru satkarma karA; nizcaYa tomAloke yi karA sei samparke Ami savizeSa aৱgata|
‘Aru tomAlokara ei ummata keৱla eTAi ummata, Aru maYei tomAlokara pratipAlaka; gatike keৱla morei tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA’|
pichatahe mAnuhe siha~tara nijara mAjata siha~tara ei dvInaka vahudhA vibhakta kariche| pratyeka dalei siha~tara ocarata yi Ache seiTo laihe Anandita|
eteke kichu samaYara vAve siha~taka siha~tara vibhrAntira mAjate eri diYA|
siha~te bhAve neki ye, Ami siha~taka yi dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santatira dvArA sahayogitA karicho~, tAra mAdhyamata--
Ami siha~tara vAve sakalo maGgala tarAnvita karima? nahaYa, varaM siha~te upalavdhi kariva parA nAi|
nizcaYa yisakale nija pratipAlakara bhaYata bhIta-santrasta,
Aru yisakale nija pratipAlakara nidarzanasamUhara prati vizvAsa poSaNa kare,
Aru yisakale nija pratipAlakara lagata zvirka nakare,
Aru yisakale dAna karivalagIYA vastu bhIta-kampita hRdaYata dAna kare, eikAraNe ye, teOMloke nija pratipAlakara ocaralai pratyAৱrtana kariva lAgiva|
teOMlokei kalyANa sAdhanata kharadhara kare, Aru ei kSetrata teOMloka agragAmI haYa|
Aru Ami kAko tAra sAdhyAtIta dAYitvara vojA arpana nakaro~ Aru AmAra ocarata Ache ene ekhana kitApa yikhane satya vyakta kare Aru siha~tara prati akaNo anyAYa karA naha’va|
varaM ei viSaYe siha~tara antara ajJAnatAta Acchanna, iYAra vAhireo siha~tara Aru karma Ache yivora siha~te kari Ache|
aৱzeSata yetiYA Ami siha~tara mAjara vilAsI vyaktisakalaka zAsti diOM tetiYAhe siha~te ArtanAda kari uThe|
siha~taka koৱA ha’va, ‘Aji ArtanAda nakarivA, nizcaYa tomAloke AmAra phAlara parA kono sahAYa nApAvA’|
nizcaYa mora AYAtasamUha tomAlokara sanmukhata tilAৱta karA haichila, kintu tomAloke ulaTi pichaphAlehe guci gaichilA--
dAmbhikatAre ei viSaYata arthahIna galpa-gujava kari tomAloke rAti ativAhita karichilA|
eteke siha~te ei vANI samparke cintA-gaৱeSaNA karA nAine? ne eikAraNe ye, siha~tara ocaralai enekuৱA vastu Ahiche yiTo siha~tara pUrvapuruSasakalara ocaralai ahA nAchila?
athavA siha~te nija rAchulaka ciniva parA nAi vuli asvIkAra kariche neki?
nAivA siha~te eiTo kaYa neki ye, eOM unmAdanAgrasta? nahaYa, varaM teOM siha~tara ocarata satya lai Ahiche, Aru siha~tara adhikAMzai satyaka apachanda kare|

Aru satya yadi siha~tara kAmanA-vAsanAra anugAmI ha’lahe~tena tente AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjata thakA sakalo vastu vizRMkhala hai parilahe~tena| varaM Ami siha~tara ocarata lai Ahicho~ siha~tara sanmAna samvalita yikara (koraAna) kintu siha~te siha~tara ei upadezavANIra (koraAnara) parA mukha ghUrAi laYa|
athavA tumi siha~tara ocarata kono pratidAna vicarA neki? (jAni thoৱA) tomAra pratipAlakara pratidAnei zreSTha Aru teৱe~i zreSTha jIৱikAdAtA|
Aru nizcaYa tumi siha~taka sarala pathara pinei AhvAna kari AchA|
nizcaYa yisakale AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare, siha~tei haiche sarala pathara parA vicyuta,
Aru yadi Ami siha~tara prati daYA karo~ Aru siha~tara dukha-dainya dUra kari diOM tathApio siha~te avAdhyatAta vibhrAntara dare ghUri thAkiva|
nizcaYa Ami siha~taka zAstira dvArA satarka karicho~, tathApio siha~te nija pratipAlakara prati aৱnata naha’la Aru vinIta hai prArthanAo nakarile|
aৱzeSata yetiYA Ami siha~tara oparata kaThina zAstira duৱAra khuli dilo~ tetiYAhe siha~te hatAza hai parila|
teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve kANa, caku Aru antakaraNa sRSTi kariche; kintu tomAloke khuvei kama kRtajJatA prakAza karA|
teৱe~i tomAlokaka pRthiৱIta vistRta kariche Aru tomAlokaka teOMra ocaratei samaveta karA ha’va|
teৱe~i jIৱna dAna kare Aru teৱe~i mRtyu ghaTAYa, teOMra adhikAratei rAti Aru dinara parivartana haYa| tathApio tomAloke vuji nopoৱAne?
varaM siha~teo sei kathAkei kaYa yi kathA siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakale kaichila|
siha~te kaYa, ‘yetiYA Ami mRtyuvaraNa karima Aru Ami mATi tathA asthita pariNata ha'ma, tAra pichato Ami punarutthita ha'mane?
‘nizcaYa AmAka Aru itipUrve AmAra pUrvapuruSasakalako ene dharaNara pratizruti diYA haichila| eYA pUrvaৱrtIsakalara upakathAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’|
koৱA, ‘pRthiৱI Aru iYAta yi Ache sei sakalovora(raadhikAra) kAra? yadi tomAloke jAnA (tente koৱA)’|
siha~te tatkSaNAta ka’va, ‘AllAhara’| koৱA, ‘tathApio tomAloke zikSA grahaNa nakarivAne’?
koৱA, ‘sapta AkAza Aru mahA Arachara pratipAlaka kona’?
zIghrei siha~te ka’va, ‘AllAha’| koৱA, ‘tathApio tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne’?
koৱA, ‘kAra hAtata sakalo vastura kartRtva? yijane AzraYa dAna kare athaca teOMra vipakSe konoৱei kAko AzraYa diva noৱAre, yadi tomAloke jAnA (tente koৱA)’|
acirei siha~te ka’va ‘AllAha’| koৱA, ‘tente ka’ra parA tomAloke yAdugrasta haichA’?
varaM Ami siha~tara ocaralai satya Anicho~; nizcaYa siha~ta michalIYA|

AllAhe kono santAna grahaNa karA nAi, Aru teOMra lagata Ana kono upAsyao nAi; yadi thAkilahe~tena tente pratyeka ilAhe nija nija sRSTika lai pRthaka hai ga’lahe~tena Aru ejane Anajanara oparata prAdhAnya vistAra karilehe~tena| siha~te AllAhara prati yivora Aropa kare seivorara parA teOM ati paৱitra ati mahAna!
gopana Aru prakAzya sakalo viSaYe teOM jJAta, eteke siha~te yi aMzI kare tAra parA teOM vahu urddhata|
koৱA, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! yi viSaYe siha~taka pratizruti pradAna karA haiche, tumi yadi seYA moka (mora jIৱna kAlate) dekhuৱAva vicarA---
‘teneha’le, he mora pratipAlaka! tumi moka yAlima sampradAYara antarbhukta nakarivA’|
Aru Ami siha~taka yi viSaYe pratizruti pradAna karicho~, nizcaYa seYA Ami tomAka dekhuৱAvalai sakSama|
tumi satkarmara dvArA asatkarmaka pratihata karA; siha~te (AmAra prati) yi Aropa kare sei samparke Ami savizeSa aৱgata|
Aru koৱA, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! mai caYatAnara prarocanAra parA tomAra ocarata AzraYa prArthanA karo~’|
‘lagate koৱA, he mora pratipAlaka! mora ocarata siha~tara (caYatAnavorara) upasthitira parA mai tomAra ocarata AzraYa prArthanA karo~’|
aৱzeSata yetiYA siha~tara kArovAra ocaralai mRtyu Ahe, tetiYA si kaYa, he mora pratipAlaka! moka Akau (pRthiৱIlai) obhatAi diYA,

yAte mai satkarma kariva pAro~ yiTo mai Agate karA nAchilo~| nahaYa, eiTo ketiYAo naha'va| si yi kaiche nizcaYa seiTo haiche eTA vAkyamAtra| punarutthAnara diৱsalaike siha~tara sanmukhata thAkiva vArayAkha|
eteke yidinA ziGAta phu~ diYA ha’va seidinA parasparara mAjata AtmIYatAra kono vandhana nAthAkiva Aru konoৱei kAro khA-khavara nala’va,
eteke yisakalara tulAcanI gadhUra ha’va teOMlokei ha’va saphalakAma,
Aru yisakalara tulAcanI pAtala ha’va, siha~tei seisakala loka yisakale nijarei kSati kariche; siha~ta jAhAnnAmata sthAYI ha’va|
juYe siha~tara mukhamaNDala dagdha kariva Aru siha~te tAta thAkiva vIbhatsa ceherAlai;
tomAlokara ocarata mora AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karA hoৱA nAchilane? athaca tomAloke seivoraka asvIkAra karichilA|
siha~te ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! durbhAgyai AmAka parAjaYa karichila Aru Ami Achilo~ eTA pathabhraSTa sampradAYa;
‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! ei agnira parA AmAka mukta karA; iYAra pichato yadi Ami punara kupharI karo~ tente nizcaYa Ami yAlima ha'ma’|
AllAhe ka’va, ‘tomAloke nikRSTa aৱsthAta iYAtei thAkA Aru mora lagata kono kathA naka'vA’|
mora vAndAsakalara mAjara enekuৱA eTA dala Achila yisakale kaichila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami ImAna Anicho~, eteke tumi AmAka kSamA karA Aru AmAra prati daYA karA, Aru tumi sarvazreSTha daYAlu’|
‘kintu tomAloke teOMlokaka lai imAna ThATTA-vidrUpa karichilA ye, sei ThATTA-vidrUpe tomAlokaka mora smaraNa pAharAi dichila| tomAloke teOMlokara viSaYe keৱla upahAsahe karichilA’|
nizcaYa Ami teOMlokara dhairyyara kAraNe Aji Ami teOMlokaka puraskRta karilo~; nizcaYa teOMlokei haiche sAphalyamaNDita|
AllAhe ka’va, ‘tomAloke pRthiৱIta kimAna vachara aৱsthAna karichilA’?
siha~te ka’va, ‘Ami aৱsthAna karichilo~ edina athavA dinara kichu aMza; eteke tumi gaNanAkArIsakalaka sudhi coৱA’|
teOM ka’va, ‘tomAloke ati kama samaYahe aৱsthAna karichilA; yadi tomAloke nizcitabhAৱe jAniva pArilAhe~tena!
‘tomAloke bhAvichilA neki ye, Ami tomAlokaka anarthaka sRSTi karicho~ Aru tomAlokaka AmAra ocaralaike obhotAi AnA naha’va?
eteke AllAha mahimAmaYa, prakRta mAlika, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi; teৱe~i sanmAnita Arachara adhipati|

Aru yiYe AllAhara lagata anya kono upAsyako AhvAna kare, (athaca) sei viSaYe tAra ocarata kono pramANa nAi, tAra hicApa-nikAca keৱla tAra pratipAlakara ocarata Ache, nizcaYa kAphirasakala saphala ha’va noৱAriva|
Aru koৱA, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! kSamA karA Aru daYA karA, Aru tumiYei sarvazreSTha daYAlu’|
eiTo eTA churA, eiToka Ami aৱtIrNa karicho~ Aru iYAta dicho~ kichumAna aৱzya pAlanIYa vidhAna, Aru iYAta Ami aৱtIrNa karicho~ suspaSTa AYAtasamUha, yAte tomAloke upadeza grahaNa karA|

vyabhicAriNI Aru vyabhicArI--- siha~ta pratyekake ezaTAkai vetrAghAta karA| AllAhara vidhAna kAryakarIkaraNata siha~tara prati daYAi yena tomAlokaka prabhAৱita nakare, yadihe tomAloke AllAha Aru AkhirAtara prati vizvAsa sthApana karA; lagate muminasakalara eTA dala yAte siha~tara zAsti (ra samaYata upasthita hai) pratyakSa kare|

vyabhicArIYe keৱla vyabhicAriNI athavA muzvarika nArIkahe vivAha karAYa; AnahAte vyabhicAriNIka, tAika keৱla vyabhicArI athavA muzvarikehe vivAha karAYa, Aru muminasakalara oparata eiTo hArAma karA haiche|

Aru yisakale saccaritrA nArIra prati apavAda Aropa kare, tAra pichata siha~te cArijana sAkSI upasthita kariva noৱAre, tente siha~taka tomAloke AzITAkai vetrAghAta karA Aru tomAloke ketiYAo siha~tara sAkSI grahaNa nakarivA; kAraNa iha~tei haiche phAchikva|
kintu yisakale iYAra pichata tAovA kariche Aru nijake saMzodhana kariche, tente AllAha nizcaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru yisakale nijara strIra prati nijei apavAda Aropa kare, athaca nijara vAhire siha~tara Ana kono sAkSI nAi, tene aৱsthAta siha~ta pratyekare sAkSya eidare ha’va ye, si AllAhara nAmata cArivAra zapata khAi ka’va ye, ‘nizcaYa si satyavAdIsakalara antarbhukta,
Aru paJcamavAra sAkSya pradAna kari ka’va ye, ‘yadi si michalIYA haYa tente tAra oparata nAmi Ahiva AllAhara abhizApa’|
AnahAte ghainiYekajanIra zAstio rahita ha’va yadi tAYo AllAhara nAmata zapata khAi sAkSya pradAna kare ye, ‘nizcaYa tAira svAmI haiche michalIYA’,
Aru paJcamavArata ka’va ye, ‘yadi tAira svAmI satyavAdI haYa tente tAira oparata nAmi Ahiva AllAhara gajava (krodha)’|
tomAlokara prati AllAhara daYA Aru anugraha nAthAkile (nizcaYa tomAloka dhvaMsa ha’lAhe~tena); nizcaYa AllAha tAovA grahaNakArI, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa yisakale ei apavAda racanA kariche, siha~ta tomAlokarei eTA dala; iYAka tomAloke tomAlokara vAve aniSTakara vuli nAbhAvivA; varaM eiTo tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara; aৱzye siha~ta pratyekare vAve Ache siha~tara pApakarmara phala, kintu siha~tara mAjara yiYe ei viSaYata pradhAna bhUmikA pAlana kariche, tAra vAve Ache mahAzAsti|
yetiYA tomAloke ei kathA zunichilA, tetiYA mumina puruSa Aru mumina nArIsakale kiYa nijara (mAnuha) samparke uttama dhAraNA poSaNa nakarile Aru eiTo naka’le ye, ‘eiTo eTA spaSTa bhittihIna apavAda’?
siha~te kiYa ei viSaYe cArijana sAkSI upasthita nakarile? gatike yihetu siha~te sAkSI upasthita kariva parA nAi, seYe siha~tei haiche AllAhara ocarata michalIYA|
pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata tomAlokara prati AllAhara anugraha Aru daYA nAthAkile, tomAloke yi viSaYata jaDa়ita haichilA tAra vAve mahA zAstiYe tomAlokaka sparza karilehe~tena,

yetiYA tomAloke mukhe mukhe ei kathA pracAra kari phurichilA Aru ene viSaYa mukhere uccAraNa kari AchilA yAra kono jJAna tomAlokara ocarata nAchila; Aru tomAloke viSaYaToka ati tuccha vuli bhAvichilA, athaca AllAhara ocarata eiTo Achila eTA ati gurutvapUrNa viSaYa|
Aru tomAloke yetiYA eiTo zunichilA tetiYA tomAloke kiYa ei vuli naka'lA ye, ‘ei viSaYe kathA koৱATo AmAra vAve ucita nahaYa; he AllAha tumi paৱitra mahAna| nizcaYa eiTo eTA jaghanya apavAda!’
AllAhe tomAlokaka upadeza diYe ye, ‘yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA tente bhaৱiSyate ketiYAo anurUpa AcaraNara punarAvRtti nakarivA’|
AllAhe tomAlokara vAve AYAtasamUha suspaSTabhAৱe vivRta kare Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYa yisakale muminasakalara mAjata azlIlatAra prasAra kAmanA kare, siha~tara vAve Ache pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata yantraNAdAYaka zAsti; (manata rAkhivA) AllAhe jAne tomAlokehe nAjAnA|
tomAlokara prati AllAhara daYA Aru anugraha nAthAkile (nizcaYa tomAloka dhvaMsa ha’lAhe~tena); Aru nizcaYa AllAha snehazIla, ati daYAlu|

he muminasakala! tomAloke caYatAnara padAGka anusaraNa nakarivA| yiYe caYatAnara padAGka anusaraNa kare, nizcaYa caYatAne (tAka) azlIlatA Aru veYA karmarahe nirdeza diYe| AllAhara anugraha Aru daYA nAthAkile tomAlokara koneo ketiYAo paৱitra ha’va noৱArilAhe~tena, kintu AllAhe yAka icchA kare paৱitra kari diYe, Aru AllAha sarvazrotA sarvajJa|

Aru tomAlokara mAjata yisakala aizvaryazAlI Aru prAcuryara adhikArI Ache, teOMloke yena ei vuli zapata grahaNa nakare ye, siha~te AtmIYa-svajanaka, abhAৱgrastaka Aru AllAhara rAstAta hijaratakArIsakalaka ekoৱe pradAna nakariva; teOMloke yena siha~taka kSamA kari diYe Aru siha~tara doSa-truTivora upekSA kare| tomAloke nivicarA neki ye, AllAhe tomAlokaka kSamA karaka? Aru AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa yisakale saccaritrA, sahaja-saralA nirmalacitta, ImAndAra nArIra prati apavAda Aropa kare, siha~tei haiche pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata abhizapta Aru siha~tara vAve Ache mahAzAsti|
yidinA siha~tara kRtakarmara viSaYe siha~tara viruddhe sAkSya diva siha~tarei jibhA, hAta Aru siha~tara bhariYe--
seidinA AllAhe siha~tara hakka tathA prApya pratiphala paripUrNarUpe pradAna kariva Aru siha~te jAni lava ye, AllAhei satya, spaSTa prakAzaka|

duzcaritrA nArI duzcaritra puruSara vAve, Aru duzcaritra puruSa duzcaritrA nArIra vAve; AnahAte saccaritrA nArI saccaritra puruSara vAve Aru saccaritra puruSa saccaritrA nArIra vAve (upayukta)| teOMlokara viSaYe mAnuhe yi kaYa seivorara saite teOMlokara kono samparka nAi; teOMlokara vAve Ache kSamA Aru sanmAnajanaka jIৱikA|

he muminasakala! tomAloke nijara gharara vAhire Ana kArovAra gharata, sei gharara adhivAsIsakalara samprItisampanna anumati noloৱAkai Aru teOMlokaka chAlAma nidiYAkai praৱeza nakarivA| eiToৱe haiche tomAlokara vAve uttama, yAte tomAloke upadeza grahaNa karA|

eteke yadi tomAloke tAta kAko nopoৱA tente anumati nopoৱAlaike tAta praৱeza nakarivA| yadi tomAlokaka koৱA haYa, ‘ubhati yoৱA’, tente tomAloke ubhati yAvA, eiToৱe haiche tomAlokara vAve adhika paৱitra| tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|

yiTo gharata koneo vAsa nakare tene gharata tomAlokara kono bhoga-sAmagrI thAkile athavA upakRta hoৱAra adhikAra thAkile tAta tomAloke praৱeza karAta kono pApa naha’va| tomAloke yi prakAza karA Aru yi gopana karA seYA AllAhe jAne|

muminasakalaka koৱA, teOMloke yena nijara dRSTi saMyata kare, Aru nijara lajjAsthAnara hiphAjata kare; eiToৱe haiche teOMlokara vAve adhika paৱitra| teOMloke yi kare nizcaYa sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka aৱhita|

Aru muminA nArIsakalaka koৱA, teOMlokeo yena nijara dRSTika saMyata rAkhe, Aru nijara lajjAsthAnara hiphAjata kare; Aru teOMloke yena nijara saundarya pradarzana nakare kintu yiTo sAdhAraNate prakAza pAYa (seYA sukIYA kathA)| teOMloke yena mUrara oraNire DiGi Aru vakSasthala DhAki rAkhe| teOMloke yena nijara svAmI, pitR, svAmIra pitR, nijara putra, svAmIra putra, bhAtRra putra, vAi-bhanIra putra, lagarIYA tirotA, nijara mAlikAnAdhIna dAsI, yauna kAmanAvodha nakarA adhInastha puruSa Aru nArIsakalara gopana aGga samparke ajJa zizura vAhire Ana kAro sanmukhatei teOMlokara saundarya prakAza nakare, lagate teOMloke yena nijara gopana saundarya prakAza karAra uddezye sajore khoja nAkADha়e| he muminasakala! tomAloka ATAYe AllAhara phAle ubhati AhA, yAte tomAloke saphalakAma ha’va pArA|

Aru tomAlokara mAjara avivAhita nArI-puruSa Aru satkarmazIla dAsa-dAsIsakalara vivAha sampAdana kari diYA| yadi siha~ta abhAৱgrasta haYa, tente AllAhe nija anugrahata siha~taka abhAৱmukta kari diva; Aru AllAha prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

Aru yisakalara vivAha karAra sAmartha nAi, AllAhe teOMlokaka teOMra anugrahara dvArA abhAৱmukta nakarAlaike teOMloke yena saMyama aৱlamvana kare Aru tomAlokara adhInastha dAsa-dAsIra mAjara konovAi nijara muktira vAve likhita cukti vicArile, siha~tara lagata cukti kari loৱA, yadihe tomAloke siha~tara mAjata kono kalyANa Ache vuli jAniva pArA| lagate AllAhe tomAlokaka yi sampada pradAna kariche tAra parA tomAloke siha~taka dAna karA| tomAlokara dAsIsakale nijara lajjAsthAnara paৱitratA rakSA kariva vicArile pArthiৱ jIৱnara dhanara lobhata siha~taka vyabhicAra karivalai vAdhya nakarAvA| yisakale siha~taka vAdhya karAva, nizcaYa siha~taka vAdhya karAra pichata AllAhe siha~tara prati atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara prati aৱtIrNa karicho~ suspaSTa AYAtasamUha, tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara parA dRSTAnta Aru muttAkvIsakalara vAve upadeza|

AllAha haiche AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra nUra, teOMra nUrara upamA haiche yenivA eTi dipAdhAra, yAra mAjata Ache eTA pradIpa, pradIpaTo eTA kA~cara AৱraNara mAjata sthApita, kA~cara AৱraNaTo ujjvala nakSatrara dare, yiTo prajvalita karA haYa varakatamaYa yAYatuna gachara telara dvArA, seiTo keৱla pUৱ dizare nahaYa Aru keৱla pazcima dizaro nahaYa, juiYe tAka sparza nakarileo yenivA tAra tele ujjvala pohara viYapAi thAke, nUrara oparata nUra! AllAhe teOMra nUrara pine yAka icchA tAkei hidAYata kare| AllAhe mAnuhara vAvei upamAsamUha varNanA kare Aru AllAha sakalo vastu samparke sarvajJa|
seivora gharata yivoraka samunnata karivalai Aru teOMra nAma smaraNa karivalai AllAhe nirdeza diche, puৱA-gadhUli teOMra paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare,

seisakala loke, yisakalaka vyaৱsAYa-vANijya Aru vecA-kinAi AllAhara smaraNara parA Aru chAlAta kAYema karAra parA, lagate yAkAta pradAna karAra parA virata rAkhiva noৱAre, teOMloke sei diৱsaka bhaYa pAYa yidinA vahuto antara Aru dRSTisamUha olaTa-pAlaTa hai yAva|

teOMloke yi uttama Amala kare tAra vAve AllAhe yAte teOMlokaka puraskAra diYe Aru teOM nija anugrahata teOMlokara prApyatakaio adhika pradAna kare, Aru AllAhe yAka icchA kare aparimita jIৱikA dAna kare|

Aru yisakale kupharI kare siha~tara AmalasamUha haiche marubhUmira marIcikAra dare, tRSNAtura vyaktiYe yiToka pAnI vuli bhAve, kintu yetiYA si seiTora kASata gai upasthita haYa, tAta si ekoke nApAYa, varaM tAta AllAhakahe pAYa, eteke teOM tAka tAra karmaphala pUrNamAtrAta pradAna kariva; Aru AllAha druta hicApa grahaNakArI|

athavA (siha~tara AmalasamUha haiche) gabhIra sAgarara talata thakA andhakArara dare, yAka Acchanna kare taraMgara oparata taraMgai, yAra urddhata Ache meghapuJja, andhakArayukta meghapuJja starara oparata stara, Anaki si nijara hAtakhana uliYAleo kadApio dekhA nApAva; Aru AllAhe yAra vAve nUrara vyaৱsthA karA nAi, tAra vAve kono nUra nAi|

tumi lakSya karA nAine ye, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yisakala Ache teOMloke, lagate zArIvaddhabhAৱe uriphurA carAiYeo AllAhara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare? pratyekei jAne nija nija ivAdata Aru paৱitratA-mahimA ghoSaNA karAra paddhati| siha~te yi kare sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka aৱgata|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sArvabhaumatva keৱla AllAharei, Aru AllAhara phAlei zeSa pratyAৱrtana|

tumi lakSya karA nAine ye, AllAhei meghamAlAka saJcAlita kare? tAra pichata teOM seivoraka ekatrita kare Aru pichata paJjIbhUta kare| tAra pichata tumi dekhivalai poৱA ye, tAra mAjara parAi varaSuNara TopAla olAi Ahe, Aru teৱe~i AkAzata aৱsthita meghara parvatara madhyasthita zilAstUpara parA zilAvRSTi varSaNa kare| tAra pichata iYAra dvArA teOM yAka icchA kare AghAta kare Aru yAka icchA kare tAra parA iYAka Ana phAle A~tarAi diYe| meghara vijulI cakamakaniYe dRSTizakti kADha়i loৱAra upakrama haYa|
AllAhei rAti Aru dinara Aৱrtana ghaTAYa, nizcaYa iYAta antardRSTisampanna vyaktisakalara vAve Ache zikSA|

Aru AllAhe pratyeka jIৱkei sRSTi kariche pAnIra parA, tAre kichumAna peTata bhara di cu~cari yAYa, Ana kichumAne dui bharire khojakADha়e Aru kichumAne khojakADha়e cAri TheGara sahAYata| AllAhe yi icchA kare seiToৱe sRSTi kare| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
nizcaYa AmiYei suspaSTa AYAtasamUha aৱtIrNa karicho~, Aru AllAhe yAka icchA kare sarala-saThika pathata paricAlita kare|
siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna Anicho~ Aru Ami Anugatya karicho~’| iYAra pichato siha~tara eTA dale mukha ghUrAi laYa; prakRtate siha~ta mumina nahaYa|
Aru yetiYA siha~taka AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ei marme AhvAna karA haYa ye, yAte teOM siha~tara mAjata vicAra-mImAMsA kari diYe, tetiYA siha~tara eTA dale mukha ghUrAi laYa|
mImAMsA siha~tara sapakSe ha’va vuli umAna pAle, siha~te vinItabhAৱe rAchulara ocaralai dauri Ahe|
siha~tara antarata vyAdhi Ache neki, ne siha~te sandeha poSaNa kare? ne siha~te bhaYa kare ye, AllAha Aru teOMra rAchule siha~tara prati anyAYa kariva, varaM siha~tei haiche yAlima|

muminasakalaka yetiYA teOMlokara mAjata vicAra-mImAMsA kari diYAra vAve AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara pine AhvAna karA haYa, tetiYA teOMloke keৱla ei kathAke kaYa ye, ‘Ami zunilo~ Aru Anugatya karilo~’| teOMlokei haiche saphalakAma|
yiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya kare, Aru AllAhaka bhaYa kare lagate teOMra tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare, teOMlokei haiche kRtakAryya|

Aru siha~te dRDha়bhAৱe AllAhara zapata khAi kaYa ye, tumi yadi siha~taka Adeza karA tente siha~te nizcaYa olAi Ahiva| tumi koৱA, ‘zapata nAkhAvA, (tomAlokara) Anugatya samparke bhAlakaiYe janA Ache| tomAloke yi karA nizcaYa AllAha sei viSaYe savizeSa aৱhita’|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAhara Anugatya karA Aru rAchulara Anugatya karA’| iYAra pichato yadi tomAloke mukha ghUrAi loৱA, tente teOM keৱla teOMra oparata arpita dAYitvara vAvehe dAYI Aru tomAlokara oparata arpita dAYitvara vAve tomAloke nijei dAYI; yadi tomAloke teOMra Anugatya karA tente satpatha pAvA, darAcalate rAchulara dAYitva haiche keৱla suspaSTabhAৱe pau~cAi diYA|

tomAlokara mAjara yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche AllAhe teOMlokaka pratizruti diche ye, teOM nizcaYa teOMlokaka pRthiৱIta pratinidhitva dAna kariva, yenekai teOM pratinidhitva dAna karichila teOMlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakalaka Aru teOM aৱzye teOMlokara vAve teOMlokara dvInaka pratiSThita kariva, yiTo dharmaka teOMlokara vAve teOM pachanda kariche; Aru teOMlokara bhaYa-bhItika zAnti tathA nirApattAta parivartana kari diva| teOMloke keৱla morei ivAdata kariva, mora lagata Ana kAko aMzIdAra sthApana nakariva, kintu iYAra pichato yisakale kupharI kariva, siha~tei haiche phAchikva|
tomAloke yathAyathabhAৱe chAlAta kAYema karA, yAkAta pradAna karA Aru rAchulara Anugatya karA, yAte tomAloka rahamataprApta ha’va pArA|

yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara viSaYe tumi ketiYAo eiTo nAbhAvivA ye, siha~te pRthiৱIta (AmAka) apAraga kariva pAriva| siha~tara AzraYasthala haiche jAhAnnAma; Aru kimAna ye nikRSTa ei pratyAৱrtanasthala!

he muminasakala! tomAlokara adhInastha dAsa-dAsIsakala Aru tomAlokara mAjara yisakale etiYAo prApta vaYaskata upanIta hoৱA nAi, siha~te yena tomAlokara koThAta praৱeza karivalai tiniTA samaYata anumati grahaNa kare, phajarara chAlAtara Agata, duparIYAra samaYata yetiYA tomAloke (vizrAmara vAve) sAja-kApora khuli thoৱA, Aru IzvA chAlAtara pichata| ei tiniTA samaYa haiche tomAlokara gopanIYatAra samaYa| ei tiniTA samaYara vAhire (Ana yikono samaYata vinA anumatita siha~te praৱeza karile) tomAlokara Aru siha~taro kono doSa nAi| kiYano tomAloke ijane-sijanara ocaralai ahA-yoৱA karAToৱe svAbhAৱika| eidarei AllAhe teOMra AYAtasamUha tomAlokara vAve spaSTakai varNanA kare, Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Aru tomAlokara santAna-santatisakala prAptavaYaskata upanIta ha’le siha~teo yena anumati grahaNa kare yenekai anumati grahaNa karichila siha~tara vaYojyeSThasakale| eidare AllAhe tomAlokara vAve teOMra AYAtasamUha vivRta kare, Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Aru vRddhA nArIsakala, yisakale vivAhara AzA poSaNa nakare, siha~te yadi saundarya pradarzana nakari siha~tara cAdara khuli rAkhe tente siha~tara kono aparAdha nahaYa| kintu iYAra parA siha~te virata thakAToৱe siha~tara vAve uttama, Aru AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

andhara vAve kono doSa nAi, khaJjara vAveo kono doSa nAi, rugIYAra vAveo kono doSa nAi Aru tomAlokara vAveo kono doSa nAi khoৱA-voৱA karAta, nijara gharata athavA tomAlokara pitRra gharata, mAtRra gharata, bhAtRsakalara gharata, vAi-bhanIsakalara gharata, dadAi-varakAisakalara gharata, pehI-jeThAisakalara gharata, momAisakalara gharata, mAhI-jeThAisakalara gharata athavA seivora gharata, yivora gharara cAvi-kAThira mAlika tomAloka nijei, nAivA tomAlokara vandhusakalara gharata| tomAloke ekelage khoৱA athavA pRthake khoৱA tAta tomAlokara kono aparAdha nahaYa| kintu yetiYA tomAloke kono gharata praৱeza karivA tetiYA tomAloke parasparara prati chAlAma karivA abhivAdana hicApe, yiTo AllAhara taraphara parA kalyANamaYa Aru paৱitra| eidarei AllAhe tomAlokara vAve teOMra AYAtasamUha spaSTabhAৱe vivRta kare yAte tomAloke anudhAৱna kariva pArA|

prakRta mumina haiche seisakala loka, yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati vizvAsa sthApana kare Aru rAchulara lagata kono sAmAjika kAmata ekatrita ha’le teOMra anumati noloৱAkai guci nAyAYa; nizcaYa yisakale tomAra parA anumati vicAre teOMlokei AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna poSaNa kare| eteke teOMloke nijara kono kAmara vAve tomAra ocaralai Ahi anumati vicArile teOMlokara mAjara parA yAka icchA karA tumi tAka anumati pradAna karivA Aru teOMlokara vAve AllAhara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karivA| nizcaYa AllAha parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomAloke rAchulara AhvAnaka tomAlokara mAjara paraspare karA AhvAnara dare gaNya nakarivA; tomAlokara mAjara yisakale pulukAmAri mane mane guci yAYa AllAhe siha~taka bhAlakaiYe jAne| eteke yisakale teOMra viruddhAcaraNa kare siha~te satarka hoৱA ucita ye, siha~te phitanAta patita ha’va nAivA yantraNAdAYaka zAstiYe siha~taka grAsa kariva|

jAni thoৱA! AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei; tomAloke yi karmata lipta AchA seYAo teOM jAne| yidinA siha~taka teOMra ocaralai obhatAi niYA ha’va, seidinA teOM siha~taka janAi diva ye, siha~te ki ki karichila; Aru AllAha sakalo viSaYe sarvajJa|
ati kalyANamaYa teOM, yijane teOMra vAndAra oparata phurakvAna aৱtIrNa kariche, yAte teOM (ra sei vAndA) vizvajagatara vAve satarkakArI ha’va pAre|

teৱe~i AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sArvabhaumatvara adhikArI; teOM kono santAna grahaNa karA nAi; sArvabhauma kSamatAta teOMra kono aMzIdAra nAi| teৱe~i sakalo vastu sRSTi kariche, tAra pichata seivoraka yathAyatha anupAtata nirdhAraNa kariche|

tathApio siha~te AllAhara vAhire vahuto ilAha grahaNa kariche, yivore ekoৱe sRSTi kariva noৱAre, varaM siha~ta nijei sRSTa, Anaki siha~te nijara apakAra vA upakAra karAro kSamatA nArAkhe| lagate mRtyu, jIৱna Aru punarutthAnato siha~tara kono adhikAra nAi|

Aru kAphirasakale kaYa, ‘eikhana michA kathAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa, eikhana teOM nijei racanA kariche Aru vibhinna sampradAYara mAnuhe teOMka ei viSaYata sahAYa kariche’| eidare kAphirasakale anyAYa kare Aru michA kathA viYapAYa|
siha~te Aru kaYa, ‘eivora haiche prAcInakAlara upakathA, yivora teOM likhoৱAi laiche; tAra pichata eivora puৱA-gadhUli teOMra ocarata pATha karA haYa’|
koৱA, ‘eikhana sei sattvAi aৱtIrNa kariche yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra samudAYa rahasya samparke aৱgata; nizcaYa teOM parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

siha~te Aru kaYa, ‘eOM kenekuৱA rAchula, yiYe khoৱA-voৱA kare Akau hATa-vajArato calAphurA kare; teOMra ocaralai kono phiristA aৱtIrNa karA naha’la kiYa, yiYe teOMra saite satarkakArI hicApe thAkilehe~tena?

‘athavA teOMra ocaralai kono dhana-bhANDAra nAhila kiYa, nAivA teOMra kAraNe eTA vAgAna nahaYa kiYa, ya’ra parA teOM khAva pArilehe~tena?’ yAlimasakale Aru kaYa, ‘tomAloke keৱla ejana yAdugrasta vyaktikahe anusaraNa kari AchA’|
coৱA, siha~te tomAra vAve kenekuৱA (yuktihIna) upamA dAGi dhariche! phalata siha~te pathabhraSTa haiche, gatike siha~te supatha pAvalai ketiYAo sakSama nahaYa|
teOM ati varakatamaYa, teOM icchA karile tomAka iYAtakaio utkRSTa vastu pradAna kariva pAre— enekuৱA udyAna, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita thAkiva, lagate teOM tomAka diva pAre prAsAdasamUha!
varaM siha~te kiYAmataka asvIkAra kariche| eteke yiYe kiYAmataka asvIkAra kare Ami tAra vAve prastuta kari rAkhicho~ jalanta jui|
dUrara parA juiYe yetiYA siha~taka dekhiva, tetiYA siha~te tAra kruddha tarjana-garjana Aru pracaNDa huMkAra zunivalai pAva|
Aru yetiYA siha~taka DiGita hAta meriYAi zRMkhalita aৱsthAta tAra (jAhAnnAmara) kono saMkIrNa sthAnata nikSepa karA ha’va, tetiYA siha~te tAta dhvaMsa kAmanA kariva|
(koৱA ha’va) ‘Aji tomAloke eTA dhvaMsaka nahaYa, varaM vahu dhvaMsaka AhvAna karA’|
(siha~taka) sodhA, ‘eiToৱe bhAla, ne sei sthAYI jAnnAta bhAla, yAra pratizruti muttAkvIsakalaka diYA haiche’? yiTo ha’va teOMlokara pratidAna Aru pratyAৱrtanasthala|
tAta teOMloke cirakAla vasavAsa kariva Aru yiTo kAmanA kariva seiToৱe pAva; ei pratizruti pUraNa karATo tomAra pratipAlakara dAYitva|

Aru seidinA teOM siha~taka (kAphirasakalaka) Aru siha~te AllAhara vAhire yivoraka upAsanA karichila seivorako ekatrita kariva, tAra pichata teOM prazna kariva, ‘tomAlokei mora ei vAndAsakalaka vibhrAnta karichilA neki, ne siha~ta nijei vibhrAnta haichila’?

siha~te ka’va, ‘tumi paৱitra Aru mahAna! tomAra vAhire Ana kArovAka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa karATo AmAra vAve ketiYAo ucita nahaYa, varaM tumiYei siha~taka Aru siha~tara pitR-puruSasakalaka bhoga-sambhAra pradAna karichilA, phalata siha~te (tomAra) smaraNa pAhari gaichila Aru dhvaMsaprApta sampradAYata pariNata haichila’|

(AllAhe muzvarikasakalaka ka’va) ‘eteke tomAloke yi kaichilA tAka siha~te michA sAvyasta kariche| seYe tomAloke etiYA zAsti pratirodha kariva noৱArivA Aru sahAYo nApAvA| tomAlokara mAjara yiYe yuluma tathA zvirka kare Ami tAka mahAzAstira svAda upabhoga karAma’|

Aru Ami tomAra pUrve yimAnavora rAchula preraNa karicho~, teOMloka ATAYe khoৱA-voৱA karichila Aru hATa-vajArato calA-phurA karichila| (he mAnaৱ!) Ami tomAlokara ejanaka Anajanara vAve parIkSA vanAi dicho~| tomAloke dhairyya dhAraNa karivAne? Aru tomAra pratipAlaka sarva draSTA|

Aru yisakale AmAra sAkSAt kAmanA nakare siha~te kaYa, ‘AmAra ocaralai phiristA kiYa aৱtIrNa karA nahaYa, athavA Ami AmAra pratipAlakaka dekhA nApAOM kiYa’? nizcaYa siha~te siha~tara antarata ahaMkAra poSaNa kariche Aru siha~te jaghanyabhAৱe sImAlaMghana kariche|
yidinA siha~te phiristAsakalaka dekhivalai pAva seidinA aparAdhIsakalara vAve kono susaMvAda nAthAkiva Aru siha~te ka’va, ‘rakSA karA, rakSA karA’|
Aru Ami siha~tara kRtakarmara prati agrasara hai seivoraka vikSipta dhUlikaNAta pariNata (kari niSphala) karima|
seidinA jAnnAtavAsIsakalara vAsasthAna ha'va utkRSTa Aru vizrAmasthala ha’va manorama|
Aru seidinA meghapuJjara dvArA AkAza vidIrNa ha'va Aru dale dale phiristAsakalaka aৱtIrNa karoৱA ha’va|
seidinA cUDa়Anta kartRtva ha’va keৱla rahamAnara Aru kAphirasakalara vAve seidinaTo ha’va atyanta kaThina|
seidinA yAlima vyaktiYe nijare duhAta kAmuri kAmuri ka’va, ‘hAYa! mai yadi rAchulara saite kono patha aৱlamvana karilo~he~tena!’
hAYa! durbhAgya mora, amukaka yadi mai vandhurUpe grahaNa nakarilo~he~tena!
nizcaYa siYe moka upadeza vANIra parA vibhrAnta karichila, yetiYA mora ocaralai upadeza Ahichila; Aru caYatAnato mAnuhara vAve mahApratAraka|
Aru rAchule ka’va, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa mora sampradAYe koraAnaka parityaja sAvyasta kariche’|
(AllAhe kaiche) ‘eidarei Ami pratyeka navIra vAve aparAdhIvilAkara mAjara parA zatru vanAi dicho~| eteke pathapradarzaka Aru sahAYakArIrUpe tomAra pratipAlakei yatheSTa’|

Aru kAphirasakale kaYa, ‘sampUrNa koraAnakhana teOMra prati ekelage aৱtIrNa karA naha’la kiYa’? (zunA) eidare aৱtIrNa karAra kAraNa haiche yAte tomAra hRdaYaka Ami iYAra dvArA majavuta kariva pAro~, seYe Ami iYAka krame krame spaSTabhAৱe AvRtti karicho~|
Aru siha~te tomAra ocaralai yi viSaYei lai nAhaka kiYa, Ami seiTora saThika samAdhAna Aru sundara vyAkhyA tomAra ocaralai Anicho~|
yisakalaka uvuri khuৱAi jAhAnnAmara pine ekatrita karA ha’va, maryAdAra dizara parA siha~ta ati nikRSTa Aru adhika pathabhraSTa|
nizcaYa AmiYei muchAka kitAva pradAna karichilo~ Aru teOMra lagata teOMra bhAtR hArUnaka sahAYakArI hicApe niyukta karichilo~|
tAra pichata Ami kaichilo~, ‘tomAloke sei sampradAYara ocaralai yoৱA yisakale AmAra nidarzanAৱlIka asvIkAra kariche’| phalata Ami siha~taka sampUrNarUpe vidhvasta karichilo~;

Aru nUha sampradAYako (dhvaMsa karichilo~), yetiYA siha~te rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karichila, tetiYA Ami siha~taka DuvAi mArichilo~ Aru siha~taka mAnuhara vAve nidarzana vanAi dicho~| Ami yAlimasakalara vAve prastuta kari rAkhicho~ yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Aru Ami dhvaMsa karichilo~ Ada, chAmUda, rAcha’ra adhivAsIvilAkaka, lagate siha~tara madhyaৱrtI samaYara vahu prajanmako|
Ami siha~tara pratyekare vAve dRSTAnta varNanA karichilo~ Aru siha~tavoraka Ami sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa karichilo~|

nizcaYa ei kAphiravilAke sei janapadara mAjerei ahA-yoৱA kare yAra oparata varSita haichila akalyANara vRSTi, tente siha~te seivora dekhA nApAYa ne? darAcalate siha~te punarutthAnara pratyAzAi nakare|
Aru siha~te yetiYA tomAka dekhe, tetiYA siha~te tomAka keৱla hA~hiYAtara pAtrarUpehe gaNya kare, (Aru kaYa,) ‘eOMৱei neki seijana, yAka AllAhe rAchula kari paThAiche’?

‘eOM nizcaYa AmAka AmAra upAsyavorara parA A~tara kari dilehe~tena, yadi Ami siha~tara prati avicala nAthAkilo~he~tena’| yetiYA siha~te zAsti pratyakSa kariva, tetiYAhe jAniva pAriva kona adhika pathabhraSTa|
