tumi seijana vyaktika dekhichAne, yiYe nijara pravRttika ilAharUpe grahaNa kariche? tathApio tumi tAra dAYitva grahaNa karivAne?
athavA tumi bhavA neki ye siha~tara adhikAMzai zunA pAYa vA vuji pAYa? prakRtate siha~ta haiche pazura dare; varaM siha~ta iYAtakaio adhika pathabhraSTa|
tumi tomAra pratipAlakara prati lakSya nakarA neki, coৱAcona teOM kenekai chA~ samprasArita kare? teOM icchA karile iYAka sthira rAkhiva pArilehe~tena; piche Ami sUryaka iYAra nirdezaka kari dicho~|
tAra pichata Ami iYAka lAhe lAhe capAi Ano|
Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve rAtika kariche AৱraNasvarUpa, Aru Topani pradAna kariche vizrAmara vAve, lagate sajAga hai uThivalai sRSTi kariche dina|
Aru teৱe~i susaMvAdavAhIrUpe vatAha preraNa kare teOMra rahamatara varaSuNara pUrve; Aru AmiYei AkAzara parA paৱitra pAnI varSaNa karo~,
yAte tAra dvArA Ami mRta bhU-khaNDaka saJjIৱita kariva pAro~, Aru Ami yivora jIৱ-jantu Aru mAnuha sRSTi karicho~, tAra mAjara vahutake Ami seYA pAna karAOM,
nizcaYa Ami iYAka siha~tara mAjata vanTana kari dicho~, yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kariva pAre| tathApio adhikAMza loke keৱla akRtajJatAi prakAza kare|
Aru Ami icchA karile pratiTo janapadatei ekojanakai satarkakArI paThAva pArilo~he~tena|
gatike tumi kAphirasakalara Anugatya nakarivA Aru tumi koraAnara sahAYata siha~tara viruddhe kaThora saMgrAma calAi yoৱA|

Aru teৱe~i dukhana sAgaraka samAntarAlabhAৱe pravAhita kariche, ekhanara (pAnI) susvAdu miThA Aru Anakhanara luNIYA, keheTA; Aru teOM ubhaYara mAjata rAkhi diche eTA antarAYa, yiTo anatikramya vyaৱdhAna|
Aru teৱe~i mAnuhaka pAnIra parA sRSTi kariche, tAra pichata teOM tAka vaMzagata Aru vaivAhika samparkazIla kariche| kAraNa tomAra pratipAlaka sarvazaktimAna |

Aru siha~te AllAhara parivarte enekuৱA kichumAnara ivAdata kare yivore siha~tara upakAro kariva noৱAre Aru siha~tara apakAro kariva noৱAre| aৱzye kAphira haiche keৱla tAra pratipAlakara viruddhe sahAYakArI|
Aru Ami tomAka keৱla susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArIrUpehe preraNa karicho~|
koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokara ocarata iYAra vinimaYata kono pArizramika nivicAro~, kintu yAra icchA si nija pratipAlakara patha aৱlamvana karaka (eiToৱe mora kAmanA)’|

Aru tumi keৱla sei sattvAra prati nirbhara karA yijana ciraJjIৱ, yijana ketiYAo mRtyuvaraNa nakariva, seYe prazaMsAra saite teOMrei paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karA, teOMra vAndAsakalara pApa samparke khavara rAkhivalai teৱe~i yatheSTa|

teৱe~i AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjata yi yi Ache sei sakalovoraka chaYa dinata sRSTi kariche; tAra pichata teOM Arachara oparata uThiche| teৱe~i rahamAna, eteke teOMra viSaYe yiYe jAne tAka sudhi coৱA|

Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa, ‘tomAloke rahamAnara prati chAjadAha karA’, tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘rahamAna Akau ki? tumi kArovAka chAjadAha kariva ka’lei Ami tAka chAjadAha karimane’? (ene AhvAne) keৱla siha~tara palAYanaparatAi vRddhi kare|
ati varakatamaYa sei sattvA yijane nabhomaNDalata sRSTi kariche vizAla nakSatrarAji Aru tAta sthApana kariche pradIpa (sUrya), lagate Alo vikiraNakArI candra|
Aru teৱe~i dina Aru rAtika parasparara anugAmI kariche, sei vyaktira vAve yiYe upadeza grahaNa kariva vicAre athavA kRtajJatA prakAza kariva vicAre|
Aru rahamAnara (prakRta) vAndA teOMlokei yisakale pRthiৱIta atyanta vinamrabhAৱe calAphurA kare Aru yetiYA murkhasakale teOMlokaka (azAlIna bhASAta) samvodhana kare, tetiYA teOMloke kaYa, ‘chAlAma’;
Aru yisakale nija pratipAlakara uddezye chAjadAৱnata hai Aru thiYa hai (ivAdata kari) thakA aৱsthAta ujAgare rAti kaTAYa;
Aru teOMloke kaYa, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAra parA jAhAnnAmara zAsti A~tarAi diYA, nizcaYa iYAra zAsti avicchinna|
‘nizcaYa seYA vasavAsa Aru aৱsthAnasthala hicApe ati nikRSTa’|
Aru teOMloke yetiYA vyaYa kare tetiYA apavyaYa nakare, Aru kRpaNatAo nakare, varaM (teOMloke) ei duYore madhyaৱrtI panthA aৱlamvana kare|

Aru teOMloke AllAhara lagata Ana kono ilAhaka AhvAna nakare; Aru AllAhe yi prANa hatyA karivalai niSedha kariche, yathArtha kAraNavihIna tAka hatyA nakare| teOMloke vyabhicAra nakare; yiYe eivora kariva si (aৱzye) zAsti bhoga kariva|
kiYAmatara dinA tAka dviguNa zAsti pradAna karA ha’va Aru tAta si apamAnita aৱsthAta sthAYI ha’va|
kintu yiYe tAovA kariche, ImAna poSaNa kariche Aru satkarma kariche, AllAhe teOMlokara guNAhasamUhaka pUNyara dvArA parivartana kari diva| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Aru yiYe tAovA kare Aru satkarma kare, nizcaYa teOM sampUrNarUpe AllAhara abhimukhI haYa|
Aru teOMloke michA kathAra sAkSI nidiYe Aru teOMloke asAra kAryakalApara sanmukhIna ha’le nijara maryAdA rakSArthe seYA parihAra kari guci yAYa|
Aru teOMlokaka nija pratipAlakara AYAtasamUha smaraNa karAi dile teOMloke andha Aru vadhirara dare AcaraNa nakare|

Aru teOMloke prArthanA kari kaYa, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka enekuৱA strI Aru santAna-santati dAna karA, yAra dvArA AmAra caku jura pari yAYa| lagate tumi AmAka muttAkvIsakalara vAve anusaraNayogya vanAi diYA’|
teOMlokakei jAnnAtara suucca kakSa pratidAna hicApe pradAna karA ha’va| yihetu teOMloka Achila dhairyyazIla| teOMlokaka tAta abhivAdana Aru chAlAmara dvArA samvardhanA janoৱA ha’va|
tAta teOMloke sthAYI ha’va| aৱsthAnasthala Aru vAsasthAna hicApe seYA kimAna ye utkRSTa!

koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke teOMka AhvAna nakarilAhe~tena tente mora pratipAlake tomAlokara prati akaNo bhrukSepa nakarilehe~tena| tAra pichato tomAloke asvIkAra karichA, seYe acirei aparihArya ha’va zAsti’|
tva-chIma-mIma|[1]
eivora haiche suspaSTa kitAvara AYAta|
siha~te mumina hoৱA nAi vuli haYato tumi dukhate AtmaghAtI hai parivA|
Ami icchA karile AkAzara parA siha~tara oparata enekuৱA nidarzana aৱtIrNa karilo~he~tena, yAra phalata sei nidarzanara prati siha~tara ghAra aৱnata hai parilahe~tena|
Aru yetiYAi siha~tara ocaralai rahamAnara taraphara parA kono natuna upadeza Ahe, tetiYAi siha~te tAra parA mukha ghUrAi laYa|
eteke nizcitabhAৱe siha~te asvIkAra kariche| seYe siha~te yiToka lai ThATTA-vidrUpa karichila tAra prakRta vArtA siha~tara ocaralai zIghrei Ahi pariva|
siha~te pRthiৱIra phAle lakSya nakare neki? tAta Ami sakalo prakArara vahuto utkRSTa udbhida utpanna karicho~!
nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei mumina nahaYa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAra pratipAlake muchAka mAti ka’le, ‘tumi yAlima sampradAYara ocaralai yoৱA,
phiraAunara sampradAYara ocaralai; siha~te tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivane’?
muchAi ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! mora AzaMkA haiche ye, siha~te moka asvIkAra kariva|
‘Aru mora vuku saMkucita hai pariche, lagate mora jibhAo svAbhAৱika nahaYa| eteke tumi hArUnara pratio ahI preraNa karA|
‘lagate mora viruddhe siha~tara ocarata eTA abhiyogo Ache, seYe mora AzaMkA haiche ye, siha~te moka hatyA kariva’|
AllAhe ka’le, ‘nahaYa, ketiYAo nahaYa, tomAloka duYo mora nidarzana lai yoৱA, nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara lagata Acho~ zraৱNakArI hicApe|
‘eteke tomAloka duYo phiraAunara ocaralai gai koৱA, ‘nizcaYa Ami vizvajagatara pratipAlakara (taraphara parA prerita) rAchula,
‘seYe tumi vanI icharAIlaka AmAra lagata yAvalai diYA’|
phiraAune ka’le, ‘Ami tomAka zaizaৱ kAlata AmAra mAjate lAlana-pAlana karA nAchilo~ne? Aru nizcaYa tumi tomAra jIৱnara vahu vachara AmAra mAjatei ativAhita karichA,
‘Aru tumi tomAra karma yiTo karivalagIYA Achila seiTo kariYe pelAichA, Aru tumi akRtajJasakalara antarbhukta’|
muchAi ka’le, ‘seiTo mai tetiYAhe karichilo~, yetiYA mai patha bhrAnta Achilo~’|

‘eteke yetiYA mai tomAlokaka bhaYa karichilo~, tetiYA mai tomAlokara parA palAYana karichilo~| iYAra pichata mora pratipAlake moka prajJA (navuoৱta) dAna kariche Aru moka rAchulasakalara antarbhukta kariche|
‘Aru mora prati tomAra yi anugrahara kathA ullekha kari tumi daYA dekhuৱAi AchA, tAra prakRta satya eiTo ye, tumi vanI icharAIlaka dAsata pariNata karichA’|
phiraAune ka’le, ‘sRSTijagatara pratipAlaka Akau ki’?
muchAi ka’le, ‘teৱe~i AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore madhyaৱrtI sakalo vastura pratipAlaka, yadi tomAloke nizcita vizvAsI hoৱA’|
phiraAune tAra ocare-pA~jare thakA lokasakalaka lakSya kari ka’le, ‘tomAloke manoyoga sahakAre zunichAne’?
muchAi ka’le, ‘teৱe~i tomAlokara pratipAlaka Aru tomAlokara pUrvapuruSasakaloro pratipAlaka’|
phiraAune ka’le, ‘tomAlokara prati prerita tomAlokara ei rAchulajana nizcaYa ejana valiYA’|
muchAi ka’le, ‘teৱe~i pUৱ Aru pazcimara, lagate ei duYore mAjata yi Ache sei sakalo vastura pratipAlaka; yadi tomAloke vuji poৱA’|
phiraAune ka’le, ‘yadi tumi mora parivarte Anaka ilAharUpe grahaNa karA tente mai tomAka nizcaYa kArAruddha karima’|
muchAi ka’le, ‘yadi mai tomAra ocaralai spaSTa kono (nidarzana) lai Aho~, tathApio (tumi moka kAraruddha karivAne)’?
phiraAune ka’le, ‘yadi tumi satyavAdI hoৱA tente seYA lai AhA’|
tetiYA muchAi nijara hAtara lAkhuTiDAla nikSepa karile Aru lage lage seYA eDAla ajagara sApata pariNata ha’la|
Aru teOM nijara hAta vAhiralai uliYAi Anile Aru lage lage seYA darzakara ocarata zubhra ujjvala pratibhAta ha’la|
phiraAune tAra ocare-pA~jare thakA pariSadavargaka uddezya kari ka’le, ‘nizcaYa eOM ejana sudakSa yAdukara’|
‘eOM nijara yAdu zaktire tomAlokaka tomAlokara dezara parAi vahiSkAra kariva vicAre| eteke tomAloke moka ki parAmarza diYA’?
siha~te ka’le, ‘teOMka Aru teOMra bhAtRka kichu samaYa aৱkAza diYaka Aru nagare nagare saMgrAhakasakalaka paThAi diYaka,
‘yAte siha~te AponAra ocaralai pratyeka abhijJa yAdukaraka lai upasthita haYa’|
tAra pichata eTA nirdhArita dinara nirdiSTa samaYata yAdukarasakalaka ekatrita karA ha’la,
Aru mAnuhaka koৱA ha’la, ‘tomAlokeo samaveta ha’vAne’?
‘yAte Ami yAdukarasakalaka anusaraNa kariva pAro~, yadi siha~te vijaYI haYa’|
eteke yetiYA yAdukaravilAke Ahi phiraAunaka ka’le, ‘yadi Ami vijaYI haOM tente AmAra vAve puraskAra thAkivane’?
phiraAune ka’le, ‘haYa, Aru nizcaYa tomAloka tetiYA mora ghaniSTasakalara antarbhukta ha’vA’|
muchAi siha~taka ka’le, ‘tomAlokara yi nikSepa karivalagIYA Ache seYA nikSepa karA’|
tAra pichata siha~te siha~tara rachI Aru lAkhuTivora nikSepa karile Aru siha~te ka’le, ‘phiraAunara maryAdAra zapata! nizcaYa AmiYei vijaYI hama’|
tAra pichata muchAi teOMra lAkhuTiDAla nikSepa karile, phalata tatkSaNAta i siha~tara michA kIrtisamUha grAsa karivalai dharile|
tetiYA yAdukarasakala chAjadAৱnata hai parila|
teOMloke ka’le, ‘Ami ImAna Anilo~ vizvajagatara pratipAlakara prati,
‘muchA Aru hArunara pratipAlakara prati’|

phiraAune ka’le, ‘mai tomAlokaka anumati diYAra Agatei tomAloke tAra prati vizvAsa karilA? nizcaYa siYei haiche tomAlokara pradhAna Aru siYe tomAlokaka yAdu zikSA diche| eteke tomAloke zIghrei iYAra pariNAma pAvA| nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara hAta Aru bhari viparIta dizara parA kATi dima Aru tomAloka sakaloke zUlaviddha karima’|
teOMloke ka’le, ‘kono asuvidhA nAi, nizcaYa Ami AmAra pratipAlakara phAlei ubhati yAma|
nizcaYa Ami AzA poSaNa karo~ ye, AmAra pratipAlake AmAra aparAdhasamUha kSamA kari diva, kAraNa AmiYe muminasakalara mAjata prathama|
Aru Ami muchAra prati ei marme ahI karilo~ ye, ‘AmAra vAndAsakalaka lai rAtira bhitarate olAi yoৱA, nizcaYa tomAlokaka piche piche khedi yoৱA ha’va’|
tAra pichata phiraAune cahare cahare loka saMgrahakArI preraNa karile,
‘(ei vuli ye,) nizcaYa iha~ta haiche kSudra eTA dala,
‘Aru nizcaYa siha~te AmAra krodha udreka kariche,
‘Aru nizcitabhAৱe Ami sakaloৱe sadAYa satarka’|
pariNAmata Ami phiraAuna goSThIka siha~tara udyAnasamUha Aru prasraৱnara parA vahiSkAra karilo~,
lagate dhana-bhANDAra Aru manorama saudhamAlAra parAo|
eidarei haichila Aru Ami vanI icharAIlaka karichilo~ eivorara adhikArI|
siha~te sUryodaYara prAkamuhUrtate teOMlokaka co~cA la’le|
eteke yetiYA duYo dale parasparaka dekhile, tetiYA muchAra saGgIsakale ka’le, ‘nizcaYa Ami dharA parilo~!’
muchAi ka’le, ‘ketiYAo nahaYa, mora lagata mora pratipAlaka Ache; anatipalame teOM moka pathanirdeza kariva’|
tAra pichata Ami muchAra prati ahI karilo~ ye, ‘tomAra lAkhuTire sAgarata AghAta karA’| phalata sAgara vibhakta hai pratyeka bhAga vizAla parvatara dare hai ga’la;
Aru Ami Ana dalaToko sei ThAira nikaTaৱrtI karilo~,
Aru Ami uddhAra karilo~ muchA Aru teOMra saGgIsakalaka,
tAra pichata DuvAi mArilo~ AnaTo dalaka|
nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei mumina nahaYa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Aru tumi siha~tara ocarata ivrAhImara vRttAnta varNanA karA|
yetiYA teOM teOMra pitRka Aru nija sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘tomAloke kihara ivAdata karA’?
siha~te ka’le, ‘Ami mUrti pUjA karo~; eteke Ami niSThAra saite seiToke dhari thAkima’|
teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke yetiYA AhvAna karA tetiYA seivore zunA pAYane?
‘athavA siha~te tomAlokara upakAra nAivA apakAra kariva pArene’?
siha~te ka’le, ‘varaM Ami AmAra pitRpuruSasakalaka pAicho~, teOMloke enekuৱAi karichila’|
ivrAhIme ka’le, ‘tomAloke bhAvi cAichAne, yisakalara ivAdata tomAloke kari AchA,
‘tomAloka Aru tomAlokara pitRpuruSasakala!
‘siha~ta ATAYe mora zatru, keৱla vizvajagatara rava (AllAha)ra vAhire|
‘yijane moka sRSTi kariche, tAra pichata teৱe~i moka hidAYata diche|
‘teৱe~i moka AhAra karAYa Aru teৱe~i moka pAna karAYa|
‘Aru yetiYA mai asustha haOM, tetiYA teৱe~i moka Arogya kare|
‘teৱe~i mora mRtyu ghaTAva Aru teৱe~i moka punarjIৱita kariva|
‘Aru teOMra ocaratei mora AzA ye, teOM moka kiYAmatara dinA mora aparAdhasamUha kSamA kari diva|
‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka hikamata dAna karA Aru satkarmazIlasakalara antarbhukta karA|
‘Aru paraৱrtIsakalara mAjata mora sunAma-sukhyAti avyAhata rAkhA,
‘Aru moka sukhamaYa jAnnAtara uttarAdhikArIsakalara antarbhukta karA,
‘Aru mora pitRka kSamA karA, nizcaYa teOM pathabhraSTavilAkara antarbhukta Achila|
‘Aru (he mora pratipAlaka!) punarutthAnara dinA moka lAJchita nakarivA|
‘yidinA dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati kono kAmata nAhiva;
‘seidinA upakRta ha’va keৱla sei vyakti, yijane lai Ahiva AllAhara ocarata vizuddha antaHkaraNa’|
Aru (seidinA) muttAkvIsakalara vAve nikaTaৱrtI karA ha’va jAnnAta,
Aru pathabhraSTasakalara vAve unmocita karA ha’va jAhAnnAma;
siha~taka koৱA ha’va, ‘tomAlokara seivora upAsya (Aji) ka’ta, yivorara tomAloke upAsanA karichilA--
AllAhara parivarte? siha~te tomAlokaka sahAYa karivane athavA siha~te AtmarakSA karivalai sakSamane?
tAra pichata sei upAsyavoraka Aru pathabhraSTavilAkaka talamUra kari jAhAnnAmata nikSepa karA ha’va,
lagate ivalIchara sainyavAhinIvilAkako|
siha~te tAta vitarkata lipta hai ka’va,
‘AllAhara zapata! nizcaYa Ami spaSTa pathabhraSTatAta Achilo~,
‘yetiYA Ami tomAlokaka vizvajagatara pratipAlakara samakakSa vuli gaNya karichilo~;
‘Aru AmAka keৱla aparAdhIvilAkei pathabhraSTa karichila,
‘eteke AmAra kono cupArichakArI nAi’|
‘Aru kono antaraGga vandhuo nAi|
‘hAYa, yadi Ami Akau evAra ubhati yoৱAra suyoga pAlo~he~tena, tente Ami muminasakalara antarbhukta hai ga’lo~he~tena!’
nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei mumina nahaYa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nUha sampradAYeo rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karichila|
yetiYA siha~tara bhAtR nUhe siha~taka kaichila, ‘tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne’?
‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve ejana vizvasta rAchula|
‘eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru mora anusaraNa karA|
‘Aru mai tomAlokara ocarata iYAra vAve kono pratidAna nivicAro~; mora pratidAna keৱla vizvajagatara rava (AllAha)ra ocarata|
‘eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru mora anusaraNa karA|
siha~te ka’le, ‘Ami tomAra prati ImAna Anima neki, athaca tomAka keৱla nimnazreNIra lokehe anusaraNa kariche’?
nUhe ka’le, ‘siha~te ki kare sei viSaYe janATo mora ki praYojana?
‘siha~tara hicApa loৱATo haiche mora pratipAlakara kAma; yadi tomAloke vuji pAlAhe~tena!
‘Aru muminasakalaka khedi paThioৱAToo mora kAma nahaYa|
‘maihe keৱla ejana spaSTa satarkakArI’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘he nUha! yadi tumi virata nohoৱA tente nizcaYa tomAka zila daliYAi mRtyudaNDa pradAna karA ha’va’|
nUhe (prArthanA kari) ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa mora sampradAYe moka asvIkAra kariche’|
‘seYe tumi mora Aru siha~tara mAjata spaSTarUpe mImAMsA kari diYA, lagate moka Aru mora lagata thakA muminasakalaka rakSA karA’|
phalata Ami teOMka Aru teOMra lagata yisakala Achila sakaloke vojAi nAৱta ArohaNa karAi rakSA karilo~|
tAra pichata vAkI thakAsakalaka DuvAi mArilo~|
nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei mumina nahaYa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Ada sampradAYeo rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karichila,
yetiYA siha~tara bhAtR hUde siha~taka kaichila, ‘tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne?
‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve ejana vizvasta rAchula|
‘eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru moka anusaraNa karA|
‘Aru mai tomAlokara ocarata iYAra vAve kono pratidAna nivicAro~; mora pratidAna Ache keৱla sRSTijagatara rava (AllAha)ra ocarata|
‘tomAloke kiYa pratiTo ucca sthAnata ayathA saudha nirmANa karA?
‘Aru tomAloke enekai prAsAdasamUha nirmANa kari AchA, yenivA tomAloke (pRthiৱIta) cirasthAYI ha’vA|
‘Aru yetiYA tomAloke AghAta karA tetiYA svecchAcArI hai AghAta karA|
‘eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru moka anusaraNa karA|
‘Aru tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA sei sattvAra yijane tomAlokaka dAna kariche sei sakalo viSaYa, yivora tomAloke jAnA|
‘teৱe~i tomAlokaka dAna kariche catuSpada jantu Aru putra santAna,
‘udyAna Aru jharNAsamUha,
‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara oparata eTA mahA diৱsara zAstira AzaMkA kari Acho~’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi AmAka upadeza diYA vA nidiYA, ubhaYe AmAra vAve samAna|
‘eiTo pUrvaৱrtIsakalara rItinItihe mAtra|
‘Ami ketiYAo zAstiprApta nahaOM’|
eteke siha~te teOMka asvIkAra karile, phalata Ami siha~taka dhvaMsa karilo~| nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei mumina nahaYa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
chAmUda sampradAYeo rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karichila,
yetiYA siha~tara bhAtR chalehe siha~taka kaichila, ‘tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne?
‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve ejana vizvasta rAchula|
‘eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru mora anusaraNa karA|
‘Aru mai tomAlokara ocarata iYAra vAve kono pratidAna nivicAro~; mora pratidAna Ache keৱla vizvAjagatara rava (AllAha)ra ocarata|
‘ei pArthiৱ bhoga-vilAsara mAjata tomAlokaka nirApade eri diYA ha’vane?
‘udyAna Aru jharNAsamUhara mAjata,
‘zasyakSetrata Aru sukomala jokA viziSTa khejura vAgAnata?
‘Aru tomAloke nipuNatAra saite pAhAra kATi yivora gRha nirmANa karichA (seivorara mAjata)|
‘eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru mora anusaraNa karA|
‘Aru tomAloke sImAlaMghanakArIsakalara nirdezara Anugatya nakarivA,
‘yisakale pRthiৱIta viparyaYa sRSTi kare Aru saMzodhana (tathA zAnti sthApana) nakare’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi haichA yAdugrastavilAkara anyatama|
‘tumi dekhona AmAra darei ejana mAnuha, seYe tumi yadi satyavAdI hoৱA tente eTA nidarzana lai AhA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘eijanI haiche (nidarzanIYa) uTa, iYAra vAve Ache pAnI khoৱAra pAla, Aru tomAlokara vAveo Ache eTA nirdhArita dinata pAnI khoৱAra pAla|
‘Aru tomAloke iYAra kono aniSTa sAdhana nakarivA, yadi (aniSTa sAdhana) karA tente mahA diৱsara zAsti tomAlokara oparata Apatita ha’va’|
tathApio siha~te sei uTajanIka vadha karile, pariNAmata siha~ta anutapta ha’la|
phalata zAstiYe siha~taka grAsa karile| nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei mumina nahaYa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
lUta sampradAYeo rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karichila,
yetiYA siha~tara bhAtR lUte kaichila, ‘tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne?
‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve ejana vizvasta rAchula|
‘eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru mora anusaraNa karA|
‘Aru mai tomAlokara ocarata iYAra vAve kono pratidAna nivicAro~; mora pratidAna Ache keৱla vizvajagatara rava (AllAha)ra ocarata|
‘sRSTijagatara mAjata (nArIsakalaka eri) tomAloke keৱla puruSasakalara ocaratei upagata hoৱA neki?
‘Aru tomAlokara pratipAlake tomAlokara vAve yi strIsakalaka sRSTi kariche siha~taka tomAloke varjana kari AchA? varaM tomAloka haichA eTA sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘he lUta! tumi yadi virata nohoৱA, tente nizcaYa tumi vahiSkAra ha’vA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara ei kukarmaka ghRNA karo~|
(teOM prArthanA kari ka’le,) ‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka Aru mora pariYAlaka siha~tara ei kukarmara parA rakSA karA’|
phalata Ami teOMka Aru teOMra pariYAlavargaka rakSA karilo~|
keৱla sei vRddhAjanIra vAhire, yijanI Achila pichata aৱsthAৱkArI vilAkara antarbhukta|
tAra pichata Ami vAkIvilAkaka dhvaMsa karilo~|
Aru Ami siha~tara oparata zAstimUlaka zilAvRSTi varSaNa karilo~| eteke yisakalaka satarka karA haichila siha~tara vAve ei vRSTi kimAna ye nikRSTa Achila!
nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei mumina nahaYa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
AikAra adhivAsIsakaleo rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karichila,
yetiYA zvuAive siha~taka kaichila, ‘tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne’?
‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve ejana vizvasta rAchula|
‘eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru mora anusaraNa karA|
‘Aru mai tomAlokara ocarata iYAra vAve kono pratidAna nivicAro~; mora pratidAna Ache keৱla vizvajagatara rava (AllAha)ra ocarata|
‘tomAloke ojana karo~te paripUrNarUpe ojana karivA, yivilAke ojanata kama diYe tomAloke siha~tara antarbhukta naha’vA|
‘Aru ojana karivA saThika tulAcanIta|
‘Aru mAnuhaka siha~tara prApya vastu kama nidivA Aru pRthiৱIta viparyaYa sRSTi kari nuphurivA|
‘Aru sei sattvAra tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA yijane tomAlokaka Aru tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakalaka sRSTi kariche’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi haichA yAdugrastasakalara anyatama|
‘tumi dekhona AmAra darei ejana mAnuha, Aru Ami tomAka michalIYAvilAkara antarbhukta vuli bhAvo~|
‘eteke tumi yadi satyavAdI hoৱA, tente AkAzara eTA TukurA AmAra oparata pelAi diYAcona’|
teOM ka’le, ‘mora pratipAlakei bhAladare jAne tomAloke yi karA’|
eteke siha~te teOMka asvIkAra karile| phalata siha~taka meghAcchanna dinara zAstiYe grAsa karile| nizcaYa eYA Achila eTA bhISaNa dinara zAsti|
nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei mumina nahaYa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teৱe~i mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa eikhana (koraAna) vizvajagatara pratipAlaka (AllAha)ra taraphara parA aৱtIrNa|
vizvasta rUhe (jIvrIle) eikhana lai aৱtaraNa kariche|
tomAra hRdaYata, yAte tumi satarkakArIsakalara antarbhukta hoৱA|
suspaSTa AravI bhASAta (aৱtIrNa karA haiche)|
Aru nizcaYa pUrvaৱrtI kitAvasamUhato iYAra viSaYe ullekha Ache|
eikhana siha~tara vAve eTA nidarzana nahaYane vAru ye, vanI icharAIlara Alimasakaleo ei viSaYe jAne?
Aru yadi Ami iYAka kono anAravara prati aৱtIrNa karilo~he~tena;
Aru seikhanaka teOM siha~tara sanmukhata pATha karile tathApio siha~te iYAra prati ImAna poSaNa nakarilehe~tena|
eidarei Ami viSaYaTo aparAdhIsakalara antarata saJcAra karicho~|
siha~te yantraNAdAYaka zAsti nedekhAlaike iYAra oparata ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
eteke sei (zAsti)To siha~tara ocaralai AkasmikabhAৱe Ahi pariva, athaca siha~te ekoৱe upalavdhi kariva noৱAriva|
tetiYA siha~te ka’va, ‘AmAka alapa aৱkAza diYA ha’vane’?
tathApio siha~te AmAra zAstika tvarAnvita kariva vicAre neki?
tumi bhAvi coৱAcona! yadi Ami siha~taka dIrghakAla bhoga-vilAsa karivalai diOM,
tAra pichata siha~taka yi viSaYe satarka karA haichila, sei zAstiTo siha~tara ocaralai Ahi pare,
siha~taka yivora bhoga-vilAsara upakaraNa hicApe diYA haichila, seivora tetiYA siha~tara kono upakArata Ahivane?
Aru Ami ene kono janapada dhvaMsa karA nAi, yAra vAve kono satarkakArI nAchila,
(siha~tara vAve) smaraNa hicApe; Aru Ami anyAYakArI nahaYa|
Aru caYatAnavilAke eikhana lai aৱtaraNa karA nAi|
Aru siha~ta ei kAmara yogyao nahaYa, lagate ei kAmara sAmarthao siha~tara nAi|
nizcaYa siha~taka zraৱNa karAra parAo A~tarata rakhA haiche|
eteke tumi AllAhara lagata Ana kono ilAhaka AhvAna nakarivA, anyathA tumi zAstiprAptavilAkara antarbhukta ha’vA|
Aru tumi tomAra nikaTAtmIYasakalaka satarka karA|
Aru muminasakalara mAjara yisakale tomAra anusaraNa kare, teOMlokara prati tomAra vAhu aৱnata karA|
eteke teOMloke yadi tomAra avAdhyatA kare, tente koৱA, ‘tomAloke yi karA, nizcaYa tAra vAve mai dAYI nahaYa’|
Aru tumi nirbhara karA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu (AllAha)ra oparata,
yijane tomAka dekhe yetiYA tumi (chAlAtara vAve) thiYa hoৱA,
Aru (teৱe~i) chAjadAkArIsakalara mAjata tomAra gatividhi (lakSya kare)|
nizcaYa teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
mai tomAlokaka saMvAda dimane, kAra oparata caYatAna aৱtIrNa haYa?
siha~ta aৱtIrNa haYa pratyeka carama michalIYA Aru pApISTha vyaktira oparata|
siha~te kANa pAti thAke Aru siha~tara adhikAMzai haiche michalIYA|
Aru kavisakala, siha~tara anusaraNa keৱla vibhrAntavilAkehe kare|
tumi lakSya karA nAine ye, siha~ta udbhrAnta hai pratyeka upatyakAta ghUri phure?
Aru siha~te enekuৱA kathA kaYa, yiTo siha~te (nijei) nakare|

kintu teOMlokara vAhire yisakale ImAna Aniche, satkarma kariche, Aru AllAhaka vechi vechi smaraNa kare Aru atyAcArita hoৱAra pichata pratizodha grahaNa kariche| yAlimasakale zIghrei jAnivalai pAva ye, kona dharaNara gantavyasthalata siha~te pratyAৱrtana kariva|
tvA-chIna;[1] eivora haiche Ala-koraAna tathA suspaSTa kitAvara AYAta;
pathanirdeza Aru susaMvAda muminasakalara vAve,
yisakale chAlAta kAYema kare Aru yAkAta pradAna kare Aru teOMlokei AkhirAtara prati nizcita vizvAsa sthApana kare|
nizcaYa yisakale AkhirAtara prati vizvAsa sthApana nakare, siha~tara vAve siha~tara karmaka Ami zobhanIYa kari dicho~, phalata siha~ta vibhrAnta hai ghUri phure;
iha~tara vAvei Ache nikRSTa zAsti Aru iha~tei ha’va AkhirAtata sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
Aru nizcaYa tumi prajJAmaYa sarvajJa (AllAha)ra taraphara parA Ala-koraAna prApta haichA|

smaraNa karA, yetiYA muchAi teOMra pariYAlavargaka kaichila, ‘nizcaYa mai jui dekhicho~, anatipalame mai tAra parA tomAlokara vAve kono saMvAda lai Ahima nAivA tomAlokara vAve lai Ahima jvalanta andharA, yAte tomAloke jui pu~ৱAva pArA’|

tAra pichata teOM yetiYA seiTora ocarata Ahi pAle, tetiYA ghoSita ha’la, ‘varakatamaYa, yi Ache ei juira mAjata Aru yi Ache iYAra cAriophAle, Aru vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAha paৱitra Aru mahimAmaYa!
‘he muchA! nizcaYa maYei AllAha! parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

‘Aru tumi tomAra lAkhuTiDAla nikSepa karA’| tAra pichata yetiYA teOM sei lAkhuTiDAlaka sApara dare keramera karA dekhA pAle tetiYA teOM picha ho~hakA di lara mArile Aru ubhati coৱA nAchila| (AllAhe ka’le) ‘he muchA! bhaYa nakarivA, nizcaYa mora ocarata rAchulasakale bhaYa nApAYa;
‘kintu anyAYakArIsakalara vAhire| tAra pichata veYA kAmara parivarte yadi satkarma kare tente nizcaYa mai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

‘Aru tumi tomAra hAtakhana kASalatita praৱeza karoৱA, cAvA seikhana truTimukta zubhra-ujjvala hai olAi Ahiva| eiTo phiraAuna Aru tAra sampradAYara ocaralai ahA naTA nidarzanara antarbhukta| nizcaYa siha~ta Achila phAchikva sampradAYa’|
tAra pichata yetiYA AmAra nidarzanasamUha siha~tara ocarata dRzyamAna ha’la, siha~te ka’le, ‘eiTo suspaSTa yAdu’|

siha~te anyAYa Aru uddhatabhAৱe nidarzanasamUha pratyAkhyAna karile, yadio siha~tara antare eivoraka nizcita satya vuli grahaNa karichila| eteke coৱA, viparyaYa sRSTikArIvilAkara pariNAma kenekuৱA Achila!

Aru nizcaYa Ami dAuda Aru chulAimAnaka jJAna dAna karichilo~ Aru teOMloke ubhaYe kaichila, ‘sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAhara vAve yijane AmAka teOMra vahuto mumina vAndAsakalara oparata zreSThatva pradAna kariche’|
Aru chulAimAna Achila dAudara uttarAdhikArI Aru teOM kaichila, ‘he mAnaৱjAti! AmAka carAi-cirikaTira bhASA zikSA diYA haiche Aru AmAka sakalo vastu dAna karA haiche, nizcaYa eYA suspaSTa anugraha’|
Aru chulAimAnara sanmukhata teOMra goTei senAvAhinIka samaveta karA ha’la, jina, mAnaৱ Aru carAi-cirikaTivoraka| tAra pichata siha~taka vinyasta karA ha’la vibhinna vyUhata|

aৱzeSata yetiYA teOMloka (eTA abhiyAnata) paruৱA adhyUSita upatyakAta upanIta ha’la tetiYA eTA paruৱAi ka’le, ‘he paruৱA vAhinI! tomAloke nija nija gharata praৱeza karA, yAte chulAimAna Aru teOMra sainyavAhinIYe ajAnite tomAlokaka gacaki nAmAre’|

ei kathA zuni chulAimAne micikiYA hA~hile Aru ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi moka sAmartha diYA yAte mai tomAra kRtajJatA jJApana kariva pAro~, mora prati Aru mora pitR-mAtRra prati tumi yi anugraha karichA tAra vAve, lagate mai yAte enekuৱA satkarma kariva pAro~ yiToka tumi pachanda karA| lagate tomAra anugrahere moka tomAra satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAsakalara antarbhukta karA’|
Aru teOM (chulAimAne) carAivorara khA-khavara la’le, Aru ka’le, ‘ki ha’la, mai hudahudaka dekhA poৱA nAi ye? si anupasthita neki?
‘nizcaYa tAka mai kaThina zAsti vihima, naha’le javeha karima, anyathA mora ocaralai upayukta kAraNa darzAva lAgiva’|
kSanteka pichatei hudahuda Ahi pAle, Aru ka’le, ‘Apuni yiTo jJAna AYatva kariva parA nAi mai sei jJAna AYatva karicho~| mai AponAra vAve ‘cAvA’ra parA sunizcita saMvAda lai Ahicho~|
‘mai egarAkI nArIka siha~tara oparata rAjatva karA dekhi Ahilo~| tAika sakalo vastu pradAna karA haiche lagate tAira ekhana vizAla siMhAsano Ache|

mai tAika Aru tAira sampradAYaka dekhilo~ siha~te AllAhara parivarte sUryaka chAjadAha kare| caYatAne siha~tara kAryaৱlI siha~tara ocarata suzobhita kari diche Aru siha~taka satpathara parA vAdhAgrasta kariche, phalata siha~te hidAYata poৱA nAi;

(caYatAne ei kAraNe vAdhA diche ye,) yAte siha~te AllAhaka chAjadAha nakare, yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra gupta vastuvoraka prakAza kare, Aru teৱe~i jAne yi tomAloke gopana karA Aru yi tomAloke prakAza karA|
AllAhara vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, teৱe~i mahA Arachara pratipAlaka|
chulAimAne ka’le, ‘Ami parIkSA kari cAma, tumi sa~cAi kaichA ne tumi michalIYAvilAkara antarbhukta|
‘tumi mora ei patrakhana lai yoৱA Aru eikhana siha~tara ocarata pelAi diYAgai, tAra pichata siha~tara parA A~tarata thAkivA Aru lakSya karivA siha~tara pratikriYA ki’?
sei mahilA (rANI) garAkIYe ka’le, ‘he mora pariSadavarga! nizcaYa molai ekhana sanmAnita patra preraNa karA haiche;
nizcaYa eikhana chulAimAnara taraphara parA (prerita), Aru (ya'ta likhA Ache, Arambha karicho~) parama karuNAmaYa, parama daYAlu AllAhara nAmata,
‘yAte tomAloke ahaMkAra kari mora virodhitA nakarA, lagate AtmasamarpaNa kari (muchalima hai) mora ocaralai upasthita hoৱA’|
rANIYe ka’le, ‘he pariSadavarga! tomAloke mora ei viSaYata abhimata diYA| tomAlokara anupasthitita mai kono cUDa়Anta siddhAnta grahaNa nakaro~’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘Ami dekhona zaktizAlI Aru kaThora yuddhA, kintu siddhAnta grahaNa karAra adhikAra keৱla AponArahe Ache; eteke cintA kari cAoka, ki nirdeza kariva’|
rANIYe ka’le, ‘rajAsakale yetiYA kono janapadata (vijaYIrUpe) praৱeza kare tetiYA tAka viparyasta kari diYe Aru tAta thakA maryAdAzIla vyaktisakalaka apadastha kare, Aru eiToৱe haiche siha~tara rIti;
‘Aru nizcaYa mai siha~tara ocaralai upaDhaukana preraNa karima, cAOM, kaTakIYe ki saMvAda lai ubhati Ahe’|

eteke yetiYA kaTakI Ahi chulAimAnara ocarata upasthita ha'la, tetiYA teOM uttarata ka’le, ‘tomAloke moka dhana-sampada pradAna kari sahAYa kariva vicArichA neki? (zunA) AllAhe moka yi dAna kariche seYA tomAlokaka yi diche tAtakaio utkRSTa varaM tomAlokei tomAlokara upaDhaukana lai Ananda karAgai|

‘siha~tara ocaralai ubhati yoৱA, (Aru zunA) nizcaYa Ami siha~tara ocaralai enekuৱA sainyavAhinI lai Ahima yAra mukAvilA karAra zakti siha~tara nAi, lagate siha~taka Ami aৱzye tAra parA lAJchita kari vahiSkAra karima Aru siha~ta ha’va apamAnita’|
(chulAimAne teOMra pariSadavargaka uddezya kari) ka’le, ‘he pariSadavarga! siha~ta mora ocaralai AtmasamarpaNa kari ahAra pUrvei tomAlokara mAjara kone moka tAira siMhAsana Ani diva pArivA’?
ejana zaktizAlI jine ka’le, ‘Apuni AponAra sthAnara parA uThAra pUrvei mai seikhana lai upasthita hama Aru ei viSaYe nizcaYa mai zaktimAna, vizvasta’|

yAra ocarata granthara jJAna Achila teOM ka’le, ‘mai cakura palakate seikhana AponAra ocaralai Ani diva pArima’| eteke chulAimAne yetiYA seikhana nijara sanmukhata sthira aৱsthAta dekhA pAle tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘eYA haiche mora pratipAlakara anugraha, yAte teOM moka parIkSA kare ye, mai teOMra kRtajJatA prakAza karo~ ne akRtajJatA prakAza karo~| eteke yiYe kRtajJatA prakAza kare si nijara kalyANara vAvei kRtajJatA prakAza kare, Aru yiYe akRtajJa haYa, si jAni thoৱA ucita ye, nizcaYa mora pratipAlaka abhAৱ mukta, mahAnubhaৱ’|
chulAimAne ka’le, ‘tomAloke tAira siMhAsanara AkAra-AkRti parivartana kari diYA, cAOM, tAi saThikabhAৱe ciniva pAre ne siha~tara antarbhukta haYa yiha~te kono diha nApAYa’|

eteke yetiYA tAi Ahila, tetiYA tAika koৱA ha’la, ‘tomAra siMhAsanakhana enekuৱAi neki’? tAi ka’le, ‘seikhanei yena lAgiche, Aru AmAka iYAra pUrvei prakRta jJAna dAna karA haiche Aru Ami AjJAvaha haicho~’|
AllAhara parivarte tAi yAra pUjA pATha karichila seiToৱei tAika ImAnara parA nivRtta karichila| nizcaYa tAi Achila kAphira sampradAYara antarbhukta|

tAika koৱA ha’la, ‘prAsAdaTora bhitarata praৱeza karA’| eteke yetiYA tAi seikhana dekhile, tetiYA tAi seikhanaka jalAzaYa vuli bhAvile Aru duYo bharira kApora kalAphulilaike anAvRta karile| teOM (chulAimAne) ka’le, ‘eikhana kAcere nirmita svaccha prAsAdahe’| mahilA garAkIYe (prArthanA kari) ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa mai nijara prati anyAYa karichilo~, Aru etiYA mai chulAimAnara lagata vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAhara ocarata AtmasamarpaNa karilo~’|

Aru nizcaYa Ami chAmUda sampradAYara ocaralai siha~tara bhAtR chalehaka preraNa karichilo~ ei Adeza pradAna kari ye, ‘tomAloke AllAhara ivAdata karA’| tAra pichata siha~te dui dalata vibhakta hai vitarkata lipta haichila|
teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke kiYa kalyANara Agate akalyANa tvarAnvita kariva vicarA, tomAloke AllAhara ocarata kSamA prArthanA kiYa nakarA, yAte tomAloke rahamata prApta ha’va pArA’?

siha~te kaichila, ‘Ami tomAka Aru tomAra saGgIsakalaka amaGgalara kAraNa vuli bhAvo~’| chalehe (uttarata) kaichila, ‘tomAlokara amaGgala grahaNa karATo haiche AllAhara ikhatiYArata, prakRtate tomAloka enekuৱA eTA sampradAYa yisakalaka parIkSA karA haiche’|
Aru sei caharata Achila enekuৱA najana vyakti, yisakale dezata viparyaYa sRSTi karichila Aru saMzodhana karA nAchila|

siha~te ka’le, ‘tomAloke paraspare AllAhara zapata grahaNa karA, Ami rAtira bhitarate zeSa kari dima teOMka Aru teOMra pariYAlavargaka; tAra pichata teOMra abhibhAৱkaka nizcitarUpe kama ye, teOMra pariYAlavargara hatyA Ami pratyakSa karA nAchilo~, Aru nizcaYa Ami satyavAdI’|
Aru siha~te eTA cakrAnta karichila Aru Amio eTA kauzala aৱlamvana karichilo~, athaca siha~te upalavdhio kariva parA nAchila|
eteke coৱA, siha~tara cakrAntara pariNAma kenekuৱA Achila, nizcaYa Ami siha~taka Aru siha~tara sampradAYara sakaloke dhvaMsa karicho~|
coৱA, eivora haiche siha~tara ghara-duৱAra, anyAYa karAra kAraNe eivora janazUnya hai Ache; nizcaYa iYAta nidarzana Ache sei sampradAYara vAve yisakale jJAna rAkhe|
Aru yisakale ImAna Anichila teOMlokaka Ami uddhAra karichilo~ Aru teOMloka Achila tAkvaৱA aৱlamvanakArI|
Aru smaraNa karA lUtara kathA, teOM nija sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘tomAloke jAni-vuji kiYa azlIla kAma karA?
‘tomAloke kAmatRptira vAve nArIsakalaka eri puruSara ocaralai upagata hoৱAne! prakRtate tomAloka haichA eTA ajJa sampradAYa’|
uttarata teOMra sampradAYe ka’le, ‘lUta pariYAlaka tomAloke janapadara parA vahiSkAra kari diYA, nizcaYa eOMloke paৱitra thAkiva vicAre’|
tAra pichata Ami teOMka Aru teOMra pariYAlavargaka uddhAra karilo~, keৱla teOMra strIra vAhire, Ami tAika aৱziSTavilAkara antarbhukta karichilo~|
Aru Ami siha~tara oparata zAstimUlaka zilAvRSTi varSaNa karichilo~| eteke yisakalaka satarka karA haichila siha~tara vAve ei vRSTi kimAna ye nikRSTa Achila!
koৱA, ‘sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAhara vAvei, Aru zAnti keৱla teOMra manonIta vAndAsakalara prati! (tente koৱAcona!) kona zreSTha, AllAha ne seivora, yivoraka siha~te yi aMzI kare’?

varaM teOMhe (zreSTha), yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche lagate teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa kare| tAra pichata tAra dvArA Ami manorama udyAna sRSTi karo~, sei udyAnavorara gacha utpanna karAra kSamatA tomAlokara nAi| (tente koৱAcona) AllAhara lagata Ana kono ilAha Achene? varaM siha~ta enekuৱA eTA sampradAYa yisakale (AllAhara) samakakSa nirdhAraNa kare|

varaM teOMhe (zreSTha), yijane pRthiৱIka vAsopayogI kariche Aru iYAra mAje mAje nada-nadI pravAhita kariche, Aru iYAta sthApana kariche sudRDha় parvatamAlA, lagate dui sAgarara mAjata sRSTi kariche antarAYa, (tente koৱAcona) AllAhara lagata Ana kono ilAha Achene? varaM siha~tara adhikAMzai nAjAne|

varaM teOMhe (zreSTha), yijane nirupAYa vyaktira AhvAnata sa~hAri diYe yetiYA si teOMka AhvAna kare Aru teৱe~i vipada-Apada dUrIbhUta kare, lagate teৱe~i tomAlokaka pRthiৱIra pratinidhi vanAYa| (tente koৱAcona) AllAhara lagata Ana kono ilAha Achene? varaM tomAloke khuvei kama upadeza grahaNa karA|

varaM teOMhe (zreSTha), yijane tomAlokaka sthalata Aru sAgarara andhakArata patha dekhuৱAYa Aru teৱe~i nija anugrahara pUrve susaMvAdavAhI vatAha preraNa kare| (tente koৱAcona) AllAhara lagata Ana konovA ilAha Achene? siha~te yivoraka aMzIdAra sthApana kare, AllAha seivorara parA vahu urddhata|

varaM teOMhe (zreSTha), yijane prathame sRSTira sUcanA kariche, tAra pichata teৱe~i iYAra punarAvRtti kariva Aru teৱe~i AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra parA tomAlokaka jIৱnopakaraNa dAna kare| (tente koৱAcona) AllAhara lagata Ana konovA ilAha Achene? koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA tente tomAlokara pramANa lai AhA’|
koৱA, ‘AllAhara vAhire AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra kAro ocaratei gAYevara jJAna nAi| Anaki siha~te (ei kathAo) upalavdhi kariva noৱAre ye siha~taka ketiYA utthita karA ha’va’|
varaM AkhirAta samparke siha~tara jJAna niHzeSa haiche; Aru sei viSaYe siha~te sandehata lipta haiche, tathA ei viSaYata siha~ta haiche andha|
Aru kAphirasakale kaYa, ‘Ami Aru AmAra pitR-puruSasakala yetiYA mATita pariNata hama, tAra pichato AmAka Akau uliYAi AnA ha’va neki?
‘nizcaYa ei viSaYe AmAka Aru iYAra pUrve AmAra pitR-puruSasakaloko pratizruti diYA haichila| eiTo pUrvaৱrtIvilAkara upakathAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke pRthiৱIta paribhramaNa karA, tAra pichata coৱA, aparAdhIvilAkara pariNAma kenekuৱA Achila’|
tumi siha~tara vAve dukha nakarivA Aru siha~tara SaDa়yantrato manaHkSuNNao naha’vA|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘tomAloke yadi satyavAdI hoৱA tente koৱA, ketiYA ei pratizruti vAstaৱAYita ha’va’?
koৱA, ‘tomAloke yiTo viSaYaka tvarAnvita kariva vicArichA, sambhaৱtaH tAre kichu (aMza) tomAlokara piche piche AhiYe pAiche!’
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka mAnuhara prati anugrahazIla; kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai haiche akRtajJa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka, teOM aৱzye jAne siha~tara antare yi gopana kare Aru siha~te yi prakAza kare|
AkAza Aru pRthiৱIta ene kono gopana rahasya nAi, yiTo suspaSTa kitAvata (lipivaddha) nAi|
vanI icharAIle yivora viSaYakalai vitarka karichila, nizcaYa ei koraAne tAre adhikAMza viSaYa siha~tara ocarata viৱraNa diYe|
Aru nizcaYa eikhana haiche muminasakalara vAve hidAYata Aru rahamata|
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlake teOMra vidhAna anuyAYI siha~tara mAjata phaYacAlA kari diva; Aru teOM mahAparAkramazAlI, sarvajJa|
eteke AllAhara oparata nirbhara karA; nizcaYa tumi suspaSTa satyara oparata pratiSThita AchA|
nizcaYa tumi mRtaka zunAva noৱArivA, Aru vadhirako AhvAna zunAva noৱArivA, yetiYA siha~te piThi dekhuৱAi ubhati yAYa|

tumi andhavilAkako siha~tara pathabhraSTatAra parA saThika pathalai Aniva noৱArivA| tumi keৱla teOMlokakahe zunAva pArivA yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhara prati ImAna poSaNa kare, eteke teOMlokei haiche AtmasamarpaNakArI|

Aru yetiYA siha~tara oparata ghoSita zAsti Ahi pariva tetiYA Ami siha~tara vAve pRthiৱIra parA eTA jantu uliYAma (dA-vvAtula Ardva), yiTo siha~tara lagata kathA ka'va ye, mAnuhe AmAra nidarzanasamUhara prati nizcita vizvAsa karA nAchila|

Aru (smaraNa karA sei dinaTora kathA,) yidinA Ami samaveta karima pratyeka sampradAYara parA eko ekoTA dala, yisakale AmAra nidarzanAৱlI pratyAkhyAna karichila| tAra pichata siha~taka zArIvaddhabhAৱe ekatrita karA ha'va|

aৱzeSata yetiYA siha~ta Ahi yAva, tetiYA AllAhe siha~taka ka’va, ‘tomAloke mora AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichilA neki, athaca sei viSaYe tomAlokara kono jJAnei nAchila, ne tomAloke Aru kivA karichilA?
gatike anyAYa karAra kAraNe siha~tara oparata ghoSita zAsti Ahi pariva; phalata siha~te kathAo ka’va noৱAriva|

siha~te dekhA nAine ye, AmiYei siha~tara vAve rAti sRSTi karicho~, yAte siha~te vizrAma lava pAre Aru dinaka karicho~ dRzyamAna? nizcaYa iYAta nidarzana Ache ene sampradAYara vAve yisakale ImAna poSaNa kare|

Aru yidinA ziGAta phu~ diYA ha’va, seidinA AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sakaloৱe bhIta-vihvala hai pariva, kintu AllAhe yisakalaka (iYAra parA virata rAkhivalai) icchA kariva teOMlokara vAhire, Aru sakaloৱe teOMra ocarata (lAJchita tathA) hIna aৱsthAta upasthita ha’va|

Aru tumi yivora pAhAra-parvataka dekhi acala bhAvi AchA, athaca (seidinA) eivora meghapuJjara dare calamAna ha’va| eiTo AllAharei sRSTi-naipuNya, yijane sakalo vastukei kariche suSama| tomAloke yi karA nizcaYa teOM sei samparke samyaka aৱhita|
yiYe satkarma lai Ahiva teOM tAtakaio utkRSTa pratiphala pAva Aru seidinA teOMloka bhItikara aৱsthAra parA nirApada thAkiva|
AnahAte yiYe asatkarma lai Ahiva, tAka adhomukhe juita nikSepa karA ha’va| (lagate siha~taka koৱA ha’va) tomAloke yi karichilA tArei pratiphala tomAlokaka diYA haiche|

moka nirdeza karA haiche ei nagarara pratipAlakara ivAdata karivalai, yijane iYAka sanmAnita kariche| sakalo vastu teOMrei| moka Aru Adeza karA haiche, mai yena AtmasamarpanakArIsakalara antarbhukta haOM|

moka Aru nirdeza diYA haiche, koraAna tilAৱta karivalai| eteke yiYe satpatha aৱlamvana kare si nijara kalyANara vAvei satpatha aৱlamvana kare, Aru yiYe bhula patha aৱlamvana kare, tente tumi koৱA, ‘mai haicho~ keৱla ejana satarkakArI’|

Aru koৱA, ‘sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAharei, acirei teOM tomAlokaka teOMra nidarzanasamUha dekhuৱAva, tetiYA tomAloke seYA ciniva pArivA’| tomAloke yi karA sei samparke tomAra pratipAlaka amanoyogI nahaYa|
tva-chIma-mIma|[1]
eivora haiche suspaSTa kitAvara AYAta|
Ami tomAra ocarata muchA Aru phiraAunara kichu vRttAnta yathAyathabhAৱe vivRta karicho~, ene sampradAYara vAve yisakale ImAna poSaNa kare|

nizcaYa phiraAuna pRthiৱIra vukuta ahaMkArI haichila, Aru sei ThAira adhivAsIvilAkaka vibhinna zreNIta vibhakta kari siha~tara eTA zreNIka si durvala kari rAkhichila; siha~tara putrasakalaka hatyA karichila Aru nArIsakalaka jIৱita eri dichila| nizcaYa si Achila viparyaYa sRSTikArI|
Aru sei dezata yisakalaka durvala kari rakhA haichila Ami sei mAnuhavilAkara oparata anugraha kariva vicArilo~ lagate teOMlokaka netRtva dAna karivalai Aru uttarAdhikArI vanAvalai icchA karilo~;

Aru pRthiৱIta teOMlokaka kSamatAta adhiSThita karivalai vicArilo~, lagate phiraAuna, hAmAna Aru siha~tara sainyavAhinIka seiTo dekhuৱAvalai icchA karilo~, yiTo siha~te sei durvala dalara parA AzaMkA karichila|

Aru Ami muchAra mAtRra prati nirdeza dilo~ ye, tAka piYAha khuoৱA; yetiYA tumi iYAra viSaYe kono AzaMkA karivA, tetiYA iYAka sAgarata nikSepa karivA Aru bhaYa nakarivA lagate cintitao naha’vA| nizcaYa Ami iYAka tomAra ocaralai ghUrAi Anima Aru iYAka rAchulasakalara antarbhukta karima|
tAra pichata phiraAunara pariYAle tAka (sAgarara parA) tuli la'le| pariNAmata teৱe~i siha~tara zatru Aru dukhara kAraNa ha’la| nizcaYa phiraAuna, hAmAna Aru siha~tara sainya vAhinI Achila aparAdhI|

phiraAunara strIYe ka’le, ‘ei zizuTi mora Aru tomAra naYana-prItikara| iYAka hatyA nakarivA| i AmAra upakArata Ahiva pAre athavA Ami iYAka santAna hicApeo grahaNa kariva pAro~’| darAcalate siha~te iYAra pariNAma upalavdhi kariva parA nAchila|

Aru ipine muchAra mAtRra hRdaYa asthira hai parichila| teOM iYAra paricaYa prakAza kariYei dilehe~tena, yadi Ami teOMra antaraka sudRDha় kari nidilo~he~tena, yAte teOM AsthAzIlasakalara antarbhukta haYa|
Aru muchAra vAYekaka ka'le, iYAra piche piche yoৱA| teOM dUrara parAi iYAka dekhi Achila kintu siha~te (zatruvilAke) seYA upalavdhi kariva parA nAchila|

Aru Ami pUrvare parA teOMra vAve dhAtrI-stanya pAna niSiddha kari dichilo~| tAra pichata muchAra vAYeke ka’le, ‘mai tomAlokaka enekuৱA eTA pariYAlara sandhAna dimane, yiYe tomAlokara hai iYAka lAlana-pAlana kariva Aru iYAra maGgalakAmI ha’va’?

tAra pichata Ami teOMka obhatAi dilo~ teOMra mAtRra ocaralai, yAte teOMra caku jura yAYa Aru cintita nahaYa, Aru yAte eiTo jAni laYa ye, AllAhara pratizruti satya| kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei nAjAne|
Aru muchA yetiYA yauৱnata upanIta ha’la Aru prAptavaYaskata pariNata ha’la, tetiYA Ami teOMka hikamata Aru jJAna dAna karilo~, Aru eidarei Ami muhachinasakalaka puraskAra pradAna karo~|

Aru teOM caharata praৱeza karile enekuৱA eTA samaYata, yetiYA tAra adhivAsIvilAka Achila asatarka| tAta teOM dujana vyaktika saMgharSata lipta dekhile, ejana teOMra nijara phaidara Aru Anajana haiche zatru pakSara| eteke muchAra dalara vyaktijane nijara zatrura viruddhe teOMra sahAYa vicArile, tetiYA muchAi tAka eTA ghocA mArile, phalata si (lage lage) mRtyuvaraNa karile| muchAi ka’le, ‘eiTo caYatAnara kAma| nizcaYa si (mAnuhara) zatru tathA prakAzya vibhrAntakArI’|
teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa mai mora nijara prati anyAYa karicho~, seYe tumi moka kSamA karA~’| tAra pichata AllAhe teOMka kSamA karile| nizcaYa teOM kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
muchAi ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi yihetu moka anugraha karichA, seYe mai ketiYAo apArIdhivilAkara sahAYakArI nahaOM’|

eteke bhIta satarka aৱsthAta sei caharate teOM rAti ativAhita karile| haThAt teOM zunA pAle, yijana vyaktiYe yoৱA kAli teOMra ocarata sahAYa vicArichila, si Akau sahAYara vAve ciJari Ache| muchAi tAka ka’le, ‘nizcaYa tumi ejana spaSTa vibhrAnta vyakti’|

eteke muchAi yetiYA ubhaYara zatruka dhariva khujile, tetiYA sei vyaktiYe ciJari ka’va dharile, ‘he muchA! yoৱAkAli tumi yenekai ejana vyaktika hatyA karichA, tenekai moko hatyA kariva khujichA neki? nizcaYa tumi pRthiৱIra vukuta svecchAcArI ha’va vicArichA, Aru tumi zAnti sthApanakArIsakalara antarbhukta ha’va nivicarA’|
Aru caharara dUraৱrtI prAntara parA ejana vyakti dauri Ahi ka’le, ‘he muchA! pariSadavargai tomAka hatyA karAra parAmarza kari Ache| seYe tumi olAi yoৱA, nizcaYa mai tomAra kalyANakAmI’|
tetiYA teOM bhIta satarka aৱsthAta sei ThAira parA olAi parila, Aru (AllAhara ocarata prArthanA kari) ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tumi moka yAlima sampradAYara parA rakSA karA’|
Aru yetiYA muchAi mAdiYAna abhimukhe yAtrA karile tetiYA teOM ka’le, ‘AzA karo~ mora pratipAlake moka sarala patha dekhuৱAva’|

yetiYA teOM mAdiYAnara pAnIra ocarata gai pAle, tAta teOM dekhivalai pAle edala mAnuhe siha~tara jantuvoraka pAnI khuৱAi Ache Aru siha~tara parA alapa A~tarata dujanI nArIYe siha~tara pazuvilAkaka Agaci dhari rAkhiche| muchAi ka’le, ‘ki haiche tomAlokara’? siha~te ka’le, ‘pazupAlakasakale siha~tara pazuvilAka lai A~tari noyoৱAlaike Ami AmAra pazuvilAkaka pAnI pAna karAva noৱAro~, Aru AmAra pitR haiche ejana ati vRddha mAnuha’|

tetiYA muchAi siha~tara phAlara parA (pazuvoraka) pAnI khuৱAle| tAra pichata teOM eDokhara chA~lai Ahi ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa tumi mora prati yi anugrahei aৱtIrNa nakarA kiYa, mai seiTore mukhApekSI’|

phalata (kichu samaYa pichatei) nArI dujanIra ejanIYe lAjakurIYAbhAৱe teOMra ocaralai Ahi ka’le, ‘Apuni AmAra pazuvilAkaka pAnI pAna karoৱAra kAraNe AponAka pArizramika pradAna karivalai mora pitRYe AponAka AmantraNa kariche’| iYAra pichata muchAi teOMra ocaralai Ahi sakalo ghaTanA vistArita varNanA karile, teOM ka’le, ‘tumi bhaYa nakarivA| tumi yAlima sampradAYara parA rakSA pAichA’|
nArI dujanIra ejanIYe ka’le, ‘he mora pitR! Apuni eOMka zramika hicApe niYoga karaka| nizcaYa AponAra zramika hicApe eOM uttama ha’va, eOM zaktizAlI, vizvasta’|

teOM ka’le, ‘mai mora ei dujanI choৱAlIra ejanIka tomAra lagata viYA diva khojo~ ei cartata ye, tumi ATha vachara mora iYAta kAma karivA, Aru yadi tumi daha vachara pUrNa karA, seiTo tomAra icchA| mai tomAka kaSTa diva nivicAro~| ina zvA AllAha nizcaYa tumi moka satkarmaparAYaNasakalara antarbhukta pAvA’|

muchAi ka’le, ‘(Thika Ache) tente eYA mora Aru AponAra mAjata vandavasta ha’la| ei duTA myAdara yikono eTA pUraNa karilei yena mora prati kono abhiyoga nAthAke| Ami yi viSaYe kathA kai Acho~ AllAhei iYAra karmavidhAYaka’|

eteke muchAi yetiYA teOMra myAda pUrNa karAra pichata sapariYAle yAtrA karile, tetiYA teOM tUra parvatara phAle jui dekhA pAle| teOM pariYAlavargaka ka’le, ‘tomAloke apekSA karA, mai jui dekhicho~, sambhaৱtaH mai tAra parA tomAlokara vAve kono khavara Aniva pArima, nAivA eDokhara andharAke lai Ahima yAte tomAloke jui pu~ৱAva pArA’|

eteke yetiYA muchAi juira ocara pAlegai, tetiYA upatyakAra so~ phAlara varakatamaYa bhUmira oparata aৱsthita sunirdiSTa gachara parA teOMka mAti koৱA ha’la, ‘he muchA! maYei AllAha vizvajagatara pratipAlaka;’

Aru koৱA ha’la, ‘tumi tomAra lAkhuTiDAla nikSepa karA’| tAra pichata teOM yetiYA seiDAlaka sApara nicinA keramera karA dekhile tetiYA teOM picha ho~hakA di lara mArile Aru ubhati nAcAle| (teOMka koৱA ha’la,) ‘he muchA! sanmukhalai AhA, bhaYa nakarivA, nizcaYa tumi nirApada’|

tomAra hAtakhana tomAra kASalatita thoৱA, (dekhivA) eikhana truTimukta aৱsthAta zubhrojjvala hai olAi Ahiva| lagate bhaYa dUra karivalai tomAra vAhure vukukhana cepi dharA| eteke ei duTA haiche tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA diYA pramANa, phiraAuna Aru tAra pariSadavargara vAve| nizcaYa siha~ta haiche phAchikva sampradAYa|
muchAi ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa mai siha~tara ejanaka hatyA karichilo~| phalata mai AzaMkA karicho~ siha~te moka hatyA kariva cAge’|
‘Aru mora bhAtR hArUna motakai vAgmI, eteke teOMka mora sahAYakArIrUpe preraNa karA, teOM moka samarthana kariva| nizcaYa mai AzaMkA karo~ siha~te moka michalIYA vuli Aropa lagAva’|

AllAhe ka’le, ‘(Thika Ache) anatipalame Ami tomAra bhAtRra dvArA tomAra vAhuka zaktizAlI karima Aru tomAloka ubhaYake Adhipatya dAna karima| phalata siha~te tomAlokara ocara cApiva noৱAriva| AmAra nidarzanAৱlIra dvArAi tomAloke Aru tomAlokara anusArIsakale siha~tara oparata vijaYa lAbha karivA’|

eteke muchAi yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai AmAra suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha lai upasthita ha’la, siha~te ka’le, ‘eYA alIka yAdura vAhire Ana eko nahaYa! Aru Ami AmAra purvapuruSasakalara yugata ketiYAo enekuৱA kathA zunA nAchilo~’|
Aru muchAi ka’le, ‘mora pratipAlake bhAlakaiYe jAne, kone teOMra parA hidAYata lai Ahiche Aru AkhirAtata kAra pariNAma zubha ha’va| nizcaYa yAlimasakala saphala naha’va’|

phiraAune ka’le, ‘he pariSadavarga! mora vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono ilAha Ache vuli mai nAjAno| eteke he hAmAna! tumi mora vAve (vokA mATi puri) iTa taiYAra karA| tAra pichata mora vAve eTA suucca prAsAda nirmANa karA, sambhaৱtaH tAta uThi mai muchAra ilAhaka bhUmuki mAri cAva pArima| kintu mora mate si haiche ejana michalIYA’|
phiraAuna Aru tAra sainyavAhinIYe anyAYabhAৱe pRthiৱIta ahaMkAra karichila Aru siha~te bhAvichila ye, siha~taka AmAra ocaralai obhatAi anA naha’va|
seYe Ami tAka Aru tAra sainyavAhinIka karAYatta kari sAgarata nikSepa karilo~| eteke coৱA, yAlimasakalara pariNAma kenekuৱA Achila!
Aru AmiYe siha~taka netRtva dAna karichilo~; siha~te mAnuhaka jAhAnnAmara pine AhvAna karichila; Aru kiYAmatara dinA siha~taka akaNo sahAYa karA naha’va|
ei pRthiৱIta Ami siha~tara pichata lagAi dichilo~ abhisampAta, Aru kiYAmatara dinA siha~ta ha’va ghRNitasakalara antarbhukta|

Aru nizcaYa pUrvaৱrtI vahu prajanmaka vinAza karAra pichata Ami muchAka kitAva pradAna karichilo~, (yikhana Achila) mAnaৱ jAtira vAve jJAna-vartikA, pathanirdeza Aru anugrahasvarUpa; yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kare|
(he navI!) Ami yetiYA muchAka vidhAna dichilo~ tetiYA tumi (tUra parvatara) pazcima prAntata upasthita nAchilA Aru pratyakSadarzIsakalaro antarbhukta nAchilA|

prakRtate (muchAra pichata) Ami vahu prajanmara AৱirbhAva ghaTAichilo~; siha~tara oparato vahu yuga ativAhita hai gaiche| tumi mAdiYAnavAsIvilAkara mAjata vidyamAna nAchilA ye, siha~tara ocarata AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karivA| muThate Amihe rAchula preraNakArI|

eidare muchAka yetiYA Ami mAtichilo~ tetiYAo tumi tUra parvatara ocarata upasthita nAchilA| prakRtate eiTo tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA daYAsvarUpa, yAte tumi enekuৱA eTA sampradAYaka satarka kariva pArA, yisakalara ocarata tomAra pUrve Ana kono satarkakArI ahA nAchila, yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kare|

Aru rAchula preraNa nakarAkai siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve siha~tara oparata kono vipada-Apada Ahile siha~te ka’lehe~tena, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAra ocaralai kiYa rAchula preraNa karA nAchilA, rAchula preraNa karilehe Ami tomAra nidarzana mAni caliva pArilo~he~tena Aru Ami muminasakalara antarbhukta ha’lo~he~tena’|

eteke yetiYA AmAra taraphara parA siha~tara ocaralai satya Ahi pAle, tetiYA siha~te ka’valai dharile, ‘muchAka yi diYA haichila, teOMko tenekuৱA (nidarzana) diYA naha’la kiYa’? (tente koৱAcona) itipUrve muchAka yi diYA haichila tAka siha~te asvIkAra karA nAchilane? siha~te kaichila, ‘duYoTAi yAdu, eTAi AnaToka samarthana kare’| lagate siha~te kaichila, ‘nizcaYa Ami eTAko nAmAno’|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke yadi satyavAdI hoৱA tente AllAhara taraphara parA ekhana kitAva lai AhA, yikhana pathanirdezata ei dukhanatakai utkRSTa ha’va, mai nije sei kitAvara anusaraNa karima’|

eteke siha~te yadi tomAra AhvAnata sa~hAri nidiYe, tente jAni thoৱA, siha~te keৱla nijara kAmanA-vAsanArahe anusaraNa kare| yiYe AllAhara patha-nirdeza agrAhya kari nijara kAmanA-vAsanAra anusaraNa kare seijanatakai adhika vibhrAnta Aru kona ha’va pAre? nizcaYa AllAhe yAlima sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|
Aru nizcaYa Ami siha~tara ocaralai eTAra pichata eTAkai vANI pau~cAi dicho~; yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kare|
iYAra pUrve Ami yisakalaka kitAva pradAna karichilo~, teOMlokeo iYAra prati ImAna poSaNa kare|

Aru yetiYA teOMlokara ocarata iYAka tilAৱta karA haYa tetiYA teOMloke kaYa, ‘Ami iYAra oparata ImAna Anicho~, nizcaYa eiTo AmAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA ahA satya| nizcaYa Ami Agateo AtmasamarpaNakArI Achilo~|’

teOMlokaka duvArakai pratidAna diYA ha’va| ei kAraNe ye, teOMloke dhairyya dhAraNa karichila, lagate teOMloke bhAla kAmara dvArA veYA kAmaka pratihata kare| eidare Ami teOMlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ tAra parA teOMloke dAna kare|

Aru teOMloke yetiYA anarthaka kathA-vatarA zunA pAYa tetiYA teOMloke tAra parA mukha ghUrAi laYa Aru kaYa, ‘AmAra Amala AmAra vAve Aru tomAlokara Amala tomAlokara vAve, tomAlokara prati ‘chAlAma’| Ami murkhara lagata tarka kariva nivicAro~’|
nizcaYa tumi yAka bhAlapoৱA icchA karilei tAka satpathata Aniva noৱArivA| varaM AllAhe yAka icchA kare tAkahe satpatha dekhuৱAYa Aru satpatha anusArIsakalara viSaYe teৱe~i bhAlakai jAne|

Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami yadi tomAra lagata satpatha anusaraNa karo~ tente AmAka dezara parA utkhAta kari diYA ha’va’| Ami siha~tara vAve eTA nirApada hArAma pratiSThA karA nAi ne, ya’ta sakalo prakArara phala-mUla AmadAnI haYa, Ami pradAna karA jIৱikAsvarUpa? kintu siha~tara sarahabhAga mAnuhei ei viSaYe nAjAne|

Aru Ami vahuto enekuৱA janapadaka dhvaMsa karicho~ yAra vAsindAsakale nijara bhoga-sampadakalai ahaMkAra karichila! eivora haiche siha~tara ghara-duৱAra, siha~tara pichata eivora ghara-duৱArata khuva kama mAnuhei vasavAsa kariche| AmiYei cUDa়Anta uttarAdhikArI (prakRta mAlika)!

Aru tomAra pratipAlake kono janapadaka sei ThAira mUla bhUkhaNData kono rAchula preraNa nakarAlaike (siha~taka) dhvaMsa nakare, yijane siha~tara ocarata AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAৱta kare| kono janapadara adhivAsIvilAka yAlima naha’le Ami siha~taka dhvaMsa nakaro~|

Aru tomAlokaka yi diYA haiche seYA haiche keৱla pArthiৱ jIৱnara bhoga-sAmagrI Aru saundarya mAtra| AnahAte AllAhara ocarata yi Ache seYA haiche uttama Aru sthAYI| tathApio tomAloke anudhAৱna nakarivAne?

yAka Ami uttama puraskArara pratizruti dicho~, teOM seiTo pAvai; teOM sei vyaktira dare neki yAka Ami pArthiৱ jIৱnara bhoga-sambhAra dicho~, tAra pichata kiYAmatara dinA si ha’va (aparAdhI hicApe) upasthita hoৱA lokara antarbhukta?
Aru seidinA teOM siha~taka mAti ka’va, ‘tomAloke yivoraka mora aMzI vuli gaNya karichilA, siha~ta ka’ta’?

yisakalara oparata zAstira vANI sAvyasta haiche siha~te ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! iha~tei seisakala loka yisakalaka Ami vibhrAnta karichilo~; Ami iha~taka vibhrAnta karichilo~ yenekai Ami vibhrAnta haichilo~| tomAra samIpata Ami siha~tara viSaYe dAYamuktatA ghoSaNA karicho~| iha~te AmAra ivAdata karA nAchila’|

Aru siha~taka koৱA ha’va, ‘tomAloke aMzIdAra sthApana karA upAsyavoraka mAtA’| tetiYA siha~te seivoraka mAtiva| kintu seivore siha~tara AhvAnata sa~hAri nidiva, Aru siha~te zAsti dekhA pAva| hAYa! siha~te yadi satpatha anusaraNa karilehe~tena! (tente ei durAৱsthA naha’lahe~tena)
Aru seidinA AllAhe siha~taka mAti ka’va, ‘tomAloke rAchulasakalaka ki uttara dichilA’?
seidinA siha~tara parA sakalo tathya vilupta ha’va tetiYA siha~te ijane sijanaka sodha-pochao kariva noৱAriva|
eteke yi vyaktiYe tAovA kariche Aru ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, AzA karA yAYa teOM sAphalya arjanakArIsakalara antarbhukta ha’va|

Aru tomAra pratipAlake yi icchA kare seiToৱe sRSTi kare Aru yAka icchA kare tAkei manonIta kare, iYAta siha~tara kono adhikAra nAi| AllAha paৱitra, mahAna Aru siha~te yi aMzI kare tAra parA teOM vahu urddhata|
Aru tomAra pratipAlake jAne siha~tara antare yi gopana kare Aru siha~te yi vyakta kare|
teৱe~i AllAha, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata sakalo prazaMsA teOMrei; vidhAna teOMrei; Aru tomAlokeo teOMra pinei pratyAৱrtita ha’vA|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke bhAvichAne, rAtira andhakAraka yadi AllAhe kiYAmata diৱsalaike sthAYI kari diYe, tente AllAhara vAhire enekuৱA kona ilAha Ache, yiYe tomAlokara vAve (dinara) pohara Ani diva pAriva? tathApio tomAloke karNapAta nakarivAne’?

koৱA, ‘tomAloke bhAvichAne, AllAhe yadi dinaka kiYAmata diৱsalaike sthAYI kari diYe, AllAhara vAhire enekuৱA kona ilAha Ache, yiYe tomAlokara vAve rAtira AvirbhAৱ ghaTAva pAriva? ya’ta tomAloke vizrAma loৱA, tathApio tomAloke bhAvi nAcAvAne’?

teৱe~i nija anugrahata tomAlokara vAve rAti Aru dina sRSTi kariche, yAte tomAloke tAta vizrAma kariva pArA Aru teOMra anugraha sandhAna kariva pArA lagate yAte tomAloke teOMra kRtajJatA prakAza kariva pArA|
Aru seidinA teOM siha~taka mAti ka’va, ‘tomAloke yivoraka mora aMzI vuli gaNya karichilA, siha~ta ka’ta’?

Aru Ami pratyeka jAtira parAi ekojanakai sAkSI uliYAi Anima Aru sudhima, ‘tomAlokara pramANa upasthita karA’| tetiYA siha~te jAniva pAriva ye, ilAha hoৱAra adhikAra keৱla AllAharei, Aru siha~te yivoraka (upAsya vuli) michA raTanA karichila seivora siha~tara parA udhAo hai yAva|

nizcaYa kvArUna Achila muchAra sampradAYabhukta, kintu si siha~tara prati auddhatya prakAza karichila| Ami tAka dAna karichilo~ imAna dhana-bhANDAra ye, yAra cAvi vahana karivalaio edala zaktizAlI mAnuhara pakSe kaSTasAdhya Achila| smaraNa karA, yetiYA tAra sampradAYara mAnuhe tAka kaichila, ‘ahaMkAra nakarivA| nizcaYa AllAhe ahaMkArI lokasakalaka pachanda nakare|

‘Aru AllAhe tomAka yi dAna kariche tAra dvArA AkhirAtara AvAsa anusandhAna karA Aru pRthiৱIra parAo tomAra aMzakhini nApAharivA, tumio anugraha karA yenekai AllAhe tomAra prati anugraha kariche Aru pRthiৱIra vukuta viparyaYa sRSTi karAra icchA nakarivA| nizcaYa AllAhe viparyaYa sRSTikArIsakalaka bhAla nApAYa’|

si ka’le, ‘ei sampada mai mora jJAnara dvArAhe lAbha karicho~’| si janA nAchilane ye, AllAhe tAra Agata vahuto prajanmaka dhvaMsa kariche, yisakala tAtakaio adhika zaktizAlI Achila Aru siha~tara janasaMkhyAo Achila adhika? Aru aparAdhIvilAkaka siha~tara aparAdha samparke prazna karA naha’va|

eteke kArUna tAra sampradAYara sanmukhalai jAka-jamakatAre olAi Ahila| yisakale pArthiৱ jIৱna kAmanA karichila siha~te ka’le, ‘hAYa! kArUnaka yidare dAna karA haiche, AmAko yadi seidare dAna karA ha’lahe~tena! nizcaYa si mahA bhAgyaৱAna’|

Aru yisakalaka jJAna dAna karA haichila, teOMloke ka’le, ‘dhika tomAlokara oparata! yiYe ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMlokara vAve AllAhara puraskArei haiche zreSTha, Aru dhairyyazIlasakalara vAhire Ana koneo seiTo (puraskAra) nApAYa’|

tAra pichata Ami kArUnaka tAra prAsAdasaha bhU-garbhata puti polAlo~| tAra sapakSe ene kono dala nAchila, yiYe AllAhara zAstira parA tAka sahAYa kariva pAriva, Anaki si nijeo nijake sahAYa karivalai sakSama nAchila|

Aru yoৱAkAli yisakale tAra dare hoৱAra kAmanA karichila, siha~te ka’valai dharile, ‘coৱA, AllAhe teOMra vAndAsakalara mAjata yAra vAve icchA kare tAra jIৱikA vRddhi kari diYe Aru yAra vAve icchA kare tAra vAve hrAsa kari diYe| yadi AllAhe AmAra prati sadaYa naha’lahe~tena tente AmAko teOM bhU-garbhata puti pelAlehe~tena| coৱA, kAphirasakala ketiYAo saphalakAma ha’va noৱAre’|
eiTo AkhirAtara sei AvAsa, yiTo Ami nirdhArita karo~ teOMlokara vAve yisakale pRthiৱIta uddhata Aru viparyaYa sRSTi kariva nivicAre; Aru zubha pariNAma keৱla muttAkvIsakalara vAvei (nirdhArita)|

yiYe satkarma lai upasthita ha’va, tAra vAve Ache tAtakaio uttama pratidAna, Aru yiYe asatkarma lai upasthita ha’va, tente siha~taka keৱla sei asatkarma anupAtei zAsti diYA ha’va yikhini siha~te kariche|

nizcaYa yiYe tomAra prati koraAnaka vidhAnasvarUpe dAna kariche, nizcaYa teOM tomAka obhatAi Aniva pratyAৱrtanasthalalai| koৱA, ‘mora pratipAlake bhAlakaiYe jAne kone satpathara nirdeza lai Ahiche Aru kona spaSTa vibhrAntita Ache’|
Aru tumi AzA karA nAchilA ye, tomAra prati kitAva aৱtIrNa ha’va| eYA keৱla tomAra pratipAlakara anugrahahe| gatike tumi ketiYAo kAphirasakalara sahAYaka naha’vA|

Aru tomAra prati AllAhara AYAtasamUha aৱtIrNa hoৱAra pichata siha~te yena tomAka konomatei tAra parA virata rAkhiva noৱAre| tumi tomAra pratipAlakara prati AhvAna karA Aru konomatei muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta naha’vA|

tumi AllAhara lagata Ana kono ilAhaka nAmAtivA, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| AllAhara sattvAra vAhire sakalo vastuৱei dhvaMsazIla| vidhAna keৱla teOMrei, Aru teOMra ocaratei tomAloka pratyAৱrtita ha’vA|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|[1]
mAnuhe bhAviche neki ye, ‘Ami ImAna Anicho~’ ei vuli ka’lei siha~taka parIkSA nakarAkaiYe enei eri diYA ha’va?
nizcaYa Ami siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalako parIkSA karichilo~, gatike AllAhe nizcaYa prakAza kari diva kona satyavAdI Aru teOM aৱzye prakAza kari diva kona michalIYA|
athavA yisakale duSkarma kare siha~te bhAviche neki ye, siha~te AmAra AYattara vAhiralai guci yAva? kimAna ye nikRSTa siha~tara ei siddhAnta!
yiYe AllAhara sAkSAt kAmanA kare teOM jAni thoৱA ucita ye, AllAhara nirdhArita samaYa nizcitabhAৱe Ahivai; Aru teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
Aru yiYe praceSTA calAYa, si nijara vAvehe praceSTA calAYa, nizcaYa AllAha sRSTijagatara parA amukhApekSI|
Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, nizcaYa Ami teOMlokara parA teOMlokara pApasamUhaka mArjanA karima Aru teOMloke yi uttama Amala karichila, nizcaYa Ami tAra pratidAna dima|

Aru Ami mAnuhaka tAra pitR-mAtRra prati sadvyaৱhAra karivalai nirdeza dicho~| kintu siha~te yadi mora lagata zvirka karivalai tomAra oparata vala praYoga kare yi viSaYata tomAra kono jJAna nAi, tente tumi siha~tara kathA nAmAnivA| (jAni thoৱA) mora ocaratei tomAlokara pratyAৱrtana| tetiYA mai tomAlokaka janAi dima tomAloke ki karichilA|
Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, nizcaYa Ami teOMlokaka satkarmaparAYaNasakalara antarbhukta karima|

Aru mAnuhara mAjata kichumAna enekuৱA mAnuho Ache, yisakale kaYa, ‘Ami AllAhara prati ImAna Anicho~’, kintu AllAhara pathata yetiYA siha~taka niryAtana karA haYa, tetiYA siha~te mAnuhara niryAtanaka AllAhara zAstira dare gaNya kare| kintu tomAra pratipAlakara parA kono sahAYa Ahile siha~te kaYa, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara lagatei Achilo~’, (tente koৱAcona) sRSTira antaHkaraNata yi Ache, sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka aৱgata nahaYane?
Aru AllAhe nizcaYa prakAza kari diva kone ImAna Aniche Aru aৱzye prakAza kari diva kona munAphika|

Aru kAphirasakale muminasakalaka kaYa, "tomAloke AmAra patha anusaraNa karA, Ami tomAlokara pApakarmara vojA vahana karima"| athaca siha~te siha~tara gunAhara kono vojAi vahana nakariva| nizcaYa siha~ta haiche michalIYA|
varaM siha~te nizcaYa vahana kariva nijara (pApakarmara) vojA lagate Aru kichumAna vojA; Aru siha~te yi michA raTanA karichila sei viSaYe siha~taka nizcaYa kiYAmatara dinA prazna karA ha’va|

Aru AmiYei nUhaka teOMra sampradAYara ocaralai preraNa karichilo~| teOM siha~tara mAjata aৱsthAna karichila paJcAza vachara kama ehejAra vachara| tAra pichata mahA-plAৱne siha~taka grAsa karichila, kAraNa siha~ta Achila yAlima|
tAra pichata Ami teOMka Aru nAৱta ArohaNakArIsakalaka rakSA karichilo~ Aru sRSTijagatara vAve iYAka eTA nidarzana vanAi dicho~|

Aru (smaraNa karA) ivrAhImaka, yetiYA teOM nija sampradAYaka kaichila, tomAloke keৱla AllAharei ivAdata karA Aru teOMrei tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA; eiToৱei tomAlokara vAve uttama yadi tomAloke jAnilAhe~tena!

tomAloke AllAhaka eri keৱla mUrtipUjAhe kari AchA Aru michA udbhAৱna kari AchA| tomAloke AllAhara vAhire yivorara ivAdata kari AchA siha~ta kintu tomAlokara jIৱikAra mAlika nahaYa| seYe tomAloke keৱla AllAhara ocaratei jIৱikA vicarA Aru teOMrei ivAdata karA| teOMra kRtajJatA prakAza karA| teOMra ocaratei tomAloka pratyAৱrtita ha’vA|
Aru tomAloke yadi asvIkAra karA tente (jAni thoৱA) tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo asvIkAra karichila| suspaSTabhAৱe pracAra karAToৱe haiche rAchulara guru dAYitva|
siha~te lakSya karA nAine, AllAhe kenekai sRSTika astitva dAna kare? tAra pichata teOM iYAra punarAvRtti kariva| nizcaYa eiTo AllAhara vAve ati sahaja|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke pRthiৱIta bhramaNa karA, tAra pichata pratyakSa karA, kenekai teOM sRSTi Arambha kariche, tAra pichata AllAhei punaravAra sRSTi kariva’| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
teOM yAka icchA kare zAsti diYe Aru yAra prati icchA kare anugraha kare| tomAlokaka teOMra ocaratei obhatAi niYA ha’va|
tomAloke AllAhaka pRthiৱIta athavA AkAzata ka'to vyartha kariva noৱArivA| AllAhara vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono abhibhAৱko nAi, Aru kono sAhAyyakArIo nAi|
Aru yisakale AllAhara nidarzanaka Aru teOMra sAkSAtaka asvIkAra kare, siha~tei mora anugrahara parA nirAza haYa, Aru siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

uttarata ivrAhImara sampradAYe keৱla ei kathASArake ka'le ye, iYAka hatyA karA athavA juita jvalAi diYA| tAra pichata AllAhe teOMka juira parA rakSA karile| nizcaYa iYAta Ache vahuto nidarzana, ene sampradAYara vAve yisakale ImAna poSaNa kare|

ivrAhIme Aru ka’le, ‘tomAloke dekhona AllAhara parivarte mUrtivorakahe upAsyarUpe grahaNa karichA, pArthiৱ jIৱnata tomAlokara pAraspArika vandhutvara khAtirata| kintu kiYAmatara dinA tomAloke ijane sijanaka asvIkAra karivA Aru paraspare parasparaka abhizApa karivA| tomAlokara AvAsa ha’va jAhAnnAma Aru tomAlokara kono sahAYakArI nAthAkiva’|
tAra pichata lUte teOMra oparata vizvAsa sthApana karile| ivrAhIme ka'le, mai mora pratipAlakara uddezye hijarata karima| nizcaYa teOM mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Aru Ami ivrAhImaka dAna karichilo~ ichahAkva Aru iYAkUva| lagate teOMra vaMzadharasakalara vAve sthira karichilo~ navUoৱta Aru kitAva| Ami teOMka pRthiৱItei puraskRta karichilo~ Aru AkhirAtato teOM nizcaYa satkarmaparAYaNasakalara anyatama ha’va|
Aru smaraNa karA lUtara kathA, yetiYA teOM nija sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘nizcaYa tomAloke enekuৱA azlIla kAma kari AchA, yiTo tomAlokara pUrve sRSTijagatara koneo karA nAchila’|

‘tomAlokei puruSara ocaralai samakAmitAra uddezye gamana karA (kAma tRptira vAve), Aru tomAlokei vATe-pathe DakAiti karA Aru tomAlokei nijara vaiThakata prakAzya ghRNanIYa kAma karA’| uttarata teOMra sampradAYe keৱla eiToৱe ka’le ye, ‘tente AmAra oparata AllAhara zAsti lai AhA, yadi tumi satyavAdI hoৱA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! viparyaYa sRSTikArI sampradAYara viruddhe tumi moka sahAYa karA’|
Aru yetiYA AmAra prerita phiristAsakala susaMvAdasaha ivrAhImara ocaralai Ahila, teOMloke ka’le, ‘nizcaYa Ami ei janapadavAsIka dhvaMsa karima| nizcaYa iYAra adhivAsIvilAka yAlima’|

ivrAhIme ka’le, ‘nizcaYa ei janapadara mAjata dekhona lUto Ache| teOMloke ka'le, tAta kona kona Ache sei kathA Ami bhAlakaiYe jAno, nizcaYa Ami lUtaka Aru teOMra pariYAlavargaka rakSA karima, keৱla teOMra strIra vAhire, tAi ha’va pichata aৱsthAnakArI vilAkara antarbhukta|

Aru yetiYA AmAra prerita phiristAsakala lUtara ocaralai Ahila, tetiYA teOM teOMlokara viSaYe cintita hai parila Aru teOM nijake teOMlokaka rakSA karivalai asamartha vuli bhAvile| teOMloke ka’le, ‘bhaYa nakariva, cintAo nakariva, nizcaYa Ami AponAka Aru AponAra pariYAlaka rakSA karima, keৱla AponAra strIra vAhire; tAi haiche pichata aৱsthAnakArIvilAkara antarbhukta;
‘nizcaYa Ami ei janapadavAsIra oparata zAsti aৱtIrNa karima, kAraNa siha~ta mahApApata lipta haiche’|
Aru nizcaYa Ami iYAta vodhazakti sampanna sampradAYara vAve eTA spaSTa nidarzana rAkhicho~|

Aru Ami mAdiYAnavAsIra ocaralai preraNa karichilo~ siha~tara bhAtR zvuAivaka| tAra pichata teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke keৱla AllAhara ivAdata karA Aru zeSa diৱsara AzA karA Aru pRthiৱIta viparyaYa sRSTi kari nuphurivA’|
tathApio siha~te teOMka asvIkAra karile; phalata siha~ta bhUmikampara dvArA AkrAnta hai nija nija gharate natajAnu aৱsthAta zeSa hai ga’la|

Ada Aru chAmUdaka AmiYe dhvaMsa karichilo~, siha~tara ghara-duৱArara kichumAna dhvaMsAৱzeSa tomAlokara vAve unmocita haiche| caYatAne siha~tara karmaka siha~tara dRSTita zobhanIYa kari dichila Aru siha~taka satpatha aৱlamvanata vAdhA dichila, yadio siha~ta Achila ati vicakSaNa|

Aru Ami dhvaMsa karichilo~ kvArUna, phiraAuna Aru hAmAnaka| nizcaYa muchAi siha~tara ocaralai suspaSTa nidarzanasaha Ahichila; tathApio siha~te pRthiৱIta ahaMkAra karichila; kintu siha~te mora zAstira parA vAciva parA nAchila|

eteke siha~tara pratyekake nija nija aparAdhara vAve Ami siha~taka karAYatta karichilo~| siha~tara kichumAnara oparata Ami preraNa karichilo~ zilAvRSTisampanna pracaNDa dhumuhA, lagate siha~tara kichumAnaka AkramaNa karichila vikaTa ciJare, Aru kichumAnaka puti pelAichilo~ bhU-garbhata Aru kichumAnaka DuvAi mArichilo~| AllAha enekuৱA nahaYa ye, teOM siha~tara prati anyAYa kariva, varaM siha~ta nijei nijara prati anyAYa karichila|

yisakale AllAhara vAhire Anaka abhibhAৱka hicApe grahaNa kare, siha~tara dRSTAnta makarAra nicinA, yiYe ghara vanAYa| nizcaYa gharara mAjata ATAitakai durvala ghara haiche makarAra ghara, hAYa! yadi siha~te jAnilehe~tena|
nizcaYa AllAhe seivoraka jAne, yivoraka siha~te AllAhara vAhire yivoraka AhvAna kare, teOM mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Aru eivora dRSTAnta Ami keৱla mAnuhara vAvei diOM, kintu keৱla jJAnIsakalehe seYA vuji pAYa|
AllAhei yathAyathabhAৱe AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche; nizcaYa iYAta Ache muminasakalara vAve nidarzana|

tomAra prati yi kitAva ahI karA haiche, tAra parA tumi tilAৱta karA Aru chAlAta kAYema karA| nizcaYa chAlAte azlIla Aru asatkarmara parA virata rAkhe| AllAhara smaraNei haiche sarvazreSTha| tomAloke yi karA AllAhe seYA jAne|

Aru tomAloke uttama panthAra vAhire kitAvIsakalara lagata vitarka nakarivA, kintu siha~tara mAjara yisakale anyAYa kariche siha~tara lagata kariva pArA| tomAloke koৱA, ‘AmAra prati Aru tomAlokara prati yi aৱtIrNa haiche tAra oparata Ami ImAna Anicho~| AmAra ilAha Aru tomAlokara ilAha ejanei, Ami teOMra pratihe AtmasamarpaNakArI’|

eidarei Ami tomAra pratio kitAva aৱtIrNa karicho~, eteke yisakalaka Ami (pUrve) kitAva pradAna karichilo~ teOMlokeo iYAra prati ImAna poSaNa kare| iha~tara mAjaro kichumAne iYAra prati vizvAsa sthApana kare| kAphirasakalara vAhire Ana koneo AmAra nidarzanAৱlIka asvIkAra nakare|
Aru tumito iYAra pUrve kono kitAva paDha়A nAchilA Aru nija hAte kono kitAvo likhA nAi ye, vAtila panthIsakale sandeha poSaNa kariva|
varaM yisakalaka jJAna dAna karA haiche prakRtate teOMlokara antarata eikhana haiche eTA spaSTa nidarzana| keৱla yAlimasakalei AmAra nidarzanasamUhaka asvIkAra kare|

siha~te Aru kaYa, ‘teOMra pratipAlakara taraphara parA teOMra ocaralai nidarzana aৱtIrNa nahaYa kiYa’? koৱA, ‘nidarzanasamUha haiche keৱla AllAhara niYantraNAdhIna| mai keৱla ejana spaSTa satarkakArIhe mAtra’|

eiTo siha~tara vAve yatheSTa nahaYane ye, Ami tomAra prati koraAna aৱtIrNa karicho~, yikhana siha~tara ocarata pATha karA haYa| nizcaYa iYAta anugraha Aru upadeza Ache sei sampradAYara vAve, yisakale ImAna poSaNa kare|

koৱA, ‘mora Aru tomAlokara mAjata sAkSI hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa| AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache seYA teOM jAne| yisakale vAtilaka vizvAsa kare Aru AllAhara lagata kupharI kare, siha~tei haiche kSatigrasta’|

Aru siha~te tomAka zAsti tvarAnvita karivalai kaYa| yadi samaYa nirdhArita nAthAkilahe~tena tente nizcaYa siha~tara oparata zAsti Ahi parilahe~tena| (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa siha~tara oparata zAsti Ahiva AkasmikabhAৱe, Anaki sihate upalavdhio kariva noৱAriva|
siha~te tomAka zAsti tvarAnvita karivalai kaYa| athaca jAhAnnAme kAphirasakalaka nizcaYa pariveSTana kariva|
seidinA zAstiYe siha~taka siha~tara oparara parA Aru talara parA Acchanna kariva, Aru teOM ka’va, ‘tomAloke yi karichilA tAra soৱAda grahaNa karA’|
he mora mumina vAndAsakala! nizcaYa mora pRthiৱIkhana vahuta prazasta, eteke tomAloke keৱla morei ivAdata karA|
pratiTo jIৱi mRtyura soৱAda grahaNa kariva, tAra pichata tomAloke AmAra ocaralaikei pratyAৱrtita ha’vA|

Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, nizcaYa Ami teOMlokara vasavAsara vAve jAnnAtata suucca prAsAda dAna karima, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita thAkiva, tAta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va, AmalakArIsakalara vAve eYA kimAna ye uttama pratidAna!
yisakale dhairyya dhAraNa kare Aru teOMlokara pratipAlakara oparata bharasA kare|
enekuৱA vahuto jIৱ-jantu Ache yivore nijara khAdya saJcaYa kari nArAkhe| AllAhei seivoraka jIৱikA dAna kare Aru tomAlokako (dAna kare), Aru teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
Aru yadi tumi siha~taka sodhA, ‘AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI kone sRSTi kariche Aru kone candra-sUryaka niYantrita kariche’? siha~te nizcaYa ka’va ‘AllAha’| teneha’le siha~taka ka’lai obhatAi niYA haiche!
AllAhe teOMra vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yAka icchA kare tAra jIৱikA vRddhi kari diYe Aru yAka icchA kare sImita kari diYe| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastu samparke samyaka aৱgata|

Aru yadi tumi siha~taka sodhA, ‘AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa kari kone mRta bhUmika saJjIৱita kare’? siha~te aৱzye ka’va, ‘AllAha’| koৱA, ‘sakalo prazaMsA AllAharei’| kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei eiTo anudhAৱna nakare|
ei pArthiৱ jIৱna khela-dhemAlira vAhire Ana eko nahaYa| AkhirAtara jIৱnei haiche prakRta jIৱna, yadi siha~te jAnilehe~tena!

kintu siha~te yetiYA nauyAnata ArohaNa kare, tetiYA siha~te vizuddhacitte ekaniSThabhAৱe keৱla AllAhakei AhvAna kare| tAra pichata teOM yetiYA siha~taka uddhAra kari sthalata Ane, tetiYA siha~te zvirkata lipta haYa;
ei kAraNe ye, yAte Ami siha~taka yi pradAna karicho~, seYA siha~te asvIkAra kariva pAre Aru bhoga-vilAsata matta thAkiva pAre; eteke zIghrei siha~te jAnivalai pAva (iYAra bhaYAৱha pariNAma samparke)|

siha~te lakSya karA nAine ye, Ami (makkAra) hArAmaka nirApada karicho~, athaca iYAra cAriophAle thakA mAnuhavora apaharaNara cikAra haYa| tathApio siha~te vAtilaka vizvAsa karivane, Aru AllAhara niYAmataka asvIkAra karivane?

Aru yi vyaktiYe AllAhara oparata michA racanA kare athavA teOMra taraphara parA satya ahAra pichato tAka asvIkAra kare, seijanatakai adhika yAlima Aru kona ha’va pAre? jAhAnnAmara mAjatei kAphirasakalara AvAsasthala nahaYane vAru?
Aru yisakale AmAra pathata sarvAtmaka praceSTA calAYa, Ami teOMlokaka nizcaYa AmAra pathasamUhata paricAlita karima| nizcaYa AllAha muhachinasakalara lagata Ache|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|[1]
romAnasakala parAjita haiche,
nikaTaৱrtI aJcalata, kintu siha~te siha~tara ei parAjaYara pichata zIghrei vijaYI ha’va,
kichu vacharara bhitaratei| Agara Aru pichara sakalo phaYacAlA AllAharei; Aru seidinA muminasakala Anandita ha’va,
AllAhara sahAYata| teOM yAka icchA kare sahAYa kare Aru teৱe~i pravalaparAkramI, parama daYAlu|
eiTo AllAharei pratizruti, AllAhe teOMra pratizrutira vyatikrama nakare, kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei nAjAne|
siha~te pArthiৱ jIৱnara vAhyika diza samparke aৱgata, Aru AkhirAta samparke siha~ta udAsIna|

siha~te nijara antarata bhAvi nAcAYa neki? AllAhe AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjata thakA sakalo vastu sRSTi kariche yathAyathabhAৱe Aru eTA nirdiSTa samaYara vAve| nizcaYa mAnuhara mAjara vahutei nija pratipAlakara sAkSAt samparke avizvAsI|

siha~te pRthiৱIta bhramaNa karA nAine? tetiYAhe siha~te dekhilehe~tena ye, siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara dazA ki haichila, zaktita siha~ta Achila iha~tatakaio pravala, siha~te mATi cahAichila, Aru iha~te yimAna nirmANa kariche tAtakaio adhika nirmANa siha~te karichila| siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara rAchulasakale suspaSTa pramANasaha Ahichila| darAcalate AllAha enekuৱA nahaYa ye, teOM siha~tara prati anyAYa kariche varaM siha~ta nijei nijara prati anyAYa karichila|
eteke yisakale veYA karichila siha~tara pariNAmo haichila veYA, kAraNa siha~te AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichila Aru tAkalai ThATTA-vidrUpa karichila|
AllAhei sRSTira sUcanA kare, tAra pichata teৱe~i iYAra punarAvRtti kariva, tAra pichata tomAlokaka teOMra ocaratei pratyAৱrtana karoৱA ha’va|
Aru yidinA kiYAmata saMghaTita ha’va seidinA aparAdhIsakala hatAza hai pariva|
Aru (AllAhara lagata karA) siha~tara zvarikasakala (seidinA) siha~tara vAve cupArichakArI naha'va Aru siha~te siha~tara zvarikakRta upAsyavoraka asvIkAra kariva|
Aru yidinA kiYAmata saMghaTita ha’va seidinA siha~ta vibhakta hai pariva|
eteke yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMloke jAnnAtata sukha-zAntita thAkiva;
yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche lagate AkhirAtara sAkSAtaka asvIkAra kariche, seisakala lokakei zAstira mAjata upasthita karA ha’va|
eteke tomAloke AllAhara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karA, yetiYA tomAloke sandhAta upanIta hoৱA Aru puৱAra bhAgata upanIta hoৱA,
lagate Avelira samaYata Aru yetiYA tomAloke dupurIYAta upanIta hoৱA| teOMra vAvei sakalo prazaMsA AkAzasamUhata Aru pRthiৱIta|
teৱe~i nirjIৱra parA sajIৱ uliYAi Ane Aru teৱe~i jIৱitara parA mRtaka uliYAi Ane| teৱe~i bhUmika tAra mRtyura pichata Akau punarjIৱita kare| eidarei tomAlokako uliYAi AnA ha’va|
Aru teOMra nidarzanAৱlIra mAjata eiToo eTA ye, teOM tomAlokaka mATira parA sRSTi kariche, tAra pichata tomAloke etiYA mAnuha hai sarvatra si~carati hai parichA|

Aru teOMra nidarzanAৱlIra mAjata eiToo eTA nidarzana ye, teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve tomAlokara mAjara parA tomAlokara yorA sRSTi kariche, yAte tomAloke siha~tara ocarata prazAnti lAbha karA Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara mAjata pArasparika prema Aru sneha sRSTi kariche| nizcaYa iYAta Ache vahuto nidarzana sei sampradAYara vAve yisakale gaৱeSaNA kare|
Aru teOMra nidarzanAৱlIra mAjata Ache AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sRSTi, lagate tomAlokara bhASA Aru varNara vaicitratA| nizcaYa iYAta jJAnIsakalara vAve vahuto nidarzana Ache|

Aru teOMra nidarzanAৱlIra mAjata rAti Aru dinata grahaNa karA tomAlokara nidrAo haiche eTA nidarzana, lagate teOMra anugrahara phalatei tomAloke (jIৱikA) anveSaNa karA| nizcaYa iYAra mAjata Ache vahuto nidarzana sei sampradAYara vAve yisakale zunA pAYa|

Aru teOMra nidarzanAৱlIra mAjata eiToo eTA ye, teৱe~i tomAlokaka bhaYa Aru AzAra saJcArakarUpe vidyuta dekhuৱAYa, Aru AkAzara parA pAnI varaSAYa Aru tAra dvArA teOM mRta bhUmika punarjIৱita kare| nizcaYa iYAta vahuto nidarzana Ache sei sampradAYara vAve yisakale anudhAৱna kare|

teOMra nidarzanAৱlIra mAjata Aru Ache ye, teOMra Adezatei AkAza Aru pRthiৱIYe bhArasAmya rakSA kari Ache, tAra pichata AllAhe yetiYA tomAlokaka mATira parA uThivalai evAra AhvAna kariva, tetiYA tomAloke olAi AhivA|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo teOMrei| sakalo teOMrei anugata|
teৱe~i sRSTira sUcanA kare, tAra pichata teৱe~i iYAra punarAvRtti kariva; Aru eiTo teOMra vAve ati sahaja| AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta sarvocca guNAguNa teOMrei; Aru teৱe~i parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAhe tomAlokara vAve tomAlokara mAjara parAi eTA upamA dAGi dhariche, (koৱAcona) Ami tomAlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~, tAta tomAlokara adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIsakalara konovAi aMzIdArane? eteke tomAloke eikSetrata samAna ne? tomAloke siha~taka seidare bhaYa karA neki yidare tomAloke paraspare parasparaka bhaYa karA? eidarei Ami nidarzanAৱlIsamUha vistAritabhAৱe varNanA karo~ sei sampradAYara vAve, yisakale anudhAৱna kare|
varaM yAlimasakale ajJatAvazataH siha~tara nijara kAmanA-vAsanAra anusaraNa kare, eteke AllAhe yAka pathabhraSTa kariche, tAka kone hidAYata diva pAriva? Aru siha~tara kono sahAYakArIo nAi|

eteke tumi ekaniSTha hai nijara mukhamaNDalaka dvInara oparata pratiSThita rakhA, (seiTo haiche )AllAhara phitarata (svAbhAৱika rIti vA dvIna ichalAma), yAra oparata (calAra upayukta kari) teOM mAnuhaka sRSTi kariche; AllAhara sRSTira kono parivartana nAi| eiToৱei haiche supratiSThita dvIna; kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei seYA nAjAne|
tomAloke vizuddhacitte teOMrei abhimukhI hoৱA, keৱla teOMrei tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru chAlAta kAYema karA; lagate muzvarikasakalara antarbhukta naha’vA|
