yisakale nijara dvInaka vibhakta kariche Aru vibhinna dalata pariNata haiche (siha~taro antarbhukta naha'vA)| pratyeka dalei siha~tara ocarata yi Ache seiToka laiYe utphullita|

Aru mAnuhaka yetiYA dukha-dainyai sparza kare tetiYA siha~te nija pratipAlakara pine vinItabhAৱe ubhati Ahi keৱla teOMkei AhvAna kare| tAra pichata yetiYA teOM siha~taka nija anugrahara soৱAda lavalai diYe, tetiYA siha~tara eTA dale nija pratipAlakara lagata zvirka kare;
eidare Ami siha~taka yi pradAna karicho~, tAra prati siha~te akRtajJa haYa| eteke tomAloke bhoga kari loৱA, zIghrei tomAloke jAniva pArivA (iYAra pariNAma ki ha’va)!
Ami siha~tara ocaralai enekuৱA kono pramANa aৱtIrNa karicho~ neki, yiToৱe siha~taka zvirka karivalai kaYa?
Aru yetiYA Ami mAnuhaka rahamatara soৱAda lavalai diOM tetiYA siha~te seiToka lai utphullita haYa Aru yadi siha~tara kRtakarmara phalata kono aniSTa sAdhana haYa, tente siha~ta nirAza hai pare|

siha~te lakSya karA nAine ye, AllAhe yAka icchA kare tAra vAve jIৱikA prazasta kari diYe athavA saMkucita kari diYe? nizcaYa iYAta vahuto nidarzana Ache sei sampradAYara vAve yisakale ImAna poSaNa kare|

eteke AtmIYa-svajanaka siha~tara prApya pradAna karA lagate michakIna Aru muchAphirasakaloko| yisakale AllAhara santuSTi kAmanA kare teOMlokara vAve eiTo ati uttama Aru teOMlokei haiche sAphalyamaNDita|

Aru mAnuhara sampada vRddhi pAva vuli tomAloke yi suta pradAna karA, AllAhara dRSTita kintu seYA dhana-sampada vRddhi nakare| AnahAte AllAhara santuSTi lAbhara vAve tomAloke yi yAkAta pradAna karA (seiToৱehe sampada vRddhi kare) eteke teOMlokehe prakRta samRddhazAlI|

AllAhei sei sattvA yijane tomAlokaka sRSTi kariche tAra pichata tomAlokaka jIৱikA dAna kariche| teৱe~i tomAlokara mRtyu ghaTAva tAra pichata teৱe~i Akau tomAlokaka jIৱita kariva| tomAloke aMzI karA vilAkara mAjata enekuৱA konovA Ache neki yijane eivorara kivA eTA kariva pAre? siha~te yivora aMzI kare teOM seivorara parA paৱitra mahimAmaYa Aru ati urddhata|
mAnuhara kRtakarmara phalatei sthalata Aru sAgarata viparyaYe dekhA diche; phalata teOM siha~taka siha~tare kichumAna kAmara zAsti AsvAdana karAYa, yAte siha~te (satpathalai) ubhati Ahe|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke pRthiৱIta bhramaNa karA Aru coৱA pUrvaৱrtIsakalara pariNAma ki haichila!’ siha~tara adhikAMzai Achila muzvarika|
eteke tumi AllAhara taraphara parA sei dina ahAra pUrvei, sarala-saThika dvInara oparata nijake pratiSThita rakhA, yiTo dina anivArya| sei dinA mAnuha vibhakta hai pariva|
yiYe kupharI kare, kupharIra zAsti tArei prApya; Aru yisakale satkarma kare teOMloke nijara vAvei racanA kare sukha-zayyA|
kAraNa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche AllAhe teOMlokaka nija anugrahere puraskRta kariva| nizcaYa teOM kAphirasakalaka pachanda nakare|

Aru teOMra nidarzanasamUhara mAjata eiToo eTA ye, teৱe~i (varaSuNara pUrve) susaMvAdavAhIrUpe vatAha preraNa kare, yAte tomAlokaka teOMra kichumAna rahamata AsvAdana karoৱAva pAre, lagate yAte teOMra nirdezata nauyAnasamUhaka calAcala karoৱAva pAre Aru yAte tomAloke teOMra anugrahara sandhAna kariva pArA, lagate yAte tomAloke kRtajJa hoৱA|

nizcaYa Ami tomAra pUrve rAchulasakalaka teOMlokara nija nija sampradAYara ocaralai preraNa karichilo~| eteke teOMloke siha~tara ocaralai suspaSTa pramANAdi lai Ahichila, phalata Ami aparAdhIvilAkara parA pratizodha laichilo~| AmAra dAYitva keৱla muminasakalaka sahAYa karA|

AllAhei sei sattvA yijane vatAha preraNa kare, phalata i meghamAlAka saJcAlita kare, tAra pichata teOM iYAka yenekai icchA kare AkAzata prasArita kari diYe, Aru iYAka khaNDa-vikhaNDa kari diYe, phalata tumi dekhivalai poৱA tAra mAjara parA olAi Ahe varaSuNara TopAla, tAra pichata teOM yetiYA iYAka teOMra vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yisakalara prati icchA kare pau~cAi diYe, tetiYA teOMloka Anandita haYa,
yadio teOMloke teOMlokara prati varaSuNa nahAra pUrve ekAnta nirAza hai parichila|
eteke tumi AllAhara anugrahara phala samparke cintA karA, kidare teOM mRta bhUmika punarjIৱita kare| nizcaYa eidarei AllAhe mRtaka jIৱita kariva, Aru teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
Aru yadi Ami enekuৱA vatAha preraNa karo~ yAra phalata siha~te dekhivalai pAYa ye, zasya hAladhIYA raM dhAraNa kariche, tetiYA siha~ta akRtajJa hai pare|
eteke nizcaYa tumi mRtaka zunAva noৱArivA, vadhiroko AhvAna zunAva noৱArivA, yetiYA siha~ta pRSThapradarzana kari guci yAYa|

Aru tumi andhavilAkako siha~tara pathabhraSTatAra parA hidAYatalai Aniva noৱArivA| yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhara prati ImAna poSaNa kare keৱla teOMlokakei tumi zunAva pArivA; kAraNa teOMlokei AtmasamarpaNakArI|

AllAhei sei sattvA yijane tomAlokaka sRSTi kare durvalarUpe, Aru teৱe~i durvalatAra pichata zakti dAna kare; zaktira pichata Akau durvalatA Aru vArdhakya diYe| teOM yi icchA kare seiToৱe sRSTi kare Aru teৱe~i sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|
Aru yidinA kiYAmata saMghaTita ha'va seidinA aparAdhIvilAke zapata khAi ka'va ye, siha~te (pRthiৱIta) eTA muhUrtara vechi samaYa aৱsthAna karA nAchila| eidarei siha~te pathabhraSTa haichila|

AnahAte yisakalaka jJAna Aru ImAna diYA haiche teOMloke ka’va, ‘nizcaYa tomAloke AllAhara likhita (myAda) anuyAYI punarutthAnara diৱsalaike aৱsthAna karichA| eteke eiToৱei haiche punarutthAnara diৱsa; kintu tomAloke janA nAchilA’|
eteke yisakale anyAYa kariche seidinA siha~tara ojara-Apatti siha~tara kono kAmata nAhiva Aru siha~taka tiraSkRta hoৱAra (mAdhyamata AllAhara santuSTi lAbhara) suyogo diYA naha’va|

Aru nizcaYa Ami ei koraAnata mAnuhara vAve sakalo dharaNara dRSTAnta dAGi dharicho~| tumi yadi siha~tara ocarata kono nidarzana upasthita karA, tente yisakale kupharI kariche siha~te aৱzye ka’va, ‘tomAloka haichA vAtilapanthI’|
eidarei AllAhe mohara mAri diYe seisakala lokara antarata, yisakale jJAna nArAkhe|
eteke tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA, nizcaYa AllAhara pratizruti satya| lagate yisakale dRDha় vizvAsI nahaYa, siha~te yena tomAka vicalita kariva noৱAre|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|[1]
eivora haiche prajJApUrNa kitAvara AYAta,
satkarmazIlasakalara vAve hidAYata Aru rahamatasvarUpa,
yisakale chAlAta kAYema kare Aru yAkAta pradAna kare Aru teOMlokei AkhirAtara prati nizcita vizvAsa sthApana kare|
teOMlokei nija pratipAlakara nirdezita hidAYatara oparata Ache Aru teOMlokei haiche sAphalyamaNDita|

Aru mAnuhara mAjata kichumAna enekuৱA mAnuho Ache yisakale AllAhara pathata vAdhA diYAra vAve asAra vAkya kini laYa, vinA jJAne Aru AllAhe dekhuৱA pathaka ThATTA-vidrUpa kare| siha~tara vAvei Ache aৱmAnanAkara zAsti|

Aru yetiYA tAra ocarata AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karA haYa tetiYA si ahaMkArata mukha ghUrAi niYe yenivA si eiTo zunAi poৱA nAi, yenivA tAra duYo kANa vadhira; eteke tAka yantraNAdAYaka zAstira saMvAda diYA|
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMlokara vAve Ache niYAmatapUrNa jAnnAta;
tAta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va| AllAhara pratizruti satya| teOM mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

teৱe~i AkAzasamUha nirmANa kariche khuTAvihIna, tomAloke seikhanaka dekhi AchA, teৱe~i pRthiৱIta sthApana kariche sudRDha় parvatamAlA, yAte pRthiৱIYe tomAlokaka lai Dhali napare, lagate iYAta si~carati kari diche sakalo dharaNara jIৱ-jantu| AmiYei AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa karo~ tAra pichata iYAta utpanna karo~ nAnA prakArara kalyANakara udbhida|
eivora haiche AllAhara sRSTi| eteke teOMra vAhire Ane ki sRSTi kariche moka dekhuৱAcona? varaM yAlimasakala Ache spaSTa vibhrAntita|

Aru nizcaYa Ami lukvamAnaka hikamata dAna karichilo~ Aru kaichilo~ ye, AllAhara prati kRtajJatA prakAza karA| yiYe kRtajJatA prakAza kare si nijara kalyANara vAvei kRtajJatA prakAza kare Aru yadi konovAi akRtajJa haYa tente nizcaYa AllAha abhAৱmukta, cira prazaMsita|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA lukvamAne teOMra putraka upadeza di kaichila, ‘he mora putra! AllAhara lagata zvirka nakarivA| nizcaYa zvirka haiche mahA anyAYa’|

Aru Ami mAnuhaka tAra pitR-mAtRra prati sadAcaraNa karivalai nirdeza dicho~| tAra mAke tAka kaSTara pichata kaSTa sahya kari garbhata dhAraNa kariche, Aru tAka piYAha eroৱAvalai samaYa lAge duvachara| eteke mora prati Aru tomAra pitR-mAtRra prati kRtajJa hoৱA| pratyAৱrtana keৱla mora ocaratei|

Aru tomAra pitR-mAtRYe yadi tomAka mora lagata zvirka karivalai he~cA praYoga kare yi viSaYe tomAra kono jJAna nAi, tente tumi siha~tara kathA nAmAnivA Aru pRthiৱIta siha~tara lagata vasavAsa karivA sadbhAৱe| tumi sei vyaktira patha aৱlamvana karA, yiYe mora abhimukhI haiche| tAra pichata tomAlokara pratyAৱrtana mora ocaratei ha’va, tetiYA mai tomAlokaka sei viSaYe aৱhita karima yivora tomAloke karichilA|

‘he mora putra! nizcaYa seYA (pApa-pUNya) yadi sariYahara vIjara samAno haYa, Aru i yadi thAke zilAgarbhata athavA AkAzasamUhata nAivA pRthiৱIta, AllAhe seiToko upasthita kariva| nizcaYa AllAha sUkSmadarzI, samyaka aৱhita|

‘he mora putra! chAlAta kAYema karA, satkarmara Adeza diYA Aru asatkarmara parA niSedha karA, lagate tomAra oparata yi (vipada) Apatita haYa tAra oparata dhairyya dhAraNa karA| nizcaYa eiTo anyatama dRDha় saMkalpara kAma|
Aru tumi mAnuhara prati aৱjJA kari tomAra gAla vekA nakarivA, lagate pRthiৱIta phitAhi mAri nuphurivA; nizcaYa AllAhe kono uddhata, ahaMkArIka pachanda nakare|
Aru tumi tomAra calA-phurAra kSetrata madhyamapanthA aৱlamvana karA Aru tomAra kaNThasvara aৱnata karA, nizcaYa mAtara bhitarata ATAitakai aprItikara mAta haiche gAdhara mAta|

tomAloke lakSya karA nAine? nizcaYa AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sakalovorakei AllAhe tomAlokara kalyANata niYojita kariche Aru tomAlokara prati teOMra prakAzya Aru aprakAzya anugrahasamUha sampUrNa kariche; Aru mAnuhara mAjata kichumAna enekuৱA mAnuho Ache yisakale kono jJAna, kono pathanirdeza athavA kono dIptimAna grantha nohoৱAkai AllAha samparke vAka-vitaNDA kare|

Aru siha~taka yetiYA koৱA haYa ye, ‘AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche tomAloke seYA anusaraNa karA’| siha~te kaYa, ‘varaM Ami AmAra pitRpuruSasakalaka yiTora oparata pAicho~, Ami seiTorei anusaraNa karima’| caYatAne yadi siha~taka jvalanta juira pine AhvAna kare tathApio, (siha~te pitRpuruSasakalara anusaraNa karivane)?
Aru yiYe ekaniSTha Aru vizuddhacitte AllAhara ocarata nijake samarpana kare, teOM nizcitabhAৱe eDAla majavuta rachI dhAraNa kare; Aru yAৱtIYa karmara pariNAma AllAharei ocarata|

Aru konovAi kupharI karile, tAra kupharIYe yena tomAka cintita nakare| AmAra ocaratei siha~tara pratyAৱrtana| eteke Ami siha~taka aৱhita karima siha~te yi karichila| nizcaYa antarasamUhata yi Ache sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱgata|
Ami siha~taka alapa samaYa bhoga karivalai dima| tAra pichata Ami siha~taka kaThina zAsti bhoga karivalai vAdhya karAma|
Aru yadi tumi siha~taka sodhA, ‘AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI kone sRSTi kariche’? siha~te nizcaYa ka’va ‘AllAhe’| koৱA, ‘sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA AllAharei’| kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai nAjAne|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei; nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i abhAৱmukta, ciraprazaMsita|

Aru pRthiৱIra sakalo gacha-gachani yadi kalama haYa Aru sAgara, tAra pichata Aru sAtokhana sAgara yadi ciYA~hI haYa, tathApio AllAhara vANI zeSa naha’va| nizcaYa AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tomAloka sakalore sRSTi Aru punarutthAna, keৱla eTA prANIra sRSTi Aru punarutthAnara darei| nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA|

tumi dekhA nAine, nizcaYa AllAhei rAtika dinara mAjata praৱeza karAYa Aru dinaka rAtira mAjata praৱeza karAYa? teৱe~i candra-sUryaka tomAlokara kalyANata niYojita kariche, pratyekei vicaraNa kare eTA nirdiSTa samaYalaike| nizcaYa tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱhita|
eivorei pramANa kare ye, nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i satya Aru siha~te teOMra vAhire yivoraka AhvAna kare seivora haiche vAtila| nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i haiche sarvocca, sumahAna|

tumi lakSya karA nAine ye, AllAhara anugrahatei nauyAnasamUha sAgarata vicaraNa kare, yAte teOM tomAlokaka teOMra kichumAna nidarzana dekhuৱAva pAre? nizcaYa iYAta vahuto nidarzana Ache, pratyeka dhairyyazIla kRtajJa vyaktira vAve|

Aru yetiYA Dhauৱe siha~taka chA~ra dare Acchanna kare, tetiYA siha~te ekaniSTha aৱsthAta Anugatyara saite keৱla AllAhakei AhvAna kare| tAra pichata yetiYA teOM siha~taka uddhAra kari sthalata pau~cAi diYe tetiYA siha~tara kichumAne madhyama panthA aৱlamvana kare| Aru keৱla vizvAsaghAtaka, kAphira vyaktiYei AmAra nidarzanAৱlIka asvIkAra kare|

he mAnaৱ! tomAloke nija pratipAlakara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru bhaYa karA sei dinaToka, yidinA kono pitRYe tAra santAnara phAlara parA eko AdAYa nakariva, eidarei kono santAneo tAra pitRra phAlara parA eko AdAYa nakariva| nizcaYa AllAhara pratizruti satya, eteke pArthiৱ jIৱne yena tomAlokaka ketiYAo pratArita kariva noৱAre Aru sei pravaJcakeo yena tomAlokaka ketiYAo AllAha samparke pravaJcita kariva noৱAre|

nizcaYa AllAhara ocaratei Ache kiYAmatara saThika jJAna, teৱe~i varaSuNa aৱtIrNa kare Aru teৱe~i jAne mAtRgarbhata yi Ache| konoৱei nAjAne ahAkAli si ki upArjana kariva Aru konoৱei nAjAne kona ThAita tAra mRtyu ghaTiva| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, samyaka aৱhita|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|[1]
ei kitAva vizvajagatara pratipAlakara taraphara parA aৱtIrNa, iYAta kono sandeha nAi|

athavA siha~te ei kathA kaYa neki ye, ‘eikhana teOM nijei racanA kariche’? nahaYa, varaM ekhana haiche tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA ahA satya, yAte tumi enekuৱA eTA sampradAYaka satarka kariva pArA, yisakalara ocaralai tomAra pUrve Ana kono satarkakArI ahA nAchila, sambhaৱtaH siha~te hidAYata lAbha kariva|

AllAhei sei sattvA, yijane AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore antaৱrtI sakalo vastuka keৱla chaYa dinata sRSTi kariche| tAra pichata teOM Arachara oparata uThiche| teOMra vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono abhibhAৱka nAi Aru kono madhyastatAkArIo nAi, tathApio tomAloke upadeza grahaNa nakarivAne?

teৱe~i AkAzara parA pRthiৱIlaike sakalo viSaYa paricAlanA kare, tAra pichata sakalo viSaYa teOMra samIpatei utthita ha’va enekuৱA eTA dinata, yAra parimANa ha’va tomAlokara gaNanA anusAre ehejAra vachara|
teOM gAYeva Aru upasthita (yAৱtIYa viSaYara) jJAnI, pravala parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
yijane teOMra pratyekaTo sRSTika uttamarUpe sRjana kariche Aru vokA mATira parA mAnaৱ sRSTira sUcanA kariche|
tAra pichata teৱe~i mAnuhara vaMza utpanna kariche tuccha tarala padArthara upAdAnara parA|
tAra pichata teৱe~i tAka suThAma kariche Aru tAta teOMra rUha phu~ৱAi diche| teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve kANa, caku Aru antaHkaraNa sRSTi kariche| tomAloke khuvei kama kRtajJatA prakAza karA|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami yetiYA mATita mihali yAma tAra pichato Ami natuna sRSTirUpe utthita ha'mane’? varaM siha~te nija pratipAlakara sAkSAtaka asvIkAra kare|
koৱA, ‘mRtyura phiristAka tomAlokara vAvei niYoga karA haiche, teৱe~i tomAlokara prANa haraNa kariva| tAra pichata tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocaratei tomAlokaka obhatAi niYA ha’va’|

Aru tumi yadi dekhilAhe~tena! yetiYA aparAdhIvilAke mUra aৱnata kari ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami dekhilo~ Aru zunilo~, eteke tumi AmAka punara paThAi diYA, Ami satkarma karima, nizcaYa Ami dRDha় vizvAsI’|

Aru Ami icchA karile pratyeka vyaktikei satpathata paricAlita karilo~he~tena; kintu mora phAlara parA ei kathA nizcitabhAৱe sAvyasta ye, nizcaYa mai kichumAna jina Aru mAnuhara dvArA jAhAnnAma pUraNa karima|

eteke (siha~taka koৱA ha’va) ‘zAsti AsvAdana karA, kAraNa tomAloke Ajira ei dinaTora sAkSAtara kathA pAhari gaichilA| nizcaYa Amio tomAlokaka parityAga karilo~| tomAloke yi Amala karichilA tAra vAve tomAloke sthAYI zAsti bhoga karA’|

keৱla teOMlokei AmAra AYAtasamUhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kare, yisakale iYAra dvArA upadeza prApta ha’le chAjadAta pari yAYa Aru nija pratipAlakara prazaMsAra saite paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare, Aru teOMloke ahaMkAra nakare|
teOMloke (rAtita) zayyA tyAga kari bhaYa Aru AzAra saite nija pratipAlakaka AhvAna kare Aru Ami teOMlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ tAra parA teOMloke dAna kare|
eteke konoৱei nAjAne teOMlokara kRtakarmara puraskAra hicApe teOMlokara vAve caku jura peloৱA ki (pratidAna) lukuৱAi rakhA haiche!
eteke ejana mumina vyakti phAchikara dare ha’va pArene? teOMloka ketiYAo samAna nahaYa|
yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, teOMlokara kRtakarmara phalasvarUpe teOMlokara ApyAYanara ThikanA ha’va jAnnAta|

AnahAte yisakale pApakarma kariche siha~tara vAsasthAna ha’va jui (jAhAnnAma); yetiYAi siha~te tAra parA olAva vicAriva tetiYAi siha~taka tAlai obhatAi paThioৱA ha’va Aru siha~taka koৱA ha’va, ‘yi juira zAstika tomAloke michA pratipanna karichilA seiToka (etiYA) AsvAdana karA’|
Aru nizcaYa Ami siha~taka mahA zAstira pUrve alapa laghu zAsti AsvAdana karAma, yAte siha~te (satpathalai) ubhati Ahe|

yi vyaktiYe nija pratipAlakara AYAtasamUhara mAdhyamata upadezaprApta hoৱAra pichato tAra parA mukha ghUrAi laYa, tAtakai DAGara yAlima Aru kona ha’va pAre? nizcaYa Ami aparAdhIvilAkara parA pratizodha grahaNa karima|
Aru nizcaYa Ami muchAka kitAva pradAna karichilo~, eteke tumi teOMra sAkSAtara viSaYata sandeha poSaNa nakarivA; Aru Ami sei (kitAva)khanaka vanI icharAIlara vAve hidAYatasvarUpa kari dichilo~|

Aru Ami siha~tara mAjara parA vahu keijana netA manonIta karichilo~, teOMloke AmAra nirdeza anuyAYI satpatha pradarzana karichila, yihetu teOMloke dhairyya dhAraNa karichila; Aru teOMloke AmAra AYAtasamUhara prati dRDha় vizvAsa poSaNa karichila|
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlake kiYAmatara dinA siha~tara mAjata phaYacAlA kari diva, yivora viSaYata siha~te matavirodha karichila|

eiToৱeo siha~taka hidAYata nakarilene ye, Ami siha~tara pUrve kimAna prajanmaka dhvaMsa karicho~, yisakalara vAsabhUmita siha~te vicaraNa kari thAke? nizcaYa iYAta Ache vahuto nidarzana; tathApio siha~te nuzunivane?

siha~te lakSya karA nAine, AmiYe zukAna bhUmira oparedi pAnI pravAhita karo~| tAra pichata sei pAnIre zasya utpanna karo~, yAra parA siha~tara catuSpada jantuvore Aru siha~ta nijeo khAdya grahaNa kare? siha~te lakSya nakarene?
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘tomAloke yadi satyavAdI hoৱA tente koৱA, ketiYA ha’va ei vijaYa’?
koৱA, ‘vijaYara dinA kAphirasakalara ImAna poSaNa kono kAmata nAhiva Aru siha~taka aৱkAzao diYA naha’va’|
eteke tumi siha~taka upekSA karA Aru apekSA karA, nizcaYa siha~teo apekSA kari Ache|
he navI AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru kAphira, munAphikasakalara Anugatya nakarivA| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
Aru tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAra prati yi ahI karA haYa, keৱla tArei anusaraNa karA| nizcaYa tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱhita|
Aru tumi keৱla AllAhara oparatei bharasA karA| karmavidhAYaka hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa|

AllAhe kono mAnuharei abhyantarata duTA hRdaYa sRSTi karA nAi| tomAlokara strIsakalara mAjata yivilAkara lagata tomAloke yihAra karA, teOM siha~taka tomAlokara mAtR kari diYA nAi Aru tomAlokara tolanIYA putra vilAkako teOM tomAlokara prakRta putra kari diYA nAi| eivora haiche tomAlokara mukhara kathAhe mAtra| AllAhe keৱla satya kathAi kaYa Aru teৱe~i sarala patha dekhuৱAYa|

tomAloke siha~taka (tolanIYA putrasakalaka) siha~tara pitRra paricaYere mAtivA; AllAhara ocarata eiToৱei vechi nyAYasaMgata| eteke yadi tomAloke siha~tara pitRra paricaYa nAjAnA tente siha~ta haiche tomAlokara dvIni bhAi Aru vandhu| ei viSaYe tomAloke kono anicchAkRta bhula karile tomAlokara kono doSa nahaYa; kintu tomAlokara antare yiTo icchAkRtabhAৱe kariche (seiTo haiche aparAdha); Aru AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

muminasakalara ocarata navI haiche teOMlokara nijatakaio vechi ghaniSTha, Aru teOMra strIsakala haiche teOMlokara mAtR| AllAhara vidhAna anuyAYI mumina Aru muhAjirasakalara tulanAta AtmIYa-svajanasakala haiche parasparara vechi nikaTaৱrtI| kintu tomAloke tomAlokara vandhu-vAndhaৱra prati kalyANamUlaka kivA kariva vicArile seYA sukIYA kathA| eYA kitAvata lipivaddha Ache|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami navIsakalara parA aMgIkAra grahaNa karichilo~ Aru tomAra parAo, lagate nUha, ivrAhIma, muchA Aru IchA ivane mAraYAmara parAo (aMgIkAra laichilo~)| Ami teOMlokara parA grahaNa karichilo~ dRDha় aMgIkAra,
satyavAdIsakalaka teOMlokara satyavAditA samparke sudhivalai (ei aMgIkAra loৱA haichila), Aru teOM kAphirasakalara vAve prastuta kari rAkhiche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

he muminasakala! tomAloke tomAlokara prati thakA AllAhara anugrahasamUhara kathA smaraNa karA, yetiYA zatruvAhinI tomAlokara viruddhe samAgata haichila, tAra pichata Ami siha~tara viruddhe preraNa karichilo~ ghUrNIvatAha lagate enekuৱA sainyavAhinI yivoraka tomAloke dekhA poৱA nAchilA| tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka draSTA|

yetiYA siha~te tomAlokara viruddhe samAgata haichila tomAlokara oparara parA Aru nimnaphAlara parA; tetiYA tomAlokara caku thara lAgichila Aru tomAlokara prANavora kaNThAgata hai parichila, Aru tomAloke AllAha samparke nAnAvidha dhAraNA poSaNa karichilA|
tetiYA muminasakalaka parIkSA karA haichila Aru teOMloka bhISaNabhAৱe prakampita (tathA AtaMkita) haichila|
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA munAphikasakale Aru yisakalara antarata vyAdhi Achila siha~te kaichila, ‘AllAha Aru teOMra rAchule AmAka yi pratizruti dichila seivora pratAraNAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’|

Aru yetiYA siha~tara eTA dale kaichila, ‘he iYAcharivara adhivAsIsakala! iYAta (rAchulara ocarata pratirodha karivalai) tomAlokara kono sthAna nAi| eteke tomAloke (gharalai) ubhati yoৱA’, Aru siha~tara mAjara eTA dale navIra ocarata gai avyAhati vicAri Avedana kari kaichila, ‘AmAra ghara-duৱArasamUha asurakSita (gatike AmAka ubhati yAvalai anumati diYaka)’; athaca seivora asurakSita nAchila, Acalate palAi yoৱATohe Achila siha~tara mUla uddezya|

Aru yadi vibhinna phAlara parA siha~tara viruddhe zatrusakale praৱeza karilehe~tena, tAra pichata siha~taka yadi zvirka karAra vAve AhvAna janoৱA ha’lahe~tena tente nizcaYa siha~te seYA karilehe~tena, siha~te seiTo karivalai akaNo palama nakarilehe~tena|
nizcaYa siha~te pUrvei AllAhara lagata aMgIkAra karichila ye, siha~te pRSTha pradarzana nakariva| (gatike jAni thoৱA) AllAhara lagata karA aMgIkAra samparke nizcaYa (siha~taka) javAvadihi karA ha’va|
koৱA, ‘yadi tomAloke mRtyu athavA hatyAra bhaYata palAva vicArichA, tente sei palAYana tomAlokara kono upakArata nAhiva, kintu tene kSetrata tomAlokaka akaNamAnahe bhoga karivalai suyoga diYA ha’va’|

koৱA, ‘kone tomAlokaka AllAhara parA rakSA kariva, yadi teOM tomAlokaka kono kSati kariva vicAre, nAivA tomAlokaka rahamata dAna kariva vicAre’? Aru siha~te AllAhara vAhire nijara vAve Ana kono abhibhAৱka Aru sahAYakArIo nApAva|

AllAhe nizcaYa jAne tomAlokara mAjara konavilAka loke (yuddhata aMza grahaNa karivalai) vAdhA pradAna kare Aru kona vilAke siha~tara bhAtRka kaYa, AmAra phAle guci AhA, siha~te ati sAmAnyahe yuddha kare,

tomAlokaka sahAYa-sahayogitA karAra kSetrata siha~ta kuNThita| eteke yetiYA bhaYa-bhIti (tathA vipada) Ahe tetiYA tumi dekhivA, siha~te mRtyura bhaYata mUrcchA yoৱA vyaktira dare caku oloTAi tomAra pine thara lAgi cAi Ache| kintu yetiYA vipada A~tari yAYa tetiYA siha~te dhanara lAlasAta tomAlokaka tIkSNa bhASAta viddha kare| siha~te ImAna poSaNa karA nAi, seikAraNe AllAhe siha~tara AmalasamUhaka niSphala kariche Aru eiTo AllAhara vAve ati sahaja|

siha~te bhAve ye, sanmilita vAhinI guci yoৱA nAi| yadi sanmilita vAhinI Akau Ahi pare, tetiYA siha~te kAmanA kariva ye, bhAla ha’lahe~tena yadi siha~te yAyAvara maruvAsIsakalara lagata thAki tomAlokara saMvAda lava pArilehe~tena! Aru siha~te tomAlokara lagata aৱsthAna karileo nAma mAtrahe yuddha karilehe~tena|

nizcaYa tomAlokara mAjara yisakale AllAhara (santuSTi kAmanA kare) Aru AkhirAtara (bhAla phalAphala) AzA kare, lagate AllAhaka vechi vechi smaraNa kare, teOMlokara vAve AllAhara rAchulara (caritrara) mAjata Ache uttama Adarza|

Aru muminasakale yetiYA sanmilita vAhinIka dekhA pAle, tetiYA teOMloke ka’le, ‘eiToৱei sei pratizruti yiTo AmAka AllAha Aru teOMra rAchule dichila, lagate AllAha Aru teOMra rAchule sa~cAi kaichila’| ei ghaTanAi teOMlokara ImAna Aru Anugatyahe vRddhi karile|

muminasakalara mAjara kichumAne AllAhara lagata karA teOMlokara aMgIkAra pUrNa kariche, teOMlokara kichumAne (aMgIkAra pUrNa kari) mRtyuvaraNa kariche Aru kichumAna pratIkSAta Ache| teOMloke nija aMgIkArata kono parivartana karA nAi;

yAte AllAhe satyavAdIsakalaka teOMlokara satyavAditAra vAve puraskRta kariva pAre, Aru teOM icchA karile munAphikasakalaka zAsti diva pAre nAivA siha~taka kSamA kario diva pAre| nizcaYa AllAha parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Aru AllAhe kAphirasakalaka kruddhAৱsthAta ubhati yAvalai vAdhya karile, siha~te kono kalyANa lAbha karA nAchila| yuddhata muminasakalara vAve AllAhei yatheSTa| AllAha sarvazaktimAna, pravala parAkramazAlI|

Aru kitAvIsakalara mAjara yivilAke siha~taka sahAYa karichila, AllAhe siha~taka siha~tara dUrgasamUhara parA aৱtaraNa karivalai vAdhya karile, Aru siha~tara antarasamUhata bhItira saJcAra karile| phalata tomAloke siha~tara kichu saMkhyaka lokaka hatyA karichA Aru kichumAnaka vandI karichA|

Aru teৱe~i tomAlokaka siha~tara bhUmi, ghara-duৱAra Aru siha~tara dhana-sampadara uttarAdhikArI kariche, Aru enekuৱA eTA bhUmiro (uttarAdhikArI kariche) ya’ta tomAloke etiYAo padArpaNa karA nAi; Aru AllAha sakalo vastura oparata pUrNa kSamatAৱAna|

he navI! tumi tomAra strIsakalaka koৱA, ‘tomAloke yadi pArthiৱ jIৱna Aru iYAra bhoga-vilAsitA kAmanA karA tente AhA, mai tomAlokaka bhoga-vilAsara vyaৱsthA kari diOM Aru saujanyara saite tomAlokaka vidAYa diOM|

‘AnahAte yadi tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchula, lagate AkhirAtara AvAsa kAmanA karA, tente (jAni thoৱA) tomAlokara mAjara satkarmazIla nArIsakalara vAve AllAhe prastuta kari rAkhiche mahApratidAna’|
he navI-patnIsakala! tomAlokara mAjara konovAi prakAzya azlIla kAma karile teOMra vAve zAsti vRddhi karA ha’va dviguNa Aru eiTo AllAhara vAve ati sahaja|
Aru tomAlokara mAjara yiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya kariva Aru neka Amala kariva Ami teOMka duvArakai pratidAna dima Aru Ami teOMra vAve prastuta kari rAkhicho~ sanmAnajanaka jIৱikA|

he navI-patnIsakala! tomAloka Ana Ana nArIra dare nahaYa, yadi tomAloke AllAhaka bhaYa karA tente para-puruSara lagata komala kaNThata kathA naka'vA, kAraNa ene karile yAra antarata vyAdhi Ache, si praluvdha haYa; Aru tomAloke nyAYasaMgata kathA ka'vA|

Aru tomAloke nija gharate aৱsthAna karivA| (prAka-ichalAmI) jAhelI yugara pradarzanIra dare nijake pradarzana kari nuphurivA| tomAloke chAlAta kAYema karA, yAkAta pradAna karA, lagate AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya karA| he navI-pariYAla! AllAhe tomAlokara parA keৱla apaৱitratAka dUrIbhUta kariva vicAre Aru tomAlokaka sampUrNarUpe paৱitra kariva vicAre|
AllAhara AYAta Aru hikamatara parA tomAlokara gharata yi pATha karA haYa, seikhina tomAloke smaraNa rAkhivA| nizcaYa AllAha ati sUkSmadarzI, samyaka aৱhita|

nizcaYa muchalima puruSa Aru muchalimA nArI, mumina puruSa Aru muminA nArI, Anugata puruSa Aru Anugata nArI, satyavAdI puruSa Aru satyavAdI nArI, dhairyazIla puruSa Aru dhairyazIla nArI, vinIta puruSa Aru vinIta nArI, dAnazIla puruSa Aru dAnazIla nArI, chaoma pAlanakArI puruSa Aru chaoma pAlanakArINI nArI, yaunAGga hiphAjatakArI puruSa Aru yaunAGga hiphAjatakArINI nArI, AllAhaka adhika smaraNakArI puruSa Aru AllAhaka adhika smaraNakArINI nArI, teOMlokara vAve AllAhe rAkhiche kSamA Aru mahApratidAna|

AllAha Aru teOMra rAchule kono viSaYara phaYacAlA dile, kono mumina puruSa athavA kono muminA nArIra vAve sei viSaYata teOMlokara Ana kono (siddhAnta grahaNara) adhikAra nAthAke| yiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulaka amAnya kariva, si nizcaYa spaSTabhAৱe pathabhraSTa hai yAva|

Aru smaraNa karA, AllAhe yAka anugraha kariche Aru tumio yAra prati anugraha karichA, tumi tAka kaichilA, tumi tomAra strIra lagata samparka vajAYa rakhA Aru AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| kintu tumi tomAra antarata yi gopana karichilA seYA AllAhe prakAza kari dile, tumi mAnuhaka bhaYa karichilA athaca tumi AllAhakahe vechi bhaYa karA ucita Achila| tAra pichata yAYede yetiYA nijara strIra saite vivAha-samparka chinna karile (tAlAka dile), tetiYA Ami teOMka (jaYanavaka) tomAra lagata viYA dilo~, yAte muminasakalara tolanIYA putrasakale nijara strIka tAlAka diYAra pichata siha~taka (seisakala nArIka vivAhara mAdhyamata strI hicApe grahaNa karivalai) muminasakalara kono samasyA nahaYa| AllAhara Adeza kAryakarI ha’vai|

AllAhe navIra vAve yi vidhivaddha kariche, seiTo karAta navIra kono doSa nahaYa| pUrve yisakala (navI) ativAhita haiche teOMlokara vAveo eiToৱei Achila AllAhara vidhAna| AllAhara phaYacAlA sunirdhArita, aৱzyambhAৱI|
teOMloke AllAhara vANI pracAra karichila, Aru teOMkei bhaYa karichila Aru AllAhara vAhire Ana kAko bhaYa karA nAchila| hicApa grahaNakArIrUpe AllAhei yatheSTa|
muhAmmada tomAlokara mAjara kono puruSare pitA nahaYa, varaM teOM AllAhara rAchula Aru sarvazeSa navI| AllAha sakalo viSaYe sarvajJa|
he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke AllAhaka vechi vechi smaraNa karA,
Aru puৱA-gadhUli teOMra paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karA|
teৱe~i tomAlokara prati anugraha kare Aru teOMra phiristAsakaleo tomAlokara vAve duA kare, yAte teOM tomAlokaka andhakArara parA poharalai uliYAi Ane| teOM muminasakalara prati parama daYAlu|
yidinA teOMloke AllAhara lagata sAkSAt kariva, seidinA teOMlokara abhivAdana ha’va ‘chAlAma’| teOMlokara vAve teOM prastuta kari rAkhiche sanmAnajanaka pratidAna|
he navI! nizcaYa Ami tomAka sAkSI, susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArIrUpehe preraNa karicho~;
lagate AllAhara anumatikrame teOMra phAle AhvAnakArI Aru ujjvala pradIparUpe (preraNa karicho~)|
Aru tumi muminasakalaka susaMvAda diYA ye, teOMlokara vAve AllAhara ocarata Ache mahA anugraha|
tumi kAphira Aru munAphikasakalara Anugatya nakarivA, siha~tara niryAtanaka upekSA karA Aru AllAhara oparatei bharasA karA| karmavidhAYaka hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa|

he ImAndArasakala! yetiYA tomAloke muminA nArIsakalaka viYA karivA, tAra pichata siha~taka sparza karAra Agate (yadi siha~taka) tAlAka diYA tente tomAlokara vAve siha~tara pAlanIYa kono iddata nAi, yiTo tomAloke gaNanA karA| ene kSetrata tomAloke siha~taka kichu parimANa sAmagrI pradAna karivA Aru saujanyara saite siha~taka vidAYa karivA|

he navI! Ami tomAra vAve vaidha karicho~ tomAra strIsakalaka, yisakalaka tumi mohara pradAna karichA; Aru vaidha karicho~ 'phAYa' hicApe AllAhe tomAka yi pradAna kariche siha~tara mAjara parA yisakala tomAra mAlikAnAdhIna haiche| lagate vivAhara vAve vaidha karicho~ tomAra dadAi-varapAira jIYekaha~taka, jeThAi-pehIra jIYekaha~taka, momAYerara jIYekaha~taka Aru tomAra jeThAi-mAhIra jIYekaha~taka, yisakale tomAra lagata hijarata kariche lagate enekuৱA mumina nArIsakaloko (vivAhara vAve vaidha karicho~) yiYe navIra vAve nijake samarpaNa kare, yadihe navIYe teOMka viYA karAva vicAre; ei vidhAna vizeSakai tomAra vAve (nirdiSTa), anyAnya muminasakalara vAve nahaYa; yAte tomAra kono asuvidhA nahaYa| sarvasAdhAraNa muminasakalara vAve teOMlokara strI Aru dAsIvilAkara viSaYe Ami yi vidhi nirdhAraNa karicho~ seYA AmAra janA Ache| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tumi siha~tara mAjara parA yAka icchA tomAra ocarara parA dUraita rAkhiva pArA Aru yAka icchA tomAra ocarata sthAna diva pArA| tumi yAka dUraita rAkhichA tAka kAmanA karile tomAra kono aparAdha nAi| ei vidhAna eivAve ye, ene karile siha~tara caku jura parAra vechi sambhAৱnA thAkiva Aru siha~te dukha nApAva Aru siha~taka tumi yi pradAna karivA seiTotei siha~ta pratyekei santuSTa hai thAkiva| tomAlokara antarata yi Ache AllAhe seYA jAne Aru AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

iYAra pichata tomAra vAve Ana kono nArI vaidha nahaYa Aru tomAra strIsakalara parivarte Ana kono strI grahaNa karAo vaidha nahaYa, yadio siha~tara saundaryai tomAka mugdha kare; kintu tomAra adhikArabhukta dAsIsakalara vAhire| AllAha sakalo vastura oparata tIkSNa paryavekSaNakArI|

he muminasakala! tomAloke navIra gharasamUhata vinA anumatita praৱeza nakarivA, aৱzye yadi tomAlokaka khoৱAra anumati diYA haYa tente (ene samaYata) praৱeza karA yAte khoৱAra vAve apekSA karivalagIYA nahaYa| eteke yetiYA tomAlokaka nimantraNa karA ha’va tetiYA tomAloke praৱeza karivA, kintu khoৱA zeSa ha’lei tomAloke guci yAvA, kathA-vatarAta vyasta naha’vA| nizcaYa tomAlokara ei AcaraNe navIka kaSTa diYe, kAraNa teOM tomAlokaka uThAi divalai saMkoca vodha kare| kintu AllAhe satya kathAta saMkoca vodha nakare| tomAloke teOMra patnIsakalara parA kivA vicArile pardAra A~rara parA vicArivA| ei vidhAna tomAlokara Aru teOMlokara hRdaYara vAve vechi paৱitra| AllAhara rAchulaka kaSTa diYATo tomAlokara vAve ucita nahaYa Aru teOMra mRtyura pichata teOMra strIsakalaka viYA karAToo tomAlokara vAve ketiYAo vaidha nahaYa| nizcaYa AllAhara ocarata eiTo haiche eTA mahA aparAdha|
yadi tomAloke kivA prakAza karA athavA gopana karA (tente jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvajJa|

navIra strIsakalara vAve teOMlokara pitRvarga, putrasakala, bhAtRsakala, bhatijAsakala, bhAginasakala, lagara tirotAsakala Aru teOMlokara dAsa-dAsIsakalara sanmukhata seYA pAlana nakarATo kono aparAdha nahaYa| he navIra patnIsakala! AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo viSaYe samyaka pratyakSadarzI|

nizcaYa AllAhe navIra prati anugraha kare Aru teOMra phiristAsakaleo navIra vAve duA Aru ichatigaphAra kare| he ImAndArasakala! tomAlokeo navIra prati daruda pATha karA Aru teOMka yathAyathabhAৱe chAlAma janoৱA|
nizcaYa yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulaka kaSTa diYe, AllAhe siha~taka pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtata abhisampAta kariche Aru teOM siha~tara vAve prastuta kari rAkhiche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
Aru yisakale mumina puruSa Aru muminA nArIsakalaka vinA aparAdhata (yiTo siha~te karA nAi tAra vAve) kaSTa diYe, nizcaYa siha~te apavAda Aru suspaSTa gunAhara vojA vahana kariche|

he navI! tumi tomAra strIsakalaka, tomAra jIYArIsakalaka Aru muminasakalara strIsakalaka koৱA, teOMloke yena teOMlokara cAdarara kichu aMza nijara oparata TAni laYa| eiTo haiche teOMlokaka cini poৱAra sahaja upAYa, phalata teOMlokaka virakta karA naha'va| AllAha parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

yadi munAphikasakala Aru yisakalara antarata vyAdhi Ache siha~te Aru caharata michA saMvAda pracArakArIsakale virata nahaYa tente nizcaYa Ami tomAka siha~tara viruddhe pravala karima; iYAra pichata ei caharata siha~te tomAra prativezIrUpe ati kama samaYahe thAkiva pAriva,
abhizapta hai; siha~taka ya’te poৱA yAva ta’tei karAYatta karA ha’va Aru nirdaYabhAৱe hatyA karA ha’va|
pUrve yisakala ativAhita haiche siha~tara viSaYeo eiToৱei Achila AllAhara nIti| tumi ketiYAo AllAhara nItita kono parivartana nApAvA|
mAnuhe tomAka kiYAmata samparke prazna kare| koৱA, ‘iYAra prakRta jJAna keৱla AllAhara ocaratahe Ache’| kihe tomAka janAva? sambhaৱtaH kiYAmata ati zIghrei ha’va pAre|
nizcaYa AllAhe kAphirasakalaka abhizapta kariche Aru siha~tara vAve prastuta kari rAkhiche jvalanta jui;
tAta siha~te cirasthAYI ha’va Aru siha~te kono abhibhAৱko nApAva Aru kono sahAYakArIo nApAva|
yidinA siha~tara mukhamaNDala juita olaTa-pAlaTa karA ha'va, seidinA siha~te ka'va, hAYa! Ami yadi AllAhaka mAnilo~he~tena Aru rAchulara Anugatya karilo~he~tena!
siha~te Aru ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami AmAra netRvarga Aru viziSTa lokasakalarahe Anugatya karichilo~ Aru siha~tei AmAka pathabhraSTa karichila;
‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi siha~taka dviguNa zAsti diYA, lagate siha~taka mahA abhisampAta diYA’|

he ImAndArasakala! muchAka yisakale kaSTa diche tomAloke siha~tara dare naha'vA, eteke siha~te yi raTanA karichila AllAhe teOMka tAra parA nirdoSa pramANita karichila; Aru teOM Achila AllAhara ocarata maryAdAৱAna|
he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru saThika kathA koৱA;

tetiYAhe teOM tomAlokara vAve tomAlokara AmalasamUha saMzodhana kariva Aru tomAlokara pApasamUha kSamA kari diva| yi vyaktiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya kare, teOM nizcaYa mahA saphalatA arjana kariva|

nizcaYa Ami AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru parvatamAlAra pratio ei AmAnatara prastAৱ dichilo~ kintu siha~te ei (dAYitvabhAra) vahana karivalai asvIkAra karile Aru seYA la’valaio bhaYa karile Aru mAnuhe seYA vahana karile; nizcaYa si atyanta yAlima, ati ajJa|

yAte AllAhe munAphika puruSa Aru munAphikA nArI, lagate muzvarika puruSa Aru muzvarikA nArIka zAsti diva pAre Aru mumina puruSa Aru muminA nArIka kSamA kariva pAre| AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAhara vAve, AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache teৱe~i sei sakalovorara mAlika Aru AkhirAtato sakalo prazaMsA teOMrei| teOM prajJAmaYa, samyaka aৱhita|
teOM jAne mATita yi praৱeza kare Aru tAra parA yi olAYa, lagate AkAzara parA yi aৱtIrNa haYa Aru yi tAlai ArohaNa kare| teOM parama daYAlu, ati kSamAzIla|

Aru kAphirasakale kaYa, ‘AmAra ocaralai kiYAmata nAhiva’| koৱA, ‘nizcaYa Ahiva, zapata mora pratipAlakara! nizcaYa tomAlokara ocaralai Ahiva’| teOM gAYeva samparke samyaka parijJAta; AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta aNu parimANa kono vastu athavA tAtakaio saru vA DAGara ekoৱei teOMra agocara nahaYa; pratiTo vastuৱei suspaSTa kitAvata lipivaddha Ache|
yAte teOM seisakala lokaka pratidAna diva pAre, yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche| teOMlokara vAvei Ache kSamA Aru sanmAnajanaka jIৱikA|
Aru yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka vyartha karAra ceSTA kare, siha~tara vAve Ache bhaYaMkara yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Aru yisakalaka jJAna diYA haiche, teOMloke jAne ye, tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlai yi aৱtIrNa haiche seYA satya; Aru eikhane parAkramazAlI prazaMsita AllAhara patha dekhuৱAYa|

Aru kAphirasakale kaYa, ‘Ami tomAlokaka enekuৱA ejana vyaktira sandhAna dimane? yiYe tomAlokaka saMvAda diva ye, tomAlokara zarIra yetiYA sampUrNarUpe chinna vicchinna hai yAva, tetiYA tomAloka nizcaYa Akau natunakai sRSTi karA ha’va’!
si AllAha samparke michA udbhAৱna kare neki, ne tAra mAjata unmAdanA Ache? varaM yisakale AkhirAtara prati vizvAsa nakare siha~te zAsti Aru ghora vibhrAntira mAjata Ache|

siha~taka AgaphAlara parA Aru pichaphAlara parA Aguri rakhA AkAzara prati Aru pRthiৱIra prati siha~te lakSya karA nAine? Ami icchA karile siha~taka mATisaha puti diva pAro~ athavA siha~tara oparata AkAzara parA eTA TukurA pelAva pAro~| nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, pratyeka AllAha abhimukhI vAndAra vAve|

Aru nizcaYa Ami AmAra phAlara parA dAudaka maryAdA pradAna karichilo~, Aru Adeza karichilo~, he parvatamAlA! tomAloke dAudara saite vAre vAre mora paৱitratA ghoSaNA karA Aru carAivorako (Ami ei Adeza karichilo~)| lagate teOMra vAve Ami lohAka komala kari dichilo~,
(ei nirdeza pradAna kari ye) tumi paripUrNarUpe varma taiYAra karA Aru yathArtha parimANata prastuta karA; Aru tomAloke satkarma karA| tomAloke yi karA nizcaYa mai tAra samyaka draSTA|

Aru vatAhaka chulAimAnara adhIna kari dichilo~, yiTo rAtipuৱA emAhara patha atikrama karichila Aru gadhUlio emAhara patha atikrama karichila| Ami teOMra vAve galita tAmara eTA prasraৱna pravAhita karichilo~ Aru enekuৱA kichumAna jinaka teOMra anugata kari dichilo~ yivilAke teOMra pratipAlakara anumatikrame teOMra sanmukhata kAma karichila| siha~tara mAjara yiYe AmAra nirdeza amAnya kariva, Ami tAka jvalanta juira zAsti AsvAdana karAma|

siha~te chulAimAnara icchAnuyAYI teOMra vAve aTTAlikA, bhAskarya, jalAdhAra sadRza vRhadAkArara pAtra Aru sudRDha়bhAৱe sthApita Dega nirmANa karichila| ‘he dAuda-pariYAla! kRtajJatAra saite tomAloke kAma kari yoৱA| mora vAndAsakalara mAjara mAtra kichu saMkhyakahe kRtajJa!’

eteke yetiYA Ami chulAimAnara mRtyu ghaTAlo~, tetiYA jinavilAkaka teOMra mRtyu samparke aৱgata karoৱAichila mATira paruৱAYa, yivore teOMra lAkhuTiDAla khAi Achila| phalata teOM yetiYA mATita vAgari parila, tetiYA jinavilAke vujiva pArile ye, yadi siha~te gAYeva jAnilehe~tena, tente siha~te lAJchanAdAYaka zAstita Aৱddha nAthAkilahe~tena|

nizcaYa chAvAra adhivAsIsakalara vAve siha~tara vAsa bhUmita Achila eTA nidarzana, dukhana udyAna, ekhana so~phAle Aru ekhana vAOMphAle| koৱA haichila, tomAloke tomAlokara pratipAlake diYA jIৱikA bhoga karA Aru teOMra prati kRtajJatA prakAza karA| uttama nagara Aru kSamAzIla pratipAlaka,

tathApio siha~ta avAdhya ha’la| phalata Ami siha~tara oparata pravAhita karilo~ vAndha-bhaGgA DhalapAnI Aru siha~tara udyAna dukhanaka parivartana kari dilo~ enekuৱA dukhana udyAnalai, ya’ta utpanna haYa titA-kehA phala-mUla, jhAugacha Aru sAmAnya keijopAmAna vagarI gacha|
sei zAsti Ami siha~taka dichilo~ siha~tara kupharIra kAraNe| akRtajJasakalara vAhire Ana kAko Ami enekuৱA zAsti nidiOM|

siha~taka lagate Aru yivora janapadara mAjata Ami varakata dichilo~, seivorara madhyaৱrtI sthAnata Ami dRzyamAna vahuto janapada sthApana karichilo~, Aru seivora janapadalai bhramaNara vAve yathAyatha vyaৱsthAo kari dichilo~| kaichilo~, ‘tomAloke eivora janapadata dine-rAti (yetiYA icchA tetiYAi) nirApade bhramaNa karA’|

tAra pichata siha~te ka’le, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra bhramaNara duratva dIrgha kari diYA’| siha~te nijare prati anyAYa karichila| phalata Ami siha~taka kAhinIra viSaYa vastuta pariNata karilo~ Aru siha~taka sampUrNarUpe chinna-vicchinna kari dilo~| nizcaYa iYAta Ache nidarzana, pratyeka dhairyazIla, kRtajJa vyaktira vAve|
Aru nizcaYa siha~tara viSaYe ivalIche tAra dhAraNA satya pramANa karile, phalata siha~tara mAjara eTA mumina dalara vAhire sakaloৱe tAra anusaraNa karichila;

Aru siha~tara oparata caYatAnara kono Adhipatya nAchila| kintu kone AkhirAtara prati ImAna poSaNa kare Aru kone ei viSaYe sandeha poSaNa kare, seYA prakAza karAToৱei Achila AmAra uddezya| tomAra pratipAlaka sakalo vastura samyaka saMrakSaNakArI|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAhara vAhire yivoraka ilAha vuli dhAraNA karichilA seivoraka mAtA| siha~te AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra aNu parimANa vasturo mAlika nahaYa| ei duYore mAjata siha~tara kono aMzao nAi Aru siha~tara mAjara parA koneo teOMra sahAYako nahaYa’|

AllAhe yAka anumati pradAna kariva, teOMra vAhire AllAhara ocarata kAro cupAricha phalaprasU naha’va| aৱzeSata yetiYA siha~tara antarara parA bhaYa vidUrita ha’va, tetiYA siha~te parasparara mAjata sodha-pocha kariva, ‘tomAlokara pratipAlake ki ka’le’? iYAra uttarata teOMloke ka’va, ‘yiTo satya seiToৱe kaiche’| teOM ati ucca, ati mahAna|

koৱA, ‘AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra parA kone tomAlokaka jIৱikA pradAna kare’? koৱA, ‘AllAha| (eiTo nizcita ye,) Ami athavA tomAloka (duYo pakSara yikono eka pakSa) nizcaYa satpathata pratiSThita Acho~ nAivA spaSTa vibhrAntita Acho~’|
koৱA, ‘AmAra aparAdhara vAve tomAlokaka prazna karA naha’va Aru tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AmAko prazna karA naha’va’|
koৱA, ‘AmAra pratipAlake AmAka sakaloke ekatrita kariva, tAra pichata teৱe~i AmAra mAjata saThikabhAৱe phaYacAlA kari diva; Aru teৱe~i zreSTha phaYacAlAkArI, sarvajJa’|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke moka dekhuৱAcona, yivoraka tomAloke teOMra aMzIdAra hicApe niyukta karichA| nahaYa, ketiYAo nahaYa| varaM teOM (ekamAtra) AllAha, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa’|
Aru Ami tomAka samagra mAnaৱ jAtira vAve keৱla susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArIrUpehe preraNa karicho~; kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei nAjAne|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘tomAloke yadi satyavAdI hoৱA tente koৱA, ei pratizruti ketiYA vAstaৱAYita ha’va’?
koৱA, ‘tomAlokara vAve Ache eTA nirdhArita dinara pratizruti, tAra parA tomAloke eka muhUrttao vilamva kariva noৱArivA, Aru tvarAnvitao kariva noৱArivA’|

yisakale kupharI kariche siha~te kaYa, "Ami ei koraAnara prati ketiYAo ImAna poSaNa nakaro~, Aru iYAra pUrvaৱrtI kono kitAvara pratio nakaro~"| hAYa! tumi yadi dekhilAhe~tena, yetiYA yAlimasakalaka siha~tara pratipAlakara sanmukhata thiYa karoৱA ha’va, tetiYA siha~te paraspare vAda-prativAda kari thAkiva, yivoraka durvala vuli bhavA haichila, siha~te ahaMkArIvilAkaka ka’va, ‘tomAloka nAthAkile Ami nizcaYa mumina ha’lo~he~tena!’
yisakale ahaMkArI Achila, siha~te durvala kari rakhA vilAkaka ka’va, ‘tomAlokara ocaralai hidAYata ahAra pichata Ami tomAlokaka tAra parA nivRtta karichilo~ neki? varaM tomAlokahe aparAdhI AchilA’|

Aru yisakalaka durvala kari rakhA haichila siha~te ahaMkArakArI vilAkaka ka’va, ‘darAcalate tomAlokei dine-rAti cakrAntata lipta AchilA, yetiYA tomAloke AmAka Adeza karichilA; yAte Ami AllAhara lagata kupharI karo~ Aru teOMra vAve samakakSa (zvirka) sthApana karo~’| kintu yetiYA siha~te zAsti dekhivalai pAva, tetiYA siha~te anutApa gopana rAkhivalai yatna kariva Aru yisakale kupharI karichila Ami siha~tara DiGita zikali lagAma| siha~te yi karichila siha~taka keৱla tArei pratiphala diYA ha’va|
Ami yi janapadatei satarkakArI preraNa karicho~ tAra vittazAlI adhivAsIsakale kaiche, ‘tomAloke yi lai prerita haichA nizcaYa Ami seYA asvIkAra karo~’|
siha~te Aru kaiche, ‘Ami dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santatira phAlara parA adhika samRddhazAlI; Aru AmAka ketiYAo zAsti diYA naha’va’|
koৱA, ‘nizcaYa mora pratipAlake yAka icchA kare tAra jIৱikA vRddhi kari diYe athavA sImita kari diYe; kintu adhikAMza lokei seYA nAjAne’|

tomAlokara dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati ene kono viSaYa nahaYa yiYe tomAlokaka maryAdAra kSetrata AmAra nikaTaৱrtI kari diva; kintu yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, teOMlokei nija karmara vAve vahuguNa pratidAna lAbha kariva; Aru teOMloke suucca aTTAlikAta nirApade thAkiva|
Aru yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka vyartha karivalai ceSTA kare, siha~taka zAstira mAjata upasthita karA ha’va|

koৱA, ‘nizcaYa mora pratipAlake teOMra vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yAka icchA kare tAra jIৱikA vRddhi kari diYe Aru yAka kare icchA sImita kari diYe| tomAloke (AllAhara pathata) yi vyaYa karA, tAra vinimaYa teৱe~i pradAna kariva Aru teৱe~i zreSTha jIৱikAdAtA’|
Aru smaraNa karA, yidinA teOM siha~ta sakaloke ekatrita kariva, tAra pichata phiristAsakalaka sudhiva, ‘iha~te tomAlokara ivAdata karichila neki’?
teOMloke ka’va, ‘tumi paৱitra, mahAna! tumihe AmAra abhibhAৱka, siha~ta nahaYa; varaM siha~te jinavilAkarahe upAsanA karichila| siha~tara sarahabhAgei jinavilAkara prati ImAna poSaNa karichila|

‘phalata Aji tomAlokara kArore ijane sijanara upakAra vA apakAra karAra adhikAra nAi’| yisakale anyAYa karichila Ami siha~taka kama ye, ‘tomAloke yi agni-zAstika michA vuli asvIkAra karichilA tAre soৱAda loৱA’|

Aru siha~tara ocarata yetiYA AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karA haYa, tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘eOM ejana enekuৱA vyakti yiYe tomAlokara pUrva puruSe yAra upAsanA karichila tAra parA tomAlokaka vAdhA diva vicAre’| siha~te Aru kaYa, ‘eiTo michA udbhAৱnara vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’| kAphirasakalara ocarata yetiYA satya Ahe tetiYA siha~te kaYa, ‘eiTo eTA suspaSTa yAduhe’|
Ami siha~taka iYAra pUrve kono kitAva diYA nAchilo~, yikhana siha~te adhyaYana kariva Aru tomAra pUrve iha~tara ocarata kono satarkakArIo preraNa karA nAchilo~|

siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo asvIkAra karichila| athaca siha~taka Ami yi pradAna karichilo~, tAra daha bhAgara ebhAgo iha~te (makkAra adhivAsIsakale) poৱA nAi, iYAra pichato siha~te AmAra rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karichila| phalata AmAra pratyAkhyAna (zAsti) kenekuৱA Achila!

koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokaka keৱla eTA viSaYe upadeza dicho~, tomAloke AllAhara uddezye dujana dujanakai athavA ejana ejanakai thiYa diYA, tAra pichata tomAloke cintA-carcA kari coৱA, tomAlokara saGgIjanara mAjata kono unmAdanA nAi| teOM keৱla Asanna kaThina zAsti samparke tomAlokara vAve mAthona ejana satarkakArIhe’|
koৱA, ‘yadi mai tomAlokara ocarata kono pArizramika vicAro~ tente seYA keৱla tomAlokara vAvei; mora puraskAra Ache keৱla AllAhara ocarata Aru teOM sakalo vasture pratyakSakArI’|
koৱA, ‘nizcaYa mora pratipAlake satyara dvArA AghAta kare, teৱe~i yAৱtIYa gAYevara samyaka jJAnI’|
koৱA, ‘satya Ahiche, gatike (jAni thoৱA) asatyai natuna eko sRSTi kariva noৱAre Aru punarAvRttio kariva noৱAre’|

koৱA, ‘mai vibhrAnta ha’le vibhrAntira pariNAma maYe pAma, Aru yadi mai hidAYataprApta haOM tente keৱla eikAraNe ye, mora pratipAlake mora prati ahI preraNa kare| nizcaYa teOM sarvazrotA, ati nikaTaৱrtI’|
yadi tumi dekhilAhe~tena yetiYA siha~te bhIta-vihvala hai pariva, tetiYA siha~te avyAhati nApAva Aru siha~taka ati ocarara parA karAYatta karA ha’va,
Aru siha~te ka’va, ‘Ami iYAra prati ImAna Anilo~’| kintu imAna dUraৱrtI sthAnara parA siha~te (ImAnaka) laga pAva kenekai?
athaca itipUrve siha~te iYAka asvIkAra karichila; Aru siha~te dUraৱrtI sthAnara parA gAYevara viSaYe veYA mantavya poSaNa karichila|

siha~ta Aru siha~tara AzA-AkAMkSAra mAjata antarAYa sRSTi kari diYA haiche, yenekai itipUrve siha~tara samapanthIsakalara kSetrata karA haichila| nizcaYa siha~ta Achila vibhrAntikara sandehara mAjata|

sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sRSTikartA AllAhara vAvei, yijane phiristAsakalaka vANIvAhakarUpe niYoga kariche, teOMloka (phiristAsakala) haiche dukhana dukhana, tinikhana tinikhana Aru cArikhana cArikhana DeukA viziSTa| teৱe~i sRSTira mAjata yi icchA kare vRddhi kare| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
AllAhe mAnuhara vAve yi anugraha mukali kari diYe tAka rodha karivalai kono nAi, AnahAte teOM yiToka rodha kare seiToka mukali karivalaio kono nAi| teOM parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he mAnaৱ! tomAlokara prati AllAhe karA anugrahavoraka smaraNa karA| AllAhara vAhire Ana kono sraSTA Ache neki, yiYe tomAlokaka AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra parA jIৱikA dAna kare? AllAhara vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| eteke tomAlokaka ka’lai obhatAi niYA haiche?
Aru yadi iha~te tomAka avizvAsa kare tente (jAni thoৱA) tomAra pUrveo rAchulasakalaka avizvAsa karA haichila| AllAhara ocaratei sakalo viSaYa pratyAৱrtita ha’va|
he mAnaৱ! nizcaYa AllAhara pratizruti satya; seYe pArthiৱ jIৱne yena tomAlokaka ketiYAo pratArita kariva noৱAre Aru sei pratArakeo (caYatAneo) yena tomAlokaka AllAhara viSaYe pratAraNA kariva noৱAre|
nizcaYa caYatAna haiche tomAlokara zatru; eteke tAka zatru vuliYei manata rAkhivA| si tAra dalaka eikAraNe AhvAna kare yAte siha~te prajjalita juira adhivAsI ha’va pAre|
yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara vAve Ache kaThina zAsti; Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMlokara vAve Ache kSamA Aru mahApuraskAra|

kArovAka yadi tAra veYA karma zobhanIYa kari dekhuৱA haYa phalata si seiToka uttama vuli bhAve, (seijana vyakti teOMra dare ha’va pArene yiYe bhAla kAmaka bhAla Aru veYA kAmaka veYA vuli bhAve?) eteke nizcaYa AllAhe yAka icchA kare vibhrAnta kare Aru yAka icchA kare tAka hidAYata diYe| eteke siha~tara vAve AkSepa kari tumi nijara prANa vinAza nakarivA| siha~te yi kare nizcaYa AllAha sei samparke samyaka parijJAta|

seijanei AllAha yijane vatAha preraNa kari tAra dvArA meghamAlA saJcAlita kare| tAra pichata Ami seiToka nirjIৱ bhUkhaNDara phAle paricAlita karo~, iYAra pichata Ami tAra dvArA mRta bhUmika Akau punarjIৱita karo~| eidarei punarjIৱna saMghaTita ha’va|

yadi konovAi sanmAna vicAre (tente si AllAhara ocaratei vicarA ucita) kiYano sakalo sanmAna-pratipattira mAlika keৱla AllAhei| teOMra ocaratei sakalo bhAla kathA utthita haYa Aru teৱe~i neka Amalaka oparalai uThAi niYe| pakSAntare yisakale veYA kAmara cakrAnta kare siha~tara vAve Ache kaThina zAsti Aru siha~tara SaDa়yantra nizcitabhAৱe vyartha ha’va|

Aru AllAhe tomAlokaka sRSTi kariche mATira parA, tAra pichata zukravindura parA, tAra pichatahe tomAlokaka yorA yorAkai vanAiche| AllAhara ajJAte kono nArIYe garbha dhAraNo nakare Aru prasaৱo nakare| kono dIrghAYu vyaktira AYu vRddhi karA nahaYa Aru tAra AYu hrAsa karAo nahaYa, kintu seYA Ache ekhana granthata (lipivaddha)| nizcaYa eYA AllAhara vAve ati sahaja|

Aru duYokhana sAgara samAna nahaYaH ekhanara pAnI miThA, susvAdu; Anakhanara pAnI luNIYA, keheTA| pratikhanara parA tomAloke tAjA mAMsa (mAcha) khoৱA Aru AharaNa karA alaMkAra, yivora tomAloke paridhAna karA| lagate tomAloke tAta dekhivalai poৱA vuku bhedi calAcala karA jAhAjavoraka, (yivorata ArohaNa kari) tomAloke teOMra anugraha sandhAna kariva pArA, lagate yAte tomAloke kRtajJatA prakAza kariva pArA|

teৱe~i rAtika dinara mAjata praৱeza karAYa Aru dinaka praৱeza karAYa rAtira mAjata, teৱe~i sUryya Aru candraka kariche niYamAdhIna; pratyekaToৱe paribhramaNa kare eTA nirdiSTa samaYalaike| teৱe~i AllAha tomAlokara pratipAlaka| Adhipatya teOMrei| tomAloke teOMra parivarte yivoraka AhvAna karA siha~te khejura guTira oparata thakA pAtala AৱraNa eTAro adhikArI nahaYa|

tomAloke siha~taka AhvAna karile siha~te tomAlokara AhvAna zunA nApAYa Aru zunA pAleo tomAlokara AhvAnara ketiYAo sa~hAri diva noৱAre| tomAloke ye siha~taka aMzI karichA seYA kiYAmatara dinA siha~te asvIkAra kariva| sarvajJa AllAhara dare koneo tomAka aৱhita kariva noৱAre|
he mAnaৱ! tomAlokehe AllAhara mukhApekSI; Aru AllAha, teৱe~i abhAৱmukta, prazaMsita|
teOM icchA karile tomAlokaka apasArita kariva pAre Aru eTA natuna sRSTi lai Ahiva pAre|
Aru eiTo AllAhara vAve eko TAna kAma nahaYa|

Aru kono vahanakArIYei Anara vojA vahana nakariva, Aru konovA bhArAkrAnta vyaktiYe yadi tAra vojA vahana karivalai kArovAka mAte tathApio tAra vojAra kono aMzai vahana karA naha’va, Anaki tAra nikaTa AtmIYa ha’leo nakariva| tumi keৱla teOMlokakahe satarka kariva pArivA yisakale nija pratipAlakaka nedekhAkaiYe bhaYa kare Aru chAlAta kAYema kare| yiYe nijake parizuddhi kare, teOM nijara kalyANara vAvei parizuddhi kare| pratyAৱrtana keৱla AllAhara phAlei|
andha Aru dRSTisampanna vyakti ketiYAo samAna nahaYa,
andhakAra Aru poharo samAna nahaYa,
zItala chA~ Aru prakhara ra’do samAna nahaYa,
Aru samAna nahaYa jIৱita Aru mRtasakala| nizcaYa AllAhe yAka icchA kare zunAYa, kintu yisakala vyakti kavarata Ache tumi siha~taka ketiYAo zunAva noৱArivA|
tumi keৱla ejana satarkakArIhe|
nizcaYa Ami tomAka satya sahakAre preraNa karicho~ susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArIrUpe; Aru ene kono jAti nAi yAra ocaralai satarkakArI ahA nAi|

Aru siha~te yadi tomAka avizvAsa kare tente (jAni thoৱA) siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo avizvAsa karichila, siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara rAchulasakale suspaSTa pramANAdi tathA granthAdi Aru dIptimAna kitAva lai Ahichila|
tAra pichata yisakale kupharI karichila Ami siha~taka zAsti vihichilo~| eteke (coৱA) kenekuৱA Achila mora pratyAkhyAna (zAsti)!

tumi dekhA nAine, AllAhe AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa kare, tAra pichata Ami tAra dvArA vibhinna raGara phalamUla utpanna karo~| pAhArara mAjato Ache vibhinna varNara stara, zubhra, raGA Aru gADha় ka’lA|

Aru eidare mAnuhara mAjata, vicaraNazIla prANI Aru catuSpada jantura mAjato Ache nAnA varNa| AllAhaka keৱla teOMra jJAnI vAndAsakalei bhaYa kare| nizcaYa AllAha pravala parAkramazAlI, parama kSamAzIla|

nizcaYa yisakale AllAhara kitAva tilAৱta kare Aru chAlAta kAYema kare, Aru Ami teOMlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ tAra parA gopane Aru prakAzyarUpe dAna-khaYarAta kare, teOMlokei AzA kare enekuৱA vyaৱsAYara, yiTo ketiYAo dhvaMsa nahaYa|
yAte AllAhe teOMlokaka teOMlokara pUrNa pratiphala dAna kare Aru nija anugrahata Aru vaDha়Ai diYe| nizcaYa teOM parama kSamAzIla, mahAguNagrAhI|

Aru Ami kitAvara parA tomAra prati yi ahI preraNa karicho~ seYA satya, iYAra pUrve yivora (grantha) diYA haichila, eikhana haiche seivorara samarthaka| nizcaYa AllAha teOMra vAndAsakalara viSaYe samyaka aৱhita, srarvadraSTA|

tAra pichata Ami kitAvara adhikArI karilo~ teOMlokaka, yisakalaka Ami AmAra vAndAsakalara mAjara parA manonIta karicho~; kintu siha~tara mAjara kichumAna Achila nijara prati atyAcArI, kichumAna madhyamapanthI Aru kichumAna Achila AllAhara icchAta kalyANara kAmata agragAmI| eiToৱei haiche mahA anugraha|
cirasthAYI jAnnAta, ya’ta teOMloke praৱeza kariva| tAta teOMlokaka soNara khAru Aru mukutAra alaMkArere alaMkRta karA ha’va Aru tAta teOMlokara pocAka ha’va khA~Ti recamara|
Aru teOMloke ka’va, ‘sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAhara vAve, yijane AmAra dukha-cintA dUrIbhUta kariche| nizcaYa AmAra pratipAlaka parama kSamAzIla, asIma guNagrAhI;
‘yijane nija anugrahata AmAka sthAYI AvAsata praৱeza karAiche, ya’ta AmAka kono viSAde sparza nakare Aru kono klAntiYeo sparza nakare’|

Aru yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara vAve Ache jAhAnnAmara jui| siha~tara prati ene kono phaYacAlA diYA naha’va, yAra phalata siha~te mRtyuvaraNa kariva, lagate siha~tara parA jAhAnnAmara zAstio lAghaৱ karA naha’va| eidarei Ami pratyeka akRtajJaka zAsti diOM|

Aru tAta siha~te ciJari ciJari ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka (iYAra parA) uliYAi niYA, Ami yi karichilo~ tAra parivarte satkarma karima’| AllAhe ka’va, ‘Ami tomAlokaka imAnakhini dIrghAYu karA nAchilo~ne ye, tetiYA konovAi upadeza grahaNa kariva vicArile upadeza grahaNa kariva pArilehe~tena, Aru tomAlokara ocarata satarkakArIo Ahichila| eteke tomAloke zAstira soৱAda loৱA, kAraNa yAlimasakalara vAve kono sahAYakArI nAi’|
nizcaYa AllAha AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra gAYeva samparke aৱgata| nizcaYa antarata yi Ache sei viSaYeo teOM samyaka parijJAta|

teৱe~i tomAlokaka pRthiৱIta sthalAbhiSikta kariche| eteke konovAi kupharI karile tAra kupharIra vAve si nijei dAYI ha’va| kAphirasakalara kupharIYe keৱla siha~tara pratipAlakara krodhahe vRddhi kare Aru kAphirasakalara kupharIYe keৱla siha~tarei kSati vRddhi kare|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAhara parivarte yivoraka AhvAna karA, sei aMzIvilAkara kathA ketiYAvA bhAvi cAichAne? siha~te pRthiৱIta kivA sRSTi kariche yadi moka dekhuৱAcona; athavA AkAzasamUhara sRSTita siha~tara kono aMza Achene vAru? nAivA Ami siha~taka ene kono kitAva dicho~ neki yAra pramANara oparata siha~te nirbhara kare’? varaM yAlimasakale ijane sijanaka pratAraNAra vAhire Ana eko pratizruti nidiYe|

nizcaYa AllAhei AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIka dhari Ache, yAte sthAnacyuta nahaYa| yadi eivora sthAnacyuta haYa tente teOMra vAhire Ana kono nAi yiYe seivoraka dhari rAkhiva pAriva| nizcaYa teOM ati sahanazIla, asIma kSamAparAYaNa|

Aru siha~te dRDha়tAra saite AllAhara zapata khAi kaichila ye, siha~tara ocaralai yadi kono satarkArI Ahe tente siha~te Ana sampradAYavilAkara tulanAta adhika Anugatyare satpatha anusaraNa kariva; kintu yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai satarkakArI Ahila, tetiYA seYA keৱla siha~tara vimukhatA Aru dUratvahe vRddhi karile,

pRthiৱIta auddhatya prakAza Aru kUTakauzala aৱlamvanara kAraNe| athaca kUTakauzale keৱla tAra udyoktAsakalakahe pariveSTana kariva| tente siha~te pUrvaৱrtIvilAkara (dare AllAhara) vidhAnara apekSA kari Ache neki? kintu tumi AllAhara paddhatita ketiYAo kono parivartana nApAvA Aru AllAhara paddhatira kono vyatikramo dekhivalai nApAvA|

Aru iha~te pRthiৱIta paribhramaNa karA nAine, tetiYAhe iha~te dekhiva pArilehe~tena ye, iha~tara pUrvaৱrtIvilAkara ki pariNAma haichila| athaca siha~ta Achila iha~tatakaio adhika zaktizAlI| AllAha enekuৱA nahaYa ye, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra konovAi teOMka akSama kariva pAriva| nizcaYa teOM sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

Aru AllAhe yadi mAnuhaka siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve karAYatta karilehe~tena, tente bhU-pRSThata kono prANIkei teOM rehAi nidilehe~tena, kintu teOM eTA nirdiSTa samaYalaike siha~taka aৱkAza diYe| eteke yetiYA siha~tara nirdiSTa samaYa Ahi pariva, (tetiYAhe teOM siha~taka karAYatta kariva) nizcaYa AllAha teOMra vAndAsakalara viSaYe samyaka draSTA|
iYA-chIna,[1]
jJAnagarbha koraAnara zapata!
nizcaYa tumi rAchulasakalara antarbhukta,
sarala pathara oparata pratiSThita|
ei koraAna pravala parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu AllAhara taraphara parA aৱtIrNa|
yAte tumi satarka kariva pArA enekuৱA eTA jAtika, yisakalara pitR-puruSasakalaka satarka karA hoৱA nAchila, seYe siha~ta udAsIna|
nizcaYa siha~tara adhikAMzara oparate (AllAhara) vANI aৱdhArita haiche, seYe siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
nizcaYa Ami siha~tara DiGita thu~tarilaike galAvAndha (zikali) meriYAi dicho~, phalata siha~ta urddhamukhI hai gaiche|
Aru Ami siha~tara AgaphAle prAcIra Aru pichaphAle prAcIra sthApana karicho~, tAra pichata Ami siha~taka DhAki dicho~, phalata siha~te dekhivalai nApAYa|
tumi siha~taka satarka karA vA nakarA, siha~tara vAve ubhaYe samAna; siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
tumi keৱla tAkei satarka kariva pArivA yiYe koraAnara anusaraNa kare Aru rahamAnaka nedekhAkaiYe bhaYa kare| eteke tumi tAka kSamA Aru sanmAnajanaka puraskArara susaMvAda diYA|
nizcaYa AmiYei mRtaka jIৱita karo~ Aru likhi rAkho~ siha~te yi Agalai preraNa kare Aru yi siha~te pichata eri yAYa| Ami pratyeka vastukei suspaSTa kitAvata saMrakSaNa kari rAkhicho~|
Aru siha~tara ocarata eTA janapadara adhivAsIsakalara dRSTAnta varNanA karA; yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai rAchulasakala Ahichila|

yetiYA Ami siha~tara ocaralai preraNa karichilo~ dujana rAchula, tetiYA siha~te teOMlokaka avizvAsa karichila, tAra pichata Ami teOMlokaka tRtIYa ejanara dvArA zaktizAlI karichilo~| teOMloke kaichila, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara ocaralai (AllAhara dUta hicApe) prerita haicho~’|
siha~te kaichila, ‘tomAloke dekhona AmAra darei mAnuha, parama karuNAmaYe eko aৱtIrNa karA nAi| tomAloke keৱla michA kathAhe kai AchA’|
teOMloke (uttarata) kaichila, ‘AmAra pratipAlake jAne, nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara ocaralai prerita haicho~’|
‘Aru (zunA!) spaSTabhAৱe pracAra karATohe AmAra dAYitva’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAlokaka amaGgalara kAraNa hicApehe gaNya karo~, yadi tomAloke virata nohoৱA tente nizcaYa Ami tomAlokaka zila daliYAi hatyA karima Aru AmAra phAlara parA tomAlokaka yantraNAdAYaka zAstiYe sparza kariva’|
teOMloke ka’le, ‘tomAlokara amaGgala tomAlokarei lagata; tomAlokaka upadeza diYA haiche vuliYei enekai kaichA neki? varaM tomAloka haichA eTA sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa’|
ipine nagarara dUraৱrtI prAntara parA ejana vyakti dauri Ahi ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke rAchulasakalara anusaraNa karA;
‘anusaraNa karA seisakala vyaktira, yisakale tomAlokara ocarata kono pratidAna nivicAre Aru teOMloka haiche satpathaprApta|
‘Aru mai ki yuktita sei sattvAra ivAdatara parA virata thAkima, yijane moka sRSTi kariche? Aru yAra ocaralai tomAlokaka obhatAi niYA ha’va|
‘mai teOMra vAhire velega kono ilAha grahaNa karima neki? rahamAne mora kono kSati kariva vicArile siha~tara cupAricha mora kono kAmata nAhiva Aru siha~te moka uddhAro kariva noৱAriva|
‘ene karile nizcaYa mai spaSTa vibhrAntita patita ha'ma|
‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara pratipAlakara oparata ImAna Anicho~, eteke tomAloke mora kathA zunA’|
teOMka koৱA ha’la, ‘jAnnAtata praৱeza karA’| teOM ka’le, ‘hAYa! mora sampradAYe yadi jAnilehe~tena,
‘yAra vinimaYata mora pratipAlake moka kSamA kari diche Aru moka sanmAnita kariche’|
Ami teOMra (mRtyura) pichata teOMra sampradAYara viruddhe AkAzara parA kono vAhinI preraNa karA nAchilo~, Anaki preraNa karAra kono praYojano nAchila|
seYA Achila keৱla eTA vikaTa zavda| yAra phalata siha~ta nithara nistavdha hai parichila|
paritApa vAndAsakalara vAve; siha~tara ocaralai yetiYAi kono rAchula Ahiche tetiYAi siha~te teOMra lagata ThATTA-vidrUpa kariche|
siha~te lakSya karA nAine ye, Ami siha~tara pUrve vahu prajanmaka dhvaMsa karicho~? nizcaYa seisakala loka siha~tara mAjalai Aru ubhati nAhiva|
siha~ta sakaloke ekatrita kari AmAra ocarata upasthita karoৱA ha’va|
Aru mRta bhUmi haiche siha~tara vAve eTA nidarzana, yAka Ami saJjIৱita karicho~ Aru tAra parA zasya utpanna karicho~, yivora siha~te khAYa|
Aru tAta Ami sRSTi karicho~ khejura Aru AGurara udyAna Aru tAta Ami pravAhita karicho~ kichumAna prasraৱna,
yAte siha~te tAra phalamUla khAva pAre, athaca (eivoraka) siha~te nija hAtere sRSTi karA nAi| tathApio siha~te kRtajJatA prakAza nakarivane?

paৱitra Aru mahAna teOM, yijane sakaloke yora yorakai sRSTi kariche, mATira parA utpanna udbhidei haoka vA siha~tara (mAnuhara) mAjara parAi haoka (nArI Aru puruSa) Aru seivora vastura mAjato yivoraka siha~te nAjAne|
Aru rAtio haiche siha~tara vAve eTA nidarzana, Ami tAra parA dinaka apasArita karo~, tetiYA siha~ta andhakArAcchanna hai pare|
Aru sUryai bhramaNa kare tAra nirdiSTa gantavyara phAle, eiTo mahAparAkramazAlI, sarvajJa (AllAha)ra nirdhAraNa|
lagate candrara vAve Ami nirdiSTa karicho~ vibhinna manajila, aৱzeSata seiTo zukAna vekA, puraNi khejura ThAnira AkArata ubhati yAYa|
sUryara pakSe sambhaৱ nahaYa candraka laga poৱA, Aru rAtira pakSeo sambhaৱ nahaYa dinaka atikrama karA, Aru pratyekei nija nija kakSapathata bhAhi~ Ache|
siha~tara vAve Aru eTA nidarzana haiche ei ye, Ami siha~tara vaMzadharavilAkaka bharti nauyAnata ArohaNa karoৱAichilo~;
Aru siha~tara vAveo anurUpa yAnavAhana sRSTi karicho~ yAte siha~te ArohaNa kare|
Aru Ami icchA karile siha~taka DuvAi mAriva pAro~, tetiYA siha~tara kono uddhArakArI nAthAkiva Aru siha~te paritrANo nApAva,
ekamAtra AmAra karuNAihe siha~taka pAra lagAi diYe Aru kichu samaYara vAve upabhogara suyoga diYA haYa|
Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa, ‘tomAlokara sanmukhata yi Ache Aru tomAlokara pichata yi Ache sei samparke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA; yAte tomAlokara prati rahamata varSita haYa’,
Aru siha~tara pratipAlakara taraphara parA siha~tara ocaralai kono nidarzana Ahilei siha~te tAra parA mukha ghUrAi laYa|

Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa ye, ‘AllAhe tomAlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna kariche tAra parA tomAloke vyaYa karA’, tetiYA kAphirasakale muminasakalaka kaYa, ‘Ami tAka khAdya dAna karimane, yAka AllAhe icchA karilei khoৱAva pAre? nizcaYa tomAloka spaSTa vibhrAntita AchA’|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘tomAloke yadi satyavAdI hoৱA tente koৱA, ei pratizruti ketiYA vAstaৱAYita ha’va’?
siha~ta mAthona eTA vikaTa zavdara apekSAtahe Ache, yiToৱe siha~taka vAka-vitaNDAta lipta thakA aৱsthAte AkramaNa kariva|
tetiYA siha~te achiYata karAro sAmartha nApAva Aru nijara pariYAlavargara ocaralaikeo ubhati Ahiva noৱAriva|
Aru yetiYA ziGAta phu~ diYA ha’va, tetiYA siha~te tatkSaNAta kavarara parA olAi nija pratipAlakara pine lara mAriva|
siha~te ka’va, ‘hAYa! durbhAgya AmAra! kone AmAka AmAra nidrAsthalara parA uThAle? daYAmaYa AllAhe iYArei dekhona pratizruti dichila Aru rAchulasakaleo dekhona satya kathAhe kaichila’|
eiTo ha’va keৱla eTA vikaTa zavda; tetiYAi iha~ta sakaloke upasthita karA ha’va AmAra sanmukhata,
eteke Aji kAro prati anyAYa karA naha'va Aru tomAloke yi karichilA tomAlokaka keৱla tArei pratiphala diYA ha’va|
nizcaYa jAnnAtavAsIsakala Aji Anandata vyasta thAkiva,
teOMloka Aru teOMlokara strIsakale suzItala chA~ra talata susajjita Asanata Auji vahiva|
tAta thAkiva teOMlokara vAve phalamUla, Aru teOMloke yiTo vicAriva seiToৱei pAva,
asIma daYAlu pratipAlakara taraphara parA koৱA ha’va ‘chAlAma’ (abhinandana vA nirApattA)|
Aru ‘he aparAdhIsakala! tomAloke Aji pRthaka hai yoৱA’|
he Adama santAna! mai tomAlokaka ei marme nirdeza diYA nAchilo~ne ye, tomAloke caYatAnara ivAdata nakarivA, kAraNa si tomAlokara prakAzya zatru?
Aru keৱla morei ivAdata karA, eiToৱei haiche sarala patha|
Aru nizcaYa caYatAne tomAlokara vahu dalaka vibhrAnta karichila, tathApio tomAloke anudhAৱna karA nAine?
eikhanei haiche sei jAhAnnAma, yAra pratizruti tomAlokaka diYA haichila|
Aji tomAloke iYAta dagdha hoৱA, kiYano tomAloke kupharI karichilA|
Aji Ami siha~tara mukhata mohara mAri dima, siha~tara hAte AmAra lagata kathA pAtiva Aru siha~tara bhariYe sAkSya diva siha~tara kRtakarmara|
Aru Ami icchA karile nizcaYa siha~tara cakuvoraka lopa kari dilo~he~tena, tetiYA siha~te patha anveSaNata dauri phurileo (kono kAmata nAhiva), kAraNa kenekaino dekhA pAva!
Aru Ami icchA karile siha~taka siha~tara nija nija sthAnate AkRti parivartana kari diva pArilo~he~tena, phalata siha~te AguৱAiYo yAva noৱArilehe~tena Aru ubhatio Ahiva noৱArilehe~tena|
Aru Ami yAka dIrgha jIৱna dAna karo~, sRSTi aৱYavata tAra aৱnati ghaTAOM| tathApio siha~te vuji nApAYane?
Ami teOMka (rAchulaka) kAvya racanA karA zikoৱA nAi Aru eiTo teOMra vAve zobhanIYao nahaYa| nizcaYa eikhana haiche keৱla eTA upadeza Aru suspaSTa koraAna;
yAte i jIৱitasakalaka satarka kariva pAre, lagate kAphirasakalara viruddhe zAstira kathA satya vuli pramANita haYa|
siha~te lakSya karA nAine ye, AmAra hAtere prastuta karA vastusamUhara mAjata Ami siha~tara vAve gharacIYA jantuo sRSTi karicho~| athaca siha~tei seivorara mAlika|
Aru Ami seivoraka siha~tara vazIbhUta kari dicho~| phalata seivorara kichu saMkhyaka haiche siha~tara vAhana Aru kichumAnaka siha~te bhakSaNa kare|
Aru siha~tara vAve eivorara mAjata Ache vahuto upakAra lagate Ache pAnIYa upAdAna| tathApio siha~te kRtajJatA prakAza nakarivane?
tathApio siha~te AllAhara parivarte anya ilAha grahaNa kariche, ei AzAta ye, siha~te sAhAyyaprApta ha’va|
kintu seivore siha~taka sahAYa karivalai sakSama nahaYa, varaM seivoraka siha~tara viruddhe vAhinIrUpe upasthita karA ha’va|
eteke siha~tara kathAYa yena tomAka cintita nakare, nizcaYa Ami jAno siha~te yi gopana kare Aru yi siha~te prakAza kare|
mAnuhe lakSya nakare neki ye, Ami tAka sRSTi karicho~ zukravindura parA, tathApio si pAchata prakAzya vitaNDAkArI hai pare|
Aru si AmAra viSaYe upamA racanA kare, athaca si nijara sRSTira kathA pAhari yAYa| si kaYa, ‘hADa়ra bhitarata kone prANa saJcAra kariva yetiYA i jahi-khahi, geli-paci yAva’?
koৱA, ‘teৱe~i tAta prANa saJcAra kariva yijane iYAka prathamavAra sRSTi kariche, Aru teOM pratiTo sRSTi samparke samyaka parijJAta’|
teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve seujIYA gachara parA jui utpanna kare, phalata tomAloke tAra parA agni prajvalita karA|
yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche, teOM siha~tara anurUpa punara sRSTi karivalai sakSama nahaYane? nizcaYa sakSama| teOM mahAsraSTA, sarvajJa|
teOMra viSaYaTo enekuৱA ye, teOM yetiYA kono vastura icchA kare, tetiYA keৱla kaYa, ‘ha’, phalata seiTo hai yAYa|
eteke paৱitra Aru mahAna sei sattvA, yAra hAtata Ache pratyeka viSaYara sArvabhauma kartRtva; Aru teOMra ocaratei tomAloka pratyAৱrtita ha’vA|
zapata zArIvaddha phiristAsakalara,
lagate kaThora dhamaka pradAnakArIsakalara,
Aru upadezagrantha tilAৱtakArIsakalara,
nizcaYa tomAlokara ilAha haiche ejana,
yijana AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore madhyaৱrtI sakalo vastura pratipAlaka Aru udaYasthala samUharo pratipAlaka|
nizcaYa Ami nikaTaৱrtI AkAzakhanaka nakSatrarAjira saundaryare suzobhita karicho~,
Aru (iYAka) rakSA karicho~ pratyeka vidrohI caYatAnara parA|
phalata siha~te urddhajagatara ekoৱe zuniva noৱAre, kAraNa keuphAlara parA siha~tara prati nikSepa karA haYa (ulkApiNDa),
siha~taka khedi paThioৱAra vAve, Aru siha~tara vAve Ache avirAma zAsti|
kintu haThAt konovAi kivA zunile jvalanta ulkApiNDai tAra prati co~cA laYa|

eteke siha~taka (avizvAsIsakalaka) sudhi coৱAcona, sRSTira kSetrata siha~ta vechi jaTila, ne Ami Ana Ana yivora sRSTi karicho~ seivora (adhika jaTila)? Ami siha~taka dekhona AlatIYA mATira parAhe sRSTi karicho~|
varaM tumi vismaYavodha karichA, Aru siha~te vidrUpa kari Ache|
Aru yetiYA siha~taka upadeza diYA haYa, tetiYA siha~te seYA grahaNa nakare|
Aru yetiYA siha~te kono nidarzana dekhe, tetiYA siha~te upahAsa kare|
Aru kaYa, ‘eiTo dekhona suspaSTa yAdura vAhire Ana eko nahaYa|
‘Ami yetiYA mRtyuvaraNa karima lagate mATi Aru asthita pariNata hama, tathApio AmAka punarutthita karA ha’vane?
‘Aru AmAra pitR-puruSa sakaloko’?
koৱA, ‘haYa, Aru (tetiYA) tomAloka ha’vA lAJchita’|
eteke seYA ha’va keৱla eTA pracaNDa dhamaka, phalata tatkSaNAt siha~te thara lAgi cAi thAkiva|
Aru siha~te ka’va, ‘hAYa! durbhAgya AmAra! eiToৱe dekhona pratidAna diৱsa’|
(siha~taka koৱA ha’va) eiToৱei haiche phaYacAlAra dina, yiToka tomAloke avizvAsa karichilA|
(phiristAsakalaka koৱA ha’va) ‘ekatrita karA yAlimasakalaka Aru siha~tara saGgI-sArathisakalaka Aru seisakalako yisakalara siha~te ivAdata karichila,
AllAhara vAhire| tathA siha~taka jAhAnnAmara patha dekhuৱAi diYA,
‘Aru siha~taka rakhoৱAcona, nizcaYa siha~taka prazna karA ha’va|
‘ki ha’la tomAlokara, tomAloke ijane sijanaka (etiYA) sahAYa nakarA kiYa’?
varaM Aji siha~te AtmasamarpaNa kariche|
Aru siha~te ijane sijanara mukhAmukhi hai sodha-pocha kariva,
siha~te ka’va, ‘nizcaYa tomAloke AmAra ocaralai zapata lai AhichilA’|
siha~te (netRsthAnIYa kAphiravilAke) ka’va, ‘varaM tomAlokei mumina nAchilA,
‘Aru tomAlokara oparata AmAra kono kartRtva nAchila; darAcalate tomAlokei AchilA sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa|
‘seYe AmAra viruddhe AmAra pratipAlakara kathA satya pramANita haiche, gatike nizcitabhAৱe Ami zAsti AsvAdana kariva lAgiva|
‘eteke AmiYei tomAlokaka vibhrAnta karichilo~, kAraNa Ami nijei vibhrAnta Achilo~’|
eteke nizcaYa seidinA siha~ta ATAYe zAstita aMzIdAra ha’va|
nizcaYa Ami aparAdhIvilAkara lagata enekuৱA AcaraNei karo~|
siha~taka yetiYA koৱA haichila, ‘AllAhara vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi’, tetiYA siha~te ahaMkAra karichila|
Aru kaichila, ‘Ami ejana unmAda kavira kathAta AmAra ilAhasamUhaka varjana karima neki’?
varaM teOM satya lai Ahiche Aru (vigata) rAchulasakalako teOM satya vuli svIkAra kariche|
nizcaYa tomAloke yantraNAdAYaka zAsti bhoga karivA,
Aru tomAloke yi karichilA keৱla tArei pratiphala lAbha karivA,
kintu teOMloka nahaYa, yisakala AllAhara ekaniSTha vAndA|
teOMlokara vAve Ache nirdhArita rijikva (jIৱikA),
phala-mUla; Aru teOMloka ha’va sanmAnita,
(teOMloke vasavAsa kariva) niYAmatere bharA jAnnAtata,
teOMloke mukhAmukhi hai Asanata vahiva|
teOMlokara cAriophAle ghUri ghUri parivezana karA ha’va vizuddha surApUrNa pAtra,
zubhra ujjvala, yivora pAnakArIsakalara vAve ha’va soৱAdapUrNa|
tAta kSatikara eko nAthAkiva Aru teOMloke eivorara dvArA mAtoৱAlo (nicAgrastao) naha’va|
teOMlokara lagata thAkiva Anata naYanA, DAGara caku viziSTA (hUrasakala)|
teOMloka yenivA AcchAdita kaNI|
tAra pichata teOMloke paraspare mukhAmukhi hai sodha-pocha kariva|
teOMlokara mAjara konovAi ka’va, ‘(pRthiৱIta) mora ejana saGgI Achila,
si kaichila, tumio siha~tara antarbhukta neki, yisakale vizvAsa kare ye,
‘Ami yetiYA mRtyuvaraNa karima Aru Ami mATi tathA asthita pariNata ha'ma tetiYAo AmAka pratiphala diYA ha’vane’?
AllAhe ka’va, ‘tomAloke tAka dekhiva vicarA neki’?
tAra pichata teOM jumi cAva Aru tAka dekhA pAva jAhAnnAmara madhyasthalata;
teOM ka’va, ‘AllAhara zapata! tumito moka prAYa dhvaMsai karichilA,
‘mora pratipAlakara anugraha naha’le, maYo dekhona (jAhAnnAmata) upasthitakRta vyaktisakalara antarbhukta ha’lo~he~tena|
(yike nahaoka etiYA) AmAra Aru dunAi mRtyu nahaYa,
‘AmAra prathama mRtyura pichata Aru AmAka zAstio diYA naha'va!’
nizcaYa eiToৱei haiche sei mahA saphalatA|
enekuৱA saphalatAra vAvei AmalakArIsakale Amala karA ucita,
(koৱAcona) ApyAYanara vAve eivorei uttama ne yAkkUma gacha uttama?
nizcaYa Ami yAlimasakalara vAve iYAka parIkSAsvarUpa sRSTi karicho~,
ei gachajopA utpanna haYa jAhAnnAmara talara parA,
iYAra thopA haiche yenivA caYatAnara mUra,
nizcaYa siha~te iYAka bhakSaNa kariva Aru iYAra dvArAi peTa bharAva|
iYAra pichato siha~tara vAve thAkiva utalA pAnIra mizraNa|
tAra pichata siha~tara pratyAৱrtana ha’va jAhAnnAmara juira phAle|
nizcaYa siha~te siha~tara pitR-puruSasakalaka pathabhraSTa pAichila,
tathApio siha~te siha~tara anusaraNata kSIpratA dekhuৱAichila|
nizcaYa siha~tara pUrveo pUrvaৱrtIsakalara mAjara sarahabhAga mAnuhei vipathagAmI haichila,
aৱzye Ami siha~tara mAjato satarkakArI preraNa karichilo~|
eteke coৱA, yisakalaka satarka karA haichila, siha~tara pariNAma ki haichila!
kintu AllAhara ekaniSTha vAndAsakalara viSaYaTo sukIYA|
Aru nizcaYa nUhe AmAka AhvAna karichila, eteke (coৱA) Ami kimAna uttamabhAৱe sa~hAri janAichilo~!
teOMka Aru teOMra pariYAlavargaka Ami mahAsaMkaTara parA uddhAra karichilo~|
Aru teOMra vaMzadharasakalakahe Ami aৱziSTa rAkhichilo~,
Aru Ami paravartIsakalara mAjata teOMra sukhyAti rAkhi dicho~|
samagra sRSTira mAjata nUhara prati zAnti varSita haoka|
satkarmazIlasakalaka Ami enekuৱAi pratidAna di thAko~|
nizcaYa teOM Achila AmAra mumina vAndAsakalara anyatama|
tAra pichata DuvAi mArichilo~ AnaTo dalaka|
Aru nizcaYa ivrAhImo Achila teOMra anusArIsakalarei antarbhukta|
smaraNa karA, yetiYA teOM nija pratipAlakara ocarata vizuddhacitte upasthita haichila,
yetiYA teOM nija pitRka Aru teOMra sampradAYaka sudhichila, ‘tomAloke kihara ivAdata kari AchA?
‘tomAloke AllAhara parivarte alIka upAsyavorake vicarA neki?
‘tente vizvajagatara pratipAlaka samparke tomAlokara dhAraNA ki’?
tAra pichata teOM tarAsamUhara pine evAra dRSTipAta karile|
Aru ka’le, ‘nizcaYa mai asustha’|
tAra pichata siha~te pRSThapradarzana kari teOMka eri guci ga’la|
tAra pichata teOM saMgopane siha~tara upAsyavorara ocaralai ga’la, Aru ka’le, ‘tomAloke nokhoৱA kiYa’?
‘ki ha’la tomAlokara, kathA nokoৱA kiYa’?
tAra pichata teOM siha~tara oparata sajore AghAta karile|
ipine mAnuhe (gharalai ghUri Ahi) teOMra phAle DhApali melile|
teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke seivorara upAsanA karA neki, yivoraka tomAloke nijei nirmANa karA’?
‘athaca AllAhei tomAlokaka sRSTi kariche Aru tomAloke yi taiYAra karA seiToko teৱe~i sRSTi kariche’|
siha~te ka’le, ‘iYAra vAve eTA sthApanA taiYAra karA, tAra pichata iYAka jvalanta juita nikSepa karA’|
eidarei siha~te teOMra viruddhe cakrAntara saMkalpa karichila; kintu Ami siha~taka sampUrNarUpe parAbhUta kari dilo~|
teOM ka’le, ‘mai mora pratipAlakara ocaralai gai Acho~, nizcaYa teৱe~i moka hidAYata kariva,
‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka ejana satkarmaparAYaNa santAna dAna karA’|
tAra pichata Ami teOMka ejana sahiSNu putrara susaMvAda dilo~|

eteke yetiYA zizuTo teOMra pitRra saite calAphurA karA aৱsthAta upanIta ha’la, tetiYA ivrAhIme ka’le, ‘he mora cenehara putra! mai saponata dekhilo~ ye, mai tomAka javeha kari Acho~, etiYA koৱAcona tomAra abhimata ki’? putrai ka’le, ‘he mora pitR! Apuni yi AdezaprApta haiche seiToৱei karaka| AllAhara icchAta Apuni moka dhairyyazIlasakalara antarbhukta pAva’|
eteke teOMloka ubhaYe yetiYA Anugatya prakAza karile Aru ivrAhIme teOMra putraka talamUra kari zuৱAi la’le,
tetiYA Ami teOMka mAti ka’lo~, ‘he ivrAhIma!
‘tumi nizcaYa saponara Adeza pAlana karichA! nizcaYa eidarei Ami satkarmazIlasakalaka puraskRta karo~’|
nizcaYa eiTo Achila eTA suspaSTa parIkSA|
Aru Ami teOMka mukta karilo~ eTA mahA kuravAnIra vinimaYata|
Aru Ami paravartIsakalara mAjata teOMra sukhyAti rAkhi dicho~|
zAnti varSita haoka ivrAhImara oparata|
eidarei Ami satkarmazIlasakalaka puraskRta karo~|
nizcaYa teOM Achila AmAra mumina vAndAsakalara anyatama|
Aru Ami teOMka ichahAkvara susaMvAda dichilo~, teOM Achila ejana navI, satkarmazIlasakalara anyatama|

Aru Ami ivrAhImara oparata varakata dAna karichilo~ Aru ichahAkvara oparato; Aru teOMloka ubhaYere vaMzadharasakalara mAjata Achila kichumAna satkarmazIla Aru kichumAna Achila nijara prati spaSTa atyAcArI|
Aru nizcaYa Ami anugraha karichilo~ mUchA Aru hArUnara prati,
Aru teOMloka ubhaYake Aru teOMlokara sampradAYako uddhAra karichilo~ mahAsaMkaTara parA|
Aru Ami teOMlokaka sahAYa karichilo~, phalata teOMloke vijaYI haichila|
Aru Ami ubhaYake vizada kitAva pradAna karichilo~|
Aru ubhaYake Ami paricAlita karichilo~ sarala pathata|
Aru Ami teOMloka ubhaYare vAve paravartIsakalara mAjata sunAma-sukhyAti rAkhi dicho~|
muchA Aru hArUnara oparata varSita haoka chAlAma (zAnti Aru nirApattA)|
nizcaYa satkarmazIlasakalaka Ami enekuৱAi pratidAna di thAko~|
nizcaYa teOMloka ubhaYe Achila AmAra mumina vAndAsakalara antarbhukta|
Aru nizcaYa iliYAcho Achila rAchulasakalara antarbhukta|
yetiYA teOM nija sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘tomAloke tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana nakarivAne’?
‘tomAloke vAAlaka AhvAna karA neki? athaca parityAga karA sarvattoma sraSTAka,
‘AllAhei haiche tomAlokara pratipAlaka, Aru tomAlokara pUrvaৱrtI pitR-puruSasakaloro pratipAlaka’|
tathApio siha~te teOMka asvIkAra karichila, seYe siha~taka nizcaYa (zAstira mAjata) upasthita karA ha’va|
kintu AllAhara ekaniSTha vAndAsakalara viSaYaTo sukIYA|
Aru Ami paravartIsakalara mAjata teOMra sukhyAti rAkhi dicho~|
zAnti varSita haoka iliYAchara oparata|
nizcaYa satkarmazIlasakalaka Ami enekuৱAi pratidAna diOM|
nizcaYa teOM Achila AmAra mumina vAndAsakalara anyatama|
Aru nizcaYa lUto Achila rAchulasakalara antarbhukta|
smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami teOMka Aru teOMra pariYAlavargara sakaloke uddhAra karichilo~,
keৱla sei vRddhAjanIra vAhire, yijanI Achila pichata aৱsthAnakArI vilAkara antarbhukta|
tAra pichata Ami vAkIvilAkaka dhvaMsa karichilo~|
Aru nizcaYa tomAloke siha~tara dhvaMsaprApta aJcaledi atikrama karA puৱAra bhAgata,
Aru rAtito| tathApio tomAloke vuji nopoৱAne?
Aru nizcaYa iunucho Achila rAchulasakalara antarbhukta|
smaraNa karA, yetiYA teOM bharA nauyAnara pine palAi gaichila,
tAra pichata teOM laTArita yogadAna karichila Aru parAbhUtasakalara antarbhukta haichila|
tAra pichata eTA DAGara mAche teOMka gili pelAichila, Aru teOM nijake dhikkAra di Achila|
Aru teOM yadi AllAhara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNAkArIsakalara antarbhukta naha’lahe~tena,
tente teOM punarutthAna diৱsalaike mAchara peTatei thAkilahe~tena|
aৱzeSata teOMka Ami nikSepa karichilo~ eTA tRNahIna samudrataTata, Aru teOM Achila asustha|
Aru Ami (teOMka chA~ divalai) teOMra oparata iYAkatIna prajAtira eTA gacha gajAi tulilo~,
Aru Ami teOMka eka lAkha vA tAtakaio vechi lokara ocaralai preraNa karichilo~|
eteke teOMloke ImAna Anichila, phalata Ami teOMlokaka kichu kAlara vAve jIৱnopabhoga karivalai suvidhA dichilo~|
eteke siha~taka sodhAcona, ‘(eiTo kenekuৱA kathA) tomAra pratipAlakara vAve kanyA santAna Aru siha~tara vAve putra santAna neki’?
athavA Ami phiristAsakalaka nArI hicApe sRSTi karicho~ neki, seYA siha~te dekhichilane?
jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa siha~te manesajA kathA kaYa ye,
‘AllAhe santAna janma diche’| nizcaYa siha~ta michalIYA|
teOM putra santAnara parivarte kanyA santAna pachanda kariche neki?
ki haiche tomAlokara? tomAloke kenekuৱA vicAra karA?
tente tomAloke upadeza grahaNa nakarivAne?
athavA tomAlokara kono suspaSTa dalIla-pramANa Ache neki?
yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA tente tomAlokara kitAva lai AhA|
siha~te AllAha Aru jina jAtira mAjata AtmIYatAra samparka sthira kariche, athaca jinavilAke jAne ye, nizcaYa siha~taka upasthita karA ha’va (zAstira vAve)|
siha~te yi Aropa kare tAra parA AllAha paৱitra Aru mahAna,
kintu AllAhara ekaniSTha vAndAsakalara viSaYaTo sukIYA|
nizcaYa tomAloke Aru tomAloke yivorara ivAdata karA seivore,
(ekaniSTha vAndAsakalara) kAko tomAloke AllAha samparke vibhrAnta kariva noৱArivA,
