keৱla sei vyaktira vAhire yijana dagdha ha'va prajjvalita juita |
Aru (jivrIle ka’va) ‘AmAra pratyekare vAve Ache nirdhArita sthAna,
‘Aru nizcaYa Ami zArIvaddhabhAৱe daNDAYamAna,
‘Aru nizcaYa Ami teOMra paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNAkArI,
Aru nizcaYa siha~te (makkAvAsIvilAke) kaichila,
‘pUrvaৱrtIsakalara dare yadi AmAro ekhana upadezamUlaka kitAva thAkilahe~tena,
‘tente nizcaYa Ami AllAhara ekaniSTha vAndA ha’lo~he~tena’|
kintu siha~te seYA (koraAnaka) asvIkAra karile, eteke anatipalame siha~te jAnivalai pAva|
nizcaYa AmAra prerita vAndAsakalara viSaYe AmAra ei kathA pUrvei nirdhArita haiche ye,
nizcaYa teOMloka sAhAyyaprApta ha’va|
Aru nizcaYa AmAra senAvAhinIYei vijaYI ha’va|
eteke kichu samaYara vAve tumi siha~tara parA mukha ghUrAi loৱA|
Aru tumi siha~taka paryavekSaNa karA, zIghrei siha~te dekhivalai pAva (iYAra sAMghAtika pariNAma)|
tente siha~te AmAra zAstika tvarAnvita kariva vicAre neki?
eteke yetiYA siha~tara cotAlata zAsti nAmi Ahiva tetiYA yisakalaka satarka karA haichila siha~tara prabhAta kimAna ye nikRSTa ha’va!
gatike kichu samaYara vAve tumi siha~taka upekSA karA|
Aru tumi siha~taka paryavekSaNa karA, zIghrei siha~te dekhivalai pAva (iYAra sAMghAtika pariNAma)|
siha~te yi Aropa kare, tAra parA tomAra pratipAlaka paৱitra Aru mahAna, teৱe~i sakalo kSamatAra adhikArI|
Aru zAnti varSita haoka rAchulasakalara prati|
Aru sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAharei prApya|
ca’da,[1] zapata upadezapUrNa koraAnara (nizcaYa tumi satyavAdI)!
kintu kAphirasakala auddhatya Aru virodhitAtahe nipatita hai Ache|
iha~tara pUrve Ami vahuto janagoSThIka dhvaMsa karicho~, tetiYA siha~te (sahAYa vicAri) ciJarichila| kintu tetiYA paritrANara kono samaYa nAchila|
Aru siha~te vismaYa vodha kariche ye, siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara mAjara parAi ejana satarkakArI Ahiche Aru kAphirasakale kaYa, ‘eOM ejana yAdukara, michalIYA’|
‘eOM sakalo ilAhaka eri keৱla ejana ilAha vanAi laiche neki? nizcaYa eiTo eTA ati Azcaryakara viSaYa!’
Aru siha~tara netRsthAnIYa vyaktisakale ei kathA kai A~tari ga’la ye, ‘tomAlokeo guci yoৱA Aru nija nija upAsyavilAkara pUjAta avicala thAkA| nizcaYa eiTo haiche eTA uddezyamUlaka viSaYa’|
Ami zehatIYA dharmAdarzata enekuৱA kathA ketiYAo zunA nAi, nizcaYa eiTo manesajA uktira vAhire Ana eko nahaYa|

‘(Ami imAna loka thAko~te) AmAra mAjara parA keৱla teOMra oparatahe yikara (koraAna) aৱtIrNa karA ha’la neki’? prakRtate siha~te AmAra koraAna samparke sandehata patita haiche| varaM siha~te etiYAo mora zAsti bhoga karA nAi|
athavA siha~tara ocarata tomAra pratipAlakara bhANDAra Ache neki? yijana mahAparAkramazAlI, asIma dAtA|
athavA AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjata thakA vastuvorara oparata siha~tara kono kartRtva Ache neki? yadi Ache teneha’le siha~te kono upAYa aৱlamvana kari (AkAzalai) ArohaNa karA ucita!
eiTo haiche eTA (saru) senAdala, nizcaYa iha~ta parAjita ha’va, pUrvaৱrtI (DAGara) dalasamUhara dare|
iha~tara pUrveo asvIkAra karichila nUhara sampradAYe, Ada Aru lauha zalAdhArI phiraAuneo,
Aru chAmUda, lagate lUta sampradAYa Aru AikAra adhivAsIvilAkeo (asvIkAra karichila)| siha~ta Achila eko ekoTA vizAla vAhinI|
siha~tara pratyekei rAchulasakalaka asvIkAra karichila| phalata siha~tara oparata AmAra zAsti vAstaৱAYita haichila|
Aru iha~te keৱla eTA vikaTa zavdara apekSA kari Ache, yAra pichata kono virAma nAthAkiva|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! hicApa diৱsara pUrvei AmAra prApya AmAka zIghrei pradAna karA!’
siha~te yi kaYa sei viSaYe tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA Aru smaraNa karA AmAra zaktizAlI vAndA dAudara kathA, nizcaYa teOM Achila adhika AllAha abhimukhI (tAovAkArI)|
nizcaYa Ami parvatamAlAka anugata kari dichilo~, yAte eivore teOMra lagata puৱA-gadhUli mora paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare,
Aru samaveta carAivorako (anugata kari dichilo~); pratyekei Achila adhika AllAha abhimukhI|
Aru Ami teOMra rAjyaka sudRDha় karichilo~ Aru teOMka pradAna karichilo~ hikamata tathA mImAMsAkArI vAgmitA|
Aru tomAra ocaralai vivadamAna lokasakalara saMvAda Ahi pAichene? yetiYA siha~te prAcIra vagAi ivAdatara ThAita praৱeza karichila|

yetiYA teOMloke dAudara ocarata praৱeza karichila, tetiYA teOMlokaka dekhi teOM bhaYa khAichila| teOMloke ka’le, ‘bhaYa nakariva, Ami duTA vivadamAna pakSa| AmAra ijane sijanara oparata sImAlaMghana kariche, eteke Apuni AmAra mAjata nyAYa vicAra kari diYaka, avicAra nakariva Aru AmAka saThika patha pradarzana karaka|
‘nizcaYa eOM haiche mora bhAtR| eOMra nirAnavvaijanI dumvA Ache; Aru mora Ache keৱla ejanI dumvA| tathApio teOM kaYa, ‘seijanI moka di diYA’, Aru tarkata teOM mora oparata prAdhAnya vistAra kariche’|

dAude ka’le, ‘tomAra dumvAjanIka teOMra dumvAvorara lagata yukta karAra dAvI utthApana kari teOM tomAra prati anyAYa kariche| nizcaYa yautha aMzIdAravilAkara vahutei ijane sijanara oparata sImAlaMghana kare, keৱla teOMlokara vAhire yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, kintu teOMloke saMkhyAta ati tAkara’| dAude vuji pAle Ami teOMka parIkSAhe karilo~| tAra pichata teOM nija pratipAlakara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karile Aru nata hai chAjadAha aৱnata ha’la, Aru teOMra abhimukhI ha’la| (chAjadAha)
eteke Ami teOMka kSamA kari dilo~| nizcaYa AmAra ocarata teOMra vAve Ache ucca maryAdA Aru uttama pratyAৱrtanasthala|

‘he dAuda! nizcaYa Ami tomAka pRthiৱIta pratinidhi vanAicho~, eteke tumi mAnuhara mAjata suvicAra karA Aru pravRttira anusaraNa nakarivA, kiYano ene karile i tomAka AllAhara pathara parA vicyuta kariva’| nizcaYa yisakale AllAhara pathara parA vicyuta haYa siha~tara vAve Ache kaThina zAsti, kAraNa siha~te vicAra diৱsaka pAhari gaiche|

Aru Ami AkAza, pRthiৱI lagate ei duYore mAjata thakA kono vastukei anarthaka sRSTi karA nAi| eivoraka (anarthaka vuli) keৱla seisakala loke dhAraNA kare yisakale kupharI kariche, eteke yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara vAve Ache agnira durbhoga|
yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche Ami teOMlokaka pRthiৱIta azAnti sRSTikArIsakalara dare gaNya karima neki? ne Ami muttAkvIsakalaka pApISTavilAkara dare gaNya karima?

eikhana haiche varakatamaYa grantha, yikhana Ami tomAra prati aৱtIrNa karicho~, yAte mAnuhe iYAra AYAtasamUhara prati gabhIrabhAৱe cintA-carcA kare Aru yAte vodhazaktisampanna vyaktisakale upadeza grahaNa kare|
Aru Ami dAudaka (santAna hicApe) dAna karichilo~ chulAimAna| kimAna ye uttama vAndA Achila teOM! nizcaYa teOM Achila atizaYa AllAha abhimukhI|
smaraNa karA, Aveli yetiYA teOMra sanmukhata (prazikSaNaprApta) drutagAmI utkRSTa azvarAjika upasthApana karA haichila,
tetiYA teOM kaichila, ‘mai dekhona mora pratipAlakara smaraNara parA vimukha hai aizvarya prItita magna hai paricho~, ipine sUrya pardAra A~rata guci gaiche,
‘eivoraka mora ocaralai ghUrAi AnA’| tAra pichata teOM seivorara bhari Aru DiGita AghAta kari javeha karivalai dharile|
nizcaYa Ami chulAimAnaka parIkSA karichilo~ Aru teOMra Asanara oparata rAkhichilo~ eTi deha, tAra pichata chulAimAna AmAra abhimukhI ha’la|
teOM ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! moka kSamA kari diYA Aru moka enekuৱA ekhana sAmrAjya dAna karA, mora pichata koneo yAte tenekuৱA sAmrAjyara adhikArI nahaYa| nizcaYa tumi parama dAtA’|
tetiYA Ami vatAhaka teOMra adhInastha kari dilo~, yiTo teOMra Adezata teOM ya’ta icchA karichila sei ThAite mRdubhAৱe pravAhita haichila,
Aru (teOMra adhIna kari dichilo~) pratyeka aTTAlikA nirmANakArI Aru DuvAru caYatAnavorako,
lagate zikalire Aৱddha Aru vahutake|
eivora haiche AmAra anugraha, eteke iYAra parA tumi Anako dAna kariva pArA Aru nijara vAveo sA~ci thava pArA| iYAra vAve kono hicAva diva nAlAge|
Aru nizcaYa teOMra vAve Ache AmAra ocarata naikaTyara maryAdA Aru uttama pratyAৱrtanasthala|
Aru smaraNa karA, AmAra vAndA AiYyuvaka, yetiYA teOM nija pratipAlakaka AhvAna kari kaichila, ‘nizcaYa caYatAne moka yantraNA Aru kaSTata pelAiche’,
(mai teOMka kaichilo~,) ‘tumi nijara bharire bhUmita AghAta karA, eYA haiche gA dhuৱAra vAve suzItala pAnI, lagate khoৱA pAnI’|
Aru Ami teOMka dAna karichilo~ teOMra pariYAlavarga Aru teOMlokara dare Aru vahuto, AmAra phAlara parA anugraha hicApe Aru vodhazaktisampanna lokasakalara vAve upadeza hicApe|

lagate (Ami teOMka Adeza karichilo~) ‘tumi emuThi ghA~ha loৱA Aru seiTore tumi kovoৱA tathApio zapata bhaMga nakarivA’| nizcaYa Ami teOMka dhairyyazIla pAichilo~| kimAna ye uttama vAndA Achila teOM! nizcaYa teOM Achila AmAra abhimukhI|
Aru smaraNa karA, AmAra vAndA ivrAhIma, ichahAkva Aru iYAkUvara kathA, teOMloka ATAYe Achila zaktizAlI Aru sUkSmadarzI|
nizcaYa Ami teOMlokaka eTA vizeSa guNara adhikArI karichilo~, seYA Achila AkhirAtara smaraNa|
nizcaYa teOMloka Achila AmAra manonIta uttama vAndAsakalara anyatama|
Aru smaraNa karA, ichamAIla, Ala-YAcAA Aru jula-kiphalara kathA, eOMloka ATAYe Achila sajjanasakalara antarbhukta|
eiTo eTA smaraNa| nizcaYa muttAkvIsakalara vAve Ache uttama AvAsa,
cirasthAYI jAnnAta, yAra duৱArasamUha teOMlokara vAve unmukta thAkiva|
tAta teOMloke Auji vahiva, tAta teOMloke vahu dharaNara phalamUla Aru pAnIYa Anivalai ka’va|
Aru teOMlokara ocarata thAkiva AnatanaYanA samavaYasIYA (gAbhuru choৱAlIsakala)|
eiToৱe haiche hicApa diৱsara vAve tomAlokaka diYA pratizruti|
nizcaYa eiToৱe haiche Ami pradAna karA rijikva (jIৱikA), yiTo ketiYAo niHzeSa naha’va|
eiToৱei (haiche muttvAkvIsakalara pratidAna)| AnahAte nizcaYa sImAlaMghanakArIvilAkara vAve Ache nikRSTatama pratyAৱrtanasthala,
jAhAnnAma, tAta siha~te agnidagdha ha’va, (eYA) kimAna ye nikRSTa vizrAmasthala!
eiToৱei (haiche avizvAsIsakalara pratidAna)| eteke siha~te utalA pAnI Aru gelA-pU~jara soৱAda laoka|
Aru Ache ei jAtIYa vibhinna dharaNara zAsti|
(jAhAnnAmI netAsakalaka koৱA ha’va) eYA haiche eTA vAhinI, yisakala tomAlokara lagatei praৱeza kariche| (siha~te ka’va) siha~tara vAve kono abhinandana nAi| nizcaYa siha~ta juita jvaliva|
anusArIsakale ka’va, ‘varaM tomAlokeo (juita jvalivA), tomAlokara vAveo kono abhinandana nAi| tomAlokei AmAra vAve ei vipada mAti AnichA| eteke kimAna ye nikRSTa ei AvAsasthala!’
siha~te ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! yiYe AmAra vAve ei vipada kaDha়iYAi Aniche, jAhAnnAmata tAka tumi dviguNa zAsti diYA’|
siha~te Aru ka’va ye, ‘ki ha’la, Ami yisakala lokaka veYA vuli gaNya karichilo~ siha~taka dekhona (iYAta) dekhA poৱA nAi’|
‘Ami siha~taka enei upaluGA karichilo~ neki, ne siha~tara viSaYe AmAra dRSTi vibhrama ghaTiche’?
jAhAnnAmIsakalara ei pArasparika vAda-prativAda, nizcaYa eiTo vAstaৱ satya|
koৱA, ‘mai keৱla ejana satarkakArIhe mAthona Aru AllAhara vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, teOM ekaka, pravala pratApazAlI|
‘teৱe~i AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjata thakA sakalo vastura pratipAlaka, pravala parAkramazAlI, parama kSamAzIla’|
koৱA, ‘eiTo eTA mahAsaMvAda,
‘yiTora parA tomAloke vimukha hai AchA|
‘urddhaloka samparke mora kono jJAna nAchila yetiYA teOMloke (phiristAsakale) vAdAnuvAda karichila|
‘molai ei ahI Ahiche ye, mai keৱla ejana spaSTa satarkakArIhe mAthona’|
smaraNa karA, yetiYA tomAra pratipAlake phiristAsakalaka kaichila, ‘mai AlatIYA vokA mATire mAnuha sRSTi karima,
eteke yetiYA mai tAka suThAma karima Aru tAra mAjata mora phAlara parA rUha saJcAra karima tetiYA tomAloke tAra prati chAjadAৱnata ha’vA,
tetiYA phiristAsakale ATAYe ekelage chAjadAha karile,
keৱla ivalIchara vAhire, si ahaMkAra karile Aru kAphiravilAkara antarbhukta ha’la|

AllAhe ka’le, ‘he ivalIcha! mai yAka mora duhAtere sRSTi karicho~, teOMra prati chAjadAৱnata ha’valai tomAka kihe vAdhA pradAna karile? tumi ahaMkAra karilA neki? ne tumi adhika ucca maryAdAsampanna’?
si ka’le, ‘mai teOMtakai zreSTha| tumi moka agnire sRSTi karichA Aru teOMka sRSTi karichA AlatIYA vokA mATire’|
teOM ka’le, ‘tente tumi iYAra parA olAi yoৱA, kAraNa nizcaYa tumi abhizapta;
‘Aru nizcaYa tomAra oparata mora abhizApa thAkiva, karmaphala diৱsalaike’|
si ka’le, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! teneha’le moka aৱkAza diYA sei diৱsalaike, yidinA siha~taka punarujjIৱita karA ha’va’|
teOM ka’le, ‘yoৱA, nizcaYa tomAka aৱkAza diYA ha’la,
‘sunirdiSTa samaYa ahAra diৱsa paryanta’|
si ka’le, ‘tomAra kSamatA-sanmAnara zapata! nizcaYa mai siha~tara ATAike pathabhraSTa karima,
‘kintu siha~tara mAjata thakA tomAra ekaniSTha vAndAsakalara vAhire’|
AllAhe ka’le, ‘tente eiToৱei satya, Aru mai satyahe kaOM,
‘nizcaYa tomAra dvArA Aru siha~tara mAjara yivilAke tomAra anusaraNa kariva siha~ta sakalore dvArA mai jAhAnnAma pUrNa karima’|
(he navI!) koৱA, ‘mai iYAra vAve tomAlokara ocarata kono pratidAna nivicAro~ Aru mai kono pravaJcaka-chalanAkArIo nahaYa’|
ei (koraAna)khana haiche keৱla vizvavAsIra vAve upadeza vANI,
Aru iYAta thakA saMvAdara satyatA tomAloke nizcaYa jAniva pArivA, kichudina pichata|
eikhana kitAva, mahA parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAhara taraphara parA aৱtIrNa|
nizcaYa Ami tomAra ocaralai ei kitAva yathAyathabhAৱe aৱtIrNa karicho~| eteke tumi AllAhara Anugatyata ekaniSTha hai teOMrei ivAdata karA|

jAni thoৱA! vizuddha Anugatya keৱla AllAharei prApya| yisakale AllAhara parivarte Anaka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa kare siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami keৱla eikAraNei iha~tara ivAdata karo~ ye, iha~te AmAka AllAhara naikaTya lAbha karAi diva’| siha~te yi viSaYakalai nijara mAjate matabheda kari Ache, nizcaYa AllAhe siha~tara mAjata sei viSaYe mImAMsA kari diva| (lagate jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa AllAhe michalIYA kAphiraka hidAYata dAna nakare|

yadi AllAhe santAna grahaNa kariva vicArilehe~tena, tente teOM yi sRSTi kariche tAra parAi yAka icchA manonIta kari la'lehe~tena| kintu teOM paৱitra Aru mahAna! teৱe~i AllAha, ekaka (advitIYa), pravala pratApazAlI|

teৱe~i yathAyathabhAৱe AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche| teৱe~i rAtira dvArA dinaka AcchAdita kare Aru rAtika AcchAdita kare dinara dvArA| sUryya Aru candraka teৱe~i kariche niYamAdhIna| pratyekei eTA nirdhArita samaYalaike gati kare| jAni thoৱA! teOM mahA parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla|

teৱe~i tomAlokaka sRSTi kariche ejana vyaktira parA| tAra pichata teOM tAra parAi tAra yorA sRSTi kariche| teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve ATha yorA gharacIYA jantu aৱtIrNa kariche| teৱe~i tomAlokaka tomAlokara mAtRgarbhara trividha andhakArata paryAYakrame sRSTi kariche| teৱe~i AllAha; tomAlokara pratipAlaka; sArvabhauma kartRtva keৱla teOMrei; teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| eteke tomAlokaka ka’lai ghUrAi niYA haiche?

yadi tomAloke kupharI karA tente (jAni thoৱA) AllAha tomAlokara mukhApekSI nahaYa| teOM vAndAsakalara vAve kupharI pachanda nakare, Aru yadi tomAloke kRtajJa hoৱA tente teOM tomAlokara vAve kRtajJatAka pachanda kare| kono vojA vahanakArIYei Anara vojA vahana nakariva| tAra pichata tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocaratei tomAlokara pratyAৱrtana ha’va| tetiYA tomAloke yi Amala karichilA seYA teOM tomAlokaka aৱhita kariva| nizcaYa antarata yi Ache sei viSaYe teOM samyaka aৱgata|

Aru mAnuhaka yetiYA dukha-dainyai sparza kare tetiYA si ekAgracitte nija pratipAlakakahe AhvAna kare| tAra pichata teOM yetiYA teOMra taraphara parA tAra prati anugraha kare, tetiYA si pAhari yAYa ye, itipUrve si ki kAraNata teOMra ocarata duA karichila, Aru teOMra pathara parA Anaka vibhrAnta karivalai si AllAhara samakakSa sthira kari laYa| koৱA, ‘kupharIra aৱsthAta tumi kichukAla jIৱna upabhoga kari loৱA| nizcaYa tumi agnivAsIvilAkara antarbhukta’|

yi vyaktiYe rAtira vibhinna praharata chAjadAৱnata hai Aru thiYa hai Anugatya prakAza kare, lagate AkhirAtaka bhaYa kare Aru nija pratipAlakara anugraha pratyAzA kare, (ei vyaktika sei vyaktira dare gaNya karA ha'va neki yiYe eivora nakare?) koৱA, ‘yisakale jAne Aru yisakale nAjAne siha~ta samAna ha’va pArene’? nizcaYa keৱla vodhazaktisampanna vyaktisakalehe upadeza grahaNa kare|

janAi diYA, ‘he mora mumina vAndAsakala! tomAloke nija pratipAlakara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| yisakale ei pArthiৱ jIৱnata kalyANakara kAma kare teOMlokara vAve Ache kalyANa| AllAhara pRthiৱI vizAla prazasta, nizcaYa dhairyyazIlasakalaka teOMlokara pratidAna agaNitabhAৱe paripUrNarUpe pradAna karA ha’va’|
koৱA, ‘moka Adeza karA haiche, mai yena AllAhara Anugatyata ekaniSTha hai keৱla teOMrei ivAdata karo~,
‘moka Aru Adeza karA haiche, maYe yena AtmasamarpaNakArI (muchalima)sakalara mAjata agraNI haOM’|
koৱA, ‘mai yadi mora pratipAlakara avAdhyatA karo~, tente nizcaYa mai bhaYa karo~ ye, mahA diৱsara zAstiYe moka grAsa kariva’|
koৱA, ‘mai AllAhara prati mora Anugatyaka ekaniSTha kari keৱla teOMrei ivAdata karo~’|

‘eteke tomAloke AllAhara parivarte yAka icchA karA tAre ivAdata karA’| koৱA, ‘prakRta kSatigrasta haiche seisakala loka, yisakale kiYAmatara dinA nijara Aru nija pariYAlavargara kSati sAdhana kariva| jAni thoৱA! eiToৱei haiche suspaSTa kSati’|

siha~tara vAve siha~tara oparato thAkiva agnira stara Aru talaphAleo thAkiva agnira stara| eivora zAstira dvArAi AllAhe teOMra vAndAsakalaka satarka kare| he mora vAndAsakala! eteke tomAloke keৱla mokei bhaYa karA|
AnahAte yisakale tAgUtara ivAdata parihAra kare Aru keৱla AllAhara abhimukhI haYa teOMlokara vAve Ache susaMvAda| eteke mora vAndAsakalaka susaMvAda diYA,
yisakale manoyoga sahakAre kathA zune Aru tAra mAjara uttama kathAra anusaraNa kare| seisakala lokakei AllAhe hidAYata dAna kariche Aru teOMlokei haiche vodhazaktisampanna|
yAra oparata zAstira Adeza sAvyasta haiche, eteke jAhAnnAmata thakA sei vyaktika tumi rakSA kariva pArivAne?

kintu yisakale nija pratipAlakara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare, teOMlokara vAve Ache vahuto aTTAlikA, yAra oparato nirmita Ache aTTAlikA, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita Ache; eiTo AllAhara pratizruti, AllAhe pratizruti bhaMga nakare|

tumi lakSya karA nAine, AllAhe AkAzara parA pAnI varSaNa kare, tAra pichata seYA bhUmita prasraৱna hicApe pravAhita kare, tAra pichata seiTora jariYate nAnA dharaNara phacala utpanna kare, aৱzeSata sei phacala paki yAYa| phalata tumi sei phacalaka hAladhIYA varNata dekhivalai poৱA, zeSata teOM seiToka kherakuTAta pariNata kare? nizcaYa iYAta upadeza Ache vodhazakti sampanna vyaktisakalara vAve|

AllAhe ichalAmara vAve yAra vuku unmukta kari diche, phalata teOM nija pratipAlakara taraphara parA (ahA) nUrara oparata Ache, (eOM sei vyaktira dare neki yijana hidAYatara oparata nAi?) eteke durbhoga seisakala lokara vAve, yisakale AllAhara smaraNara parA vimukha hoৱAta siha~tara antara kaThora hai pariche! siha~ta Ache spaSTa vibhrAntita|

AllAhe aৱtIrNa kariche uttama hAdIcha (vANI) samvalita enekuৱA ekhana kitAva, ya’ta pArasparika sAdRzyapUrNa ekei kathAke nAnA dharaNe vAre vAre koৱA haiche| phalata yisakale nija pratipAlakaka bhaYa kare, iYAra dvArA teOMlokara zarIra ziYa~ri uThe, tAra pichata teOMlokara deha-mana vinamra hai AllAhara smaraNata dhAৱita haYa| eiToৱei haiche AllAhara hidAYata, teOM iYAra dvArA yAka icchA kare hidAYata kare| kintu AllAhe yAka vibhrAnta kare tAra hidAYatakArI kono nAi|

yi vyaktiYe kiYAmatara dinA nijara mukhamaNDalara dvArA kaThina zAsti rodha karivalai ceSTA kariva, (si teOMra dare neki yijana nirApada thAkiva?) Aru yAlimasakalaka koৱA ha’va, ‘tomAloke yi karma karichilA tArei zAsti upabhoga karA’|
siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo asvIkAra karichila, phalata siha~tara prati zAsti enekai Ahichila ye, siha~te upalavdhio kariva parA nAchila|
phalata AllAhe siha~taka pArthiৱ jIৱnate lAJchanA bhoga karoৱAichila Aru AkhirAtara zAsti iYAtakaio kaThina| hAYa! yadi siha~ta jAnilehe~tena!
nizcaYa Ami ei koraAnata mAnuhara vAve sarvaprakAra dRSTAnta upasthApana karicho~, yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kariva pAre|
AravI bhASAta ei koraAna (aৱtIrNa), iYAra mAjata kono dharaNara jaTilatA nAi, yAte siha~te tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariva pAre|

AllAhe eTA dRSTAnta upasthApana kariche: ejana vyakti, yAra keivAjano maniva Ache, yisakala paraspara viruddhabhAvApanna, pakSAntare Ana ejana vyaktira keৱla ejanei maniva Ache; ei duYojana vyaktira aৱsthA eke ha’va pArene? sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAharei; kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai nAjAne|
nizcaYa tumi maraNazIla Aru siha~teo maraNazIla|
eteke kiYAmatara dinA nizcaYa tomAloke nija pratipAlakara sanmukhata paraspare vAka-vitaNDA karivA|
eteke yi vyaktiYe AllAha samparke michA Aropa kare Aru satya ahAra pichato tAka asvIkAra kare, seijanatakai DAGara yAlima Aruno kona ha’va pAre? kAphirasakalara AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma nahaYane vAru?
AnahAte yiYe satya lai Ahiche Aru satyaka satya vuli mAni laiche, teOMlokei haiche muttAkvI|
teOMlokara vAve teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata sei sakalo vastu upalavdha Ache yiTo teOMloke vicAriva| eiToৱei haiche satkarmazIla lokara puraskAra|
kAraNa teOMloke yivora asatkarma karichila AllAhe seivora kSamA kari diva Aru teOMlokaka teOMlokara sarvottama karmara vAve puraskRta kariva|
AllAha teOMra vAndAra vAve yatheSTa nahaYane? athaca siha~te tomAka AllAhara parivarte Anara bhaYa dekhuৱAYa| AllAhe yAka pathabhraSTa kare tAra vAve kono hidAYatakArI nAi|
eidare yAka AllAhe hidAYata kare, tAka pathabhraSTa karivalaio kono nAi; tente AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, pratizodha grahaNakArI nahaYane vAru?

Aru tumi yadi siha~taka sodhA, ‘AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI kone sRSTi kariche’? siha~te nizcaYa ka’va, ‘AllAhe’| koৱA, ‘tomAloke bhAvichAne, AllAhe yadi moka aniSTa kariva vicAre tente tomAloke AllAhara parivarte yivoraka AhvAna karA siha~te sei aniSTa dUra kariva pArivane? athavA teOM yadi mora prati anugraha kariva vicAre tente siha~te sei anugrahaka rodha kariva pArivane’? koৱA, ‘mora vAve AllAhei yatheSTa’| nirbharakArIsakale teOMra oparatei nirbhara kare|
koৱA, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke nija nija sthAnata kAma kari yoৱA, nizcaYa mai mora kAma kari yAma| eteke zIghrei tomAloke (tomAlokara pariNAma) jAnivalai pAvA,
‘kAra oparata Ahiva lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti Aru Apatita ha’va sthAYI zAsti’|

nizcaYa Ami tomAra prati mAnuhara vAve yathAyathabhAৱe kitAva aৱtIrNa karicho~, eteke yiYe satpatha aৱlamvana kare si nijara kalyANara vAvei kare Aru yiYe vipathagAmI haYa si nijara dhvaMsara vAvei haYa, Aru tumi siha~tara oparata tattvAৱdhAYaka nahaYa|

AllAhei prANIsakalara prANa haraNa kare siha~tara mRtyura samaYata, Aru yisakale mRtyuvaraNa karA nAi siha~taro (prANa haraNa kare) nidrA aৱsthAta| tAra pichata teOM yAra vAve mRtyura siddhAnta grahaNa kare, tAra prANa teOM rAkhi diYe Aru Anavoraka eri diYe, eTA nirdiSTa samaYalaike| nizcaYa iYAta nidarzana Ache ene sampradAYara vAve, yisakale gaৱeSaNA kare|
tente siha~te AllAhara vAhire Anaka cupArichakArI vanAi laiche neki? koৱA, ‘siha~tara kono kSamatA nAthAkileo Aru siha~te eko vuji nApAleo (tomAloke siha~taka madhyasthatAkArI vanAi lavAne)’?
koৱA, ‘sakalo dharaNara madhyasthatA keৱla AllAharei adhInastha, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra rAjatva teOMrei, tAra pichata teOMra ocaratei tomAlokaka pratyAৱrtita karoৱA ha’va’|

Aru yetiYA keৱla eka AllAhara kathA koৱA haYa tetiYA yisakale AkhirAtara prati vizvAsa nakare siha~tara antara vitRSNAta saMkucita haYa| kintu AllAhara parivarte Ana upAsyavorara kathA ullekha karA ha’le tetiYAi siha~te Anandata utphullita haYa|

koৱA, ‘he AllAha, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sraSTA, prakAzya Aru aprakAzya viSaYAdira jJAnI, nizcaYa tumiYe tomAra vAndAsakalara mAjata sei viSaYe phaYacAlA kari divA yi viSaYata siha~te matavirodha kari Ache’|

Aru yisakale sImAlaMghana kariche, pRthiৱIta thakA sakalo vastu yadi siha~tara hai yAYa, lagate iYAra samaparimANa vastuo yadi siha~tara thAke, tente kiYAmatara dinA kaThina zAstira parA rakSA pAvalai muktipaNasvarUpe sei sakalo siha~te divalai sAju ha'va, Aru siha~tara vAve AllAhara taraphara parA enekuৱA kivA prakAzita ha’va yiTo siha~te kalpanAo kariva parA nAi|
Aru siha~te yi karma karichila tArei veYA pariNAma siha~tara ocarata prakAza hai pariva, Aru siha~te yiTo viSaYakalai ThATTA-vidrUpa karichila seiToৱe siha~taka pariveSTana kariva|

eteke yetiYA kono vipada-Apade mAnuhaka sparza kare, tetiYA si keৱla mokei AhvAna kare, tAra pichata yetiYA Ami tAka AmAra kono niYAmatara adhikArI karo~ tetiYA si kaYa, ‘eiTo moka keৱla mora jJAnara kAraNehe diYA haiche’| varaM eiTo eTA parIkSA, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei seYA nAjAne|
nizcaYa siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakaleo eiToৱei kaichila, kintu siha~te yi arjana karichila seYA siha~tara kono kAmata ahA nAchila|

eteke siha~tara kRtakarmara veYA pariNAma siha~tara oparatei Apatita haiche; Aru iha~tara mAjara yisakale yuluma kare, iha~tara oparato zIghrei iha~tara kRtakarmara veYA pariNAma Apatita ha’va, Aru iha~te (sei zAstika ketiYAo) rodha kariva noৱAriva|

siha~te nAjAne neki ye, AllAhe yAra vAve icchA kare tAra vAve jIৱikA prazasta kari diYe Aru saMkucitao kari diYe? nizcaYa iYAta vahuto nidarzana Ache ene sampradAYara vAve, yisakale ImAna poSaNa kare|

(siha~taka) janAi diYA, ‘he mora vAndAsakala! tomAlokara mAjara yisakale nijara oparata anyAYa karichA, AllAhara anugrahara parA (ketiYAo) nirAza naha’vA, nizcaYa AllAhe sakalo pApa kSamA kari diva| nizcaYa teOM parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|
Aru tomAloke nija pratipAlakara abhimukhI hoৱA Aru tomAlokara oparata zAsti ahAra Agatei tomAloke teOMra ocarata Atmasamarpana karA, iYAra pichata kintu tomAlokaka sahAYa karA naha’va|

Aru tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA tomAlokara prati yi uttama (grantha) aৱtIrNa karA haiche, tomAlokara oparata atarkitabhAৱe zAsti ahAra pUrvei tomAloke tAra anusaraNa karA, anyathA (yetiYA sei zAsti Ahiva) tomAloke upalavdhio kariva noৱArivA|
pichata yAte konoৱei ka'valagIYA nahaYa ye, ‘hAYa mora durbhAgya! AllAhara prati thakA mora kartavyata mai aৱhelA karichilo~! Aru mai upahAsakArI vilAkara antarbhukta Achilo~’|
athavA enekaio yAte ka'valagIYA nahaYa, ‘hAYa! AllAhe yadi moka hidAYata karilehe~tena tente nizcaYa mai muttAkvIsakalara antarbhukta ha’lo~he~tena!’
athavA zAsti pratyakSa karAra pichata yAte konoৱei ka'valagIYA nahaYa, ‘hAYa! yadi mai evAra ubhati yAva pArilo~he~tena, tente mai satkarmazIlasakalara antarbhukta ha’lo~he~tena!’
(AllAhe ka’va) haYa, nizcaYa tomAra ocaralai mora nidarzana Ahichila, kintu tumi seivoraka asvIkAra karichilA Aru ahaMkAra karichilA; Aru tumi AchilA kAphiravilAkara antarbhukta|
Aru yisakale AllAhara prati michA Aropa kare, tumi kiYAmatara dinA dekhivA siha~tara mukha ka’lA pariche| ahaMkArIvilAkara AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma nahaYane vAru?
Aru yisakale tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariche, AllAhe teOMlokaka saphalatAre uddhAra kariva, teOMlokaka kono amaGgale sparza kariva noৱAriva Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va|
AllAhei sakalo vastura sraSTA Aru teৱe~i sakalo vastura tattvAৱdhAYaka|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra cAvisamUha teOMra ocaratei| yisakale AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kare, siha~tei haiche kSatigrasta|
koৱA, ‘he ajJasakala! tomAloke moka AllAhara vAhire Anara ivAdata karivalai nirdeza diYA neki’?
nizcaYa tomAra prati Aru tomAra pUrvaৱrtIsakalara prati ahI karA haiche ye, ‘yadi tumi zvirka karA tente tomAra sakalo Amala niSphala hai yAva Aru nizcaYa tumi kSatigrastasakalara antarbhukta ha’vA|
‘varaM tumi keৱla AllAharei ivAdata karA Aru kRtajJasakalara antarbhukta hoৱA’|

Aru siha~te AllAhaka yathocita sanmAna karA nAi, athaca kiYAmatara dinA goTei pRthiৱI thAkiva teOMra hAtara muThita Aru AkAzasamUha teOMra so~ hAtata meriYAi thoৱA aৱsthAta thAkiva| paৱitra Aru mahAna teOM, (AnahAte) siha~te yivoraka aMzI sthApana kare teOM seivorara parA vahu urddhata|

Aru (seidinA) ziGAta phu~ diYA ha’va| phalata AkAzasamUhata yisakala Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yisakala Ache siha~ta ATAYe ajJAna hai pariva, keৱla AllAhe icchA karA vyaktisakalara vAhire| tAra pichata Akau ziGAta phu~ diYA ha’va, phalata tatkSaNAta siha~te thiYa hai thara lAgi cAi thAkiva|

Aru (seidinA) pRthiৱI teOMra pratipAlakara nUrata udbhAsita ha'va Aru AmalanAmA upasthApana karA ha'va| navIsakalaka Aru sAkSIsakalaka upasthita karA ha'va Aru teOMlokara mAjata nyAYa vicAra karA ha'va, enekai ye siha~tara prati kono dharaNara anyAYa karA naha’va|
Aru pratyekake tAra Amalara pUrNa pratiphala diYA ha’va Aru siha~te yi Amala kare sei samparke AllAha sarvAdhika aৱgata|

Aru kAphirasakalaka jAhAnnAmara phAle dale dale khedi lai yoৱA ha’va| aৱzeSata yetiYA siha~te jAhAnnAmara ocarata gai pAva, tetiYA iYAra duৱArasamUha khuli diYA ha’va Aru jAhAnnAmara rakSakasakale siha~taka sudhiva, ‘tomAlokara ocaralai tomAlokara mAjara parAi rAchula ahA nAchilane, yisakale tomAlokara ocarata tomAlokara pratipAlakara AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karichila Aru ei diৱsara sAkSAt samparke tomAlokaka satarka karichila’? siha~te ka’va, ‘nizcaYa Ahichila’| kintu zAstira vANI kAphirasakalara oparata sAvyasta haiche|
koৱA ha’va, ‘tomAloke jAhAnnAmara duৱArere tAta sthAYIbhAৱe thakAra vAve praৱeza karA| eteke ahaMkArIvilAkara AvAsasthala kimAna ye nikRSTa!

AnahAte yisakale nija pratipAlakara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karichila teOMlokaka dale dale jAnnAtara phAle lai yoৱA ha’va| aৱzeSata yetiYA teOMloke jAnnAtara ocarata Ahi pAva, Aru iYAra duৱArasamUha khuli diYA ha’va Aru jAnnAtara rakSakasakale teOMlokaka ka’va, ‘AponAlokara prati chAlAma (zAnti aৱtIrNa) haoka, AponAloka sukhI thAkaka| eteke cirasthAYI vasavAsara vAve jAnnAtata praৱeza karaka’|

Aru teOMloke (praৱeza kari) ka’va, ‘sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAharei prApya, yijane AmAra prati teOMra pratizruti satya hicApe vAstaৱAYita kariche Aru AmAka ei bhUmira adhikArI kariche, Ami jAnnAtata ya’te icchA ta’tei vasavAsara ThAi kari lama’| eteke (coৱA) neka AmalakArIsakalara puraskAra kimAna ye uttama!

Aru tumi phiristAsakalaka dekhivalai pAvA ye, teOMloke Arachara cAriophAle Aguri dhari nija pratipAlakara prazaMsAra saite paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kari Ache| (seidinA) nyAYara saite sakalore vicAra karA ha’va Aru koৱA ha’va, ‘sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAharei prApya’|
hA-mIma|[1]
eikhana kitAva aৱtIrNa haiche AllAhara taraphara parA yijana mahAparAkramazAlI, sarvajJa,
teOM pApa kSamAkArI, tAovA grahaNakArI, kaThora zAsti pradAnakArI, anugraha varSaNakArI| teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| teOMra phAlei pratyAৱrtana|
AllAhara AYAtasamUhakalai vitarka keৱla siha~tei kare yisakale kupharI kariche; eteke deza videzalai siha~tara avAdha vicaraNe yena tomAka vicalita nakare|

siha~tara pUrve nUha sampradAYeo asvIkAra karichila, lagate siha~tara pichata Aru vahu dale asvIkAra karichila| pratyeka sampradAYei nija nija rAchulaka karAYatta karAra saMkalpa karichila Aru siha~te satyaka vyartha karivalai asAra tarka-vitarkata lipta haichila| phalata maYe siha~taka karAYatta karichilo~| eteke kimAna kaThora Achila mora zAsti!
Aru yisakale kupharI karichila, eidarei siha~tara oparata vAstaৱAYita haichila tomAra pratipAlakara vANI ye, nizcaYa siha~ta haiche jAhAnnAmI|

yisakale Aracha vahana kari Ache Aru yisakale iYAra cAriophAle Ache, teOMloke nija pratipAlakara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare prazaMsAra saite, lagate teOMloke teOMra oparata ImAna poSaNa kare, Aru muminasakalara vAve kSamA prArthanA kari kaYa, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tomAra daYA Aru jJAna sarvavyApI| eteke yisakale tAovA kare Aru tomAra patha aৱlamvana kare, tumi teOMlokaka kSamA kari diYA| lagate jAhAnnAmara zAstira parA tumi teOMlokaka rakSA karA|

‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi teOMlokaka praৱeza karoৱA sthAYI jAnnAtata, yAra pratizruti tumi teOMlokaka pradAna karichA lagate teOMlokara pitR-mAtR, pati-patnI Aru santAna-santatira mAjara yisakale satkarma kariche teOMlokako (praৱeza karoৱA)| nizcaYa tumi parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
‘Aru tumi teOMlokaka aparAdhara zAstira parA rakSA karA| seidinA tumi yAka (aparAdhara) veYA pariNatira parA rakSA karivA, nizcaYa tumi tAka anugrahahe karivA; Aru eiToৱei haiche mahAsaphalatA!’

nizcaYa yisakale kupharI kariche siha~taka ucca kaNThata koৱA ha’va, ‘tomAlokara nijara prati (Aji) tomAlokara yimAna kSobha haiche, AllAhara kSobha iYAtakaio adhika Achila, yetiYA tomAlokaka ImAnara prati AhvAna karA haichila, kintu tomAloke seYA asvIkAra karichilA’|

siha~te ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAka duvArakai mRtyu pradAna karichA Aru duvArakai AmAka jIৱna dAna karichA| seYe Ami AmAra aparAdha svIkAra karicho~| eteke (jAhAnnAmara parA) oloৱAra kono upAYa Ache neki’?

(siha~taka koৱA ha’va) ‘tomAlokaka zAsti diYAra kAraNa haiche, yetiYA AllAhaka ekakabhAৱe AhvAna karA haichila tetiYA tomAloke kupharI karichilA, Aru yetiYA teOMra lagata zvirka karA haichila tetiYA tomAloke seYA vizvAsa karichilA| eteke yAৱtIYa kartRtva keৱla suucca, mahAna AllAharei’|
teৱe~i tomAlokaka teOMra nidarzanAৱlI dekhuৱAYa Aru AkAzara parA tomAlokara vAve jIৱikA aৱtIrNa kare| upadeza keৱla sei vyaktihe grahaNa kare yiYe AllAha abhimukhI haYa|
eteke tomAloke AllAhara Anugatyata ekaniSTha hai keৱla teOMkei AhvAna karA| yadio kAphirasakale iYAka apachanda kare|

teOM suucca maryAdAra adhikArI, Arachara adhipati, teৱe~i nijara Adezata vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yAra prati icchA kare tAra prati ahI preraNa kare, yAte teOM mahA sanmilana diৱsa samparke satarka kariva pAre|
yidinA siha~ta (mAnuha vilAka) prakAzita ha’va, seidinA AllAhara ocarata siha~tara ekoৱei gopana nAthAkiva| (teOM ka’va) ‘Aji kartRtva kAra’? keৱla AllAharei, teOM ekaka, pravala pratApazAlI|
Aji pratyekake tAra kRtakarma anusAre pratiphala diYA ha’va, Aji kono dharaNara anyAYa karA naha’va| nizcaYa AllAha hicApa grahaNata ati tatpara|

Aru tumi siha~taka Asanna diৱsa samparke satarka kari diYA; yetiYA dukha-kaSTa samvaraNa aৱsthAta siha~tara prANa kaNThAgata ha’va| yAlimasakalara vAve kono antaraGga vandhu nAi Aru enekuৱA kono madhyasthatAkArIo nAi yAra madhyasthatA grahaNa karA ha’va|
cakusamUhara vizvAsaghAtakatA Aru antarasamUhe yi gopana kare seYAo teOM jAne|
AllAhe yathAyathabhAৱe phaYacAlA kare, Aru AllAhara parivarte siha~te yivoraka AhvAna kare siha~te ekoৱei phaYacAlA kariva noৱAre| nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

iha~te pRthiৱIta vicaraNa nakare neki? tetiYAhe siha~te dekhA pAlehe~tena, pUrve yisakala Achila siha~tara pariNAma ki haichila| siha~te iha~tara tulanAta pRthiৱIta adhika zaktizAlI Achila Aru kIrtita Achila ati pravala| tathApio AllAhe siha~taka siha~tara aparAdhara vAve karAYatta karichila Aru AllAhara zAstira parA siha~taka rakSA karivalai kono nAchila|

eiTo eikAraNe ye, siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara rAchulasakale suspaSTa pramANAdisaha Ahichila tathApio siha~te (teOMlokaka) pratyAkhyAna karichila| seYe AllAhe siha~taka karAYatta karichila| nizcaYa teOM zaktizAlI, zAsti pradAnata ati kaThora|
Aru nizcaYa AmiYei muchAka AmAra nidarzanAৱlI Aru spaSTa pramANasaha preraNa karichilo~|
phiraAuna, hAmAna Aru kArUnara ocaralai| kintu siha~te teOMka, ‘yAdukara, carama michalIYA vuli kaichila’|

tAra pichata muchAi yetiYA AmAra taraphara parA satya lai siha~tara ocarata gai upasthita ha’la, tetiYA siha~te ka’le, ‘muchAra lagata yisakale ImAna Aniche, siha~tara putra santAnavilAkaka hatyA karA Aru siha~tara nArIsakalaka jIৱita eri diYA’| nizcaYa kAphirasakalara SaDa়yantra haiche bhraSTatApUrNa|

Aru phiraAune ka’le, ‘moka eri diYA mai muchAka hatyA karima, cAOM si tAra pratipAlakaka AhvAna karakacona| nizcaYa mai AzaMkA karo~ ye, si tomAlokara dvInaka parivartana kari diva nAivA dezata azAnti viYapAva’|

muchAi ka’le, ‘mai mora pratipAlaka Aru (yijana) tomAlokaro pratipAlaka teOMra ocarata AzraYa prArthanA karicho~, enekuৱA pratyeka ahaMkArI vyaktira parA yiYe vicAra diৱsara oparata ImAna poSaNa nakare’|

Aru phiraAuna vaMzara ejana mumina vyaktiYe yijane nijara ImAna gopana rAkhichila teOM ka’le, ‘tomAloke ejana vyaktika ei kAraNe hatyA karivA neki ye, teOM kaYa, ‘mora pratipAlaka haiche keৱla AllAha’, athaca teOM tomAlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA suspaSTa pramANasaha tomAlokara ocaralai Ahiche? teOM yadi michalIYA haYa tAra vAve dAYI teOM nijei ha’va, Aru yadi teOM satyavAdI haYa tente teOM tomAlokaka yi pratizruti diche, tAra parA kichu parimANa ha’leo tomAlokara oparata Apatita ha’va’| nizcaYa AllAhe sei vyaktika hidAYata nakare, yijana sImAlaMghanakArI, michalIYA|

‘he mora sampradAYa! Aji tomAlokarei rAjatva, pRthiৱIta tomAlokei prabhAৱzAlI; kintu AllAhara zAsti Ahile kone AmAka sahAYa kariva’? phiraAune ka’le, ‘mai yiTo saThika vuli bhAvo~, seiToৱei tomAlokaka dekhuৱAOM Aru mai tomAlokaka keৱla saThika pathahe dekhuৱAOM’|
mumina vyaktijane Aru ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! nizcaYa mai tomAlokara pratio sei dinaTora AzaMkA karo~ yiTo pUrvaৱrtI dalasamUhara oparata Ahichila;
‘yidare saMghaTita haichila, nUha, Ada, chAmUda Aru siha~tara paraৱrtI lokasakalara kSetrata| AllAhe vAndAsakalara oparata kono anyAYa kariva nivicAre|
‘Aru he mora sampradAYa! nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve bhaYArta AhvAna diৱsara AzaMkA karicho~,
‘yidinA tomAloke picha ho~hakA di palAva vicArivA, (seidinA) AllAhara zAstira parA tomAlokaka rakSA karivalai kono nAthAkiva| AllAhe yAka vibhrAnta kare, tAra vAve kono hidAYatakArI nAi’|

nizcaYa itipUrve tomAlokara ocaralai suspaSTa pramANAdisaha iuchupha Ahichila, phalata teOM tomAlokara ocaralai yi Anichila tAka tomAloke sadAYa sandeha karichilA| aৱzeSata yetiYA teOMra mRtyu ha’la, tetiYA tomAloke kaichilA, ‘AllAhe eOMra pichata ketiYAo Ana kono rAchula preraNa nakariva|’ eidarei AllAhe pratyeka sImAlaMghanakArI, saMzaYavAdIka vibhrAnta kare|

yisakale siha~tara ocaralai (siha~tara dAvIra samarthanata) kono dalIla-pramANa nahA sattveo AllAhara nidarzanAৱlI samparke vitarkata lipta haYa| AllAha Aru muminasakalara dRSTita siha~tara ei karma ati ghRNAra yogya| eidarei AllAhe pratyeka ahaMkArI, svairAcArI vyaktira hRdaYata mohara mAri diYe|
Aru phiraAune ka’le, ‘he hAmAna! mora vAve tumi ekhana suucca prAsAda nirmANa karA, yAte mai upAYa aৱlamvana kariva pAro~,

‘AkAzasamUhata ArohaNara upAYa vicAri pAOM, yAte mai muchAra ilAhaka jumi cAva pAro~, nizcaYa mai tAka michalIYA vulihe bhAvo~’| eidarei phiraAunara karmaka tAra ocarata zobhanIYa kari diYA haichila Aru tAka sarala pathara parA nivRtta karA haichila, lagate phiraAunara SaDa়yantra vyarthahe haichila|
ImAna poSaNa karA vyaktijane Aru ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke mora anusaraNa karA, mai tomAlokaka saThika pathata paricAlita karima|
‘he mora sampradAYa! ei pArthiৱ jIৱna haiche keৱla asthAYI bhoga-sAmagrI| nizcaYa AkhirAta, seiTohe haiche sthAYI AvAsa|

‘konovAi asatkarma karile si keৱla tAra karma anupAtei zAsti pAva| AnahAte puruSa haoka vA nArI mumina hai yiYe satkarma kariva, teOMlokei jAnnAtata praৱeza kariva, tAta teOMlokaka diYA ha’va agaNana jIৱikA|
‘he mora sampradAYa! ki ha’la! mai tomAlokaka muktira pine AhvAna kari Acho~, Aru tomAloke moka agnira pine mAti AchA!

‘tomAloke moka mAti AchA yAte mai AllAhara lagata kupharI karo~ Aru teOMra lagata zvirka karo~, yi viSaYe mora kono jJAna nAi; athaca mai tomAlokaka AhvAna kari Acho~ mahA parAkramazAlI, parama kSamAzIlara phAle|

‘ei viSaYata kono sandeha nAi ye, tomAloke moka yAra phAle AhvAna kari AchA, si pRthiৱI Aru AkhirAtara ka'to AhvAnara yogya nahaYa| prakRtate AmAra pratyAৱrtana ha’va keৱla AllAhara pine Aru nizcaYa sImAlaMghanakArI- vilAka haiche agnira adhivAsI|

‘eteke mai tomAlokaka yivora kathA kai Acho~, anatipalame tomAloke seivora kathA smaraNa karivA; Aru mai mora (yAৱtIYa) viSaYa AllAhara ocaratei samarpaNa karicho~| nizcaYa AllAha teOMra vAndAsakalara prati sarvadraSTA’|
phalata AllAhe teOMka siha~tara yaDa়yantrara aniSTara parA rakSA karile Aru phiraAuna goSThIka kaThina zAstiYe gheri pelAle,
puৱA-gadhUli siha~taka agnita upasthita karA haYa Aru yidinA kiYAmata saMghaTita ha’va seidinA (phiristAsakalaka) koৱA ha’va, ‘phiraAuna goSThIka kaThora zAstita nikSepa karA’|

Aru yetiYA siha~te jAhAnnAmatagai paraspare vitarkata lipta ha’va, tetiYA durvalasakale ahaMkArIvilAkaka ka’va, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAlokara anusArI Achilo~, eteke tomAloke AmAra parA jAhAnnAmara juira kichu aMza grahaNa karivAne’?
ahaMkArIvilAke ka’va, ‘Ami sakaloৱe dekhona iYAtei Acho~, nizcaYa AllAhe vAndAsakalara mAjata vicAra sampanna kariche’|
Aru jAhAnnAmIvilAke jAhAnnAmara praharIsakalaka ka’va, ‘AponAloke (AmAra hai) AponAlokara pratipAlakara ocarata prArthanA karakacona, teOM yena AmAra parA edinara vAve ha'leo zAsti lAghaৱ kari diYe’|

teOMloke ka'va’, ‘tomAlokara ocaralai spaSTa pramANAdi sahakAre tomAlokara rAchulasakala ahA nAchilane’? jAhAnnAmIvilAke ka’va, ‘haYa nizcaYa Ahichila’| praharIsakale ka’va, ‘eteke tomAlokei prArthanA karA; Aru kAphirasakalara prArthanA keৱla niSphalahe haYa’|
nizcaYa Ami AmAra rAchulasakalaka Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokaka pArthiৱ jIৱnata sahAYa karima, Aru seidinAo sahAYa karima yidinA sAkSIsakala thiYa ha’va|
yidinA yAlimasakalara ojara-Apatti siha~tara kono kAmata nAhiva| siha~tara vAve Ache abhisampAta Aru siha~tara vAve Ache nikRSTa AvAsa|
Aru nizcaYa Ami muchAka hidAYata dAna karichilo~ Aru vanI icharAIlaka kitAvara uttarAdhikArI karichilo~,
vodhazaktisampanna lokasakalara vAve pathanirdeza Aru upadeza hicApe|

eteke tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA, nizcaYa AllAhara pratizruti satya| lagate tumi tomAra truTira vAve kSamA prArthanA karA Aru puৱA-gadhUli tomAra pratipAlakara prazaMsAra saite paৱitratA tathA mahimA ghoSaNA karA|

nizcaYa yisakale nijara ocarata kono dalIla-pramANa nathakA satveo AllAhara nidarzanAৱlI samparke vitarkata lipta haYa, siha~tara antarata Ache keৱla ahaMkAra, siha~te ei viSaYata ketiYAo saphalatA lAbha kariva noৱAriva| eteke tumi keৱla AllAhara ocarata AzraYa vicarA; nizcaYa teOM sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
nizcaYa AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sRSTi, mAnaৱ sRSTitakaio DAGara viSaYa, kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei seYA nAjAne|

andha Aru dRSTisampanna vyakti ketiYAo samAna nahaYa, eidare yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, pakSAntare yisakale asatkarma kariche siha~teo samAna nahaYa| tomAloke ati sAmAnyahe upadeza grahaNa karA|
nizcaYa kiYAmata aৱzyambhAৱI, iYAta kono sandeha nAi; kintu adhikAMza lokei vizvAsa nakare|

Aru tomAlokara pratipAlake kaiche, ‘tomAloke keৱla mora ocaratei duA karA, mai tomAlokara duA kavula karima| nizcaYa yisakale ahaMkAra kari mora ivAdatara parA vimukha haYa, siha~ta acirei lAJchita hai jAhAnnAmata praৱeza kariva’|

AllAha, yijane tomAlokara vAve rAtika sRSTi kariche yAte tomAloke tAta vizrAma kariva pArA, Aru dinaka kariche Alokojjvala| nizcaYa AllAha mAnuhara prati anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza mAnuhei kRtajJatA prakAza nakare|
teৱe~i AllAha, tomAlokara pratipAlaka, sakalo vastura sraSTA; teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| eteke tomAlokaka ka’lai obhotAi niYA haiche?
eidarei obhatAi niYA haYa seisakala lokaka, yisakale AllAhara nidarzanAৱlIka asvIkAra kare|

AllAhei tomAlokara vAve pRthiৱIka sthitizIla kariche Aru AkAzakhanaka kari diche cAda Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara AkRti gaThana kariche, tAra pichata tomAlokara AkRtika sundara rUpa diche, lagate tomAlokaka paৱitra vastura parA jIৱikA dAna kariche| teৱe~i AllAha, tomAlokara pratipAlaka| eteke vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAha kimAna ye varakatamaYa!

teOM ciraJjIৱ, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| eteke tomAloke teOMra Anugatyata ekaniSTha hai keৱla teOMkei prArthanA karA| sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAharei prApya|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke AllAhara vAhire yivoraka prArthanA karA, seivorara ivAdata karivalai moka niSedha karA haiche, kAraNa mora pratipAlakara taraphara parA mora ocaralai suspaSTa pramANAdi Ahiche| mai vizvajagatara pratipAlakara ocarata AtmasamarpaNa karivalai AdezaprApta haicho~|

teৱe~i tomAlokaka mATira parA sRSTi kariche, tAra pichata zukravindura parA, tAra pichata AlAkA (raktapiNDa)ra parA, tAra pichatahe tomAlokaka uliYAi Ane naৱjAta zizurUpe, yAte tomAloke yauৱnata upanIta hoৱA, tAra pichata yAte tomAloke vRddha hoৱA| tomAlokara kichumAnaka iYAra pUrvei mRtyu ghaToৱA haYa, yAte tomAloke nirdhArita samaYata upanIta hoৱA Aru tomAloke yAte vujiva pArA|
teৱe~i jIৱna dAna kare Aru teৱe~i mRtyu ghaTAYa, Aru yetiYA teOM kivA karivalai sthira kare tetiYA iYAra vAve teOM keৱla kaYa ‘ha’, seiTo tatkSaNAta hai yAYa|
tumi siha~taka lakSya karA nAine, yisakale AllAhara nidarzanAৱlI samparke vitarka kare? siha~taka ka’lai obhatAi niYA haiche?
siha~te kitAvaka Aru AmAra rAchulasakale yi lai prerita haiche tAka asvIkAra kare, eteke siha~te zIghrei jAnivalai pAva,
yetiYA siha~tara DiGita galAvaddha Aru zikali thAkiva, Aru siha~taka TAni lai yoৱA ha’va,
utalA pAnIra mAjata, tAra pichata siha~taka jvaloৱA ha'va agnira mAjata|
tAra pichata siha~taka koৱA ha’va, ‘ka'ta siha~ta, yisakalaka tomAloke aMzIdAra sthApana karichilA,
AllAhara vAhire’? siha~te ka’va, ‘siha~ta dekhona AmAra parA (Aji) A~tari gaiche; varaM itipUrve Ami kAko AhvAne karA nAchilo~’| eidarei AllAhe kAphirasakalaka vibhrAnta kare|
eYA eikAraNe ye, tomAloke pRthiৱIta ayathA ullAsa karichilA Aru ei kAraNeo ye, tomAloke ahaMkAra karichilA|
tomAloke jAhAnnAmata sthAYIbhAৱe aৱsthAna karivalai iYAra vibhinna duৱArere praৱeza karA, eteke (coৱAcona!) kimAna ye nikRSTa ahaMkArI vilAkara AvAsasthala!

gatike tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA| nizcaYa AllAhara pratizruti satya| Ami siha~taka yi pratizruti pradAna karicho~ tAre alapa yadi mai tomAka dekhuৱAi diOM athavA (tAra pUrvei yadi) tomAra mRtyu ghaTAOM, tathApio dekhona siha~te mora ocaralaikei pratyAৱrtita ha’va|

nizcaYa Ami tomAra pUrveo vahuto rAchula preraNa karicho~| Ami teOMlokara kichumAnara varNanA tomAra ocarata karicho~ Aru kichumAnara varNanA karA nAi| AllAhara anumati avihane kono nirdazana lai ahATo kono rAchulara pakSe sambhaৱ nahaYa| eteke yetiYA AllAhara Adeza Ahiva tetiYA nyAYa saMgatabhAৱe phaYacAlA hai yAva| tetiYA vAtilapanthIvilAka kSatigrasta ha’va|
teৱe~i AllAha, yijane tomAlokara vAve gharacIYA jantu sRSTi kariche, yAte tomAloke seivorara kichumAnara oparata ArohaNa kariva pArA Aru kichumAnaka bhakSaNa kariva pArA|

Aru iYAta tomAlokara vAve Ache pracura upakAra, yAte tomAloke nijara antarata yi praYojana anubhaৱ karA, seivorara dvArA seYA pUraNa kariva pArA| lagate seivorara oparata Aru nauyAnara oparata tomAlokaka vahana karA haYa|
Aru teৱe~i tomAlokaka teOMra nidarzanAৱlI dekhuৱAi thAke| eteke tomAloke AllAhara konaTo konaTo nidarzanaka asvIkAra karivA?

siha~te pRthiৱIta bhramaNa karA nAi neki, tetiYAhe siha~te dekhA pAlehe~tena siha~tara pUrvaৱrtI vilAkara pariNAma ki haichila? siha~te pRthiৱIta iha~tatakaio saMkhyAgariSTha Achila lagate zakti Aru kIrtita Achila ati pravala| tathApio siha~te yi arjana karichila seYA siha~tara kono kAmata ahA nAchila|

siha~tara ocaralai yetiYA siha~tara rAchulasakale suspaSTa pramANAdi lai upasthita haichila, tetiYA siha~te (seivoraka aৱjJA kari) nijara ocarata thakA jJAnake prAdhAnya di Anandita haichila| phalata siha~te yiToka lai ThATTA-vidrUpa karichila seiToৱei siha~taka pariveSTana karichila|
Aru siha~te yetiYA AmAra zAsti dekhA pAichila tetiYA kaichila, ‘Ami ekamAtra AllAhara oparata ImAna Anilo~ Aru Ami teOMra lagata yivoraka aMzI karichilo~ seivoraka pratyAkhyAna karilo~’|

kintu AmAra zAsti dekhA poৱAra pichata siha~te lai ahA ImAna siha~tara kono upakArata ahA nAchila| AllAhara ei vidhAna pUrvare parA teOMra vAndAsakalara mAjata cali Ahiche| phalata kAphirasakala kSatigrasta ha’la|
hA-mIma|[1]
(ei granthakhana) parama karuNAmaYa parama daYAlu sattvAra taraphara parA aৱtIrNa|
enekuৱA ekhana kitAva, yAra AYAtasamUha jJAnI sampradAYara vAve vizadabhAৱe varNanA karA haiche, koraAnarUpe AravI bhASAta,
susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArI hicApe| tathApio siha~tara sarahabhAgei mukha ghUrAi laiche| gatike siha~te nuzuniva|

Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘tumi AmAka yAra prati AhvAna kari AchA, sei viSaYe AmAra antarata AৱraNa pariche, Aru AmAra kANata Ache vadhiratA, lagate AmAra Aru tomAlokara mAjata Ache pardA; seYe tumi tomAra kAma karA, nizcaYa Ami AmAra kAma karima’|

koৱA, ‘mai keৱla tomAlokara darei ejana mAnuha, mora prati ahI karA haYa ye, tomAlokara ilAha haiche keৱla ejana ilAha| eteke tomAloke teOMra prati dRDha়tA aৱlamvana karA Aru teOMra ocaratei kSamA prArthanA karA’| lagate durbhoga haiche muzvarikasakalara vAve,
yisakale yAkAta pradAna nakare, Aru siha~tei haiche AkhirAta asvIkArakArI|
nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche, teOMlokara vAve Ache niraৱcchinna puraskAra|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke teOMra lagata kupharI karA neki, yijane dudinata pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche? Aru tomAloke teOMra samakakSa sthira karAne’? teOM haiche vizvajagatara pratipAlaka!
Aru teৱe~i bhUpRSThata dRDha় parvatamAlA sthApana kariche Aru tAta varakata diche Aru cAri dinara mAjata iYAta khAdya vastura vyaৱsthA kariche samAnabhAৱe sakalo anusandhAnakArIra vAve|

tAra pichata teOM AkAzara phAle manoniৱeza karile, yiTo (Agate) Achila dhUmrapuJjavizeSa| tAra pichata teOM tAka (AkAzaka) Aru pRthiৱIka ka’le, ‘tomAloka ubhaYe AhA icchAtei haoka vA anicchAtei haoka’| siha~ta ubhaYe ka’le, ‘Ami anugata hai Ahilo~’|

eidare teOM dudinata AkAzasamUhaka sAta AkAzata pariNata karile Aru pratyeka AkAzata teOMra nirdeza ahI yoge preraNa karile; Aru Ami nikaTaৱrtI AkAzakhanaka pradIpamAlAra dvArA suzobhita Aru surakSita karilo~| eivora haiche mahAparAkramazAlI, sarvajJara vyaৱsthApanA|

tathApio yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa tente (siha~taka) koৱA, ‘mai tomAlokaka keৱla eTA dhvaMsAtmaka zAsti samparke satarka karicho~, yenekuৱA zAstira sanmukhIna haichila Ada Aru chAmUda sampradAYa’|

yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara rAchulasakale sanmukhara parA Aru pichaphAlara parA Ahi kaichila ye, ‘tomAloke ekamAtra AllAhara vAhire Ana kAro ivAdata nakarivA’| (tetiYA) siha~te kaichila, ‘yadi AmAra pratipAlake icchA karilehe~tena tente nizcaYa teOM phiristA aৱtIrNa karilehe~tena| eteke tomAloke yi lai prerita haichA seYA Ami asvIkAra karo~’|

AnahAte Ada sampradAYara viSaYaTo haiche enekuৱA ye, siha~te pRthiৱIta ayathA ahaMkAra karichila Aru kaichila, ‘AmAtakai adhika zaktizAlI Aru kona Ache’? eteke siha~te lakSya karA nAi neki ye, nizcaYa AllAha, yijane siha~taka sRSTi kariche, teOM siha~tatakaio zaktizAlI? Aru siha~te AmAra nidarzanAৱlIka asvIkAra karichila|

tAra pichata Ami siha~tara oparata azubha dinavorata dhumuhA preraNa karilo~; yAte Ami siha~taka pArthiৱ jIৱnatei lAJchanAdAYaka zAstira soৱAda bhoga karAva pAro~; Aru AkhirAtara zAsti iYAtakaio adhika lAJchanAdAYaka Aru siha~taka sahAYo karA naha’va|

Aru chAmUda sampradAYara viSaYaTo Achila enekuৱA ye, Ami siha~taka pathanirdeza dichilo~, kintu siha~te satpathara parivarte andhapathata calATohe pachanda karichila| phalata siha~tara kRtakarmara pariNAma hicApe lAJchanAdAYaka zAstira vajrAghAte siha~taka karAYatta karichila|
Aru yisakale ImAna Anichila Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karichila, Ami teOMlokaka rakSA karichilo~|
Aru (smaraNa karA) yidinA AllAhara zatruvilAkaka agnira phAle samaveta karA ha’va, seidinA siha~taka vinyasta karA ha’va vibhinna dalata|
aৱzeSata siha~te yetiYA jAhAnnAmara ekevAre sannikaTata gai upasthita ha’va, tetiYA siha~tara kANa, siha~tara caku Aru chAleo siha~tara viruddhe siha~tara kRtakarma samparke sAkSya diva|

Aru siha~te (jAhAnnAmIvilAke) siha~tara chAlavoraka sudhiva, ‘kiYa tomAloke AmAra viruddhe sAkSya dilA’? chAlavore ka’va, ‘AllAhei AmAka vAkazakti diche, yi sattvAi sakaloke vAkazakti diche’| teৱe~i tomAlokaka prathamavAra sRSTi kariche Aru teOMra ocaratei tomAloka pratyAৱrtita ha’vA|

tomAlokara kANa, caku Aru chAla AdiYe tomAlokara viruddhe sAkSya nidiva vuli tomAloke eivorara parA ekoৱei gopana karA nAchilA, Anaki tomAloke bhAvichilA ye, tomAloke yi karA tAra sarahabhAgei AllAhe nAjAne|
tomAlokara pratipAlaka samparke tomAlokara ei dhAraNAi tomAlokaka dhvaMsa kariche| phalata tomAloka haichA kSatigrastavilAkara antarbhukta|
etiYA yadi siha~te dhairyya dhAraNa kare tathApio agniYei ha’va siha~tara AvAsa; Aru yadi siha~te santuSTi vidhAna kariva vicAre tathApio siha~te santuSTi prAptasakalara antarbhukta naha’va|

Aru Ami siha~tara vAve veYA svabhAৱra sahacaravRnda nirdhAraNa kari dichilo~, yisakale siha~tara bhaৱiSyat Aru atItaka siha~tara dRSTita zobhanIYa kari dekhuৱAichila| seYe siha~tara oparata zAstira vANI sAvyasta haiche, siha~tara pUrve ativAhita hoৱA jina Aru mAnaৱ jAtira dare| nizcaYa siha~ta Achila kSatigrasta|
Aru kAphiravilAke kaYa, ‘tomAloke ei koraAnara nirdeza nuzunivA Aru eikhana tilAৱta karAra samaYata tomAloke hai cai sRSTi karivA, yAte tomAloke jaYI ha’va pArA’|
gatike nizcaYa Ami kAphirasakalaka kaThina zAsti AsvAdana karAma Aru aৱzye Ami siha~taka siha~tara nikRSTa kAryakalApara pratiphala dima|
ei haiche AllAhara zatruvilAkara pratidAna, jAhAnnAma| AmAra nidarzanAৱlIra prati siha~tara asvIkRtira pratiphala hicApe siha~tara vAve tAta Ache sthAYI AvAsa|

Aru kAphirasakale ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! jina Aru mAnuhara mAjara parA yi dujane AmAka pathabhraSTa karichila siha~taka dekhuৱAi diYA, Ami siha~ta ubhaYake bharira talata rAkhima, yAte siha~ta nikRSTavilAkara antarbhukta haYa’|

nizcaYa yisakale kaYa, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka haiche AllAha’, tAra pichata avicalita thAke, teOMlokara ocaralai phiristA aৱtIrNa hai ei kathA kaYa ye, ‘tomAloke bhaYa nakarivA, Aru cintitao naha’vA varaM tomAlokaka yi jAnnAtara pratizruti diYA haichila tAra vAve Anandita hoৱA|
‘AmiYei tomAlokara vandhu pArthiৱ jIৱnato Aru AkhirAtato| Aru tAta tomAlokara vAve pratyeka seiTo vastu thAkiva yiTo tomAlokara mane vicAriva, lagate tomAloke tAta yiTo dAvI karivA seiToৱei thAkiva’|
atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu AllAhara taraphara parA eiTo ha’va Atithya|
seijanatakai Aruno kAra kathA uttama ha’va pAre, yiYe AllAhara phAle AhvAna kare, lagate satkarma kare? Aru kaYa, ‘nizcaYa mai muchalimasakalara antarbhukta’|
bhAla Aru veYA ketiYAo samAna ha’va noৱAre| seYe utkRSTa panthAre veYAka pratihata karA, phalata tomAra Aru yAra mAjata zatrutA Ache, (ene karile) si hai yAva tomAra antaraGga vandhura dare|
ei caritrara adhikArI keৱla teOMlokei haYa yisakala dhairyyazIla| lagate iYAra adhikArI keৱla teOMlokei haYa yisakala mahAbhAgyaৱAna|
Aru yadi caYatAnara taraphara parA kono kumantraNAi tomAka prarocita kare, tente tumi AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA karivA| nizcaYa teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

Aru teOMra nidarzanAৱlIra mAjata Ache rAti Aru dina, sUrya Aru candra| tomAloke sUryaka chAjadAha nakarivA, Aru candrako nahaYa; chAjadAha karivA keৱla AllAhaka, yijane eivoraka sRSTi kariche, yadihe tomAloke keৱla teOMrei ivAdata karA|

tathApio yadi siha~te ahaMkAra kare, tente (jAni thoৱA) yisakala tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata Ache, teOMloke dine rAti teOMrei paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare Aru teOMloke klAntivodho nakare| (chAjadAha)

teOMra Ana eTA nidarzana ei ye, tumi bhUmika zukAna dekhivalai poৱA, tAra pichata yetiYA Ami tAta pAnI varSaNa karo~ tetiYA seYA ujjIৱita Aru sphIta haYa| nizcaYa yijane bhUmika jIৱita kare teৱe~i mRtasakalaka jIৱita kariva| nizcaYa teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

nizcaYa yisakale AmAra AYAtasamUhaka vikRta kare, siha~ta AmAra parA uhya nahaYa| (koৱAcona) ‘yijana agnita nikSipta ha’va si zreSTha, ne yijana kiYAmatara dinA nirApade upasthita ha’va teOM zreSTha’? tomAloke yi icchA Amala karA| tomAloke yi Amalake nakarA kiYa, nizcaYa teOM tAra samyaka draSTA|
nizcaYa yisakale upadeza (koraAna) ahAra pichato seYA asvIkAra kare (siha~taka aৱzye kaThina zAsti diYA ha’va)| nizcaYa eYA haiche ekhana sanmAnita grantha,
vAtila ketiYAo iYAta anupraৱeza kariva noৱAre, sanmukhara parAo nahaYa, pichaphAlara parAo nahaYa| eiTo prajJAmaYa, ciraprazaMsita sattvAra taraphara parA aৱtIrNa|
tomAka keৱla seiToৱei koৱA haYa, yiTo koৱA haichila tomAra pUrvaৱrtI rAchulasakalaka| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka ekAnta kSamAzIla Aru ati yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pradAnakArI|

Aru Ami yadi anAravI bhASAta koraAna aৱtIrNa karilohe~tena tente siha~te nizcaYa ka’lehe~tena, ‘iYAra AYAtasamUha vizadabhAৱe vivRta hoৱA nAi kiYa? bhASA anAravIYa, athaca rAchula AravIYa!’ koৱA, ‘eikhana muminasakalara vAve hidAYata Aru pratikAra’| AnahAte yisakale ImAna poSaNa nakare siha~tara kANata Ache vadhiratA Aru koraAne siha~tara (antarara) oparata andhatva sRSTi kariva| siha~takei AhvAna karA ha’va dUraৱrtI sthAnara parA|

nizcaYa Ami muchAka kitAva pradAna karichilo~, kintu tAta matabheda ghaTichila| yadi tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA eTA vANI (siddhAnta) pUrvei kari thoৱA nAthAkilahe~tena tente siha~tara mAjata cUDa়Anta mImAMsA hai ga’lahe~tena| nizcaYa siha~ta ei koraAna samparke vibhrAntikara sandehata patita haichila|
yiYe satkarma kare teOM nijara kalyANara vAvei kare Aru konovAi asatkarma karile tAra pratiphala si nijei bhoga kariva| tomAra pratipAlake nija vAndAsakalara prati kadApio anyAYa nakare|

kiYAmatara jJAna keৱla AllAhara ocaratei pratyAৱrtita haYa| teOMra ajJatAsArata kono phalo AৱraNara parA olAi nAhe, kono nArIo garbha dhAraNa nakare Aru santAno prasaৱ nakare| yidinA AllAhe siha~taka mAti ka’va, ‘mora aMzIdArasakala ka’ta’? tetiYA siha~te ka’va, ‘Ami tomAra ocarata nivedana karo~ ye, ei viSaYe AmAra mAjata kono sAkSI nAi’|
Aru itipUrve siha~te yivilAka (upAsya)ka AhvAna karichila seivora siha~tara parA antardhAna hai yAva, tetiYA siha~te (muzvarikasakale) vizvAsa kariva ye, siha~tara palAYanara kono upAYa nAi|
mAnuhe kalyANa prArthanAta kono klAntivodha nakare, kintu yetiYA tAka kono akalyANe sparza kare tetiYA si sampUrNarUpe hatAza tathA nirAza hai pare;

Akau dukha-dainyai sparza karAra pichata yadi Ami tAka AmAra taraphara parA anugrahara soৱAda la’valai diOM, tetiYA si kaYa, ‘eYA haiche mora prApya Aru mora vizvAsa nahaYa ye kiYAmata saMghaTita ha’va| AnahAte yadi moka mora pratipAlakara ocaralai obhatAi niYAo haYa, tathApio teOMra ocarata mora vAve kalyANei thAkiva’| eteke nizcaYa Ami kAphirasakalaka siha~tara Amala samparke aৱhita karima Aru siha~taka aৱzye kaThora zAsti AsvAdana karAma|
Aru yetiYA Ami mAnuhara prati anugraha karo~ tetiYA si mukha ghUrAi laYa Aru dUralai A~tari yAYa| kintu yetiYA tAka akalyANe sparza kare tetiYA si dIrgha prArthanAkArI haYa|

koৱA, ‘tomAloke ketiYAvA bhAvichAne, yadi ei koraAnakhana AllAhara taraphara parA aৱtIrNa hai thAke, tathApio tomAloke iYAka pratyAkhyAna karichA, tene aৱsthAta yijana vyakti ghora viruddhAcaraNata lipta hai Ache, tAtakai adhika vibhrAnta Aru kona ha’va pAre’?

anatipalame Ami siha~taka AmAra nidarzanAৱlI dekhuৱAma, vizvajagatara prAntasamUhata Aru siha~tara nijara mAjato; yAte siha~tara ocarata suspaSTa hai uThe ye, nizcaYa eikhana (koraAna) satya| eikhana tomAra pratipAlaka samparke yatheSTa nahaYane ye, teOM sakalo vastura oparata sAkSI?
jAni thoৱA! nizcaYa siha~ta nija pratipAlakara sAkSAt samparke sandehata pari Ache| jAni thoৱA ye, nizcaYa teOM (AllAha) sakalo vastukei pariveSTana kari Ache|
hA-mIma|[1]
AIna-chIna-kvApha|[1]
eidarei tomAra prati Aru tomAra pUrvaৱrtIsakalara prati ahI kariche mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAhe|
AkAzasamUhata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalovora teOMrei| teOM suucca, sumahAna|

AkAzasamUha oparara parA bhAGi parAra upakrama haYa, Aru phiristAsakale nija pratipAlakara prazaMsAra saite paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare Aru pRthiৱIvAsIsakalara vAve kSamA prArthanA kare| jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Aru yisakale AllAhara parivarte Anaka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa kare, AllAhe siha~tara prati samyaka dRSTidAtA| (he navI!) tumi siha~tara oparata karmavidhAYaka nahaYa|

Aru eidarei Ami tomAra prati koraAna aৱtIrNa karicho~ AravI bhASAta, yAte tumi makkA Aru iYAra cAriophAle thakA janagaNaka satarka kariva pArA, lagate yAte satarka kariva pArA samaveta ha’valagIYA (kiYAmata) diৱsa samparke, ya’ta kono sandeha nAi| (seidinA) edala jAnnAtata yAva Aru edala yAva jvalanta agnita|

Aru AllAhe icchA karile siha~taka eTAi ummata kariva pArilehe~tena, kintu teOM yAka icchA kare keৱla tAkahe nija anugrahata praৱeza karAYa| AnahAte yAlimasakala, siha~tara kono abhibhAৱka nAi Aru kono sahAYakArIo nAi|
siha~te AllAhara parivarte Anaka abhibhAৱkarUpe grahaNa kariche neki, kintu AllAha, keৱla teOMhe prakRta abhibhAৱka, Aru teৱe~i mRtaka jIৱita kare| teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
Aru tomAloke yi viSaYate matabheda nakarA kiYa, tAra mImAMsA Ache keৱla AllAharei ocarata| teৱe~i AllAha, mora pratipAlaka; teOMra oparatei mai nirbhara karicho~ Aru mai teOMrei abhimukhI haOM|

teৱe~i AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sRSTikartA, teৱe~i tomAlokara mAjara parA tomAlokara yorA sRSTi kariche Aru catuSpada jantura mAjato yorA sRSTi kariche| eidarei teOM tomAlokara vaMza vistAra kare; ekoৱei teOMra upamAyogya nahaYa, teOM sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra cAvi-kAThi teOMrei ocarata| teOM yAra vAve icchA kare tAra jIৱikA vRddhi kari diYe Aru saMkucitao kare| nizcaYa teOM sakalo vastu samparke sarvajJa|

teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve dvIna vidhivaddha kariche, yAra nirdeza teOM nUhaka pradAna karichila; Aru Ami tomAra prati iYArei ahI preraNa karicho~ lagate ivrAhIma, muchA Aru IchAko iYAra nirdeza dichilo~ ye, tomAloke dvInaka pratiSThita karA Aru iYAra mAjata vibheda sRSTi nakarivA| tumi muzvarikasakalaka yiTora phAle AhvAna kari AchA seYA siha~tara ocarata kaThina vulihe dhAraNA haYa| AllAhe yAka icchA kare tAkahe teOM dvInara prati AkRSTa kare Aru yiYe teOMra abhimukhI haYa tAka teOM dvInara prati hidAYata dAna kare|

Aru siha~tara ocaralai jJAna ahAra pichato keৱla pArasparika vidveSavazataH siha~te nijara mAjata matabheda ghaTAYa| eTA nirdhArita samaYalaike aৱkAza diYA ha'va vuli tomAra pratipAlakara pUrva siddhAnta nAthAkile siha~tara viSaYe cUDa়Anta phaYacAlA hai ga’lahe~tena| siha~tara pichata yisakale kitAvara uttarAdhikArI haiche, nizcaYa siha~te ei (koraAna) samparke vibhrAntikara sandehata patita haiche|

eteke tumi AhvAna karA Aru dRDha়bhAৱe aTala thAkA, yidare tomAka Adeza karA haiche| tumi ketiYAo siha~tara pravRttira anusaraNa nakarivA; Aru koৱA, ‘AllAhe yikhana kitAva aৱtIrNa kariche mai tAta ImAna Anicho~ Aru tomAlokara mAjata nyAYa vicAra karivalai moka Adeza karA haiche| AllAhei AmAra pratipAlaka Aru tomAlokaro pratipAlaka| AmAra Amala AmAra vAve Aru tomAlokara Amala tomAlokara vAve; AmAra Aru tomAlokara mAjata kono vivAda-visamvAda nAi| AllAhei AmAka ekatrita kariva Aru teOMra ocaratei AmAra pratyAৱrtana ha’va’|

AllAhara AhvAnata sa~hAri diYAra pichato yisakale AllAha samparke vitarka kare, siha~tara yukti-tarka siha~tara pratipAlakara dRSTita asAra| siha~ta haiche teOMra krodhara pAtra, Aru siha~tara vAve Ache kaThina zAsti|
teৱe~i AllAha, yijane satya sahakAre kitAva Aru mIjAna aৱtIrNa kariche| tumi kenekai jAnivA! sambhaৱtaH kiYAmata ati nikaTaৱrtI?

yisakale iYAka vizvAsa nakare siha~tei iYAka tvarAnvita kariva vicAre| AnahAte yisakale iYAka vizvAsa kare, teOMloke iYAka bhaYa kare, Aru teOMloke jAne ye, eYA nizcitabhAৱe satya| jAni thoৱA, kiYAmata samparke yisakale vAka-vitaNDA kare, siha~ta nizcaYa ghora vibhrAntita nipatita|
AllAha teOMra vAndAsakalara prati atyanta snehazIla; teOM yAka icchA kare jIৱikA dAna kare| teOM sarvazaktimAna. pravala parAkramazAlI|
yiYe AkhirAtara phacala kAmanA kare tAra vAve Ami tAra phacala vRddhi kari diOM Aru yiYe pRthiৱIra phacala kAmanA kare Ami tAka tAra parA akaNamAna diOM| kintu AkhirAtata tAra kono aMza nAthAkiva|

athavA siha~tara ene kichumAna aMzI Ache neki, yivilAke siha~tara vAve dvInara parA carIYatI vidhAna praৱrtana kariche, yAra anumati AllAhe diYA nAi? cUDa়Anta mImAMsAra ghoSaNA nAthAkile siha~tara viSaYe nizcaYa phaYacAlA hai ga’lahe~tena| nizcaYa yAlimasakalara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

tumi yAlimasakalaka siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve bhIta-santrasta dekhivalai pAvA| athaca seYA Apatita ha’va siha~tarei oparata| AnahAte yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMloke thAkiva jAnnAtara udyAnasamUhata| teOMloke yiToৱei vicAriva seiToৱei teOMlokara pratipAlakara ocarata pAva| eiToৱei haiche mahA anugraha|

eiToৱei haiche sei susaMvAda, yiTo AllAhe teOMra seisakala vAndAka diche, yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche| koৱA, ‘mai iYAra vinimaYata tomAlokara parA keৱla AtmIYatAra sauhArdyara vAhire Ana eko pratidAna nivicAro~’| yiYe uttama kAma kare Ami tAra vAve iYAta kalyANa vRddhi kari diOM| nizcaYa AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|

athavA siha~te ei kathA kaYa neki ye, ‘teOM (muhAmmade) AllAha samparke michA udbhAৱna kariche’? yadi seiToৱei ha’lahe~tena tente (he muhAmmada) AllAhe icchA karile tomAra hRdaYata mohara mAri dilehe~tena| AllAhe vAtilaka maci diYe Aru nijara vANIra dvArA satyaka pratiSThita kare| nizcaYa antarasamUhata yi Ache sei viSaYe teOM savizeSa aৱgata|
Aru teৱe~i nija vAndAsakalara tAovA kavula kare Aru pApasamUha mocana kare; Aru tomAloke yi karA seYA teOM jAne|
Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche teOMlokara AhvAnata teৱe~i sa~hAri diYe Aru teOMlokara prati teOMra anugraha vRddhi kari diYe; Aru kAphirasakalara vAve Ache kaThina zAsti|

Aru yadi AllAhe teOMra sakalo vAndAra jIৱikA prazasta kari dilehe~tena, tente siha~te pRthiৱIta nizcaYa sImAlaMghana karilehe~tena; kintu teOM nijara icchAmate nirdiSTa parimANe (jIৱikA) aৱtIrNa kare| nizcaYa teOM nija vAndAsakalara viSaYe samyaka aৱhita Aru sarvadraSTA|
Aru siha~ta nirAza hoৱAra pichata teৱe~i varaSuNa aৱtIrNa kare Aru teOMra rahamata vistAra kare| teৱe~i abhibhAৱka, atyanta prazaMsita|

Aru teOMra anyatama nidarzana haiche AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sRSTi, Aru ei duYore mAjata teOM yivora jIৱ-jantu vistAra kariche seivoro (teOMrei nidarzana); Aru teOM yetiYAi icchA tetiYAi seivoraka samaveta karivalai sakSama|
Aru tomAlokara prati yi vipada-Apada Apatita haYa seYA tomAlokarei kRtakarmara pariNAma Aru vahuto aparAdha teOM kSamA kari diYe|
Aru tomAloke pRthiৱIta (AllAhara karma parikalpanAka) vyartha kariva noৱArivA| AllAhara vAhire tomAlokara Ana kono abhibhAৱka nAi Aru kono sahAYakArIo nAi|
teOMra nidarzanAৱlIra mAjata Ache sAgarata calAcala karA parvatasadRza nauyAnasamUha|

teOM icchA karile vAYuka stavdha kari diva pAre, phalata nauyAnasamUha gatihIna hai pariva samudrapRSThata| nizcaYa iYAta vahuto nidarzana Ache, pratyeka carama dhairyazIla Aru ekAnta kRtajJa vyaktira vAve|
athavA siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve seivoraka teOM dhvaMsa kari diva pAre; Aru vahuto (aparAdhaka) teOM kSamAo kare|
Aru yisakale AmAra nidarzana samparke vitarka kare, siha~te yAte jAnivalai pAYa ye, siha~tara kono AzraYasthala nAi|

eteke tomAlokaka yi diYA haiche seYA haiche keৱla pArthiৱ jIৱnara bhoga-sAmagrIhe| AllAhara ocarata yi Ache seYA uttama Aru sthAYI, seisakala lokara vAve yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru teOMloke nija pratipAlakara oparata tAৱAkkula kare,
teOMloke kAvIrA gunAha Aru azlIla karmara parA A~tarata thAke Aru yetiYA khaM uThe tetiYA kSamA kari diYe|

Aru teOMloke nija pratipAlakara AhvAnata sa~hAri diYe, chAlAta kAYema kare Aru teOMloke nijara karmasamUhaka paraspara parAmarzara mAdhyamata sampAdita kare| lagate teOMlokaka Ami yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ tAra parA vyaYa kare|
Aru teOMlokara oparata atirikta anyAYa-avicAra karA ha’le teOMloke iYAra pratividhAna kare|
(jAni thoৱA) veYAra pratiphala haiche sei anupAtei veYA| eteke yiYe kSamA kari diYe Aru Apoca-niSpatti kare tAra vAve Ache AllAhara ocarata puraskAra| nizcaYa teOM anyAYakArIvilAkaka pachanda nakare|
kintu atyAcArita hoৱAra pichata yisakale pratividhAna kare, teOMlokara viruddhe kono vyaৱsthA grahaNa karA naha’va,
keৱla siha~tara viruddhe vyaৱsthA grahaNa karA ha’va yisakale mAnuhara oparata anyAYa kare Aru pRthiৱIta anyAYabhAৱe vidrohAcaraNa kari phure| siha~tara vAvei Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
aৱzye yiYe dhairyya dhAraNa kare Aru kSamA kari diYe, nizcaYa seYA dRDha় saMkalparei kAma|
Aru AllAhe yAka pathabhraSTa kare, iYAra pichata tAra vAve Ana kono abhibhAৱka nAi| yAlimasakale yetiYA zAsti dekhiva tetiYA tumi siha~taka kaOMte zunivA ye, ‘ubhati yoৱAra kono upAYa Ache neki’?

Aru tumi siha~taka dekhivalai pAvA ye, siha~taka jAhAnnAmara sanmukhata upasthita karA haiche; siha~te apamAnata mUra aৱnata aৱsthAta curakai cAi thAkiva; Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMloke kiYAmatara dinA ka’va, ‘nizcaYa siha~ta kSatigrasta, yisakale nijara Aru nija pariYAlavargara kSati sAdhana kariche’| sAৱdhAna! nizcaYa yAlimasakala sthAYI zAstita nipatita thAkiva|
AllAhara vAhire siha~taka sahAYa karAra vAve siha~tara Ana kono abhibhAৱka nAthAkiva| eteke AllAhe yAka pathabhraSTa kare tAra vAve Ana kono patha nAi|

AllAhara taraphara parA sei apratirodhya diৱsaTo ahAra pUrvei tomAloke nija pratipAlakara AhvAnata sa~hAri diYA| yidinA tomAlokara kono AzraYasthala nAthAkiva Aru tomAlokara vAve pratirodhakArIo nAthAkiva|

tathApio yadi siha~te mukha ghUrAi laYa, tente (jAni thoৱA) Ami tomAka siha~tara rakSaka hicApe preraNa karA nAi| tomAra dAYitva haiche keৱla vANI pracAra karA| Ami yetiYA AmAra taraphara parA mAnuhaka kono rahamata AsvAdana karAOM tetiYA si utphullita haYa kintu yetiYA siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve siha~tara vipada-Apada ghaTe, tetiYA mAnuha ati akRtajJa hai pare|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra Adhipatya keৱla AllAharei| teOM yi icchA kare seiToৱei sRSTi kare| teOM yAka icchA kare kanyA santAna dAna kare, Aru yAka icchA kare putra santAna dAna kare,
nAivA siha~taka putra Aru kanyA ubhaYa (santAna) dAna kare Aru yAka icchA kare vandhyA kari diYe| nizcaYa teOM sarvajJa, mahA kSamatAৱAna|

kono mAnuharei enekuৱA maryAdA nAi, yiYe AllAhara lagata ponapaTIYAkai kathA ka'va pAriva ahIra mAdhyamara vAhire, athavA pardAra A~rata nAivA enekuৱA kono vArtAvAhaka preraNa karAra vAhire, yi vArtAvAhake keৱla teOMra anumatikrame teOM yiTo vicAre keৱla seiTohe ahI kare, teOM sarvocca, prajJAmaYa|

anurUpabhAৱe (uparokta tiniTA paddhatita) Ami tomAra prati AmAra nirdezara parA rUhaka ahI karicho~| tumi janA nAchilA kitAva ki Aru ImAna ki! kintu Ami iYAka nUra vanAicho~, yAra dvArA Ami AmAra vAndAsakalara mAjara parA yAka icchA hidAYata dAna karo~| nizcaYa tumi sarala pathara pine dika nirdezanA diYA,
AllAhara pathalai, yijana AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalore mAlika| jAni thoৱA! sakalo viSaYa AllAharei phAle ubhati yAva|
hA-mIma|[1]
zapata suspaSTa kitAvara!
nizcaYa Ami iYAka koraAna hicApe AravI bhASAta aৱtIrNa karicho~, yAte tomAloke vujiva pArA|
nizcaYa eikhana AmAra ocarata ummula kitAvata ucca maryAdAsampanna, hikamatapUrNa|
tomAloka sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa vuliYei Ami tomAlokara parA ei upadeza vANI sampUrNarUpe pratyAhAra karima neki?
Aru pUrvaৱrtIvilAkara ocaralai Ami vahuto navI preraNa karichilo~|
Aru yetiYAi siha~tara ocaralai kono navI Ahiche siha~te teOMka lai ThATTA-vidrUpa kariche|
phalata yisakala iha~tatakaio zaktita pravala Achila, siha~tako Ami dhvaMsa karichilo~, Aru pUrvaৱrtIsakalara anurUpa dRSTAnta atIta hai gaiche|
Aru yadi tumi siha~taka sodhA, AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIka kone sRSTi kariche? tente siha~te nizcaYa ka’va, ‘eivoraka sRSTi kariche mahA parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa(AllAhe)’,
teৱe~i pRthiৱIka tomAlokara vAve zayyA kari diche Aru tAta tomAlokara vAve calAra patha vanAi diche, yAte tomAloke saThika patha pAva pArA;
Aru teৱe~i AkAzara parA parimitabhAৱe pAnI varSaNa kare| tAra pichata iYAra dvArA Ami saJjIৱita karo~ nirjIৱ janapadaka| eidarei tomAlokaka (punarjIৱita kari) uliYAi anA ha’va|
Aru teৱe~i sakaloke yorA yorAkai sRSTi kariche Aru teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve enekuৱA nauyAna Aru gharacIYA jantu sRSTi kariche, yivoraka tomAloke parivahaNa hicApe vyaৱhAra karA;

yAte tomAloke iYAra piThita sthira hai vahiva pArA, (Aru zunA!) tAra pichata yetiYA tomAloke iYAra oparata sthira hai vahivA tetiYA tomAloke tomAlokara pratipAlakara anugraha smaraNa karivA Aru ka'vA, ‘paৱitra Aru mahAna teOM, yijane eivoraka AmAra vazIbhUta kari diche| athaca eivoraka vazIbhUta karivalai Ami sAmartha nAchilo~|
‘Aru nizcaYa Ami AmAra pratipAlakara ocaratei pratyAৱrtanakArI’|
Aru siha~te AllAhara vAndAsakalara mAjara parAi teOMra aMza sAvyasta kariche| nizcaYa mAnuha spaSTa akRtajJa|
teOM yi sRSTi kariche tAra parA teOM (nijara vAve) kanyA santAna grahaNa kariche Aru tomAlokaka putra santAnara dvArA viziSTa kariche neki?

athaca yetiYA siha~tara kArovAka susaMvAda diYA haYa (kanyA santAna janma hoৱA vuli), yiTora dvArA siha~te rahamAnara prati dRSTAnta dAGi dhare, tetiYA tAra mukhamaNDala malina hai yAYa, tene aৱsthAta si duzcintAta bhAgi pare|
(seivilAka AllAhara bhAgata parila neki) yivilAka alaMkArere lAlita-pAlita haYa Aru vitarkara samaYata suspaSTa vaktavya pradAnata akSama?

lagate siha~te rahamAnara vAndA phiristAsakalaka nArI vuli gaNya kariche; teOMlokaka sRSTi karAra samaYata siha~te pratyakSa karichila neki? siha~tara sAkSya nizcaYa lipivaddha karA ha’va Aru siha~taka sodha-pocha karA ha’va|
siha~te Aru kaYa, ‘rahamAne icchA karile Ami eOMlokara ivAdata nakarilohe~tena’| ei viSaYe siha~tara kono jJAna nAi| siha~te keৱla mane sajA kathAhe kaYa|
Ami siha~taka koraAnara Agata kono kitAva pradAna karicho~ neki, yikhanaka siha~te dRDha়bhAৱe dhAraNa kari Ache?
varaM siha~te kaYa, ‘nizcaYa Ami AmAra pitR-puruSasakalaka eTA matAdarzara oparatahe pAicho~ Aru Ami teOMlokara padAGka anusaraNa kariYe nizcitabhAৱe hidAYataprApta hama’|

Aru eidarei tomAra pUrve yetiYAi Ami kono janapadalai kono ejana satarkakArI preraNa karicho~ tetiYAi sei ThAira vilAsapriYa lokasakale kaiche, ‘nizcaYa Ami AmAra pitR-puruSasakalaka eTA matAdarzara oparata pAicho~ Aru Ami teOMlokarei padAGka anusaraNa kari calima’|

tetiYA sei satarkakArIYe kaiche, ‘tomAloke tomAlokara pitR-puruSasakalaka yiTo matAdarzara oparata pAichA, mai yadi tomAlokara vAve tAtakaio utkRSTa patha lai Aho~ tathApio (tomAloke siha~tara anusaraNa karivAne)’? siha~te kaiche, ‘nizcaYa tomAloke yi lai prerita haichA seYA Ami asvIkAra karo~’|
phalata Ami siha~tara parA pratizodha la’lo~| eteke coৱA, asvIkArakArIvilAkara pariNAma kenekuৱA Achila!
Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA ivrAhIme teOMra pitR Aru teOMra sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘tomAloke yivorara ivAdata karA nizcaYa mai seivorara parA samparkamukta|
‘keৱla teOMra vAhire yijane moka sRSTi kariche| eteke nizcaYa teOM zIghrei moka satpathata paricAlita kariva’|
Aru ei ghoSaNAka teOM cirantana vANIrUpe rAkhi thai gaiche teOMra uttarasUrIsakalara mAjata, yAte siha~te ubhati Ahe|
varaM Ami siha~taka Aru siha~tara pitR-puruSasakalaka bhoga karivalai suyoga dichilo~, aৱzeSata siha~tara ocarata Ahila satya Aru spaSTa varNanAkArI rAchula|
Aru satya yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai Ahi pAle, tetiYA siha~te ka’le, ‘eYA dekhona yAdu Aru nizcitabhAৱe Ami iYAka pratyAkhyAna karo~’|
siha~te Aru ka’le, ‘ei koraAnakhana duYo janapadara kono ejana mahAna vyaktira oparata kiYa aৱtIrNa karA naha’la’?

siha~te tomAra pratipAlakara rahamata bhAga-vanTana kare neki? Amihe pArthiৱ jIৱnata siha~tara mAjata siha~tara jIৱikA vaNTana kari diOM Aru siha~tara ijanaka sijanara oparata maryAdAta unnIta kari diOM, yAte ijane sijanaka adhInastha hicApe grahaNa kariva pAre; (jAni thoৱA) siha~te yi saJcaYa kare, tomAra pratipAlakara rahamata tAtakaio utkRSTa|

yadi sakalo mAnuha ekeTA matAlamvI hoৱAra AzaMkA nAthAkilahe~tena, tente yisakale rahamAnara lagata kupharI kare, siha~taka Ami siha~tara gharara vAve raupya-nirmita cAda Aru khaTakhaTI dilo~he~tena yAte siha~te ArohaNa kare,
Aru siha~tara gharasamUhara vAve duৱAra Aru AsanasamUha, ya’ta siha~te Auji vahe,
Aru (anurUpa dilo~he~tena) soNara nirmitao; Aru ei sakalovora keৱla pArthiৱ jIৱnara bhoga-sAmagrIhe| (jAni thoৱA) tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata AkhirAta haiche keৱla muttAkvIsakalara vAvehe|
Aru yiYe rahamAnara smaraNara parA vimukha haYa, Ami tAra vAve niYojita karo~ ejana caYatAna, phalata si tAra sahacara hai yAYa|
nizcaYa siha~tei (caYatAnavilAkei) mAnuhaka satpathara parA vAdhA diYe, athaca mAnuhe (bhraSTa pathata thakAra pichato) nijake hidAYataprApta vuli bhAve|

aৱzeSata yetiYA si AmAra ocarata Ahi upasthita ha’va, tetiYA si caYatAnaka ka’va, ‘hAYa! mora Aru tomAra mAjata yadi pUৱ Aru pazcimara dare vyaৱdhAna thAkilahe~tena!’ eteke kimAna nikRSTa sahacara si!
Aru Aji tomAlokara ei anutApa tomAlokara kono kAmata nAhiva, yihetu tomAloke sImAlaMghana karichilA; nizcaYa tomAloka ATAYe haichA zAstira aMzIdAra|
tumi vadhiraka zunAva pArivAne athavA andhaka patha dekhuৱAva pArivAne, Aru yijana spaSTa vibhrAntita Ache tAka tumi satpathata paricAlita kariva pArivAne?
eteke yadi Ami tomAka iYAra parA A~tarAi lai yAOM, tente nizcaYa Ami siha~tara parA pratizodha lamei;
athavA Ami siha~taka yi zAstira pratizruti dicho~, seYA Ami tomAka dekhuৱAma, nizcaYa siha~tara oparata Ami pUrNa kSamatAৱAna|
eteke tomAra prati yi ahI karA haiche, seYA tumi dRDha়bhAৱe aৱlamvana karA| nizcaYa tumi sarala pathara oparata pratiSThita|
nizcaYa ei koraAnakhana haiche tomAra Aru tomAra sampradAYara vAve smaraNikAsvarUpa; anatipalame tomAlokaka (iYAra viSaYe) sodha-pocha karA ha’va|

tomAra pUrve Ami AmAra rAchulasakalara mAjara parA yisakalaka preraNa karichilo~ teOMlokaka sudhi coৱA, Ami parama karuNAmaYa (rahamAna)ra vAhire ivAdata kariva parA Ana kono ilAha nirdhAraNa karichilo~ neki?
nizcaYa Ami muchAka AmAra nidarzanAৱlIsaha phiraAuna Aru tAra netRvargara ocaralai preraNa karichilo~| teOM kaichila, ‘nizcaYa mai vizvajagatara pratipAlakara (taraphara parA prerita) ejana rAchula’|
eteke teOM yetiYA siha~tara ocaralai AmAra nidarzanAৱlIsaha upasthita ha’la tetiYA siha~te seivoraka lai upahAsa karivalai dharile|
Ami siha~taka yi nidarzanei dekhuৱAicho~ seYA Achila tAra Agara nidarzanatakai DAGara| Ami siha~taka zAstira mAdhyamata satarka karichilo~, yAte siha~te (satpathalai) ubhati Ahe|

siha~te Aru kaichila, ‘he yAdukara! tumi tomAra pratipAlakara ocarata AmAra vAve duA karA, tomAra pratipAlake tomAra lagata yiTo aMgIkAra kariche, (seiTo yadi pUraNa haYa tente) nizcaYa Ami satpatha aৱlamvana karima’|
tAra pichata yetiYA Ami siha~tara parA sei zAsti A~tarAi nilo~, tetiYAi siha~te aMgIkAra bhaMga karile|

Aru phiraAune teOMra sampradAYara mAjata ghoSaNA kari ka’le, ‘he mora sampradAYa! micharara rAjatva mora nahaYane vAru? Aru ei nada-nadIvora mora pAdadezata pravAhita hoৱA nAi jAno; tomAloke nedekhA neki?
‘mai ei vyaktitakai zreSTha nahaYane? yijana hIna Aru spaSTa kathA ka’valaio prAYa akSama!
‘(teOM yadi sa~cAi navI) tente teOMka (muchAka) soNara gAmakhAru pradAna karA naha'la kiYa, athavA teOMra saite phiristAsakala dalavaddhabhAৱe nAhila kiYa’?
eidarei si tAra sampradAYaka vurvaka sajAle, phalata siha~te tAra kathAke mAni la’le| nizcaYa siha~ta Achila eTA phAchikva sampradAYa|
tAra pichata yetiYA siha~te AmAka krodhAnvita karile tetiYA Ami siha~tara parA pratizodha grahaNa karilo~ Aru siha~ta ATAike DuvAi mArilo~|
phalata Ami siha~taka paraৱrtIvilAkara vAve atIta itihAsa Aru dRSTAnta vanAi rAkhilo~|
Aru yetiYAi mAraYAma-putrara udAharaNa diYA haYa, tetiYAi tomAra sampradAYara lokasakale ciJara-vAkhara kari hulasthula lagAi diYe|
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘AmAra upAsyavilAka zreSTha ne IchA’? siha~te keৱla vAka-vitaNDAra uddezyehe tomAra sanmukhata teOMra kathA dAGi dhare| varaM siha~ta haiche eTA kalahapriYa sampradAYa|
teOM keৱla mora ejana vAndAhe Achila| yAra oparata Ami anugraha karichilo~ Aru teOMka Ami vanI icharAIlara vAve nidarzana vanAichilo~|
Aru Ami yadi icchA karilo~he~tena, tente tomAlokara parivarte phiristA sRSTi karilo~he~tena, yisakale pRthiৱIra uttarAdhikArI ha’lahe~tena|
Aru nizcaYa IchA haiche kiYAmatara eTA nizcita nidarzana; seYe tomAloke kiYAmata samparke sandeha poSaNa nakarivA| tomAloke keৱla morei anusaraNa karA| eiToৱei haiche sarala patha|
caYatAne yena tomAlokaka ketiYAo vAdhA pradAna kariva noৱAre| nizcaYa si tomAlokara prakAzya zatru|

Aru IchAi yetiYA spaSTa pramANAdi lai Ahichila, tetiYA teOM kaichila, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara ocaralai hikamata lai Ahicho~ Aru tomAloke yivora viSaYata matabheda karichilA seivora viSaYaka spaSTa karivalai Ahicho~| seYe tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru mora Anugatya karA|
‘nizcaYa AllAha, teৱe~i haiche mora pratipAlaka Aru tomAlokaro pratipAlaka| eteke tomAloke teOMrei ivAdata karA; eiToৱei haiche sarala patha’|
tathApio siha~tara mAjara vibhinna dale matAnaikya sRSTi karichila, seYe yAlimasakalara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka diৱsara zAstira durbhoga!
siha~te keৱla siha~tara ajAnite AkasmikabhAৱe kiYAmata ahAra apekSAta Ache|
seidinA antaraGga vandhusakaleo ijane sijanara zatru hai pariva, keৱla muttAkvIsakalara vAhire|
he mora vAndAsakala! Aji tomAlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru tomAloke cintitao naha’vA|
yisakale AmAra AYAtara prati ImAna Anichila Aru teOMloka Achila muchalima,
(teOMlokaka koৱA ha'va) tomAloka Aru tomAlokara strIsakale Anandacitte jAnnAtata praৱeza karA|
soNara thAla Aru pAnapAtra lai teOMlokaka pradakSiNa karA ha’va, tAta sei sakalo vastu upalavdha thAkiva yivora mane vicAre Aru yivora dekhile caku tRpta haYa, Aru tAta tomAloke sthAYI ha’vA|
eiToৱei haiche jAnnAta, tomAlokaka yiTora adhikArI karA haiche, kAraNa tomAloke Amala karichilA|
tAta tomAlokara vAve Ache pracura phalamUla, tAra parA tomAloke AhAra karivA|
nizcaYa aparAdhIvilAke sthAYIbhAৱe jAhAnnAmara zAsti bhoga kariva;
siha~tara zAsti lAghaৱ karA naha’va Aru siha~te tAta hatAza hai pariva|
Aru Ami siha~tara prati anyAYa karA nAchilo~, varaM siha~ta nijei Achila yAlima|

siha~te ciJari ciJari ka’va, ‘he mAlika (jAhAnnAmara praharI phiristA)! (Apuni AmAra phAlara parA Avedana karakacona) AponAra pratipAlake yena AmAka niHzeSa kari diYe’| teOM ka’va, ‘nizcaYa tomAloke enekaiYe (cirakAla) thAkiva lAgiva’|
(AllAhe ka’va,) ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAlokaka satya aৱgata karoৱAichilo~, kintu tomAlokara sarahabhAgei Achila satya apachandakArI’|
siha~te kono viSaYe cUDa়Anta siddhAnta grahaNa kariche neki? nizcaYa Amihe cUDa়Anta siddhAntakArI|
athavA siha~te bhAve neki ye, Ami siha~tara gopana viSaYa Aru gopana parAmarza zunivalai nApAOM? nizcaYa zunivalai pAOM| AmAra phiristAsakale dekhona siha~tara ocarate thAki likhe|
koৱA, ‘rahamAnara yadi kono santAna thAkilahe~tena tente maYei prathama teOMra ivAdatakArI ha’lo~he~tena;
