siha~te yivora viSaYa Aropa kare seivorara parA AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra pratipAlaka tathA mahA Arachara adhipati (mahAna AllAha) ati paৱitra-mahAna|
eteke siha~taka yiTo diৱsara pratizruti diYA haiche, sei diৱsara sanmukhIna nohoৱA paryanta siha~taka nirarthaka kathA-vatarA Aru khela-dhemAlita matta hai thAkivalai diYA|
teৱe~i satya ilAha AkAzata, Aru teৱe~i satya ilAha pRthiৱIta| teOM prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

Aru teOM varakatamaYa, yAra kartRtvata Ache AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore madhyaৱrtI sakalo vastu| kiYAmatara jJAna keৱla teOMra ocaratei Ache, Aru teOMra ocaratei tomAlokaka pratyAৱrtita karA ha’va|
Aru teOMra vAhire siha~te yivoraka AhvAna kare, siha~te ketiYAo cupArichara adhikArI ha’va noৱAre, kintu teOMlokara vAhire yisakale jAni-zuni satya sAkSya diYe|
Aru yadi tumi siha~taka sodhA, ‘kone siha~taka sRSTi kariche’?tente siha~te nizcaYa ka’va ‘AllAhe’| tathApio siha~te kenekai vimukha haiche?
Aru teOMra (rAchulara) ei vANI ye, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa iha~ta enekuৱA eTA sampradAYa yisakale ImAna poSaNa nakariva’|
eteke tumi siha~taka upekSA karA Aru koৱA, ‘chAlAma’| kintu siha~te (iYAra pariNAma) anatipalame jAnivalai pAva|
hA-mIma|[1]
zapata suspaSTa kitAvara!
nizcaYa Ami iYAka aৱtIrNa karicho~ eTA varakatamaYa rAtita; nizcaYa Ami satarkakArI|
sei rAtita pratyeka cUDa়Anta siddhAnta sthira karA haYa,
AmAra Adeza anusAre| nizcaYa AmiYei rAchula preraNa karo~|
tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA rahamatasvarUpe; nizcaYa teOM sarvazrotA, sarvajJa,
teৱe~i AkAzasamUha, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjara sakalo vastura pratipAlaka; yadi tomAloke nizcita vizvAsI hoৱA|
teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, teৱe~i jIৱna dAna kare Aru teৱe~i mRtyu ghaTAYa; teৱe~i tomAlokara pratipAlaka Aru tomAlokara pitR-puruSasakaloro pratipAlaka|
varaM siha~te sandehara vazaৱrtI hai khela-dhemAli kari Ache|
eteke tumi apekSA karA sei dinaTolai, yidinA spaSTa dho~ৱAre Acchanna ha’va AkAza,
sei dho~ৱAi mAnuhako AvRta kari pelAva|eiTo ha’va yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
(tetiYA siha~te ka’va) ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra parA zAsti dUra kari diYA, nizcaYa Ami mumina hama’|
ka’ta siha~te upadeza grahaNa kariva? athaca itipUrve siha~tara ocaralai ejana spaSTa rAchula Ahichila;
tAra pichata siha~te teOMra parA mukha ghUrAi laichila Aru kaichila, ‘eOM ejana prazikSaNaprApta unmAda’|
Ami alapa samaYara kAraNe yadi zAsti rahita kari diOM tente nizcaYa tomAloke tomAlokara pUrvAৱsthAlai ubhati yAvA|
yidinA Ami pravalabhAৱe karAYatta karima, seidinA Ami nizcaYa pratizodha lama|
Aru iha~tara Agateo Ami phiraAuna sampradAYaka parIkSA karichilo~ Aru siha~tara ocarato Ahichila ejana sanmAnita rAchula,
(teOM phiraAunaka kaichila) ‘AllAhara vAndAsakalaka (vanI icharAIlaka) molai gatAi diYA| nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve ejana vizvasta rAchula|
‘Aru tomAloke AllAhara viruddhe auddhatya prakAza nakarivA, nizcaYa mai tomAlokara ocaralai spaSTa pramANa lai Ahima|
‘tomAlokara prastarAghAtara parA mai mora pratipAlaka Aru tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocarata AzraYa vicAricho~|
‘Aru yadi tomAloke mora prati vizvAsa sthApana nakarA, tente moka eri guci yoৱA’|
tAra pichata teOM nija pratipAlakara ocarata duA kari ka’le, ‘nizcaYa iha~ta haiche eTA aparAdhI sampradAYa’|
(AllAhe ka’le) ‘tente tumi mora vAndAsakalaka lai rAtira bhitarate olAi yoৱA, nizcaYa tomAlokaka picha phAlara parA khedi yoৱA ha’va’|
‘Aru sAgarakhanaka sthira thAkivalai diYA, nizcaYa siha~ta enekuৱA eTA vAhinI yisakale Duvi mariva’|
siha~te pichaphAle eri thai gaichila vahuto udyAna Aru prasraৱna,
zasyakSetra Aru suramya vAsasthAna,
Aru nAnA dharaNara vilAsa-sAmagrI, ya’ta siha~te Ananda upabhoga karichila|
enekuৱAi haichila, Aru Ami ei sakalovorara uttarAdhikArI karichilo~ eTA velega sampradAYaka|
eteke AkAza Aru pRthiৱIYe siha~tara vAve azrupAta karA nAchila Aru siha~ta aৱkAzaprAptao nAchila|
Aru nizcaYa Ami vanI icharAIlaka lAJchanAdAYaka zAstira parA uddhAra karichilo~,
(uddhAra karichilo~) phiraAunara parA, nizcaYa si Achila sImAlaMghanakArIsakalara mAjata zIrSasthAnIYa|
Aru Ami jAni vujiYe siha~taka sakalo sRSTira oparata nirvAcita karichilo~|
Aru Ami siha~taka enekuৱA nidarzanAৱlI pradAna karichilo~, ya’ta Achila suspaSTa parIkSA;
nizcaYa siha~te (ei kathA sadAYe) kai thAke,
‘AmAra prathama mRtyui haiche ekamAtra mRtyu, Ami Aru ketiYAo punarutthita nahaOM|
‘eteke tomAloke yadi satyavAdI hoৱA tente AmAra pitR-puruSasakalaka upasthita karAcona’|
(koৱAcona) zreSTha kona, siha~ta ne tuvvA sampradAYa, ne siha~tara pUrve yisakala Achila siha~ta? Ami siha~taka dhvaMsa karichilo~| nizcaYa siha~ta Achila aparAdhI|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI, lagate ei duYore mAjata thakA kono vastukei Ami dhemAlira chalere sRSTi karA nAi;
Ami ei duYoke yathAyathabhAৱei sRSTi karicho~, kintu siha~tara sarahabhAgei nAjAne|
nizcaYa mImAMsAra dina siha~ta sakalore vAve nirdhArita|
seidinA ejana vandhuৱe Ana ejana vandhura kono kAmata nAhiva Aru siha~te sahAYao nApAva|
kintu AllAhe yAra prati daYA kariva keৱla teOMra vAhire| nizcaYa AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa yAkkUma gacha ha’va,
pApIra khAdya,
galita tAmara dare, peTara mAjata utali thAkiva,
utali thakA garama pAnIra dare|
(koৱA ha’va) ‘tAka dharA Aru TAni lai yoৱA jAhAnnAmara madhyasthalata,
‘tAra pichata tAra mUrara oparata utalA pAnI DhAli zAsti diYA’,
(koৱA ha’va, etiYA) ‘soৱAda loৱA, nizcaYa tumi sanmAnita, abhijAta AchilA!
‘nizcaYa eiToৱei haiche sei zAsti, yiToka tomAloke sandeha karichilA’|
nizcaYa muttAkvIsakala thAkiva nirApada sthAnata,
‘udyAna Aru jharNAsamUhata,
teOMloke paridhAna kariva mihi Aru moTA recamI vastra Aru ijane sijanara sanmukhata vahiva|
enekuৱAi ha’va, Aru Ami teOMlokaka viYA pAti dima mRganaYanA hUrasakalara lagata,
tAta teOMloke prazAnta citte vividha phalamUla Anivalai ka'va|
prathama mRtyura pichata teOMloke tAta Aru mRtyu AsvAdana nakariva| teৱe~i teOMlokaka jAhAnnAmara zAstira parA rakSA kariva,
(eiTo haiche) tomAra pratipAlakara eTA anugraha, eiToৱei haiche mahA saphalatA|
eteke nizcaYa Ami tomAra bhASAta koraAnaka sahaja kari dicho~, yAte siha~te upadeza grahaNa kariva pAre|
eteke tumi apekSA karA, nizcaYa siha~teo apekSAkArI|
hA-mIma|[1]
mahAparAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAhara taraphara parA eikhana kitAva nAyilakRta|
nizcaYa AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIta muminasakalara vAve Ache vahuto nidarzana|
Aru tomAlokara sRSTita, lagate yivora jIৱ-jantu si~carati hai Ache, tAto Ache vahuto nidarzana, ene sampradAYara vAve, yisakale nizcita vizvAsa sthApana kare;

rAti Aru dinara parivartanata, lagate AllAhe AkAzara parA yi jIৱikA (pAnI) varSaNa kare, tAra pichata iYAra dvArAi teOM mRta bhUmika punarjIৱita kare, iYAra mAjata Aru vatAhara parivartanara mAjato vahu nidarzana Ache ene sampradAYara vAve yisakale vuji pAYa|
eivora haiche AllAhara AYAta, yivora Ami tomAra ocarata yathAyathabhAৱe tilAৱta karicho~| eteke siha~te AllAha Aru teOMra AYAtara pichata kona hAdIchara (vANIra) oparata vizvAsa sthApana kariva?
durbhoga pratyeka ghora michalIYA pApIra vAve!

yiYe AllAhara AYAtasamUha zune yivora tAra ocarata tilAৱta karA haYa, tathApio si auddhatyara saite Ako~ragoja hai thAke yenivA si seYA zunAi nAi| eteke tumi tAka yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda diYA;
Aru yetiYA si AmAra kono AYAtara viSaYe aৱgata haYa, tetiYA si seiToka parihAsara AhilA hicApe grahaNa kare| siha~tare vAve Ache lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|

siha~tara sanmukhata Ache jAhAnnAma; siha~tara kRtakarma siha~tara kono kAmata nAhiva, siha~te AllAhara parivarte yivoraka abhibhAৱka hicApe grahaNa kariche siha~teo kono kAmata nAhiva| siha~tara vAve Ache mahA zAsti|
ei (koraAna) haiche satpatha pradarzaka; Aru yisakale nija pratipAlakara AYAtasamUhara lagata kupharI kare, siha~tara vAve Ache ati yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

seijanei AllAha, yijane sAgaraka tomAlokara kalyANata niYojita kariche, yAte teOMra Adezata tAta nauyAna calAcala kariva pAre; lagate yAte tomAloke teOMra anugraha sandhAna kariva pArA lagate yAte tomAloke (teOMra prati) kRtajJatA prakAza karA|

AkAzasamUhata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache, sei sakalovora teৱe~i tomAlokara kalyANata niYojita kariche| nizcaYa iYAta vahuto nidarzana Ache ene sampradAYara vAve yisakale cintA-carcA, gaৱeSaNA kare|

yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokaka koৱA, teOMloke yena siha~taka kSamA kari diYe, yisakale AllAhara dinavorara pratyAzA nakare| yAte AllAhe nijei pratyeka sampradAYaka siha~tara kRtakarmara vAve pratidAna diYe|

yiYe satkarma kare si nijara kalyANara vAvei kare, Aru konovAi asatkarma karile tAra pratiphala si nijei bhoga kariva| tAra pichata tomAlokaka tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocaralai pratyAৱrtita karA ha’va|

nizcaYa Ami vanI icharAIlaka kitAva, kartRtva Aru navuoৱta dAna karichilo~ Aru siha~taka uttama vastura parA jIৱikA pradAna karichilo~, lagate siha~taka sakalo sRSTira oparata zreSThatva pradAna karichilo~|

Aru Ami siha~taka dvInara yAৱtIYa viSaYata suspaSTa pramANAdi dAna karichilo~| tathApio siha~tara ocarata jJAna ahAra pichato siha~te keৱla paraspara vidveSavazataH mata virodha karichila| siha~te yivora viSaYata matavirodha karichila, nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlake kiYAmatara dinA siha~tara mAjata seivora viSaYara phaYacAlA kari diva|
tAra pichata Ami tomAka pratiSThita karicho~ dvInara vizeSa vidhAnara oparata; eteke tumi tArei anusaraNa karA| yisakale nAjAne siha~tara pravRttira anusaraNa nakarivA|
nizcaYa AllAhara mokAvilAta siha~ta tomAra kono kAmata nAhiva, (jAni thoৱA) nizcaYa yAlimasakala haiche ijane sijanara vandhu, Aru AllAha haiche keৱla muttAkvIsakalara vandhu|
eikhana (koraAna) haiche mAnaৱ jAtira vAve AlokavartikA, Aru nizcita vizvAsI sampradAYara vAve hidAYata tathA rahamata|

yisakale duSkarma kariche siha~te bhAviche neki ye, jIৱna Aru mRtyura kSetrata Ami siha~taka teOMlokara dare gaNya karima, yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche? siha~tara vicAra-siddhAnta kimAna ye nikRSTa!

AllAhei AkAzasamUhaka Aru pRthiৱIka yathAyathabhAৱe sRSTi kariche, ei uddezye ye, yAte pratyeka vyaktika tAra karma anuyAYI phalAphala pradAna kariva parA yAYa; Aru siha~tara prati kono anyAYa karA naha’va|

eteke tumi seijana vyaktira pine lakSya karichAne, yiYe nijara kAmanA-vAsanAka nijara ilAha kari laiche? Aru tAra ocarata jJAna ahAra pichato AllAhe tAka vibhrAnta kariche, lagate AllAhe tAra kANa Aru hRdaYata mohara mAri diche| teৱe~i tAra cakura oparata rAkhi diche AৱraNa| eteke AllAhara pichata kone tAka hidAYata diva? tathApio tomAloke upadeza grahaNa nakarivAne?

Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘pArthiৱ jIৱnei haiche AmAra ekamAtra jIৱna, AmAra jIৱna-maraNa iYAtei| AmAka keৱla kAlacakraihe dhvaMsa kare’| prakRtate siha~tara ei viSaYe kono jJAna nAi, siha~te keৱla dhAraNAhe kare|

Aru siha~tara ocarata yetiYA AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karA haYa tetiYA siha~tara kono yukti nAthAke, keৱla ei kathAra vAhire ye, yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA tente AmAra pitR-puruSasakalaka lai AhA|

koৱA, AllAhei tomAlokaka jIৱna dAna kare Aru tAra pichata teৱe~i tomAlokara mRtyu ghaTAYa| teৱe~i tomAlokaka kiYAmatara dinA ekatrita kariva, iYAta kono sandeha nAi| kintu sarahabhAga mAnuhei seYA nAjAne|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra rAjatva keৱla AllAharei; Aru yidinA kiYAmata saMghaTita ha’va seidinA vAtilapanthIsakala kSatigrasta ha’va|

Aru tumi pratyeka jAtike dekhivA bhaYate natajAnu hai Ache; pratyeka jAtikei tAra kitAvara prati AhvAna karA ha’va, (Aru koৱA ha’va) ‘Aji tomAlokaka keৱla seiTorei pratiphala diYA ha’va yiTo tomAloke Amala karichilA’|
‘eiTo haiche AmAra likhani, eiToৱe tomAlokara viSaYe sa~cA kathA dAGi dhariva| nizcaYa tomAloke yi Amala karichilA seYA Ami likhi rAkhichilo~’|
eteke yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche pariNAmata teOMlokara pratipAlake teOMlokaka teOMra rahamatata praৱeza karAva| eiToৱei haiche suspaSTa saphalatA|

AnahAte yisakale kupharI kariche (siha~taka koৱA ha’va) ‘tomAlokara ocarata AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA hoৱA nAchilane? tathApio tomAloke ahaMkAra karichilA, Aru tomAloka AchilA eTA aparAdhI sampradAYa’|

Aru yetiYA koৱA haichila, ‘nizcaYa AllAhara pratizruti satya; Aru kiYAmata (saMghaTita ha’va) iYAta kono sandeha nAi’; tetiYA tomAloke kaichilA, ‘kiYAmata ki Ami eko nAjAno; Ami iYAka eTA dhAraNA vulihe bhAvo~ Aru ei viSaYe Ami nizcita nahaYa’|
Aru siha~tara asatkarmavorara kuphala siha~tara sanmukhata prakAzita ha’va Aru yiToka lai siha~te ThATTA-vidrUpa karichila seiToৱe siha~taka pariveSTana kariva|
Aru koৱA ha’va, ‘Aji Ami tomAlokaka aৱjJA karima yidare tomAloke ei diৱsara sAkSAtara viSaYaToka pAhari gaichilA| tomAlokara AvAsasthala ha’va jAhAnnAma, Aru tomAlokara kono sahAYakArIo nAthAkiva’|

‘eiTo eikAraNe ye, tomAloke AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka ThATTA-vidrUpara AhilA vanAi laichilA Aru pArthiৱ jIৱne tomAlokaka pratArita karichila’| seYe Aji siha~taka jAhAnnAmara parA muktio diYA naha’va Aru AllAhara santuSTi lAbhara suyogo diYA naha’va|
eteke sakalo dharaNara prazaMsA keৱla AllAhare prApya, yijana AkAzasamUhara pratipAlaka Aru teৱe~i pRthiৱIra pratipAlaka Aru teৱe~i sakalo vizvajagatara pratipAlaka|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra yAৱtIYa gauraৱ-garimA teOMrei Aru teOM mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
hA-mIma|[1]
mahAparAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAhara taraphara parA eikhana kitAva aৱtIrNa haiche|

AkAzamaNDala, pRthiৱI Aru ei duYore mAjata thakA sakalo vastu Ami yathAyathabhAৱe Aru nirdiSTa samaYara vAve sRSTi karicho~; kintu yisakale kupharI kariche, siha~taka yi viSaYe satarka karA haiche tAra parA siha~te vimukha haYa|

siha~taka koৱA, ‘tomAlokara dhAraNA ki? tomAloke AllAhara parivarte yisakalaka AhvAna karA, moka dekhuৱAcona siha~te pRthiৱIta kivA sRSTi kariche neki? athavA AkAzasamUhata siha~tara kivA arihaNA Ache neki? iYAra pUrvaৱrtI kono kitAvata athavA paramparAgata kono jJAna thAkile seYA tomAloke mora ocaralai lai AhA, yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA’|

Aru sei vyaktitakai adhika vibhrAnta Aruno kona ha’va pAre, yiYe AllAhara parivarte ene kichumAnaka AhvAna kare yivore kiYAmata diৱsalaike tAra AhvAnata sa~hAri diva noৱAre? Anaki seivora siha~tara AhvAna samparkeo udAsIna|
Aru kiYAmatara dinA yetiYA mAnuhaka ekatrita karA ha’va tetiYA sei upAsyavorei ha’va siha~tara zatru, Aru seivore siha~tara upAsanAka asvIkAra kariva|
Aru yetiYA siha~tara ocarata AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAৱta karA haYa, tetiYA yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara ocaralai satya ahAra pichato siha~te kaYa, ‘eYA dekhona suspaSTa yAdu’|

athavA siha~te kaYa ye, ‘eOM eikhana nijei udbhAৱna kariche’| koৱA, ‘yadi eikhana mai nije udbhAৱna karicho~, tente AllAhara parA moka vacAvalai tomAlokara kono kSamatA nAi| tomAloke yi viSaYe AlocanAta lipta haichA, sei viSaYe AllAha savizeSa aৱgata| mora Aru tomAlokara mAjata sAkSI hicApe teৱe~i yatheSTa Aru teOM kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

koৱA, ‘mai kono natuna (vA prathama) rAchula nahaYa| mai ei kathAo nAjAno ye, mora Aru tomAlokara viSaYe ki karA ha’va| mai keৱla mora prati yi ahI karA haYa seiTorahe anusaraNa karo~| mai ejana suspaSTa satarkakArI mAtra’|

siha~taka koৱA, ‘tomAloke bhAvi dekhichAne, yadi ei koraAnakhana AllAhara taraphara parA aৱtIrNa hai thAke Aru tomAloke iYAka asvIkAra karichA, athaca vanI icharAIlara ejana sAkSIYe ei viSaYe anurUpa sAkSI pradAna kari tAra prati ImAna Aniche; kintu tomAloke auddhatya prakAza karichA, (teneha’le tomAlokara pariNAma ki ha’va?) nizcaYa AllAhe yAlima sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare’|

yisakale kupharI kariche siha~te muminasakalara viSaYe kaYa, ‘iYAra mAjata kono kalyANa thAkile siha~te ketiYAo AmAtakai agraNI ha’va noৱArilehe~tena’| siha~te yihetu iYAra dvArA hidAYata poৱA nAi seYe siha~te acirei ka’va, ‘eYA eTA prAcIna michA kathAhe’|

iYAra pUrve muchAra kitAva Achila patha pradarzaka Aru rahamatasvarUpa, Aru ei kitAvakhana (seikhanare) samarthaka, AravI bhASAta, yAte i yAlimasakalaka satarka kare, lagate i haiche satkarmazIlasakalara vAve susaMvAda|
nizcaYa yisakale kaYa, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka haiche AllAha’, tAra pichata avicala thAke, teOMlokara kono bhaYa nAi Aru teOMloka cintitao naha’va|
teOMlokei haiche jAnnAtara adhivAsI, teOMloke yi Amala karichila tAra puraskAra hicApe tAta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va|

Aru Ami mAnuhaka siha~tara pitR-mAtRra prati sadaYa vyaৱhArara nirdeza pradAna karicho~| tAra mAke tAka vahu kaSTare garbhata dhAraNa karichila Aru vahu kaSTare prasaৱ kariche, tAka garbhata dhAraNa karA Aru piYAha khuoৱA eruৱAvalai lAgichila triza mAha, aৱzeSata yetiYA si pUrNa zakti prApta haYa Aru calliza vacharata upanIta haYa, tetiYA si kaYa, he mora pratipAlaka! tumi moka sAmartha diYA, yAte mai tomAra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kariva pAro~, mora prati Aru mora pitR-mAtRra prati tumi yi anugraha karichA tAra vAve, lagate yAte mai enekuৱA satkarma kariva pAro~ yiTo tumi pachanda karA, Aru mora vAve mora santAna-santatisakalaka saMzodhana kari diYA, nizcaYa mai tomArei abhimukhI haicho~ Aru nizcaYa mai muchalimasakalara antarbhukta|

eOMlokei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara utkRSTa AmalasamUha Ami kavula karo~, Aru teOMlokara veYA AmalasamUha Ami kSamA kari diOM, teOMlokei jAnnAtavAsIsakalara antarbhukta| teOMlokaka yiTo pratizruti diYA haiche, seYA nizcitabhAৱe satya pramANita ha’va|

Aru yiYe tAra pitR-mAtRka kaYa, ‘Aphacoca tomAlokara vAve! tomAloke moka ei pratizruti diYA neki ye, moka punarutthita karA ha’va, athaca mora pUrve vahu prajanma atIta haiche’? tetiYA tAra pitR-mAtRYe AllAhara ocarata sahAYa prArthanA kare, Aru tAka kaYa, ‘durbhAgya tora! ImAna poSaNa kara, nizcaYa AllAhara pratizruti satya’| tetiYA si kaYa, ‘eYA atIta kAlara upakathAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa’|

iha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara prati zAstira sei phaYacAlA sAvyasta haiche, yiTo satya pramANita haichila siha~tara pUrve jina Aru mAnaৱra parA ativAhita hoৱA ummatara oparata| nizcaYa siha~ta Achila kSatigrasta|
Aru pratyekare vAve siha~tara Amala anusAre maryAdA Ache; yAte AllAhe pratyekare karmara pUrNa pratiphala pradAna kare| lagate siha~tara prati akaNo anyAYa karA naha’va|

Aru yisakale kupharI kariche yidinA siha~taka jAhAnnAmara sanmukhata peca karA ha’va (seidinA siha~taka koৱA ha’va) tomAloke tomAlokara pArthiৱ jIৱnatei yAৱtIYa sukha-zAnti bhoga kari niHzeSa karichA| eteke Aji tomAlokaka diYA ha’va aৱmAnanAkara zAsti; kAraNa tomAloke pRthiৱIta anyAYabhAৱe auddhatya prakAza karichilA Aru tomAloke avAdhyatA karichilA|

Aru smaraNa karA Ada sampradAYara bhAtRra kathA, yetiYA teOM AhakvAphata nija sampradAYaka satarka karichila| yAra Agata Aru pichato satarkakArI Ahichila (ei nirdeza lai) ye, ‘tomAloke ekamAtra AllAhara vAhire Ana kAro ivAdata nakarivA| nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve mahAdiৱsara zAstira AzaMkA karicho~’|

siha~te ka’le, ‘tumi AmAka AmAra upAsyavorara parA nivRtta karivalai AhichA neki? anyathA tumi yadi satyavAdIsakalara antarbhukta hai thakA tente AmAra lagata tumi yi pratizruti karichA seYA lai AhA’|
teOM ka’le, ‘ei jJAna keৱla AllAhara ocaratahe Ache| mai yiTo lai prerita haicho~ keৱla seiTohe mai tomAlokara ocarata pracAra karo~, kintu mai dekhi Acho~ tomAloka eTA murkha sampradAYa’|

tAra pichata yetiYA siha~te siha~tara upatyakAra pine megha ahA dekhile tetiYA siha~te ka’valai dharile, ‘ei meghe AmAra iYAta varaSuNa diva’| (hUde ka’le) nahaYa, varaM eiToৱe haiche sei zAsti yiTora vAve tomAloke kharadhara karichilA, ejAka varaSuNa, ya’ta Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

‘i tAra pratipAlakara nirdezata sakalo vastu dhvaMsa kari diva’| phalata siha~ta enekai (dhvaMsa) hai ga’la ye, siha~tara AvAsasthalara vAhire Ana eko dRzyamAna nAchila| eidarei Ami aparAdhI sampradAYaka pratiphala pradAna kari thAko~|

nizcaYa Ami siha~taka yenekai pratiSThita karichilo~, tomAlokaka tenekai pratiSThita karA nAi; Aru Ami siha~taka dichilo~ kANa, caku Aru hRdaYa; tathApio siha~tara kANa, caku Aru hRdaYa kono kAmata ahA nAchila, yetiYA siha~te AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra karichila| yiTo viSaYakalai siha~te ThATTA-vidrUpa karichila, aৱzeSata seiToৱei siha~taka pariveSTana karile|
nizcaYa Ami dhvaMsa karichilo~ tomAlokara cAriophAle thakA janapadamUhaka; Aru Ami vibhinnabhAৱe AYAtasamUha vivRta karichilo~, yAte siha~te (satpathalai) ubhati Ahe|

eteke yisakale AllAhara sAnnidhya lAbha karAra vAve AllAhara parivarte yivoraka upAsyarUpe grahaNa karichila seivore siha~taka sahAYa nakarile kiYa? varaM seivora siha~tara parA udhAo hai ga’la, kAraNa eiTo Achila siha~tara manesajA michA pratAraNA; yiTo siha~te alIka udbhAৱna karichila|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA Ami tomAra phAle jinara eTA dala Anichilo~| yisakale manoyoga sahakAre koraAna pATha zuni Achila| eteke yetiYA teOMloke teOMra ocarata Ahi upasthita haichila, tetiYA teOMloke paraspare kaichila, ‘mane mane zunA’| tAra pichata yetiYA koraAna pATha samApta ha’la tetiYA teOMloke satarkakArIrUpe nija nija sampradAYara ocaralai ubhati ga’la|

teOMloke kaichila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! nizcaYa Ami ene ekhana granthara pATha zunicho~ yikhana aৱtIrNa haiche muchAra pichata, ei granthakhane iYAra pUrvaৱrtI kitAvasamUhaka satyAYana kare, lagate satya Aru sarala pathara pine hidAYata kare|

‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAhara phAle AhvAnakArIra prati sa~hAri diYA Aru teOMra prati ImAna poSaNa karA, teOM tomAlokara pApasamUha kSamA kari diva Aru yantraNAdAYaka zAstira parA tomAlokaka rakSA kariva’|

Aru AllAhara phAle AhvAnakArIra prati yiYe sa~hAri nidiYe (manata rakhA ucita) si kintu pRthiৱIta AllAhaka apAraga kariva noৱAriva; Aru AllAhara vAhire tAra kono abhibhAৱko nAi| siha~tei Ache suspaSTa vibhrAntira mAjata|

siha~te dekhA nAine ye, nizcaYa AllAha, yijane AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI sRSTi kariche Aru eivorara sRSTita teOM kono klAntivodha karA nAi, teৱe~i mRtaka jIৱna dAna karivalai sakSama? nizcaYa haYa, nizcaYa teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

Aru yisakale kupharI kariche yidinA siha~taka jAhAnnAmara sanmukhata upasthita karA ha’va (seidinA siha~taka koৱA ha’va) ‘eiTo sa~cA nahaYane’? siha~te ka’va, ‘AmAra pratipAlakara zapata! nizcaYa sa~cA’| teOM ka’va, ‘tente zAsti bhoga karA; kAraNa tomAloke kupharI karichilA’|

eteke tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA yenekai dhairyya dhAraNa karichila dRDha়pratijJa rAchulasakale| tumi siha~tara vAve kharakhedA nakarivA| siha~taka yi viSaYe satarka karA haiche seiToka yidinA siha~te dekhivalai pAva, seidinA siha~tara dhAraNA ha’va, siha~te yenivA pRthiৱIta eTA muhUrtara vechi samaYa aৱsthAna karA nAchila| eiTo haiche eTA ghoSaNA, eteke keৱla phAchikva sampradAYakei dhvaMsa karA ha’va|
yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AllAhara pathara parA Anaka nivRtta kariche teOM (AllAhe) siha~tara AmalasamUhaka vyartha kari diche|

Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche, satkarma kariche lagate muhAmmadara prati yi aৱtIrNa haiche tAra oparata vizvAsa sthApana kariche, Aru eikhana haiche teOMlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA (prerita) satya, teৱe~i teOMlokara veYA AmalasamUha dUra kariva Aru teOMlokara aৱsthAra saMzodhana kariva|

eiTo eikAraNe ye, yisakale kupharI kariche siha~te vAtilara anusaraNa kariche Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMloke nija pratipAlakara prerita satyara anusaraNa kariche| eidare AllAhe mAnuhara vAve siha~tara dRSTAntasamUha upasthApana kare|

etake yetiYA tomAloke kAphirasakalara lagata yuddha kSetrata mukAvilA karA tetiYA (siha~tara) ghArata AghAta karivA, aৱzeSata yetiYA tomAloke siha~taka sampUrNarUpe paryudasta karivA tetiYA siha~taka kaTakaTIYAkai vAndhi lavA; tAra pichata ha’le anukampA, naha’le muktipaNa, yetiYAlaike (siha~te) yuddhara bhAra (astra-zastra) namAi nathaYa| eidarei, AllAhe icchA karile siha~tara parA pratizodha lava pArilehe~tena, kintu teOM tomAlokara ejanaka Anajanara dvArA parIkSA kariva vicAre| yisakale AllAhara pathata nihata haYa AllAhe teOMlokara Amala ketiYAo vinaSTa ha’valai nidiYe|
anatipalame AllAhe teOMlokaka pathanirdeza kariva Aru teOMlokara aৱsthAra saMzodhana kariva|
Aru teOMlokaka praৱeza karAva jAnnAtata, yAra paricaYa teOM teOMlokaka janAi diche|
he muminasakala! yadi tomAloke AllAhaka sahAYa karA tente teOM tomAlokaka sahAYa kariva Aru tomAlokara bhari sudRDha় rAkhiva|
Aru yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara vAve Ache dhvaMsa Aru teOM siha~tara AmalasamUha vyartha kari diche|
eiTo eikAraNe ye, AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche, siha~te tAka apachanda kariche| seYe teOM siha~tara AmalasamUhaka niSphala kari diche|
tente siha~te pRthiৱIta bhramaNa kari coৱA nAine siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara pariNAma ki haichila? AllAhe siha~taka dhvaMsa kariche| kAphirasakalara vAve Ache anurUpa pariNAma|
eiTo eikAraNe ye, nizcaYa AllAha haiche muminasakalara abhibhAৱka Aru ei kathAo nizcita ye, kAphirasakalara kono abhibhAৱka nAi|

nizcaYa yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche AllAhe teOMlokaka praৱeza karAva jAnnAtata, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita; kintu yisakale kupharI kariche siha~te bhoga-vilAsata matta thAke Aru seidare AhAra kare yidare catuSpada jantuvore AhAra kare; eteke jAhAnnAmei haiche siha~tara AvAsasthala|

Aru tomAra janapada yiTora parA siha~te tomAka vahiSkAra kariche, sei janapadara tulanAta adhika zaktizAlI Aru vahuto janapada Achila; yivoraka Ami dhvaMsa karicho~, phalata siha~tara kono sahAYakArI nAchila|

yijana vyakti teOMra pratipAlakara taraphara parA prerita suspaSTa pramANara oparata pratiSThita Ache, seijana vyakti tAra dare neki yAra ocarata nijara veYA AmalasamUhaka zobhanIYa kari diYA haiche, lagate yisakale nijara kAmanA-vAsanAra anusaraNa kari Ache?

muttAkvIsakalaka yi jAnnAtara pratizruti diYA haiche tAra dRSTAnta haiche enekuৱA, tAta Ache nirmala pAnIra nijarAsamUha, Aru Ache gAkhIrara nadIsamUha yAra soৱAda aparivartanIYa, lagate seৱnakArIsakalara vAve Ache susvAdu surAra naharasamUha, Aru Ache parizodhita maujolara nadIsamUha, lagate tAta teOMlokara vAve thAkiva pratyeka prakArara phalamUla, Aru Ache teOMlokara pratipAlakara taraphara parA kSamA| teOMloka siha~tara dare neki yisakale jAhAnnAmata sthAYI ha’va Aru yisakalaka pAna karoৱA ha’va utalA pAnI, phalata sei pAnIYe siha~tara nADa়I-bhuru chinna-vicchinna kari pelAva|

siha~tara mAjara kichumAne tomAra kathA manoyoga sahakAre zune, aৱzeSata tomAra ocarara parA olAi gai teOMlokaka sodhe yisakalaka jJAna dAna karA haiche, ‘ei mAtra teOM ki ka’le’? iha~tei haiche seisakala loka, yisakalara antarasamUhata AllAhe mohara mAri diche Aru siha~te nijara kAmanA-vAsanAra anusaraNa kariche|
Aru yisakale hidAYata prApta haiche, AllAhe teOMlokara hidAYata Aru adhika vRddhi kari diYe, lagate teOMlokaka teOMlokara tAkvaৱA pradAna kare|

eteke siha~te keৱla ei apekSAta Ache neki ye, kiYAmata siha~tara ocaralai AkasmikabhAৱe Ahi paraka? kiYAmatara lakSaNasamUha kintu AhiYe pariche! eteke kiYAmata Ahile siha~te upadeza grahaNa kariva kenekai!

gatike jAni thoৱA! AllAhara vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi| lagate kSamA prArthanA karA nijara Aru mumina nara-nArIsakalara bhula-truTira vAve| AllAhe tomAlokara gatividhi Aru aৱsthAna samparke aৱgata|

Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMloke kaYa, eTA churA aৱtIrNa karA nahaYa kiYa, tAra pichata yadi kono muhakAma churA aৱtIrNa haYa Aru tAta yuddhara kono nirdeza thAke, tetiYA tumi dekhivA yisakalara antarata vyAdhi Ache siha~te mRtyura bhaYata vihvala mAnuhara dare tomAra phAle cAi Ache| eteke siha~tara vAve uttama Achila----

Anugatya Aru nyAYasaMgata vAkya; eteke cUDa়Anta siddhAnta hoৱAra pichata siha~te yadi AllAhara lagata karA pratizruti satyata pariNata karilehe~tena, tente nizcaYa seYA siha~tara vAve kalyANakara ha’lahe~tena|
kSamatAta adhiSThita ha’le sambhaৱtaH tomAloke pRthiৱIta viparyaYa sRSTi karivA Aru AtmIYatAra vandhana vicchinna karivA?
iha~takei AllAhe lAnata kariche, phalata teOM siha~taka vadhira kari diche Aru siha~tara dRSTisamUhaka andha kari diche|
tente siha~te koraAnaka lai gabhIra cintA-carcA nakare neki? ne siha~tara antarata talA lagoৱA Ache?
nizcaYa yisakale nijara ocarata satpatha spaSTa hoৱAra pichato tAra parA pRSThapradarzana kare, caYatAne siha~tara karmaka zobhanIYa kari dekhuৱAYa Aru siha~taka michA AzA diYe|

eiTo eikAraNe ye, AllAhe yi aৱtIrNa kariche, tAka yisakale apachanda kare siha~taka iha~te kaYa, ‘anatipalame Amio kichumAna viSaYata tomAlokara anusaraNa karima’| kintu AllAhe siha~tara gopana abhisandhisamUha jAne|
eteke sei samaYata siha~tara ki dazA ha’va! yetiYA phiristAsakale siha~tara mukhamaNDala Aru piThita mariYAi mariYAi prANa haraNa kariva!

eiTo eikAraNe ye, siha~te ene kichumAna viSaYara anusaraNa kariche yivore AllAhaka asantuSTa kariche, lagate siha~te teOMra santuSTika apachanda kariche, seYe teOM siha~tara AmalasamUhaka niSphala kari diche|
yisakalara antarata vyAdhi Ache siha~te eiTo bhAve neki ye, AllAhe ketiYAo siha~tara vidveSabhAৱ prakAza kari nidiva?

Aru Ami icchA karile tomAka siha~tara paricaYa dilo~he~tena; phalata tumi siha~tara lakSaNa dekhiYe siha~taka ciniva pArilAhe~tena| kintu nizcaYa tumi siha~tara kathAra bhaGgite siha~taka ciniva pArivA| AllAhe tomAlokara yAৱtIYa Amala samparke jAne|
Aru Ami nizcaYa tomAlokaka parIkSA karima ei kathA prakAza nakarAlaike ye, tomAlokara mAjata mujAhida Aru dhairyyazIla loka konasakala, Aru AmiYei tomAlokara karmakANDa parIkSA karo~|

nizcaYa yisakale kupharI kariche Aru mAnuhaka AllAhara pathara parA nivRtta kariche lagate siha~tara ocarata hidAYata suspaSTa hoৱAra pichato rAchulara virodhitA kariche, siha~te ketiYAo AllAhara kono kSati kariva noৱAriva| atizIghre teOM siha~tara AmalasamUhaka niSphala kari diva|
he muminasakala! tomAloke AllAhara Anugatya karA Aru rAchulara Anugatya karA, Aru tomAloke nijara AmalasamUhaka vinaSTa nakarivA|
nizcaYa yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AllAhara pathara parA mAnuhaka nivRtta kariche, tAra pichata kAphira aৱsthAta mRtyuvaraNa kariche, AllAhe siha~taka ketiYAo kSamA nakariva|
eteke tomAloke manovala neheruৱAvA Aru sandhira prastAvo nidivA, tomAlokei pravala, kAraNa tomAlokara lagata (sahAYaka hicApe) AllAha Ache, Aru teOM tomAlokara karmaphala ketiYAo kSuNNa nakariva|

pArthiৱ jIৱna haiche keৱla khela-dhemAli Aru arthahIna kathA-vatarAhe| yadi tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karA Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA tente AllAhe tomAlokaka tomAlokara puraskAra pradAna kariva| teOM tomAlokara dhana-sampada nivicAre|

yadi teOM tomAlokara ocarata seYA (dhana-sampada) vicAre, lagate yadi teOM tomAlokara oparata pravala cApa diYe tente tomAloke kRpaNAlihe karivA Aru teOM tetiYA tomAlokara vidveSabhAৱ prakAza kari diva|

coৱA, tomAlokei seisakala loka, yisakalaka AllAhara pathata vyaYa karivalai koৱA haiche athaca tomAlokara kichumAne kRpaNatAhe kariche, kintu yiYe kRpaNAli kariche si nijara pratihe kRpaNAli kariche| (jAni thoৱA!) AllAha abhAৱmukta Aru tomAloka haichA abhAৱgrasta| yadi tomAloke vimukha hoৱA, tente teOM tomAlokara vAhire velega eTA sampradAYaka tomAlokara sthalaৱrtI kariva; siha~ta kintu tomAlokara dare naha’va|
(he rAchula!) nizcaYa Ami tomAka pradAna karicho~ suspaSTa vijaYa,
yAte AllAhe tomAra atIta Aru bhaৱiSyatara truTisamUha mArjanA kare Aru tomAra prati teOMra anugraha pUrNa kare, lagate teOM yAte tomAka sarala pathara hidAYata diYe,
lagate yAte AllAhe tomAka valiSTha sAhAyya dAna kare|

teৱe~i muminasakalara antarata prazAnti nAyila kariche, yAte teOMloke nijara ImAnara saite ImAna vRddhi kari laYa| AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra senAvAhinI keৱla AllAharei; Aru AllAha haiche sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

yAte teOM mumina puruSa Aru muminA nArIsakalaka jAnnAtata praৱeza karAva pAre, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita, ya’ta teOMloka sthAYI ha’va Aru teৱe~i teOMlokara pApasamUha mocana kariva; eiToৱe haiche AllAhara ocarata mahA saphalatA|

lagate munAphika puruSa Aru munAphikA nArI, muzvarika puruSa Aru muzvarikA nArI yisakale AllAhara viSaYe veYA dhAraNA poSaNa kare, siha~taka yAte teOM zAsti vihiva pAre| amaGgala cakra siha~tara oparatei Apatita haYa| AllAhe siha~tara oparata krodhAnvita haiche Aru siha~taka lAnata kariche; Aru siha~tara vAve prastuta kari rAkhiche jAhAnnAma| seiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa pratyAৱrtanasthala!
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra senAvAhinI keৱla AllAharei; Aru AllAha haiche parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
nizcaYa Ami tomAka preraNa karicho~ sAkSIrUpe, susaMvAdadAtA Aru satarkakArIrUpe,

yAte tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna poSaNa karA Aru teOMka sahAYa-sahayogitAra dvArA zakti yuguৱA lagate teOMka sanmAna karA; Aru puৱA-gadhUli teOMra paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karA|

nizcaYa yisakale tomAra ocarata vAiAta kare, aৱzye teOMloke AllAhara hAtatei vAiAta kare| AllAhara hAta teOMlokara hAtara oparata| tAra pichata yiYe seiTo bhaMga kariva, sei bhaMga karAra pariNAma tArei oparata vartiva Aru yiYe AllAhara lagata karA aMgIkAra pUrNa kariva tAka AllAhe zIghrei mahApuraskAra pradAna kariva|

yisakala veduine picha ho~hakA dichila, siha~te tomAka anatipalame Ahi ka’va, ‘AmAra dhana-sampada Aru pariYAlavargai AmAka vyasta kari rAkhichila, gatike AmAra vAve kSamA prArthanA kari diYaka’| siha~te mukhere yi kaYa seYA siha~tara antarata nAi| siha~taka koৱA, ‘AllAhe yadi tomAlokara kono kSati kariva vicAre athavA kono upakAra kariva vicAre, tente teOMka vAdhA diYAra kSamatA kAra Ache? varaM tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe AllAha savizeSa aৱhita’|

varaM tomAloke dhAraNA karichilA ye, rAchula Aru muminasakale teOMlokara nija nija pariYAlara ocaralai ketiYAo ubhati Ahiva noৱAriva; Aru ei dhAraNA tomAlokara antarata suzobhita haichila, Aru tomAloke eiTo vara nikRSTa dhAraNA poSaNa karichilA, Aru tomAloka AchilA dhvaMsamukhI eTA sampradAYa!
Aru yiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna poSaNa nakare, nizcaYa Ami seisakala kAphirara vAve prastuta kari rAkhicho~ jalanta jui|
AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra sArvabhauma kartRtva ekamAtra AllAharei, teOM yAka icchA kare kSamA kari diYe Aru yAka icchA kare zAsti diYe| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomAloke yetiYA yuddhalavdha sampada saMgraha karivalai yAvA, tetiYA yisakale picha ho~hakA dichila siha~te Ahi ka’va, ‘AmAko AponAlokara lagata yAvalai anumati diYaka’| siha~te AllAhara vANI parivartana kariva vicAre| koৱA, ‘tomAloke kono matei AmAra lagata yAva noৱArA| ei ghoSaNA AllAhe Agatei kari thaiche’| siha~te ka’va, ‘varaM AponAloke AmAka hiMsA kare’| nahaYa, darAcalate siha~te ati sAmAnyahe vuji pAYa|

picha ho~hakA diYA veduinavilAkaka koৱA, ‘zIghrei tomAlokaka eTA kaThora yuddhA jAtira viruddhe AhvAna karA ha’va; tomAloke siha~tara viruddhe yuddha karivA nAivA siha~te AtmasamarpaNa kariva| eteke tomAloke ei Adeza pAlana karile AllAhe tomAlokaka uttama puraskAra dAna kariva| anyathA tomAloke yadi Agara dare pRSTha pradarzana karA, tente teOM tomAlokaka yantraNAdAYaka zAsti diva’|

andhara vAve kono aparAdha nAi, khaJjara vAveo kono aparAdha nAi Aru asustha lokara vAveo kono aparAdha nAi; Aru yiYe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya kariva, teOM tAka enekuৱA jAnnAtata praৱeza karAva, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita; kintu yiYe pRSTha pradarzana kariva teOM tAka yantraNAdAYaka zAsti diva|

nizcaYa AllAhe muminasakalara prati santuSTa haiche, yetiYA teOMloke gachara talata tomAra vAiAta grahaNa karichila, eteke teOMlokara antarata yi Achila sei viSaYe teOM aৱgata Achila; phalata teOMlokara oparata teOM prazAnti aৱtIrNa karile Aru teOMlokaka Asanna vijaYere puraskRta karile;
lagate vipula parimANa yuddhalavdha sampadara dvArA (teOMlokaka puraskRta kariva) yivora teOMloke grahaNa kariva; Aru AllAha pravala parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAhe tomAlokaka prabhUta yuddhalavdha sampadara pratizruti dAna kariche, yAra adhikArI keৱla tomAloka ha’vA| lagate teOM eiTo tomAlokara vAve tvarAnvita kariche| teৱe~i tomAlokara parA mAnuhara hAta nivArita kariche, yAte eiTo muminasakalara vAve eTA nidarzana haYa, teৱe~i tomAlokaka sarala pathata paricAlita kare;
iYAra vAhireo Aru Ache vahu sampada, yivora etiYAo tomAlokara adhikArata ahA nAi, seivoraka AllAhei pariveSTana kari rAkhiche| AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

Aru yisakale kupharI kariche siha~te yadi tomAlokara lagata yuddha karilehe~tena tente nizcaYa siha~te pRSTa pradarzana karilehe~tena, tAra pichata siha~te kono abhibhAৱka Aru sahAYakArIo nApAlehe~tena|
eiToৱe haiche AllAhara vidhAna--- yiTo pUrvare parA cali Ahiche, tumi AllAhara vidhAnata kono parivartana nApAvA|

Aru teৱe~i makkA upatyakAta siha~tara hAta tomAlokara parA Aru tomAlokara hAta siha~tara parA nivArita karichila, siha~tara oparata tomAlokaka vijaYI karAra pichata, Aru tomAloke yi karA AllAhe tAra samyaka draSTA|

siha~tei kupharI karichila Aru tomAlokaka vAdhA pradAna karichila machajidula hArAmara parA, lagate vAdhA pradAna karichila kurAvAnIra vAve Aৱddha pazuvilAkaka yathAsthAnalai lai yoৱAta| yadi (makkAta) mumina puruSa Aru muminA nArIsakala nAthAkilahe~tena, yisakalara viSaYe tomAloke nAjAnA ye, tomAloke ajJatAvazataH teOMlokaka padadalita karivA, phalata teOMlokara kAraNe tomAlokei aparAdhI Aru doSI sAvyasta ha’lAhe~tena, (tathApio teOM yuddhara anumati dilehe~tena, kintu AllAhe tomAlokaka tetiYA yuddhara anumati diYA nAchila) eikAraNe ye, AllAhe yAka icchA kare tAka teOM nija anugrahata praৱeza karAYa| yadi teOMloka pRthaka hai thAkilahe~tena, tente aৱzye Ami siha~tara mAjata kAphiravilAkaka yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pradAna karilo~he~tena|

yetiYA kAphirasakale siha~tara antarata gotrIYa ahamikA poSaNa karichila— ajJatA yugara ahamikA, tetiYA AllAhe teOMra rAchulara oparata Aru muminasakalara oparata teOMra prazAnti aৱtIrNa karile, Aru teOMlokaka tAkvaৱAra kalimAta sudRDha় karile, teOMlokei Achila iYAra adhika yogya Aru upayukta; Aru AllAha sakalo viSaYe sarvajJa|

nizcaYa AllAhe teOMra rAchulara saponaka yathAyathabhAৱe vAstaৱAYita kariche, AllAhara icchAta tomAloke nizcitabhAৱe nirApade mUra khuroৱAi Aru culi cuTi kari nirbhaYe machajidula hArAmata praৱeza karivA| eteke tomAloke yiTo nAjAnA seiTo teOM jAne| seYe iYAra vAhireo teOM tomAlokaka pradAna kariche eTA sadya vijaYa|
teৱe~i nija rAchulaka pathanirdeza Aru satya dvIna sahakAre preraNa kariche, Ana sakalo dvInara oparata iYAka jaYayukta karivalai; Aru sAkSI hicApe AllAhei yatheSTa|

muhAmmada haiche AllAhara rAchula, Aru teOMra sahacarasakala kAphirasakalara prati ati kaThora, parasparara mAjata sahAnubhUtizIla; tumi teOMlokaka ruku Aru chAjadAha aৱnata aৱsthAta AllAhara anugraha Aru santuSTi kAmanA karA dekhivalai pAvA| teOMlokara mukhamaNDalata thAkiva chAjadAra cihna; eiToৱe haiche tAorAtata teOMlokara dRSTAnta| iJjIlata teOMlokara dRSTAnta haiche enekuৱA eTi gachapulira dare, yiTora parA olAYa komala pAta, tAra pichata seiTo majavuta haYa Aru puSTa haYa, lagate dRDha়bhAৱe kANDara oparata thiYa diYe, yiTo khetiYakara vAve vara AnandadAYaka| eidare AllAhe muminasakalara samRddhira dvArA kAphirasakalara antardahana vRddhi kare| yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche AllAhe teOMlokaka kSamA Aru mahApratidAnara pratizruti diche|
he muminasakala! AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara sanmukhata tomAloke kono viSaYe agraNI naha'vA Aru tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

he muminasakala! tomAloke navIra kaNThasvarara oparata nijara kaNThasvara ucca nakarivA Aru nijara mAjata yenekai uccasvare kathA koৱA teOMra lagata tenekai uccasvarata kathA naka’vA; anyathA tomAloke ga'ma nopoৱAkaiYe tomAlokara sakalo Amala vinaSTa hai yAva|
nizcaYa yisakale AllAhara rAchulara sanmukhata nijara kaNThasvara aৱnamita kare, AllAhe teOMlokara antarasamUhaka tAkvaৱAra vAve nirvAcita kariche| teOMlokara vAve Ache kSamA Aru mahA puraskAra|
nizcaYa yisakale tomAka hujarAsamUhara pichaphAlara parA uccasvare mAte, (darAcalate) siha~tara adhikAMzai navuje|
tumi siha~tara ocaralai olAi nahAlaike yadi siha~te dhairyya dhAraNa karilehe~tena, tente seiToৱe siha~tara vAve uttama ha’lahe~tena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAndArasakala! yadi kono phAchikve tomAlokara ocaralai kono vArtA lai Ahe, tente tomAloke seYA parIkSA kari cAvA, yAte ene nahaYa ye, ajJatAvazataH tomAloke kono sampradAYaka AkramaNa kari pelAvA, yAra phalata tomAloke nijara kRtakarmara vAve anutapta ha’va lAgiva|

jAni thoৱA ye, tomAlokara mAjata AllAhara rAchula Ache, teOM yadi adhikAMza viSaYata tomAlokara kathA mAni la’lehe~tena, tente tomAloke nizcaYa kaSTata patita ha’lAhe~tena| kintu AllAhe tomAlokara vAve ImAnaka priYa kari diche Aru seiToka tomAlokara hRdaYagrAhI kariche| lagate kupharI, pApakarma Aru avAdhyatAka tomAlokara vAve apriYa kari diche| teOMlokei saThika pathaprApta|
(eivora haiche) AllAhara dAna Aru anugraha; Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Aru yadi muminasakalara duTA dale vAda-vivAdata lipta haYa tente tomAloke teOMlokara mAjata mImAMsA kari diYA, tathApio yadi teOMlokara eTA dale Ana eTA dalara viruddhe sImAlaMghana kare, tente yisakale sImAlaMghana kare siha~tara viruddhe tomAloke yuddha karA, yetiYAlaike siha~te AllAhara nirdezara pine ubhati nAhiva| tAra pichata yadi siha~te ubhati Ahe tente siha~tara mAjata nyAYara saite Apoca mImAMsA kari diYA Aru nyAYa vicAra karA| nizcaYa AllAhe nyAYa vicArakArIsakalaka bhAla pAYa|
muminasakala paraspare bhAi-bhAi; seYe tomAloke nija bhAtRsakalara mAjata Apoca-mImAMsA kari diYA| lagate AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, yAte tomAloke anugrahaprApta hoৱA|

he ImAndArasakala! kono mumina sampradAYe yena Ana kono mumina sampradAYaka upahAsa nakare, kiYano yisakalaka upahAsa karA haiche teOMloke upahAsakArIsakalatakai uttama ha’va pAre; Aru nArIsakaleo yena Ana Ana nArIsakalaka upahAsa nakare, kiYano yisakalara upahAsa karA haiche teOMloke upahAsakArINI vilAkatakaio uttama ha’va pAre| lagate tomAloke ijane sijanara prati doSAropa nakarivA Aru ejane Anajanaka veYA nAmere nAmAtivA; ImAnara pichata veYA nAma ati nikRSTa| eteke (jAni thoৱA) yisakale tAovA nakare siha~tei haiche yAlima|

he muminasakala! tomAloke atimAtrA sandeha karAra parA virata thAkA| nizcaYa kichumAna sandeha haiche pApa; lagate tomAloke ijane sijanara gopanIYa viSaYa sandhAna nakarivA Aru ejane Anajanara gIvata nakarivA| tomAlokara mAjara konovAi tAra mRta bhAtRra mAMsa khoৱoTo pachanda karivane? nizcaYa tomAloke tAka apachanda karA| gatike tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA; nizcaYa AllAha tAovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|

he mAnaৱ sampradAYa! nizcaYa Ami tomAlokaka ejana puruSa Aru ejanI nArIra parA sRSTi karicho~, Aru tomAlokaka vibhakta karicho~ vibhinna jAti-janagoSThI Aru vibhinna gotrata, yAte tomAloke ejane Anajanara lagata paricita ha’va pArA| AllAhara ocarata tomAlokara mAjara keৱla sei vyaktiYei vechi maryAdAzIla, yijana tomAlokara mAjata vechi tAkvaৱA sampanna| nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJa, samyaka aৱhita|

veduinavilAke kaYa, ‘Ami ImAna Anicho~’| koৱA, ‘tomAloke ImAna poSaNa karA nAi, varaM tomAloke koৱA, ‘Ami AtmasamarpaNa karicho~’, kAraNa ImAna etiYAo tomAlokara antarata praৱeza karA nAi| yadi tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya karA tente teOM tomAlokara AmalasamUhara choৱAva akaNo lAghaৱ nakariva| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

prakRta mumina haiche seisakala loka, yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna Aniche, tAra pichata teOMloke sandeha poSaNa karA nAi, lagate teOMloke jAna-mAlara saite AllAhara pathata jihAda kariche| teOMlokei haiche satyaniSTha|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke tomAlokara dvIna samparke AllAhaka aৱgata kari AchA neki? athaca AllAhe jAne AkAzasamUhata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache| AllAha sakalo viSaYei samyaka aৱgata’|

siha~te bhAve ye, siha~te ichalAma grahaNa kari tomAka dhanya kariche| koৱA, ‘tomAloke ichalAma grahaNa kari moka dhanya karichA vuli nAbhAvivA; varaM AllAhei tomAlokaka ImAnara dizata paricAlita kari tomAlokakahe dhanya kariche, yadi tomAloke satyavAdI hoৱA’|
nizcaYa AllAha AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱIra gAYeva samparke aৱgata| lagate tomAloke yi karA AllAhe tAra samyaka draSTA|
kvA-pha,[1] zapata sanmAnita koraAnara!
varaM siha~te vismita haiche eikAraNe ye, siha~tara mAjara parAi ejana satarkakArI siha~tara ocaralai Ahiche; Aru kAphirasakale kaYa, ‘eiTo dekhona eTA vismaYakara viSaYa!’
‘Ami yetiYA mRtyuvaraNa karima Aru mATita pariNata ha'ma tathApio (Ami punarutthita ha'mane?), ei pratyAৱrtana sudUraparAhata!’
nizcaYa Ami jAno mATiYe siha~taka kimAna kSaYa kare, Aru AmAra ocarata Ache samyaka saMrakSaNakArI kitAva|
prakRtate siha~tara ocaralai satya ahAra pichato siha~te tAka asvIkAra kariche| phalata siha~ta saMzaYayukta viSaYata nipatita|
siha~te siha~tara oparata aৱsthita AkAzara pine lakSya nakare neki, kenekai Ami seYA nirmANa karicho~ Aru iYAka suzobhita karicho~ Aru tAta kono dharaNara phATao melA nAi?
Aru Ami pRthiৱIka vistRta karicho~ Aru tAta sthApana karicho~ parvatamAlA| lagate tAta utpanna karicho~ naYana prItikara sakalo prakArara udbhida,
AllAhara anurAgI pratyeka vAndAra vAve jJAna Aru upadezasvarUpa|
Aru AkAzara parA varSaNa karo~ Ami kalyaNamaYa pAnI| tAra pichata tAra dvArA utpanna karo~ vAga-vAgicA Aru kartanayogya zasyadAnA|
Aru okha okha khejura gacha, ya’ta Ache oparA-oparikai lAgi thakA khejurara jokA,
vAndAsakalara jIৱikAra vAve| AmiYei pAnIra dvArA saJjIৱita karo~ mRta caharaka; eidarei punarutthAna ghaTiva|
siha~tara pUrveo satyaka asvIkAra karichila nUhara sampradAYe, rA’chara adhivAsI Aru chAmUda sampradAYeo,
Ada, phiraAuna Aru lUta sampradAYeo|
lagate AikAra adhivAsI Aru tuvvA sampradAYeo, siha~ta sakaloৱe asvIkAra karichila rAchulasakalaka| phalata siha~tara oparata AmAra zAsti yathArthabhAৱe Apatita haichila|
Ami prathamavAra sRSTi kariYei klAnta haicho~ neki! varaM siha~tei sandehata patita haiche natuna sRSTira viSaYe|
nizcaYa AmiYei mAnuhaka sRSTi karicho~ Aru tAra pravRttiYe tAka yi kumantraNA diYe seiToo Ami jAno; Aru Ami tAra ghArara dhamanItakaio adhika nikaTaৱrtI|
yetiYA tAra so~phAle Aru vAOMphAle vahA dujana phiristAi (tAra karmasamUha) lipivaddha kare|
si yi kathAi uccAraNa nakaraka kiYa tAra ocarata sadAYa upasthita thAke saMrakSaNakArI (lekhaka phiristA)|
Aru sa~cAkaiYe mRtyu yantraNA yathAyathabhAৱe Ahiva| eiToৱei seiTo, yiTora parA tumi palAYana kariva vicArichilA|
Aru ziGAta phu~ diYA ha’va| eiToৱe haiche pratizruta dina|
Aru seidinA pratijana vyakti upasthita ha’va, tAra lagata thAkiva ejana cAlaka Aru ejana sAkSI|
nizcaYa ei diৱsa samparke tumi udAsIna AchilA, tAra pichata AmiYe tomAra sanmukhara parA pardA unmocana karicho~| phalata Aji tomAra dRSTi ati prakhara|
Aru tAra saGgIYe (phiristAi) ka’va, ‘eYA mora ocarata AmalanAmA prastuta Ache|
Adeza karA ha’va, tomAloka ubhaYe jAhAnnAmata nikSepa karA pratyeka uddhata kAphiraka,
kalyANakara kAmata pravala vAdhA pradAnakArI, sImAlaMghanakArI Aru sandeha poSaNakArIka|
yiYe AllAhara lagata Anaka ilAharUpe grahaNa karichila, tomAloke tAka kaThina zAstita nikSepa karA|
tAra saGgI (caYatAne) ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! mai tAka vidrohI kari tolA nAchilo~| varaM si nijei Achila ghora vibhrAnta’|
AllAhe ka’va, ‘tomAloke mora sanmukhata vAka-vitaNDA nakarivA, mai tomAlokaka Agatei satarka karichilo~|
mora ocarata kathA parivartana nahaYa Aru mai vAndAsakalara prati anyAYakArIo nahaYa|
seidinA Ami jAhAnnAmaka sudhima, ‘tumi paripUrNa haichAne’? jAhAnnAme ka’va, ‘Aru kivA Achene’?
Aru jAnnAtaka muttAkvIsakalara vAve nikaTaৱrtI karA ha’va, kono dUratva nAthAkiva|
iYArei pratizruti tomAlokaka diYA haichila| pratyekajana AllAha abhimukhI, (teOMra Adeza) saMrakSaNakArIra vAve,
yisakale nedekhAkaiYe rahamAnaka bhaYa karichila Aru vinIta citte upasthita haiche|
(teOMlokaka koৱA ha’va,) ‘zAntira saite tomAloke tAta praৱeza karA; eiToৱe haiche ananta jIৱnara dina’|
tAta teOMloke yiTo kAmanA kariva seiToৱe pAva, lagate AmAra ocarata Ache Aru adhika (pratidAna, arthAt AllAha darzana)|

Aru Ami siha~tara pUrve vahuto prajanmaka dhvaMsa karicho~, yisakala zakti-sAmarthara kSetrata Achila iha~tatakaio adhika pravala, siha~te deza-videze ghUri phurichila; tathApio siha~tara kono palAYanasthala Achilane vAru?
nizcaYa iYAta upadeza Ache tAra vAve, yAra Ache antaHkaraNa athavA yiYe manoyoga sahakAre zraৱNa kare|
Aru nizcaYa Ami AkAzasamUha Aru pRthiৱI, lagate ei duYore mAjata yi Ache sei sakalovoraka sRSTi karicho~ keৱla chaYa dinata; Aru AmAka kono klAntai sparza karA nAchila|

eteke siha~te yivora (kaSTadAYaka) kathA kaYa sei viSaYe tumi dhairyya dhAraNa karA Aru tomAra pratipAlakara prazaMsAra saite paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karA suryodaYa hoৱAra Agata Aru sUryAsta yoৱAra Agata,
lagate teOMra paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karA rAtira ekAMzata Aru chAlAtara pichata|
manoyoga sahakAre zunA, yidinA ejana ghoSaNAkArIYe nikaTaৱrtI sthAnara parA AhvAna kariva,
seidinA siha~te sa~cAkaiYe zunivalai pAva vikaTa ciJara, seiToৱei haiche punarutthAnara dina|
nizcaYa AmiYei jIৱna dAna karo~ Aru AmiYei mRtyu ghaTAOM, Aru AmAra phAlei (sakalore) pratyAৱrtana|
yidinA siha~tara parA pRthiৱIkhana vidIrNa ha’va, Aru mAnuhe kharadharakai lara mAriva, enekai ekatrita karATo AmAra vAve ati sahaja|
siha~te yi kaYa seYA Ami bhAlakaiYe jAno, Aru siha~taka vAdhya karoৱATo tomAra kAma nahaYa; eteke yiYe AmAra zAstika bhaYa kare tAka tumi koraAnara sahAYata upadeza diYA|
zapata dhUli uruৱAi niYA vatAhara,
tAra pichata pAnIra vojA vahanakArI meghamAlAra,
tAra pichata mRdugatita vai yoৱA nauyAnasamUhara,
tAra pichata (AllAhara) nirdeza vanTanakArI phiristAsakalara--
tomAlokaka diYA pratizruti nizcitabhAৱe satya|
nizcaYa pratidAna diৱsa aৱzyambhAৱI|
zapata vahu pathaviziSTa AkAzara,
nizcaYa tomAloka paraspara virodhI kathAta lipta|
iYAra parA virata thAke sei vyakti, yAka virata rakhA haiche|
michalIYAsakala (tathA anumAnata kathA koৱAsakala) dhvaMsa haoka!
yisakala sandeha-saMzaYata nipatita, udAsIna|
siha~te sodhe, ‘pratidAna diৱsa ketiYA ha’va’?
‘(koৱA) yidinA siha~taka zAsti diYA ha’va agnita’|
koৱA ha’va, ‘tomAloke tomAlokara zAsti bhoga karA, iYAra vAvei tomAloke kharadhara karichilA’|
nizcaYa muttAkvIsakala thAkiva jAnnAtata Aru prasraৱNasamUhara mAjata|
teOMlokarara pratipAlake teOMlokaka yi dAna kariva seYA teOMloke (Anandacitte) grahaNa kariva; nizcaYa itipUrve teOMloka Achila satkarmazIla,
teOMloke rAtira ati kama samaYa Topanita kaTAichila,
Aru rAtira zeSa praharata teOMloke kSamA prArthanA karichila,
Aru teOMlokara dhana-sampadata Achila bhikhArI Aru vaJcitasakalara haka (prApya)|
Aru sunizcita vizvAsIsakalara vAve pRthiৱIta Ache vahuto nidarzana,
Aru tomAlokara nijara mAjato Ache (vahuto nidarzana)| tomAloke lakSya nakarA neki?
Aru AkAzata Ache tomAlokara jIৱikA Aru pratizruti diYA sakalo vastu|
eteke AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra pratipAlakara zapata! nizcaYa eiTo parama satya, yenekai tomAlokara kathA koৱATo satya|
ivrAhImara sanmAnita atithisakalara vRttAnta tomAra ocaralai Ahichene?
yetiYA teOMloke teOMra ocarata Ahi upasthita ha’la Aru ka'le, ‘chAlAma’, uttarata teৱo~ ka'le ‘chAlAma’| eOMloka dekhona acinAki vyakti|
tAra pichata teOM (ivrAhIma) saMgopane nijara gRhiNIra ocaralai ga’la Aru eTA svAsthyaৱAna go-poৱAlI (bhajA) lai upasthita ha’la,
tAra pichata teOM seiTo teOMlokara sanmukhata rAkhi ka’le, ‘AponAloke nAkhAYa neki’?
phalata teOMlokara viSaYe teOMra manata bhItira saJcAra ha’la| teOMloke ka’le, ‘bhaYa nakariva’; aৱzeSata teOMloke teOMka ejana jJAnI putra santAnara susaMvAda dile|
tetiYA teOMra strI ciJari ciJari AguৱAi Ahila Aru nijare mukhata thapariYAi ka’le, vandhyA-vRddhA (ejanIra santAna ha’va kenekai?)|
teOMloke ka’le, ‘tomAra pratipAlake eiToৱe kaiche; nizcaYa teOM prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa’|
ivrAhIme ka’le, ‘he prerita phiristAsakala! tomAlokara vizeSa kAma ki’?
teOMloke ka’le, ‘nizcaYa AmAka eTA aparAdhI sampradAYara ocaralai preraNa karA haiche---
siha~tara oparata pakA mATira TukurA nikSepa karivalai,
yiTo tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA cihnita sImAlaMghanakArIsakalara vAve|
Aru tAta yisakala mumina Achila Ami siha~taka uliYAi Anicho~|
kintu Ami tAta eTA pariYAlara vAhire Ana kono muchalima poৱA nAchilo~|
Aru yisakale yantraNAdAYaka zAstika bhaYa kare Ami siha~tara vAve tAta eTA nidarzana thai Ahicho~|
Aru mUchAra kAhinIto nidarzana Ache, yetiYA Ami teOMka suspaSTa pramANasaha phiraAunara ocaralai paThiYAichilo~,
kintu si kSamatAra ahaMkArata mukha ghUrAi laichila Aru kaichila, ‘eOM ejana (sudakSa) yAdukara naha’le unmAda’|
phalata Ami tAka Aru tAra senAvAhinIka zAsti vihichilo~ Aru siha~taka sAgarata nikSepa karichilo~, Aru si Achila tiraskArayogya|
Aru nidarzana Ache Ada sampradAYara ghaTanAto, (smaraNa karA) yetiYA Ami siha~tara viruddhe akalyANakara vatAha preraNa karichilo~;
sei vatAhajAke ekoৱe erA nAchila, yAra oparedi gaichila tAka cUrNa-vicUrNa kari gaichila|
Aru nidarzana Ache chAmUda sampradAYara ghaTanAto, yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haichila, ‘eTA nirdiSTa samaYalaike tomAloke bhoga kari loৱA’|
tathApio siha~te siha~tara pratipAlakara Adeza amAnya karile; phalata siha~ta cAi thakA aৱsthAte siha~taka vajrapAte dharile|
phalata siha~te thiYa ha’valaikeo sakSama naha’la Aru pratirodho kariva noৱArile|
Aru (dhvaMsa karichilo~) iYAra Agata nUhara sampradAYaka, nizcaYa siha~ta Achila phAchikva sampradAYa|
Aru Ami AmAra kSamatAra valata AkAza nirmANa karicho~ Aru nizcaYa Ami mahAsamprasAraNakArI|
Aru Ami bhUmikhanaka pAri dicho~, (coৱAcona, Ami) kimAna sundara vyaৱsthApanAkArI!
Aru Ami pratiTo vastu yorA yorAkai sRSTi karicho~, yAte tomAloke upadeza grahaNa karA|
eteke tomAloke AllAhara phAle dhAৱita hoৱA, nizcaYa mai keৱla teOMra taraphara parA ejana spaSTa satarkakArIhe|
Aru tomAloke AllAhara lagata Ana kono ilAha nirdhAraNa nakarivA; nizcaYa mai teOMra taraphara parA ejana spaSTa satarkakArIhe|
eidare siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalara ocaralai yetiYAi kono rAchula Ahiche, tetiYAi siha~te kaiche, ‘eOM ejana yAdukara naha’le unmAda’|
siha~te ijane sijanaka ei viSaYe achiYata kariche neki? varaM siha~ta haiche sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|
eteke tumi siha~taka upekSA karA, tomAra kono doSa naha’va|
Aru tumi upadeza di thAkA, kAraNa nizcaYa upadeza muminasakalara upakArata Ahe|
Aru mai jina Aru mAnuhaka keৱla eikAraNei sRSTi karicho~ ye, siha~te yena keৱla morei ivAdata kare|
mai siha~tara parA kono jIৱikA nivicAro~ Aru mai eiToo nivicAro~ ye, siha~te moka khuৱAva|
nizcaYa AllAhei jIৱikAdAtA, pravala zaktidhara, mahAparAkramazAlI|
eteke sImAlaMghanakArIsakalara vAve Ache siha~tara samamatAlamvIsakalara darei prApya (zAsti); gatike siha~te kharakhedA kariva nAlAge|
yisakale kupharI kariche siha~tara vAve seidinA dhvaMsa anivArya, yi diৱsaTora viSaYe siha~taka satarka karA haiche|
zapata tura parvatara,
zapata lipivaddha granthara,
unmukta pAtata|
zapata vAitula mA’mUrara (AvAda gRhara),
zapata suucca cAdara,
zapata taraGga-vikSuvdha uttAla sAgarara--
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlakara zAsti aৱzyambhAৱI,
iYAka pratirodha kariva parA kono nAi|
yidinA pravalabhAৱe AkAza prakampita ha’va,
Aru parvatasamUha drutagatita paribhramaNa kariva;
eteke sarvanAza seidinA asvIkArakArIsakalara vAve,
yisakale khela-dhemAlira chalanAre asAra karmata lipta thAke|
seidinA siha~taka jAhAnnAmara juira phAle gatiYAi khedi lai yoৱA ha’va,
‘eiToৱe haiche sei jAhAnnAma yAka tomAloke asvIkAra karichilA’|
eiTo yAdu neki? ne tomAloke dekhA nopoৱA!
tomAloke juita praৱeza karA, tAra pichata tomAloke dhairyya dhAraNa karA vA nakarA ubhaYei tomAlokara vAve samAna| tomAloke yi karichilA tArei pratiphala tomAlokaka diYA haiche|
nizcaYa muttAkvIsakala thAkiva jAnnAtata Aru prAcuryasamUhara mAjata|
teOMlokara pratipAlake teOMlokaka yi pradAna kariche seYA teOMloke upabhoga kariva, lagate teOMlokara pratipAlake teOMlokaka rakSA kariva jvalanta agnira zAstira parA,
(teOMlokaka koৱA ha'va) tomAloke yi Amala karichilA tAra pratidAna hicApe tRptira saite pAnAhAra karA;
teOMloke zreNIvaddhabhAৱe susajjita Asanata AujI vahiva; Aru Ami teOMlokara milana ghaTAma mRganaYanI DAGara cakuviziSTA hurara saite;

Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru teOMlokara santAna-santatio ImAnara kSetrata teOMlokara anugAmI haiche, Ami teOMlokara lagata teOMlokara santAna-santatika ekatrita karima, Aru teOMlokara karmaphala Ami alapo hrAsa nakarima; pratyeka vyaktiYei nijara kRtakarmara vAve dAYI|
Aru Ami teOMlokaka atirikta pradAna karima phala-mUla Aru mAMsa, yivora teOMloke kAmanA kariva|
tAta teOMloke paraspare pAnapAtra AdAna-pradAna kariva, tAta kono nirarthaka kathA-vatarA nAthAkiva Aru kono pApakarmao nAthAkiva|
Aru tAta teOMlokara seৱAta cAriophAle ghuri thAkiva kizorasakalara dala; siha~ta dekhAta yenivA surakSita mukutAhe|
Aru teOMloke ijane sijanara phAle cAi sodha-pocha kariva,
teOMloke ka’va, ‘nizcaYa Ami itipUrve AmAra pariYAla vargara mAjata zaMkita aৱsthAta Achilo~’|
tAra pichata AllAhe AmAra prati anugraha kariche Aru AmAka juira zAstira parA rakSA kariche|
nizcaYa Ami Agateo teOMkei AhvAna karichilo~; nizcaYa teOM kRpAmaYa, parama daYAlu|
eteke tumi upadeza di thAkA, kAraNa tomAra pratipAlakara anugrahata tumi gaNako nahaYa Aru unmAdo nahaYa|
siha~te kaYa neki ye, eOM (muhAmmada) haiche ejana kavi? Ami tAra mRtyura pratIkSA karicho~|
koৱA, ‘tomAloke apekSA karA, nizcaYa maYo tomAlokara lagata apekSA kari Acho~’|
siha~tara viveka-vuddhiYe siha~taka ei Adeza diYe neki? ne siha~ta sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa?
ne siha~te kaYa ye, ‘eikhana teOM nijei racanA kariche’? varaM siha~te ImAna poSaNa nakariva|
eteke siha~ta yadi satyavAdI haYa, tetiYAha’le siha~te iYAra dare kono vANI lai Ahakacona!
siha~te sraSTAvihIna sRSTi haiche neki, ne siha~ta nijei sraSTA?
athavA siha~te AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIka sRSTi kariche neki? varaM siha~te dRDha় vizvAsa nakare|
ne siha~tara ocarata tomAra pratipAlakara gopana kono bhANDAra Ache? ne siha~tei sakalo vastura niYantraNakArI?
ne siha~tara ocarata jakhalA Ache, ya’ta ArohaNa kari siha~te (urddhajagatara kathA) zunivalai pAYa? tente siha~te zunA poৱA sei spaSTa pramANaTo lai Ahakacona!
ne kanyA santAna teOMra vAve; Aru putra santAna tomAlokara vAve?
(he navI!) tumi siha~tara ocarata pArizramika (vinimaYa) dAvI karichA neki, yAra phalata siha~te RNara vojAta bhArAkrAnta hai pariche?
ne siha~tara ocarata gAYevara kono jJAna Ache? yiTo siha~te likhi rAkhe!
ne siha~te kono SaDa়yantra kariva vicAriche? (jAni thoৱA) yisakale kupharI kare siha~tei ha’va SaDa়yantrara cikAra|
ne AllAhara vAhire siha~tara kono ilAha Ache? (jAni thoৱA) siha~te yi zvirka kare tAra parA AllAha paৱitra|
Aru AkAzara kono TukurA bhAgi parA dekhileo siha~te ka’va, ‘eiTo eTA puJjibhUta megha’|
eteke siha~taka eri diYA sei diৱsalaike, yidinA siha~ta vajrAghAtara phalata acetana hai pariva|
seidinA siha~tara SaDa়yantra kono kAmata nAhiva Aru siha~taka sahAYao karA naha’va|
nizcaYa iYAra vAhireo Aru zAsti Ache sImAlaMghanakArIsakalara vAve| kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai ei kathA nAjAne|

Aru tumi tomAra pratipAlakara siddhAntara apekSata dhairyya dhAraNa karA; kAraNa tumi AmAra cukura sanmukhate AchA| tumi tomAra pratipAlakara prazaMsAra saite paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA karA yetiYA tumi (chAlAtara vAve) thiYa hoৱA|
Aru teOMra paৱitratA ghoSaNA karA nizAra bhAgata Aru tarAvora astamita hoৱAra pichata|
zapata nakSatrara, yetiYA i astamita haYa,
tomAlokara saGgI vibhrAnta hoৱA nAi, Aru vipathagAmIo hoৱA nAi,
Aru teOM mane sajA kathA nakaYa|
eYA haiche keৱla ahI, yiTo teOMra prati ahIrUpe preraNa karA haYa,
teOMka zikSA dAna kare, pravala zaktidhara (phiristA jivrIle),
saundaryapUrNa sattvA| tAra pichata teOM sthira haichila,
Aru teOM Achila Urddhadigantata,
tAra pichata teOM (rAchulara) nikaTaৱrtI ha’la, ati nikaTaৱrtI,
phalata ubhaYara mAjata dukhana dhenura duratva ra’la, athavA tAtokai kama|
tetiYA AllAhe teOMra vAndAra prati yi ahI karivalagIYA Achila seYA ahI karile|
teOM yi dekhiche, teOMra antare seivoraka asvIkAra karA nAi;
teOM yi dekhiche, sei samparke tomAloke teOMra lagata vitarka karivA neki?
Aru nizcaYa teOMka teOM Aru evAra dekhichila|
chidarAtula munatAhAra ocarata,
yAra ocarata jAnnAtula mA’oৱA aৱsthita|
yetiYA chidarAi yi AcchAdita karAra seYA AcchAdita karichila,
teOMra dRSTi vibhrama hoৱA nAi, Aru sImAo atikrama karA nAi|
nizcaYa teOM nija pratipAlakara kichumAna mahAna nidarzanAৱlI dekhichila;
eteke tomAloke lAta Aru ujjhA samparke ki koৱA?
Aru tRtIYa Ana eTA mAnAta samparke?
eiTo kene dharaNara kathA, tomAlokara vAve putra santAna Aru AllAhara vAve kanyA santAna?
teneha’le eYA dekhona eTA asaGgata vaNTana|

mAnuhe yi vicAre seiToৱe si pAYane?

nizcaYa yisakale AkhirAtaka vizvAsa nakare, siha~tei phiristAsakalaka nArIvAcaka nAmere nAmakaraNa kare;
athaca ei viSaYe siha~tara kono jJAnei nAi| siha~ta keৱla anumAnarahe anusaraNa kare; Aru nizcaYa satyara mukAvilAta anumAnara kono mUlya nAi|
eteke tumi sei vyaktika upekSA karA, yiYe AmAra smaraNara parA vimukha haYa Aru akala pRthiৱIra jIৱnakei kAmanA kare|

AkAzamaNDalata yi Ache Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sei sakalo AllAharei| yAte teOM seisakala lokaka veYA pratiphala diva pAre yisakale veYA karma kare, Aru yAte seisakala lokaka uttama puraskAra diva pAre yisakale satkarma kare,

yisakale saru-surA doSa-truTira vAhire DAGara DAGara pApakarma Aru azlIla kAryakalApara parA virata thAke| nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlakara kSamA aparisIma; teOM tomAlokara viSaYe samyaka aৱgata—(smaraNa karA) yetiYA teOM tomAlokaka mATira parA sRSTi karichila Aru yetiYA tomAloka mAtRgarbhata bhruNarUpe AchilA| eteke tomAloke AtmaprazaMsA nakarivA, kone tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariche sei viSaYe teৱe~i samyaka aৱgata|

tAra ocarata kivA gAYevara jJAna Ache neki, yiTo si pratyakSa kare?

Aru ivrAhImara chahIphAta, yijane pUrNa karichila (teOMra aGgIkAra)?

Aru tAra praceSTAra phala atizIghrei dekhuৱA ha’va---

Aru nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlakara ocaratei haiche zeSa gantavya,
Aru nizcaYa teৱe~i ha~huৱAYa Aru teৱe~i kanduৱAYa,
Aru nizcaYa teৱe~i mRtyu pradAna kare Aru teৱe~i jIৱna dAna diYe,
Aru nizcaYa teৱe~i sRSTi kariche yora-yorakai puruSa Aru nArI,

Aru chAmUda jAtiko (dhvaMsa kariche)| siha~tara ejanako aৱziSTa rakhA nAi|
Aru iYAra pUrve nUhara sampradAYako (teৱe~i dhvaMsa kariche)| nizcaYa siha~ta Achila atizaYa yAlima Aru carama avAdhya|
Aru teৱe~i oloTAi diYA AvAsabhUmika nikSepa karichila,
tAra pichata seiToka Acchanna karichila yi Acchanna karivalagIYA Achila|
eteke tumi tomAra pratipAlakara konaTo anugrahaka sandeha karivA?
atItara satarkakArIsakalara darei, ei navIo ejana satarkakArI|
kiYAmata nikaTaৱrtI|
AllAhara vAhire koneo iYAka prakAza karivalai sakSama nahaYa|
tomAloke ei kathAta vismaYavodha karichA neki?
Aru hA~hi-ThATTA kari AchA! kandA nAi?
tomAloka haichA udAsIna,
eteke tomAloke AllAhaka chAjadA karA Aru teOMrei ivAdata karA|
kiYAmata nikaTaৱrtI haiche Aru candra vidIrNa haiche,
Aru siha~te kono nidarzana dekhile mukha ghUrAi laYa Aru kaYa, ‘eYAto cirAcarita yAduhe’|
Aru siha~te asvIkAra kare Aru nija nija pravRttira anusaraNa kare, athaca pratiTo viSaYei zeSa lakSyata upanIta ha’va|
Aru nizcaYa siha~tara ocaralai Ahi pAiche saMvAdasamUha, ya’ta Ache satarkavANI,
eikhana haiche paripUrNa jJAnagarbha vANI, kintu ei satarkavANI siha~tara kono kAmata ahA nAi|
eteke tumi siha~taka upekSA karA| (smaraNa karA) yidinA AhvAnakArIYe AhvAna kariva eTA bhaYAৱha pariNAmara phAle,
seidinA siha~te apamAnita aৱnamita naYanere kavarara parA olAi Ahiva, ene lAgiva yenivA siha~ta vikSipta phariMhe,
siha~te AhvAnakArIra phAle bhIta-vihvala hai guci Ahiva| kAphirasakale ka’va, ‘eiTo eTA vara kaThina dina’|
iha~tara pUrve nUhara sampradAYeo michA vuli bhAvichila-- eteke siha~te AmAra vAndAka asvIkAra karichila Aru kaichila, ‘eOM haiche ejana unmAda’, Aru teOMka bhAvukio diYA haichila|
tetiYA teOM nija pratipAlakaka AhvAna kari kaichila, ‘nizcaYa mai asahAYa, eteke tumiYei iYAra pratizodha grahaNa karA’|
phalata Ami dhArAsAra varaSuNasaha AkAzara duৱArasamUha khuli dilo~,
Aru mATira parA jharNAsamUha utsArita karilo~; phalata eTA parikalpanA anusAre goTei pAnI milita ha’la|
Aru Ami teOMka (nUhaka) kATha Aru perekara dvArA nirmita nauyAnata ArohaNa karAlo~|
yiTo AmAra cakura sanmukhata calichila, eiTo puraskAra tAra vAve yAka pratyAkhyAna karA haichila|
Aru nizcaYa Ami iYAka nidarzanarUpe rAkhi dicho~; eteke Achene konovA upadeza grahaNakArI?
eteke kenekuৱA Achila mora zAsti Aru bhItipradarzana?
Aru nizcaYa Ami koraAnaka sahaja kari dicho~ upadeza grahaNa karAra vAve; eteke konovA Achene upadeza grahaNakArI?
Ada sampradAYeo asvIkAra karichila, eteke mora zAsti Aru bhItipradarzana kenekuৱA Achila?
nizcaYa Ami siha~tara oparata paThiYAichilo~ pracaNDa zItala dhumuhA, niraৱcchinna amaGgala dinata,
sei dhumuhAi mAnuhaka enekai utkhAta karichila, yenivA siha~ta ughAli parA khejura gachara kANDahe|
eteke kenekuৱA Achila mora zAsti Aru bhItipradarzana?
Aru nizcaYa Ami koraAnaka sahaja kari dicho~ upadeza grahaNa karAra vAve; eteke konovA Achene upadeza grahaNakArI?
chAmUda sampradAYeo satarkakArIsakalaka asvIkAra karichila|
