AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra sakalo kartRtva teOMrei Aru AllAhara phAlei sakalo viSaYa pratyAvartita haYa|
teৱe~i rAtika dinara bhitarata praৱeza karAYa Aru dinaka rAtira bhitarata praৱeza karAYa; Aru teৱe~i antarara viSaYasamUha samparke samyaka aৱgata|

tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna poSaNa karA Aru AllAhe tomAlokaka yi sampadara uttarAdhikArI kariche tAra parA vyaYa karA| eteke tomAlokara mAjata yisakale ImAna poSaNa kare Aru (AllAhara pathata) vyaYa kare teOMlokara vAve Ache mahApuraskAra|

Aru tomAlokara ki ha’la, tomAloke AllAhara prati vizvAsa nakarA kiYa? athaca rAchule tomAlokaka tomAlokara pratipAlakara prati ImAna Anivalai AhvAna kariche, Aru AllAheo tomAlokara parA aGgIkAra grahaNa kariche, yadi tomAloke mumina hoৱA|
teৱe~i nija vAndAra prati suspaSTa AYAtasamUha aৱtIrNa kare, tomAlokaka andhakArara parA poharalai AnAra vAve; Aru nizcaYa AllAha tomAlokara prati karuNAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

Aru tomAlokara ki ha’la, tomAloke AllAhara pathata kharaca nakarA kiYa? athaca AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra mIrAcha keৱla AllAharei| tomAlokara mAjata yisakale (makkA) vijaYara Agata dAna kariche Aru yuddha kariche, teOMloka (Aru paravartIsakala) samAna nahaYa| teOMloka seisakala lokatakai maryAdAta zreSTha yisakale paravartI samaYata vyaYa kariche Aru yuddha kariche| kintu AllAhe ubhaYara vAvei kalyANara pratizruti diche; Aru tomAloke yi Amala karA sei samparke AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|
enekuৱA kona Ache, yiYe AllAhaka uttama RNa diva? phalata teOM tAra vAve iYAka vahuguNe vRddhi kari diva Aru tAra vAve Ache sanmAnajanaka puraskAra|

seidinA tumi mumina nara-nArIsakalaka dekhivalai pAvA ye, teOMlokara sanmukhata Aru so~phAle teOMlokara nUra dauri Ache| (koৱA ha’va) ‘Aji tomAlokara vAve susaMvAda haiche jAnnAta, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita, tAta tomAloka cirasthAYI ha’vA, eiToৱei haiche mahAsaphalatA’|

seidinA munAphika puruSa Aru munAphikA nArIsakale ImAndArasakalaka ka’va, ‘tomAloke AmAra vAve alapa apekSA karA, yAte tomAlokara nUrara parA Ami alapa grahaNa kariva pAro~’| koৱA ha’va, ‘tomAloke nijara pichaphAle ubhati yoৱA Aru nUrara sandhAna karAgai’| tAra pichata ubhaYara mAjata sthApana ha’va eTA prAcIra, ya’ta eTA duৱAra thAkiva, yAra bhitara bhAgata thAkiva rahamata Aru vAhirata thAkiva zAsti|

munAphikasakale muminasakalaka mAti ka’va, ‘Ami tomAlokara lagata nAchilo~ne? teOMloke ka’va, ‘haYa, kintu tomAloke nijei nijaka vipadagrasta karichA Aru tomAloke pratIkSA karichilA Aru sandeha karichilA Aru michA AkAMkSAi tomAlokaka pratArita kari rAkhichila, Aru aৱzeSata AllAhara nirdeza Ahi ga’la, Aru (antima samaYalaike) mahApratArake tomAlokaka AllAha samparke pratArita karichila’|

‘eteke Aji tomAlokara parA kono muktipaNa grahaNa karA naha’va Aru yisakale kupharI karichila siha~tara parAo nahaYa| jAhAnnAmei haiche tomAlokara AvAsasthala, eiToৱei tomAlokara upayukta sthAna; Aru kimAna ye nikRSTa ei pratyAvartanasthala!

AllAhara smaraNata Aru yi satya aৱtIrNa haiche tAra phalasvarUpe muminasakalara antara etiYAo komala (vinIta) hoৱAra samaYa hoৱA nAine? Aru teOMloke yena siha~tara dare nahaYa, yisakalaka iYAra Agata kitAva diYA haichila-- tAra pichata vahu kAla ativAhita hoৱAra pichata siha~tara antarasamUha kaThora hai parichila; Aru siha~tara adhikAMzai Achila phAchikva|
jAni thoৱA ye, AllAhei bhUmika tAra mRtyura pichata punarjIৱita kare| Ami nidarzanasamUha tomAlokara vAve suspaSTabhAৱe varNanA karicho~ yAte tomAloke vujiva pArA|

nizcaYa dAnazIla puruSa Aru dAnazIlA nArI Aru yisakale AllAhaka uttama RNa diYe, teOMlokaka (iYAra vinimaYata) vahu guNa vRddhi kari (pratidAna) diYA ha’va Aru teOMlokara vAve Ache sanmAnajanaka puraskAra|

Aru yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna Aniche, teOMlokei nija pratipAlakara ocarata chiddIkva Aru zvahIda (vuli vivecita)| teOMlokara vAve Ache teOMlokara prApya puraskAra Aru nUra; AnahAte yisakale kupharI kariche Aru AmAra nidarzanasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche, siha~tei haiche jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI|

jAni thoৱA ye, nizcaYa pRthiৱIra jIৱna khela-dhemAli, krIDa়A-kautuka, saundarya, Aru tomAlokara pAraspArika gauraৱ-ahaMkAra, dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santatita prAcurya lAbhara pratiyogitAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa| iYAra udAharaNa haiche varaSuNara dare, yAra dvArA utpanna zasya-sambhAre kRSakasakalaka Anandita kare, tAra pichata (yetiYA) seivora zukAi yAYa, tetiYA tumi seivoraka hAladhIYA varaNata dekhivalai poৱA, aৱzeSata seivora khera-kuTAta pariNata haYa; Aru AkhirAtata Ache kaThina zAsti Aru AllAhara mAgaphirAta tathA santuSTi; Aru pRthiৱIra jIৱna pratAraNAra vAhire Ana eko nahaYa|

tomAloke nija pratipAlakara kSamA Aru sei jAnnAta lAbhara praYAsata pratiyogitAta aৱtIrNa hoৱA, yAra prazastatA AkAza Aru pRthiৱIra prazastatAra dare, yiTo prastuta karA haiche seisakala lokara vAve yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna Aniche| eiTo AllAhara anugraha, teOM yAka icchA kare tAkei eiTo pradAna kare; Aru AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

pRthiৱIta Aru vyaktigatabhAৱe tomAlokara oparata Apatita hoৱA ene kono viparyaYa nAi yiTo saMghaTita hoৱAra Agate Ami tAka ekhana kitAvata lipivaddha kari rakhA nAi| nizcaYa AllAhara pakSe eYA ati sahaja|

eiTo eikAraNe ye, yAte tomAloke yi herAichA tAra prati paritApa nakarA Aru teOM tomAlokaka yi pradAna kariche tAra vAve utphullita nohoৱA| kAraNa AllAhe gauraৱkArI tathA ahaMkArI vyaktika pachanda nakare|
yisakale kRpaNatA kare Aru mAnuhaka kRpaNatAra nirdeza diYe, Aru yiYe mukha ghUrAi laYa (si jAni loৱA ucita) nizcaYa AllAha abhAৱmukta, cira prazaMsita|

nizcaYa Ami AmAra rAchulasakalaka suspaSTa pramANa sahakAre preraNa karicho~, Aru teOMlokara lagata dicho~ kitAva Aru nyAYara mAnadaNDa, yAte mAnuhe suvicAra pratiSThA kariva pAre| Ami Aru aৱtIrNa karicho~ lohA, ya’ta Ache pracaNDa zakti Aru mAnuhara vAve Ache vahuvidha kalyANa| eYA eikAraNe ye, yAte AllAhe prakAza kari diYe ye, kone gAYeva aৱsthAta teOMka Aru teOMra rAchulaka sahAYa kare| nizcaYa AllAha mahAzaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

Aru nizcaYa Ami nUha Aru ivrAhImaka rAchularUpe preraNa karichilo~ Aru Ami teOMlokara vaMzadharasakalara vAve sthira karichilo~ navuoৱAta Aru kitAva| kintu siha~tara kichumAnehe satpatha aৱlamvana karichila Aru siha~tara adhikAMzai Achila phAchikva|

iYAra pichata Ami teOMlokara anugAmI hicApe AmAra rAchulasakalaka preraNa karichilo~ Aru mAraYAma putra IchAko anugAmI karichilo~, Aru teOMka Ami dichilo~ iJjila Aru teOMra anusArIsakalara antarata dichilo~ karuNA Aru daYA; Aru vairAgyavAda—eiTo siha~te nijei AllAhara santuSTira vAve praৱrtana karichila| Ami eiTo siha~tara oparata lipivaddha karA nAchilo~; athaca eiToo siha~te yathAyathabhAৱe pAlana karA nAi| kintu siha~tara mAjata yisakale ImAna Anichila, siha~taka Ami siha~tara puraskAra pradAna karichilo~; kintu siha~tara adhikAMzai Achila phAchikva|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna poSaNa karA| teOM nija anugrahata tomAlokaka dviguNa puraskAra pradAna kariva Aru teOM tomAlokaka pradAna kariva nUra, yAra sahAYata tomAloke caliva pArivA Aru teOM tomAlokaka kSamA kariva; Aru AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

eYA eivAvei ye, yAte Ahale kitAvasakale jAniva pAre ye, AllAhara sAmAnyatama anugrahato siha~tara kono adhikAra nAi; Aru nizcaYa anugraha AllAharei hAtata, teOM yAka icchA kare tAkahe pradAna kare, Aru AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

(he rAchula!) AllAhe nizcaYa zuniche sei nArIra kathA; yiYe tAira svAmIra viSaYe tomAra lagata vAdAnuvAda kari Achila Aru AllAhara ocarata abhiyoga kari Achila| AllAhe tomAloka duYore kathopakathana zuniche; nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

tomAlokara mAjara yisakale nijara strIsakalara lagata yihAra kare, (siha~te jAni thoৱA ucita ye) siha~tara strIsakala siha~tara mAka hai nAyAYa, varaM siha~tara mAtR haiche keৱla seisakala tirotA, yisakale siha~taka janma diche; Aru nizcaYa siha~te asaMgata Aru michA bhittihIna kathA kaiche; nizcaYa AllAha adhika pApa mocanakArI Aru vara kSamAzIla|

Aru yisakale siha~tara strIsakalara lagata yihAra kare, Aru pichata nijara ukti pratyAhAra kare, tente (iYAra kAphaphArA haiche) ijane sijanaka sparza karAra Agate ejana dAsa mukta karA, iYAra dvArA tomAlokaka upadeza diYA haiche; Aru tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱhita|

kintu yiYe eiTo kariva noৱAriva, tente (tAra prAYazcita haiche) ijane sijanaka sparza karAra Agate si ekerAhe dumAha chiYAma (rojA) pAlana kariva lAgiva; Aru yiYe eiToo karivalai sakSama nahaYa, si SAThijana michakInaka AhAra karAva lAgiva; ei vidhAna eikAraNe ye, yAte tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna poSaNa karA| eivora haiche AllAhara nirdhArita vidhAna; Aru asvIkArakArIsakalara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

nizcaYa yivilAka mAnuhe AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara viruddhAcAraNa kare, siha~taka apadasta karA ha’va yenekai apadasta karA haichila siha~tara pUrvaৱrtIsakalaka; Aru Ami suspaSTa AYAta aৱtIrNa karicho; Aru kAphirasakalara vAve Ache lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti--

yidinA AllAhe siha~ta sakaloke punarujjIৱita kari uThAva, tAra pichata siha~te yi Amala karichila seYA teOM siha~taka janAi diva; AllAhe seivora hicApa kari rAkhiche yadio siha~te pAhari gaiche; Aru AllAha pratiTo vastura pratyakSadarzI|

tumi lakSya karA nAine ye, AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakalo AllAhe jAne? tinijana vyaktira mAjata enekuৱA kono gopana parAmarza nahaYa ya’ta caturthajana hicApe teOM nAthAke, Aru pA~cajanara mAjato nahaYa ya’ta SaSThajana hicApe teOM nAthAke| siha~ta iYAtakai kama haoka vA vechi, teOM siha~tara lagate Ache siha~ta ya’tei nAthAkaka kiYa| tAra pichata kviYAmatara dinA teOM siha~taka siha~tara kRtakarma samparke janAi diva| nizcaYa AllAha sakalo vastu samparke samyaka aৱgata|

tumi siha~taka lakSya karA nAine, yisakalaka gopana parAmarza karivalai niSedha karA haichila? tAra pichato siha~te seiToke punarAvRtti karile yiTo karivalai siha~taka niSedha karA haichila; Aru siha~te duSkArya, sImAlaMghana Aru rAchulara viruddhAcAraNara vAve gopana parAmarza kare| siha~te yetiYA tomAra ocaralai Ahe tetiYA siha~te tomAka ene kathAra dvArA abhivAdana janAYa yiTora dvArA AllAhe tomAka abhivAdana janoৱA nAi| siha~te mane mane kaYa, ‘Ami yi kaOM tAra vAve AllAhe AmAka kiYa zAsti nidiYe’? jAhAnnAmei siha~tara vAve yatheSTa, ya’ta siha~te praৱeza kariva, Aru kimAna ye nikRSTa sei gantavyasthala!

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke yetiYA gopane parAmarza karivA tetiYA yAte tomAloke gunAha, sImAlaMghana Aru rAchulara viruddhAcAraNa samparke gopana parAmarza nakarA| varaM tomAloke satkarma Aru tAkvaৱA aৱlamvanara viSaYe gopana parAmarza karivA, lagate AllAhaka bhaYa karA, yAra ocarata tomAlokaka samaveta karA ha’va|

gopana parAmarza keৱla caYatAnara prarocanAtahe haYa, yAte muminasakale kaSTa pAYa| kintu AllAhara anumati avihane caYatAne teOMlokara sAmAnyatama kSati sAdhana karivalaio sakSama nahaYa| eteke muminasakale keৱla AllAhara oparatei bharasA karA ucita|

he muminasakala! tomAlokaka yetiYA koৱA haYa ‘vaiThakata sthAna prazasta kari diYA’ tetiYA tomAloke sthAna prazasta kari divA, AllAheo tomAlokaka prazastatA dAna kariva; Aru yetiYA tomAlokaka koৱA haYa, ‘uThA’ tetiYA uThi yAvA| tomAlokara bhitarata yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru yisakalaka jJAna dAna karA haiche, AllAhe teOMlokaka ucca maryAdA pradAna kariva; Aru tomAloke yi karA sei samparke AllAha savizeSa aৱhita|

he muminasakala! tomAloke yetiYA rAchulara saite akalazarIYAkai kathA ka’va vicarA, tetiYA tomAloke ene kathA koৱAra Agate cAdAkvA pradAna karivA, eiToৱe tomAlokara vAve zreYa Aru parizodhaka; kintu yadi tomAloke sakSama nohoৱA tente nizcaYa AllAha parama kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

akalazarIYAkai parAmarza karAra Agate cAdAkvA diva lAgiva vuli tomAloke bhaYa pAlA neki? yihetu tomAloke eiTo kariva noৱArilA, Aru AllAheo tomAlokaka kSamA kari dile, tente tomAloke chAlAta kAYema karA Aru yAkAta pradAna karA, lagate AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara Anugatya karA| tomAloke yi karA, sei samparke AllAha samyaka aৱgata|

tumi siha~tara prati lakSya karA nAine, yisakale enekuৱA sampradAYara lagata vandhutva kare yisakalara oparata AllAha krodhAnvita haiche? siha~ta (arthAt munAphikasakala) tomAlokaro dalabhukta nahaYa Aru siha~taro dalabhukta nahaYa; Aru siha~te jAni vuji michA zapata khAYa|
AllAhe siha~tara vAve prastuta kari rAkhiche kaThora zAsti| nizcaYa siha~te yi kare seYA kimAna ye garhita!
siha~te nijara zapatavoraka DhAla hicApe grahaNa kariche, tAra pichata siha~te AllAhara pathata vAdhA pradAna kariche| phalata siha~tara vAve Ache lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
AllAhara zAstira viparIte siha~tara dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati siha~tara kono kAmata nAhiva; siha~tei haiche jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI, tAta siha~te cirakAla thAkiva|

yidinA AllAhe siha~ta sakaloke punarutthita kariva, seidinA siha~te AllAhara ocarata enekuৱA zapata kariva yenekuৱA zapata siha~te tomAlokara ocarata kare, Aru siha~te dhAraNA kariva ye, siha~ta bhAla kivA eTAra oparata pratiSThita Ache| sAৱdhAna! nizcaYa siha~tei haiche prakRta michalIYA|
caYatAne siha~tara oparata prabhAৱ vistAra kariche; Aru siha~taka AllAhara smaraNa pAharAi diche| iha~tei haiche caYatAnara dala| nizcaYa caYatAnara dalei haiche kSatigrasta|
nizcaYa yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara viruddhAcAraNa kare, siha~tei ha’va carama lAJchitasakalara antarbhukta|
AllAhe likhi rAkhiche ye, ‘mai Aru mora rAchulasakalei nizcitabhAৱe vijaYI ha’ma’| nizcaYa AllAha mahAzaktimAna, mahAparAkramazAlI|

AllAha Aru AkhirAtara prati vizvAsa sthApana karA ene kono sampradAYa tumi vicAri nApAvA, yisakale AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulaka viruddhAcAraNa karA lokaka bhAla pAYa--- yadio siha~ta teOMlokara pitA vA putra athavA bhAi nAivA vaMza-pariYAlara mAnuhei nahaoka kiYa! eOMlokara antaratei AllAhe ImAna likhi diche Aru teOMra taraphara parA rUhara dvArA teOMlokaka zaktizAlI kariche| teOMlokaka teOM praৱeza karAva enekuৱA jAnnAtasamUhata yAra taledi nijarAsamUha pravAhita haYa| tAta teOMloke cirakAla thAkiva; AllAhe teOMlokara prati santuSTa haiche Aru teOMlokeo teOMra prati santuSTa| teOMlokei haiche AllAhara dala| jAni thoৱA, AllAhara dalei saphalatA lAbha kariva|
AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakalovorei AllAhara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare; Aru teOM parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa|

Ahale kitAvasakalara mAjara yisakale kuphurI karichila teৱe~i siha~taka prathama samAvezara vAve siha~tara AvAsabhUmira parA vitArita karichila| tomAloke kalpanAo karA nAchilA ye siha~ta nirvAsita ha’va; Aru siha~teo bhAvichila ye, siha~tara durgasamUhe siha~taka AllAhara (zAstira) parA rakSA kariva; kintu siha~tara ocaralai AllAhara AyAva enekuৱA ThAira parA Ahila yiTo siha~te kalpanAo kariva parA nAchila; Aru siha~tara antarata AtaMka saJcAra karile| phalata siha~te nija hAtere Aru muminasakalara hatoৱAi nijara ghara-duৱAra dhvaMsa karile; eteke he dRSTisampanna vyaktisakala! tomAloke upadeza grahaNa karA|

Aru yadi AllAhe siha~tara vAve nirvAsanadaNDa lipivaddha nakarilehe~tena, tente teOM nizcaYa siha~taka pRthiৱItei (velega kono) zAsti vihilehe~tena; Aru AkhirAtata siha~tara vAve Ache jAhAnnAmara zAsti|

eiTo eikAraNe ye, nizcaYa siha~te AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara viruddhAcAraNa karichila; Aru yiYe AllAhara viruddhAcAraNa kariva, tente (si jAni thoৱA ucita) nizcaYa AllAha zAsti pradAnata ati kaThora|
tomAloke yivora khejura gacha kATichA Aru yivoraka kANDara oparata sthita aৱsthAta rAkhi dichA, seYA Achila keৱla AllAhara anumatikramei; yAte teOM phAchikasakalaka lAJchita kariva pAre|

Aru AllAhe siha~tara (iYAhudIsakalara) parA teOMra rAchulaka yi ‘phAYa’ (yuddha nakarAkai lAbha karA dhana-sampada) arpana kariche, tAra vAve tomAloke gho~rA athavA uTata ArohaNa kari kono abhiyAna karA nAchilA; varaM AllAhe teOMra rAchulasakalaka yAra oparata icchA kare kartRtva pradAna kare; Aru AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|

AllAhe ei janapadara adhivAsIsakalara parA teOMra rAchulaka ‘phAYa’ hicApe yi sampada pradAna kariche, seYA haiche AllAhara vAve Aru rAchulara vAve Aru AtmIYa-svajanara vAve, iYAtImasakala Aru michakInasakalara vAve lagate muchAphirasakalara vAve, yAte dhana-sampada keৱla tomAlokara mAjara vittazIla lokara mAjatei Aৱrtana kari nAthAke| rAchule tomAlokaka yi diYe seYA tomAloke grahaNa karA, Aru yiTora parA teOM tomAlokaka niSedha kare tAra parA virata thAkA, lagate tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA; nizcaYa AllAha zAsti pradAnata ati kaThora|

ei sampada seisakala daridra muhAjIrara vAve yisakalaka nijara ghara-vArI Aru sA-sampattira parA vitArita karA haiche| teOMloke AllAhara anugraha Aru santuSTi anveSaNa kare, lagate AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulaka sahAYa kare| eOMlokei haiche satyavAdI|

Aru teOMlokara vAveo, yisakale muhAjirasakalara Agamanara Agara parAi ei nagarIta vasavAsa kari Ache Aru ImAna Aniche, teOMloke teOMlokara ocaralai hijarata kari ahA mAnuhavilAkaka bhAlapAYa Aru muhAjirasakalaka yi diYA haiche tAra vAve teOMloke nija antarata kono hiMsA poSaNa nakare, Aru teOMloke abhAৱ thakA sattveo nijara oparata teOMlokaka agrAdhikAra diYe| prakRtate yisakalaka antarara kRpaNatAra parA rakSA karA haiche, teOMlokei haiche sAphalyamaNDita|

Aru yisakala teOMlokara pichata Ahiche teOMloke kaYa, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAka Aru AmAra pUrve ImAna poSaNa karA AmAra bhAtRsakalaka kSamA kari diYA; Aru yisakale ImAna Aniche teOMlokara viruddhe AmAra antarata kono vidveSa nArAkhivA| he AmAra pratipAlaka! nizcaYa tumi snehazIla, parama daYAlu’|

tumi munAphikasakalara prati lakSya karA nAine? siha~te Ahale kitAvasakalara mAjara parA yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~tara seisakala bhAtRka kaYa, ‘tomAloke yadi vahiSkRta hoৱA, tente Amio tomAlokara lagata nizcaYa deza tyAga karima Aru Ami tomAlokara viSaYe ketiYAo kAro Anugatya nakaro~ Aru tomAlokara lagata yuddha ha’le nizcaYa Ami tomAlokaka sahAYa karima’| kintu AllAhe sAkSya diYe ye, nizcaYa siha~ta haiche ghora michalIYA|

prakRtate yadi siha~ta (iYAhudIsakala) vahiSkRta haYa tente iha~te (munAphikasakale) ketiYAo siha~tara saite deza tyAga nakariva Aru siha~tara lagata yuddha karA ha’le, iha~te ketiYAo siha~taka sahAYa nakariva Aru yadi siha~taka kono sahAYa karivalai Aheo tente nizcaYa pRSThapradarzana (kari palAYana) kariva; tAra pichata siha~te kono sahAYei nApAva|
prakRtapakSe siha~tara antarata AllAhatakai tomAlokara bhaYahe vechi| kAraNa siha~ta haiche eTA jJAnavodha nathakA sampradAYa|

siha~ta sanmilitabhAৱe tomAlokara lagata yuddha kariva noৱAriva, yuddha karileo surakSita janavasatira mAjata aৱsthAna kari athavA durga-prAcIrara A~ra laihe kariva; siha~ta pAraspArika virodhitAta pracaNDabhAৱe lipta| tumi siha~taka aikyavaddha vuli bhAvA; kintu siha~tara antarasamUhata kono mila nAi; kAraNa, siha~ta haiche eTA nirvodha sampradAYa|
iha~ta seisakala lokara darei, yisakale iha~tara kichukAla pUrvei nijara kRtakarmara zAsti bhoga kariche, Aru siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

iha~ta haiche caYatAnara dare, yiYe mAnuhaka kaYa, ‘kuphurI karA’; tAra pichata yetiYA si kuphurI kare tetiYA si kaYa, ‘tomAra lagata mora kono samparka nAi, nizcaYa mai vizvajagatara pratipAlaka AllAhaka bhaYa karo~’|
phalata siha~ta ubhaYare pariNAma ha’va jAhAnnAma; tAta siha~ta cirasthAYI ha’va Aru eiToৱe haiche yAlimasakalara pratidAna|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA; Aru pratyekare cintA karA ucita ye, ahAkAlira vAve si ki preraNa kariche; lagate tomAloke AllAhaka bhaYa karA; tomAloke yi karA sei samparke nizcaYa AllAha savizeSa aৱhita|
tomAloke siha~tara dare naha’vA yisakale AllAhaka pAhari gaiche; phalata AllAheo siha~taka AtmavismRta kariche, iha~tei haiche phAchikva|
jAhAnnAmara adhivAsIsakala Aru jAnnAtara adhivAsIsakala ketiYAo samAna nahaYa| prakRta saphalatAra adhikArI keৱla jAnnAtara adhivAsIsakalahe|

yadi Ami ei koraAnakhanaka kono parvatara oparata aৱtIrNa karilo~he~tena tente tumi iYAka AllAhara bhaYata vinIta vidIrNa aৱsthAta dekhilAhe~tena, Aru Ami eivora udAharaNa varNanA karo~ mAnuhara vAve yAte siha~te cintA-gaৱeSaNA kare|
teৱe~i AllAha, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, teOM adRzya Aru prakAzya viSaYa samparke parijJAta; teOM parama karuNAmaYa parama daYAlu|

teৱe~i AllAha, teOMra vAhire Ana kono satya ilAha nAi, teৱe~i adhipati, mahApaৱitra, zAntira utsa truTimukta, nirApattAdAnakArI, rakSaka, mahAparAkramazAlI, mahApratApazAlI, ati mahimAnvita| siha~te yi aMzIsthApana kare tAra parA AllAha paৱitra, mahAna|

AllAhei haiche sRSTikartA, udbhAৱnakartA, AkAra-AkRtidAnakArI, sarvottama nAmasamUha teOMrei| AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sakaloৱe teOMra paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare| teOM parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke mora zatru Aru tomAlokara zatruka vandhurUpe grahaNa nakarivA, tomAloke siha~tara prati vandhutvara vArtA preraNa karichA, athaca siha~te tomAlokara ocaralai ahA satyaka pratyAkhyAna kariche, rAchulaka Aru tomAlokaka vahiSkAra kariche ei kAraNe ye, tomAloke tomAlokara pratipAlaka AllAhara prati ImAna AnichA| yadi tomAloke mora pathata jihAda karivalai Aru mora santuSTi lAbhara vAve olAichA, tente kiYa tomAloke siha~tara lagata gopane vandhutva karichA? Aru tomAloke yi gopana karA Aru tomAloke yi prakAza karA sei viSaYe mai samyaka aৱgata| tomAlokara mAjata yiYe enekuৱA kariva si sarala pathara parA vicyuta ha’va|

siha~te yadi tomAlokara oparata pradhAnya lAbha kare tente siha~ta tomAlokara zatru hai pariva, lagate hAta Aru jibhAra dvArA tomAlokaka aniSTa sAdhana kariva, Aru siha~te kAmanA kariva ye, tomAlokeo kuphurI karA!
tomAlokara AtmIYa-svajana Aru santAna-santatiYe kviYAmatara dinA kono upakAra kariva noৱAriva| AllAhe tomAlokara mAjata phaYacAlA kari diva; Aru tomAloke yi karA sei viSaYe AllAha sarvadraSTA|

nizcaYa tomAlokara vAve ivrAhIma Aru teOMra lagata yisakala Achila teOMlokara mAjata Ache uttama Adarza| yetiYA teOMloke nija sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘tomAlokara lagata Aru tomAloke AllAhara parivarte yisakalara upAsanA karA seisakalara lagata AmAra kono samparka nAi| Ami tomAlokaka nAmAno| (Ajira parA) AmAra Aru tomAlokara mAjata cirakAlara vAve zatrutA Aru vidveSa sRSTi ha’la; yetiYAlaike tomAloke eka AllAhara prati ImAna poSaNa nakarivA’| kintu ivrAhImara nija pitAra prati karA ei uktiTo Achila vyatikrama ye, ‘mai nizcaYa AponAra vAve kSamA prArthanA karima, kintu mai AponAra hake AllAhara parA kivA upakAra karivalai mora sAdhya nAi’| (ivrAhIma Aru teOMra anusArIsakale kaichila) he AmAra pratipAlaka! ‘Ami tomAra oparatei bharasA karicho~, Aru tomArei abhimukhI haicho~ Aru tomAra ocaralaikei AmAra pratyAৱrtana’|
‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAka kAphirasakalara phitanAra pAtra nakarivA| he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAka kSamA kari diYA; nizcaYa tumi parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa’|

nizcaYa tomAlokara vAve uttama Adarza Ache teOMlokara mAjata, yihetu tomAloke AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara pratyAzA karA; Aru yiYe mukha ghUrAi laYa (si jAni loৱA ucita ye) nizcaYa AllAhei haiche abhAৱmukta, svaYaM prazaMsita|
yisakalara lagata tomAlokara zatrutA Ache sambhaৱtaH AllAhe siha~tara Aru tomAlokara mAjata vandhutva sRSTi kari diva; AllAha kSamatAৱAna: Aru AllAha parama kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

dvInI kSetrata yisakale tomAlokara viruddhe yuddha karA nAi Aru tomAlokaka svadezara parA vahiSkAro karA nAi, siha~tara prati mahAnubhaৱtA dekhuৱAvalai Aru nyAYavicAra karivalai AllAhe tomAlokaka niSedha nakare| nizcaYa AllAha nyAYaparAYaNasakalaka bhAlapAYa|

AllAhe keৱla siha~tara lagata vandhutva karivalai niSedha kariche, yisakale dvIna samparke tomAlokara viruddhe yuddha kariche, tomAlokaka svadezara parA vahiSkAra kariche Aru tomAlokaka vahiSkAra karivalai sahAYa kariche| enekuৱA lokara saite yisakale vandhutva kare, siha~tei haiche yAlima|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAlokara ocaralai muminA nArIsakala hijarata kari Ahile tomAloke siha~taka parIkSA kari lavA; AllAhei siha~tara ImAna samparke samyaka aৱgata| tAra pichata yadi tomAloke jAniva pArA ye, siha~ta muminA nArI, tente siha~taka kAphirasakalara ocaralai obhatAi napaThiYAvA| muminA nArIsakala kAphirasakalara vAve vaidha nahaYa Aru kAphirasakalo muminA nArIsakalara vAve vaidha nahaYa| kAphirasakale yi kharaca kariche seYA tomAloke siha~taka obhatAi diYA| tAra pichata tomAloke siha~taka vivAha karile tomAlokara kono aparAdha naha’va, yadi tomAloke siha~taka mohara AdAYa diYA; Aru tomAloke kAphirA nArIsakalara lagata dAmpatya samparka vajAYa nArAkhivA| tomAloke yi vyaYa karichA seYA tomAloke obhatAi lavA Aru kAphirasakale yi vyaYa kariche seYA siha~te ghUrAi vicarA ucita| eiToৱe haiche AllAhara vidhAna; teOM tomAlokara mAjata phaYacAlA kari diYe; Aru AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Aru tomAlokara strIsakalara mAjara konovAi yadi hAta erAdi kAphirasakalara ocaralai guci yAYa, tAra pichata yadi tomAloke yuddhata vijaYI hai ganImata lAbha karA, teneha’le yisakalara strI guci gaiche siha~taka, siha~te yi vyaYa kariche, tAra samaparimANa pradAna karivA; Aru tomAloke AllAhaka bhaYa karA, yAra prati tomAloke vizvAsa sthApana karichA|

he navI! yetiYA muminA nArIsakale tomAra ocaralai Ahi ei samparke vAiAta kare ye, siha~te AllAhara lagata Ana kAko aMzIdAra sthApana nakariva, curi nakariva, vyabhicAra nakariva, nijara santAnasakalaka hatyA nakariva, icchAkRtabhAৱe nije apavAda racanA kari raTanA kari nuphuriva Aru satkarmata tomAra avAdhyatA nakariva, tetiYA tumi siha~tara vAiAta grahaNa karivA, Aru siha~tara vAve AllAhara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karivA| nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke sei sampradAYara lagata vandhutva nakarivA, yisakalara prati AllAha krodhAnvita haiche| siha~te AkhirAta samparke nirAza hai pariche, yenekai kAphirasakale kavaravAsIra viSaYe nirAza hai pariche|
AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakalovorei AllAhara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare; Aru teOM parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa|
he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke yiTo nakarA seiTo kiYa koৱA?
tomAloke yiTo nakarA seiTo tomAloke koৱATo AllAhara dRSTita vara asantoSajanaka|
nizcaYa AllAhe teOMlokaka bhAlapAYa, yisakale teOMra pathata zArIvaddhabhAৱe yuddha kare; yenivA siha~ta galita sIhere nirmita sudRDha় prAcIra|

Aru smaraNa karA, mUchAi yetiYA teOMra sampradAYaka kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! tomAloke kiYa moka kaSTa di AchA? athaca tomAloke jAnA ye, nizcaYa mai tomAlokara prati (prerita) AllAhara rAchula’| tAra pichata siha~te yetiYA vakra patha aৱlamvana karile tetiYA AllAhe siha~tara hRdaYasamUhaka vakra kari dile; Aru AllAhe phAchikva sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA mAraYAmara putra IchAi kaichila, he vanI icharAIla! ‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara prati prerita AllAhara rAchula Aru mora pUrvaৱrtI tAorAtara satyAYanakArI, lagate ejana rAchulara susaMvAdadAtA, yijana mora pichata Ahiva, yAra nAma ha’va Ahamada’| tAra pichata teOM yetiYA suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha lai Agamana karile, tetiYA siha~te ka’le, ‘eYA dekhona spaSTa yAdu’|
sei vyaktitakai DAGara yAlima Aru kona ha’va pAre, yiYe AllAha samparke michA racanA kare? athaca tAka ichalAmara prati AhvAna karA haYa; Aru AllAhe yAlima sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|
siha~te AllAhara jyotika mukhere phu~ mAri nirvApita kariva vicAre, Aru AllAhe teOMra jyotika (nizcitabhAৱe) pUrNatA dAna kariva| yadio kAphirasakale iYAka apachanda kare|
teৱe~i nija rAchulaka preraNa kariche hidAYata Aru satya dvIna sahakAre sakalo dvInara oparata tAka vijaYI karAra vAve, yadio muzvarikasakale iYAka apachanda kare|
he ImAndArasakala! mai tomAlokaka enekuৱA eTA vyaৱsAYara sandhAna dimane, yiTo tomAlokaka yantraNAdAYaka zAstira parA rakSA kariva?

seYA haiche, tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati ImAna AnivA Aru tomAloke nijara dhana-sampada Aru jIৱnara dvArA AllAhara pathata jihAda karivA| eiToৱei haiche tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara, yadi tomAloke jAnA|

teOM tomAlokara vAve tomAlokara pApasamUha kSamA kari diva; Aru tomAlokaka enekuৱA jAnnAtata praৱeza karAva yAra taledi nadIsamUha pravAhita, Aru cirasthAYI jAnnAtasamUhara uttama vAsagRhasamUhato (praৱeza karAva)| eiToৱe haiche mahA saphalatA|
lagate (teOM pradAna kariva) Aru eTA anugraha, yiTo tomAloke pachanda karA| (arthAt) AllAhara taraphara parA sahAYa Aru nikaTaৱrtI vijaYa; Aru tumi muminasakalaka susaMvAda diYA|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke AllAhara sahAYakArI hoৱA, yenekai mAraYAmara putra IchAi hAৱArIsakalaka kaichila, ‘AllAhara pathata kone mora sahAYaka ha’vA’? hAৱArIsakale kaichila, ‘AmiYei AllAhara pathata sahAYakArI’| tAra pichata vanI icharAIlara eTA dale ImAna Anichila Aru Ana eTA dale kuphurI karichila| gatike yisakale ImAna Anichila teOMlokaka Ami teOMlokara zatruvAhinIra oparata zaktizAlI karichilo~| phalata teOMloka vijaYI haichila|
AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakaloৱe AllAhara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare, yijana adhipati, mahApaৱitra, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

teৱe~i ummIsakalara mAjata siha~tara mAjara parAi ejana rAchula preraNa kariche, yijane siha~tara ocarata teOMra AYAtasamUha tilAৱAta kare, siha~taka paৱitra kare Aru siha~taka kitAva Aru hikamatara zikSA diYe; yadio itipUrve siha~ta Achila ghora vibhrAntita;
Aru siha~tara mAjara parA anyAnyasakalara pratio, (ei rAchulakei preraNa karA haiche) yisakale etiYAo siha~tara lagata milita hoৱA nAi Aru AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
eiTo AllAharei anugraha, teOM yAka icchA kare tAka seYA dAna kare; Aru AllAha mahAnugrahara adhikArI|

yisakalaka tAorAtara dAYitvabhAra diYA haichila, kintu siha~te iYAka vahana karA nAchila| siha~tara udAharaNa haiche- gAdhara dare! yiYe vahu kitAvara vojA vahana kare| kimAna ye nikRSTa sei sampradAYara dRSTAnta, yisakale AllAhara AYAtasamUhaka michA vuli amAnya kare; (jAni thoৱA) AllAhe yAlima sampradAYaka hidAYata nakare|
koৱA, he iYAhudIsakala! yadi tomAloke bhAvA ye, Ana Ana mAnuhara vAhire akala tomAlokei AllAhara vandhu, tente tomAloke mRtyu kAmanA karA yadi tomAloke satyavAdI|
kintu siha~tara hAte Agalai yi preraNa kariche tAra kAraNe siha~te ketiYAo mRtyu kAmanA nakariva; Aru AllAha yAlimasakalara viSaYe samyaka aৱgata|

koৱA, yi mRtyura parA tomAloke palAYana karA, seYA nizcaYa tomAlokara lagata sAkSAt kariva| tAra pichata tomAlokaka pratyAৱrtana karoৱA ha’va gAYeva Aru prakAzyara jJAnI AllAhara ocarata| teOM tomAlokaka janAi diva tomAloke yi Amala karichilA|

he ImAndArasakala! jumuAra dinA yetiYA chAlAtara vAve AhvAna karA haYa, tetiYA tomAloke AllAhara smaraNara phAle dhAৱita hoৱA Aru vecA-kinA vandha karA| eiToৱe tomAlokara vAve sarvottama, yadi tomAloke upalavdhi karA|
tAra pichata chAlAta samApta ha’le tomAloke pRthiৱIta prasArita hai yoৱA Aru AllAhara anugraha sandhAna karA lagate AllAhaka vechi vechi smaraNa karA, yAte tomAloke saphalatA arjana kariva pArA|

Aru siha~te yetiYA vyaৱsAYa athavA krIDa়A-kautuka dekhA pAYa tetiYA siha~te tomAka thiYa aৱsthAtei rAkhi seiphAle dhAৱita haYa| koৱA, AllAhara ocarata yi Ache seYA krIDa়A-kautuka Aru vyaৱsAYa-vANijyatakaio utkRSTa; Aru AllAha sarvazreSTha jIৱikAdAtA|

yetiYA munAphikasakala tomAra ocaralai Ahe tetiYA siha~te kaYa, Ami sAkSya diOM ye, ‘nizcaYa Apuni AllAhara rAchula’; Aru AllAhe jAne ye, tumi nizcaYa teOMra rAchula, lagate AllAhe sAkSya diYe ye, nizcaYa munAphikasakala haiche michalIYA|
siha~te nijara zapatavoraka DhAlarUpe vyaৱhAra kare| phalata siha~te AllAhara pathara parA mAnuhaka nivRtta kare| siha~te yi kare seYA kimAna ye nikRSTa!
eYA ei kAraNe ye, siha~te ImAna poSaNa karAra pichata Akau kuphurI kariche| phalata siha~tara antarata mohara mAri diYA haiche; seYe siha~te nuvujA haiche|

Aru tumi yetiYA siha~tara prati lakSya karivA tetiYA siha~tara dehara AkRtiYe tomAka mugdha kariva Aru siha~te yetiYA kathA kaYa tumi siha~tara kathA Agrahere zuni thAkA| siha~ta verata lagAi thoৱA kAThara khu~TAra dare; siha~te yikono zavdaka nijara viruddhe dhAraNA kare| siha~tei haiche prakRta zatru, eteke siha~tara viSaYe satarka thAkivA; AllAhe siha~taka dhvaMsa karaka! siha~taka ka’lai obhatAi niYA haiche!

Aru yetiYA siha~taka koৱA haYa, ‘AhA, AllAhara rAchule tomAlokara vAve kSamA prArthanA kariva’, tetiYA siha~te mUra jukAri asvIkRti janAYa, lagate tumi siha~taka ahaMkAra kari vimukha hai guci yoৱA dekhivalai pAvA|
tumi siha~tara vAve kSamA prArthanA karA vA nakarA, ubhaYei siha~tara vAve samAna| AllAhe siha~taka ketiYAo kSamA nakariva| nizcaYa AllAha phAchikva sampradAYaka hidAYata nidiYe|
siha~te kaYa, ‘tomAloke AllAhara rAchulara sahacarasakalara vAve vyaYa nakarivA, yAte siha~ta A~tari yAYa’| athaca AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIra dhana-bhANDAra AllAharei, kintu munAphikvasakale nuvuje|

siha~te kaYa, ‘Ami madInAlai ubhati ga’le nizcaYa zaktizAlIsakale tAra parA durvalasakalaka vahiSkAra kariva’| athaca zakti-sanmAna keৱla AllAhara Aru teOMra rAchulara Aru muminasakalara| kintu munAphikvasakale seYA nAjAne|
he ImAndArasakala! tomAlokara dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santatiYe yAte tomAlokaka AllAhara smaraNara parA udAsIna nakare; Aru yisakale enekai udAsIna ha’va siha~tei haiche kSatigrasta|

Aru mai tomAlokaka yi jIৱikA dAna karicho~ tomAlokara ocarata mRtyu ahAra Agate tAra parA vyaYa karA, (kAraNa mRtyu ahAra pichata mAnuhe ka’va) he mora pratipAlaka! ‘moka Aru kichu samaYara vAve aৱkAza dile mai chAdakvA karilo~he~tena Aru satkarmaparAYaNasakalara antarbhukta ha’lo~he~tena’!
yetiYA kArovAra nirdiSTa samaYa upasthita haYa, tetiYA AllAhe tAka ketiYAo aৱkAza nidiYe| tomAloke yi Amala karA sei samparke AllAha savizeSa aৱgata|
AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIta yi yi Ache sei sakaloৱe AllAhara paৱitratA Aru mahimA ghoSaNA kare, teOMrei Adhipatya Aru teOMrei prazaMsA; Aru teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
teৱe~i tomAlokaka sRSTi kariche| tAra pichata tomAlokara mAjata kichumAna haiche kAphira Aru kichumAna haiche mumina; Aru tomAloke yi Amala karA sei samparke AllAha samyaka draSTA|
teৱe~i AkAzamaNDala Aru pRthiৱIka yathAyathabhAৱe sRSTi kariche Aru tomAlokaka AkRti dAna kariche, tAra pichata tomAlokara AkRti utkRSTa kariche; Aru pratyAৱrtana keৱla teOMra ocaratei|
AkAzamaNDalata Aru pRthiৱIta yi Ache sakalo teOM jAne Aru tomAloke yi gopana karA Aru yi prakAza karA seYAo teOM jAne; Aru antarasamUhata yi Ache sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka jJAnI|
iYAra Agata yisakale kuphurI kariche siha~tara saMvAda tomAlokara ocaralai Ahi poৱA nAine? siha~te nijara karmara veYA pariNati bhoga kariche Aru siha~tara vAve Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

eYA ei kAraNe ye, siha~tara ocaralai siha~tara rAchulasakale suspaSTa pramANAdisaha Ahichila, tathApio siha~te kaichila, ‘mAnuhei AmAka pathara sandhAna diva neki’? tAra pichata siha~te kuphurI karichila Aru mukha ghUrAi laichila; phalata AllAheo (siha~tara ImAnara viSaYe) bhrukSepa nakarile; Aru AllAha abhAৱmukta, saprazaMsita|

kAphirasakale dhAraNA kare ye, siha~taka ketiYAo punarutthita karA naha’va| koৱA, ‘nizcaYa karA ha’va, mora pratipAlakara zapata! tomAlokaka nizcaYa punarutthita karA ha’va| tAra pichata tomAloke yi karichilA sei viSaYe tomAlokaka nizcaYa aৱgata karoৱA ha’va Aru eiTo AllAhara pakSe tenei sahaja’|
eteke tomAloke AllAha Aru teOMra rAchulara prati, lagate Ami yi nUra aৱtIrNa karicho~ tAra prati ImAna poSaNa karA; Aru tomAlokara kRtakarma samparke AllAha savizeSa aৱhita|

smaraNa karA, yidinA teOM tomAlokaka samAveza diৱsara uddezye samaveta kariva, sei dinaToৱe ha’va kSatira dina; Aru yiYe AllAhara prati ImAna Aniva Aru satkarma kariva, teOM tAra pApasamUha mocana kari diva Aru tAka jAnnAtata praৱeza karAva, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita, tAta siha~ta cirasthAYI ha’va| eiToৱe haiche mahA saphalatA|
kintu yisakale kuphurI kariche Aru AmAra AYAtasamUhaka asvIkAra kariche siha~tei haiche jAhAnnAmara adhivAsI, tAta siha~te cirakAla aৱsthAna kariva| kimAna nikRSTa sei pratyAৱrtanasthala|
AllAhara anumati avihane kono vipadei Apatita nahaYa| yiYe AllAhaka vizvAsa kare, AllAhe tAra antaraka satpathata paricAlita kare| AllAha sakalo viSaYe samyaka aৱgata|
tomAloke AllAhara Anugatya karA Aru rAchulara Anugatya karA| kintu tomAloke yadi mukha ghUrAi loৱA tente (jAni thoৱA) mora rAchulara dAYitva haiche keৱla spaSTabhAৱe pracAra karAhe|
AllAha, teOMra vAhire Ana kono (satya) ilAha nAi Aru AllAhara oparatei muminasakale tAৱAkkula karA ucita|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAlokara strI-svAmI Aru santAna-santatisakalara mAjara kichumAna haiche tomAlokara zatru; eteke siha~tara viSaYe tomAloke satarka thAkivA| yadi tomAloke siha~taka mArjanA kari diYA, siha~tara doSa-truTika upekSA karA Aru siha~taka kSamA kari diYA, tente nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa tomAlokara dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati keৱla eTA parIkSA vizeSa; Aru AllAhara ocaratei Ache mahApuraskAra|

eteke tomAloke yathAsAdhya AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, zraৱNa karA, Anugatya karA Aru vyaYa karA, tomAlokara nijare kalyANa ha’va; Aru yisakale antarara kRpaNatAra parA mukta, siha~tei haiche sAphalyamaNDita|
yadi tomAloke AllAhaka uttama RNa pradAna karA, teOM tomAlokara vAve tAka vahu guNa vRddhi kari diva Aru teOM tomAlokaka kSamA kariva; Aru AllAha guNagrAhI, parama dhairyazIla|
teOM dRzya Aru adRzya yAৱtIYa viSaYara jJAnI, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he navI (koৱA), tomAloke yetiYA strIsakalaka tAlAka divA, tetiYA siha~taka siha~tara iddatara prati lakSya rAkhi tAlAka divA Aru tomAloke iddatara hicApa rAkhivA; Aru tomAlokara pratipAlaka AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA| tomAloke siha~taka siha~tara gharara parA vahiSkAra nakarivA Aru siha~ta nijeo yena olAi nAyAYa, (kintu) siha~ta yadi kono spaSTa azlIlatAta lipta haYa (tente viSaYaTo sukIYA)| eivora haiche AllAhara nirdhArita sImArekhA; Aru yiYe AllAhara sImArekhA laMghana kare, si nijara oparate anyAYa kare| tumi nAjAnA, sambhaৱtaH AllAhe iYAra pichata kono upAYa udbhAৱna kari diva|

tAra pichata yetiYA siha~te siha~tara iddatara zeSa sImAta upanIta ha’va, tetiYA tomAloke siha~taka yathAvidhi rAkhi divA naha’le siha~taka yathAvidhi parityAga karivA Aru tomAlokara mAjara parA dujana nyAYaparAYaNa lokaka sAkSI rAkhivA; Aru tomAloke AllAhara vAve saThikabhAৱe sAkSya divA| iYAra dvArA tomAlokara mAjara yiYe AllAha Aru zeSa diৱsara prati vizvAsa kare tAka upadeza diYA haiche; Aru yiYe AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariva AllAhe tAra vAve uttaraNara patha uliYAi diva,

Aru teOM tAka tAra dhAraNAtIta utsara parA jIৱikA dAna kariva; Aru yiYe AllAhara prati tAৱAkkula kariva, tAra vAve AllAhei yatheSTa| nizcaYa AllAhe teOMra uddezya pUraNa karivai; nizcaYa AllAhe pratiTo vastura vAve eTA samaYasImA nirdhAraNa kari diche|

tomAlokara strIsakalara mAjara yisakale Rtumati hoৱAra kAla atikrama kariche, siha~tara iddata samparke yadi tomAloke sandeha karA teneha’le siha~tara iddatakAla ha’va tini mAha; Aru yisakale etiYAo Rtura vaYasata upanIta hoৱA nAi siha~taro (iddatakAla haiche tini mAha); Aru garbhaৱtI nArIsakalara iddatakAla haiche santAna prasaৱ nohoৱAlaike; Aru yiYe AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kare AllAhe tAra vAve tAra karmaka sahaja kari diYe|
eiTo haiche AllAhara vidhAna, yiTo teOM tomAlokara prati aৱtIrNa kariche; Aru yiYe AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana kariva teOM tAra pApasamUha mocana kari diva Aru tAka pradAna kariva mahApuraskAra|

tomAlokara sAmartha anuyAYI ya’ta tomAloke vasavAsa karA tAtei siha~tako vAsa karivalai diYA, siha~taka saMkaTata pelAvalai kaSTa nidivA; Aru siha~ta garbhaৱtI thAkile santAna prasaৱ nakarAlaike siha~tara vAve vyaYa karA| tAra pichata yadi siha~te tomAlokara santAnaka piYAha khuoৱAYa teneha’le siha~taka pArizramika pradAna karivA Aru (santAnara kalyANa samparke) tomAloke nijara mAjatei saMgatabhAৱe parAmarza karA; Aru yadi tomAloke paraspare aikyamata ha’valai TAna poৱA teneha’le pitAra phAlara parA Ana tirotAi piYAha khuৱAva|

vittavAne nija sAmartha anuyAYI vyaYa kariva Aru yAra jIৱnopakaraNa sImita tAka AllAhe yi dAna kariche tAra parA vyaYa kariva| AllAhe yAka yi sAmartha diche tAtakai vechi gurutara vojA teOM tAra oparata jApi nidiYe| nizcaYa AllAhe kaThina aৱsthAra pichata sacchalatA pradAna kariva|

Aru vahuto janapade siha~tara pratipAlaka Aru teOMra rAchulara nirdezara viruddhAcAraNa karichila| phalata Ami siha~tara parA kaThina hicApa grahaNa karichilo~ Aru Ami siha~taka vihichilo~ kaThina zAsti|
phalata siha~te nijara kRtakarmara soৱAda pAichila; Aru siha~tara karmara pariNAma Achila kSatiYei kSati|

AllAhe siha~tara vAve kaThina zAsti prastuta kari rAkhiche| eteke tomAloke AllAhara tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, he vodhazaktisampanna vyaktisakala! yisakale ImAna AnichA| nizcaYa AllAhe tomAlokara prati aৱtIrNa kariche upadeza---

ejana rAchula, yiYe tomAlokara ocarata AllAhara suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAৱAta kare, yAte seisakala lokaka andhakArara parA poharalai uliYAi Aniva pAre yisakale ImAna Aniche Aru satkarma kariche; eteke yiYe AllAhara oparata ImAna Aniva Aru satkAma kariva, teOM tAka jAnnAtata praৱeza karAva, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita, tAta siha~ta cirakAla aৱsthAna kariva| nizcaYa AllAhe tAka uttama jIৱikA pradAna kariva|

teৱe~i AllAha, yijane sAtakhana AkAza sRSTi kariche Aru anurUpa pRthiৱIo, eivorara mAjata nAmi Ahe teOMra nirdeza; yAte tomAloke jAniva pArA ye, AllAha sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna; Aru AllAhe jJAnara dvArA sakalo vastuke pariveSTana kari Ache|
he navI! AllAhe tomAra vAve yi vaidha kariche seYA tumi nijara vAve niSiddha kari laichA kiYa? tumi tomAra strIsakalara santuSTi vicarA neki; Aru AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa AllAhe tomAlokara vAve zapatara parA mukti lAbhara vyaৱsthA kariche; Aru AllAhei haiche tomAlokara abhibhAৱka Aru teৱe~i sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Aru smaraNa karA, yetiYA navIYe teOMra strIsakalara egarAkIka gopana kathA eSAra kaichila; tAra pichata seigarAkIYe Ana egarAkIka janAi dichila, ipine AllAhe teOMra navIra ocarata sei viSaYaTo prakAza kari dile, tAra pichata navIYe ei viSaYe alapa vyakta karile Aru alapa aৱjJA kari eri dile| yetiYA navIYe viSaYaTo sei strIka janAle, tetiYA strIgarAkIYe ka’le, ‘AponAka eiSAra kathA kone aৱgata karAle’? navIYe ka’le, ‘moka sei sattvAi janAiche, yijana sarvajJa, samyaka aৱgata’|

yadi tomAloke ubhaYe (anutapta hai) AllAhara ocarata tAovA karA (tente i tomAlokara vAve kalyANakara ha’va), kAraNa tomAlokara hRdaYa DhAla khAichila| kintu yadi tomAloke navIra viruddhe ijane sijanaka poSakatA karA tente jAni thoৱA, nizcaYa AllAhei haiche teOMra abhibhAৱka Aru jIvrIla lagate satkarmazIla muminasakala, iYAra vAhireo Ana Ana phiristAsakaleo teOMra sahAYakArI|

yadi navIYe tomAlokaka tAlAka diYe tente teOMra pratipAlake sambhaৱtaH tomAlokara sthAnata teOMka tomAlokatakaio uttama strI pradAna kariva--- yisakala ha'va muchalimAha, muminAha, anugata, tAovAkArINI, ivAdatakArINI, chiYAma pAlanakArINI, akumArI Aru kumArI|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke nijake Aru tomAlokara pariYAlavargaka jAhAnnAmara parA rakSA karA, yAra indhana ha’va mAnuha Aru zila, ya’ta niYojita Ache nirmama-hRdaYa, kaThorasvabhAৱ phiristAsakala, yisakale AllAhara Adeza amAnya nakare; Aru teOMloke yiTo karivalai AdezaprApta haYa seiToৱei kare|
he kAphirasakala! Aji tomAloke ojara-Apatti dAGi dharivalai ceSTA nakarivA| tomAloke yi karichilA tArei pratiphala tomAlokaka diYA haiche|

he ImAndArasakala! tomAloke AllAhara ocarata tAovA karA-- vizuddha tAovA; AzA karA yAYa tomAlokara pratipAlake tomAlokara pApasamUha mocana kari diva Aru tomAlokaka jAnnAtata praৱeza karAva, yAra talata nadIsamUha pravAhita| seidinA AllAhe navIka Aru teOMra lagata yisakale ImAna Anichila teOMlokaka lAJchita nakariva| teOMlokara nUra teOMlokara sanmukhata Aru so~hAte dhAৱita ha’va| teOMloke ka’va, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra vAve AmAra nUraka pUrNatA dAna karA Aru AmAka kSamA kari diYA, nizcaYa tumi sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna’|
he navI! kAphira Aru munAphikasakalara viruddhe jihAda karA Aru siha~tara prati kaThora hoৱA| siha~tara AzraYasthala haiche jAhAnnAma Aru seiTo kimAna ye nikRSTa gantavyasthala!

yisakale kuphurI kariche, siha~tara vAve AllAhe nUhara strI Aru lUtara strIra udAharaNa diche; siha~ta AmAra vAndAsakalara mAjara dujana sat vAndAra adhInata Achila, kintu siha~ta ubhaYe teOMlokara lagata vizvAsaghAtakatA karichila| phalata (navIra strI haiYo) AllAhara zAstira parA rakSA poৱA nAchila, teOMloka duYo (nUha Aru lUta) siha~tara kono kAmata ahA nAchila, Aru siha~taka koৱA ha’la, ‘tomAloka ubhaYe praৱezakArIsakalara lagata jAhAnnAmata praৱeza karA’|

Aru muminasakalara vAve AllAhe phiraAunara strIra udAharaNa dAGi dhariche, yetiYA teOM ei vuli prArthanA karichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! tomAra ocarata mora vAve jAnnAtata eTA ghara nirmANa karA Aru moka phiraAuna Aru tAra karmara parA uddhAra karA Aru moka uddhAra karA yAlima sampradAYara parA’|

(AllAhe Aru udAharaNa diche) imarANara jIYeka mAraYAmara---- yiYe nijara lajjAsthAnara paৱitratA rakSA karichila, phalata Ami tAta AmAra rUhara parA phu~ৱAi dichilo~ Aru teOM teOMra pratipAlakara vANI Aru teOMra kitAvasamUha satya vuli grahaNa karichila Aru teOM Achila anugatasakalara anyatama|
varakatamaYa sei sattvA, yAra hAtata sarvamaYa kartRtva; Aru teOM sakalo vastura oparata kSamatAৱAna|
yijane mRtyu Aru jIৱna sRSTi kariche, yAte tomAlokaka parIkSA kariva pAre ye, tomAlokara mAjata kona ATAitakai uttama AmalakArI? teOM parAkramazAlI, ati kSamAzIla|
yijane sAtakhana AkAza stare stare sRSTi kariche| rahamAnara sRSTita tumi kono truTi dekhivalai nApAvA; tumi Akau ghUri coৱA, kono truTi dekhivalai pAichAne?
tAra pichata Akau tumi dvitIYavAra dRSTipAta karA, ei dRSTi vyartha Aru klAnta hai tomAra phAlei ubhati Ahiva|

nizcaYa Ami nikaTaৱrtI AkAzaka pradIpapuJjara dvArA suzobhita karicho~ Aru seivoraka caYatAnasakalara prati nikSepara upakaraNa vanAicho~ Aru siha~tara vAve prastuta karicho~ jvalanta agnikuNDara zAsti|
Aru yisakale nija pratipAlakaka asvIkAra kariche, siha~tara vAve Ache jAhAnnAmara zAsti; Aru kimAna ye nikRSTa sei pratyAৱrtanasthala|
yetiYA siha~taka tAta nikSepa karA ha'va, tAta siha~te iYAra vikaTa zavda zunivalai pAva, Aru i uthali uThiva|
krodhata i chinna-bhinna hoৱAra upakrama ha'va| yetiYAi tAta kono dalaka nikSepa karA ha'va, iYAra praharIsakale siha~taka sudhiva, ‘tomAlokara ocaralai kono satarkakArI ahA nAchilane’?
siha~te ka'va haYa, 'nizcaYa AmAra ocaralai satarkakArI Ahichila| tetiYA Ami (teOMlokaka) mithyAropa karichilo~ Aru kaichilo~, ‘AllAhe ekoৱe aৱtIrNa karA nAi| tomAloke mahAvibhrAntita AchA’|
Aru siha~te ka'va, ‘yadi Ami zunilo~he~tena Aru viveka-vuddhi praYoga karilo~he~tena, tente Ami jvalanta juira adhivAsI naha'lo~he~tena’|
phalata siha~te nijara aparAdha nije svIkAra kariva| eteke (AllAhara rahamatara parA) jAhAnnAmIsakala dUra haoka (siha~tara dhvaMsa anivArya)|
nizcaYa yisakale nedekhAkai nija pratipAlakaka bhaYa kare teOMlokara vAve Ache kSamA Aru DAGara pratidAna|
Aru tomAloke tomAlokara kathA gopane koৱA athavA prakAzyabhAৱe koৱA, nizcaYa antarasamUhata yi Ache sei viSaYe teOM samyaka aৱgata|
yijane sRSTi kariche, teৱe~i nAjAnivane? athaca teOM sUkSmadarzI, samyaka aৱhita|

teৱe~i tomAlokara vAve pRthiৱIkhanaka sugama kari diche, eteke tomAloke iYAra patha-prAntarata vicaraNa karA Aru teOMra jIৱikAra parA tomAloke AhAra karA; Aru teOMra ocaratei punarutthita hai yAva lAgiva|
tomAloke nirApattA lAbha karichA neki ye, AkAzata yijana Ache teOM tomAlokaka bhUmiskhalanara dvArA (puti pelAi) dhvaMsa nakariva? phalata haThAt i (pRthiৱIkhana) thara tharakai ka~pivalai dhariva|

athavA tomAloke nirApattA lAbha karichA neki ye, yijana AkAzata Ache, teOM tomAlokara oparata zila varSaNakArI pravala dhumuhA napaThAva? tetiYA tomAloke jAnivalai pAvA kenekuৱA Achila mora satarkavANI!
Aru nizcaYa siha~tara purvaৱrtIsakaleo mithyAropa karichila| phalata kenekuৱA Achila mora pratyAkhyAna (iYAra zAsti)?

siha~te siha~tara oparata (uri phurA) carAivorara prati lakSya nakare neki, yivore pAkhi meli diYe Aru saMkucita kare? parama karuNAmaYa AllAhei eivoraka sthira kari rAkhe| nizcaYa teOM sakalo vastura samyaka draSTA|
parama karuNAmaYa AllAhara vAhire tomAlokara ene kono senAvAhinI Achene, yisakale tomAlokaka sahAYa kariva? kAphirasakala Ache mAthona pravaJcanAra mAjata|
teOM yadi teOMra jIৱikA vandha kari diYe, kona Ache enekuৱA, yijane tomAlokaka jIৱikA dAna kariva? varaM siha~ta avAdhyatA Aru (satya) vimukhatAta avicala hai Ache|
yi vyaktiYe mukhara oparata bhara di hAli khojakADha়e, siYei adhika hidAYata prApta ne sei vyakti, yijane pona hai sarala pathata khojakADha়e?
koৱA, teৱe~i tomAlokaka sRSTi kariche Aru tomAlokara vAve zraৱNazakti Aru dRSTizakti lagate antaHkaraNasamUha pradAna kariche| tomAloke khuvei kama kRtajJatA prakAza karA|
koৱA, teৱe~i tomAlokaka pRthiৱIta sRSTi kari prasArita kariche Aru teOMra ocaratei tomAlokaka samaveta karA ha'va|
Aru siha~te kaYa, 'tomAloke yadi satyavAdI hoৱA tente koৱAcona ei pratizruti ketiYA vAstaৱAYita ha’va'?
koৱA, ei viSaYara jJAna keৱla AllAhara ocaratei Ache| Aru maito keৱla spaSTa satarkakArIhe mAtra|
yetiYA siha~te iYAka nicei ocarata dekhA pAva tetiYA kAphirasakalara cehArA mlAna hai pariva Aru koৱA ha’va, ‘eiToৱei haiche sei zAsti, yiToka tomAloke (sonakAle Anivalai) Avedana karichilA’|
koৱA, tomAloke bhAvi cAichAne, yadi AllAhe moka Aru mora saGgIsakalaka dhvaMsa kari diYe athavA AmAra prati daYA kare, tente kAphirasakalaka yantraNAdAYaka zAstira parA kone rakSA kariva?
koৱA, teৱe~i parama karuNAmaYa| Ami teOMra oparatei ImAna Anicho~ Aru teOMra oparatei bharasA karicho~| gatike tomAloke anatipalame jAnivalai pAvA kona spaSTa vibhrAntita Ache|
koৱA, tomAloke bhAvi cAichAne, yadi tomAlokara pAnI bhUgarbhalai guci yAYa, tetiYA kone tomAlokaka pravAhamAna pAnI Ani diva?
nUna;[1] kalamara zapata Aru teOMloke (phiristAsakale) yi likhe tAra zapata!
tomAra pratipAlakara anugrahata tumi unmAda nahaYa|
Aru nizcaYa tomAra vAve Ache niraৱcchinna puraskAra|
Aru nizcaYa tumi mahAna caritrara ucca zRGgata adhiSThita|
eteke anatipalame tumi dekhivalai pAvA Aru siha~teo dekhivalai pAva--
tomAlokara mAjata kona vikAragrastha?
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlake bhAlakaiYe jAne, kona teOMra pathara parA vicyuta haiche, Aru ei kathAo bhAlakaiYe jAne konasakala loka hidAYataprApta|
gatike tumi mithyAropakArIsakalara Anugatya nakarivA|
siha~te kAmanA kare ye, tumi ApocakAmI hoৱA, tente siha~teo ApocakAmI ha'va|
Aru tumi enekuৱA vyaktiro Anugatya nakarivA yiYe adhika zapata khAYa, lAJchita,
piThira A~rata nindAkArI Aru yijane cogalakhurI kari phure (ijanara kathA sijanaka gAi phure),
kalyANara kAmata vAdhA pradAnakArI, sImAlaMghanakArI, pApiSTha,
duSTa prakRtira, tadupari kukhyAta;
ei kAraNe ye, si dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santatira kSetrata samRddhazAlI|
yetiYA tAra ocarata AmAra AYAtasamUha tilAৱAta karA haYa tetiYA si kaYa, eivora haiche pUrvaৱrtIsakalara kalpa-kAhinI mAtra|
zIghrei Ami tAra zu~rata (nAkata) dAga dima|
nizcaYa Ami iha~taka parIkSA karicho~, yenekai parIkSA karichilo~ udyAna-adhipatisakalaka, yetiYA siha~te zapata karichila ye, puৱArabhAgate siha~te vAgAnara phala AharaNa kariva|
kintu siha~te ‘ina zvA AllAha’ koৱA nAchila|
phalata tomAra pratipAlakara taraphara parA eTA pradakSiNakArI (viparyaYa, juYe) vAgAnara oparata pradakSiNa karile, sei samaYata siha~ta Achila Topanita|
phalata vAgAnakhana (puri) ka’lAvarNara nicinA hai ga’la|
rAtipuৱAi siha~te ijane sijanaka mAti ka’le,
‘yadi tomAloke phala AharaNa kariva vicarA, teneha’le puৱti nizAi vAgAnalai valA’|
tAra pichata siha~te nimnasvare kathA pAti yAvalai dharile--
ye ‘Aji yAte tAta tomAlokara ocaralai kono dukhIYA-abhAৱI praৱeza kariva noৱAre’|
Aru siha~te (abhAৱIsakalaka nivRtta karivalai) sakSama vuli bhAvi puৱti nizAi dRDha় icchA zaktire (vAgAnalai) yAtrA karile|

siha~tara dRSTisamUha aৱnata aৱsthAta thAkiva, apamAne siha~taka Acchanna kariva athaca yetiYA siha~ta nirApada (sustha) Achila tetiYA siha~taka mAtA haichila chAjadA karivalai (kintu siha~te chAjadA karA nAchila)|
eteke moka Aru siha~taka eri diYA, yisakale ei vANIka pratyAkhyAna kare| Ami siha~taka lAhe lAhe enekai dharima ye, siha~te gamei nApAva|
Aru mai siha~taka aৱkAza diOM| nizcaYa mora kauzala atyanta valiSTha|
tumi siha~tara ocarata pArizramika (vinimaYa) dAvI karichA neki, yAra phalata siha~te RNara kAraNe bhArAkrAnta hai pariche?
ne siha~tara ocarata gAYevara jJAna Ache, yiTo siha~te likhi rAkhe!
eteke tumi tomAra pratipAlakara Adezara apekSAta dhairyya dhAraNa karA, Aru tumi mAchara garAkIra dare (adhairyya) naha’vA, yetiYA teOM viSAda Acchanna aৱsthAta minati karichila|
yadi teOMra pratipAlakara anugraha teOMra ocarata Ahi nApAlehe~tena, tente teOM lAJchita aৱsthAta unmukta prAntarata nikSipta ha’lahe~tena|
tAra pichata teOMra pratipAlake teOMka manonIta karile Aru teOMka satkarmaparAYaNasakalara antarbhukta karile|
Aru kAphirasakale yetiYA upadezavANI (koraAna) zune tetiYA siha~te enekuৱA dRSTire tomAra phAle cAYa, yenivA tomAka vAgarAi diva, Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘nizcaYa eOM haiche ejana unmAda’|
athaca ei koraAna haiche keৱla vizvavAsIra vAve upadeza|
sei aৱzyambhAৱI ghaTanA, (kviYAmata)
ki sei aৱzyambhAৱI ghaTanA?
Aru tumi kenekai gama pAvA sei aৱzyambhAৱI ghaTanATono ki?
chAmuda Aru Ada sampradAYe mithyAropa karichila bhItiprada mahAvipadaka|
seYe chAmuda sampradAYaka dhvaMsa karA haichila eTA pralaYaMkara viparyaYakArI pracaNDa zavdara dvArA|
Aru Ada sampradAYaka dhvaMsa karA haichila pracaNDa ThANDA dhumuhA vatAhara dvArA,

iYAka teOM sAta rAti Aru ATha dinalaike avirAmabhAৱe siha~tara oparata pravAhita karichila; phalata tumi ukta sampradAYaka dekhivalai pAlAhe~tena---ye siha~ta enekai si~carati hai pari Ache yenivA sArazUnya khejura gachara kANDahe|
eteke siha~tara mAjara kArovAka tumi aৱziSTa dekhivalai poৱAne?
lagate phiraAuna, tAra pUrvaৱrtIsakale Aru oloTAi diYA janapadavAsIYeo jaghanya pApakarmata lipta Achila|
Aru siha~te nija pratipAlakara rAchulaka amAnya karichila, phalata teOM siha~taka atyanta kaThorabhAৱe karAYatta kariche|
yetiYA vAnapAnI vipadara sImA cerAi gaichila, tetiYA nizcaYa Ami tomAlokaka nAৱta ArohaNa karoৱAichilo~|
Ami eiTo karichilo~ tomAlokaka eTA smaraNIYa zikSA diYAra vAve Aru eikAraNe ye, yAte zrutidhara kANe iYAka saMrakSaNa kari rAkhiva pAre|
eteke yetiYA ziGAta phu~ diYA ha’va—keৱla eTA phu~|
Aru pRthiৱIsaha parvatasamUhaka uThAi niYA ha’va Aru mAtra eTA AghAtata eivora cUrNa-vicUrNa hai yAva|
phalata seidinA mahAghaTanA saMghaTita ha’va|
Aru AkAza vidIrNa hai yAva, phalata seidinA i durvala-vikSipta hai pariva|
Aru phiristAsakala AkAzara vibhinna prAntata thAkiva| seidinA AThajana phiristAi tomAra pratipAlakara Arachaka vahana kariva|
seidinA tomAlokaka upasthita karoৱA ha’va lagate tomAlokara kono gopanIYatAi Aru gopana nAthAkiva|
tetiYA yAra AmalanAmA tAra so~ hAtata diYA ha’va si (Anandata velegaka) ka’va, ‘eYA loৱA, mora AmalanAmA paDha়i coৱA’|
‘mora dRDha় vizvAsa Achila ye, mai mora hicApara sanmukhIna hama’|
teOM thAkiva santoSajanaka jIৱnata;
suucca jAnnAtata,
yAra phalamUla olami thAkiva nicei ocarata|
(koৱA ha’va) ‘vigata dinasamUhata tomAloke Agalai yi preraNa karichilA tAra vinimaYata tomAloke tRpti sahakAre khoৱA Aru pAna karA’|
kintu yAra AmalanAmA tAra vAOM hAtata diYA ha’va, si ka’va, ‘hAYa, moka yadi mora AmalanAmA diYA naha’lahe~tena’!
‘Aru mai yadi mora hicApa samparke gamei nApAlo~he~tena!
‘hAYa, mora mRtyuৱei yadi mora vAve zeSa cUDa়Anta phaYacAlA ha’lahe~tena!
‘mora dhana-sampada mora kono kAmate nAhila|
‘mora kSamatA zaktio vinaSTa haiche’|
(phiristAsakalaka koৱA ha’va) ‘dharA tAka Aru galata paghA lagAi diYA’|
‘tAra pichata tAka jAhAnnAmata nikSepa karA’|
tAra pichata tAka vAndhi thoৱA, ene eDAla zikalire yAra dairgha sattara hAta|
nizcaYa si mahAna AllAhara prati ImAna poSaNa karA nAchila,
Aru michakinaka khAdyadAnato utsAhita karA nAchila|
eteke Aji iYAta tAra kono antaraGga vandhu nAthAkiva|
Aru kSata-niHsRta pu~jara vAhire Ana kono khAdyao nAthAkiva,
yiTo aparAdhIsakalara vAhire Ana koneo nAkhAva|
eteke mai zapata karo~ seivora vastura, yivoraka tomAloke dekhA poৱA,
lagate yivoraka tomAloke dekhA nopoৱA;
nizcaYa eYA (koraAna) ejana sanmAnita rAchulara (vahanakRta) vANI|
Aru eYA kono kavira kathA nahaYa; (Aphacoca!) tomAloke khuvei kama ImAna poSaNa karA|
Aru eYA kono gaNakara kathAo nahaYa; tomAloke khuvei kama upadeza grahaNa karA|
eYA vizvajagatara pratipAlakara taraphara parA nAyilakRta|
teOM yadi AmAra nAmata kono michA racanA karilehe~tena,
tente nizcaYa Ami tAka so~hAtere dharilo~he~tena,
tAra pichata Ami tAra hRdapiNDara sirA (mahAdhamanI) kATi dilo~he~tena,
eteke tomAlokara mAjata enekuৱA kono nAi, yiYe teOMka rakSA kariva pArilehe~tena|
Aru eYA (koraAna) muttAkvIsakalara vAve nizcita eTA upadeza|
Aru Ami nizcaYa jAno ye, tomAlokara mAjata kichumAna mithyAropakArI Ache|
Aru nizcaYa ei (koraAna)khana kAphirasakalara vAve eka nizcita anuzocanAra kAraNa ha’va|
Aru nizcaYa eikhana sunizcita satya|
eteke tumi tomAra mahAna pratipAlakara nAmata tachavIha pATha karA|
AvedanakArIYe Avedana karile, saMghaTita haoka aৱdhArita zAsti-
kAphirasakalara oparata, yAra kono pratirodhakArI nAi|
eiTo Ahiva AllAhara taraphara parA, yijana UrdhvArohaNara khaTakhaTIvorara (jakhalA) adhikArI,
phiristAsakala Aru rUha ene eTA dinata AllAhara dize UrddhagAmI haYa, yAra parimANa paJcAza hAjAra vachara|
eteke tumi dhairya dhAraNa karA parama dhairya|
nizcaYa siha~te ei diৱsaToka vahu dUrata thakA vuli bhAve|
Aru Ami iYAka nicei ocarata dekhi Acho~|
seidinA AkAza hai yAva galita dhAtura dare,
Aru parvatasamUha hai yAva raM-viraGara UNara dare,
Aru kono antaraGga vandhuৱeo antaraGga vandhura khA-khavara nusudhiva,
(yadio) siha~taka parasparara dRSTigocara karoৱA ha’va| aparAdhIYe seidiৱsara zAstira vinimaYata diva vicAriva tAra santAna-santatika,
Aru tAra strI Aru bhAtRka,
Aru tAra jAti-goSThika, yisakale tAka AzraYa dichila,
lagate pRthiৱIra sakaloke (diva vicAriva), yAte iYAra vinimaYata tAka mukti diYA haYa|
ketiYAo nahaYa, nizcaYa eiTo haiche lelihAna jui,
yiYe (tAra) mUrara chAla khahAi pelAva|
jAhAnnAme sei vyaktika mAtiva, yiYe (satyara prati) pRSTha pradarzana karichila Aru mukha ghUrAi laichila|
Aru si sampada saJcaYa karichila, lagate saMrakSaNa kari rAkhichila|
nizcaYa mAnuhaka sRSTi karA haiche atizaYa dhairyahIna asthiracittarUpe|
yetiYA tAka vipade sparza kare, tetiYA si atimAtrA utkaNThita hai pare|
Aru yetiYA tAka kalyANe sparza kare, tetiYA si atizaYa kRpaNa hai pare|
kintu chAlAta pratiSThAkArIsakalara vAhire,
yisakale nijara chAlAtara kSetrata sadAYa pratiSThita,
Aru yisakalara dhana-sampadata Ache nirdhArita hakva (prApya),
khojanIYA-maganIYA Aru vaJcitasakalara vAve,
Aru yisakale pratiphala diৱsaka satya vuli vizvAsa kare|
Aru yisakale nija pratipAlakara zAsti samparke bhIta-santrasta--
nizcaYa teOMlokara pratipAlakara zAsti kono nirApada vastu nahaYa;
Aru yisakale nijara yaunAGgara hiphAjata kare,
kintu siha~tara patnI athavA adhikArabhukta dAsIra vAhire, ene kSetrata siha~ta nindanIYa naha’va--
kintu yisakale eOMlokara vAhire Anaka kAmanA kare, siha~tei sImAlaMghanakArI|
Aru yisakale nijara AmAnata Aru pratizruti rakSA kare,
Aru yisakale sAkSyadAnata aTala,
Aru yisakale nijara chAlAtara hiphAjata kare,
teOMlokei jAnnAtasamUhata sanmAnita ha’va|
kAphirasakalara ki ha’la, siha~te dekhona tomAra phAle DhapalIYAi Ahi Ache?
so~phAlara parA Aru vAOMphAlara parA, dale dale|
siha~tara pratyekei eiTo AzA kare neki ye, tAka prAcuryamaYa jAnnAtata praৱeza karoৱA ha’va?
ketiYAo nahaYa, nizcaYa Ami siha~taka yiTore sRSTi karicho~, seYA siha~te jAne|
eteke mai zapata karicho~ udaYAcala Aru astAcalasamUhara pratipAlakara, nizcaYa Ami sakSama,
siha~tatakai utkRSTasakalaka siha~tara sthalaৱrtI karivalai, Aru eiTo karivalai Ami akSama nahaYa|
eteke siha~taka nirarthaka kathA-vatarA Aru khela-dhemAlita matta hai thAkivalai diYA-- yiTo diৱsara pratizruti siha~taka diYA haiche sei diৱsara sanmukhIna nohoৱA paryanta|
seidinA siha~ta kavarara parA drutavegata olAi Ahiva, ene lAgiva yenivA siha~te kono lakSyasthalara phAle dhAৱita haiche,
siha~tara dRSTisamUha aৱnata aৱsthAta thAkiva, apamAne siha~taka Acchanna kariva| eiToৱe seidiৱsa yAra viSaYe siha~taka satarka karA haichila|
nizcaYa Ami nUhaka teOMra sampradAYara prati ei nirdezasaha preraNa karichilo~ ye, ‘siha~tara ocaralai yantraNAdAYaka zAsti ahAra pUrvei tumi siha~taka satarka kari diYA’|
teOM kaichila, ‘he mora sampradAYa! nizcaYa mai tomAlokara vAve spaSTa satarkakArI--
‘ei viSaYe ye, tomAloke AllAhara ivAdata karA Aru teOMra tAkvaৱA aৱlamvana karA, Aru mora Anugatya karA;

teOM tomAlokara vAve tomAlokara pApasamUha kSamA kariva Aru tomAlokaka eTA nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta aৱkAza diva| nizcaYa AllAhara nirdhArita samaYa upasthita ha’le seYA (ketiYAo) vilamva karA nahaYa; yadi tomAloke eiTo jAnilAhe~tena!’
teOM kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! nizcaYa mai mora sampradAYaka dine rAtiYe AhvAna karicho~,
‘kintu mora AhvAne siha~tara palAYana-praৱNatAhe vRddhi kariche’|

Aru yetiYAi mai siha~taka AhvAna karicho~ yAte tumi siha~taka kSamA karA, siha~te nijara kANata AGulire sopA diche Aru kAporere nijake DhAki laiche, Aru A~koragoja haiche lagate ati dAmbhikatAre auddhatya prakAza kariche|
‘tAra pichato mai siha~taka uccasvare AhvAna karicho~,
‘Akau siha~taka mai prakAzya Aru ati gopanIYabhAৱeo AhvAna karicho~’|
Aru kaicho~, tomAlokara pratipAlakara ocarata kSamA prArthanA karA, nizcaYa teOM mahA kSamAzIla,
teOM tomAlokara vAve pracura parimANe varaSuNa aৱtIrNa kariva,
‘Aru teOM tomAlokaka dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santati pradAna kari sahAYa kariva Aru tomAlokara vAve udyAna sthApana kariva Aru nada-nadI pravAhita kariva|
tomAlokara ki ha'la, tomAloke AllAhara zreSThatva upalavdhi nakarA kiYa?
‘athaca teৱe~i tomAlokaka sRSTi kariche paryAYakrame|
tomAloke lakSya karA nAine, AllAhe kenekai stare stare sAtakhana AkAza sRSTi kariche?
Aru tAta candraka sRSTi kariche pohara hicApe Aru sUryaka vanAiche pradIpa|
‘Aru AllAhe tomAlokaka mATira parA udbhUta kariche,
‘tAra pichata teৱe~i tomAlokaka tAlaike obhatAi niva Aru nizcitabhAৱe tomAlokaka punarutthita kariva,
‘Aru AllAhe pRthiৱIkhanaka tomAlokara vAve vistRta kariche,
‘yAte tomAloke tAta prazasta pathata calAcala kariva pArA’|
nuhe kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! siha~te moka amAnya kariche Aru ene lokara anusaraNa kariche yAra dhana-sampada Aru santAna-santatiYe keৱla tAra kSatihe vRddhi kariche’|
Aru siha~te bhaYAৱha SaDa়yantra kariche;
Aru siha~te kaYa, ‘tomAloke ketiYAo tomAlokara upAsyavoraka varjana nakarivA; lagate parityAga nakarivA adda, chuৱAA, iYAgucha, iYAukva Aru nAcharaka’|
‘nizcaYa siha~te vahulokaka pathabhraSTa kariche, Aru (he AllAha) tumi yAlimasakalara vAve bhraSTatAra vAhire Ana eko vRddhi nakarivA’|
(phalata) siha~tara aparAdhara vAve siha~taka DuvAi diYA ha’la, tAra pichata siha~taka juita praৱeza karoৱA ha’la, eteke siha~te AllAhara vAhire Ana kAko sahAYakArI hicApe poৱA nAchila|
nuhe Aru kaichila, ‘he mora pratipAlaka! pRthiৱIra vukuta kAphirasakalara eTA gRhao aৱziSTa nArAkhivA|
‘yadi tumi siha~taka aৱziSTa rAkhA tente siha~te tomAra vAndAsakalaka pathabhraSTa kariva Aru siha~te keৱla duskRtikArI kAphirakahe janma diva|

he mora pratipAlaka! moka Aru mora pitR-mAtRka, lagate yiYe mumina hai mora gharata praৱeza kariche tAka, Aru mumina puruSa tathA muminA nArIsakalaka kSamA kari diYA; Aru yAlimasakalara vAve dhvaMsara vAhire Ana eko vRddhi nakarivA’|
koৱA, mora prati ahI karA haiche ye, nizcaYa jinasakalara eTA dale manoyoga sahakAre (ei koraAna) zuniche; tAra pichata kaiche, ‘nizcaYa Ami eka vismaYakara koraAna zunicho~,
‘yikhane satyara patha dekhuৱAYa, seYe Ami tAra oparata ImAna Anicho~| gatike Ami ketiYAo AmAra pratipAlakara saite Ana kAko aMzI sthApana nakaro~,
‘Aru nizcaYa AmAra pratipAlakara maryAdA suucca’ teOM kono saGginI Aru kono santAno grahaNa karA nAi|
‘Aru AmAra mAjara nirvodhasakale AllAhara viSaYe avAstaৱ kathA-vatarA kaichila’|
‘athaca Ami dhAraNA karichilo~ ye, mAnuha Aru jina jAtiYe ketiYAo AllAha samparke michA Aropa kariva noৱAre|
‘Aru nizcaYa kichumAna mAnuhe kichumAna jinara AzraYa laichila, phalata siha~te jinasakalara ahaMkAra vRddhi karichila’|
‘Aru nizcaYa siha~teo (mAnuheo) dhAraNA karichila yenekai tomAloke dhAraNA karichA ye, AllAhe kAko ketiYAo punarutthita nakariva’|
‘Aru nizcaYa Ami AkAzara tathya saMgraha kariva vicArichilo~, kintu Ami dekhilo~ ye, AkAzakhana kaThora praharI Aru ulkApiNDara dvArA paripUrNa;
‘Aru Ami Agate AkAzara vibhinna ghA~Tita saMvAda zunAra vAve vahichilo~ kintu etiYA konovAi saMvAda zunivalai vicArile si jalanta ulkApiNDara sanmukhIna ha'valagIYA haYa|
‘Aru nizcaYa Ami nAjAno ye, pRthiৱIvAsIra vAve amaGgala vicarA haiche, ne siha~tara pratipAlake siha~tara maGgala vicAriche|
Aru nizcaYa AmAra mAjara kichumAna haiche satkarmazIla Aru kichumAna iYAra vyatikrama, Ami Achilo~ vibhinna pathara anusArI;
‘Aru Ami vuji pAicho~ ye, Ami pRthiৱIta ketiYAo AllAhaka apAraga kariva noৱArima Aru palAYana kario teOMka vyartha kariva noৱArima|
‘gatike Ami yetiYA hidAYatara vANI zunilo~, tetiYA tAra prati ImAna Anilo~| eteke yiYe tAra pratipAlakara prati ImAna Aniva, tAra kono kSati Aru kono anyAYara AzaMkA nAthAkiva|
‘Aru nizcaYa AmAra mAjata Ache kichu saMkhyaka AtmasamarpaNakArI Aru kichu saMkhyaka Ache sImAlaMghanakArI; eteke yisakale ichalAma grahaNa kariche siha~tei saThika patha vAci laiche|
‘AnahAte sImAlaMghanakArIsakala haiche jAhAnnAmarei indhana’|
Aru yadi siha~te saThika pathata avicala thAkilahe~tena, teneha’le Ami siha~taka nizcaYa pracura parimANe pAnI pAna karAlo~he~tena,
yAte Ami iYAra dvArA siha~taka parIkSA kariva pAro~; Aru yiYe nija pratipAlakara smaraNara parA mukha ghUrAi laYa, tAka teOM kaThina zAstita praৱeza karAva|
Aru nizcaYa machajidasamUha AllAhara vAvei (nirmita), gatike tomAloke AllAhara lagata Ana kAko nAmAtivA|
Aru nizcaYa yetiYA AllAhara vAndAi teOMka prArthanA karivalai thiYa ha’la, tetiYA siha~te teOMra ocarata Ahi bhira karile|
koৱA, ‘mai keৱla mora pratipAlakakei AhvAna karo~ Aru teOMra lagata Ana kAko AMzI nakaro~’|
koৱA, ‘nizcaYa mai tomAlokara kono kSati Aru kalyANara mAlika nahaYa’|
koৱA, nizcaYa AllAhara parA koneo moka rakSA kariva noৱAriva Aru teOMra vAhire mai ketiYAo kono AzraYa nApAma|
